jobs.title: Director: National School Nutrition Programme (NSNP)
jobs.summary: Director role leading the National School Nutrition Programme, overseeing the conditional grant and national coordination. Requires NQF Level 7 qualification and five years' managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: The applicant must be in possession of a qualification at NQF Level 7 as recognised by SAQA , 5 years’ experience at a Middle/Senior managerial level In-depth experience in school nutrition, nutrition or food security programming, conditional grant programme management, or a comparable large-scale public sector programme, together with a sound understanding of the National School Nutrition Programme; Experience in policy formulation and implementation processes; Experience in managing diverse stakeholders and working effectively with communities; Strong analytical, strategic, research, programme and project-management skills; A sound understanding of the national, provincial, district and school interface within the education sector; Knowledge and understanding of nutrition/dietetics and related research; Knowledge and understanding of Government’s strategic vision and Public Service legislation and policies applicable to the education sector; Knowledge of the public sector policy, legislative and regulatory environment, particularly the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) and Public Service Regulations (PSR); and An understanding of Government strategies and interventions relevant to the work of the Directorate. Process competencies: Knowledge Management; Service Delivery Innovation; Report Writing; Problem Solving and Analysis; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; and Communication. Core competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership; Programme and Project Management; Financial Management; Knowledge Management; People Management and Empowerment; Communication; Innovation; and Creativity. Applicants must have a valid driver’s license and be willing to travel extensively. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong computer literacy and the ability to work collaboratively and effectively in a dynamic and demanding environment.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will provide strategic leadership and management of the National School Nutrition Programme and will be responsible for the national coordination, oversight and monitoring of the NSNP Conditional Grant, including programme implementation, compliance with the applicable grant framework, performance monitoring and reporting. Leading the development, review and implementation of norms, standards, policies and related measures for the National School Nutrition Programme; Providing strategic leadership in relation to the implementation of the three components of the NSNP, namely school feeding, nutrition education and sustainable food production; Coordinating the integration of the NSNP with relevant Government programmes, including the Integrated Food Security and Nutrition Programme (IFSNP); Overseeing, supporting and monitoring the implementation of the NSNP across provincial, district and school levels to promote consistent, efficient and quality programme delivery; Monitoring provincial implementation and performance against applicable grant requirements, programme objectives and agreed targets; Coordinating and supporting the preparation of programme and financial performance reports for relevant oversight structures; Evaluating programme implementation and impact in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and use evidence to inform programme improvement; Establishing and implement appropriate risk-management measures to strengthen accountability, governance and service-delivery outcomes; Managing and supervising national DBE officials within the NSNP Directorate, and provide strategic coordination, guidance, support and oversight in relation to NSNP implementation by provincial education departments; Leading and coordinating engagement with provincial education departments, other Government departments, communities and relevant stakeholders to promote alignment with departmental priorities and Government interventions; Promoting sound financial management and continuously monitor compliance with applicable Public Service prescripts and financial-management requirements; and Performing such other functions as may reasonably be required in support of the effective management and implementation of the National School Nutrition Programme.

af.title: Direkteur: National School Nutrition Programme (NSNP)
af.summary: Direkteursrol wat die Nasionale Skoolvoedingsprogram lei, met toesig oor die voorwaardelike toekenning en nasionale koördinasie. Vereis 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring.
af.requirements: Die aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n kwalifikasie op NQF Level 7 soos deur SAQA erken. 5 years' ervaring op 'n Midde/Senior bestuursvlak. Diepgaande ervaring in skoolvoeding, voeding of voedselsekerheidsprogrammering, bestuur van voorwaardelike toekenningsprogramme, of 'n vergelykbare grootskaalse openbare sektor-program, tesame met 'n deeglike begrip van die Nasionale Skoolvoedingsprogram. Ervaring in beleidsformulering en implementeringsprosesse. Ervaring in die bestuur van diverse belanghebbendes en die doeltreffende saamwerk met gemeenskappe. Sterk analitiese, strategiese, navorsings-, program- en projekbestuursvaardighede. 'n Deeglike begrip van die nasionale, provinsiale, distriks- en skoolkoppelvlak binne die onderwyssektor. Kennis en begrip van voeding/dieetkunde en verwante navorsing. Kennis en begrip van die Regering se strategiese visie en Openbare Dienswetgewing en -beleide van toepassing op die onderwyssektor. Kennis van die openbare sektor se beleids-, wetgewende en regulatoriese omgewing, veral die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) en Public Service Regulations (PSR). 'n Begrip van Regeringsstrategieë en -intervensies wat relevant is tot die werk van die Direktoraat. Prosesbevoegdhede: Kennisbestuur; Dienslewering-inovasie; Verslagskrywing; Probleemoplossing en Analise; Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus; en Kommunikasie. Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese Vermoë en Leierskap; Program- en Projekbestuur; Finansiële Bestuur; Kennisbestuur; Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging; Kommunikasie; Innovasie; en Skeppendheid. Aansoekers moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê en bereid wees om uitgebreid te reis. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet sterk rekenaarvaardighede toon en die vermoë hê om saamwerkend en doeltreffend in 'n dinamiese en veeleisende omgewing te werk.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal strategiese leierskap en bestuur van die Nasionale Skoolvoedingsprogram verskaf en verantwoordelik wees vir die nasionale koördinasie, toesig en monitering van die NSNP-voorwaardelike toekenning, insluitend programimplementering, nakoming van die toepaslike toekenningsraamwerk, prestasiemonitering en verslagdoening. Die leiding neem met die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van norme, standaarde, beleide en verwante maatreëls vir die Nasionale Skoolvoedingsprogram; Verskaf strategiese leierskap ten opsigte van die implementering van die drie komponente van die NSNP, naamlik skoolvoeding, voedingsopvoeding en volhoubare voedselproduksie; Koördineer die integrasie van die NSNP met tersaaklike Regeringsprogramme, insluitend die Geïntegreerde Voedselsekerheid en Voedingsprogram (IFSNP); Oorsien, ondersteun en monitor die implementering van die NSNP oor provinsiale, distriks- en skoolvlakke om konstante, doeltreffende en gehalte-programlewering te bevorder; Monitor provinsiale implementering en prestasie teen toepaslike toekenningvereistes, programdoelwitte en ooreengekome teikens; Koördineer en ondersteun die voorbereiding van program- en finansiële prestasieverslae vir tersaaklike toesigstrukture; Evalueer programimplementering en impak in samewerking met tersaaklike belanghebbendes en gebruik bewyse om programverbetering in te lig; Stel en implementeer toepaslike risikobestuurmaatreëls om verantwoordelikheid, beheer en dienslewering-uitkomste te versterk; Bestuur en onder toesig neem nasionale DBE-amptenare binne die NSNP-direktoraat, en verskaf strategiese koördinasie, leiding, ondersteuning en toesig ten opsigte van NSNP-implementering deur provinsiale onderwysdepartemente; Neem die leiding en koördineer betrokkenheid by provinsiale onderwysdepartemente, ander Regeringsdepartemente, gemeenskappe en tersaaklike belanghebbendes om belyning met departementele prioriteite en Regeringsintervensies te bevorder; Bevorder gesonde finansiële bestuur en monitor voortdurend nakoming van toepaslike Openbare Diensvoorskrifte en finansiële bestuursvereistes; en Enige ander funksies uitvoer wat redelikerwys vereis mag word ter ondersteuning van die doeltreffende bestuur en implementering van die Nasionale Skoolvoedingsprogram.

zu.title: Umongameli: National School Nutrition Programme (NSNP)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaDirector esiholela i-National School Nutrition Programme, sibheke isibonelelo esimibele kanye nokubambisana kwesifunda. Sidinga isiqu sika-NQF Level 7 kanye nesipiliyoni seminyaka eyi-5 sokuba ngumphathi.
zu.requirements: Umuntu okufaka isicelo kumele abe nesiqu ezingeni NQF Level 7 njengoba samkelwa yi-SAQA. Uzama iminyakaengu-5 ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi noma ophakeme. Isipiliyoni esijulile ekudleni kwezikole, ekudleni noma ohlelweni lokutholakala kwengelelo yokudla, ekuphathweni kohlelo lwesibonelelo, noma ohlelweni olubheke kakhulu emphakathini olulinganisekayo, kanye nokuzuva okuhle i-National School Nutrition Programme; Isipiliyoni ekwakheni imigomo kanye nasekuqhubeni imikhuba; Isipiliyoni ekuphatheni abantu abalingene kanye nokusebenza kahle nemiphakathi; Amakhono okuhlaziya, okusesiqiniseko, okuphenya, kohlelo nolwemiklamo; Ukwaziswa okuhle mayelana nokuxhumanisa amazwe, isifundazwe, isifunda nesikole ngaphakathi kwesigaba somfundvo; Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukudla/ukudla okusezingeni lomuntu nokuphenya okuhlobene; Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda umbono wesiqiniseko kaHulumeni kanye nomthethosisekelo wezeNkonzo yaZwidu nagemigomo esebenza kwesigaba somfundvo; Ulwazi lomthetho, imigomo kanye nendawo ekuphethweni kwesifunda, ikakhulukazi i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) kanye ne-Public Service Regulations (PSR); kanye Nokuqonda izinkambiso kanye nezinye izindlela zokuqhuba zikahulumene ezihlobene nomsebenzi weDirectorate. Amakhono okusebenza: Ukuphatha Ulwazi; Intuthuko yokuhlinzeka ngesevisi; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya; Ukubhekwa kwamakhasimende kanye nokuqotho kwabo; kanye Nokuxhumana. Amakhono abalulekile: Ikhono lokusesiqiniseko kanye noholo; Ukuphatha uhlelo nemiklamo; Ukuphatha izimali; Ukuphatha ulwazi; Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokusinika amandla; Ukuxhumana; Intuthuko; kanye Nokwakha. Abafaki isicelo kumele babe nelayisense elivumelekile lokushayela futhi bazimisele ukuhamba kakhulu. Umuntu oyisiqaphamandla kumele abonise ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuytha futhi akwazi ukusebenza ngokubambisana kahle endaweni eguqukayo futhi edinga kakhulu.
zu.duties: Umuntu oyisiqaphamandla uzohola ngokwesiqiniseko futhi abuphathe uhlelo lokuphathwa i-National School Nutrition Programme futhi uzobheke ukubambisana kwesifunda, ukuphenya kanye nokulandelela i-NSNP Conditional Grant, okuhlanganisa ukuphatha uhlelo, ukuzwisa emigomeni ohlelweni lolusito olusebenzayo, ukulandelela ukusebenza kanye nokuvela kwemibiko. Ukuhola ekwakheni, ukubuyekeza nasekuphotheni imigomo, izindingo kanye nezinye izindlela ezihlobene ne-National School Nutrition Programme; Ukunikeza uholo olusesiqiniseko mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinhlobo ezintathu ze-NSNP, okungukuthi ukudla ezikoleni, imfundo yokudla kanye nokukhiqiza ukudla okuhlolakalayo; Ukubambisana ekuhlanganiseni i-NSNP ohlelweni oluhlobene lwesiKhashimazwe, okuhlanganisa i-Integrated Food Security and Nutrition Programme (IFSNP); Ukubuka, ukusekela kanye nokulandelela ukuphathwa kwe-NSNP emazingeni esifundazwe, wesifunda nasesikoleni ukuze kuvunyelwe ukuphathwa okuhambisana, okusebenza kahle futhi nobuningi; Ukulandelela ukuphathwa kanye nokusebenza esifundazweni mayelana nezidingo ezisebenzayo zesibonelelo, injongo yohlelo kanye namaphakhiwo avunyelwene; Ukubambisana kanye nokusekela ukulungiselela imibiko yokusebenza kanye nezimali mayelana izinhloko eziphenya; Ukubuyekeza ukuphathwa kohlelo kanye nomphumela ngokubambisana nabaluleki futhi use iziqiniseko ukukhombisa ukuthuthuka kohlelo; Ukwakha futhi kuphothe izindlela ezifanele zokuphatha ubungozi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ithubo lokuphatha, umthethosisekelo kanye namaphakhiwo omphakathi; Ukuphatha kanye nokuhlola izikhulu ze-DBF ezifunda ngaphakathi kwesikhungo se-NSNP, futhi anikeze ukubambisana ngokwesiqiniseko, imiyalo, ukusekela kanye nokuqhathanisa mayelana nokuphathwa kwe-NSNP emaphandleni imfundo yesifundazwe; Ukuhola kanye nokubambisana ekuxhumeni namaphandle imfundo yesifundazwe, emanyeni amanye amaphandlesi, emiphakathini nabaluleki ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhambisana namaphakhiwo abalulekile futhi ukungenelela kwesifunda; Ukuthuthukisa ukuphatha kwezimali futhi ahlale alandelela ukuzwisa emigomeni ohlelweni olusebenzayo futhi izidingo zokuphatha izimali; kanye Nokwenza eminye imisebenzi engadingeka ngokobuhlakani ekusekeleni ukuphatha futhi ukuphatha i-National School Nutrition Programme.

xh.title: uDirektha: National School Nutrition Programme (NSNP)
xh.summary: Indima kaDirector eholisa iNational School Nutrition Programme, ilawula imali ethathwa ngesiko nolungelelaniso lwesizwe. Ifuna iNQF Level 7 qualification kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava obulungisa.
xh.requirements: Umsebenzisi kufuneka abe nawe ngesimemo sokuba negunya kwiNQF Level 7 njengoko kubonakalise iSAQA; 5 years’ experience at a Middle/Senior managerial level Ulwazi olunzulu kwinkqubo yesondlo sikolweni, isondlo okanye inkqubo yokhuseleko lokutya, ulawulo lwenkqubo yemali ethathwa ngesiko, okanye inkqubo ekulinganiswa nayo kwindawo ehle yomphakathi, kunye neqondo eliqinileyo lokuyiqonda iNational School Nutrition Programme; Amava ekuqameni iinkqubo zezicwangciso nokuziphatha kwazo; Amava ekuhoyeni abantu abahlukeneyo nasekubambisweni nabemi; Amakhono anamandla okuhlola, amaqhinga, uphando, ulawulo lwenkqubo namaprojekthi; Ukuqonda okuqinileyo kwindibano kazwelonke, eyephondo, yesithili nesikolo kummandla wemfundo; Ulwazi nokuqonda ngosondlo/ukutya okunyibilikayo nopho oluhlobene nalo; Ulwazi nokuqonda ngabom baStrathiji karhulumente nakuMthetho weSebe loLwazi loWoP wonke namapholisi asetyenziswa kwimfundo; Ulwazi ngepholisi yomphakathi, konke okusesiqwagxeni somthetho naloonkqubo zolawulo, ngakumbi uPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), uPreferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) namaPublic Service Regulations (PSR); nokuyiqonda iinqubomgomo zarhulumente nezinyamezelo ezihambelana nomsebenzi weDirectorate. Iinkqubo zokusebenza: Ulawulo lolwazi; Iindlela ezitsha zokunikezela iinkonzo; Ukubhalwa kwemibiko; Ukuqxada iingxaki nokuqonda iziphumo; Ukuqonda abathengi nogxile kumthengi; kunye nonxibelelwano. Iinkqubo eziyimfuno: Ikhono leStrathiji noQondo alawulo; Ulawulo lwenkqubo namaprojekthi; Ulawulo lweemali; Ulawulo lolwazi; Ulawulo labantu nokuqinisekisa amandla abo; Unxibelelwano; Iindlela ezitsha; kunye nobuchule bokuyila. Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nelaysensi yomqhubi egqithisiweyo baze bavume ukuhamba kakhulu. Umceli-mgama opumeleleyo kufuneka abonise ubuchule obuqinileyo ekusebenzeni ngekhompyutha nakhono lokusebenza ngokubambisana ngenndlela efezekayo kwindawo ethathiweyo ezele yimisebenzi.

jobs.title: Audit and Risk Committee Members
jobs.salary_text: Remuneration shall be in accordance with National Treasury Regulations 3.1.6, read with National Regulations 20.2.3. Members will be remunerated for preparation and attendance of the meeting.
jobs.summary: The Department of Basic Education seeks Audit and Risk Committee members in Pretoria to oversee internal controls, risk management and audit processes, remunerated per National Treasury Regulations.
jobs.requirements: The applicant must be in possession of NQF Level 6 in Accounting, Auditing, Finance, Compliance, Business Management, Risk Management, IT or Law;, as recognised by SAQA; Committee Chairperson: Minimum of 10 years of senior/executive; Audit Committee Members: 5-10 years of senior/executive management experience; Combine experience for the committee members and chairpersons: Auditing, Governance, Risk Management, Information Communication Technology, Organisational Performance Management, Performance Information, External Auditing or Legal; Prior committee experience (Audit, Risk Anti-Fraud) is strongly preferred. Competencies: Attributes and skills highly independent, integrity, objectivity, reliability, knowledge of governance process and risk management principles and internal control, good communication skills, strong leadership skills and knowledge of Education Sector.
jobs.duties: Audit Committee Members (Including Chairperson): Participating in audit committee meetings and deliberations; Reviewing internal controls, risk management and governance processes; Overseeing and approving internal and external audit plans and outcomes; Monitoring implementation of audit recommendations; Reviewing financial and performance reporting. Additional Responsibilities of Audit Committee Chairperson: Leading and facilitating committee meetings; Guiding strategic discussions on key risks; Engaging with management, internal and external auditors. Providing strategic guidance to accounting officer and executive authority on the Departmental governance process. Risk Management Committee Chairperson: Chairing the Risk Management Committee and serve on the Audit Committee; Providing strategic oversight to accounting officer and executive authority on risk management frameworks and practices; Advising the accounting officer and the executive authority on risk identification, mitigation, and risk appetite. Monitoring implementation of risk mitigation plans; Overseeing Business Continuity Management (BCM) and fraud prevention; Presenting quarterly risk reports to the Audit Committee.

af.title: Lede van die Oudit- en Risikokomitee
af.summary: Die Department of Basic Education soek lede vir die Oudit- en Risikokomitee in Pretoria om interne kontroles, risikobestuur en ouditprosesse te oorsien, vergoed volgens Nasionale Tesourie Regulasies.
af.requirements: Die aansoeker moet oor NQF Level 6 beskik in Rekeningkunde, Ouditering, Finansies, Nalewing, Besigheidsbestuur, Risikobestuur, IT of Regte;, soos erken deur SAQA; Komiteevoorsitter: Minimum van 10 jaar se senior/uitvoerende; Ouditkomiteelede: 5-10 jaar se senior/uitvoerende bestuurservaring; Kombinasie van ervaring vir die komiteelede en voorsitters: Ouditering, Bestuur, Risikobestuur, Inligtingkommunikasietegnologie, Organisasiewerkverrigtingsbestuur, Werkverrigtingsinligting, Eksterne Ouditering of Regte; Vorige komitee-ervaring (Oudit, Risiko, Bedrogvoorkoming) word sterk verkies. Bevoegdhede: Attribuute en vaardighede hoogs onafhanklik, integriteit, objektiwiteit, betroubaarheid, kennis van bestuursprosesse en risikobestuursbeginsels en interne beheer, goeie kommunikasievaardighede, sterk leierskapsvaardighede en kennis van die Onderwyssektor.
af.duties: Ouditkomiteelede (insluitend voorsitter): Neem deel aan ouditkomiteevergaderings en beraadsligings; Hersien interne kontroles, risikobestuur en bestuursprosesse; Oorsien en keur interne en eksterne ouditplanne en uitkomste goed; Monitor implementering van oudit-aanbevelings; Hersien finansiële en werkverrigtingsverslaggewing. Bykomende verantwoordelikhede van die Ouditkomiteevoorsitter: Lei en fasiliteer komiteevergaderings; Rig strategiese besprekings oor sleutelrisiko's; Skakel met bestuur, interne en eksterne ouditeure. Verskaf strategiese leiding aan rekenpligtige beampte en uitvoerende gesag oor die departementale bestuursproses. Risikobestuurskomiteevoorsitter: Voorsit die Risikobestuurskomitee en dien op die Ouditkomitee; Verskaf strategiese toesig aan rekenpligtige beampte en uitvoerende gesag oor risikobestuursraamwerke en -praktyke; Adviseer die rekenpligtige beampte en die uitvoerende gesag oor risiko-identifikasie, mitigasie en risiko-aptyt. Monitor implementering van risikomitasieplanne; Oorsien Besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuur (BCM) en bedrogvoorkoming; Lewer kwartaallikse risikoverslae aan die Ouditkomitee.

zu.title: Amalungu eKomidi Yokubuyekezwa Nangozi
zu.summary: I-Department of Basic Education ifuna amalungu ekomidi yokubuyekezwa nangozi ePretoria ukuze aqaphe izilawuli zangaphakathi, ukuphathwa kwezingozi namaprocesses okubuyekezwa, akhokhiswe njengokuqondiswa koMthetho weNdlu Yegcinwa Likazwelonke.
zu.requirements: Isicelo kumele sibe namakhredithi eNQF Level 6 kwezimali, ekuhlolweni kwamabhuku, ezezimali, ekuvumeleni, ekuphathweni kwezohwebo, ekuphathweni kwezingozi, kwe-IT noma ngomthetho njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA; USihlalo weKomidi: Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 esikhundleni esiphezulu/abaphathi; Amalungu eKomidi Yokubuyekezwa: iminyaka eyi-5-10 yokuhola esikhundleni esiphezulu/abaphathi; Uhlanganise lolu hlu lwamakhredithi ngamalungu ngesihlalo: ukuhlola amabhuku, ukulawula, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, Ubuchwepheshe Bolwazi Loxhumano, Ukuphathwa Kokwenza Kwezinhlangano, Ulwazi Ngokwenza, ukuhlola amabhuku angaphandle noma umthetho; Ngaphambili ukuba ngumuntu wekomidi (Yokubuyekezwa, Yokuphathwa Kwengozi Nokulwa Nenkohliso) kuthandwa kakhulu. Ikhono: Izimo namakhono ahlukene kakhulu, ukuzimela, inqondo elungile, ukuthembeka, ulwazi ngamaprocesses obulungiswa nangamaphimiso okuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nesilawuli sangaphakathi, amakhono wokuxhumana kahle, amakhono aqinile okuhola kanye nolwazi ngomkhakha weMfundo.
zu.duties: Amalungu Akomidi Yokubuyekezwa (Kuhlanganise nosihlalo): Ukubambe iqhaza emihlanganweni yekomidi yokubuyekezwa nasezinkulumweni zephimiso; Ukubuyekeza izilawuli zangaphakathi, ukuphathwa kwezingozi namaprocesses obulungiswa; Ukuqapha futhi kuvume izinhlelo zemiphumela yokubuyekezwa yangaphakathi nangaphandle; Ukuqapha ukuphathwa kwezincomo zokubuyekezwa; Ukubuyekeza ukubika ngemali nangokwenza. Izibopho Ezingeziwe Zosihlalo weKomidi Yokubuyekezwa: Ukuhola futhi kuphathe imihlangano yekomidi; Ukuhola izinkulumo eziguquguqukayo mayelana nezingozi eziyinhloko; Ukuxhumana nabaphathi, nababuyekezi bahlele bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondiswa okuguquguqukayo umphathi wamabhuku nosigungu esiphezulu mayelana namaprocesses obulungiswa bakaMnyango. Uhlalo weKomidi Yokuphathwa Kwezingozi: Ukuba nguSihlalo weKomidi Yokuphathwa Kwezingozi futhi ukhonze eKomidini Yokubuyekezwa; Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondiswa okuguquguqukayo kumphathi wamabhuku nosigungu esiphezulu mayelana namasimu nendlela zokuphathwa kwezingozi; Ukulekelela umphathi wamabhuku nosigungu esiphezulu ekuboniseni izingozi, ekunciphiseni, nasekutheni kuthatheke izingozi. Ukuqapha ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokunciphisa izingozi; Ukuqapha ukuphathwa Kokuqhubeka Kobuchwepheshe Bezohwebo (BCM) nokuvikela ukukhwabanisa; Ukubika ngesikhathi esinye ngamakhomu izingxoxo eKomidini Yokubuyekezwa.

xh.title: Amalungu eKomiti yoKuhlola nokuLawula uYingozi
xh.summary: Isebe leZemfundo eBekiseleyo lifuna amalungu eKomiti yoKuhlola nokuLawula uYingozi ePretoria ukuba alawule izilawulo zangaphakathi, ulawulo loyingozi nenkqubo zohlolo, ahlawulwe ngokweMigaqo yeQhawe leSizwe.
xh.requirements: Umceli-msebenzi kufuneka abe nakwiNqanaba leNQF 6 kwi-Accounting, Auditing, Finance, Compliance, Business Management, Risk Management, IT okanye iLaw;, njengoko kugunyaziswe yi-SAQA; USihalo beKomiti: Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-10 njengomlawuli ophakamile/owasezulwini; Amalungu eKomiti yoKuhlola: Iminyaka eli-5-10 yamava obulawuli ophakamile/owasezulwini; Udibanisa amava amalungu ekomiti neesihalo: Auditing, Governance, Risk Management, Information Communication Technology, Organisational Performance Management, Performance Information, External Auditing okanye iLegal; Amava ngaphambili bekomiti (Audit, Risk Anti-Fraud) aqatywa ngokuba mangcangca. Ikhono: Iimpawu nanamava ezimeleyo kakhulu, integriti, ukuzenzekelayo, ukuthembeka, ulwazi lwenkqubo yolawulo nemigaqo yolawulo loyingozi nolawulo lwangaphakathi, izakhono ezilungeleleneyo zokunxibelelanisa, izakhono ezomeleleyo zokulawula nolwazi lweSektor yeZemfundo.
xh.duties: Amalungu eKomiti yoKuhlola (kuquka uSihalo): Ukubamba iqhaza kwiindibano zekomiti yokuhlola nengxoxo; Ukuphonononga izilawulo zangaphakathi, ulawulo loyingozi nenkqubo kolawulo; Ukulawula nokuvuma iindlela zohlolo zangaphakathi nangaphandle nemveliso; Ukulandelela ukusebenziswa iindululo zohlolo; Ukuphonononga ingxelo zemali nenzalo. Isebenzo Esongezelekileyo soSihalo beKomiti yoKuhlola: Ukukhokela nokwenza kube lula iindibano zekomiti; Ukukhokela ingxoxo ngamacebo amatsha malunga neengozi eziphambili; Ukusebenzisana nabaphathi, abaHloli bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukubonelela ngokuqondisa ngeenjongo kuqeqeshi-mali negunya eliphezulu malunga nenkqubo yolawulo yesebe. USihalo beKomiti yoLawulo loYingozi: Ukukhokela iKomiti yoLawulo loYingozi nokusebenza kuKomiti yoKuhlola; Ukubonelela ngokuqondisa ngamabala kuqeqeshi-mali negunya eliphezulu malunga neenkqubo namasu olawulo loyingozi; Ukucebisa iqeqeshi-mali negunya eliphezulu malanga nokuchonga iyingozi, ukunciphisa iyingozi, nokumelwa neyingozi. Ukulandelela ukusebenziswa iindlela zokunciphisa iyingozi; Ukulawula ulawulo loQhubekayo lweShishini (BCM) nokuthintela ubuzenzakali; Ukubonelela ngeengxelo zenyanga zintathu ezimalunga neyingozi kuKomiti yoKuhlola.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.summary: Deputy Director Chief Information Security Officer position at the Department of Basic Education in Pretoria, responsible for cybersecurity programmes and safeguarding IT infrastructure.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of NQF level 6 post matric qualification in Information Technology/Information Systems or equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA; Four (4) years relevant experience as an Assistant Director or equivalent; A minimum of two (2) certifications in any of the following: ITIL, COBIT, CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, ISO 27001 plus a minimum of at least five (5) years’ experience as a Chief Information Security Officer/ Information Security Officer; Experience in managing networks; Sound knowledge of Enterprise or Technology architecture environment is required, strategic management, information and communication technology systems and processes; Sound knowledge of Microsoft environment, virtualised, cloud environments; Sound knowledge of business continuity management; Sound knowledge of the E-government strategy and roadmap, interactive communication, problem solving and analytical thinking orientation, planning and organising skills, project management skills, strategic thinking; Understanding organisational information flows and maintaining an inventory of data; Understanding the data classification framework and implementing controls in accordance with the sensitivity levels; Vulnerability awareness through an understanding of the vulnerability Detection and management program; Patching and Remediation SLAs and Agreed-upon timelines for addressing security vulnerabilities; A valid driver's license.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for CyberSecurity Program: Designing, configuring, deploying, and maintaining security controls to safeguard the Department’s infrastructure; Actively protecting the Department’s information technology assets and infrastructure from external or internal threats and ensuring compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements regarding information access, security, and privacy; Analysing problems and recommending solutions, products and technologies to meet the Organisation’s security and information security objectives; Performing security assessments for all systems and applications and checking for compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations in projects and new system design implementation; Developing and interpreting the cybersecurity strategy and framework; Interpreting cybersecurity maturity levels and implementing road maps; Leading the implementation of best practice network security controls across cloud environments and On-premises platforms to maintain resistance against cyberattacks; Focusing on the safe adoption of AI integration; Data protection and encryption: Ensuring sensitive information is identified and adequately protected; Developing or installing software, such as data-at-rest encryption programs and SSL certificates to protect sensitive information in transit and in use; Supporting the development of disaster response and recovery strategies and its implementation within the DBE; Troubleshooting security and network problems to maintain a fit-for-purpose DR site and business continuity plans; Network, web, and Endpoint Security and monitoring; Threat and Vulnerability Management: Leading threat landscape assessment and situational Cyber-attack; Ensuring vulnerability assessments and penetration tests are performed periodically; Analysing and interpreting vulnerability results and facilitating remediation of identified vulnerabilities at Protection and Response Maturity levels in conjunction with other business application owners; Providing reports to Senior Management on the vulnerability management program. Incident response and third-line support: Providing third-line support to any Information security-related queries; Overseeing and providing advanced incident response support for breaches, intrusions, or data theft; Performing Third-Party Risk Management: Effective monitoring of supplier security postures; Ensuring rapid recovery capabilities. Delivering on Security Projects within budget; Training employees on Information Security.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Hoofinligtingssekuriteitsbeampte
af.summary: Pos van Adjunkdirekteur Hoofinligtingssekuriteitsbeampte by die Department of Basic Education in Pretoria, verantwoordelik vir kuberveiligheidsprogramme en die beskerming van IT-infrastruktuur.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n NQF-vlak 6 post-matriekkwalifikasie in Inligtingstegnologie/Inligtingstelsels of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken besit; Vier (4) jaar relevante ervaring as 'n Assistentdirekteur of gelykwaardig; 'n Minimum van twee (2) sertifiserings in enigeen van die volgende: ITIL, COBIT, CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, ISO 27001 plus 'n minimum van ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring as 'n Hoofinligtingssekuriteitsbeampte/Inligtingssekuriteitsbeampte; Ervaring in die bestuur van netwerke; Degelike kennis van Enterprise- of Tegnologie-argitektuuromgewing word vereis, strategiese bestuur, inligtings- en kommunikasietegnologie-stelsels en -prosesse; Degelike kennis van Microsoft-omgewing, gevirtualiseerde, wolkomgewings; Degelike kennis van besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuur; Degelike kennis van die E-regeringstrategie en -padkaart, interaktiewe kommunikasie, probleemoplossing en analitiese dinkoriëntasie, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, projekbestuursvaardighede, strategiese denke; Begrip van organisatoriese inligtingsvloeie en die onderhoud van 'n data-inventaris; Begrip van die dataklassifikasieraamwerk en die implementering van kontroles ooreenkomstig die sensitiwiteitsvlakke; Kwesbaarheidsbewustheid deur 'n begrip van die kwesbaarheidsopsporings- en bestuursprogram; Regstellings en Herstel-SLA's en ooreengekome tydlyne vir die aanspreek van sekuriteitskwesbaarhede; 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die CyberSecurity-program: Ontwerp, konfigureer, ontplooi en onderhou sekuriteitskontroles om die departement se infrastruktuur te beskerm; Beskerm aktief die departement se inligtingstegnologie-bates en infrastruktuur teen eksterne of interne bedreigings en verseker nakoming van statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes rakende inligtingstoegang, sekuriteit en privaatheid; Analiseer probleme en beveel oplossings, produkte en tegnologieë aan om die organisasie se sekuriteits- en inligtingssekuriteitsdoelwitte te bereik; Voer sekuriteitsassessering uit vir alle stelsels en toepassings en kontroleer vir nakoming van kuberveiligheidsstandaarde en -regulasies in projekte en nuwe stelselontwerp-implementering; Ontwikkel en interpreter die kuberveiligheidsstrategie en -raamwerk; Interpreter kuberveiligheidsvolwassenheidsvlakke en implementeer padkaarte; Lei die implementering van best-practice-netwerksekuriteitskontroles oor wolkomgewings en plaaslike platforms om weerstand teen kuberaanvalle te handhaaf; Fokus op die veilige aanvaarding van KI-integrasie; Databeskerming en -versleuteling: Verseker dat sensitiewe inligting geïdentifiseer en behoorlik beskerm word; Ontwikkel of installeer sagteware, soos data-at-rest-versleutelingsprogramme en SSL-sertifikate om sensitiewe inligting in oordrag en in gebruik te beskerm; Ondersteun die ontwikkeling van rampreaksie- en herstelstrategieë en die implementering daarvan binne die DBE; Los sekuriteits- en netwerkprobleme op om 'n geskikte DR-werf en besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne te handhaaf; Netwerk-, web- en eindpuntsekuriteit en monitering; Bedreigings- en kwesbaarheidsbestuur: Lei bedreigingslandskap-assessering en situasionele kuberaanval; Verseker dat kwesbaarheidsassesserings en penetrasietoetse periodiek uitgevoer word; Analiseer en interpreter kwesbaarheidsresultate en fasiliteer die herstel van geïdentifiseerde kwesbaarhede op Volwassenheidsvlakke vir Beskerming en Reaksie in samewerking met ander besigheidstoepassingseienaars; Verskaf verslae aan Senior Bestuur oor die kwesbaarheidsbestuursprogram. Voorvalreaksie en derdelynondersteuning: Verskaf derdelynondersteuning vir enige inligtingssekuriteitsverwante navrae; Hou toesig oor en verskaf gevorderde voorvalreaksie-ondersteuning vir skendings, indringings of datadiefstal; Voer Derdeparty-risikobestuur uit: Effektiewe monitering van verskaffersekuriteidsposisies; Verseker vinnige herstelvermoëns. Lewer Sekuriteitsprojekte binne begroting; Verskaf opleiding aan werknemers oor inligtingssekuriteit.

zu.title: Deputy Director: Chief Information Security Officer
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Deputy Director Chief Information Security Officer e-Department of Basic Education e-Pretoria, sibhekene namaphrojekthi we-cybersecurity kanye nokuvikela isakhiwo se-IT.
zu.requirements: Abafakwayo kumele babe nethifikethi lesikhundla esingesikhundla esingaphansi kuka-NQF level 6 ku-Information Technology/Information Systems noma ithifikethi elingakuningi noma elilingana njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA; Ukuba namava amane (4) okuhamba kahle njengoAssistant Director noma njengezinye ezifana nalo; Ubuncwane besithifikethi sezinkalashe (2) kunoma yisiphi esilandelayo: ITIL, COBIT, CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, ISO 27001 kanye nobuncwane bamava amakhulu amahlanu (5) njengoChief Information Security Officer/Information Security Officer; Abasebenzayo abanamava ekuphathweni kwe-inethiwekhi; Ukwazi kahle isimo sobuchwepheshe be-Enterprise noma i-Technology kuyadingeka, ukuphathwa okuhle kwentshitshiso, izinhlelo zolwazi kanye nobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana namanqubo; Ukuzuza ulwazi oluwumqondo oqhubekayo ngendawo ye-Microsoft, kwezimo eziguqukayo ezibhaliwe kwekhompyutha nakwezimo ezibhalwe ngekhompyutha ezezxhumana nenhlelekompuyutha; Ukuzwa ngomsindo wobuqhubo obuqhubekekayo; Ukwazi kahle umkhakha kahulumeni we-E-government kanye namaphu awo, ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye ne-orientation yokucabanga ngokuuhlaziya, ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela izinto, amaqhosa eprojekthi, ukucabanga ngokuhle; Ukuqonda ukuphela kwentshitshiso yolwazi kwi-organisation kanye nogcino lwazo zonke izinto ezenziwayo ezingemininingwane; Ukuqonda isakhiwo sokuhlukanisa imininingwane futhi kusetshenziswe izilawuli ngokuhambisana namazinga okuzwela; Ukuqonda isimo sobungozi ngokuqonda uhlelo lokuthola ukungavikeleki kanye noku_phatha uku_vela kobungozi; Amasevisi alungele ukulungisa izinsiza ezingavikelekile kanye nesikhathi esivunyelwe sokuxazulula ukungavikeleka; Ithifikethi elivumelekile lokushayela.
zu.duties: Ngumuntu ongumphumelelo ozophathwa ngomsebenzi ohlobene ne-CyberSecurity Program: Ukuyila, ukulungisela, ukusebenzisa, kanye nokugcina izilawuli zokuvikela ukuphatha insimbi yomnyango; Ukuvikela ngokuzimisela izimpahla kanye nesakhiwo sobuchwepheshe bolwazi bongoxhumano lomnyango ezongweni ezingaphandle noma ezingaphakathi futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhambisana nezidingo ezisemthethweni nangamalungiselelo mayelana nokuфинwa kolwazi, ukuvikelwa, kanye nobumfihlo; Ukuhlaziya izinkinga futhi kuphakanyiswe izixazululo, imikhiqizo kanye nobuchwepheshe ukwenza izinjongo zokuvikelwa kolwazi kanye nobuchwepheshe bolwazi bongoxhumano entshitshini; Ukwenza ukuhlola ukuvikelwa kuzo zonke izinhlelo kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza futhi kuhlolwe ukuthi zihambisana yini nemigomo yoku_finwa kolwazi kanye nemithetho kumaphrojekthi nakukwenza amayilwa amasha esinhle; Ukuthuthukisa futhi kuchazwe inqubomgomo kanye nesakhiwo esisisekelo se-cybersecurity; Ukuchaza izinga lokuphumelela kokuvikela ubuchwepheshe be-cybersecurity futhi kusetshenziswe amamaphu; Ukuba ngumholi ekusetshenzisweni kwezilawuli ezinhle zokuvikela inethiwekhi emimeni yasekhaya kanye nakumaphulatifomu abo ekuxhumweni okwasekhaya ukugcina amandla okumelana noku_finwa kolwazi; Ukuqondiswa ekuthathweni ngokuphepha kwe-AI; Ukuvikelwa kwemininingwane kanye nokubhalwa ngemikhoda: Ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi imininingwane ebuswayo itholakale futhi ivikelwe ngokwanele; Ukuthuthukisa noma ukufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza, njengezinhlelo zokubhala ngemikhoda kwemininingwane egciniwe kanye namakhithifikethi e-SSL ukuvikela imininingwane ebuswayo esiyini futhi esiyisebenzisayo; Ukuxhasa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubo zokuphendula kwezinsiza ezingeyinhloko kanye nokubuyisela emuva futhi kusetshenziswe ngaphakathi kwe-DBE; Ukuxazulula izinkinga zokuvikelwa kanye ne-inethiwekhi ukuze kugcinwe isiza esifanele i-DR futhi kwenziwe amaphulani wobuqhubo obuqhubekayo; Ukuvikelwa kwe-inethiwekhi, i-web, kanye ne-Endpoint Security kanye nokubuka konke okwenzekayo; Ukuphathwa kwe-Threat kanye ne-Vulnerability: Ukuba ngumholi ekubukeni amandla ezinsiza ezibhekayo futhi kubhekwe imeko ye-Cyber-attack; Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa ukuhlola ukungavikeleki kanye nezivivinyo zokungena zikhathini; Ukuhlaziya futhi kuchazwe imiphumela yokungavikeleki futhi kuqedwe ukulungiswa kwaleyo bungavikeleki ezingeni lokuvikela kanye nokuphendula, ngokubambishe nomnikazi wensiza ethize entshitshini; Ukunikeza izibiko kuMphathi ophakeme ngehlelo lokuvikela ukungavikeleki. Ukuphendula kwesimo kanye nensekelo yesigaba sesithathu: Ukunika insekelo yesigaba sesithathu kuyo yonke imibuzo ehlobene nokuvikelwa kolwazi; Ukuphatha futhi kunikezwe insekelo yezinga eliphezulu lokuphendula isimo ezimeni zokungena ngamakhodi ezingagunyazwe, ukungena noma ukweba imininingwane; Ukwenza ukuphathwa kwengozi yesithathu: Ukubuka ngokusebenzayo imeko yomnikazi wezinsiza zokuvikela; Ukuqinisekisa amandla okubuyisela emuva ngokushesha. Ukuphothula umsebenzi weziphrojekthi zokuvikela ngaphakathi kwebhajethi; Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ngoku_finwa kolwazi.

xh.title: UMlawuli oNcedisayo: uLawuli oPhakamileyo weNkqubo yoKhuseleko loLwazi
xh.summary: Isithuba soMlawuli oNcedisayo ongumLawuli oPhakamileyo weNkqubo yoKhuseleko loLwazi kurhulumente oseBekelwe iNgcwele ePretoria, ogxile ekwenzeni iinkqubo zokhuseleko olusezandleni zerekthenolojini nakukhuseleni inkqubo esebenzayo.
xh.requirements: Izicelo kufuneka zibe namagqabantshintshi eNQF level 6 emva kwesidanga se-matric kwinkqubo yelwazi nerekthenolojini/Iinkqubo zelwazi okanye esinye isidanga esithintelweyo njengoko sivunywa yi-SAQA; Iiminyaka elinguFour (4) yokuba ngumsebenzi ongemva kokuqesha njengomlawuli oncedisayo okanye esinye isidanga esinjalo; Ukuqinisekiswa okuncitshiswe kakhulu kwamabini amabini (2) nakweyiphi na le ilandelayo: I-ITIL, i-COBIT, i-CISA, i-CISM, i-CISSP, i-CRISC, i-ISO 27001 kunye neminye emi-5 yeminyaka eliqela lokuba ngumlawuli weNkqubo yoKhuseleko loLwazi/Umsebenzi weNkqubo yoKhuseleko; Iinkingezi zolawulo lwenkqubo yonxulumano; Ulwazi olukhulu ngemeko yeziko i-Architecture yoshishino okanye yerekthenoloji iyafuneka, ulawulo olusesikweni, iinkqubo zolwazi nonxibelelwano nerecrococedure; Ulwazi olukhulu ngeMicrosoft environment, virtualised, cloud environments; Ulwazi olukhulu ngolawulo lokuqhubela phambili koshishino; Ulwazi olukhulu ngesicwangciso nobumfihlo bobuchwephesha be-E-government, ukunxibelelana okuthe ngqo, ukusombulula iingxaki nombono wokulinganisa, ukuqamba iplani nokuhlela, amakhono olawulo lweenkqubo, umbono oya phambili; Ukuqonda iindlela ezihamba ngazo ulwazi kushishino nokugcina uluhlu lwedata; Ukuqonda iindlela zokwahlula idata nokusebenzisa izilawuli ngokwamanqanaba okubaluleka kwayo; Ukuqonda ubukhondo ngokuqonda iNkqubo yokufumanisa nokulawula iNtshukumo; I-SLA zokuLungisa iNdlela zokuSebenza kwesiGqibo I-Timeframe ezivunywe ngokubambisana ukuba zilungele iNdlela yokuSebenza; Idrayiva elifanelekileyo nelivunywe lisetyenziswa ngokomthetho.
xh.duties: Umntu okhethiweyo uza kuba nogxenya lweNxulunyaniso yeKhompyutha (CyberSecurity Program): Ukuyila, ukumisela, ukusebenzisa, kunye nokugcina izilawuli zokhuseleko ukhusela ingxowa-mali yeNgcwele yesebe; Ukukhusela ngokusebenzayo izinto ezisezandleni zenkqubo yelwazi erekthenolojini nesenzo esisebenzayo ngaphandle okanye ngaphakathi kuwo nomxeliso ngokusesikweni nangokwemigaqo eziquka ukufikelela kwelwazi, ukhuseleko, nobumfihlo; Ukusabalalisa iingxaki nokukhankanya izisombululo, imveliso nakwerekthenoloji eziza kuzalisa iinjongo zokhuseleko nelwazi loBuchwepheshe; Ukwenza izilinganiselo zokhuseleko kuzo zonke iinkqubo nabalawuli begciphezo kokusebenza nokujonga ukubhalisele kokusesikweni kweekharityhuli zokhuseleko nangokwemigaqo kumaphulo nakuyilo olutsha lenkqubo esebenzayo; Ukuyila nokuchaza iindlela zokhuseleko ezisesikweni; Ukuchaziwa kwamangangabakho okusesikweni nokusebenzisa iindlela eziya phambili; Ukukhokela ukusebenziswa kwangcono kakhulu izilawuli zokhuseleko lonxulumano nakwindawo esesikweni esekwi-athinxi nakwindawo ebumatshini ukugcina ukuchaswa nokuhlaselwa ngekhompyutha; Ukugxila ekwamkelweni okukhuselekileyo kwe-AI; Ukukhuselwa kwelwazi nokufihla: Kuqinisekiswe ukuba ulwazi olubalulekileyo luyachongwa lwaye lukhuselwe kakuhle; Ukuyila okanye ukusebenzisa isoftware, njengeenkqubo zokufihla ulwazi olugciniweyo neziphadamshi ze-SSL ukukhusela ulwazi olubalulekileyo olusasazwa nolusetyenziswa; Ukuxhasa ukuyila kweenkqubo zokuphendula kutsho kubuye kubuyiswe imiba esebenzayo nakusebenzisa ngaphakathi kwe-DBE; Ukusombulula iingxaki zokhuseleko nolonxulumano ukugcina indawo eSebenzayo ye-DR namacebo okuqhubela phambili nenkampani; Ukukhuselwa kwesonxulumano, i-web, kunye nokhuseleko lwesiphel sendlela yokubeka umkhondo; Ukulawula iMiba kunye nobuNcinci beKhondo: Ukukhokela ukulinganiselwa kobukhondo beNdlela yokusebenza kwaye kuqwalaselwe imeko yokuhlaselwa ngeKhompyutha; Kuqinisekiswe ukuba ukulinganiselwa kobukhondo nokulinganiselwa kolwazi lwamanqanaba okungena kwenziwa ngamaxesha athile; Ukusabalalisa nokuchaza iziphumo zobukhondo kulwazi lweemfuno zokulungisa iingxaki ezichongiweyo kwimanqanaba ombono womsebenzi osebenzayo oza kwenza isikhundla kunye namachaphaza omnye owo namachaphaza; Ukubeka iingxelo kuLawulo oluPhakamileyo malunga nenkqubo yolawulo lobukhondo. Ukuphendula kwemiba nogxenya loxhaso lwesithathu: Ukunika uxhaso lwesithathu kwaye naluphi na udibi olunezantsi yolwazi kwimibuzo edibana nayo; Ukulawula nokunika uxhaso oluphakamileyo lokuphendula imiba yobuqhathamlulo, ukungena ngaphakathi, okanye ukwebiwa kwelwazi; Ukwenza uLawulo olutsha loSengoze lesiThathu: Okulungele iilonko zokubeka umkhondo kwazo iimeko zokhuseleko zemveliso; Kuqinisekiswe ukubaikhapa ezimfutshane ezibuyiselayo. Ukuphumeza iPhulo loKhuseleko ngaphakathi kwebhajethi; Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ngoKhuseleko lwelwazi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Debt, Revenue and Financial Compliance
jobs.summary: Manage accounts receivable, revenue collection and financial compliance at the Department of Basic Education in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: The applicant must be in possession of a qualification NQF level 6 or equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA in Financial Accounting/ Financial Management/Management Accounting; Four (4) years relevant experience as an Assistant Director in the area of debt and revenue management, in-depth knowledge of the Debt/Loss Control officer’s responsibilities; Knowledge and understanding of the public sector financial administration relating to the listed duties and the provisions of the PFMA and Treasury Regulation; Ability to develop and apply policies; Computer literacy, planning, organisational skills, communication skills (verbal and written); Numeracy and accuracy skills; People management and leadership skills; A good understanding of BAS, PERSAL and other computer systems.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for managing of accounts receivable and revenue collection; Handling documents and information with strict confidentiality; Preparing financial statements relevant to the section; Ensuring that financial transactions are brought to book; Managing the cashier’s office activities and banking; Managing the TRC payments; Collecting and keeping safe Departmental revenue; Ensuring safekeeping of financial documentation according to prescripts; Ensuring that reconciliations are done monthly; Ensuring telephone accounts are paid; Establishing and maintaining a strong relationship with key stakeholders internally and externally; Ensuring that all outstanding interdepartmental receivables are followed up, cleared and reconciled; Responding and resolving audit queries related to the section; Providing supervision to junior staff; Investigating irregular and fruitless and wasteful expenditure, identify potential financial risks (inclusive of fraud risks) and facilitating management action to mitigate the identified risks; Testing and monitoring level of compliance to enabling legislation: PFMA, Treasury Regulations, SCM and raise findings on areas of concern relating to weaknesses in controls to assist and enhance effectiveness of the process; Monitoring the implementation of internal and external audit recommendations based on the audit results; Attending Audit steering committee meetings; Monitoring the progress of audit recommendations; Coordinating, monitoring and reporting on fruitless and wasteful expenditure registers; Coordinating, monitoring and reporting on irregular expenditure registers; Monitoring and strengthening the control environment within the Department through performance of planned internal control assessments of Quarterly key control assessments and follow through of all data analysis reviews; Managing operational risk register; Performing any duties as delegated.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Skuld, Inkomste en Finansiële Nakoming
af.summary: Bestuur debiteure, inkomsteinning en finansiële nakoming by die Department of Basic Education in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Die aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n kwalifikasie NQF vlak 6 of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken in Finansiële Rekeningkunde/Finansiële Bestuur/Bestuursrekeningkunde; Vier (4) jaar relevante ervaring as 'n Assistentdirekteur in die area van skuld- en inkomstebestuur, diepgaande kennis van die skuld/verliesbeheerbeampte se verantwoordelikhede; Kennis en begrip van die openbare sektor se finansiële administrasie wat verband hou met die gelysde pligte en die bepalings van die PFMA en Tesouriereëls; Vermoe om beleide te ontwikkel en toe te pas; Rekenaarvaardigheid, beplanning, organisatoriese vaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik); Syfer- en akkuraatheidsvaardighede; Mensebestuur en leierskapsvaardighede; 'n Goeie begrip van BAS, PERSAL en ander rekenaastelsels.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur van debiteure en inkomsteinning; Hanteer dokumente en inligting met streng vertroulikheid; Berei finansiële state voor wat relevant is tot die afdeling; Verseker dat finansiële transaksies tot boek gebring word; Bestuur die kassierkantoor se aktiwiteite en bankwese; Bestuur TRC-betalings; Versamel en hou Departmentele inkomste veilig; Verseker die veilige bewaring van finansiële dokumentasie volgens voorskrifte; Verseker dat vereffening maandeliks gedoen word; Verseker dat telefoonrekenings betaal word; Stel en handhaaf 'n sterk verhouding met sleutellbelanghebbendes intern en ekstern; Verseker dat alle uitstaande interdepartementele debiteure gevolg, uitgeklaar en vereffen word; Reageer en los ouditnavrae op wat verband hou met die afdeling; Verskaf toesig aan junior personeel; Ondersoek onreëlmatige en onnodige en vermorsende uitgawes, identifiseer potensiële finansiële risiko's (insluitend bedrog Risico's) en fasiliteer bestuursaksie om die geïdentifiseerde risiko's te matig; Toets en monitor die vlak van nakoming van befondsende wetgewing: PFMA, Tesouriereëls, SCM en lig bevindings op oor areas van kommer wat verband hou met swakhede in kontroles om te help en die doeltreffendheid van die proses te verbeter; Monitor die implementering van interne en eksterne ouditaanbevelings gebaseer op die ouditresultate; Bywoon ouditstuurkomiteevergaderings; Monitor die vordering van ouditaanbevelings; Koördineer, monitor en rapporteer oor onnodige en vermorsende uitgaweregisters; Koördineer, monitor en rapporteer oor onreëlmatige uitgaweregisters; Monitor en versterk die kontroleomgewing binne die Department deur die uitvoering van beplande interne kontrole-assesserings van kwartaallikse sleutelkontrole-assesserings en opvolg van alle data-ontledingshersienings; Bestuur operasionele risikoregister; Voer enige pligte uit soos gedelegeer.

zu.title: Office of the Deputy Director: Debt, Revenue and Financial Compliance
zu.summary: Phatha izikhwama ezitholakalayo, ukuqoqwa kwemali engenayo kanye nokuhambisana nezimali eDepartment of Basic Education ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Isicelo kufanele sibe nesiqu sika-NQF level 6 noma isiqu esilinganayo njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA kwi-Financial Accounting/Financial Management/Management Accounting; Ukuqondiswa kwemisebenzi eminye eyiminyaka eyi-Four (4) njengomqondisi wesikhundla kumasiko wezinqoloba nomgudu wengeniso, ulwazi olujulile ngemisebenzi ka-Debt/Loss Control officer; Ulwazi nokuqonda kokuqondisa kwezimali zomnyango ophathwa ngaphandle mayelana nemisebenzi ehlaziywe; Ulwazi ngomthetho we-PFMA kanye nomthetho we-Treasury; Amandla okusungula futhi usebenzise izinkambiso; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha, ukweluleka, amakhono abantu (aphathwayo n aphathwayo) njengoba okuveziwe kwi-Financial Accounting kanye nezinkambiso; Ulwazi ngomthetho we-PFMA kanye nomthetho we-Treasury; Ukusebenzisa izinkambiso, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, amandla okuxhumana (aphathwayo n aphathwayo) njengoba kubonisiwe; Ukusebenzisa izinkambiso ze-Office; Ulwazi ngomthetho we-PFMA kanye nomthetho we-Treasury; Ukusebenzisa izinkambiso ezinye mayelana nezinkambiso ezihlukene; Ulwazi oluhle nge-BAS, PERSAL kanye namanye amasistimu ekhompyutha.
zu.duties: Umuntu okhethwayo uzobe nomdlandla wokuqasha izikhwama ezitholakala kanye nokuqoqwa kwemali engenayo; Ukuphathwa kwemibhalo nelwazi ngokwesekela ngokuphelele; Ukulungiselela izitatimende zezimali ezihambelana nesigaba; Kuqiniseke ukuthi izinkokhela zezimali zifakwe esitolo sezincwadi; Ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi ye-ofisi yomkhiqizi kanye nokubhangeka; Ukuphathwa kwamakhadi e-TRC; Ukuqoqa futhi zigcinwe ngokuphephile imali engenayo yoMnyango; Kuqiniseke ukugcinwa kwemibhalo yezimali ngokuhambisana nemiyalo; Kuqiniseke ukuthi ukuqondaniswa kwenziwa nyanga zonke; Kuqiniseke ukuthi ama-akhawunti efoni abhadalwa; Ukusungula futhi kugcinwe ubudlelwano obuqinile nabalingane ababalulekile baphakathi nangaphandle; Kuqiniseke ukuthi yonke imali eqoqiwe phakathi kwezinsiza ezingakahlelwa ilandelwa, iqediswa futhi iqondaniswe; Ukuphendula futhi kuxazulule izibuzo zokuhlola ezihambelana nesigaba; Ukunikeza abasebenzi abasha abaqondiswa; Ukuphenya ukuchithwa okungalungile kanye nokuchithwa okungalungile nokuchithwa okungalungile, ukubona izinkinga ezingaba khona zezimali (uhlu olubandakanya izinkinga zokukhwabanisa) futhi ukwenza umzamo wokunciphisa izinkinga eziboniwe; Ukuhlola futhi kulandelwe izinga lokuhambisana nomthetho okuvunyelwe: I-PFMA, Imiyalo ye-Treasury, i-SCM futhi kutholwe izikhalo ezindaweni ezibheke kwezakhi zokulawula ukuze kusize futhi kwandise amandla esimweni; Ukulandela ukusetshenziswa kwemibuzo yokuqondisa yangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokusekelwe emiphumeleni yokuqondisa; Ukubandakanya emihlanganweni ye-Audit steering committee; Ukulandela inqubekela phambili yemibuzo yokuqondisa; Ukuhlanganisa, ukulandela futhi kubike ngokuchithwa okungalungile kanye nokuchithwa okungalungile; Ukulandela futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhalo ezingajwayelekile zibhalwe; Ukulandela futhi kukhuliswe ibutho elilawulayo ngaphakathi koMnyango ngokwenza ukuqondisa okuhleliwe kwangaphakathi kwe-Khatholikhwe yokuqondisa kwamasonto; Ukulawula inqubo yomzila wokusebenza; Ukwenza nanoma yimiphi imisebenzi.

xh.title: Ingqalasndothi: Izingeniso, Ngeniso lemali kunye noWabiso lweMali
xh.summary: Ukuphatha ii-akhawunti ezingeniswayo, ukuqokelela ingeniso kunye nowabiso lwemali kwisebe leZemfundo eZisiseko ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka umfaki isicelo abe negunya le-NQF level 6 okanye elingana nalo njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA kwi-Financial Accounting/Financial Management/Management Accounting; Abenamava eminyaka emi four (4) ejolise kwindima yakhe njengakwi-Assistant Director kwelithuba lophatho lwezingeniso kunye ngeniso, afike ezolwazi oluzolileyo malunga nemisebenzi yomphathi we-Debt/Loss Control; Abenolwazi ukuqonda indlela yophalatsho lwemali kwicandelo likarhulumente ehambelana nemithe yakhe apha aze akwaqonda izigqibo ze-PFMA kunye neTreasury Regulation; Abenamandla okuyila aze asetyenzise iinkqubo; Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuqhubeleka phambili, amandla okuhlela, amandla okunxibelelwana (okusithiyo nakusilondakuzipha); Amandla okusebenza namanani nokuqinisekisa ukuchanekileyo; Amandla okuphatha abantu kunye nobukhosi; Ukuqonda kakuhle i-BAS, i-PERSAL nakwezinye iinkqubo zekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Umfaki isithuba onempumelelo uza kuba nefuthe lokuphatha ii-akhawunti ezingeniswayo kunye nokuqokelela ingeniso; Ukusingatha amaxwebhu kunye nolwazi ngokwembeko yokuyigcina inokudluliselwa kwenye; Ulungiselela iinkqubo zemali ezihambelana neli candelo; Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zemali zingeniswa kwiibhuku; Ukuphatha imisebenzi yefestile yekheshiya nakwingeniswa kwemali; Ukuphatha nahlawule izinxibelelanisi ze-TRC; Ukuqokelela zigcine ngokhuseleko ingeniso yeSebe; Ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokhuseleko kwamaxwebhu emali ngokwemiqathango; Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izibandanisi zenziwa nyanga nonyaka; Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ii-akhawunti zefowuni zihlawulwa; Ukwakha ulwandiso olomeleleyo kunye nokululondoloza nomgxowa nabantu abalulekileyo ngaphakathi nangaphandle; Ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke ingeniso ezisalayo phakathi kweesebe zilandelwa, zicacekiswe kunye nokuqokelelwa; Ukuphendula uze uxazulule imibuzo ye-ola ehambelana neli candelo; Ukuqokelela inkokheli abasebenzi abasese; Uphenya iindleko ezingaqediswanga neziswatyora ezinganyusekanga, uchaze iingozi ezinokubakho kweemali (kuquka iingozi zokukrobha iimali) aze acedise isinyathelo sobukhosi ukunciphisa iingozi ezitholakele; Ukuvavanya ukuqonda inqanaba lokuwisa kwemithetho yamagunya: PFMA, iziNqibo zeTreasury, SCM aze akhuphe izifundo kwizithuba ezingakhuselekanga malunga nokuhanjiswa kwezilawulo ukunceda nokuqinisa ukusebenza kwenkqubo; Ukuphatha ukusebenziswa kwezi Syntaxokunye nezingaphandle ze-audit ngokusekelwe kwiziphumo ze-audit; Ukubakhona kwiindibano zekomiti yokuqhubeleka phambili ye-Audit; Ukulandela inkqubela phambili yezi Syntaxokunye nezingaphandle; Ukuquka, ukulawula ukuphatha ukuze kuxelwe ngemirhumo yamarejista wezindleko ezinganyusekanga; Ukuquka, ukulawula nokuxela ngeemirhumo yamarejista wezindleko ezingaqidiswanga; Ukulawula ukuze kuqinisiswe indawo yolawulo ngaphakathi kwiSebe ngokwenziwa kokuqwalasela ulawulo lwangaphakathi olucwangcisiweyo kwisikali sonyaka samaQ3 kwiqwalaselo eliphandlwayo lolawulo olubalulekileyo nokulandela yonke imiyalelo yokuhlela idatha; Ukuphatha irejista yengozi yemisebenzi; Ukwenza nayiphi na imisebenzi enikwe yona.

jobs.title: Senior Registry Clerk
jobs.summary: Manage personnel registry records, open files, handle PERSAL enquiries and maintain registers at the Department of Basic Education in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: The applicant must be in possession of a Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification; Knowledge of personnel registry; Basic knowledge of PERSAL and Archive Rules pertaining to personnel records are additional recommendation; Good organisational skills, communication skills (Verbal and Written); Computer and interpersonal relations skills are essential; Ability to deal with confidentiality matters, work under pressure and work independently as well as part of a team.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for writing of standard letters to institutions and government departments; Handling basic enquiries on PERSAL; Ensuring that new personnel files are opened and that records are well maintained; Receiving and posting of documents; Maintaining registers and files.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Monyela Tel No: (012) 357 3294/ Mr M Segowa Tel No: (012) 357 4291

af.title: Senior Registerklerk
af.summary: Bestuur personeelregisterrekords, open lêers, hanteer PERSAL-navrae en onderhou registers by die Department of Basic Education in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Die aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Senior Sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie; Kennis van personeelregister; Basiese kennis van PERSAL en Argiefreëls met betrekking tot personeelrekords is 'n bykomende aanbeveling; Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik); Rekenaar- en interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede is noodsaaklik; Vermoë om met vertroulikheidsake om te gaan, onder druk te werk en onafhanklik sowel as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die skryf van standaardbriewe aan instellings en regeringsdepartemente; Hantering van basiese navrae op PERSAL; Verseker dat nuwe personeel lêers geopen word en dat rekords goed onderhou word; Ontvang en pos van dokumente; Onderhou van registers en lêers.

zu.title: Somlilo Ophakeme Wokubhaliswa Kwamafayela
zu.summary: Iphosi eliphethe izinkomba zokubhaliswa kwamafayela abasebenzi, ukuvula amafayela, ukuphendula imibuzo yePERSAL nokulondoloza izinkomba eDepartment of Basic Education ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Umnikazi weSikhundla kufanele abe noSitifiketi samabanga aphezulu noma isifundo esingalinganiselwa; Ulwazi mayelana nesibuyazwe ngabasizi ababhalisile ngosizo lwaleli chibi alitholakali; Ukukutazwa okuyisiseko mayelana nePERSAL kanye nemiyalo esemthethweni yokukhuluma izindlu ekufundeni kwabantu abambuka kulezi zindlu kule minyaka yonke, uma ekhuluma izinto okuyimfuneko ukwazi kakhulu; Amakhono alunga kwizinto ezihlukene, kanye nokukhuluma kahle (Okubhalwayo nakho okukhulunywayo); Ukubona ngamaphuzu aphambili, ukuhlonza, ukuvuselela, ukuphendula nokuba nokuvunywa okungamukelekile kuyisikhundla esibalulekile sokuba umuntu ukhululeke; Amakhono okusebenza ngomsingathi wamathuluzi aphathwayo nemibono emikhulu yamathuluzi apathwayo akufanele ngokwezinye izinkomba asho ngokukhuza okusemthethweni, nokukwazi ukuhlela izincwadi zokuthutha kanye nokuba nokuvunywa okuyisikhundla esibalulekile sokuba umuntu aze akwazi ukusebenza esikhundleni sokuba ngumuntu osemthethweni nokuba ngumuntu okwazi ukuhlola izinto ezingase zibe khona.
zu.duties: Umqashi ophumelelayo uzobe nen ukuletha ulwazi olumayelana nokubhala kwamagama abhalwe ngendlela esemthethweni ayathunyelwa izikhungo kanye namaphoyili ahulumeni; Ukuphendula imibuzo eyisiseko mayelana nePERSAL; Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi avuliwe amafayela omqashi bese kugcinwa kahle izinkinga; Ukuthola bese uphehla imibhalo; Ukulondoloza amabala nezinkambu.

xh.title: Mlinganiselo Ophakamileyo weSikhokelo seRejista
xh.summary: Phatha iirekhodi ze-rejista yabasebenzi, vula iifayile, jonga imibuzo ye-PERSAL uze ugcine iirejista kwiSebe lezeMfundo eBekiselayo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Umfonye kufuneka abe nesiSitifikati seSenior okanye nelifikeshana elilingana naso; Ulwazi nge-rejista yabasebenzi; Ulwazi olusisiseko malunga ne-PERSAL neMithetho ye-Arhayivisi malunga neerekhodi zabasebenzi ngolunye ulwazi oluyimfuno ekuncedeni; Amakhono alungileyo ohlelo, amakhono ethosayo (Esebenziswayo neElibhaliwayo); Amakhono ekhompyutha nobudlelwane nabantu ngumsebenzi obalulekileyo; Ikakhulu ukuba nokhakho lokupatha iindaba ezimfihlo, ukusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo nokusebenza zendodwa nakwindima yeqela.
xh.duties: Ophumeleleyo uza kuba nawomsebenzi wokubhala iileta ezingagqithiswanga ziinkqubo ezikumaziko nakwayo nakwisebe karhulumente; Ukuhlangabezana nemibuzo esisiseko malunga ne-PERSAL; Kuqinisekiswe ukuba iifayile ezintsha zabasebenzi zivuliweyo nokuba iirekhodi zilungelelaniswe kakuhle; Ukufumana nokuthumela amaxwebhu; Ukugcina iirejista naye iifayile.

jobs.title: Telecom Operator

jobs.requirements: The applicant must be in possession of a Senior Certificate or equivalent; Communication (written and verbal); Computer literacy (MS Office); Good interpersonal skills; Good public relations skills, Ability to work under pressure and to solve problems; Customer service and document management.

af.title: Telekommunikasie-operateur
af.summary: 'n Telekommunikasie-operateur word in Pretoria benodig om inkomende oproepe te bestuur, departementele inligting te verskaf en oproeprekords by te hou by die Department of Basic Education.
af.requirements: Die aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Senior Sertifikaat of gelykwaardig; Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings); Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office); Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede; Goeie openbare betrekkinge-vaardighede; Vermoë om onder druk te werk en probleme op te los; Klantediens en dokumentbestuur.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die beantwoording en deurskakel van inkomende oproepe na die betrokke afdeling/direktoraat; Verskaffing van inligting oor dienste wat deur die departement gelewer word; Skandering van alle inkomende oproepe en byhou van 'n rekord; Verskaffing van 'n interne telefoongids aan personeel wanneer vereis; Verskaffing van sekretariële dienste aan afdelings wanneer amptenare nie in die kantoor is nie en oordra van boodskappe; Verskaffing van kontakbesonderhede van alle Provinciale en Distrikskantore aan die publiek; Verseker dat die skakelbord te alle tye beman word; Lewering van 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe telefoondiens aan die departement.

zu.title: Umsebenzi wezocingo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi wezocingo ePretoria ukulawula amakholi asezingeni eliphezulu, ukunikela ngolwazi lomnyango, ukuze kugcinwe izinkomba zeminyango kwisikhungo sezezimali eNgqongqosheni yesiBanza.
zu.requirements: Isiphakeli kumele sibe ne-Senior Certificate noma okulinganayo; Ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe noko kukhulunywayo); Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Office); Amakhono alunge kahle ukuxhumana nabantu; Amakhono abalulekile ezenzubomfundo zabantu, Ukusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo nokuyakha izisombululo; Ukukhathalela abathengi ukuphathwa kwamafa.
zu.duties: Umuntu ophumeleleyo uzobe nogweme lokuphendula nokuhambisa amakholi angena kumuntu ohambisana nesigaba/ i-ofisi yeziqondiso; Ukunikeza ulwazi mayelana nezinsiza ezinikezwa umnyango; Ukuhlola wonke amakholi angena ukugcina irekhodi; Ukunikeza abasebenzi uchungechunge lwamafoni angaphakathi uma kudingeka; Ukunikeza izinsiza zokubhala kumagatsha uma amaphoyisa engekho ehhovisi futhi adlulise imiyalezo; Ukunikeza imininingwane yokuxhumana yawo onke amahhovisi ePhondo nweSifunda kubantu; Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iswitshibodi ihlalo ibhekeke; Ukunikeza insiza yefoni esebenzayo futhi esebenzayo umnyango.

xh.title: Umlawuli we-Telecom
xh.summary: Kufuneka kuye umlawuli we-telecom ePretoria ukulawula amakholo afikayo, ukunika ulwazi ngesabe, kwaye ugcinamarekhodi amakholo kuSebe leMfundo yeSiseko.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka oqeqeshwa abe nesiSatiyari Sokwazisa okanye esilinganayo; Unxibelelwano (olubhaliweyo noluthethwayo); Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office); Amakhono amabalisezayo abantu; Amakhono amabalisezayo kubantu babantu, Ulwazi lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokuxazula iingxaki; Inkonziselwano kumthengi nokulawula amaxwebhu.
xh.duties: Ophumeleleyo uza kuba nesibhadaliso sokuphendula nokuzisa amakholo afikayo kwahlulo/ urhwebo olufanelekileyo; Nikela ulwazi ngeenkonzo ezinikiwa yisebe; Scanning zonke amakholo afikayo kwaye ugcine irekhodi; Nikezela uvimba wenani lefowuni langaphakathi kuqeqeshwa xa kufuneka; Nikela iinkonzo zobonakalise kwiindawo xa abasebenzi besengabikho kofiso kwaye udlulise imiyalezo; Nikela iinkcukacha zoxhumo zazo zonke iiSebe zePhondo neZoMmandla kubantu babantu; Qinisekisa ukuba iswichi-board ihlala inabantu bayo; Nikela inkonzo yefowuni esebenzayo nesebenzayo kwesebe.

jobs.title: Security Guards
jobs.summary: Guard departmental premises, conduct patrols, monitor CCTV, and respond to security incidents at the Department of Basic Education in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: The applicant must be in possession of a Senior Certificate or equivalent; Communication (written and verbal); Valid PSIRA Registration; Security Training with accredited security training such as Grade “A, B, C or D”; Fire Fighting & First Aid certificate added advantage; Clean criminal record; Security and operational skills- access and egress control; Patrol and surveillance techniques; CCTV and alarm monitoring; Incident and emergency response; Visitor and vehicle management; key and access control management; Communication skills- effective verbal communication; Good written communication and report writing; active listening; professional interaction with officials, visitors and the public; Personal competencies- professionalism; discipline and adherence to procedures; Reliability and punctuality; Alertness and vigilance; Ability to remain calm under pressure; Integrity, Honesty and confidentiality; Problem solving and decision making- assess situations and take appropriate actions; Ability to identify potential risks; Respond effectively to emergencies; Escalate the incidents through correct reporting channels; Exercising sound judgment within delegated authority; Team-work and interpersonal skills; Ability to work effectively as part of security team; Cooperation with management and other stakeholders; Conflict management skills; Respect for diversity and different backgrounds; Ability to work with SAPS, and other security stakeholders where required.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for guarding and protecting of people, property and information; Conducting security patrols; Monitoring CCTV and alarm systems; Searching persons, vehicles or property where legally authorised; Responding to security incidents and emergencies; Maintaining OB and incident reports; Enforcing organizational security procedures; Reporting suspicious activities, security breaches and incidents; Managing security operations in the department. ENQUIRIES Ms N Monyela Tel No: (012) 357 3294/ Mr M Segowa Tel No: (012) 357 4291

af.title: Veiligheidswagte
af.summary: Bewaak departementele persele, voer patrollies uit, monitor CCTV en reageer op sekuriteitsvoorvalle by die Department of Basic Education in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Die applikant moet in besit wees van 'n Senior Sertifikaat of ekwivalent; Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings); Geldige PSIRA-registrasie; Sekuriteitsopleiding met geakkrediteerde sekuriteitsopleiding soos Graad "A, B, C of D"; Brandbestryding en Eiehulp-sertifikaat is 'n bykomende voordeel; Skoon strafrekord; Sekuriteits- en operasionele vaardighede- toegangs- en uitgangskontrolering; Patrollie- en waarnemingstegnieke; CCTV- en alarmmonitering; Voorval- en noodreaksie; Besoeker- en voertuigbestuur; sleutel- en toegangskontrolebestuur; Kommunikasievaardighede- effektiewe mondelinge kommunikasie; Goed skriftelike kommunikasie en verslagdoening; aktiewe luister; professionele interaksie met amptenare, besoekers en die publiek; Persoonlike bevoegdhede- professionaliteit; dissipline en nakoming van prosedures; Betroubaarheid en stiptheid; Waaksaamheid en waakvatbaarheid; Vermoë om kalm te bly onder druk; Integriteit, eerlikheid en vertroulikheid; Probleemoplossing en besluitneming- assessering van situasies en neem van toepaslike aksies; Vermoë om potensiële risiko's te identifiseer; Effektiewe reaksie op noodsituasies; Eskalering van voorvalle deur korrekte rapporteringskanale; Uitoefening van goeie oordeel binne gedelegeerde gesag; Spanwerk en interpersoonlike vaardighede; Vermoë om effektief as deel van sekuriteitsspan te werk; Samewerking met bestuur en ander belanghebbendes; Konflikbestuursvaardighede; Respek vir diversiteit en verschillende agtergronde; Vermoë om saam met SAPS en ander sekuriteitsbelanghebbendes te werk waar vereis.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bewaak en beskerming van mense, eiendom en inligting; Die uitvoer van sekuriteitspatrollies; Die monitering van CCTV- en alarmsisteme; Die deursoek van persone, voertuie of eiendom waar wettiglik gemagtig; Die reageer op sekuriteitsvoorvalle en noodsituasies; Die byhou van OB- en voorvalverslae; Die afdwing van organisatoriese sekuriteitsprosedures; Die rapporteer van verdagte aktiwiteite, sekuriteitskendings en voorvalle; Die bestuur van sekuriteitsbedrywighede in die departement. zu.title: Abavikeli Bokuphepha
zu.summary: Vikela izakhiwo zumnyango, yenza amaphathi, qaphela i-CCTV, upendule ezimeni zokuphepha eDepartment of Basic Education ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Isicelo kufanele sibe ne-Senior Certificate noma okulinganayo; Unalwazi lokuxhumana (olubhalwe nolukhulunywayo); Ukubhaliswa kwe-PSIRA okusebenzayo; Ukuqeqeshwa kokuphepha nokuqeqeshwa okugunyaziwe njengoGrade "A, B, C noma D"; Isitifiketi se-Fire Fighting & First Aid kuyinzuzo; Irekhodi lenzenzo ezingcolile elihlanzekile; Amakhono okuphepha nokuqhuba- ukulawula ukungena nokuphuma; Izinga lomthetho wokubuka nokuphatha; Ukubheka i-CCTV nokuqaphela amaxhoso; Ukupendula kumansebenzi namazinga aphuthumayo; Ukuphatha abavakashi nezimoto; ukuphatha amafungu nobulawulo bokungena; Amakhono okuxhumana- ukuxhumana ngomlomo ngempumelelo; Ukubhala kahle nokubhala imibiko; ukulalela ngokusebenzaya; ukuxhumana ngobungcweti nabaphathi, abavakashi nomphakathi; Amakhono omuntu- ubungcweti; inhlalakahle nokulandela izinqubo; Ukuthembeka nokufika ngesikhathi; Ukubulalazele nokubambe iqhaza; Ikhono lokuhlala uzolile ngaphansi koxinzelelo; Ukuqonda, Ukuqamba nokugcina umfihlo; Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo- ukuhlola izimo nokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele; Ikhono lokubona izingozi ezibhubhisiyo; Ukupendula ngempumelelo ezimeni eziphuthumayo; Ukudlulisa izehlakalo ngemikhondo yokubika elungile; Ukusebenzisa isiphoqangelo esihle ngaphakathi kwesigaba esinikeziwe; Ikhono lokusebenza njengeqembu nomkhondo wabantu; Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo njengengxenye yeqembu lokuphepha; Ukubambisana nabaphathi kanye namanye abanomthelela; Amakhono okuphatha izinkinga; Ukuhlonipha ukwahlukahlukana nemvelo ehlukene; Ikhono lokusebenza ne-SAPS, kanye namanye abanomthelela ekuphepheni lapho kudingeka.

jobs.title: Intern: Internal Audit
jobs.summary: Internship in internal audit at the Centre for Public Service Innovation in Pretoria, offering R98,097 per annum for unemployed graduates with an internal audit qualification.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 certificate. A recognised National Diploma /Degree (NQF level 6/7) qualification in Internal Audit. Applicants must be unemployed. Siyakhula Student Membership Programme/ Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA) membership will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: The successful Intern will participate in the development of internal audit plans, planning audit projects, execution of audit engagements, reporting and support to audit committees. The internship provides an opportunity to be part of the development programme for internal auditors including follow-ups of audit findings. Personal Profile: Basic skills that Interns should possess include office management; computer literacy; interpersonal skills; teamwork. Must have strong interpersonal skills, demonstrate sound work ethic and be honest, respectful and trustworthy. Client orientation and customer focus. Understands the importance of maintaining the confidentiality of sensitive employee information. Good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate with internal and external partners.
jobs.applications: must be submitted through CPSI eRecruitment (https://erecruitment.cpsi.co.za) This link is for CPSI applications only. Emailed or hand-delivered/posted/couriered applications will not be considered. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.notes: CPSI reserves the right not to fill the above-mentioned posts, withdraw or to put a position on hold and/or to re-advertise a post. The CPSI is compliant with the requirements of POPIA. The CPSI is a National Government Component listed in Part A of Schedule 3 of the Public Service Act, reporting to the Minister for the Public Service and Administration (MPSA). The CPSI’s vision is to enable a solution-focused effective and efficient public sector and is playing a leading and catalytic role with regard to Public Service reform and transformation through innovation. It aims to entrench the culture and practice of innovation in public service through developing new solutions and unearthing existing innovations for learning and replication. In order to perform this purpose, the CPSI performs the following functions: (1) Providing the Minister (and his portfolio organisations) with independent, diverse and forward-looking advice and research, as well as partnerships that enhance Public Service innovation. (2) Creating an enabling environment that nurtures, supports and encourages innovation within the South African Government. (3) Initiating, implementing and managing self-sustainable innovation projects in partnership with other government institutions, the private sector and other relevant stakeholders. (4) Implementing special projects that are mandated by the Minister from time to time. It is the intention to promote representivity in the CPSI through the filling of these positions. Applicants must note that the information as required on the new form Z83 (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/document) will be uploaded onto the system during the application process whereafter a form will be generated. Applicants thus do not have to upload a completed and signed new Z83 form. Do however note that failure to upload ALL required information onto the system may lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. By submitting your application, it also means you consent to the Centre for Public Service Innovation (the CPSI) processing your information for Human Resources Management purposes. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at their own expense. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to (1) a practical exercise, (2) integrity (ethical conduct), and (3) personnel suitability checks, including criminal records, citizenship or permanent residency verification, financial records, and qualification/study verification. Applicants could also be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Reference checks will be done during the selection process. Include the email address of your references. The successful candidate will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within three (3) months of appointment, as well as complete a financial interest declaration within one month of appointment and annually thereafter. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Regrettably, due to excessive budget cuts, the department cannot meet any travel and subsistence costs relating to recruitment processes, or relocation and resettlement costs for shortlisted and successful candidates. INTERNSHIP 2026/27 The Centre for Public Service Innovation (CPSI) is committed to youth skills development by providing graduates with opportunities to gain work experience to complement their studies or immediately after completing their studies. Applications are invited for internship positions from promising graduates. Candidates who previously participated in an internship programme in any Government Department will not be considered.
