af.title: Intern: Interne Oudit
af.summary: Internskap in interne oudit by die Centre for Public Service Innovation in Pretoria, wat R98,097 per jaar bied vir werklose gegradueerdes met 'n interne ouditkwalifikasie.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat/Graad 12-sertifikaat. 'n Erkende Nasionale Diploma /Graad (NQF-vlak 6/7)-kwalifikasie in Interne Oudit. Aansoekers moet werkloos wees. Siyakhula Student Membership Programme/ Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA)-lidmaatskap sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle intern sal deelneem aan die ontwikkeling van interne ouditplanne, die beplanning van ouditprojekte, die uitvoering van ouditopdragte, verslagdoening en ondersteuning aan ouditkomitees. Die internskap bied 'n geleentheid om deel te wees van die ontwikkelingsprogram vir interne ouditeurs, insluitend die opvolg van ouditbevindings. Persoonlike profiel: Basiese vaardighede wat interns moet besit, sluit in kantoorbestuur; rekenaarvaardigheid; interpersoonlike vaardighede; spanwerk. Moet oor sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede beskik, 'n goeie werksetiek toon en eerlik, onderskeidend en betroubaar wees. Kliëntgerigtheid en klantefokus. Begryp die belangrikheid daarvan om die vertroulikheid van sensitiewe werknemerinligting te handhaaf. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om met interne en eksterne vennote te kommunikeer.

zu.title: Ofakelwe Ezintsha: Internal Audit
zu.summary: Isikhundla esifakela ezintsha esimkhakheni wokuhlola ngaphakathi esikhungweni i-Centre for Public Service Innovation e-Pretoria, sinikeza i-R98,097 ngonyaka kubafundi abangasebenzi abanesitifiketi sokuhlola ngaphakathi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu/Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. Isitifiketi sediploma/yebakheleri ezemukelwe (NQF level 6/7) ezingeni le-Internal Audit. Abafaka izicelo kumele bengasebenzini. Ukuba yingxenye kohlelo lukamfundi i-Siyakhula/ukuba yilungu le-Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA) kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Ofakelwe ezintsha ophumelele uzoba yingxenye kokuhlelwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlola ngaphakathi, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuhlola, ukwenza imisebenzi yokuhlola, ukubika kanye nokweseka amakomidi okuhlola. Lesi sikhundla sokufakela ezintsha sinikezela ithuba lokuba yingxenye kohlelo lokuthuthukisa abahloli ngaphakathi kuhlanganise nokulandisa izinselele eziyisiphetho sokuhlola. Iphrofayela Yomuntu: Amakhono okwaziswa ofakelwe ezintsha okufanele abe nawo ahlanganisa abaningi bekhompyutha; ukusebenza kahle nabantu; ukusebenza njengeqembu. Kumele abe namakhono amahle okusebenza nabantu, abonise izimilo ezinhle zomsebenzi futhi abe ngumuntu oqotho, ohloniphekile nethembekile. Ukugxila kumthengi nokubeka umthengi phambili. Uyaqonda ukubaluleka kokugcina ubumfihlo olumayelana nemininingwane ebuqe yabasebenzi. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa ngomlomo nokubhala. Ikhono lokuxhumana nabalingani baphakathi nabo bangaphandle.

xh.title: Umntu oqeqeshwa kumsebenzi: ukuHlolwa kwangaphakathi
xh.summary: Ukuqeqeshwa kolwazi emsebenzini ekubhukhweni kwangaphakathi e Centre for Public Service Innovation e Pretoria, elinika umvuzo we R98,097 ngonyaka othweswe izidanga abangenamsebenzi abanelayithhesebhu yokuHlolwa kwangaphakathi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethe samabanga aphezulu/Isatifikethe se Grade 12. Isidanga esiqapela i National Diploma /Degree (inqanaba le- NQF level 6/7) ekubhukhweni kwangaphakathi. Abafakeli kufuneka bengenamsebenzi. Ukuzibandakanya kwi Siyakhula Student Membership Programme/ Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA) kuya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Umntu ophumeleleyo oqeqeshwa kumsebenzi uya kuthatha inxaxheba ekuyilweni kweplani yokuhlolwa kwangaphakathi, ekulungeniseni iiprojekthi zokuhlolwa, ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuhlolwa, ekubaliseni nasekuxhaseni amacommythi okuhlolwa. Lo msebenzi wokuqeqeshwa unika ithuba lokuba yingxenye yenkqubo yophuhliso labahloli bangaphakathi equka noku landela iziphumo zokuhlolwa. Inqaku lobuntu bomntu: Amapoplanethi amabalisa umntu oqeqeshwa kumsebenzi kufuneka abe nawo aquka ulawulo leofisi; ukwazi ukusebenza ngekhompyutha; amakhono obudlelwane nabantu; ukusebenza njengesinqwema. Kufuneka abe namakhono amaninzi obudlelwane nabantu, abonise imeko yomsebenzi elungileyo, abe yintombi ethe nkqo, ethobekileyo nethembekileyo. Ukwakhkelela kumaxhaswa nogqoliselo koluntu. Aqonde ubaluleko lokugcina imfihlo yolwazi oluqapela ngabasebenzi. Amakhono amaninzi okuthetha nokuvelisa ngeshwa. Amandla okudibana nabalinganeli bangaphakathi nangaphandle.

af.title: Intern: Regsdienste
af.summary: 'n Regsdienste-intern word benodig by die Centre for Public Service Innovation in Pretoria om bystand te verleen met die opstel van regsmenings, litigasie, kontrakte en wetgewing.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Certificate/Grade 12-sertifikaat. 'n Erkende graad (NQF level 7) in regte. Aansoekers moet werkloos wees. Praktiese regsonderiging sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle Intern sal blootgestel word aan die opstel van regsmenings, litigasiesake; kontrakte, diensvlakooreenkomste en die opstel, verwerking en die interpretasie van wetgewing verwant aan die openbare administrasie. Bystand verleen met die verskaf van regsdienste oor wetgewende aangeleenthede rakende bestaande openbare administrasiewetgewing. Ondersteuning bied aan die Public Administration Management Amendment Act/Public Service Act/Regulations. Bystand verleen met die opstel van Regulasies om in lyn te bring met Public Service Amendment Bill. Bystand verleen met die finalisering van Handbook en hersiene bepalings en direktiewe. Ondersteuning bied aan die opstel en verwerking van enige ander wetgewende hervormingsproses. Persoonlike Profiel: Basiese vaardighede wat Interns behoort te besit sluit in kantoorbestuur; rekenaarvaardigheid; interpersoonlike vaardighede; spanwerk. Moet oor sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede beskik, goeie werketiek toon en eerlik, onderskeidend en betroubaar wees. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Verstaan die belangrikheid daarvan om die vertroulikheid van sensitiewe werknemerinligting te handhaaf. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om met interne en eksterne vennote te kommunikeer.

zu.title: Umntwana ohlezi emsebenzini: Amasevisi Omthetho
zu.summary: Kudingeka umntwana ohlezi emsebenzini wezomthetho e-Centre for Public Service Innovation e-Pretoria ukuba asize ekubhalweni kwezinhlambo zezenzo zomthetho, izinkantolo, izinkontilaka nomthetho jikelele.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu/Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-degree evunyelwe (izinga le-NQF 7) ezomthetho. Abafaka izibumbo kumele bengasebenzi. Ukuqeqeshwa kwemisebenzo yomthetho kuzoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Umntwana ohlezi emsebenzini ongaphumeleleyo uzoziswa ukubhala izinhlambo zezenzo zomthetho, izindaba zezinkantolo; izinkontilaka, izivumelwano sezinga lenkonzo kanye nokubhala, ukucubungula nokutolikwa komthetho ohlobene nokuphathwa koluntu. Siza ekunikezeni izeluleko zomthetho ezindabeni zomthetho mayelana nomthetho jikelele wokuphathwa koluntu osekho. Sekela i-Public Administration Management Amendment Act/i-Public Service Act/Izimiso. Siza ekubhaleni Izimiso ukuze zihambisane ne-Public Service Amendment Bill. Siza ekugqamiseni i-Handbook kanye nezinqumo ezibukiwe nezinqondiso. Sekela ukubhala nokuqhuba nanoma yisiphi esinye inqubo yokulungisa umthetho. Iphrofayili Yomuntu: Amakhono okuyisisekelo okufanele abanayo abahlezi emsebenzini afaka ukuphathwa kohhovisi; ulwazi lwekhompyutha; amakhono okuxhumana nabantu; ukusebenza njengeqembu. Kumele abe namakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu abonke isimilo somsebenzi esihle futhi abe ngumuntu onaqoqo, ohloniphekile futhi ongathembekile. Ukwakheka ngomlayezo wokusingathwa kwezikhashana namandla okugxila kusikhathi somthengi. Uyaqonda ukubaluleka kokugcina imfihlo yemininingwane ebuqambi mayelana nabasebenzi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala. Ikhefu lokuxhumana nabalingani bangaphakathi nangaphandle.

xh.title: Intern: Isebe lomthetho
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-Intern yesebe lomthetho eCentre for Public Service Innovation ePretoria ukunceda ekubhalweni kwezimvo zomthetho, i-litigation, ii-contracts nomthetho.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu/isatifikethi se-Garde 12. I-dgree evunyiweyo (NQF level 7) kumthetho. Abafaka izicelo kufuneka bangasebenzi. Ukutya kwamakhono omthetho kuya kuba ngaphezulu kakhulu.
xh.duties: I-Intern edingekayo iya kufundiswa ukubhala izimvo ezomthetho, izinto ezimalunga ne-litigation; ii-contracts, amaqela abakho zenkonzo kunye nokubhala, ukuqhuba nokutolika umthetho ohambelana nolawulo lwentlalo. Nceda ekunikeni ingcebiso yomthetho kumacandso omthetho mayelana nomthetho obukhoyo wolawulo lwentlalo. Xhasa i-Public Administration Management Amendment Act/i-Public Service Act/Regulations. Nceda ekubhalweni kwe-Regulations ukuze zihambelane ne-Public Service Amendment Bill. Nceda ekugqibeleni i-Handbook kunye nokutshintshwa kwezigqibo nemiyalelo. Xhasa ukubhala nokuqhuba naniphi na inkqubo yantshintsho yomthetho. Inkcazelo yomntu: Ikhono esiseko abo mababekho bande kubo iquka ulawulo lofisi; ulwazi lwekhompyutha; ikhono lokulumka nomntu; ukusebenza njengaqela. Kufuneka babe namakhono amaninzi okulumka nomntu, abonakalise izimiso ezilungileyo zomsebenzi kwaye bengathembekanga, bahambelane nabantu kwaye bengathembeki. Ukujolisa kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Aqonde ukubaluleka kokugcina iyimfihlo inkcazelo ebucayi yabasebenzi. Amakhono amaninzi okuthetha nokubhala. Ikhono lokunxibelelwana nabalingane bangaphakathi nangaphandle.

jobs.title: Director: Technology Innovation and Artificial
jobs.department: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (the all-inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Pension Fund, a medical fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules).
jobs.summary: Director role overseeing technology innovation, digital transformation and AI governance policy frameworks for the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF Level 7 qualification / Degree in Information and Communication Technology (ICT) / Computer Science, Information Systems / Digital Transformation, Engineering/Innovation Management or a relevant equivalent qualification. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at Middle / Senior Management in leading digital transformation, technology adoption, or innovation ecosystem development. A postgraduate qualification (NQF Level 8 or above) in Digital Economy Studies, Technology Management, or Public Sector Innovation will be an added advantage. Skills / Competencies And Knowledge: Strategic Capability and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Programme and Project Management, Financial Management, Change Management, Problem Solving And Analysis, Client Orientation, Customer Focused Communication, Emerging Technology Integration, Internet Of Things (Iot), Cloud Computing, Big Data Analytics, Digital Transformation, ICT Ecosystem, National Digital and Future Skills Strategy 4IR Initiatives, AI Governance and Responsible AI, Emerging Technology Strategy and Foresight, Technology Policy and Regulatory Analysis, Innovation Ecosystem Development, Entrepreneurship and ICT SMME Development, Technology Commercialisation, Strategic Partnership Development and Resource Mobilisation, Public-Private Partnerships, International Technology Cooperation, Technology Investment and Financing Models, Government Policy and Legislative Processes, Technology Standards and Ethics, Innovation Procurement and Market Creation.
jobs.duties: The purpose of the post is to manage and create an enabling digital environment, policy framework and innovative strategic reforms that govern the delivery of technology innovation, research and artificial intelligence governance services in line with the department’s strategic objectives. The successful candidate will manage and drive the development and implementation of technologies and artificial intelligence policies and strategies to drive innovation, entrepreneurship, and economic growth in the digital sector. Research and analyse emerging technologies, market trends and industry practices to inform strategic decision-making and increase innovation in high-tech manufacturing and relevant industries. Invest in research and development (R&D), establish financing and alternative start-up scheme activities to support and promote responsible innovation practices. Facilitate access to venture capital, grants, blended finance, development finance, corporate investment and public-private partnerships, and manage intellectual property and technology transfer processes to support the commercialisation of government-supported innovation. Identify the latest emerging disruptive technologies, potential opportunities of emerging technologies applicable to government, society, and operational services and develop mitigation strategies to mitigate potential risks. Spearhead initiatives to support ICT and mobilise support and incubation to foster a culture of experimentation and creativity within society, driving forward-thinking approaches to problem- solving and service delivery. Develop and support innovation ecosystems, guiding technologies and enterprises through the continuum of research, innovation, prototyping, incubation, funding, commercialisation, market adoption and scaling. Collaborate with industry partners, research institutions, and other stakeholders to establish partnerships to drive technology adoption and innovation and stay updated on the latest technological advancements and trends. Build, negotiate and sustain strategic partnerships with multinational technology companies, research institutions, universities, international organisations, development agencies, investors and entrepreneurs, identifying mutual value and mobilising resources to convert relationships into sustainable programmes. Drive global developments and policy frameworks related to emerging technologies to ensure alignment with national objectives and priorities. Monitor and interpret international technology policy developments within the ITU, United Nations, G20, BRICS, African Union and other relevant institutions, and translate these into South African policy responses and implementation programmes. Conduct SEIAS and manage the design of an AI governance framework to monitor compliance with relevant regulations and standards, manage risks and ensure ethical and responsible AI use. Support the establishment and maintenance of AI Institute, Hubs and Centres of Excellence, and support initiatives to develop AI applications, platforms and solutions in collaboration with entities and partners. Contributing to key result areas such as strategic functional leadership, managing human resources, managing financial resources, driving change and operational excellence, and managing and ensuring compliance.

af.title: Direkteur: Tegnologie-innovasie en Kunsmatige
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat toezig hou oor tegnologie-innovasie, digitale transformasie en KI-beheerbeleidraamwerke vir die Department of Communications and Digital Technologies.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie / graad in Inligting- en Kommunikasietegnologie (IKT) / Rekenaarwetenskap, Inligtingstelsels / Digitale Transformasie, Ingenieurswese/Innovasiebestuur of 'n relevante ekwivalente kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar ervaring op Middel-/Seniorbestuursvlak in die leiding van digitale transformasie, tegnologie-aanneming of innovasie-ekosisteemontwikkeling. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 8 of hoër) in Digitale Ekonomiestudies, Tegnologiebestuur of Publieke Sektornovasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vaardighede / Bevoegdhede en Kennis: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, veranderingbestuur, probleemoplossing en analise, kliëntoriëntasie, kliëntgefokusde kommunikasie, integrasie van opkomende tegnologie, Internet of Things (Iot), wolkrekenaars, ontleding van groot data, digitale transformasie, IKT-ekosisteem, Nasionale Digitale en Toekomstige Vaardigheidsstrategie 4IR-inisiatiewe, KI-beheer en verantwoordelike KI, opkomende tegnologie-strategie en vooruitsig, tegnologiebeleid en regulasie-analise, innovasie-ekosisteemontwikkeling, entrepreneurskap en IKT-KMO-ontwikkeling, tegnologie-kommersialisering, strategiese vennootskapsontwikkeling en hulpbronmobilisering, publiek-privaat vennootskappe, internasionale tegnologie-samewerking, tegnologie-investering en finansieringsmodelle, regeringsbeleid en wetgewende prosesse, tegnologie-standaarde en etiek, innovasie-aankope en markskepping.
af.duties: Die doel van die pos is om 'n bemagtigende digitale omgewing, beleidsraamwerk en innoverende strategiese hervormings te bestuur en te skep wat die lewering van tegnologie-innovasie, navorsing en kunsmatige intelligensie-beheerdienste regeer in ooreenstemming met die departement se strategiese doelwitte. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal die ontwikkeling en implementering van tegnologie- en kunsmatige intelligensie-beleide en -strategieë bestuur en dryf om innovasie, entrepreneurskap en ekonomiese groei in die digitale sektor te dryf. Doen navorsing en ontleed opkomende tegnologieë, markneigings en bedryfspraktyke om strategiese besluitneming te inlig en innovasie in hoëtegnologie-vervaardiging en relevante bedrywe te verhoog. Belê in navorsing en ontwikkeling (N&O), vestig finansiering en alternatiewe beginprogram-aktiwiteite om verantwoordelike innovasiepraktyke te ondersteun en te bevorder. Fasiliteer toegang tot waagkapitaal, toelaes, gemengde finansiering, ontwikkelingsfinansiering, korporatiewe belegging en publiek-privaat vennootskappe, en bestuur intellektuele eiendom en tegnologie-oordragprosesse om die kommersialisering van regeringsondersteunde innovasie te ondersteun. Identifiseer die jongste opkomende ontwrigtende tegnologieë, potensiële geleenthede van opkomende tegnologieë wat van toepassing is op regering, samelewing en operasionele dienste en ontwikkel mitigasiestrategieë om potensiële risiko's te verminder. Neem die voortou met inisiatiewe om IKT te ondersteun en steun en inkubasie te mobiliseer om 'n kultuur van eksperimentasie en kreatiwiteit binne die samelewing te bevorder, wat vooruitdenkende benaderings tot probleemoplossing en dienslewering dryf. Ontwikkel en ondersteun innovasie-ekosisteme, en begelei tegnologieë en ondernemings deur die kontinuum van navorsing, innovasie, prototipering, inkubasie, finansiering, kommersialisering, markaanneming en skaalvergroting. Werk saam met bedryfvennote, navorsingsinstellings en ander belanghebbendes om vennootskappe te vestig om tegnologie-aanneming en innovasie te dryf en op hoogte te bly van die jongste tegnologie-vooruitgang en neigings. Bou, onderhandel en handhaaf strategiese vennootskappe met multinasionale tegnologie-maatskappye, navorsingsinstellings, universiteite, internasionale organisasies, ontwikkelingsagentskappe, beleggers en entrepreneurs, en identifiseer wedersydse waarde en mobiliseer hulpbronne om verwantskappe in volhoubare programme om te sit. Dryf globale ontwikkelings en beleidsraamwerke wat verband hou met opkomende tegnologieë om belyning met nasionale doelwitte en prioriteite te verseker. Monitor en interpreteer internasionale tegnologiebeleid-ontwikkelings binne die ITU, Verenigde Nasies, G20, BRICS, African Union en ander relevante instellings, en vertaal dit in Suid-Afrikaanse beleidsreaksies en implementeringsprogramme. Voer SEIAS uit en bestuur die ontwerp van 'n KI-beheerraamwerk om nakoming van relevante regulasies en standaarde te monitor, risiko's te bestuur en etiese en verantwoordelike KI-gebruik te verseker. Ondersteun die vestiging en instandhouding van KI-instellings, sentrums en vakansiesentrums, en ondersteun inisiatiewe om KI-toepassings, platforms en oplossings in samewerking met entiteite en vennote te ontwikkel. Dra by tot sleutelresultaatgebiede soos strategiese funksionele leierskap, bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, bestuur van finansiële hulpbronne, drywing van verandering en operasionele uitmuntendheid, en bestuur en versekering van nakoming.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ubuchule Obusha Bwe-Theknoloji Nobuhlakani Obwenziwe
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi esibuza ukuphatha ubuchule obusha bwe-theknoloji, ukuguqulwa kwe-dijithali nezinhlelo zomthethosisekelo zokulawula i-AI zomnyango we-Communications and Digital Technologies.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile ezinga le-NQF Level 7 / Isiqu kwi-Information and Communication Technology (ICT) / Computer Science, Information Systems / Digital Transformation, Engineering/Innovation Management noma isiqu esifana nalokho. Okungenani eminyakeni emihlanu (5) yohlu lobudala obuphathi kakhulu ekubeni nomthelela ekubukeni ukuguqulwa kwe-dijithali, ukwamukelwa kwe-theknoloji, noma ekuthuthukisweni kokwakha isimiso sokuhlakanya okusha. Iziqu eziphezulu (NQF Level 8 noma ngaphezulu) kwi-Digital Economy Studies, Technology Management, noma Public Sector Innovation kuzoba yinzuzo. Amakhono / Ikhono futhi Ulwazi: Amandla okubeka ihlelo Nokuba NoMphathi, Ukuphatha Abantu Nokubanika Amandla, Ukuphatha Uhlelo Namaphrojekthi, Ukuphatha Izimali, Ukuphatha Ishintsho, Ukuxazulula Izinkinga Nokuhlaziya, Ukuqonda Abathengi, Ukuxhumana Okugxile Kubathengi, Ukuhlanganisa Itheknoloji Ephumayo, Internet Of Things (Iot), Cloud Computing, Ukuhlaziya Imininingwane Enkulu, Ukuguqulwa Kwe-Dijithali, Isimiso Se-ICT, Inqubo Yezobuchwepheshe Bendawo Nezekusasa yama-4IR Initiatives, Ukulawula I-AI Nendlela Ebenziwe Yokusebenzisa I-AI, Inqubo Yetheknoloji Ephumayo Nokuqaphela Isikhathi, Itheknoloji Inqubo Yokulawula Nomthetho, Ukuthuthukisa Isimiso Sokuhlakanya Okusha, Ukuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amakhulu Namancane Kwi-ICT SMME Development, Ukuthengisa Itheknoloji, Ukuthuthukiswa Kokuhlangana Ngezinhloso Eziyisinqamo Nokusondezwa Kwemithombo, Ukuhlanganiswa Komphakathi Nobucala, Ukusebenzisana Kwamazwe Ngamtheknoloji, Ukuwachitha Amatheknoloji Namasu Ezezimali, Inqubo Yomthetho Kuhulumeni Nemithetho Yezwe, Izinga Nemithetho Yetheknoloji, Ukuthenga Ubuchule Bokuhlakanywa Nokudala Imakethe.
zu.duties: Injongo yesikhundla ukuphatha futhi kudale indawo enika amandla i-dijithali, inqubo yomthethosisekelo nezinguquko ezinguqulayo ezihle zokuphatha ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo ze-theknoloji ehlakanywe kabusha, ucwaningo lolwazi bokulawula i-AI ngokuvumelana nezinhloso ezihleliwe zomnyango. Owayindaba angaphatha futhi aqonde ekuthuthukisweni nasekusetshenzisweni kwezinhlelo zomthetho namasu e-theknoloji ehlakanywe kabusha noma i-AI ukuqonda okuhlakaniphile, ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi, nokuqhuba inqubo yokukhula kwezomnotho kwisimiso se-dijithali. Kufanele kwenziwe ucwaningo nokuqoqa lolwazi mayelana ne-theknoloji ephumayo, izinkomba zamanje kanye namasu wobuchwepheshe bokuqonda ukuthatha izinqumo ezihle, nokwengeza ukuhlakaniphile ekukhiqizeni inqubo ye-theknoloji nakuqoqoqo oluhlobene nayo. Kufanele kuwiswe imali ku-cwaningo futhi sikhuthazwe ekuthuthukisweni (R&D), sibheke ukutholwa noma ukuhlelelwa nezinye izimiso noma izinhlela zokuxhasa inkampani entsha ukuyixhasa futhi sikhuthaze izinhlelo ezibhekene nobuchule obuhlakaniphile. Kubuye kufanele kugqugquzelwe ukungena emahlinweni oqoqo oluzuzisayo, ukusiza, ukuxhasa kwezezimali, ukuxhasa ngemali yentuthuko, ukufaka imali amabhizinisi amakhulu nokuxhumana nomphakathi nobucile, futhi kuphathwe imininingwane yokuqonda nokudluliswa kwe-theknoloji ngokuqonda ukuthengisa ubuchule ehlakanywe kabusha ohulumedeni. Okufanele kuqashelwe kakhulu yikubuka i-theknoloji ephumayo noma evela inqubo entsha, amathuba angenzeka noma angatholakala e-Atheknoloji ephumayo okungeniswa kuhulumeni, emphakathini, nakuzezelwa ezinsizakalweni ngaphakathi futhi kuhlelwe inqubo yokubambe phansi inqubo yochungechunge kulezo zinkinga. Okuyindaba nje kufanele kuqondwe ukuxhaswa kwama-ICT nokubolekwa ngamandla nokuqashelwa okukhulisa amandla okuhlola kanye nobuciko empilweni yakho nabantu bakhona, kube nomthelela ekubukeni ukuxazulula izinkinga nasezinsizakalweni ezinikelwa abantu. Kufanele kuhlelwe futhi kuxhaswe izimiso esiwu-hlakani nobuchule, kuholele izimiso futhi izinsizakalo kulo lonke uhlu lokuhlangana, kusukela kwezocwaningo, ekuhlakanyweni kabusha, ekukhiqizeni nasekubukeleni amaphrojekthi amasha, ekuxhaseni kwamabhizinisi aye kuqoqo lokuthengisa, aze abambe iqhaza emakethe futhi akhule. Kuyadingeka kusebenzelane nothisha nabashwashwashi kwi-theknoloji, amalungu ophando, kanye nalabo abafuna ukuphathwa ngokukhululekile ukuqonde ukwamukelwa kwetheknoloji ephiwo nobuchwepheshe bokwamukela iqiniso lokuqonda izinkomba ezenzakalayo nezingaphezulu kwazo zonke eziyisikhathi esisha ezingakaqeqhwa ngaloluhlelo lwe-theknoloji. Kufanele kuqondwe, kuxoxwe futhi kugcinwe ukuhlangana ngokuhleleleka nezinkampani zikawonke wonke eziphathwa yi-theknoloji, amalungu abafundi kanye nabalimele be-Fakalthi namanyuvesi, amahlelo ezezwe lilonke, abaxhasi bokuqhuba ukulunga, kanye nabatshali bomali nabaphathe imali abayicusha kulezi zinto, kuhlakaniswe ukubonisa ukuthi kufanele kutholakale izinhloso kuhlelwe imali esebenzisa ubudlelwano bokuqonda ukubuka izinsiza noma izindaba ukuziphendukela kwalezo zinhlelo eziqhubekayo emaphakathi. Kubuye kufanele kuhlutshwe imali yazo zonke izinkomba ze-theknoloji nezinhlelo zomthethosisekelo mayelana nabakwamukela kumthelela wokuqonda izinhloso kanye nezinkomba ezihleliwe zabantu abavela emazweni athile ngokuzivumelanisa nezinhlelo namanye amaphuzu abalulekile ekulawulweni i-theknoloji namanye amaphuzu abalulekile ekulawulweni i-theknoloji ephumayo noma okukhona. Kufanele kuhlelwe futhi kuqoqwe nokuqondwe ngokubuka imithetho yamazwe ngamanye i-theknoloji abekelwe yi-ITU, United Nations, G20, BRICS, African Union namanye amalungu abalulekile ngokuyiqondisa ekubukeni imithetho nezinhlelo mayelana nokususwa kwentuthuko i-theknoloji emhlabeni wonke nokuyiqondisa kuwo emazweni aseNingizimu Afrika. Kubuye kufanele kuhlelwe i-SEIAS futhi kuphathwe uhlelo lokulawula i-AI ngokubuka ukulandelana nemithetho yezwe kanye nezinkomba ezenzakalayo ezibambe iqhaza ekulawulweni noma ekunqumeni imithetho yokwamukela i-theknoloji ukuze kugcine ukulawula ubungozi nokuphathwa kabi nasekuthathweni kwamanyathelo okuqonda ukusetshenziswa kolwazi oluhlakaniphile. Kufanele kuxhaswe ukusungulwa nokugcinwa kwe-AI Institute, ama-Hub kanye nama-Centres of Excellence, futhi kuxhaswe izinhlelo zokwenza izinhlelo zamabhizinisi noma izinkomba ezinikeza amandla i-AI ngokusebenzisana namanye amaphuzu amakhulu namalungu aphezu kwawo. Okuhlangenwe nakho kule mininingwane okuyisikhungo esikhulu kungathuthukisa izindawo ezibalulekile njengokuba ngumphathi wezinsiza, ukuphatha abantu futhi ube negalelo ekubukeni imali, ukuqonda ukuguqulwa nangemisebenzi ephumelelayo, ukuphatha futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho.

xh.duties: Injongo yesi sithuba kukulawula kunye nokudala indawo ekhululekileyo yedijithali, inkqubo yeenkqubo zolawulo kunye neenguqu ezinguqukelayo ezilawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo zotshintsho olutsha kwiteknoloji, uphando kunye nokulawulwa kobuchwepheshe bokwenza ngokwengqondo ngokwemigaqo yenjongo yesebe. Omele kule пост ukuqwalasela iimpawu ezinomthamo wolawulo. Umntu ofanelekayo uya kulawula kunye nokukhokela uphuhliso kunye nokusebenzisa iiteknoloji kunye neenkqubo zolawulo kobuchwepheshe bokwenza ngokwengqondo ukuze khuthaze ukutshintsha, ungeniso lwemali, nokukhula kwezoqoqosho kwicandelo ledijithali. Qwalasela kunye nokuhlaziya iiteknoloji ezitsha, iintshukumo zemarike kunye neenkonzo zeshishini ukuze umise izigqibo ezingcali kunye nokwandisa ukutshintsha kwimveliso yamashishini amakhulu kwaye nase kwelinye iqela leshishini. Tyala imali kuphando kunye nophuhliso (R&D), misela iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuxhasa amaqumrhu amatsha ashishino ukuxhasa kunye nokukhuthaza iindlela eziziphandlayo zokutshintsha. Yenza kube lula ukufikelela kwimali yotyalo-mali, malini ekhutshwa ngamajoni, imali ehlanganiswayo, imali yophuhliso, utyalo-mali lwamashishini kunye nobudlelwane obusesiqu phakathi kwabalinganiswa basesikhundleni, ulawule inkqubo yamalungelo obuchwepheshe kunye nokudlulisa iinkqubo zolwazi ukuze uxhase ukwenziwa koludwebiso lwezinto ezixhaswa ngurhulumente. Qaphela iiteknoloji ezitsha ezichaphazela izinto, amathuba anokubakho ezo nteknoloji ezinokusebenza kurhulumente, kuhlalatheni nakwiinkonzo, uphuhlise iindlela zokunciphisa iingozi ezinokubakho. Khokela iinqobo zokuxhasa i-ICT kunye nokuba mandla kwakho nokukhusela iinkqubo zokunceda ukuba ziqhube phambili ukuze kwakheke isiko lokuzama izinto nokwenza izinto ngokobuchwephesha kuhlalatheni, kukhokele iindlela ezicingwayo zokusombulula iingxaki nakunikweni kweenkonzo. Phuhlisa uxhase ii-ecosystem zotshintsho, khokela iiteknoloji namarshishini apha kwindlela yokuphanda, ukutshintsha, ukwenza iimodeli ezingako, ukukhusela iinkqubo ezitsha, ukuxhaswa ngemali, ukwenza uludwebiso lwezinto kumarike, nokwamkelwa kwamarike. Sebenzisana namaphatho eshishini, iindawo zophando, nabo bonke abo banomdla ukwakha amaqela abakho ukuze khuthaze ukwamkelwa kweeknoloji nakutshintshweni, uhlale ulungile ngeenkqubo zobuchwepheshe ezize zatsha. Yakha, uncwadi lugcino, ugcine amaqela abakho anomdla obuchwepheshe namashishini amakhulu, iindawo zophando, iyunivesithi, iindawo zamazwe ngamazwe, amaqela ophuhliso, abatyalo-mali, nabashishini, qaphela ixabiso eliphathwayo kwaye ubuze imali yokuxhasa iinkqubo ukuze uguqule amaqela abo abe ziinkqubo ezisindayo. Khokela iindlela zophuhliso lwamazwe ngamazwe kunye neenkqubo zolawulo ezinxulumene neeknologi ezitsha ukuze qinisekise ukuba zihambelana nenjongo yezizwe. Qwalasela uhlalutye iinkqubo zamazwe ngamazwe zolawulo lweeknoloji ngaphakathi kwe-ITU, iZizwe Ezimanyeneyo, i-G20, i-BRICS, Umbutho we-Afrika nantoni na na enye iindawo ezinomdla, uze uyiguquule ibe ngumphendulo wemigaqo yaseMzantsi Afrika nakuqhubekayo phambili kweenkqubo. Yenza i-SEIAS ulawule ukumiselwa kwenkqubo yamalungelo abuchwepheshe bokwenza ngokwengqondo ukuze ulawule ukuthobela imigaqo nemiqathango, ulawule iingozi ukuze qinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe bokwenza ngokwengqondo okufanelekileyo ngokomoya. Xhasa ukumiswa kunye nogcino lwe-AI Institute, i-Hubs kunye nee-Centres of Excellence, uxhase iinqobo zokuphuhlisa izicelo ze-AI, iiplatforms kunye nezisombululo ngokusebenzisana nabaqulunqi kunye nabakho. Y贡献a kwimisebenzi ebalulekileyo efana nokuba ngumkhokeli ongcali, ukulawula abasebenzi, ukulawula imali, ukukhokela iinguqu ezinguqukelayo nangokuphumelela, kunye nokulawula kunye noqinisekiso lokuthobela imigaqo.

jobs.title: Director: Parliamentary, Cabinet and Cluster Support
jobs.department: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (the all-inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Pension Fund, a medical fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules).
jobs.summary: Direct parliamentary, cabinet and cluster support services for the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies, managing all parliamentary processes in support of the Director-General.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF Level 7 qualification / Degree in Public Administration / Political Science / Law or Management or relevant equivalent qualification as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at Middle / Senior Management level in Parliamentary and Cabinet environment. Skills / Competencies And Knowledge: Strategic Capability and Leadership, People management and Empowerment, Programme and project Management, Financial Management, Change Management, Problem Solving and Analysis, Client Orientation, Customer Focused Communication, Analytic and Problem-Solving Skills, E-Cabinet system for Cabinet Work, Government Administrative Processes, Continuous Learning, Agility and Adaptability, Public Service Regulations Act, Public Financial Management Act, RSA Constitution, Labour Legislation.
jobs.duties: The purpose of the post is to manage and drive the provision of effective and efficient Parliamentary, Cabinet and Cluster services in support of the Director- General. The successful candidate will manage and drive all parliamentary processes relating to the department, including preparing and submitting parliamentary questions (PQs), briefing notes, and responses to committee requests, to ensure compliance with parliamentary rules and timelines. Manage and drive the flow of parliamentary questions (oral and written); ensure quality control, accuracy, and compliance with deadlines; track progress and maintain the central PQ management system; support/facilitate preparation for parliamentary meetings, debates, and committee sittings. Manage the coordination of cabinet memoranda/submissions; ensure documents meet secretariat standards and are submitted within timelines; prepare briefing packs for the Director-General ahead of cabinet/committee meetings; and track post-cabinet decisions and monitor departmental implementation. Provision of administrative support to the department and Ministry in relation to Cabinet/Cluster and Parliamentary work and enable seamless integration of content to be submitted to Cabinet/Cluster. Manage EXCO/MANCO related requests. Drive adherence to governance systems and processes, model the culture of the Department, manage DGO staff based in the Parliamentary office in Cape Town and manage Directorate risks. Manage and drive the department’s participation in Parliamentary Portfolio and Select Committee meetings, including preparation of presentations, briefing documents, and follow-up actions. Act as a key point of contact with the Cabinet Secretariat; Parliamentary Committees, Ministry, Cluster departments, and senior management in the department. Identify emerging risks raised in Parliament for the department and advise the Director-General on mitigation actions, ensure rapid response mechanisms for urgent PQs. Review and ensure the quality, accuracy, and policy alignment of all Parliamentary and Cabinet submissions, briefing notes, speeches and reports before submission to the Executive Authority. Contributing to key result areas such as strategic functional leadership, managing human resources, managing financial resources, driving change and operational excellence, and managing and ensuring compliance.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Sekele Tel No: (012) 427 8599, Ms N Khosa Tel No: (012) 427 8260, Mr M Cilo at 068 227 5029

af.title: Direkteur: Parlementêre, Kabinet- en Trosondersteuning
af.summary: Bied direkte parlementêre, kabinet- en trosondersteuningsdienste vir die Department of Communications and Digital Technologies, en bestuur alle parlementêre prosesse ter ondersteuning van die Direkteur-generaal.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie / graad in Publieke Administrasie / Politieke Wetenskap / Regte of Bestuur of 'n toepaslike equivalente kwalifikasie soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op Middle / Senior Management-vlak in 'n parlementêre en kabinetomgewing. Vaardighede / Bevoegdhede en Kennis: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, veranderingsbestuur, probleemoplossing en analise, kliëntgerigtheid, klijëntgefokusde kommunikasie, analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede, E-Kabinetstelsel vir Kabinetwerk, regeringsadministratiewe prosesse, deurlopende leer, beweeglikheid en aanpasbaarheid, Public Service Regulations Act, Public Financial Management Act, RSA Constitution, Arbeidswetgewing.
af.duties: Die doel van die pos is om die voorsiening van effektiewe en doeltreffende Parlementêre, Kabinet- en Trosdienste ter ondersteuning van die Direkteur-generaal te bestuur en aan te dryf. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal alle parlementêre prosesse wat verband hou met die departement bestuur en aanstuur, insluitend die voorbereiding en indiening van parlementêre vrae (PQ's), notas van inligting en antwoorde op komiteeversoeke, om nakoming van parlementêre reëls en tydlyne te verseker. Bestuur en dryf die vloei van parlementêre vrae (mondelings en skriftelik) aan; verseker gehaltebeheer, akkuraatheid en nakoming van sperdatums; volg vordering en handhaaf die sentrale PQ-bestuurstelsel; ondersteun/fasiliteer voorbereiding vir parlementêre vergaderings, debatte en komiteesessies. Bestuur die koördinering van kabinetmemoranda/voorleggings; verseker dat dokumente aan sekretariaatstandaarde voldoen en binne tydlyne ingedien word; berei voorleggingspakkette vir die Direkteur-generaal voor voorafgaande aan kabinet/komiteevergaderings; en volg na-kabinetbesluite en monitor departementele implementering. Voorsien administratiewe ondersteuning aan die departement en die Ministerie met betrekking tot Kabinet/Tros- en Parlementêre werk en stel naadlose integrasie van inhoud wat na die Kabinet/Tros ingedien moet word, in staat. Bestuur EXCO/MANCO-verwante versoeke. Dryf nakoming van bestuurstelsels en -prosesse aan, modelleer die kultuur van die Departement, bestuur DGO-personeel wat in die Parlementêre kantoor in Cape Town gestasioneer is, en bestuur Direktoraatrisiko's. Bestuur en dryf die departement se deelname aan Parlementêre Portefeulje- en Seleksiekomiteevergaderings aan, insluitend die voorbereiding van aanbiedings, voorleggingsdokumente en opvolgaksies. Tree op as 'n sleutelkontakpunt met die Kabinetsekretariaat; Parlementêre Komitees, Ministerie, Trosdepartemente en senior bestuur in die departement. Identifiseer opkomende risiko's wat in die Parlement vir die departement geopper word en stel die Direkteur-generaal in kennis oor mitigeringsaksies, verseker vinnige reaksiemeganismes vir dringende PQ's. Hersien en verseker die gehalte, akkuraatheid en beleidsbelyning van alle Parlementêre en Kabinetvoorleggings, notas van inligting, toesprake en verslae voor indiening by die Uitvoerende Gesag. Bydrae tot sleutelresultaatgebiede soos strategiese funksionele leierskap, bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, bestuur van finansiële hulpbronne, aanstuur van verandering en operasionele uitnemendheid, en bestuur en verseker van nakoming.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Ukusekela kwe-Parliamentary, Cabinet kanye ne-Cluster
zu.summary: uqondise imisebenzi yesekelo ye-parliamentary, cabinet kanye ne-cluster yomnyango we-Department of Communications and Digital Technologies, ephatha zonke izinqubo ze-parliamentary ngokusekelwa komqondisi-jikele.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezifanele zeNQF Level 7 / Isiqu soMfundi soMnyango / ISayensi yezepolitiki / Umthetho noma ukuLawula noma ezilinganayo ezifanele njengoba zivunywe yi-South African Qualifications Authority. Ukuze kube khona iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yokusebenza kuleveli yezinga eliphakathi / eliphezulu lokuphatha ezindaweni ze-Parliamentary kanye ne-Cabinet. Amakhono / Ikhono / Ulwazi: Ikhono lokuhlela kanye nokuqondisa, ukuphatha abantu nokuKhuthaza, ukuphatha uhlelo kanye nomklamo, ukuphatha izimali, ukuPhatha ukuShintsha, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye ne-analizi, ukukhethwa kwegciwane, isikhashana nekusebenza kahle kweklenti, amakhono e-analizi nokuxazulula izinkinga, uhlelo lwe-E-Cabinet ngomsebenzi weCabinet, izinqubo zokuphatha kahle zombuso, ukufunda ngokuqhubekayo, ukushesha nokuzelelwa, umthetho wePublic Service Regulations Act, umthetho wePublic Financial Management Act, i-RSA Constitution, umthetho wobudlelwano basesebenzini.
zu.duties: Inhloso yesikhundla ukuphatha futhi kunqabe ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi ethembekile nesebenzayo ye-Parliamentary, Cabinet kanye ne-Cluster ngokusekelwa umqondisi-jikele. Ophumeleleyo uzophatha futhi aqhube zonke izinqubo ze-parliamentary ezihlotshaniswe nomnyango, okuhlanganisa ukulungisa nokuthumela imibuzo ye-parliamentary (PQs), amanotsi okwazisa, kanye neziphendulo ezikuwo amacala ezidingweni zikomiti, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nemithetho yesikhathi nemigomo ye-parliamentary. Phatha futhi uqhubise ukugeleza kwemibuzo ye-parliamentary (yangomlomo nobhalwayo); qinisekisa ukulawula ikhwalithi, ukuqiniseka, kanye nokuhambisana namadedele abalulekile; landa inqubo ulondoloze indlela yokuphatha i-PQ ekuqhubeni; sekela/ukhuthaza ukulungiselela izinkomfa ze-parliamentary, izingxoxo, kanye nezikhathi zokuhlala zikomiti. Phatha ukuhleleniswa kwemibhalo/izithunywa ze-cabinet; qinisekisa ukuthi amafayela ahambisana nemigomo yesikhungo sokubhala futhi athunyelwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi; lungisa amaphakethe okwazisa umqondisi-jikelele ngaphambi kokuhlangana komnyango/komiti; futhi ulande izinqumo zangemva kwe-cabinet ulawule ukuphathwa komnyango. Ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuphatha umnyango kanye noMnyango mayelana nomsebenzi we-Cabinet/Cluster kanye ne-Parliamentary futhi kunikeze ukuhlanganiswa okuhambisayo kokuqukethwe okuzothunyelwa ku-Cabinet/Cluster. Phatha izidingo ezihlobene ne-EXCO/MANCO. Qhubisa ukulandelwa kwamasistimu nokuqhutshwa kwezinsiza, makenze isiko lomnyango, phatha abasebenzi be-DGO abahlala ehhovisi le-parliamentary eCape Town futhi uphathe izengozi zombuso. Phatha futhi uqhubise ukubamba kwakhona komnyango emihlanganweni yamakomiti we-Parliamentary Portfolio kanye ne-Select, okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela okwethulwayo, amafayela okwazisa, kanye nokuqhathaniswa kwemisebenzi. Yiba ngumphumela obalulekile wokuqhathanisa noCabinet Secretariat; Amakomiti e-Parliamentary, oMnyango, amaphuzu amnyama kanye nezinga eliphezulu kombuso. Hlakanipha izingozi ezisanda zibonakala ezikhulunywa ePhalamende umnyango, fellule umqondisi-jikelele ngemisebenzi yokunciphisa, qinisekisa izindlela zokuphendula ngokushesha zemibuzo ebalulekile ye-PQ. Hlola futhi qinisekisa ikhwalithi, ukuqiniseka, kanye nokuhambisana kwezinqubo zamaphuzu wonke umsebenzi we-Parliamentary kanye ne-Cabinet, amanotsi okwazisa, izinkulumo kanye nemibiko ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa kubuNgaphansi. Ukufaka isandla ezindaweni eziyisiphethu ezibalulekile ezinjengokubusa ngokusebenza, ukuphatha abantu, ukuphatha izimali, ukukhuthaza ushintsho nokuqhuba okuhle, kanye nokuphatha kanye nezenzo zokusebenza kahle zokwazisa.

xh.title: Umhleli: Inkxaso yeNkqubo yoMlawulo, iKhabhini kunye neQela
xh.summary: Phatha iinkonzo zenkxaso yenkqubo yolawulo, ikhabhini neseqela kwiSebe lezeThunuzelo eziBhalwe nokuSebenza kwezulwini, ulawule zonke iinkqubo zekomiti yolawulo ngokwenza inkxaso kuMlawuli-Jikele.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo senqanaba le-NQF Level 7 / Isidanga kwi-Nkuluseko kaRhulumente / iZaziso lweZopolitiko / uMthetho okanye uLawulo okanye isifundo esilinganayo esihambelana nesi esivunywa yi-South African Qualifications Authority. Amava amabalwa angapesheya kweminyaka emihlanu (5) ukusebenza kwinqanaba leLawulo eliPhakathi / eliPhezulu kwimeko yekomiti yolawulo neKhabhini. Amandla / Ulwazi / Unyango: AmandlaokuQamba iNdlela nokulawula, uLawula abantu nokubakhulisa, uLawulo lweNkqubo namaprojekthi, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuQwalasela, uJolise kumthengi, uNxibelelwano oluQondiswe kumthengi, AmandlaokuQwalasela nokuSombulula iingxaki, inkqubo ye-E-Cabinet yomsebenzi weKhabhini, iNkqubo zoLawulo zoRhulumente, ukuFunda ngokungapheli, uKwazi ukutshintsha ngokukhawuleza nokuLunga iimeko, uMthetho weSatshati weNkonzo kaRhulumente, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, uMgaqo-siseko weRSA, uMthetho weBasebenzi.
xh.duties: Injongo yesithuba kukulawula kwapha kunye nokukhokela ukunikwa kweenkonzo ezisebenzayo nangempumelelo zenkqubo yolawulo, iKhabhini kunye neQela ngokwenza inkxaso kuMlawuli-Jikele. Ophumeleleyo uya kuba ngumlawuli nokukhokela zonke iinkqubo zekomiti yolawulo ezithintela isebе, kuquka ukuqokelela nokunikela iimbuzo yekomiti yolawulo (PQs), iintshutsho zokwazisa, kwaye anike iimpendulo kwiimfuno zekomiti, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho yekomiti yolawulo namaxesha. Lawula kwapha ukujija kweembuzo zekomiti yolawulo (ezilwandoyo nezibhaliweyo); qinisekisa ulawulo lobungakanani, ukuchaneka, nokuhambelana namaxesha; landela inkqubo kwaye ugcine inkqubo ephakathi yokulawula i-PQ; nceda/lenza izibikelelo kwiimfundo zekomiti yolawulo, iingxoxo, kunye nezihlalo zekomiti. Lawula uququaniso lwemizekelo yekhabhini/okunikelwayo; qinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu ahambelana namagqabantshiweyo esikaliwo kwaye anikelwe ngaphakathi kwamaxhesha; lungiseela iipakethe zokwazisa kuMlawuli-Jikele ngaphambi kweemfundo zekhabhini/ekomiti; kwaye ulandele iigqibo zangemva kweKhabhini kwaye ulawule ukuphunyezwa ngokusebenzisa isebе. Nikela ngenkxaso yolawulo isebе nakwiMinistry ngokuphathelele umsebenzi weKhabhini/iQela kunye neNkqubo yoLawulo kwaye uvumele ukudityaniswa okukhawulezayo kolwazi okunikelwa kuKhabhini/iQela. Lawula iimfuno ezidityene ne-EXCO/MANCO. Khokela ukuthobela iinkqubo nendlela zolawulo, ukuba yomfanekiso wendalo yesebе, lawula abasebenzi beDBO abakweziiko leNkqubo yoLawulo eCape Town kwaye ulawule iingozi zeKhahleli. Lawula kwapha ungeno lwesebe ekuzimeni kwiimfundo zeKomiti yoLawulo yaseKhahlephi nakwiKomiti eKhethiweyo, kuquka ukuqokelela iintonombexhelo, amaxwebhu okwazisa, nangokulandela izenzo. Yiba yindawo ebalulekileyo yonxibelelwano neSikali saseKhabhini; amaKomiti oLawulo, iMinistry, oonozibasebenzi beqela, kunye nolawulo oluphezulu kwisebe. Phawula iingozi eziphuma kuloLawulo ezizakuvela kwisebe kwaye ucebe uMlawuli-Jikele ngendlela zokuzithintela, qinisekisa iindlela zokuphendula ngokukhawuleza i-PQ ezingxamisekileyo. Phinda uqwalasele kwaye uqinisekise ubungakanani, ukuchaneka, kunye nokuqonda kwemigaqo yonke amaxwebhu oLawulo nakuKhabhini, iintshutsho zokwazisa, iinkulumo namaxwebhu ngaphambi kokunika uGunya oluPhethwe ngamagunya. Nceda kumagumbi eziphambili ezinje ngokuba ngumkhokeli wobuchule, ulawulo lweemfuno zabantu, ulawulo lweemfuno zemali, ukukhokela inguquko nokugqitywa kweenkqubo, kunye nokulawula nokwqinisekisa ukuthobela.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Employee Relations
jobs.department: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (the all-inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Pension Fund, a medical fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules).
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Employee Relations role at the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies in Pretoria, managing labour relations policies and ER compliance frameworks.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF level 7 qualification/Degree in Labour Relations/ Labour Law / Human Resources Management or a relevant equivalent field as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority. A minimum of three (3) years' experience at Assistant Director/Middle Management level in delivering labour relations services. PERSAL proficiency. Skills / Competencies And Knowledge: Job knowledge, Quality of Work, Initiatives; Planning and Executions, Communication, Teamwork, Reliability, Ability to Meet Deadlines, Ability to Work Under Pressure, Service Delivery Innovation, Project Management, Report Writing, Investigation, Problem Solving and Analysis, Negotiation, Discipline Management, Collective bargaining, Conflict and Dispute Resolution, Research, Data analysis, Presentation, Facilitation, Honesty, Integrity Business partnering, HCM Systems, HCM Policies And Procedures.
jobs.duties: Manage the design and maintenance of employee relations policies, plans, systems, guidelines, procedures, and processes, in line with the relevant public service prescripts, and monitor compliance. Provide advice on all ER legislative framework and processes, including rights and obligations, interpretation of policies and labour law, and facilitate capacity-building programs to empower employees on ER matters and supervisors on discipline management. Obtain mandates where required and represent the department in relevant ER structures, hearings and labour relations forums. Manage conciliation/arbitration cases, as well as the implementation of arbitration awards and Labour Court judgments. Coordinate and monitor labour disputes in collaboration with legal services/state attorney on litigation cases. Manage and conduct ER investigations, draft charge sheets, and ensure resolutions/outcomes are approved, communicated and implemented. Facilitate the resolution of employee grievances and disputes to maintain a harmonious work environment and promote a positive work culture. Facilitate disciplinary/consequence management processes and ensure finalisation of cases, including referral of criminal cases to relevant law enforcement agencies. Manage and facilitate the department’s collective bargaining processes and agreements, including consulting on topics, providing data and developing action plans. Establish and maintain partnerships and regularly liaise with organised labour. af.duties: Bestuur die ontwerp en onderhoud van werknemerverhoudingsbeleid, planne, stelsels, riglyne, prosedures en prosesse, in ooreenstemming met die relevante openbare diens voorskrifte, en monitor nakoming. Fasiliteer dissiplinêre/gevolgbestuursprosesse en verseker finalisering van sake, insluitend verwysing van kriminele sake na relevante regshandhawingsagentskappe. Bestuur en fasiliteer die departement se kollektiewe onderhandelingsprosesse en -ooreenkomste, insluitend raadpleging oor onderwerpe, verskaffing van data en ontwikkel aksieplanne. Okungenani isipiliyoni seminyaka emithathu (3) ezingeni lika-Assistant Director/Middle management ekuletheleni izinsiza zezinqubo zokusebenza. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa i-PERSAL. Amakhono / Amandla Nokwazile: Ulwazi ngomsebenzi, Ikhwalithi yomsebenzi, Ukuqala; Ukuphucula nokuhamba phambili, Ukuxhumana, Ukusebenza njengesiqembu, Ukuthembeka, Ukukwazi ukugcwalisa izikhathi ezimisiwe, Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela, Inqubomgomo yokuqamba izinsiza zokuletha izimpilo, Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, Ukubhala imibiko, Ukuqeqesha, Ukuhlola izinkinga nokuzibuyekeza, Ukuxoxisana, Ukuphatha isiyaluyalu, Ukulondoloza amalungelo, Ukuxazulula izingxabano nokungabambisani, Ucwaningo, Ukuhlaziya idatha, Okunikezwa phambi kwabantu, Ukwenza kube lula, Ukwethembeka, Ukusebenzisana kwamabhizinisi, Amasistimu e-HCM, Inqubomgomo nezinqubo ze-HCM.
zu.duties: Phatha ukwakheka nokugcinwa kwezinqubo, izinhlelo, izixazululi, iziqondiso kanye nendlela zokwenza izinto ezihlobene nobudlelwano babasebenzi, ngokuhambisana nemithetho yesevisi yomphakathi egqamile, bese uqapha ukuthi kuhambisana yini. Nikela ngeluleko ngezinhlelo zomthetho nangezinqubo zobudlelwano babasebenzi, okuhlanganisa namalungelo nezibopho, incazelo yezinqubo kanye nomthetho wokusebenza, futhi uthuthukise izinhlela zokwakha amandla ukugcwalisa izidingo zabasebenzi ngemayelana nobudlelwano babasebenzi, kanye nabaphathi ngokuphatha isiyaluyalu. Thola imiyalelo lapho kudingeka khona futhi umele umnyango kumakomidi abudlelwano babasebenzi, ezinkundleni zokuva kanye namarobho wemisebenzi. Phatha icala lokuxazulula izingxabano/ ukulalelwa kwezinsolo, kanye nokuphatha izinqumo zokulalelwa kwezinsolo nezinqumo zika-Labour Court. Hlanganisa futhi uqashe izinkinga zemisebenzi ngokusebenzisana nomsebenzi wezomthetho/nogqaja wesifundazwe kumacala ezomthetho. Phatha futhi wenze izinhlelo zokuhlola ubudlelwano babasebenzi, bhala amakhasi ezinsolo, futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izinqumo zigunyazwe, zaziswa futhi zisetshenziswe. Khokhela ukuxazululwa kokungalungi kanye nezinkinga zabasebenzi ukugcina indawo yokusebenza enhle futhi ukuthuthukisa isiko elihle lokusebenza. Khokhela izinqubo zokuphatha isiyaluyalu/ iziphetho, bese eqinisekisa ukuba kwakhiwa amacala, okuhlanganisa nokuthumela amacala ezenzo ezingelonya kumapoyisa ahambisana nomthetho. Phatha futhi ukukhokhelwa kolunye ucwaningo nokuxoxisana ngemisebenzi kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwayo, okuhlanganisa nokuxoxa ngezihloko, ukunika idatha kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokwenza. Suka udale futhi ugcine ubudlelwano futhi ukhulume njalo neqembu labasebenzi. Phatha futhi uhlele izinqubo zokulalelwa kuphondo, okuhlanganisa ukumiswa kwamalungu ekomidi, abahenuzi/abasunguli, kanye nabasihlalo, bese ethola izinqumo ezingunyathiwe kanye nokuqwashisa ngokuqedwa kwayo. Lungiselela futhi ukhokhele ukugunyazwa kanye nokuthunyelwa kwezibalo zaminye, nyanga zonke, nezinyanga ezinhlanu kanye neminye yonke yezibalo zemisebenzi kubaphathi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Yisisekelo kumagumbi okwenza izinto njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuqinisekisa ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuphatha insiza yemali, ukushintsha futhi uholele ekusebenzeni kwezobuciko, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana. jobs.summary: Deputy Director role coordinating governance frameworks and performance improvement initiatives at the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF level 7 qualifications / Degree in Risk Management / Governance and Compliance / Operational Management/Quality Management or relevant equivalent qualification as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority. A minimum of three (3) years' experience at Assistant Director/Middle Management level in a Governance and Compliance environment. Training certificate in Business Process Management or related training. Skills / Competencies and Knowledge: Job knowledge, Quality of Work, Initiative, Planning and Execution, Communication, Teamwork, Reliability, Service Delivery Innovation, Governance and Compliance, Policy Coordination, Business Process Analysis and Mapping, Quality Management/Assurance, Stakeholder Engagement, Benchmarking, Research.

Business Processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in line with approved guidelines and a risk- based approach. Maintain a comprehensive, up-to-date database of policy, SOP, and business process blueprints and registers to ensure consistency, accuracy, and accessibility, and to monitor compliance. Identify and advise on processes that could be reengineered, in collaboration with the business units and IT, to improve operational effectiveness. Facilitate the establishment of quality standards for programme delivery to ensure outcomes meet defined standards. Manage the development of governance terms of reference and charters and monitor their effective rollout and adoption across the Department. Assist in interfacing with oversight structures through effective processing of their recommendation. Assist with enterprise project management administrative activities where required. Contributing to key result areas such as project management, managing financial resources, driving change and operational excellence and managing compliance.

Okungenani amakhulu amathathu (3) iminyaka yokuhlangabezana njengomqondisi osekelayo/ohlezi ohlelweni lophuhliso wesikhundla esiphakathi kumgwaqo we Governance and Compliance. Amakhono / Ukuziphatha kanye nolwazi: Ulwazi ngomsebenzi, Isiphathamva somsebenzi, Ukuzethemba, Ukuhlela kanye nokuphumeza, Ukuxhumana, Ukusebenza njengesiqu, Ukwethembeka, Ukuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwenkonzo, Ulawulo kanye nokuqwalasela, Ukuhlelelana kwezinqubo, Ukuhlaziya kanye nokuqamba amandla wezinhlelo zokuhamba kwezabhizinisi, Ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi/ukukhombisa, Ukuhlobana nabahloniphwa, Ukulinganisa, Ukuqeqeshwa.
zu.duties: Inhloso yalesi sikhundla ukuhlelela, ukweseka kanye nokuhlola ukulethwa kobuququmbelo bezinhlelo zolawulo imizamo yokuthuthukiswa kokusebenza. Umqondisi ophumelele uzosiza ukubuyekeza futhi alawule amaphandle okuququmbela imigomo kanye nohlelo ezolawula futhi aqagule inqubo yolawulo efaka ulawulo oluhle ngendlela ebezwe umnyango. Ukusekela nokuhlelelana nokwenza imisebenzi yomkhankaso (GCC) futhi sinikeze insiza ezisebenzayo kanye nokuba bamba phansi othile kule minyaka yenhlangano. Ukuhlelela izinqubo futhi unikeze izeluleko ezindaweni eziphephile ngokuthuthukisa kanye nokugcina izinkambu. Izinhlelo ezisebenzayo kanye nohlelo lwemisebenzi egqamile (SOP) ngokuhambisana imiyalelo esemthethweni kanye nendlela ehlukene nazo ngokwesimo sezingozi. Ukugcina iqoqo elihle elinzolokwanwa lemigomo, SOP, izinhlaka zezinhlelo zokuhamba kwezabhizinisi namarejista ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke ziyahambisana ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukutholakala futhi kubhalwe ngokwenqubo yokuhamba kwamaphoyinti ambalwa eziphephile. Ukuqapha futhi usize izinhlelo ezingaqanjwa kabusha, kanye nezinye izindawo ezisebenzayo, ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono okusebenza ezindaweni ezihlukene. Ukuqinisekisa kubude bezinkambu ukuthi izindlela zokuhamba ziyahlangabezana ezinhlelekile ngokusebenza nokulawula imigomo. Ukulawula ukuthuthukiswa kwamagama okuqondene nolawulo izinkambu zeNyuso kanye nokulawula imigomo ukuba ihambisana ngokuphelele kwezinye izindawo nomnyango. Ukusiza ekuxhumaneni nezinhlelo eziyikhono, okuhlwayo okuhlelelekile kwamaphuzu okugxila izeluleko. Ukusiza ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi yephrojekthi yolimi lwezezimala lapho kudingwa khona. Ukuthumela kumaphuzu abalulekile njengohlelo Iphrojekthi, ukulawula ezinye izindawo ezisebenzayo ezinzima, ukugxila ushintsho kanye nokugcizelela ukusebenza kahle futhi ulawule ukuhlangabezana nemigomo.

xh.title: Iputyatha Direktha: Ukuphucula Ukusebenza, Ishishino
xh.summary: Indima ye Deputy Director yokulungelelanisa iinkqubo zolawulo nezinkqubo zokuphucula ukusebenza kwisebe le Communications and Digital Technologies e Pretoria.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo zesinqanaba se-NQF level 7 / Isidanga kwi Risk Management / Governance and Compliance / Operational Management/Quality Management okanye isifundo esingundoqo esihambelana neso njengokuqatshwa yi South African Qualifications Authority. Amava afunyanwayo eminyaka emithathu (3) kwinqanaba le Assistant Director/Middle Management kwimeko ye Governance and Compliance. Isatifikethi sokuzifundela kwi Business Process Management okanye ukuzifundela okuhambelana naloo nkqubo. Amakhono / Ukuzibophelela nolwazi: Ulwazi ngomsebenzi, Umgangatho womsebenzi, Ukuzithatha isigqibo, Ukuqamba nokuqwalasela, Unxibelelwano, Ukusebenza njengesiqhaga, Ukuthembeka, Ukutsha inkqubo yokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo, Ulawulo nokuzithoba, Ulungelelaniso lwemigaqo, Ukuhlalutya nokumapisha inkqubo yeshishino, Ukuphatha umgangatho/Ukuqinisekisa umgangatho, Unxibelelwano nabathathi nxaxheba, Ukuthelekisa, Uphando.
xh.duties: Injongo yesi sithuba kukulungelelanisa, ukwenza lula kwaye uqonde ukuhanjiswa kweenkqubo zolawulo nezinkqubo zokuphucula ukusebenza. Umnye ofunyanwayo uza kwenzela lula ukuqwalasela nokusebenza kweenkqubo zolawulo aze axelele isakhiwo solawulo ukuze sifakeliswe ulawulo oluhle kwisebe. Misela ulungelelanise imisebenzi ye komiti yolawulo noyilo (GCC) uze uze ngeenkonzo eziphathwayo nezabakhuseli kule komiti. Lungelelanisa iinkqubo uze uxelele iindawo ezisebenzayo ngokwenza nokugcina imigaqo. Iinkqubo zeshishino ne Nkqubo zoBuesele bomsebenzi (SOPs) ngokuvumelana nemigaqo evediweyo nendlela esekwe kwingozi. Gcina isiseko seenkcukacha esipheleleyo, esihlaziyweyo semigaqo, i-SOP, neebhuphu zeenkqubo zeshishino namagama ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukungqamana, ukuchaneka, nokufikelelwa, nokuqonda ukuzithoba. Qapha uze uxelele ngeenkqubo ezingenwe ngokutsha, ngokusebenzisana namayunithi eshishino ne-IT, ukuze kuphuculwe ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo. Yenza lula ukumiselwa kwemigangatho yomgangatho yokuhanjiswa kweenkqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe iziphumo ezihambelana nemigangatho echediweyo. Phatha ukuphuhliswa kwemigaqo yexesha yokujolisa kwaye uqonde ukusetenziswa kwayo ngempumelelo nokuamkelwa kuyo yonke isebe. Nceda kulungelelanisaniswa namakomiti okuqonda ngokusetyenziswa okusebenzayo kwe ziinkqubo ezinamava. Nceda ngeenkqubo zolawulo lwe projekthi yeshishino apho kufuneka. Nyenzelela kumagatya aphambili wemixhaso njengokulawula iiprojekthi, ukuphatha iziseko zemali, ukushukumisa inguquko nokuphumelela ngokusebenza nokulawula ukuzithoba.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Raaddienste en Sakebestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur-pos by die Unemployment Insurance Fund in Pretoria, wat raaddienste ondersteun en nasionale appelsake-ondersoeke bestuur.
af.requirements: Driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 6) Publieke Administrasie en Besigheidsadministrasie. Vier (4) jaar se ervaring waarvan twee (2) jaar funksionele ervaring in 'n Raaddienste- en sekretariaatsomgewing moet wees en twee (2) jaar op toesigvlak. zu.title: Umncedisi weNduna: Amasevisi eBhodi nokuPhatha Icala
zu.summary: Indima yenkomcedisi ku-Unemployment Insurance Fund ePretoria, ukusekela amasevisi eBhodi nokuqondisa iziphondo zocalo lwesizwe eziphathelene nokuvinjelwa ukusebenza.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole esiphakeme ezithatha iminyaka emithathu (izinga le-NQF Level 6) ku-Public Administration and Business Administration. Ubudlulo obungeminyaka emine (4) lapho kufanele kube ngeminyaka emibili (2) ngokusebenza ngqo emasevisi eBhodi nendaweni yethosi kanye neminyaka emibili (2) ngokuba ngumphathi ulwazvu oluthile. Ulwazi: I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). I-Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). I-Protected Disclosure Act. I-Unemployment Insurance Act (UIA). I-Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act (UICA). I-Labour Relations Act (LRA). I-Public Service Act (PSA). I-Public Service Regulations (PSR). Izenzo nezinqubo zesibhalo sokungabikho emsebenzini. I-Board Services Charter. Amakhono: uKuqondisa Imali. uKuxhumana. uKuhlola. ukuXazulula Inkinga.okuvezwa. uKuhlela nokuHlela. ukuThisha ngekhompyutha.
zu.duties: Qondisa iziphondo ezibhekele iziphakamiso ezibhekiswe emaSifundazweni. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe eemfunzweni ezibhekiswe kwiFundo (isb. iOfisi kaNgqongqoshe, uMvikeli wesiZwe, uMqondisi-Jikelele kanye noMengameli). Nikeza amasevisi okuphatha nokuqondisa kuBhodi. Qondisa imithombo (Imali, Izinto/Impahla/Abantu) kuwo onke amakomidi.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Iinkonzo zoBhunga nokuLawula iZelesimo
xh.summary: Indima kaMncedisi woMlawuli eKwingxowa yeMali yokungasebenzi ePretoria, ukuxhasa iinkonzo zoBhunga nokuLawula iingcamango zezabanjwa kwelizwe lonke.
xh.requirements: Isifundo sezidanga zethatu (NQF Level 6) kuLawulo loLuntu nokuba yiSebe leShishini. Iimveliso zonyaka ezine (4) ezisebenzayo, apho kwakufuneka kubekho iimveliso ezimbini (2) ngokubanzi kwemisebenzi kwendawo yeNkonzo yoBhunga nendawo yokwamkela iimvelwano, kunye neminyaka yoxesho (2) inqanaba lokulawula. Ulwazi: uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (PFMA). uMthetho wokuKhuthaza uFikelelo kwiNkcukacha (PAIA). uMthetho wokuZikhusela ekubeni tyhila ngasese. uMthetho weNgeniso yokungasebenzi (UIA). uMthetho weeNgeniso zokuNgasebenziswa (UICA). uMthetho weeNxaxheba zokuSebenza (LRA). uMthetho wokuSebenza koLuntu (PSA). uMthetho wokuLawulwa kokuSebenza koLuntu (PSR). Iinkqubo neNdlela zoNxaxheba. INkqubo yeNkonzo yoBhunga. Amakhono: uLawulo lweMali. uThethathethwano. uKuQondisisa. uKusombulula iingxaki. iSicatshulwa. uCwangciso nokuHlela. uKusebenzisa iKhompyutha.
xh.duties: Qhubela phambadi izindwendwendweko malunga nezabanjwa zoxaxheba ezithunyelwe ziNgingqi. Nikeza inkxaso yobugcisa kwimibuzo ethunyelwe eNgenxwini (umz. iKamva leNgqungqutha, uMkhuseli woLuntu, uMlawuli-Jikelele naye uMlawuli weeNgeniso). Nikeza iinkonzo zolawulo nenkxaso kuBhunga. Lawula izixhobo zemali (iMali, iziQhobozi / iziXhobo / iMisebenzi yabantu) kwiNgxenye eNgezantsi yeNxenda.

zu.title: Umncedisi weqhaza: iQondiso loMnyango (Corporate Governance)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somncedisi weqhaza e-Unemployment Insurance Fund e-Pretoria esibhekelele iqondiso lomnyango, amakomidi ebhodi kanye nokuhlolwa kokuziphatha kwemithetho.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziphakeme eziyisithupha (3) ezithatha iminyaka emithathu (izinga le-NQF 6) ku-Public Management/ Administration / Auditing/ Law / B Com Law/ B Com Auditing. Esikhundleni sokusebenza eminyaka emine (4) lapho kule minyaka emibili (2) kumele kubekho okuhlangenwe nakho okusebenzayo emhlabeni weBhodi namaKomidi futhi eminyaka emibili ezingeni lokubusa. xh.requirements: Iziqu zesithathu (3) zemfundo ephakamileyo (NQF Level 6) kwi-Public Management/ Administration / Auditing/ Law / B Com Law/ B Com Auditing. Uphando lweminyaka emine (4) apho kufuneka iminyaka emibini (2) ibe ngamava asebenzayo kwimeko yebhodi namakomiti kwakunye neminyaka mibini kwinqanaba lobaluleke kwindalama: i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). i-Protocol on Corporate Governance in the Public Sector (PCGPS). i-Handbook on Appointment of persons/s in Boards of State and State Owned Entities (HAPBSSOE). i-Companies Act (CA). i-Unemployment Insurance Act (UIA). i-Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act (UICA). i-Labour Relations Act (LRA). i-Public Service Act (PSA). i-Public Service Regulations (PSR). Amaphayimenti. Ulawulo lweMali. Unxibelelwano. Ukuhlalutya. UkuSomba iingxaki. iZibezo. ukuCwangcisa nokuLunga. Ulwazi lweKhompyutha. ukuBhala iiNgxelo.
xh.duties: Yenza uphando ngentlhambo lolawulo nangendlela ezilungileyo zokusebenza. Qhoboshela ukusebenziswa kweenkqubo zeQela loLawulo lweShishino kwiFolo. Qhoboshela ukuqwalasela nokuvunywa kweeCharters/ Terms of Reference zeKomiti. Qinisekisa umgangatho wokuqwalasela ngokuhamba kwexesha ibhodi namakomiti. Qhoboshela ukuvavanya ngeminyaka yonke ibhodi neKomiti. Lawula onke amakhaya (abantu, imali, izixhobo/ izinto) kwesi-'sub- directorate'.

jobs.centre: Unemployment Insurance Fund, Pretoria Provincial Office: Western Cape
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum, plus 37% in lieu of benefits. R487 197 per annum, plus 37% in lieu of benefits.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Trade Creditors position at the Unemployment Insurance Fund in Pretoria, requiring an accounting qualification and four years of finance experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Accounting /Auditing / Business Information Systems and Economics at NQF Level 6 as recognized by SAQA. Four (4) years of experience of which two (2) years must be functional experience in Finance environment and two (2) years at a supervisory level. Knowledge: Unemployment Insurance Act (UIA). Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act (UICA). Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Treasury Regulations. Public Service Act (PSA). Basic Conditions of Employment Act (BCEA). Labour Relations Act (LRA). Generally Recognized Accounting Principles (GRAP). Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Relevant Financial Systems (AX-One, BAS, etc.). HR System (PERSAL). Financial Systems Skills: Accounting. Communication (Verbal and written). Computer Literacy. Time Management. Interpersonal. Report Writing. Planning and Organizing. Analytical. Creative. Financial Management. An undergraduate qualification in Human Resource Management / Public Management/ Employee Relations at NQF Level 6 as recognized by SAQA. Driver’s License will be an added advantage. Four (4) years’ experience of which two (2) years must be functional experience in Human Resource Management and Employee Relations environment and two (2) years must be at a Senior Practitioner level. Knowledge: Public Service transformation and management issues, White paper on transformation of Public Service, Ability to convert policy into action, Human resources System and Procedures, Public Service Act and Resolutions, Recruitment and Selection, Departmental Policies and Procedures, Batho Pele Principles, Minimum information Security Standards, PERSAL and other HR information management systems. Skills: Communication (Verbal and Written), Computer Literacy (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, PERSAL, etc.), Innovative / Creative, Presentation, Responsiveness, Report writing, Time management, Organizing and Planning, Financial Management, Policy Analysis and Problem Solving and Decision Making.
jobs.duties: Internal and External invoices paid within 30 days of receipt by the Fund. Monthly DEL Claim process and paid. Approved weekly and monthly reconciliations. Improved financial Management and accounting through planning, tracking, monitoring and reporting of achievements against set targets. Review of Financial Statements and Annual Report information. Improve Governance. Manage resources (Human, Financial, Equipment / Assets) in the sub-directorate. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of human resources management policies in the Province. Monitor and provide advice on the implementation of Employment Relations policies and prescripts. Coordinate and manage the implementation of Employment Equity programmes. Monitor the administration of service benefits. Manage resources (Human, Finance, Equipment / Assets) in the Division.

Ukulawula iindawo zokusebenzela (abantu, ezimali, izixhobo / izinto) kwicandelo.

Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Een (1) jaar funksionele ervaring in Vloot/ Vervoerbestuursdienste. Kennis: Aankope, onderhoud, bedryf, instandhouding en herstel van County-voertuie. Metodes, materiaal, gereedskap en toerusting wat gebruik word vir die instandhouding en herstel van voertuie. Toepaslike wette, kodes, regulasies, beleide en prosedures. Praktyke en prosedures betrokke by die ondersoek, vergelyking en aankoop van voertuie, toerusting en voorrade. Diagnostiese prosedures vir voertuie. Werking, teorie en beginsels van petrol- en dieselenjins. Openbare Diensregulasies, bedrywighede, beleide en doelwitte. Beleide en doelwitte van toegewysde programme en aktiwiteite. Voorraadpraktyke en -prosedures. Beginsels en praktyke van administrasie. Tegniese aspekte van die spesialiteitsveld. Vaardighede: Kommunikasie (Mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede). Koördinering. Beplanning en organisasie. Verslagskrywing. Rekenaar (Bedryf van 'n rekenaar en toegewysde sagteware). Monitering en evaluering. Tydbestuur.
af.duties: Voer inspeksie uit op Provinsiale vlootvoertuie. Handhaaf nakoming van Provinsiale vlootbedrywighede. Voer instandhouding van vlootvoertuie by die Provinsie uit. Voer algemene administratiewe take met betrekking tot vlootbedrywighede uit.

zu.title: Inkantolo Ezebhekalanga Nezesikhashana Kwezimoto
zu.summary: Bhekisisa futhi uvakashele izimoto zeNyakatho neKwaZulu-Natal, uqinisekisa ukuziphila kwemithetho futhi wenze imisebenzi yokulungisa nokulawula ngemisebenzi yezimoto.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwabafundi abasha (NQF level 6) njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA kwezoMnotho/ Ukuphathwa kwezokuthutha/ Ukuphathwa kwenqwaba yezimpahla/ Ukuphathwa kwezomphakathi/ Ukuphathwa kwezomphakathi/ Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ifayedi yokushayela evunyiwe. Unyaka owodwa (1) weminyaka yohlu lokusebenza ekuPhathweni kwezimoto/ Nkonzo yokuphathwa kwezokuthutha. Ulwazi: Ukuthenga izinto, ukulekelela, ukusebenza, ukulungisa nokulungisa izimoto zase-County. Izindlela, izinto, amathuluzi nempahla esetshenziswa ekulungiseni nokulungiseni izimoto. Izomthetho, amakhodi, imithetho ezimele, izinqubomgomo neziyalezo. Amasu neziyalezo ezibandakanya ukuphenya, ukuqhathanisa nokuthenga izimoto, impahla nezinto ezidingekayo. Izindlela zokuqaphela ukuphahluka kwezimoto. Ukusebenza, inqubo nemigomo yamaphethseni asebenza ngegasi nadiyaseli. Imithetho yezomphakathi, izindlela zokusebenza, izinqubomgomo nemiqondo. Izinqubomgomo nemiqondo yohlelo nemisebenzi ohlinzekiwe. Amasu neziyalezo ezibhalwe ezimpahleni. Imigomo nolwazi ekuphathweni. Izici ezinhlelokusebenza ekhundleni lobuchwepheshe. Amandla: Ukuxhumana (Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nokubhaliwe). Ukuhlanganisa. Ukuhlela nokuhlelela. Ukubhala okubhaliwe. Ikhompyutha (Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha nezinhlelo ezohlinzekwe). Ukubheka futhi uhlolisise. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi.
zu.duties: Yenza isivakashi ezimotweni zeSifundazwe. Qinisekisa ukuthobela emisebenzini yezimoto. Yenza ukulungiswa kwezimoto esiSifundazweni. Yenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yokulawula ngemisebenzi yezimoto.

xh.title: Iofisa Wolawulo nokuhlola iFleet
xh.summary: Ukuhlola kwaye kuqinisekise iifleet zephondo KwaZulu-Natal, ukuze kuqatshelwe ngokuzelelwa kwaye kuzenziwe imisebenzi yokunakekelwa nolawulo kumisebenzi weefleet.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ze-Undergraduate (NQF level 6) njengokuziwa yiSAQA kwizifundo ze-Economics/ Logistics Management/ Supply Chain Management/ Public Management/ Public Administration/ Financial Management. Ilayisenisi yokuQamba ethembekileyo. Unyaka omnye (1) wamava omsebenzi kwi-Fleet/ Transport Management Services. Ulwazi: Ukuthenga, ukusebenzisa, ukusebenza, ukunakekelwa nokulungisa iimoto zaseCounty. Iindlela, izinto, izixhobo nemishini yasetyenziswa ekunakekelweni nokulungiseni iimoto. Imithetho, amakhowudi, iimigaqo-nkqubo neendlela ezifanelekileyo. Iindlela neenqobo ezibandakanyekayo ekuphenyeni, ekuthelekiseni nasekuthengeni iimoto, izixhobo nezinto ezifunekayo. Iindlela zokuqonda iingxaki zemoto. Ukusebenza, ithiyori namagama abalulekileyo emishini yegasoline nedizile. Iimigaqo-nkqubo zesebe loPhakamiswayo, imisebenzi, iindidi ezahlukeneyo nemigangatho yemisebenzi. Iindidi nezinhloso zemmiso ezinikelweyo nemisebenzi. Iindlela nezinto ezikwizixa. Iindlela nezimvo ngolawulo. Iinkalo ezinobuchule ekundwendwini lokwazi kwakhona. Amakhono: Unxibelelwano (Unxibelelwano ngomlomo nangokubhalayo). Uqhagamshelo. Uqhelaniso nokuhlela. Ukubhala iingxelo. Ikhompyutha (Ukuqhuba ne software enikiweyo). Ukuqhelanisa nokuhola. Ukuqhelanisa nexesha.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba ukuhlola kwiimoto zeProvincial fleet. Ukuqinisekisa ukwenza ngokwemigaqo-nkqubo kumisebenzi weefleet zeProvincial. Ukwenza ukunakekelwa kweimoto zefleet ePhondweni. Ukwenza imisebenzi yonke yolawulo malunga nemisebenzi yefleet.

jobs.summary: Director of Law Reform to provide legislative drafting, vetting and policy support to the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF7) in Law or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at middle or senior managerial level in Law reform. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme, as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG), must be submitted prior to appointment. Experience in the legislation and policy development process. Knowledge: public service and departmental policies, legislation and procedures; environmental, administrative and mining legislation; research methodologies and presentation skills; legal administration; strategic coordination/planning; business planning; report/professional writing; business process management; organisation performance management; risk management; audit procedures; project management; planning and performance management legislation. Skills and Competencies: Advanced skills in policy formulation; advanced skills in legislative drafting; advanced negotiation skills; advanced statutory interpretation skills, adequate skills in computer use; advanced skills in financial and project management; advanced skills in respect of formal presentation and public speaking; good interpersonal relations and diplomatic skills; relationship management; stakeholder engagement; public relations; research; strategic capability and leadership; programme and project management; change management; knowledge management; service delivery innovation (SDI); problem solving and analysis; people management and empowerment; client orientation and customer focus; ability to work under pressure and long hours; ability to work individually and in a team; good interpersonal relations, ability to work with difficult persons and to resolve conflict; sense of responsibility and loyalty; objectiveness; integrity; service orientated; self-supervision; highly developed sense of honesty and protect the confidentiality of documents. Must have a valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Provide legislative support (drafting, vetting and commenting on Bills, policies and subordinate legislation) to the Department. This includes drafting and legally vetting Policies, Bills, Regulations, Notices, Strategies, Plans, Norms, Standards and related workflows. Review Socio-Economic Impact Assessments (SEIAS) Reports. Review Comments and Responses Reports (CRRs). Taking Bills and some sub-ordinate legislation through the Cabinet process, Parliamentary process and engagements with the Office of the Chief State Law Advisor, and Parliamentary Legal Advisors. Provide legal support (legal opinions/advice/research on legislation administered by the department, submissions, briefing documents, responses to the public, media statements Parliamentary questions, support to interpretation queries and subordinate legislation). Legally vet applications for exemptions, authorisations, licenses and permits. Manage Delegations Register for the Department. Participate and represent the Department in forums, committees, meetings, and related stakeholder platforms. Coordinate law reform and policies through the Intergovernmental Relations (IGR) Process. Management of the Directorate including the performance of the staff, attend management meetings and financial management.
