Ervaring in die wetgewings- en beleidsontwikkelingsproses. Kennis: openbare diens- en departementele beleide, wetgewing en prosedures; omgewings-, administratief- en mynbouwetgewing; navorsingsmetodes en aanbiedingsvaardighede; regsadministrasie; strategiese koördinasie/beplanning; besigheidsbeplanning; verslag-/professionele skryfwerk; besigheidsprosesbestuur; organisasieprestasiebestuur; risikobestuur; ouditprosedures; projekbestuur; beplannings- en prestasiebestuurswetgewing. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Gevorderde vaardighede in beleidsformulering; gevorderde vaardighede in wetgewingsopstel; gevorderde onderhandelingsvaardighede; gevorderde vaardighede in statutêre interpretasie, toereikende vaardighede in rekenaargebruik; gevorderde vaardighede in finansiële en projekbestuur; gevorderde vaardighede ten opsigte van formele aanbieding en openbare spreke; goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge en diplomatieke vaardighede; verhoudingsbestuur; belanghebbende-betrokkenheid; openbare betrekkinge; navorsing; strategiese vermoë en leierskap; program- en projekbestuur; veranderingsbestuur; kennisbestuur; diensleweringinnovasie (SDI); probleemoplossing en analise; mensebestuur en bemagtiging; kliëntgerigtheid en klienfokus; vermoë om onder druk en lang ure te werk; vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk; goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los; verantwoordelikheidsin en lojaliteit; objektiwiteit; integriteit; diensgerig; selftoesig; hoogs ontwikkelde sin van eerlikheid en beskerming van die vertroulikheid van dokumente. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê.
af.duties: Verskaf wetgewingssteun (opstel, hersiening en kommentaar op Wetsontwerpe, beleide en ondergeskikte wetgewing) aan die Departement. Dit sluit in die opstel en regswerklike hersiening van Beleide, Wetsontwerpe, Regulasies, Kennisgewings, Strategieë, Planne, Norme, Standaarde en verwante werkstrome. Hersien Socio-Economic Impact Assessments (SEIAS)-verslae. Hersien Comments and Responses Reports (CRR's). Neem Wetsontwerpe en sommige ondergeskikte wetgewing deur die Kabinetsproses, Parlementêre proses en betrokkenheid by die Office of the Chief State Law Advisor, en Parliamentary Legal Advisors. Verskaf regssteun (regsmenings/advies/navorsing oor wetgewing wat deur die departement geadministreer word, voorleggings, briefdokumente, antwoorde aan die publiek, mediaverklarings, Parlementêre vrae, ondersteuning aan interpretasie-navrae en ondergeskikte wetgewing). Hersien aansoeke om vrystellings, magtigings, lisensies en permitte regsgekundig. Bestuur Delegations Register vir die Departement. Neem deel en verteenwoordig die Departement in forums, komitees, vergaderings en verwante belanghebbende platforms. Koördineer regshervorming en beleide deur die Intergovernmental Relations (IGR)-proses. Bestuur van die Direktoraat insluitend die prestasie van die personeel, bywoon van bestuursvergaderings en finansiële bestuur.

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukulungiswa Kwezomthetho
zu.summary: Umongameli Wokulungiswa Kwezomthetho onikeza ukulungiselwa kwezomthetho, ukuhlola kanye nokusekela izinqubomgomo kwi-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesigaba (NQF7) ezifundweni zomthetho noma iziqu ezihambisana nalezo njengokuqashelwe yi-SAQA. Ukwaba okuncane kweminyaka eyisihlanu (5) ngokulingene ngokuya kwabaphathi abaphakathi noma abaphezulu ekulungisweni komthetho. Ukugqitshwa kohlelo lokungena kwabaphathi abaphezulu, njengokuqashiwe yi-National School of Government (NSG), kufanele kunikwe ngaphambi kokuqashwa. Okuhlangabezayo kule ndima. Ukwazi umthetho nendlela yokwakha izinqubomgomo. Ulwazi: izinqubomgomo zesevisi yomphakathi kanye nezomnyango, umthetho kanye neziyalezo; umthetho wokwesimo kwendawo, wokuphatha nokuqanjwa kwamaminerali; izindlela zocwaningo kanye namakhono okubonisa; ukuphathwa komthetho; ukuhlanganisa/uqgoqoLwabiwo okuhlose ukufeza ihluLwabiwo; uqgoqoLwabiwo kahle lokusebenza; ukubhala imibiko/ukubhala ngobungcweti; ukuphatha inqubo yoshintsho; ukuphatha ukusebenza kwezinhlangano; ukuphatha imingozi; izinqubo zokuqamba imali; ukuphatha imiklomelo; umthetho wokuqgoqoLwabiwo kanye nokuphatha ukwenza okuhlose ukufeza ihluLwabiwo. Amakhono kanye nokukwazi okuningiliziwe: ukuzululela ezinqubomgomo ezithuthukisiwe; ukuzululela emthethweni ohleliwe; ukuzwana kwezinyunyana ezithuthukisiwe; ukuqonda izincazelo ezithuthukisiwe zomthetho, amakhono ohleleleko ekusetshenzisweni kwekhompyutha; ukuphatha imali yasekhaya nokuqamba imiklomelo; amakhono okubonisa emphakathini nokuKhuluma kuleso sikhathi; ukuxhumana kakahle nabantu kanye namakhono okuba Msthandazo; ukuphatha ubudlelwano; ukuthinta izithakazelo; ukuxhumana nomphakathi; ucwaningo; ukuKhondlakhondla futhi ababambe iqhaza ekubukeni nasekuqondweni ukusebenza kahle kweNqubomgomo yokuNqamula okukhulu ikakhulu kwezimali ezifunwa kabusha kwezinyunyana; ukuphatha ushintsho; ukuphatha ulwazi; ukuzululela ukwakhiwa imiklomelo kahle; ukuphathwa kwemiklomelo kweNqubomgomo yokuHlela; ukuKhondlakhondlwa ukuphendula imibuzo Yomphakathi nakwezinye izindawo zokuxhumana ezaziwayo neyamukelekayo; isandla esihle, isibopho, ubuhlakani, ukubeka pambili isevisi; ukuziphendulela; ukuzethemba okuphakeme kakhulu kokuQamba ukuthi kungabi mthetho ongaphandle weNqubomgomo nokuQonda ukugunyazwa kwemithelela yayo. Kufanele abe nelayisense yokushayela.
zu.duties: Nika isekelo lomthetho (ukulunga, ukuhlola kanye nokuphawula kumabhili, izinqubomgomo kanye nomthetho ongaphansi) kuMnyango. Lokhu kubala ukulunga nokuHlola ngokomthetho izinqubomgomo, amabhili, umthetho, izaziso, izinhlelo zokuSebenza, iNdlela eya phambili, izimiso, amaphuzu kanye nezinye izinto ezihamba kahle. Buka imibiko yokuHlolwa kokuchithwa kwemali enza kanzima abantu kakhulu (SEIAS). Buka imibiko yokuphendula imibuzo (CRRs). UkuHamba nababhili kanye nomthetho ongaphansi endleleni eza kumakhomidi okuqamba umthetho noma ukuze abe mthetho, inqubo yesiGungu kanye nokuSetshenziswa neNqubomgomo yokuVumelana kwezinsizakalo nezinye izindlu eziSebenzela isiKhungo somthetho ezikwazi ukuba necala elikhulu njengoba kusho umthetho namakhonsela eNqubomgomo yesiGungu. Nika isekelo ngokomthetho (izincazelo ngokomthetho/iyathandaza/ucwaningo komthetho osetshenziswa umnyango, izibhalo ezithumelwayo, izibhalo zokusiza ukuba sibe sezintweni ezibalulekile, ukuphendula imibuzo yomphakathi, izinkulumo zamaphephandaba kanye nemibuzo evela esiGungwini, ukusekela ekuqonden izincazelo zamaphuzu kanye nomthetho ongaphansi). Hlola ngokomthetho izicelo zokuQasha izinkomishi ezivunyelwe ukuze kungenwe ezinye izindawo noma zibe khona, amalayisense namaphermita. Phatha nokuQamba ukubhaliswa kwemibiko evezwa kubantu abaholi nebhalwe kuMnyango. Zibandakanya futhi ume ngomlomo (buka imibiko) kuMnyango emiphakathi yamakhomidi, emihlanganweni, nezinye izindawo lapho kubonisana khona abantu abanegalelo. Hlanganisa ukulungiswa komthetho nokuHlela izinqubomgomo ngaphakathi nendlela esiYenza ngayo ukuphathwa kwezamaphathiswe phakathi koHulumende (IGR). Ukuphatha inqubomgomo, okubala nokuSetshenziswa nokwenza umsebenzi ababekwayo, ukuHamba emihlanganweni yokuphatha futhi kubandakanya ukuphathwa kwemali.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ukuqwalaselwa koMthetho
xh.summary: Umongameli woKuqwalaselwa koMthetho ukunika inkxaso yokubhala imithetho, ukuhlola nokusekela iinkqubo zomthetho kwisebe leZohlamathuzo, ezeMiba zeNhlanzi nendalo.
xh.requirements: I qualification yesiqu phantsi (NQF7) kuMthetho okanye i qualification ehambelana nayo njengokujulwa yi-SAQA. Amava amabini angaphantsi okanye aphezulu kweminye emihlanu (5) kwelona nqanaba lalawulo apho abasebenzi ngamapolisa benza umsebenzi wokuqwalaselwa koMthetho. Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kwiNkqubo yoKungena yangaphambili koLawulo oluPhakamileyo, njengokugqithiswe yiSikolo sawoLuntu (NSG), kufuneka kuziswe ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe isikhundla. Amava kwinkqubo yomthetho nokuqwalaselwa kwezinqubo zenkqubo. Ulwazi: iinkqubo zasezikhundleni zikarhulumente nezesebe, umthetho neenkqubo; umthetho wendalo, wolawulo nakwamamayini; iindlela zophando namakhono okubonisa; ulawulo lomthetho; ulungelelwaniso/iplani ephethe ngokwebhizinisi; ukuhlela ibhizinisi; ukubhala iingxelo/ukubhala ngobuchwepheshe; ulawulo lwenkqubo yebhizinisi; ulawulo lokusebenza kwentlangano; ulawulo loxhoba; iinkqubo zokuqwalasela; ulawulo lweenkqubo; umthetho wokuhlela nokulawula ukusebenza. Amandla namakhono: Amandla aphezulu ekubheni iinkqubo zenkqubo; amandla aphezulu ekubheni umthetho; amandla aphezulu ekuxoxweni ngeenjongo; amandla aphezulu ekutolikeni umthetho, amandla afanelekileyo ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha; amandla aphezulu ekulawulweni kwemali neenkqubo; amandla aphezulu ekuboniseni ngokusesikweni noku thetha phakathi kwabantu; ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu namakhono obudiplomat; ulawulo lobuhlobo; ungenelelo kubathathi-nxaxheba; ubuhlobo noluntu; uphando; amandla okulawula nokuqonda iindlela; ulawulo lweenkqubo neenkqubo zokusebenza; ulawulo loshintsho; ulawulo lolwazi; intsingiselo yokwenza izinto ngendlela entsha (SDI); ukusombulula iingxaki nokuziqwalasela; ulawulo abantu noku ba khupha emnyameni; ukuqwalasela umthengi kwaye unxibelelane naye; ukwazi ukusebenza xa kunzima nangentsasa ende; ukwazi ukusebenza wedwa nakwindlongano; ubuhlobo obuhle, ukwazi ukusebenza nabantu abanzima noku susa iingxaki; indima yokuzithatha nokuthembeka; ukuba ngumntu ongathathi hlangothi; ukuzithiba; ukukhathalela abathengi; ukuzilawula; intlonipho ephantsi noku gcina iincwadana ezingabonwa bantu. Kufuneka unabhanqa wokuqhuba osemthethweni.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yomthetho (ukubhala, ukuhlola nokuchaza iBhills, iinkqubo nomthetho ongaphantsi) kwisebe. Oku kuquka ukubhala nokuhlola ngokomthetho iinkqubo, amaBhills, iRegulations, amaNotices, iStrategies, amaPlans, amaNorms, amaStandards nemisebenzi ehambelanayo. Phengula iingxelo zoPhando loMqhapho-mphatho waQoqosho (SEIAS). Phengula iingxelo zoPhando lokusabela ngeZimvo (CRRs). Dlulisa amaBhills ethile nomthetho ongaphantsi kweNkqubo yeKhabhinethi, iNkqubo yePalamente noku chasana nesiSebe sikaGunyazwe oMkhulu woMthetho weZwe, nabaLuleki boMthetho bePalamente. Nika inkxaso yomthetho (iimvozo/inceso/ophando komthetho olawulwa liSebe, izibhalo, amaxwebhu oku chaza, iimpendulo koluntu, izitatimende ezibhaliweyo zimibuzo yePalamente, inkxaso kwimibuzo yotoliko nomthetho ongaphantsi). Hlola ngokumthetho izicelo zoku sukululeka, kwabhunga, namalayisensi nakwi permit. Lawula uBhalo loLawulo lweMimiselo yeliSebe. Thatha inxaxheba kwaye umele iSebe kumabala, nakwi komiti, kwindla-mimiyo, nakumabala abathathi-nxaxheba. Lungelanisa ukuqwalaselwa komthetho neenkqubo ngokwendlela yeMibhiyano phakathi koLawulo (IGR). Ulawulo loNyulo bukaMongameli kuquka ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, uku thatha inxaxheba kwindla-mimiyo yolawulo noku lawula imali.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Forest Sector Charter Coordination
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed to coordinate implementation of the Forest Sector Charter and transformation initiatives within the forestry sector.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or relevant qualification within the related field as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years' experience in the forestry sector, of which three (3) years must be at an Assistant Director level or equivalent supervisory / management level. Experience in stakeholder coordination, policy implementation, programme management or transformation within the forestry sector will be an added advantage. Knowledge and understanding of project and programme management, the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, the Public Service Act and Public Service Regulations. Knowledge and understanding of the National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No. 84 of 1998), the National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No. 101 of 1998), the National Environmental Management Act (NEMA), the National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act (NEMBA), the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), and other relevant environmental legislation. Knowledge of data management, analysis, monitoring and reporting. Good understanding of the forestry sector and transformation initiatives. Excellent project and programme management, planning and organising, communication (written and verbal), report writing, financial management, analytical and problem-solving, facilitation, negotiation, stakeholder management, leadership, conflict management and computer literacy skills. Ability to develop and implement policies and programmes, work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, work effectively under pressure, manage competing priorities, and resolve conflict. Good interpersonal relations, creativity, integrity, honesty and a high level of ethical conduct. Willingness to work extended hours when required. A valid driver's licence and willingness to travel extensively.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the implementation of the Forest Sector Charter, ensuring effective implementation of the Charter's transformation targets and sector commitments. Coordinate the implementation and monitoring of the Forestry Sector Masterplan relating to transformation initiatives and Government Charter Undertakings. Develop and monitor policies and strategies that support the Forest Sector Charter. Interface with the Forestry Sector Charter Council and other stakeholders, act as the focal point for engagement with government, industry, labour and community representatives regarding the Charter, and coordinate community outreach and awareness programmes. Oversee and manage the submission of business plans, reports and funding for the Forestry Sector Charter Council, develop, maintain and manage the Forest Sector Charter and transformation database to support the implementation, monitoring and reporting of transformation initiatives. Ensure accurate documentation and record-keeping in alignment with the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and other governance requirements. Ensure compliance to legislation, policies and prescripts related to the Forest Sector Charter, manage allocated budgets for Charter-related programmes and ensure efficient use of financial resources. Manage compliance with relevant legislation, including the National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No. 84 of 1998), the National Environmental Management Act (NEMA), the National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act (NEMBA), the National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No. 101 of 1998), and Public Service Regulations.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preference, emotional intelligence and integrity. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Koördinering van die Bosbousektorkart
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur benodig om die implementering van die Bosbousektorkart en transformasie-inisiatiewe binne die bosbousektor te koördineer.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) of 'n relevante kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die bosbousektor, waarvan drie (3) jaar op 'n Assistentdirekteurvlak of gelykwaardige toesighoudende / bestuursvlak moet wees.ervaring in belanghebbende-koördinering, beleidsimplementering, programbestuur of transformasie binne die bosbousektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en begrip van projeks- en programbestuur, die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, die Public Service Act en Public Service Regulations. Kennis en begrip van die National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No. 84 of 1998), die National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No. 101 of 1998), die National Environmental Management Act (NEMA), die National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act (NEMBA), die Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), en ander tersaaklike omgewingswetgewing. Kennis van databestuur, ontleding, monitering en verslagdoening. Goeie begrip van die bosbousektor en transformasie-inisiatiewe. Uitstekende projeks- en programbestuur, beplanning en organisering, kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), verslagskrywing, finansiële bestuur, analitiese en probleemoplossing, fasilitering, onderhandeling, bestuur van belanghebbendes, leierskap, konflikbestuur en rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede. Vermoë om beleide en programme te ontwikkel en te implementeer, onafhanklik en as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk, doeltreffend onder druk te werk, mededingende prioriteite te bestuur, en konflik op te los. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, kreatiwiteit, integriteit, eerlikheid en 'n hoë vlak van etiese gedrag. Bereidwilligheid om lang ure te werk wanneer vereis. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om uitgebreid te reis.
af.duties: Koördineer die implementering van die Bosbousektorkart, en verseker doeltreffende implementering van die Kart se transformasieteikens en sektortoewyerings. Koördineer die implementering en monitering van die Forestry Sector Masterplan met betrekking tot transformasie-inisiatiewe en Regering se Karttoewyerings. Ontwikkel en monitor beleide en strategieë wat die Bosbousektorkart ondersteun. Skakel met die Forestry Sector Charter Council en ander belanghebbendes, tree as die spilpunt op vir betrokkenheid by regering, bedryf, arbeid en gemeenskapsverteenwoordigers rakende die Kart, en koördineer gemeenskapsbuitereik en bewustheidsprogramme. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die indiening van besigheidsplanne, verslae en befondsing vir die Forestry Sector Charter Council, en ontwikkel, hou in stand en bestuur die Bosbousektorkart- en transformasiedatabasis om die implementering, monitering en verslagdoening van transformasie-inisiatiewe te ondersteun. Verseker akkurate dokumentasie en rekordhouding in ooreenstemming met die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en ander goederetroduksie-vereistes. Verseker nakoming van wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte wat verband hou met die Bosbousektorkart, bestuur toegekende begrotings vir Kartverwante programme en verseker doeltreffende gebruik van finansiële hulpbronne. Bestuur nakoming van tersaaklike wetgewing, insluitend die National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No. 84 of 1998), die National Environmental Management Act (NEMA), die National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act (NEMBA), die National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No. 101 of 1998), en Public Service Regulations.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSekela Ngqondo: Ukuxhumana kweNqubo yesiKhulu seSektho yezihlahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka uSekela Ngqondo ukuqondisa ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yesiKhulu seSektho yezihlahla kanye nokuqondiswa kwemigomo yoshintsho ngaphakathi kwesektho yezihlahla.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF Level 6) noma iziqu ezithintekayo endimeni ehlobene njengoba kusukwamiswa yi-SAQA. Isiphephelo seminyaka eyisihlanu (5) sokusebenza esekthweni yezihlahla, lapho kufanele kube seminyaka eyintathu (3) esigabeni sikaMsizi weNgqondo noma esigabeni esihlobene sokubusa / ekulawuleni. Isiphephelo ekuxhumaniseni abahlanganyeli, ekusetshenzisweni kwezinqubo, ekuphatheni izinhlelo noma ekushintshweni ngaphakathi kwesektho yezihlahla kuzoba usuzu olungeziwe. Ulwazi nekuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo nezinhlelo zomsebenzi, uMthetho woKuphathwa kweMali kahulumeni (PFMA), Izimiso zeHhovisi leZigwegwe, uMthetho weSevisi Kahulumeni kanye neZimiso zeSevisi Kahulumeni. Ulwazi nekuqonda uMthetho weZihlahla zeZwe, 1998 (Act No. 84 of 1998), uMthetho weMlilo waseNadle nangezihlahla, 1998 (Act No. 101 of 1998), uMthetho woKuphathwa kweZehlalo eZwe (NEMA), uMthetho woKuphathwa kweZehlalo eZwe: I-Biodiversity Act (NEMBA), uMthetho wokuPhakamisa uBulungiswa eBuphathwe nokuBhaliswa (PAJA), kanye nezinye izindlela zomthetho ezithinteko mayelana nezehlalo. Ulwazi ekuphathweni kwemininingwane, ekuhlaziyeni, ekulawuleni nasekubikeni. Ukuqonda kahle isektho yezihlahla kanye nemigomo yoshintsho. Amakhono aphezulu ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo nezinhlelo zomsebenzi, ekuhleleni nasekuhlelekiseni, ekuxhumeni (okubhalwayo nokukhulunywayo), ekubhaleni imibiko, ekuphathweni kwezimali, ekuhlaziyeni nasekuxazululeni izinkinga, ekwenzeni izinkulumo, ekuxhumaneni, ekuphathweni kwabahlanganyeli, ekuholeni, ekuphathweni kwezinkinga kanye nolwazi lwesikhompyutha. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa nokuqondisa izinqubo nezinhlelo, ukusebenza eyedwa kanye njengenxenye yeqembu elinobuchwepheshe obuhlukene, ukusebenza ngempumelelo ngaphansi kwegcino, ukuphatha izinto eziphikisana, kanye nokuqondisa izinkinga. Ubudlelwano obuhle obuntu phakathi kwabantu, ukubumba, ukuqotho, ukuzithoba kanye nizinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha ngokuzethemba. Ukuzethemba ukusebenza isikhathi eside uma kudingeka. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni kanye nesifiso sokuhamba kakhulu.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yesiKhulu seSektho yezihlahla, ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwezinjongo zoshintsho zeNqubo kanye nezibopho zesektho. Qondisa ukusetshenziswa nokulawulwa kwe-Hlelo elikhulu leSektho yezihlahla mayelana nemigomo yoshintsho kanye neZibopho zeNqubo kahulumeni. Thuthukisa futhi ulawule izinqubo nezinhlaka ezisekela iNqubo yesiKhulu seSektho yezihlahla. Xhumana neNqubo yeSektho yezihlahla kanye nabanye abahlanganyeli, zibe njengendawo yokuzulazula kubuqhawe kahulumeni, endaweni yokushumayela, emisebenzini nasezimelezeni mayelana neNqubo, futhi uqondise ukufinyelela kubahlali kanye namahlelo okwazisa. Qapha futhi uphathe ukuhlolwa kwezinhlela zezezimali, imibiko kanye nezimali zeNqubo yesiKhulu seSektho yezihlahla, thuthukisa, gcina futhi uphathe isisekelo seniningwane seNqubo yesiKhulu seSektho yezihlahla kanye noshintsho ukuze useke ukusetshenziswa, ukulawula nokubika imigomo yoshintsho. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa kumafayela nokugcina amarekhodi ngokuvumelana noMthetho woKuphathwa kweMali kahulumeni (PFMA) kanye nezinye izidingo zokubusa. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana nomthetho, izinqubo nezinyathelo ezihlobene neNqubo yesiKhulu seSektho yezihlahla, phatha amabhajeti abekiwe ezinhlelweni ezihlobene neNqubo futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa ngokushesha kwezinsiza zezimali. Phatha ukuvumelana nomthetho ohlobene, okuhlanganisa uMthetho weZihlahla zeZwe, 1998 (Act No. 84 of 1998), uMthetho woKuphathwa kweZehlalo eZwe (NEMA), uMthetho woKuphathwa kweZehlalo eZwe: I-Biodiversity Act (NEMBA), uMthetho weMlilo waseNadle nangezihlahla, 1998 (Act No. 101 of 1998), kanye neZimiso zeSevisi Kahulumeni.

xh.title: iPhini leNgqungqutha: Ulungelelwaniso loMgaqo-siseko loMmandla weSihlahla
xh.summary: Kufuneka iPhini leNgqungqutha malungelelwanise loPhumezo loMgaqo-siseko woMmandla weSihlahla nemiPhumezo yokuGuqula ngaphakathi kwammandla wezihlahla.
xh.requirements: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) okanye isifikelelo esinxulumene nendawo ekuyo njengoko kuvunywa yi-SAQA. Kufuneka ube nemo yeminye emi-5 ngama-ohluwo kwindawo yamasebe, apho iminye emi-3 kufuneka ibe ngalingqongqo loMphathi okanye ngokulinganayo ngowolawulo / abalawuli. Iminyaka yokuguqulelana ngokusebenzisana nabathathi-nxaxheba, ukuPhumeza iNqulamvo, ulawulo lweNkqubo okanye ukuGuqula ngaphakathi kwamasebe ezihlahla kuya kuba ngumvuzo ongezelelweyo. Ulwazi nokuQonda ulawulo lweProjekthi neseNkqubo, iMigaqo yoLawulo lweMali yaSeburhuliki (PFMA), iMigaqo yoLawulo lweQheke, uMthetho waSeburhuliki nokuQonda koMthetho waSeburhuliki. Ulwazi nokuQonda koMthetho weZihlahla zoMzantsi-National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No. 84 of 1998), iNational Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No. 101 of 1998), iNational Environmental Management Act (NEMA), iNational Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act (NEMBA), iPromotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), kwezinye iMigaqo nxulumene nendalo. ULwazi ngolawulo lweekhompyutha, isahlulo, nokuQamba iiveze. UkuQonda ngcono ummandla wezihlahla nemiPhumezo yokuGuqula. Ulawulo olugqithisileyo lweProjekthi neseNkqubo, ukulungiselela nokuHlela, ithetha-thetha (elubhalwe noluthethwayo), ukubhala iiveze, ulawulo lweMali, isahlulo nokuSombulula iingxaki, ulungelelwaniso, ukuxoxisana, ulawulo lokusebenzisana nabathathi-nxaxheba, ukukhokela, ulawulo lweNxaxheba nokuzoba ngesikrini ngekhompyutha. Ukuba nakho ukuphuza nokuthumela iMigaqo neenkqubo, ukusebenza lodwa okanye njengenxalenye yeqela elixubeneyo, ukusebenza kakuhle ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ukulawula iindlela ezahlukeneyo, nokusombulula iingxaki. Kubuhlobo obuhle nxulumene nokuQambeleka, ukwenza izinto ngenqanaba eliphezulu lokuZithembisa nokuQotho. Ukuvuma ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo xa kufuneka. Iburhulo yokwazi ukuya kwindlela ebhodloko kwaye ukuvuma ukuHamba ixesha elide.
xh.duties: Lungelelwanise uPhumezo loMgaqo-siseko woMmandla weSihlahla, kuqinisekiswe uPhumezo olusebenzayo kokuGuqulwa okuxelwe nguMgaqo-siseko nokuzimisela kwendawo. Lungelelwanise uPhumezo nokuQonda iNkqubo yeNqulamvo woMmandla weSihlahla, ukujolisa ekwenzeni imiPhumezo yokuGuqula nokuzimisela kweNkululeko yaRhulumente. Phuza nokuQonda iMigaqo neNqulamvo eziXhasa uMgaqo-siseko woMmandla weSihlahla. Qhagamshelana noBulungu boMgaqo-siseko besebenzisana nabathathi-nxaxheba, ube ndawo yokwenza ucociswano oluQhubekayo noRhulumente, namashishini, abasebenzi, namagosa abamelene nommandla, kwaye ulungelelwanise iinkqubo ezixhasa abantu bendlala kubomi babo. Bukela nokuLawula imiNtla neNtshishino yokulawulwa kweekhompyutha zeNdalo ezingeni elingatshintshwa.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Knowledge and Information Management
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role managing knowledge and information management frameworks, strategies and policies for the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Information Science, Knowledge Management or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in Knowledge and Information Management environment, of which at least three (3) years should be at entry/junior management level (Assistant Director level or equivalent). Understanding of knowledge management frameworks, strategies, policies, implementation plans, governance instruments, practices and systems. Knowledge of relevant public-service legislation, directives, prescripts and departmental procedures. Understanding of knowledge management maturity assessments, monitoring and evaluation, change management, organisational learning, knowledge sharing, knowledge harvesting, and knowledge retention approaches. Knowledge of electronic knowledge management systems, digital information-sharing platforms, evidence management and reporting requirements. Strategic planning, leadership, people management, project management, change management, policy development and implementation, monitoring and evaluation, stakeholder engagement, research, analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills. Good verbal and written communication, report- writing, presentation, facilitation, coordination, planning and organising skills. Computer literacy and the ability to work independently, under pressure and as part of a multidisciplinary team. A service-oriented approach, sound interpersonal relations, initiative, integrity and a strong sense of responsibility.
jobs.duties: Manage the development, implementation, monitoring and review of the Department’s knowledge and information management frameworks, strategies, policies, plans, protocols, guidelines, standard operating procedures and supporting governance instruments. Conduct and manage knowledge management maturity assessments. Develop, implement, monitor and update the Department’s knowledge management implementation plan, knowledge management Policy, knowledge management strategy, change management plan and monitoring and evaluation plan. Ensure alignment of knowledge management frameworks and strategies with DPSA directives, departmental strategic objectives and emerging good practices. Manage the implementation and institutionalisation of knowledge management programmes, initiatives, systems, and interventions that promote knowledge sharing, retention, accessibility, and utilisation across the Department. Coordinate communities of practice, After action reviews, brown-bag sessions, knowledge-harvesting and knowledge-retention processes. Facilitate knowledge management awareness-building and capacity-building initiatives. Promote a departmental knowledge-sharing culture through appropriate change-management interventions. Identify and implement electronic systems and digital platforms that support knowledge and information management. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness and impact of knowledge management interventions and recommend improvements. Manage knowledge management governance structures, stakeholder engagement and compliance processes. Coordinate the establishment and operation of knowledge management governance structures in line with DPSA directives and departmental requirements. Manage the preparation, recording, quality assurance, approval and implementation of resolutions and decisions taken by knowledge management governance structures. Coordinate meetings of knowledge management governance structures. Represent the Department at the national DPSA knowledge management forum and other relevant knowledge management forums and platforms. Manage monitoring, evaluation and reporting on the implementation of knowledge management initiatives, plans and strategies. Manage the compilation and submission of annual, quarterly and ad hoc knowledge management reports. Facilitate consultation and reporting to the Department’s knowledge and information management forum and other relevant governance structures. Manage the collection, verification, and maintenance of evidence to support knowledge management implementation. Coordinate the submission of knowledge management implementation reports and supporting evidence through the DPSA online system.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preference, emotional intelligence and integrity. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Kennis- en Inligtingsbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteurpos wat kennis- en inligtingsbestuursraamwerke, -strategieë en -beleide vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria bestuur.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Inligtingswetenskap, Kennisbestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in 'n kennis- en inligtingsbestuursomgewing, waarvan ten minste drie (3) jaar op toegang-/juniorbestuursvlak (Assistentdirekteursvlak of gelykwaardig) moet wees. Begrip van kennisbestuursraamwerke, -strategieë, -beleide, -implementeringsplanne, -bestuursinstrumente, -praktyke en -stelsels. Kennis van relevante openbaredienswetgewing, -direktiewe, -voorskrifte en departementele prosedures. Begrip van volwassenheidsassesserings van kennisbestuur, monitering en evaluering, veranderingsbestuur, organisatoriese leer, kennisdeling, kennisoes en kennisbehoud-benaderings. Kennis van elektroniese kennisbestuurstelsels, digitale inligtingsdelingsplatforms, bewysbestuur en verslagdoeningsvereistes. Strategiese beplanning, leierskap, mensebestuur, projekbestuur, veranderingsbestuur, beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering, monitering en evaluering, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, navorsing, analitiese, probleemoplossing-, onderhandelings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goede mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie, verslagdoenings-, aanbiedings-, fasiliterings-, koördinerings-, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid en die vermoë om onafhanklik, onder druk en as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. 'n Diensgerigte benadering, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings, inisiatief, integriteit en 'n sterk verantwoordelikheidsin.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, implementering, monitering en hersiening van die departement se kennis- en inligtingsbestuursraamwerke, -strategieë, -beleide, -planne, -protokolle, -riglyne, standaardbedryfsprosedures en ondersteunende bestuursinstrumente. Voer kennisbestuursvolwassenheidsassesserings uit en bestuur dit. Ontwikkel, implementeer, monitor en dateer die departement se kennisbestuursimplementeringsplan, kennisbestuursbeleid, kennisbestuursstrategie, veranderingsbestuursplan en moniterings- en evalueringsplan op. Verseker belyning van kennisbestuursraamwerke en -strategieë met DPSA-direktiewe, departementele strategiese doelwitte en ontluikende goeie praktyke. Bestuur die implementering en institusionalisering van kennisbestuursprogramme, -inisiatiewe, -stelsels en -ingrypings wat kennisdeling, -behoud, -toeganklikheid en -benutting regdeur die departement bevorder. Koördineer gemeenskappe van praktyk, na-aksie-hersienings, brown-bag-sessies, kennisoes- en kennisbehoudprosesse. Fasiliteer bewusmakings- en kapasiteitsbou-initiatiewe rakende kennisbestuur. Bevorder 'n departementele kennisdelingskultuur deur toepaslike veranderingsbestuursingrypings. Identifiseer en implementeer elektroniese stelsels en digitale platforms wat kennis- en inligtingsbestuur ondersteun. Monitor en evalueer die doeltreffendheid en impak van kennisbestuursingrypings en beveel verbeterings aan. Bestuur kennisbestuursbestuursstrukture, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en nakomingsprosesse. Koördineer die totstandbrenging en werking van kennisbestuursbestuursstrukture in ooreenstemming met DPSA-direktiewe en departementele vereistes. Bestuur die voorbereiding, optekening, kwaliteitsversekering, goedkeuring en implementering van besluite en beslissings wat deur kennisbestuursbestuursstrukture geneem is. Koördineer vergaderings van kennisbestuursbestuursstrukture. Verteenwoordig die departement by die nasionale DPSA-kennisbestuursforum en ander tersaaklike kennisbestuursforums en -platforms. Bestuur monitering, evaluering en verslagdoening oor die implementering van kennisbestuursinisiatiewe, -planne en -strategieë. Bestuur die opstel en voorlegging van jaarlikse, kwartaallikse en ad hoc-kennisbestuursverslae. Fasiliteer konsultasie en verslagdoening aan die departement se kennis- en inligtingsbestuursforum en ander tersaaklike bestuursstrukture. Bestuur die versameling, verifikasie en instandhouding van bewyse om kennisbestuursimplementering te ondersteun. Koördineer die voorlegging van kennisbestuursimplementeringsverslae en ondersteunende bewyse deur die DPSA-aanlynstelsel.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mkhuzi: Ukuphathwa Kolwazi Nolwazi Lwemininingwane
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mkhuzi sokuphatha izakhiwo, izindlela nezinqubomgomo zokuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi lwemininingwane kwezohwebo, eziphathelene nezidlidli e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) kwi-Information Science, i-Knowledge Management noma iziqu ezihambisana nazo ezivunywe yi-SAQA. Ukwesisulu eminye emihlanu (5) unyaka ngokusebenza kwimvelo yokuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi lwemininingwane, lapho okungenani eminye emithathu (3) kufanele ibe ku-izinga lokuphatha lokungena/lokusesikhathini esincane (izinga lokaMqogi oNcedisayo noma okulingana nalo). Ukuqonda izakhiwo zokuphathwa kolwazi, izindlela, izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo zokusebenzisa, izinkimbobuso zokubusa, izindlela nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ulwazi ngomthetho othintwe inkonzo yomphakathi kanye nemiyalo, imibhalo yomthetho noma inqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo zomnyango ezihambisana nalokhu. Ukuqonda ukuhlola ukukhwela kolwazi ngokuphathwa kolwazi, ukuqapha nokubuyekeza, ukuphatha izinguquko, ukufunda kwezinhlangano, ukwabelana kolwazi, ukuqoqa ulwazi, kanye nezindlela zokugcina ulwazi. Ulwazi ngamahlelo wamazuba okuphatha ulwazi, amaphulatifomu wamazuba okwabelana ngolwazi, ukuphatha ubufakazi kanye nezidingo zokubika. Izindlela zokuqamba izinhlelo, ukuba ngumholi, ukuphatha abantu, ukuphatha amaphulo, ukuphatha izinguquko, ukuthuthukisa futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo, ukuqapha nokubuyekeza, ukuhlanganyelana nabathintekayo, uphando, izikhindi zokuhlola, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxoxisana nokuxazulula izinkinga namakhonstitshwa. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala, ukubhala ngemibiko, okuphathiswayo, ukukhuthaza, ukuhlanganisa, ukwenza izinhlelo nokuhlela, namakhono okusebenza ngokuphathelele. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa isahlukaniswa nasekhompyutha kanye nethemba lokusebenza ngokuzimela, ngokucindezelwa kanye nokuba yingxenye yeqembu elinezinkalo ezinkimbimbili. Indlela ehambisana nokukhuluma ngokwenzela, ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuthatha isinyathelo, ukuqina ngokuzethemba, nokuzwana okuyinjongo.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, ukuqapha nokubuyekeza izakhiwo zomnyango, izinhlelo zolwazi, izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo, imiyalo, izinkombandlela, izinqubo ezisesenqubweni, kanye namazwibela wobuholi obusekela. Ukuqhatha nokuphatha ukuhlola ukukhwela kolwazi ngokuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa, ukuqapha futhi ubuyekeze inkqubo yokuphathwa kolwazi komnyango, inqubomgomo yokuphatha ulwazi, isu lokuphatha ulwazi, ukuphatha izinguquko, kanye nenhlela yokuqapha nokubuyekeza. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo nezinhlelo zokuphatha ulwazi zihambisana nemiyalo ye-DPSA, izinhloso ezibalulekile zomnyango, kanye nezindlela ezisha ezinhle zokwenza. Ukuphatha ukusebenzisa nokwenza yonke into iqondwe kahle ngokuphathwa kolwazi kwezinhlelo, amaphulo, izinhlelo, kanye nokungenelela okukhuthaza ukwabelana ngolwazi, ukugcwalisa, ukufinyelela, nokusebenzisa kulo lonke umnyango. Ukuhlanganisa imiphakathi yabasebenzayo, izincomo ezenziwe ngemva senkinga, izinhlangano zokusizakala, ukuqoqa nokugcina izinkomba. Ukukhuthaza ulwazi ngokuphathwa kolwazi kanye nokuqeqesha. Ukukhuthaza inkcubabo yokwabelana kolwazi emnyangweni ngokuholela ekungenisweni kwemiyalo efanayo yokuthatha izinyathelo. Ukuthola nokusebenzisa amasistim wamazuba namaphulatifomu wamazuba asekelwa ukuphatha ulwazi nolwazi lwemininingwane. Ukuqapha nokubuyekeza ukusebenza nokubaluleka kokungenelela kokuphatha ulwazi futhi ukubize ngokusungula okusha. Ukuphatha izakhiwo zolawulo, ukuhlanganyelana nabathintekayo, kanye nezenzo ezihambisana. Ukuhlanganisa ukuhleleka kanye nokusebenza kwamahlelo okuphatha ulwazi ngokuhambisana nemiyalo ye-DPSA nezidingo zomnyango. Ukuphatha ukuhlela, ukurekhoda, ukuqinisekisa, ukuvuma, futhi kusetshenziswe izinqumo kanye nezinqumo ezithathiwe. Ukuhlanganisa izinkomfa zamahlelo olawulo lomnyango wezohwebo. Ukumela umnyango esikhundleni sesizwe se-DPSA emphakathi wokuphatha ulwazi kanye namaphaphu amanye. Ukuphatha ukuqapha, ukubuyekeza nokubika ngesihlukaniswa sezinhlelo zokusebenziswa kolwazi kwezinhlelo namasu. Ukuphatha ukuhlanganiswa nokuhambiswa kwemibiko ngokuphathwa kolwazi ngesikhathi esingajwayelekile. Ukuxazulula ukuxoxa nokubika kulemincili yangaphakathi emnyangweni yokuphathwa kolwazi kanye namanye amahlelo lawula. Ukuphatha ukuqoqa, ukuqinisekisa, nokugcina ukufakazela ukusekelwa kokuphatha ulwazi. Ukwenza ukuhambiswa kwemibiko ngokwenza ulwazi kanye nokusesekela isisindo ngohlelo lwe-DPSA lwamazuva.

xh.title: Isekela Ngqondo: Ulawulo lolwazi nolwaziolunye
xh.summary: Inkundla yomsebenzi kaSekela Ngqondo ephatha iinkqubo, iindlela namagunya olawulo lolwazi nolwaziolunye kwiSebe leziZihlahla, ezoLwandle kunye nezeMihlaba Pretoria.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) kwi-Information Science, i-Knowledge Management okanye izifundo ezifaneleyo ezithathwa ngqo yi-SAQA. Okona kuncinane iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kulawulo lolwazi nolwaziolunye, apho kubikho iminyaka elishumi (3) kwindawo yonqanaba lolawulo lokuqala/lotsha (nqanaba loMncedi Ngqondo okanye elinganayo). Ukuqonda kweekhaphethi, iindlela, amagunya, iiplani zokuzezelwa, izixhobo zolawulo, iinkqubo kunye namachaphaza e-arhente. Ulwazi ngemithetho yolawulo loluntu, imiyalelo, amagunya akawonke-wonke kunye namaxwebhu esebe. Ukuqonda ukupima ukuzinza kolawulo lolwazi, ukuqonda nokuqeqesha ulwazi, ukutshintshwa kolawulo, ukuqonda iinkqubo, ukwabelwana ngolwazi, ukuvuna ulwazi, nendlela zokugcina ulwazi. Ulwazi ngee-nkqubo ze-elekthronikhi zolawulo lolwazi, iiplathiphom e-dijitali zokwabelwana ngolwazi, ulawulo lobungqina nokuqonda iimfuno zokubika. Amakhono okucinga ngokubambisa, ukulawula abantu, ukulawula iiprojekthi, ukulawula utshintsho, ukwenza kunye nokuzisezelwa amagunya, ukuqonda nokuqeqesha, ukuzibandakanya nabanomdla, uphando, ukuhlalutya, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuthetha ngokusemthethweni nokusombulula iingxabano. Amakhono amabaléyo auhleliweyo nokubhala, ukubika, okubonakalayo, ukukhwazisa, ukuhlanganisa, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kunye namandla okusebenza ngokuzimela, ngaphantsi koxinzelelo njengesithandathu senqanaba sokusebenza. Indlela ekhokelela ezicini, ukuba nokungathembani kwindalo, amandla okwenza ngokuzimela, ukuzinza nolwande lokuzimisela.
xh.duties: Lawula iplasimento, izicwangciso, ukuqwalasela nokubuyekeza iikhaphethi kunye nezicwangciso, amagunya, iiplani, amalungiselelo, iinkqubo, ezomseqonweni, iinkqubo zokusebenza nokwamkela kwezoLuntu. Ukwenza nokuqonda iziphumo zokuqeqesha iinkqubo zolwazi ezingekwazi ukuzinza. Phatha, zeza, qwalasela, uze uhlaziye iiplani zokuzisa iinkqubo ngokulandelana, izicwangciso kunye neenkqubo ezilawula ulwazi eLuntu. Qinisekisa ukuba kuhambelana neendlela ekhoyo ngokomthetho wesizwe, iindawo ezibalulekileyo ekusebenzeni koluntu nakwinkqubo yekomiti. Lawula ukuzisa iinkqubo zonxibelelwano nemizamo yokwenza ulwazi lufikeleleka nakwabanye. Hlanganisa iinkqubo ezimbalwa, zihlaziywe ngemiba yokuzihlanganisa nokugcina inkqubo ethi yenze isebenze kwindawo yokubakho. Khokela iinkqubo ezintsha nakwabakho abasebenzisa ulwazi ebalulekileyo kuqhankqalaza kunye namanye amaxwebhu. Hlangabezisa inkqubo eza kuvakalelwa emva kokuba abasebenzi begqitha iinkqubo ngokubeka ushuni kwiinkqubo ezimalunga nolwazi ezalathwa nguMphathi weQela leSizwe. Misa inkqubo yelinye igazethu ezakulawula ulwazi olukhoyo mayelana nokuthi abasebenzi baziphi na iinkqubo eziza kusetyenziswa ekulawuleni ukwamkelwa kolwazi nakwinkqubo yabasebenziswa ngokubambisana ngamancedo amakhulu okuba ngokuqinisekileyo ngokwexesha. Lawula ukuqwalasela, ukubeka ngokulandelelana, ukuqinisekisa ukwamkelwa nokwenza izigqibo zeenkqubo ngokumiselwa kokulawula kwindawo yokukhulisa inkqubo kwizixhobo zeendaba. Hlanganisa iinkqubo ezenza iinkqubo ngokubeka ngokulandelelana nokuqwalasela usetyenziso ngokubanzi phakathi kwesebe lonke. Lawula ukuqhankqalaza okwenziwa kwindawo eyayisesicheni sezehlobo. Susa izigqibo ezingathintelwa ngesiNgesi kwinkqubo yesizwe ePhangalazini, kwizinto ezisisiseko zoluntu nakwezinye iindawo ezichanileyo. Lawula iinkqubo eziqulunqwe kwindawo okukhoyo inkqubo yonke yokugcina ulwazi ikwakhoyo nanjengesixhobo sokwenza okubonisana ngokusesikweni. Hlaziya ulwazi olujoliswe ekulungiseleleni iinkqubo ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqwalasela nakulawulo lokuqonda ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba luphela phi na inkqubo esebenza ngokomthetho. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kolwazi kwinkqubo egcina ulwazi ikwakhona nakwinkqubo yokwazisa amagosa ngokusesikweni. Susa izigqibo kwindawo ethileyo ngokusebenzisa izixhobo ezahlukeneyo ngokusesikweni somthetho welizwe nakumaxwebhu ezakuba ngokusetyenziswa ngokusesikweni. Lawula iinkqubo ezikwiphondo lokuqonda ukuba ingakanani na inkqubo egqithiswe kwindawo ekuyo nesebe. Lawula ukuqwalasela nokuqonda iinkqubo ezenza okusemthethweni ngokumisela izicwangciso ngokomthetho welizwe nakumaxwebhu asetyenziswa kwelinye igazethu. Hlanganisa iinkqubo ngokuzisa ulwazi ngokomthetho welizwe kwindawo apho inkqubo ikhoyo napha koMphathi welizwe ngokusesikweni esiza kusetyenziswa ngokusesikweni mayela nolwazi.

jobs.title: Control Environment Officer Grade A: National
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Control Environment Officer Grade A position in Pretoria administering environmental authorisations under NEMA, requiring a four-year degree and six years of experience.
jobs.requirements: A recognised Four (4) year degree in Environmental Management/ Science or Natural Science or equivalent qualification (NQF 8) in a related field coupled with Six (6) years post qualification experience. Appropriate experience in the application of National Environmental Management Act (Act 107 of 1998) (NEMA), as amended, NEMA Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 2014 (GN No, R982 of 4 December 2014, as amended) and National Environmental Management Waste Act. Knowledge of EIA Regulations, the integrated environmental management and its application. Extensive knowledge of sustainable development ideals and objectives, and all associated integrated environmental management instruments and tools. Understanding of the policy and legislative framework governing environmental management in general and legislative process. Experience in the administration and review of EIA’s and the dynamics of EIA’s administration systems. Applicants must have the following skills: Advance computer skills, Project management skills, report writing skills and good communication skills (written or oral). Applicants must be able to work individually and in a team, and must have the ability to work under pressure without supervision. Applicants must be willing to travel extensively and have a valid driver’s license.

Review and process a Section 24G and 30A applications in terms of NEMA and its Regulations, 2014 as amended. Establish and/or maintain relationships with key stakeholders on a monthly or bi-monthly or quarterly meetings or forums. Manage, respond and/ or delegate queries from stakeholders. Manage, guide and advise Control Environmental Officers and Case Officers. Coordinate and interact with stakeholders and provide guidance during planned and impromptu meetings as well as during site visits to clarify EIA related matters. Review and/ or provide technical input to Appeals Response Reports (ARRs). Support Regulatory Services with compliance monitoring and enforcement. zu.title: Isikhundla Sokuphathwa Kwendawo Yesimo Sendawo Isigaba A: Ezikhandeni
zu.summary: Isikhundla Sokuphathwa Kwendawo Yesimo Sendawo Isigaba A ePretoria esiphethe izigunyazindlela zesimo sendawo ngaphansi kuka-NEMA, esidinga idiploma yeminyaka emine nokuqashelwa okuminyakeni eyisithupha.
zu.requirements: Idiploma elamukelekile leminyaka emi-(4) eMqondweni Wokuphathwa Kwesimo Sendawo/Isayensi noma Isayensi Yemvelo noma isifundo esihambisana nalo (NQF 8) enkabeni ehlobene kanye nokuqashelwa okuminyakeni eyisi-(6) ngemuva kokuthola isifundo. Okuqashelwa okuhambisana ekusetshenzisweni kwe-National Environmental Management Act (Act 107 of 1998) (NEMA), njengokulungisiwe, NEMA Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 2014 (GN No, R982 of 4 December 2014, njengokulungisiwe) kanye ne-National Environmental Management Waste Act. Ulwazi nge-EIA Regulations, ukuphathwa kwezokusingatha isimo sendawo ngokuhlanganiswayo nokuqashelwa kwayo. Ulwazi olwolulekile ngezinjongo nezinhloso zentuthuko eqhubekayo, kanye nazo zonke izinto ezisetshenziswa nezithulusi zokuphathwa kwezokusingatha isimo sendawo ngokuhlanganiswayo. Ukuqonda inqubo yomthetho nesisekelo somthetho esibusa ukuphathwa kwesimo sendawo ngokujwayelekile kanye nenqubo yomthetho. Okuqashelwa ekuphathweni nasekuhlolweni kwe-EIA kanye nezinto eziguquguqukayo ezinhlelweni zokuphatha i-EIA. Abafaka izicelo kumelwe babe namakhono okulandelayo: Amakhono anamuva amakhompyutha, amakhono okuphatha iphrojekthi, amakhono okubhala imibiko kanye namakhono okuxhumana ahlelekile (okubhaliwe noma okukhulunwayo). Abafaka izicelo kumelwe bakwazi ukusebenza ngabanye nangohlelo, kanye namandla okusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo ngaphandle kolawulo. Abafaka izicelo kumelabe bazimisele ukuhamba kakhulu kanye nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha inkqubo yesigunyazindlela yesimo sendawo ngokuka-NEMA naku-NEMWA ehlobene nazo zonke izinto zokuthuthukiswa ezingeni lesizwe. Ukuhlola imibiko ye-EIA kanye nokuqondiswa okwenziwe abasebenzi bamacala. Ukuhlola futhi_ucubungula izicelo ze-Section 24G naku-30A ngokuka-NEMA nezimiso zayo, 2014 njengokulungisiwe. Ukusungula kanye nokugcina izinhlangano abantu abahlanganyelayo emihlanganweni yenyanga ngalinye noma yamasonto amabili noma kohanjuli noma kumajoni. Ukuqondisa, uphendule kanye nokwabelana imibuzo evela kubantu abahlanganyelayo. Ukuphatha, ukuqondisa kanye nokunikezazeluleko oseshini bokuqondisa isimo sendawo kubasebenzi bamacala. Ukuqondisa nokuxhumana abantu abahlanganyelayo bese unikeza ukuqondisa emihlanganweni ehleliwe kanye nengahleliwe kanye nasokuvakashela izindawo ukuze aqonde izinto ezihlobene ne-EIA. Ukuhlola kanye nokunikeza imibono yobuchwepheshe emibikweni yokuphendula izikhalazisibopho (ARRs). Ukusekela izinkonzo ezibuswa ngesinyathelo ngokuqaphela ukuzwelayo nokuphoqelela. Ukubambe iqhaza emihlanganweni ye-South African Wind Energy Association (SAWEA) kanye ne-Strategic Infrastructure Projects (SIPs) kumacelo e-EIA asekelwe kuwo umnyango. Ukuphendula izicelo ze-Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA), imibuzo ye-Ministerial kanye ne-Parliamentary.

xh.title: Iofisa Kolawulo lwendalo inqanaba A: Kwinqanaba lesizwe
xh.summary: Isithuba seSiba seNqanaba A kwindalo esimela ukuphatha iimvume zendalo ngaphansi kweNEMA, sifuna inqanaba lemine (4) lemfundo ephakamileyo kunye neminyaka emithandathu yamava.
xh.requirements: Idegree evunyiweyo yeminyaka emine (4) kuLawulo lweNdalo/Inzululwazi okanye ekuNzululwazini koBunjalo okanye isigaba esilinganayo semfundo (NQF 8) kwicala elinxulumeneyo eliqhotyoshelwa neminyaka emithandathu (6) yamava emva kokufumana isigaba semfundo. Amaba afanelekileyo ekusebenziseni uMthetho woLawulo lweNdalo leSizwe (uMthetho wama-107 ka-1998) (NEMA), njengoko ulungisiwe, IRekhulashini yoKulinganiswa kwempembelelo kwindalo yeNEMA ka-2014 (GN No, R982 ka-4 Disemba 2014, njengoko ulungisiwe) noMthetho woLawulo lweNkunkuma koLawulo lweNdalo leSizwe. Ulwazi ngeRekhulashini ye-EIA, ukulawulwa kwendalo okudityanisiweyo nokusetyenziswa kwayo. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeenjongo neengcabano zophuhliso ozinze kwayo ngaphezu komlinganiselo wemilinganiselo yonke eyahlulweyo yemixholo yolawulo okudityanisiweyo. Ukuqonda ummandla weNqungquthela nomthetho ohlawula ukulawulwa kwendalo ngokubanzi nendlela yokwenza umthetho. Amaxesha okuphatha nokuhlola ama-EIA namanxulumano nolawulo lwenkqubo ye-EIA. Abafakeli kufuneka banamakhono alandelayo: Amakhono obugcisa bekhompyutha amakhulu, amakhono olawulo lprojekthi, amakhono okubhala iingxelo namakhono olwazindlela zokuqonda (ezibhalwayo okanye ezithethwayo). Abafakeli kufuneka bakwazi ukusebenza ngabanye nakwijodi, futhi kufuneka benelise ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo ngaphandle kolawulo. Abafakeli kufuneka bekhululekile ukutshatha kakhulu futhi baneliswe nelayisense yokushayela.
xh.duties: Lawula inkqubo yemvume yolawulo lwendalo ngokweNEMA nama-NEMWA enxulumene nazo zonke iinkqubo zophuhliso lwesizwe. Hlola iingxelo ze-EIA neengcamango eziziwe ngabasebenzi beeKheyisi. Hlola aze aphathe iFom zama-24G nama-30A ngokweNEMA neRekhulashini yayo, ka-2014 njengoko ilungisiwe. Misela kwaye/okanye zigcine iindibaniselwano neendaba ezingundoqo kwiintlanganiso okanye amaqumrhu eentsuku zenyanga okanye ezivezinyanga okanye kwindanga. Phatha, phendula kwaye/okanye wabelana ngemibuzo evela kumabaniso. Phatha, gcalekisa kwaye ulule abasebenzi boLawulo lweNdalo kunye nabasebenzi beeKheyisi. Qhagamshelana nababaniso, umgciselise ngexesha leentslanganiso ezicwangcisiweyo nangezimedwa, nangexesha lokutyelela iindawo ukuze ucace imiba enxulumene ne-EIA. Hlola kwaye/okanye uze ngezinto ezinolwazi kumaxwebhu okuPhendula kokuPhela (ARR). Xhasa iinkonzo ezilawula ngokubukiwa kokulandelwa kwemithetho nokuphinywa kwemithetho. Thatha inxaxheba kwiiSouth African Wind Energy Association (SAWEA) neStrategic Infrastructure Projects (SIPs) iintlanganiso ngeenkqubo ze-EIA ezisiwe kuSebe. Phendula kumagqabantshi esiPromotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA), imibuzo yeMinista nayoPalamente.
