Uitgebreide ervaring in die opstel van wetgewing, beide primêre en ondergeskikte wetgewing. Kennis van openbare diens- en departementele beleide, wetgewing en prosedures; omgewings-, administratiewe en mynbouwetgewing; navorsingsmetodes en voorleggingsvaardighede; regsadministrasie; strategiese koördinasie/beplanning; besigheidsbeplanning; verslag-/professionele skryfwerk; besigheidsprosesbestuur; organisasie-prestasiebestuur; risikobestuur; ouditprosedures; projektebestuur; beplannings- en prestasiebestuurwetgewing. Vaardighede & Bevoegdhede: Gevorderde vaardighede in beleidsformulering; gevorderde vaardighede in wetgewingsopstel; gevorderde onderhandelingsvaardighede; gevorderde statutêre interpretasievaardighede, voldoende vaardighede in rekenaargebruik; gevorderde vaardighede in finansiële en projektebestuur; gevorderde vaardighede ten opsigte van formele voorleggings en openbare spraak; goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en diplomatieke vaardighede; verhoudingsbestuur; belanghebbendes-betrokkenheid; openbare betrekkinge; navorsing; strategiese vermoë en leierskap; program- en projektebestuur; veranderingsbestuur; kennisbestuur; diensleweringsinnovering (SDI); probleemoplossing en -analise; mensebestuur en -bemagtiging; kliëntoriëntasie en klantefokus; vermoë om onder druk en lang ure te werk; vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk; goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings, vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los; verantwoordelikheidsin en lojaliteit; objektiwiteit; integriteit; diensgerigtheid; selftoesig; hoë ontwikkelde eerlikheidsin en beskerm die vertroulikheid van dokumente. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê.
af.duties: Verskaf wetgewingsondersteuning aan die departement (opstel, ondersoek en kommentaar op Wetsontwerpe, beleide en ondergeskikte wetgewing). Verskaf algemene regsondersteuning met betrekking tot die National Environmental Management Act, 1998 (NEMA) en sy ondergeskikte wetgewing (Regsmenings/advies/navorsing oor wetgewing wat deur die departement geadministreer word, voorleggings, briefingsdokumente, response aan die publiek, mediavereiste, parlementêre vrae, ondersteuning aan interpretasieverwysings ter sake NEMA en ondergeskikte wetgewing). Verskaf regsondersteuning met betrekking tot NEMA/Spesifieke omgewingsbestuurswette en mynbou-belyningsondersteuning. Neem Wetsontwerpe deur en help met die Kabinets- en Parlementêre prosesse. Verseker dat die werk wat deur die Direktoraat gelewer word regtens verdedigbaar en van goeie gehalte is, en dat die tydlyne en voorskrifte wat deur die wetgewing en departementele diensstandaarde gestel is, nagekom word. Verskaf wetgewings- en beleidskoördinasieondersteuning aan Werkgroepe en ondergeskikte strukture wat met NEMA en ondergeskikte wetgewing handel, en neem deel aan regshervormingsfora van ander Departemente en bydraes op konsepwetsontwerpe, ondergeskikte wetgewing, beleide en riglyne met spesifieke fokusareas.

zu.title: Som lawu Olungele Okuphatha Isezimo Esiphakeme (MR6): Ukwesekwa Ngomthetho
zu.summary: Nikela ngokubhalwa kwemithetho nezinsiza zokwesekwa ngomthetho kuMnyango Wezohlamtetho, Zokulima Ezilwini Nokulingana Nomhlaba ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-LLB noma isifundo esihambisana nalokhu njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Isiphephelo seminyaka eyisishiyagalombili (8) sokuthola isiphephelo seminyaka ngemva kweziqu kulendlela yokunikeza izinsiza zomthetho. Isiphephelo esibanzi ekubhalweni kwemithetho, kokubili imithetho ebalulekile naleyasenhlanganweni. Ulwazi ngemithetho yesevisi yomphakathi nemithetho yomnyango, izinqubo; imithetho yezulu, yokuphatha kanye nezomgodi; izindlela zocwaningo namakhono okuhumusha; ukuphathwa komthetho; ukuhlelwa/ukuhlelwa ngokuhlose ukufeza okuthile; ukuhlelwa kwezomsebenzi; ukubhala ngokusesibonelo / ngobuchwepheshe; ukuphathwa kwenqubo yomsebenzi; ukuphathwa kokusebenza kwenhlangano; ukuphathwa kwezingozi; izinqubo zokuhlola; ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; imithetho yokuhlelwa nokuphathwa kokufeza. Amakhano nobuhlakani: amakhano aphakeme ekubhalwen kwenqubo yokubuyekeza; amakhano aphakeme ekubhaleni imithetho; amakhano aphakeme ekuxoxiswani; amakhano aphakeme ekutolikweni kwemithetho, amakhano afanele ekusebenziseni isidlankhompuyutha; amakhano aphakeme ekuphathweni kwezimali nasekuphathweni kwephrojekthi; amakhano aphakeme maqondana nokuhumusha okusesibonelo nokukhuluma phambi komphakathi; ubuhlobo obuhle kanye namakhano obudiplomathikhi; ukuphathwa kwezihlobo; ukuthathana kwezinkundla; izindaba zomphakathi; ucwaningo; ikhono lokuhola nokuqonda; ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi; ukuphathwa izele) ekuxazululeni izinkinga nasekuhlukaniseni; ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuwasiza; ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokugxila kumyeni; ikhono lokusebenza ngokucindezelwa nangezinsuku ezinde; ikhono lokusebenza ngabanye nakwezinklasi; ubuhlobo obuhle, ikhono lokusebenza nabantu ababucayi kanye noaxazulule phakathi kwalabo; isizinda esiphefumulelwe sokuphathwa nobunye. Isimilo nokuthembeka; ukungenisa icala; ukuqinisekisa isinsiza; ukuqinisice; ukubuka ngaphandle kokubandlula; ukuziphathela okusesibonelo; ukuqaphela okuzenzakalelayo; isizinda esikhulu sokuthembekile nokuqinisekisa ukungatholwa kalula kwemibhalo. Kudingeka abe nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokwesekwa komthetho kumnyango (ukubhalwa, ukucubungula nokuphawula emthethweni, inqubo nethetho elasenhlanganweni). Nikela ngokwesekwa ngomthetho ngokuvamile kuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemvelo Kwezwe, 1998 (NEMA) nethetho lasenhlanganweni (Izinkomba ezomtheth (izincomo/ucwaningo emthethweni ophathwa ngumnyango. Nikela ngokwesekwa ngokomthetho maqondana NEMA / nakumthetho wokuphathwa kwemvelo okukhethekile kanye nokwesekwa ukungqinelana komgodi. Ukudlulisa umthetho nokusiza eNqabeni nakwiNkundla yamaphalamende. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi okhiqizwa yisikhungo usemthethweni futhi ngokwemingeko, nokuthi isikhathi nemithetho esethwe umthetho nezindinganiso zesevisi zomnyango zihlonishwe. Nikela ngokubhangiswa komthetho kanye nokuxazulula inqubo kwamakilasi abasebenzi kanye nezakhiwo ezingezansi ezithatha i-NEMA nethetho lasenhlanganweni, nokubambe iqhaza ekuqokomelweni komthetho yeminango yamanye Umnyango kanye nezikhalazo ngemithetho eyayisakhiwo esikhethekile.

xh.title: Mphathi Wezabaphethe Imisebenzi Yamazwe ngokuLuntu ngesiXhosa (MR6): Inkxaso ngesiXhosa
xh.summary: Kubonezele inkxaso ngesiXhosa ekubhalweni kolwimilo nemisebenzi yamanyathelo kwiSebe leZohlamvu, iziLwandle nokuKhusiwa kweNdalo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB okanye isifundo esichanekileyo njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA. Amava ambalwa (8) eminyaka umba wamava emva kokugqiba ukufunda ekubonezelelweni kweenkonzo ngesiXhosa. Amava aninzi ekubhalweni kolwimilo ngokujulileyo kokuziphatha ngokomthetho nolwimilo oluncinci. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yomphakathi kunye nemigaqo yesebe, iintsapho zemithetho, iinkqubo, nolwimilo ngolwasiwoyike, ngokuLawulwa koluntu, nokuhlwa kwamathafa; iindlela zokucaphula nokubonisa iinkqubo zokulawula, ngesiXhosa ngokwendalo, nokuqamba iindlela; iinkqubo zokuqamba iindlela, ukubhala iingxelo; ulawulo lweenkqubo zorhwebo, ulawulo lweziphumo zoluntu, ukulawula ingozi, iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa, ulawulo lomsebenzi woluntu; imithetho yokuqamba nokulawula iziphumo. Amakhono namandla: Amakhono aphambili ekwakhiwa kwemigaqo; amakhono aphambili ekubhalweni kolwimilo; amakhono aphambili enkululeko-mvuzo; amakhono aphambili ekutolikweni kolwimilo, amakhono ngokwaneleyo ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha; amakhono aphambili ekulawulweni zemali nomsebenzi woluntu; amakhono aphambili ekuboniseni nasekuthetheni phakathi kwentlanganiso; amakhono amahle abakwazi ukuzonakalisa ubudlelwane babantu, bokubamba ngokucokise, bokulawula ubudlelwane, bokuzibandakanya nabantu, bokwenza udliwano-ndlebe, bokupapasha, bokucaphula, bakwazi ukukhokela, bakwazi ukulawula iinkqubo, ulwazi lokutshintsha, ukulawula ulwazi; ukuvakalisa iinkonzo (SDI); ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuwahlalutywa; ukulawula abantu nokuba inkhulele; ukukhathalela abathengi nokubekwa phambili abathengi; ukwazi ukusebenza ngcwele, ixesha elide nokuba ncedwa ngokomva; ukwazi ukusebenza ngokwakho, ngokwakhe nakwindima; ukwazi ukuba nengxaki yomntu onzima noxazululo lweengxaki; ukuba nomoya woxanduva nembeko; ukuzinikela ngokweneleleyo, unyanisekile; ukwenza inkonzo; ukuzihlola; ulwazi lokwenyuka ngesisa sokuziphatha ngokumfihlo izinto.
xh.duties: Kubonezele inkxaso ngesiXhosa kurhwebo (ukubhala, ukupenda nokuchaza ngeBhills, imigaqo nolwimilo oluncinci). Kubonezele inkxaso ngokubanzi nge-Act yeSilawulo seNdalo yeSizwe, 1998 (NEMA) nolwimilo bayo oluncinci (Imibono, izindululo/nkankhula zolwimilo eziphethwe yisebe, iingxelo zokuba ngaphantsi komthetho, iingxelo ezifutshane, iziphendulo zabantu, iintsebenziso zomthetho ezivela kubaphakathi/bantu, kumabali aphuma kumajelo, kwingxelo zamaphalambede, inkxaso ekutolikweni kweNEMA nolwimilo bayo oluncinci). Kubonezele inkxaso ngesiXhosa kubandakanya ukuqondanisa kweNEMA/ iindlela ezithile zokuLawulwa kweNdalo nokuqondaniswa kweendawo zokutsha kweendalo. Kubonezele inkxaso yokungenisa iBhills ePalameni nakwiinkqubo zeKhabhinethi. Qinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi ovela kulomsebenzi ulawulwa ngokomthetho, ungabi nalubuwo, ubengachanekanga, kwaye ulandela imigaqo namaxesha abekiweyo ngumthetho kunye nemigaqo yesebe yokwenza iinkonzo. Kubonezele inkxaso ekulawulweni kwemigaqo nolwimilo kumamphu amasebe aphakathi kwemigaqo esebenza ngeNEMA nolwimilo bayo oluncinci, kwaye uthabathe inxaxheba kumajelo oogqatswa bomthetho kumasebe amanye, angenise iimvozo ngeBhills ezakhiwayo, ulwimilo oluncinci, imigaqo neenkqubo.

jobs.title: Biodiversity Officer Specialised Production: Biosecurity
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Biodiversity officer enforcing biosecurity legislation, coordinating enforcement operations, conducting criminal investigations and prosecuting offenders in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: Honours degree (NQF8) in Natural/Environmental Sciences or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA coupled with a minimum of three (3) years’ experience in the relevant field. Knowledge and experience in criminal and administrative enforcement. Knowledge of the National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act, 2004 (Act No. 10 of 2004) (NEMBA), its associated subordinate legislation, and other relevant acts that deal with biodiversity matters. Knowledge and relevant experience in criminal procedures including the Criminal Procedures Act, court processes and document management. Knowledge of relevant legal processes. Knowledge and experience in criminal investigations and processes, in particular but not limited to alien and invasive species, threatened or protected species and applicable MEA’s such as CITES and the CBD. Knowledge of administrative procedures. Knowledge of, and experience in, the application of the provisions of the National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act, 2004 (Act No. 10 of 2004) (NEMBA), and its associated subordinate legislation, or experience in a law environment. Knowledge of the National Environmental Management Act, 1998 (Act No. 107 of 1998) (NEMA) and other acts affecting biodiversity. A Certificate in Environmental Management Inspector will be an added advantage. Advanced skills in policy formulation. Negotiation skills. Good interpersonal relations and diplomatic skills. Stakeholder engagement skills. Presentation skills. Ability to work under extreme pressure. Ability to work under pressure, willingness to travel. Computer literacy. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Ensure enforcement of Biodiversity related legislations. Coordinate enforcement operations. Do criminal investigations, crime scene management and open criminal cases to prosecute offenders, Co-operate and liaise with enforcement stakeholders on matters relating to Biodiversity enforcement activities, programmes and projects. Consult with prosecutors, police and all other stakeholders regarding criminal investigations. Follow and implement the National Compliance and Enforcement Information system. Develop and facilitate the implementation of national policies, strategies and programmes relating to the enforcement of the TOPS, CITES, AIS and BABS regulations. Provide strategic enforcement support to EMI’s. Participate in inter- departmental forums and processes regarding policy and legislative reform.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preference, emotional intelligence and integrity. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Biodiversiteitsbeampte Gespesialiseerde Produksie: Biosekuriteit
af.summary: Biodiversiteitsbeampte wat biosekuriteitswetgewing handhaaf, handhawingsbedrywighede koördineer, kriminele ondersoeke uitvoer en oortreders in Cape Town vervolg.
af.requirements: Honours-graad (NQF8) in Natuurlike/Omgewingswetenskappe of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, gekoppel aan 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar se ondervinding in die relevante veld. Kennis en ondervinding in kriminele en administratiewe handhawing. Kennis van die National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act, 2004 (Act No. 10 of 2004) (NEMBA), die geassosieerde ondergeskikte wetgewing daarvan, en ander relevante wette wat met biodiversiteitsake handel. Kennis van en relevante ondervinding in kriminele prosedures insluitend die Criminal Procedures Act, hofprosesse en dokumentbestuur. Kennis van relevante reg prosesse. Kennis en ondervinding in kriminele ondersoeke en prosesse, in die besonder maar nie beperk tot vreemde en indringer spesies, bedreigde of beskermde spesies en toepaslike MEA's soos CITES en die CBD nie. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures. Kennis van, en ondervinding in, die toepassing van die bepalings van die National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act, 2004 (Act No. 10 of 2004) (NEMBA), en die geassosieerde ondergeskikte wetgewing daarvan, of ondervinding in 'n regs omgewing. Kennis van die National Environmental Management Act, 1998 (Act No. 107 of 1998) (NEMA) en ander wette wat biodiversiteit beïnvloed. 'n Sertifikaat in Environmental Management Inspector sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Gevorderde vaardighede in beleidsformulering. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en diplomatieke vaardighede. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsvaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, bereidwilligheid om te reis. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verseker handhawing van Biodiversiteitsverwante wetgewings. Koördineer handhawingsbedrywighede. Doen kriminele ondersoeke, misdaadtoneelbestuur en open kriminele sake om oortreders te vervolg, Samewerk en skakel met handhawingsbelanghebendes oor aangeleenthede wat verband hou met Biodiversiteits-handhawingsaktiwiteite, programme en projekte. Raadpleeg aanklaers, polisie en alle ander belanghebendes rakende kriminele ondersoeke. Volg en implementeer die National Compliance and Enforcement Information system. Ontwikkel en fasiliteer die implementering van nasionale beleide, strategieë en programme wat verband hou met die handhawing van die TOPS, CITES, AIS en BABS regulasies. Verskaf strategiese handhawingsondersteuning aan EMI's. Neem deel aan interdepartementele forums en prosesse rakende beleids- en wetgewingshervorming.

zu.title: Onogada we-Biodiversity Ukukhiqizwa Okukhethekile: I-Biosecurity
zu.summary: Onogada we-Biodiversity ophoqa umthetho we-biosecurity, ohlela imisebenzi yokuphoqa umthetho, oqamba iphondo lezobugebengu futhi esiba ngamecala e-Cape Town.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-Honours (NQF8) kwe-Natural/Environmental Sciences noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokho ezivunyelwe yi-SAQA okuphathe kanye nobuncwane obungangeniswa eminyakeni eyithathu (3) ngaphakathi endaweni ehambisana nalokho. Ulwazi nompilo ngokuqatshelwa kwebugebengu nokuphathwa kolunye uhlelo. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act, 2004 (Act No. 10 of 2004) (NEMBA), lomthetho ongaphansi kwawo ohambisana nalokhu, kanye namanye amathemu ahambisana nalokhu abhekene nezindaba ze-biodiversity. Ulwazi nompilo ohambisana nalokhu mayelana nezinqubo zebugebengu okuhlanganisa nomthetho we-Criminal Procedures Act, izinqubo zezinkantolo kanye nokuphatwa kwamadokhumenti. Ulwazi ngezinqubo zomthetho ezihambisana nalokhu. Ulwazi nompilo mayelana neziphande zebugebengu nezinqubo, ngokukhethekile kodwa lingakhawulelwanga kuhlobo lwamaspecsi angaphandle nolunye olusongela ukuphila, izinhlobo ezisongelwe noma eziqinisekisiwe kanye nama-MEA asetshenziswayo njenge-CITES ne-CBD. Ulwazi ngezinqubo zokuphatwa kolunye uhlelo. Ulwazi nayo, kanye nomphilo, mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlinzeko zomthetho we-National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act, 2004 (Act No. 10 of 2004) (NEMBA), kanye nalomthetho ongaphansi kwawo ohambisana nalokhu, noma umphilo endaweni yomthetho. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-National Environmental Management Act, 1998 (Act No. 107 of 1998) (NEMA) kanye namanye amathemu abambe i-biodiversity. Isitifiketi se-Environmental Management Inspector kuzoba yinikhiyo engezuzisayo. Amakhono aphakeme ekubunjweni kolunye uhlebo. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu namakhono obudiplomat. Amakhono okuba negalelo kubaphathi bamabhizinisi. Amakhono okubonisa. Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxaku elikhulu. Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxaku, inkululeko yokuhamba. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphoqwa kwamathemu ahlobene ne-Biodiversity. Hlela imisebenzi yokuphoqa umthetho. Yenza iziphande zebugebengu, kuphatwe indawo yecaleni bese kuvulwa amacala ebugesinyi ukuba babhalwe abaculi, Sebenzisane uthintane nabaphathi bamabhizinisi bokuphoqa umthetho kuzindaba ezihlobene nemisebenzi yokuphoqa i-Biodiversity, amaphulo kanye namaphrojekthi. Xoxa nabaqinisekisi, amaphoyisa kanye nabo bonke abanye abaphathi bamabhizinisi mayelana neziphande zebugebengu. Landela futhi usebenzise uhlelo le-National Compliance and Enforcement Information system. Busa futhi wenze kube lula ukusetshenziswa kolunye uhlebo lwesifunda, izinqobo kanye namaphulo ahlobene nokuphoqwa kwamathemu we-TOPS, CITES, AIS kanye ne-BABS. Nikeza inkhaso yokuphoqa umthetho ebanzi kuma-EMI. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphora amnyanga asemabhulongana phakathi kwamaphoyisa kanye nezinqubo ngohlebo lomthetho nokulunye kwezinqobo.

xh.title: Iofisa woZinzo lwemihla ngemihla eZinzileyo: Ukhuseleko lweNzululwazi yeBiyo
xh.summary: Iofisa woZinzo lwemihla ngemihla oluphothula umthetho wokhuseleko lweNzululwazi yeBiyo, olulungelelanisa imisebenzi yophando, olwenza iziphando ezingalunganga nolugweba abenzi bobuganga eCape Town.
xh.requirements: Idegree yeHonours (NQF8) kwiZiNzululwazi eZidenduleyo Nemihlaba okanye isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo njengoko sivunyiwe yiSAQA esihamba nenkcazelo yeminyaka elitatu (3) yamava kwinkambelo efanelekileyo. Ulwazi namava kukujoliswa ngendlela yomthetho ezingalunganga nololulawulo. Ulwazi ngokuMthetho woLawulo lweNdalo: uMthetho woZinzo lwemihla ngemihla, 2004 (Act No. 10 of 2004) (NEMBA), nomthetho ongaphantsi wawo ohambisayo, namanye omthetho ofanelekileyo ophatha izinto zezinzo lwemihla ngemihla. Ulwazi namava afanelekileyo kwiinkqubo zomthetho oyingalunganga kuquka uMthetho weNkqubo zeZiphando eZingalunganga, iinkqubo zevenkileshala nokulawulwa kwamafxatsho. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zomthetho ezifanelekileyo. Ulwazi namava kziphando ezingalunganga nantsekqubo, ngokukodwa kodwa ungekho mgangathweni kummandla ohlaselayo nangesipilo esingahanjwayo, iintlobo ezisengozini okanye ezikhuselweyo ne-MEA efanayo njengeCITIES neCBD. Ulwazi ngenkqubo zolawulo. Ulwazi, namava, kokusebenzisa iinkqubo zoMthetho woLawulo lweNdalo: uMthetho woZinzo lwemihla ngemihla, 2004 (Act No. 10 of 2004) (NEMBA), nomthetho ongaphantsi wawo, okanye amava kwinkambelo yomthetho. Ulwazi ngokuMthetho woLawulo lweNdalo, 1998 (Act No. 107 of 1998) (NEMA) nomthetho omnye ochaphazela izinzo lwemihla ngemihla. Isatifikethi sokuba yiNkathhambi yoLawulo lweNdalo siza kuba/ngodla olongezelelweyo. Amakhono aphezulu ekwakheni iinkqubo. Amakhono axoxwa izinto. Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu namakhono obudiplomatic. Amakhono axoxa izinto. Amakhono abonisa izinto. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngxologa enkulu. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngxologa, ukulungelelana ukuhamba. Ukusenza ngekhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphathwa komthetho ohambelana noZinzo lwemihla ngemihla. Lungelelanisa imisebenzi yophando. Yenza iziphando ezingalunganya, kulawulwe iindawo zenkohlakalo ezizehlwayo kuvulwe iikaloso ezijongana nokugweba abenzi bobuganga, Ubumanyano nokudibana nabaphathi bomthetho kwimiba ehambelana noZinzo lwemihla ngemihla nanteknqubo, iinkqubo namaphojekthi. Dibana nokuqamba ngabagwebi, abapolisi nabo bonke abanye abantu kwimiba yesiphando esingalunganga. Landela uze usebenzise iinkqubo zeSizwe yokuzigcina nokugweba kolwazi. Yakha ulungelelanise ukusebenziswa kwezizwe ngeenkqubo, iindlela ezahlukeneyo neenkqubo ezihambelana nokugwebwa ngumthetho we-TOPS, CITIES, AIS ne-BABS. Zeza inkxaso ebonakalisa amakhondo kwi-EMI. Thabatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezihlanganisayo namaphanga eendawo ngomthetho nentengiso ekuvunjwa kweendaba nakulungiswa kwankqubo.

jobs.title: Environmental Officer Specialised Production: Criminal
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.salary_text: R518 769 per annum, (OSD) CENTRE             Pretoria Ref No: RCSM28/2026 Cape Town Ref No: RCSM29/2026
jobs.summary: Environmental officer sought to conduct criminal investigations into waste and pollution offences under environmental legislation, based in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Honours degree (NQF8) in Natural/Environmental Sciences/Management or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA coupled with a minimum of three (3) years’ experience in the criminal investigations or related investigative field. Applicants must have demonstrable experience in conducting criminal investigations, gathering and managing evidence, interviewing witnesses, obtaining affidavits and warning statements, compiling investigation reports and preparing case dockets for submission to prosecuting authorities. Experience in the application of environmental legislation to cases of non- compliance and working within the criminal justice system will be advantageous. Experience in conducting criminal investigations relating to environmental offences, particularly waste and pollution-related crimes, will serve as a strong recommendation. Knowledge: Investigation best practice; environmental policies and legislation; environmental compliance and enforcement methodologies; criminal investigation processes; the Criminal Procedure Act; National Environmental Management Act (NEMA); constitutional law; administrative law; civil procedure; criminal procedure; environmental governance; evidence management and chain of custody requirements; the criminal justice system; and the integration of scientific and technical information into criminal investigations. Sound knowledge of environmental crimes associated with waste management, pollution incidents, unlawful disposal of waste, contaminated land, industrial pollution and other environmental offences. Skills and Competencies: Good written and verbal communication skills. Strong investigative, analytical and evidence-gathering skills. Ability to compile high-quality investigation reports and criminal case dockets. Computer literacy and information management skills. Ability to analyse complex information and apply legislation effectively. Good interpersonal relations, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Honesty, integrity, objectivity, reliability and a strong sense of responsibility. Ability to interact effectively with prosecutors, SAPS, environmental authorities, laboratories and other stakeholders. Must have a valid driver's licence and be willing to travel extensively.
jobs.duties: Conduct criminal investigations into environmental offences, with a particular focus on waste and pollution-related crimes, in accordance with the Criminal Procedure Act, NEMA and other applicable environmental legislation. Conduct inspections, site investigations and crime scene activities. Collect, preserve and manage evidence, including environmental samples, and ensure proper chain of custody procedures are maintained. Gather and analyse information and evidence relating to environmental crimes. Obtain affidavits, warning statements and other evidentiary material. Draft and serve subpoenas and other legal documents required during investigations. Register criminal cases with the South African Police Service and maintain accurate records of investigations. Capture and update information on departmental enforcement systems and prepare weekly and monthly reports. Finalise investigations and compile comprehensive criminal case dockets, including investigation reports and charge sheets, for submission to the Director of Public Prosecutions or Specialised Prosecution authorities for decision. Manage criminal cases during the post-investigation phase, including consultation with prosecutors, witness preparation, attendance at court proceedings and provision of technical support during prosecutions. Facilitate successful prosecution outcomes by responding to requests for further particulars, attending consultations and court proceedings, and providing evidence where required. Participate in compliance and enforcement operations, multidisciplinary investigations and strategic projects aimed at addressing environmental non-compliance and environmental crime. Assist with operational planning, implementation, reporting and capacity-building initiatives. Co-operate and liaise with national, provincial and local government authorities, the National Prosecuting Authority, SAPS, Environmental Management Inspectors, laboratories and other stakeholders to strengthen environmental compliance and enforcement outcomes.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preference, emotional intelligence and integrity. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Gespesialiseerde Produksie: Krimineel
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte gesoek om kriminele ondersoeke na afval- en besoedelingsmisdrywe ingevolge omgewingswetgewing in Pretoria uit te voer.
af.requirements: Honours-graad (NQF8) in Natuurlike/Omgewingswetenskappe/-bestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, tesame met 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar se ondervinding in kriminele ondersoeke of 'n verwante ondersoekveld. Aansoekers moet aantoonbare ondervinding hê in die uitvoer van kriminele ondersoeke, die versamel en bestuur van bewysmateriaal, die ondervra van getuies, die verkryging van affidavits en waarskuwingverklarings, die opstel van ondersoekverslae en die voorbereiding van saakdossiers vir voorlegging aan vervolgingsgesag. Ondervinding in die toepassing van omgewingswetgewing op gevalle van nie-nakoming en werk binne die kriminele regsstelsel sal voordelig wees. Ondervinding in die uitvoer van kriminele ondersoeke met betrekking tot omgewingsmisdrywe, veral afval- en besoedelingsverwante misdae, sal as 'n sterk aanbeveling dien. Kennis: Ondersoekbestuurpraktyke; omgewingsbeleid en -wetgewing; omgewingsnakoming en -handhawingsmetodes; kriminele ondersoekprosesse; die Strafproseswet; Nasionale Omgewingsbestuurswet (NEMA); grondwetlike reg; administratiefreg; siviele prosedure; strafprosedure; omgewingsbestuur; bewysbestuur en ketting-van-bewaringvereistes; die kriminele regsstelsel; en die integrasie van wetenskaplike en tegniese inligting in kriminele ondersoeke. Goed deeglike kennis van omgewingsmisdae verbonde aan afvalbestuur, besoedelingsvoorvalle, onwettige wegdoening van afval, besoedelde grond, nywerheidsbesoedeling en ander omgewingsmisdrywe. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Sterk ondersoek-, analitiese en bewysversamelingsvaardighede. Vermoë om hoëgehalte-ondersoekverslae en kriminele saakdossiers op te stel. Rekenaarvaardigheid en inligtingsbestuurvaardighede. Vermoë om komplekse inligting te ontleed en wetgewing doeltreffend toe te pas. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en binne multidissiplinêre spanne te werk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom. Eerlikheid, integriteit, objektiwiteit, betroubaarheid en 'n sterk sin vir verantwoordelikheid. Vermoë om doeltreffend met vervolgers, SAPS, omgewingsgesagsinstansies, laboratoriums en ander belanghebbendes te skakel. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê en gewillig wees om uitgebreid te reis.
af.duties: Voer kriminele ondersoeke uit na omgewingsmisdrywe, met spesifieke fokus op afval- en besoedelingsverwante misdae, ooreenkomstig die Strafproseswet, NEMA en ander toepaslike omgewingswetgewing. Voer inspeksies, terreinondersoeke en misdaadtoneelaktiwiteite uit. Versamel, bewaar en bestuur bewysmateriaal, insluitend omgewingsmonsters, en verseker dat behoorlike ketting-van-bewaringprosedures gehandhaaf word. Versamel en ontleed inligting en bewysmateriaal met betrekking tot omgewingsmisdae. Verkry affidavits, waarskuwingverklarings en ander bewysmateriaal. Stel dagvaardings en ander regsdokumente op en bedien dit tydens ondersoeke. Registreer kriminele sake by die South African Police Service en handhaaf akkurate rekords van ondersoeke. Vang inligting op en werk dit by op departementele handhawingstelsels en berei weeklikse en maandelikse verslae voor. Finaliseer ondersoeke en stel omvattende kriminele saakdossiers op, insluitend ondersoekverslae en klagstate, vir voorlegging aan die Director of Public Prosecutions of gespesialiseerde vervolgingsgesagsinstansies vir besluitneming. Bestuur kriminele sake gedurende die na-ondersoekfase, insluitend oorleg met vervolgers, getuigingsvoorbereiding, bywoning van hofverrigtinge en die verskaffing van tegniese ondersteuning gedurende vervolgings. Fasiliteer suksesvolle vervolgingsuitkomste deur te reageer op versoeke om verdere besonderhede, bywoning van oorlegpligtings en hofverrigtinge, en die verskaffing van getuienis waar nodig. Neem deel aan nakomings- en handhawingsoperasies, multidissiplinêre ondersoeke en strategiese projekte wat gemik is op die aanspreek van omgewingsnie-nakoming en omgewingsmisdaad. Bied bystand met operasionele beplanning, implementering, verslagdoening en kapasiteitsbou-inisiatiewe. Werk saam en skakel met nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regeringsgesagsinstansies, die National Prosecuting Authority, SAPS, Environmental Management Inspectors, laboratoriums en ander belanghebbendes om uitkomste rakende omgewingsnakoming en -handhawing te versterk.

zu.title: Isiphathimandla sezwe, Ukukhiqizwa okukhethekile: Ize
zu.summary: Kufunwa isiphathimandla sezwe ukuphenya emizehleni yamacala ezonakalisa indawo nokungahloniphi imithetho yesimo sezulu ngaphansi komthetho wezemvelo, sise Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeHonours (NQF8) kwezEzemvelo/ezesayensi/ezilawulwa noma izifundo ezihambisana neziqu ezithathwa njengezamukelekile yi-SAQA, ezihambisana nobuncwane beminyaka emithathu (3) yokuqashelwa emsebenzini wokuphenya amacala noma othweni ohlobene nokuphenya. Abafaka izicelo kumelwe babezokwenza ucwaningo lwamacala, ukuqoqa ukuqashwa kobufakazi, ukuxoxa nobufakazi, ukuthola izitatimende nezinkomba zesexwayiso, ukuhlela imibiko yocwaningo nokulungiselela amafayelaamacala ukuthunyelwa kubaphathi bomthetho. Kubalulekile ukuba ulotshwe ngemithetho yezemvelo kumacala angahambisana nomthetho nokusebenza ngaphakathi kwesimiso somthetho wemacala ezonakalisa izwe; lolu hlobo lolwazi luzokusiza kakhulu. Ukuba nokuhlolwayo kwamacala ezonakalisa izwe, ikakhulukazi amacala ahlobene nokulahla ingudlala nokungcola, kuzokuba lusizo olukhulu. Ulwazi: Izindlela ezinhle zokuphenya; izinqubomgomo nomthetho wezemvelo; izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwe umthetho wemvelo nokuphoqelela ukuthenjwa kwawo; inqubo yokuphenya amacala; umthetho weCriminal Procedure Act; i-National Environmental Management Act (NEMA); umthetho welizwe; umthetho wemisebenzi kahulumeni; inqubo yomthetho wabaholiwe; umthetho wezamacala; ukulawula izwe nendawo; ukuphathwa kwamafaqaza nokuqinisekisa ukuhamba kwawo ngokulandelana; ukwenza umthetho; kanye nokuhlanganisa ukwaziswa kwesayensi nobuchwepheshe kumacala. Ukuqonda kahle ngamacala ezemvelo ahlobene nokulawula ingudlala, ukwenza kungcola indawo, ukulahla ingudlala ngokungashwephaheli, izinkaba ezingcolile, ukungcola kwezimboni kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izenzo ezingemthethweni ezingcolisa indawo. Amakhono namandla okusebenza: Amakhono amahle okubhala noku khuluma. Amakhono amakhulu okuphenya, ukuhlaziya, kanye nokuqoqa ubufakazi. Isiqu sokubhala imibiko emihle yokuphenya kanye namafayela amacala ezemvelo. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuphatha ukwaziswa. Isiqu sokuqonda ukwaziswa okudidiyelayo nokusebenzisa umthetho ngempumelelo. Amakhono amahle ohlelo lwabantu, ukuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Isiqu sokusebenza wedwa nakubudlelwano beziqu ezingafani. Isiqu sokusebenza ngokucindezelayo nokuhlukanisa isikhathi. Ukuqamba, ukuziphatha kahle, ukungaboni ngamehlo munye, ukuthembeka kanye nesibindi esikhulu sokuzibophezela. Isiqu sokuxhumana nabaphathi bomthetho, ne-SAPS, nabaphathi bendawo, kanye namalabhulethri kanye nabanye abantu. Kumele ubenelayisense yokushayela okusemthethweni futhi uthande ukuhamba njalo.
zu.duties: Yenza uphenyo ngamacala ezonakalisa izwe, ugqamisa kakhulu amacala ezemvelo ahe hhayana nokulahla ingudlala kanye nokungcola, ngokulandela umthetho weCriminal Procedure Act, i-NEMA kanye nomthetho ohlukile wezemvelo. Phenya izindawo, zenze imisebenzi yokuphenya kwindawo yecala. Qoqa, gcina uphathe amafaqaza, okuhlanganisa izampula zendawo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhlonishwa izinqubo ezifanele zokuqinisekisa ukuthi amafaqazi ahambe kahle ngokulandelana. Qoqa ukuze uhlaziye ukwaziswa kanye nobufakazi ohlobene namacala ezemvelo. Thola izitatimende, izinkomba zesexwayiso, nobunye obufakazi obudingekayo. Bhala unikeze izeluleko zomthetho kanye nemibhalo yomthetho edingekayo phakathi kokuphenya. Bhalisa amacala nge-South African Police Service futhi ugcine ukushicilelwa okuqinisekile kolwazi mayelana nokuphenya. Faka ubuwazi futhi ubuse ukwaziswa kumaimethobho wokusebenza komnyango, ulungise imibiko yamasonto nyanje kanye neyenyanga. Qedela okuphenyiwe ucwangcise ngokuphelele amafayela amacala, okuhlanganisa imibiko yokuphenya, nokuthunyelwa kumphathi obhekene nezococwa lwegciwane noma kubaphathi bakhethekile bomthetho ukuze bathathe isinqumo. Phatha amacala ngemva kokuphenya, okuhlanganisa ukuxoxisana nabaphathi bomthetho, ukuqinisekisa ubufakazi, ukuhamba uye enkantolo, kanye nokunika usizo olubhekene netheknoloji phakathi kokuqulwa kamacala. Phumelelisa ukuqulwa kwamacala ngokuphendula izicelo zemininingwane engaphezulu, ukuhamba uye ekuxoxeni kwenkantolo, nokunikela ngobufakazi lapho kudingeka khona. Zibophezele ekusebenzeni nasemisebenzini yokuphenya iqembu, ukuhlanganisa abantu abangeniso yodwa ngokuhamba ohlelweni. Siza ngesixazuzo, ngokusebenzisa, ukubika kanye nokuqinisa ikhono ekusebenzeni. Sebenzisana nemiqondo yezombusazwe emaphakathi nasekhaya kakhulu, ne-National Prosecuting Authority, ne-SAPS, ne-Environmental Management Inspectors, namalabhulethri kanye nabanye abantu ukuze kugcine kushiywe isidingo esihle ekusebenzeni.

xh.title: Iofisa yomxinikela okhethekileyo ekukhiqizeni: Ebalulekileyo ngokwesono
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe ofisa womxinikela owenza uphando ngamafa ngokuhlukumbisa imetho nakwezinye izifo ngokuchasene nomthetho womxinikela osekelwe ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Idegree yeHonours (NQF8) kwiZenzelezo eZidlanganile/Ezemimandla okanye isifanekiso esifanelekileyo njengokubalwa yiSAQA ekunye neminye ubuncinane emithathu (3) yamava kuphando ngamafa okanye kwelinye icandelo elinxulumene nophando. Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe namava abonakalayo ekwenzeni uphando ngamafa,okuqokelela nokulawula ubungqina,ukuxoxa nabangqina,ukufumana izitatimende ezifungiselwayo neziphawuli zesilumkiso,okuqamba iirapoti zophando nokulungiselela iifayile zemiba zokuhanjiswa kubagunyazi bolweso. Amava ekusebenziseni umthetho womxinikela kwimiba engahambelani nomthetho nakwinkqubo yolweso lwezonyezi kuya kuba lusizo. Amava ekwenzeni uphando ngamafa ngokuhlangene nezonyezi zemiba,ngakumbi amafa ahlobene nokuhlukumbisa imetho,naya kubakho isiphulelo esomelezayo. Ulwazi: Indlela esebenzayo yokwenza uphando;iinkqazo zomxinikela nomthetho;indlela zokuthobela nomthetho namagunya olweso olusetyenziswa;inkqubo yophando ngamafa;uMthetho wokuQhuba iNtyholo;uMthetho woLawulo lweMiba yoMxholo weSizwe (NEMA);umthetho wolwango;umthetho wolawulo;inkqubo yomthetho wesigqeba;inkqubo yamafa;ulawulo lomxinikela;ulawulo lobungqina neemfuno zohlu lokuqhuba ubungqina;inkqubo yolweso lwezonyezi;nakwodibanisa ulwazi lwesayensi nolwezobuchwepheshe kuphando ngamafa. Ulwazi olunamandla ngamafa omxinikela anxulumene nokulawula imetho,iziganeko zokuhlukumbisa imetho,ukulahla imetho ngokungekalungileyo,umhlaba othintelweyo,ukuhlukumbisa imithombo yemveliso nakwezinye izifo zemimandla. Amakhono nobuchule: Amakhono amabalise ngokubhala nokuthetha. Amakhono amandla okwenza uphando,okuhlalutya nokuyila iibungqina. Imandla yokwenza iirapoti zophando ezilungileyo neefayile zemiba ngamafa. Ukuzoba ngamakhompyutha kwaye unalo ulawulo kolwazi. Imandla yokuhlalutya ulwazi oludidiyelweyo nakusebenzisa umthetho ngokusebenzayo. Ubumame bobudlelwane nabantu,ukubandakanyeka nabanomdla kwezomthetho namakhono okuxazula iingxaki. Imandla yokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo nakumanqanaba amaninzi osebenziswana. Imandla yokusebenza ngaphantsi komvuzo kwaye ugcwalise iimikhosi. Inyaniso,inkanuko yokwenza into engalunganga ngokuzithandela,ukubukhohwa ngokubanzi,izifungo nokuzinikela ngokupheleleyo. Imandla yokudibana ngokusebenzayo nabagunyazi bolweso,iSAPS,abagunyazi bomxinikela,amasentsoro nakwezinye iindidi. Kufuneka unabhedi osemthethweni womqhubi kwaye ube lugqatshe lokuhamba kakhulu.
xh.duties: Yenza uphando ngamafa ngokuchasene nemimandla,ngakumbi amafa ahlobene nokuva kwezimuncu nokuhlukumbisa imetho,ngokulandela uMthetho weNkqubo yeNtyholo,iNEMA namanye amathetho womxinikela osebenzayo. Yenza ukuponjwa,kuphando kwendawo kwaye wenze imisebenzi yendawo yesono. Qokelela,gcina ulawulo lobungqina,kuquka iisampulu zomxininkela,kwaye uqinisekise ukuba inkqubo yokulandela ubungqina iqhutywa ngokulungileyo. Qokelela kwaye uhlalutye ulwazi nangobungqina ngokumafa womxinikela. Fumana izitatimende ezifungiselwayo,eziphawula isilumkiso nakwezinye izinto ezizobungqina. Bhala kwaye wanelise isaphulelo nemixholo yomthetho efunekayo ngexesha lophando. Bhalisa imiba ngamafa eSouth African Police Service kwaye ulondoloze irekhodi elungileyo lophando. Faka kwaye uvuse useto ulwazi kwinkqubo yamagunya esebe kwaye ulungiselele iirapoti zansuku zonke ngenyanga. Qedela uphando kwaye uqambe iifayile zemiba ngamafa elididiyelweyo,kuquka iirapoti zophando nepepela leetyholo,eziza kuhanjiswa kuGunya loMthetho kuQhankarhadi okanye oMagunya asebenzayo abancedisayo ukwenza isigqibo. Lawula imiba ngamafa ngexesha elilandela uphando,kuquka ingxoxo nabagunyazi bolweso,ukulungiselela abangqiba,ukubakho kwinkqubo yentshona yokutyholwa nokuvela kolwazi ngezobugcisa ngexesha lontyholo. Yenza kube lula ukuphumelela isigqibontyholo ngokuphendula iimfuno zolwazi olungakumbi,ukubakho kwiingxoxo nakwinkqubo yetyholo,nokusuka ubungqina apho kufuneka khona. Thatha inxaxheba kumanqamlezelo wokuthobela umthetho nolawulo,uphando kwamanqanaba amaninzi namaphulo aqhelanayo anjengokusombulula ukungahambelani nomthetho womxinikela nafa womxinikela. Nceda ngokucwangcisa ukusebenza,ukuyisebenzisa,iirapoti nezenzo zokwakh' izakhono. jobs.title: Environmental Officer Specialised Production: Integrated
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Environmental Officer position in the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria to process EIA decisions under NEMA.
jobs.requirements: Honours Degree (NQF Level 8) in Environmental Sciences or relevant equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years’ experience in Environmental Management or relevant field. Experience in processing EIA decisions and currently involved in the EIA sector. Appropriate knowledge and experience in the application of National Environmental Management Act as amended with specific reference to S24 and National Environmental Management: Waste Act. Knowledge and experience of GN Regulation 982, 983, 984, 985 and 994 and its proposed amendments. Thorough knowledge of integrated environmental management and its application. Knowledge of sustainable development ideals and objectives. Working experience in the administration and review of EIA’s and the dynamics of EIA administration systems. Advanced computer literacy skills will serve as an added advantage. Attendance of environmental management or EIA courses, and GIS skills will serve as an added advantage. Good interpersonal relations and diplomatic skills. Good communication skills (written, oral and graphic). Good organising, planning and reporting skills. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to develop and apply policies. Ability to work individually and in a team. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Processing EIA (Environmental Integrated Authorisations) final decisions; Receive a draft report. Comment on the draft. Receive a final report. Verify, review and analyse information and conditions. Ensure final decisions (environmental authorization (EAs) are routed within timeframe. Processing of other EIA (Environmental Integrated Authorisations) decisions and NEMA section 24G applications submitted; Comments on draft reports (BARs/SRs/EIRs) & application forms, acknowledgement and comments on EA amendment applications (part 1 & 2), Comments on EMPr amendments, EMPr approvals, EA amendment, MMPs, exemptions, all S24G decisions, etc. Coordinate and interact with stakeholders and provide guidance during planned and impromptu meetings as well as during site visits to clarify EIA (Environmental Integrated Authorisations) related matters; Attend project specific and preapplication meetings. Conduct site inspections. Updating of the project priority lists/database. Respond to external queries and requests via email. EIA Administration & functional support to management and Branches within the Department. Archiving decision and projects folders on EDMS. Archiving finalized files. Provide technical input to Appeals Response Reports (ARR’s).

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Gespesialiseerde Produksie: Geïntegreerd
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte-pos in die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria om MIL-besluite onder NEMA te verwerk.
af.requirements: Honours-graad (NQF-vlak 8) in Omgingswetenskappe of 'n relevante equivalente kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in Omgewingsbestuur of 'n relevante veld. Ervaring in die verwerking van MIL-besluite en tans betrokke in die MIL-sektor. Toepaslike kennis en ervaring in die toepassing van die National Environmental Management Act soos gewysig met spesifieke verwysing na S24 en die National Environmental Management: Waste Act. Kennis en ervaring van GN Regulasie 982, 983, 984, 985 en 994 en die voorgestelde wysigings daarop. Deeglike kennis van geïntegreerde omgewingsbestuur en die toepassing daarvan. Kennis van volhoubare ontwikkelingsideale en -doelwitte. Werkervaring in die administrasie en hersiening van MIL'e en die dinamika van MIL-administrasiestelsels. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardighede sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Bywoning van omgewingsbestuurs- of MIL-kursusse, en GIS-vaardighede sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en diplomatieke vaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik, mondeling en grafies). Goeie organisasie-, beplannings- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om beleide te ontwikkel en toe te pas. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Verwerking van MIL (Milieugeïntegreerde Magtigings) finale besluite; Ontvang 'n konseptverslag. Lewer kommentaar op die konsep. Ontvang 'n finale verslag. Verifieer, hersien en ontleed inligting en voorwaardes. Verseker dat finale besluite (omgewingsmagtiging (EAs) binne die tydraamwerk roeteer word. Verwerking van ander MIL (Milieugeïntegreerde Magtigings) besluite en NEMA seksie 24G-aansoeke wat ingedien is; Kommentaar op konseptverslae (BAR's/SR's/EIR's) & aansoekvorms, erkenning en kommentaar op EA-wysigingsaansoeke (deel 1 & 2), Kommentaar op EMPr-wysigings, EMPr-goedkeurings, EA-wysiging, MMP's, vrystellings, alle S24G-besluite, ens. Koördineer en interakteer met belanghebbendes en verskaf leiding tydens beplande en onvoorbereide vergaderings asook tydens terreinbesoeke om MIL (Milieugeïntegreerde Magtigings) verwante aangeleenthede te verduidelik; Bywoon projekspesifieke en vooraf-aansoekvergaderings. Voer terreininspeksies uit. Opdatering van die projekprioriteitslyste/databasis. Reageer op eksterne navrae en versoeke via e-pos. MIL-administrasie & funksionele ondersteuning aan bestuur en Takke binne die departement. Argiveer besluit- en projelêers op EDMS. Argiveer gefinaliseerde lêers. Verskaf tegniese insette tot Appèl Respons Verslae (ARR's).

zu.title: Nogesi Wezokusingatha Kwezomnotho Osegcaleni Okukhethekile: Okuhlangene
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaNogesi Wezomnotho Kulesikhungo sokusebenza sikaHulumeni e Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment e Pretoria kulezi zinhlelo zokusebenza kwemibhalo yokwamukelwa kwezinqumo EIA nge NEMA.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zobudunywa (NQF Level 8) kwezolwazi lwezomnotho noma ulwazi olulinganayo lokufeza isidingo esithile. Kufanele kubekhona isikhathi esinganeminyaka engu-3 sokusebenza okwenziwe okuhlobene nezokuphathwa kwezomnotho. Kubekho okuhlukile kokutholakala komsebenzi ongatholwa emkhakheni we-EIA namuhla. Ukuba nolwazi oluhambisana nokutshela ukusetshenziswa kokuqonda okuyisiqu komthethosisekelo wezomnotho njengoba kulungiselelwa okuhlobene nesigaba sika-S24 komthetho wezokuphathwa kwezokusingatha kwemfucuza. Ukuba nolwazi lokusebenza ngokuqonda komthetho osemthethweni we-GN 982, 983, 984, 985, 994 kanye neziguquko ezihlongozwayo ezikuleminingwane. Ulwazi olujulile ngohlelo oluhlanganisayo lokuphathwa kwezomnotho kanye nendlela okusetshenziswa ngayo. Ulwazi ngemigomo nezinhloso ezigxile ekuthuthukisweni okuhamba phambili. Ukuba nolwazi lwabo msebenzi wokuphathwa kanye nokubuyekezwa kwezinqumo EIA kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwalezi zinqumo. Ukuba nokuzikhandla ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuzobe kuhle lokhu. Ukuba nayo imiklomelo yokuzihlomisa kumkhakha wezomnotho noma kuleyo ye-EIA, hlobisa namakhono e-GIS kuzodingeka kakhulu. Ukuba nokwazana kahle nomphakathi nokuba nokuziphatha okuhle. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle (okubhaliwe, okukhulunywayo kanye nemiyalo). Ukuba namakhono amahle okuhlela, okulungiselela nokubika. Ukuba nomthelela wokuthola ukwazi nokuyihlaziya. Ukuba nomthelela wokwakha futhi usebenzise izinqumo ezisukela kolunye uhlangothi. Ukuba namakhono okusebenza wedwa nakuba nimhhumini. Ukuba nokuthola ukusebenza ngqo nangaphantsi kokucindezelwa.
zu.duties: Ukuxhumana nezinqumo eziqediwe zokuqinisekiswa kokuqoqwa kwezomnotho; Ukuthola imibhalo esanda kwenziwa. Ukubeka imibono kuleyo mininingwane. Ukuthola umbhalo oqediwe. Ukugcina ukuthi imininingwane kanye nemibandela ihlolwe futhi iqoqwe ngokucophelela. Ukugciselela ukuthi izinqumo zokugcina zithunyelwa kwesikhathi esibekiwe. Ukwenza eminye imisebenzi yokubuyekeza izinqumo EIA kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ngemibhalo esisigaba sika-24G se-NEMA; Izincomo emabhulukwe wezinsiza (BARs/SRs/EIRs) kanye namafomu esidingweni, ukwamukelwa nezinye izincomo emabhulukweni olimi bezinhlelo EIA (ingxenye 1 no-2), Izincomo kumabhulukwe azo lonke olunye uhlaziyo, izinqumo ezithile, izinqumo ezihlukene, izinhlelo ezithile zokusetshenziswa, nezinye izinqumo zamabhulukwe EIA. Ukuhlanganisa nokuthintana namaphoyinta bokusebenza ndawonye nokunikeza iziqondiso ezinhlelweni ezingakahlaliwe nasenkundleni yamamephu okuhlangana, futhi nasezindaweni ezithile zokuvakashela ukuze kucace izinto eziyinkinga mayelana nezinqumo EIA; Ukuba khona emihlanganweni abekhona ngokuthile nokuhlela kwayo eziqalele kuyo imisebenzi. Ukwenza izivakashi ezindaweni. Ukugcina futhi kuye kuhlaziwe uhlu lwezinhlelo mayelana nemibhalo ephathwayo. Ukuphendula imibuzo noma izinhlelo ezingahambi kahle esuka kubantu bangaphandle nge-imeyili. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo EIA nokusekelwa kwemisebenzi ebalulekile kubaphathi bamagatsha angenhla. Ukuqoqa imibhalo yeziqobo nemibhalo yamaphrojekthi ohlelweni lokuqoqa imibhalo EDMS. Ukuphotha izinsiza ezimgqinishiwe mayelana nemisebenzi egqinsiwe yemibhalo yamazwe aphesheya kanye nezinye izindaba ezithunyelwa ohlelweni lokusebenza lwe-ARR.

xh.title: IOfisa yezeemvelo eZikumgangatho ophezulu kwimveliso: Esidibaneyo
xh.summary: Isithuba sofisa wezemvelo kwisebe le-Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria ukuqhuba iinqumo ze-EIA ngokuka-NEMA.
xh.requirements: IHonours Degree (NQF Level 8) kwi-Environmental Sciences okanye ngesiqinisekiso esifanayo njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA. Isiphelo seminyaka elithathu (3) yamava kwi-Environmental Management okanye kwinkalo efunwayo. Amandla ekwenzi nokuqhuba iinqumo ze-EIA, kwaye ngeli xesha unobuthathuhe kwindawo ye-EIA. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo namava ekusebenziseni i-National Environmental Management Act njengokulungisiweyo kunye nentetho ethile kwi-S24 kunye ne-National Environmental Management: Waste Act. Ulwazi namava kwi-GN Regulation 982, 983, 984, 985 and 994 nangolungelelwano lwalo olululiweyo. Ulwazi oluqinileyo nolubanzi kwezolawulo lemvelo esidibaneyo nokusetyenziswa kwaso. Ulwazi ngamagqabantshintshi nangemiqulu yentlalo-ntle. Amanqanaba ekubakho kwindawo yolawulo nabalawuli nakuxhomezike lwaqhubo kwe-EIA nakwindalo kwezithulwana zolawulo lwabaphathi be-EIA. Amandla aphezulu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha aya kuba lusizo oluqhatshiweyo. Amandla ekuzibandakanyeni kwamakosi okulawulo abavelo okanye i-EIA, kwaye namandla okusebenzisa i-GIS aya kuba lusizo oluqhatshiweyo. Amakhono amabini ahlobo lokusondelelana ngokuhlakaniphi. Amabakhono abalulekileyo ekuthetheni kwaye kubhalwe, kuthethwe nokusetyenziswa iintshukumo ezifuneka. Amakhono abalulekileyo ekulungiselelweni, ekucingweni, nabakhoso abalawulwa. Amandla okuqokelela nokuqokelelwa iinkcukacha. Amandla okwakha nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Amandla okusebenza ngokweqids nesigqeba ekubeni kubakho namakhaya.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba amagqibio amanqanaba aphelileyo kwi-EIA (Environmental Integrated Authorisations); Wamkela isivakalisi se-National Environmental Management Act. Phawula ngeli nceda. Wamkela isivakalisi esasolulungiselelo. Qinisekisa, pinga, keza iinkcukacha nemigaqo esemthethweni. Qinisekisa ukuba izigqibo eziphelileyo (environmental authorization (EAs) zisuswa ngaphakathi kwexesha. Ukuqhuba iinqumo ezahlukileyo ze-EIA (Environmental Integrated Authorisations) nakunxibelelwano ngebhoki yamakhalasi e-NEMA section 24G anikelweyo; Nika imibuzo ngesixa ngamaxwebhu (BARs/SRs/EIRs) & izicelo zamafomu, wamkele uncedo nge-EA nakumagqibo okulungisa (part 1 & 2), Phawula ngokulungiswa kwe-EMPr, ukuvunyelwa kwe-EMPr, ukulungiswa kwe-EA, i-MMPs, iinkqubo zokulungiselela ekhaya, zonke iinqumo ze-S24G, nokunye. Baluleza kwaye uzame ukusebenzisana nabantu baphathelelana neenkqubo ezahlukeneyo unike isikhokelo phantsi kokuba kuye kubekho iindibano ezicwanguliswayo nezingacwanguliswanga, nakunyakamo kwindawo ezikuyo ukuze ucace iindaba ezithile ezivela kwi-EIA (Environmental Integrated Authorisations); Yondula iindibano ezimalanga nasekulingeni isicelo sokusebenza. Yenza iindibano ezimalana nabalawuli baphakathi besebe. Isikhokelo ngokwenza isalathiso esiNginganiselwa kwisebe ngokubakho kwamathuba. Lungelelanisa uluhlu lwamaphrojekhi abalulekileyo/uqoqosho. Phendula imibuzo yabangaphandle iinkqubo ngokuka-email. Inkxaso yolawulo kwi-EIA ekubakho kunxibelelwano phakathi kukaqoqosho namaqumva kwesebe. Ulungelelisa iinkqubo ezingayiyo namaphaphu kwakhona. Yenza isalathiso kulwazi lwe-Appeals Response Reports (ARR's).

xh.requirements: Isidanga seLLB okanye izifundo ezifaneleyo njengoko zivunyiwe yiSAQA. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-8 yokulingana emva kokuqeqeshwa kwamava ekuweni iinkonzo zomthetho. jobs.title: Senior Forester: Forests Management
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Senior Forester to manage state forest plantations at Qhudeni, implementing operational plans and quality-assuring service-provider work.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Forestry or relevant qualification within the related field recognized by SAQA. A Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in Forestry or relevant field. Knowledge of the National Forests Act, 1998 (Act 84 of 1998) and the National Veld and Forest Fires Act, 1998 (Act 101 of 1998) including other relevant legislations such as NEMA, NEMBA, CARA, Protected Areas Act, Public Services Act, PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of the forest and environmental management sector. Knowledge of PCI&S management Framework. People management and empowerment. Client orientation and customer focus. Financial Management. Project and Programme Management. Good communication skills (written and verbal). Facilitation and negotiation skills. Conflict management skills. Planning and organising skills. Good interpersonal relations skills. Ability to work under pressure and work long hours. Ability to work individually and in a team. A valid Driver’s license and willingness to travel and be able to drive State Vehicles.
jobs.duties: Render commercial activities in state forest plantations. Implement operational plans for the state forest plantations. Quality assures work rendered by service providers. Development of management plans. Assist in compiling and updating annual plans of operations. Plan and conduct physical verification for state forest plantations in the region. Monitor compliance with applicable business processes for management of state forest plantations. Prepare weekly and monthly reports. Implement the Audit Action Plan and keep record of evidence. Create jobs through Expanded Public Works Programme. Ensure protection of plantations from fires, livestock and pests. Assist with the implementation, enforcement and promotion of the National Forest Act (NFA), Conservation of Natural Resources Act (CARA) and National Veld Forest Fire Act (NVFFA). Administer forestry support services. Participate in stakeholder engagements. Conduct awareness campaigns.

af.title: Senior Bosbouer: Bosboubestuur
af.summary: Senior Bosbouer om staatsbosplantasies by Qhudeni te bestuur, deur operasionele planne te implementeer en die werk van diensverskaffers se gehalte te verseker.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Bosbou of 'n relevante kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld wat deur SAQA erken word. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ervaring in Bosbou of 'n relevante veld. Kennis van die National Forests Act, 1998 (Act 84 of 1998) en die National Veld and Forest Fires Act, 1998 (Act 101 of 1998) insluitend ander relevante wetgewing soos NEMA, NEMBA, CARA, Protected Areas Act, Public Services Act, PFMA en Treasury Regulations. Kennis van die bos- en omgewingsbestuursektor. Kennis van die PCI&S management Framework. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Finansiële bestuur. Projekte- en programbestuur. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Fasiliterings- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Konflikbestuursvaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en lang ure te werk. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis en staatvoertuie te kan bestuur.
af.duties: Lewer kommersiële aktiwiteite in staatsbosplantasies. Implementeer operasionele planne vir die staatsbosplantasies. Verseker die gehalte van werk wat deur diensverskaffers gelewer word. Ontwikkeling van bestuursplanne. Bystand met die opstel en bywerk van jaarlikse operasionele planne. Beplan en voer fisiese verifikasiëring vir staatsbosplantasies in die streek uit. Monitor nakoming van toepaslike besigheidsprosesse vir die bestuur van staatsbosplantasies. Stel weeklikse en maandelikse verslae op. Implementeer die oudit-aksieplan en hou rekord van bewyse. Skep werksgeleenthede deur die Expanded Public Works Programme. Verseker beskerming van plantasies teen brande, vee en plaagdiere. Bystand met die implementering, handhawing en bevordering van die National Forest Act (NFA), Conservation of Natural Resources Act (CARA) en National Veld Forest Fire Act (NVFFA). Administreer bosbousteenbrondienste. Neem deel aan belanghebbende betrokkenhede. Voer bewusmakingsveldtogte uit.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Wamahlathi: Ukuphatwa Kwamahlathi
zu.summary: Umphathi Omkhulu Wamahlathi ongaphatha izindawo zokwezaliswa amahlathi ezingamabhizinisi karhu umnyango e Qhudeni, ongasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza futhi aqinise iziqu imisebenzi yenqubo yabenzi bezinsiza.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF6) kumahlathi noma izifundo ezihambisana nalesi sikhundla ohlotshaniswa naso ezibonwa yi SAQA. Okungenani amava eminyaka emibili (2) emsebenzini wamahlathi noma enkimeni ohlotshaniswa nayo. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wamahlathi Wezwe, 1998 (i-Act 84 ka 1998) kanye noMthetho Wamablolo Nezikhokho Zamahlathi, 1998 (i-Act 101 ka 1998) kuhlanganise namanye omunye umthetho ohlobene nalawo njengo NEMA, NEMBA, CARA, i-Act Yezindawo Eziyigodi, i-Act Yezinsiza Zomphakathi, i-PFMA kanye Nemigomo Yesikhwama SoMbuso. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokuphatwa kwamahlathi nendawo okuhlala kuyona. Ulwazi ngohlaka lokuphatwa kwe-PCI&S. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokubusisa. Ukubhekiswa kubathengi nokugxila kubathengi. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali. Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Namaphrojekthi. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (okuqoshiwe nokukhulunwayo). Amakhono okuquququmba nokuxoxisana. Amakhono okuphatha iziphixinjengi. Amakhono okucubungula futhi uhlele. Amakhono ohlelo lokuhlobana kwabantu. Ikhono elokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezeli nangaphezulu kwesikhathi. Ikhono elokusebenza ngamunye nasemqubelweni. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile nokuzimisela ukuhamba kwayo ukwazi ukushayela izimoto zaRhulumayidi.
zu.duties: Ukuze ugcwalise imisebenzi yezentengiselwano kuzindawo zokwezaliswa amahlathi ezingamabhizinisi karhu umnyango. Ukuze usebenzise izinhlelo zokusebenza ezindaweni zokwezaliswa amahlathi ezingamabhizinisi karhu umnyango. Ukuqinise ukuthi umsebenzi owenziwe ngabenzi bezinsiza uqinisekisiwe. Ukuqamba izinhlelo zokuphatwa. Ukusize ukuqamba futhi ugcacise izinhlelo zeminyaka yonke ngokusebenza. Ukucubungula futhi wenze isibononongo sezibalo kuzindaweni zokwezaliswa amahlathi ezingamabhizinisi karhu umnyango esifundeni. Ukuhlola ukuthobela imigomo yamabhizinisi esebenzayo ukuphathwa kwamahlathi ezingamabhizinisi karhu umnyango. Ukuhlanganisa ubuwemi beminingwane yamasonto nenyanga zonke. Ukusebenzisa i-Audit Action Plan futhi ulondoloze ukubhalwa ngokungenisa izikhalazili. Ukudala izikhundla zemisebenzi kuhlelo lokwakha Izinsiza Zomphakathi. Ukuze waqinise ukuvikelwa kwamahlathi ngomlilo, izinkomo nezifo. Ukwaqinise inzuzo yokuba ingenise umthetho wamahlathi wezwe i-NFA, ukuvikelwa kwezinsiza zemvelo i-CARA) nomthetho wamablolo nezinkokelo zamahlathi i-NVFFA. Ukuphatha izinsiza zokweseka imisebenzi yamahlathi. Ukuba ngcoliswa kubathintekayo. Ukuze waqgibe izinkundla zokwazisa abantu.

xh.title: UMphathi weSihlahla: Uqondo Lwezihlahla
xh.summary: UMphathi weSihlahla ukulawula izityalo zezihlahla zikarhulumente eQhudeni, ukuze aphumeze iindlela zokuqhuba kwaye aqiniseke umgangatho womsebenzi ozenziwa ngabavelisi besebenza.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) kwi-Forestry okanye ngesidanga esihambelana nalo kwicala elinxulumene nalo evunywe yi-SAQA. Uqobo lweeminyaka ezingamawathathu (2) ngaphezulu yamava kwi-Forestry okanye kwicala elinxulumene nalo. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weZihlahla weSizwe, 1998 (uMthetho 84 ka-1998) noMthetho we-Miliferi noMlilo weNdawo weSizwe, 1998 (uMthetho 101 ka-1998) kuquka nezinye iintlobo zemithetho enyebo ngenjongo enkulu njenge-NEMA, i-NEMBA, i-CARA, uMthetho weeNdawo eZikhuselwe, uMthetho weNkonzo zoLuntu, i-PFMA neMigaqo ye-Ngxowa-mali. Ulwazi ngamacandelo olawulo lezihlahla nemizekelo. Ulwazi ngesakhiwo soLawulo lwe-PCI&S. Ukuqonda abantu nokuqinisa isakhono sabo. Ukwagqibelela kumthengi nokujolisa kumthengi. ULawulo lwezeMali. ULawulo lweeProjekthi neenkqubo. Isakhono esihle sokunxibelelwana (esibhalwayo nesithethwayo). Isakhono sokulunga izinto nokuxoxa. Isakhono sokuqonda iingxabano. Isakhono sokucwangcisa nokuhlela. Isakhono esihle sokuhlobana nabantu. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokusebenza iiyure ezinde. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza wedwa nakwisikhululo. I-Layisensi yokushayela esemthethweni nokuzithanda ukuhamba nokuba nakho ukushayela iimoto zoLuntu.
xh.duties: Kwenziwe imisebenzi yoshisho kwizityalo zezihlahla zikarhulumente. Kuphunyezwa iindlela zokuqhuba kwizityalo zezihlahla zikarhulumente. Kuqinisekiswa umgangatho womsebenzi ozenziwa ngabavelisi besebenza. Kusetyenziswa iindlela zolawulo. Kuncedwa ekuyiliweni nokuhlaziyeni iindlela zokuqhuba zeminyaka yonke. Kucwangciswa kwaye kwenziwa uqiniseko lwebali ngokubakho kwezityalo zezihlahla zikarhulumente kwingingqi. Kujongwa ukuthobela iinkqubo zoshisho ezifanelekileyo ekulawulweni kwezityalo zezihlahla zikarhulumente. Kulungiswa iingxelo zbeveki nezinyanga. Kuphunyezwa iNqumamvi yeNgcaciso ye-Audit kwaye kugcinwa irekhod yamagqinisekiso. Kudalwa amakhulu amasebe ngenkqubo yeNkqubo yokuNgcwalisa iNdlela zoLuntu. Kuqinisekiswa ukhuselo lwezityalo kummlilo, izilwanyana neentswembu. Kuncedwa ekuphumezeni, ukwaziseni nokuqinisekisa uMthetho weZihlahla weSizwe (NFA), uMthetho woKhuselo lweMithombo yoNdalo (CARA) noMthetho we-Miliferi noMlilo weNdawo weSizwe (NVFFA). Kulawulwa iinkonzo zokuxhasa izihlahla. Kuthathwa inxaxheba kwiintlanganiso nabantu bakhangele. Kwenziwa iinkqubo zokuvakalisa.

jobs.title: Office Administrator II Various Chief Directorate
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Office Administrator II providing secretarial and administrative support across various chief directorates within the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Office Management / Public Administration or relevant qualification in the related field as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of one (1) year experience in executive support and office administration function. Knowledge of procurement procedures. Knowledge of Public Service Act and relevant prescripts. Basic understanding of Public Financial Management Act and Treasury regulations. Good Understanding of administration and records management. Knowledge of diary management and minutes taking. Experience in document management. Skills: Good interpersonal relation, Communication (written and verbal), Coordination and organising skills. Good computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and internet). Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to screen telephone. Understanding of public service systems and procedures will also serve as an advantage. Ability to work under pressure and work independently with limited supervision.
jobs.duties: Provide efficient secretarial support by maintaining documents register for incoming and outgoing documents, liaising with stakeholders and other government departments, allocation and tracking workflows on EDMS system and diary management. Provide efficient and effective administrative support by managing filing systems, managing and distributing incoming and outgoing correspondence. Ensure compliance with procurement policies and procedures, make follow up with SCM for payment of companies. Provide financial administration services support by assisting with budget management, petty cash, compiling monthly financial reports, S&T claims are completed and submitted and assist with compilation of BAS payments.

af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Kantoorbestuur / Openbare Administrasie of 'n relevante kwalifikasie in die verwante veld soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar ervaring in uitvoerende ondersteuning en kantooradministrasiefunksie. Kennis van verkrygingsprosedures. Kennis van die Public Service Act en relevante voorskrifte. Basiese begrip van die Public Financial Management Act en Treasury-regulasies. Goeie begrip van administrasie en rekordbestuur. Kennis van dagboekbestuur en notule neem. Ervaring in dokumentbestuur. Vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings, kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), koördinasie en organisasievaardighede. Goeie rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook en internet). Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om telefoonoproepe te filtreer. Begrip van openbare diensstelsels en prosedures sal ook 'n voordeel wees. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en onafhanklik te werk met beperkte toesig.
af.duties: Verskaf doeltreffende sekretariële ondersteuning deur 'n dokumentregister vir inkomende en uitgaande dokumente te handhaaf, met belanghebbendes en ander regeringsdepartemente te skakel, werksvloei op die EDMS-stelsel toe te ken en te volg, en dagboekbestuur. Verskaf doeltreffende en effektiewe administratiewe ondersteuning deur lêerstelsels te bestuur, inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie te bestuur en te versprei. Verseker nakoming van verkrygingsbeleid en -prosedures, en volg op by SCM vir betaling van maatskappye. Verskaf finansiële administratiewe diensteondersteuning deur te help met begrotingsbestuur, klein kontant, samestelling van maandelikse finansiële verslae, verseker dat S&T-kwitsings voltooi en ingedien word, en help met die samestelling van BAS-betalings.

zu.title: Isiphathi Sezensi II Izinhlobo Ezahlukene Zomqondisi Omkhulu
zu.summary: Isiphathi Sezensi II esinika inkuseleko yobungqikithi nezolawulo kuzinhlobo ezahlukene zomqondisi omkhulu ngaphakathi kweDepartment of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF6) kokuLawula Izinsi / Ukuqashwa Kwezinkundla Zomphakathi noma iziqu ezihlobene nendawo edingekayo njengoba kuqashwe i-SAQA. Okungenani unyaka oyedwa (1) wolesiphefulelo kunkuseleko yobungqikithi nomsebenzi wokulawula izinsi. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokuthenga. Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Act namagama achazekayo ahlobene nawo. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwe-Public Financial Management Act nemigaqo ye-Treasury. Ukuqonda kahle ukulawula izinsi nokuphathwa kwegama. Ulwazi lokuphatha idiary nokubhala amaminithi. Isiphefulelo ekuphathweni kwamadokhumenti. Amakhono: Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, Unxibelelwano (okubhaliwe nokuwenza ngomlomo), Amandla okuhlela nokuhlela izinto. Ukuqonda kakuhle ukusebenzana ngekhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook nange-Internet). Ikono lokuthola futhi uhlaziye ulwazi. Ikono lokuhlola amakhol ezocingo. Ukuqonda izinhlelo nezinqubo zezinkundla zomphakathi kuzofakazela ingcongcolo enkulu. Ikono lokusebenza ngamandla nokusebenza ngabunye ngaphandle kokuhlolwa okulingene.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkuseleko yobungqikithi esebenzayo ngokugcina ukuqopha kwamadokhumenti amawelelayo naphumayo, ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli namanye amanye amakomidi azebe okuhlangenwe nakho ayisoze; ukubeka futhi ulandele isikhathi se-misebenzi ohlelweni lwe-EDMS nokuphathwa kwegama. Nikeza inkuseleko yokulawula izinsi esebenzayo ngokuphatha amasistimu wokulondoloza amafayela, ukuphatha nokusabalalisa okuhlangenwe nakho okuvela nokuhambe. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana namagama neziphoqo ezenzwa ngokuthenga; landela emuva i-SCM ukuze izinkampani zikhokhelwe. Nikeza inkuselelo yezimali zokulawula izinsi ngokusiza ekuphathweni kwesabelo, imali encane, ukubhala imibiko yezimali yanyanga zonke; izifiso ze-S&T kugcwaliswa futhi zithunyelwa futhi usize ekubhaleni ngezimali ezikhokhwa kwi-BAS.
