af.title: Taalpraktisyn
af.summary: Vertaal, redigeer en proeflees dokumente terwyl terminologie-ontwikkeling in Sepedi vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria ondersteun word.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Toegepaste Taalkunde / Taalpryktyk of relevante kwalifikasie, in die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken, met spesialisasie in Sepedi en vertaalkunde. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar se ervaring in taaldienste, vertaling of 'n verwante veld. Begrip van die toepassing van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika, 1996; die Wet op die Gebruik van Amptelike Tale, 2012 (Wet No. 12 van 2012); en die Pan-Suid-Afrikaanse Taaltraadwet, 1995 (Wet No. 59 van 1995), onder andere verwante wetgewing. Kennis van vertaling en redigering. Kennis van staatsdiensbeleid en administratiewe prosedures. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling), asook analitiese, koördinasie- en belanghebbende-skakelvaardighede. Wees rekenaarvaardig met kennis van MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Word, Outlook en die Internet. Oor persoonlike eienskappe beskik soos om innoverend en proaktief te wees, in staat wees om inligting in te samel en te ontleed, onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk, onder druk te werk, bereid wees om lang ure te werk, asook verantwoordelik en lojaal te wees.
af.duties: Vertaal dokumente. Doen navorsing en raadpleeg oor vertaalkwessies. Redigeer en proeflees vertalings. Bied ondersteuning in terminologie-ontwikkeling deur terme te onttrek en te definieer, asook deur voorlopige ekwivalente te verskaf. Werk saam met ander terminologie-ontwikkelingsbelanghebbendes. Skep taalbewustheid en verskaf taalverwante ondersteuning aan departementele werknemers. Bied ondersteuning in die monitering van die implementering van die departementele taalbeleid. Bied ondersteuning deur dokumente te redigeer, asook deur geredigeerde dokumente op te teken en in te lê. Skakel met takke rakende navrae oor dokumente wat geredigeer moet word.

zu.title: Umuntu Osebenza Nolimi
zu.summary: Humusha, hlela bese uhlolisa amadokhumenti ngokusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwamagama esiPedini kuDepartment of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) ku-Applied Linguistics / Language Practice noma izifundo ezifanele, ensimini ehlobene njengoba kuqashelwe yi-SAQA, ngobuchule esiPedini nakwizifundo zokuhumusha. Ukuze ube nokuhloniphwa kokuqala, kudingeka ube nenexpeshensi eyodwa (1) ehlezi egameni lokusebenza ngolimi, noma ukwenza imisebenzi ehlobene nayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukusetshenziswa kwe- Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, i- Use of Official Languages Act, 2012 (Act No. 12 of 2012), kanye nesiSouth African Language Board Act, 1995 (Act No. 59 of 1995) kanye Nemithetho elandelayo ehlobene nayo. Ulwazi nge- Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment nemithetho. Ulwazi ngokuhumusha noku. Ulwazi lwezinqumo zomphakathi nangemithetho yomsebenzi kahulumeni. Ubuchule bokuxhumana kwabningi, ubuchule bokusebenzisana (okubhaliwe noku) kanye nokuba namakhono okuhlaziya, ukuhlanganisa nokuba ubungina namalungu abanye emsebenzini ophuma emthethweni. Ukuze ube nekhono elihle lokusebenzisa i-Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook nakakhona i- Word kanye nokusebenzisana. Kudingeka aphathe kabi, kube nokuhlakanipha ekusebenzeni, kube nokuhlakanipha ekusebenzisana nalaba abakufanele abakwenze nomsebenzi wakho, kube nokuhlonipha, ukuzethemba, ukuqonda ngokulandelana imithetho yemisebenzi kahulumeni nokwenza imisebenzi ngokusemthethweni.
zu.duties: Humusha amadokhumenti. Yenza ucwaningo bese ubuza imibuzo ezindabeni zokuhumusha. Hlela bese uhlolisa okuhumushiwe. Nikeza usizo ekuthuthukisweni kwamagama ngokukhipha amagama kanye nokuwachaza ngaphezulu, kanye nokunikeza amagama aguqule kancane. Sebenzisana nalabo abathuthukisa amagama. Yaza abantu ngolimi bese unika usizo oluhlobene nolimi kubasebenzi bale ndawo. Nikeza usizo ekuqaphelelweni kokusetshenziswa kolimi endaweni yakho. Nikeza usizo ekulungiseni amadokhumenti, nokugcina amadokhumenti ohlele. Xhumana nezinsimbi ngemibuzo ehlobene namadokhumenti okuhlela.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi welulwimi
xh.summary: Huqumba, hlela kwaye uhlolelwe iimpazamo amaxwebhu ngelixa uxhasa intshukubiso yamagama kwisiXhosa kwiSebe leMisebenzi yoNtshatshalo, zoZiMpemba nokoMhlaba ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Nesidanga seSizwe (iNQF 6) kwiLinguistics eSetyenziswayo / uQeqesho lwesiXhosa okanye igqibo elinxulumeneyo, kwinqobo elihambelana nendawo efakiweyo njengoko kuqatshelwa yiSAQA, ngobuchule kwiSepedi nakwizifundo zokuqumba. Qinisekisela amava anqabileyo eminyaka eli-1 (1) kumasevisi esiXhosa, ukuqumba okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Ukuqonda ukusetyenziswa koLulo-mthetho weRiphabhuliki yaseMzantsi Afrika, 1996; uMthetho woKusetyenziswa koLwimi oSemthethweni, 2012 (uMthetho wona. 12 ka-2012); noMthetho weBhodi yoLwimi yaseMzantsi Afrika yodwa, 1995 (uMthetho wona. 59 ka-1995), phakathi kwamanye oLulo-mthetho anxulumene nabo. Ulwazi ngokuqumba nokuqhubelela phambili. Ulwazi lweenqongo-mthetho zesebe loLwazi lwesiXhosa nemigaqo yolawulo. Amakhono amabalalisekile ubudlelwane bomntu nomntu, amakhono abalaseleyo okunxibelelwana (okubhalwayo nokuqhathanisiweyo), namakhono okuhlalutya, ukuqamba, nokuqhubelela phambili abantu. Ukuba nokuzoba nolwazi lwekhompyutha ngokubonelela ngolwazi lwe-MS Excel, i-MS PowerPoint, i-MS Word, i-Outlook, naku-Internet. Ukuba nomlinganiselo wakho ofana nokuzoba mntu otsha nothanda ukuziqhuba phambili, ukwazi ukuqokelela ahlale ulwazi, ukusebenza wedwa nakwindalo, ukusebenza ngoxinzelelo, ukuzibophelela ekusebenzeni ixesha elide, nokuvela nekholo.
xh.duties: Qumba amaxwebhu. Qhuba uphande uze ungene kumanxulumo aqondene neenkxalabo zokuqumba. Hlela uze uhlale ngokuqinisekisa imigaqo ekubhalweni. Bonelela ngoxhaso ekulungelelweni kwamagama ngokuziba nokuqamba amagama, njengoko nokuqamba amaxabiso. Sebenzisana namanye angenelelo ekulungelelweni kwamagama. Dala ukwaziswa ngolwimi uze ubonelele ngokuxhasa olunxulumene nolwimi basebenzi basebe. Bonelela ngokuxhasa ekulawulweni kwenkqubo yomthetho welwimi esebe. Bonelela ngokuxhasa ngokuhlela amaxwebhu, nangokubhala iirekhodi uze ugcinwe amaxwebhu ahlikiweyo. Ngenxa yamaphondo angene ngemibuzo enxulumene namaxwebhu ahlikiweyo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: EPWP Reporting
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Provide administrative support including correspondence handling, records management, petty cash and procurement for the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate. A post-matric qualification and relevant experience in administration will be an added advantage. Knowledge of administrative procedure. Knowledge of public service prescripts and procedures. Knowledge of procurement policies and procedures. Thorough knowledge of financial management and supply chain management procedures. Computer literacy (Microsoft Office). Good communication skills (written and spoken). Report writing skills. Good interpersonal relations skills. Sound organising and planning skills. Ability to work long hours voluntarily and plan under pressure. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to adhere to policies, work independently, and work in a team.
jobs.duties: Provide administrative and logistical support to the Directorate: receive and register incoming and outgoing correspondence. Make photocopies. Assist with petty cash requests and procurement of office stock. Records management. Distribution of documents in a prompt and confidential manner. Make travel arrangements for the officials. Handle travel claims. Maintain and oversee the filling system of the Directorate. Create folders on Microsoft Teams. Provide electronic internal filing platform(s) support to users. Upload Directorate evidence on weekly/monthly basis on electronic filing platforms. Consolidate and maintain sub-directorate monthly inventory registers. Provide training support for electronic internal filing platform(s). Maintain database of trained stakeholders. Assist with the management of finances within the Directorate. Procurement of goods and services using the correct procedures. Prepare quarterly procurement reports for the Directorate. Ensure that orders are created, and invoices are paid timeously.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preference, emotional intelligence and integrity. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: EPWP-verslagdoening
af.summary: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning insluitend korrespondensiehantering, rekordbestuur, klein kontant en verkryging vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. 'n Post-matriekkwalifikasie en relevante ervaring in administrasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures. Kennis van openbare diensvoorskrifte en prosedures. Kennis van verkrygingsbeleid en -prosedures. Deeglike kennis van finansiële bestuur en voorsieningskettingbestuursprosedures. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Office). Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Verslagskryfvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Soliede organisatoriese en beplanningsvaardighede. Vermoë om lang ure vrywillig te werk en onder druk te beplan. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om beleide na te kom, onafhanklik te werk en in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe en logistieke ondersteuning aan die Direktoraat: ontvang en registreer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Maak fotostaatkopieë. Bystand verleen met klein kontantversoeke en verkryging van kantoorvoorraad. Rekordbestuur. Verspreiding van dokumente op 'n vinnige en vertroulike wyse. Maak reërelings vir amptenare. Hanteer reisaansprake. Onderhou en hou toesig oor die invulsisteem van die Direktoraat. Skep vouers op Microsoft Teams. Verskaf elektroniese interne invulplatform(s)-ondersteuning aan gebruikers. Laai Direktoraatbewys op 'n weeklikse/maandelikse basis op op elektroniese invulplatforms. Konsolideer en onderhou subdirektoraat maandelikse voorraadregisters. Verskaf opleidingsondersteuning vir elektroniese interne invulplatform(s). Onderhou databasis van opgeleide belanghebbendes. Bystand verleen met die bestuur van finansies binne die Direktoraat. Verkryging van goedere en dienste met die korrekte prosedures. Berei kwartallike verkrygingsverslae vir die Direktoraat voor. Verseker dat bestellings geskep word en fakture betyds betaal word.

zu.title: Clerk Wezolawulo: Ikuvela Kwe-EPWP
zu.summary: Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwemibhalo, ukuphathwa kwerekhodi, imali encane kanye noku thengwa kwezimpahla ze Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se Grade 12. Isiqu esingemva kwe-matric kanye nocwaningo oluhambisana nezolawulo kuzoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi mayelana nendlela yokwenza izinkundla zolawulo. Ulwazi mayelana nemiyalo yesevisi yomphakathi kanye nezindlela. Ulwazi mayelana namapholisi okuthenga kanye nezindlela. Ulwazi olujulile mayelana nokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nezindlela zokuphathwa kwesonto lokuhlinzeka. Ulwazi lwegumbi lokusebenza ngakhompyutha (Microsoft Office). Amakhono wokuxhumana kahle (okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo). Amakhono okubhala imibhalo. Amakhono ohlelo lokuhlobana nemuntu ngamunye. Amakhono ohlelo nokuhlela kahle. Ikono lokusebenza isikhathi eside ngokuzithandelayo nokuhlela ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ikono lokuqoqa kanye nokuqonda ulwazi. Ikono lokuzethulela kumapholisi, ukusebenza wedwa, kanye nokusebenza ngenqamu.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo kanye nezokuhamba kwezimpahla kwi-Directorate: wamukele ubhalise imibhalo ephuma kanye naleyo engena. Yenza amakhophi. Siza ngemibhalo yemali encane kanye nokuthengwa kwezimpahla zihhovisi. Ukuphathwa kwerekhodi. Ukusatshaliswa kwamadokhumenti ngendlela elula kanye neyasese. Yizindlela zokuhlela ukuhambaabezimali kubasebenzi. Phatha imibhalo yokuhambaabezimali. Gcina ulawule nokuqapha uhlelo lokugcwalisa kwi-Directorate. Dala amafolda ku Microsoft Teams. Nikeza inkxaso yohlelo lokugcina imibhalo ngemithombo yamakhompyutha kubasebenzisi. Faka ubufakela be-Directorate njalo ngeviki/njalo ngenyanga kumaphulatifomu e-eshothi yokugcina imibhalo. Hlanganisa ulwazi lwamabhokisi okuthengisa njalo ngenyanga, ugcine futhi aqoqwe. Nikeza inkxaso yokufundisa ngeplethifomu yohlelo lokugcina imibhalo. Gcina idathabheysi yabantu abafundisiwe. Siza ekuphathweni kwezimali ngaphakathi kwi-Directorate. Ukuthengwa kwezimpahla kanye nezinkonzo kusetshenziswa izindlela ezifanele. Hlela imibhalo yokuthenga njalo kwenyangankathazinya ka-4 i-Directorate. Qinisekisa ukuthi imiyalelo idaliwe, kanye nezikweletu zikhokhwa sikuhambisile isikhathi.

xh.title: Iclerk yolawulo: Iingxelo ze-EPWP
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo equka ukuphatha iindaba zabakwethu, ukulawula irekhodi, imali encinci nephulo zemali kwi-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment e-Pretoria.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Grade 12. Isifundo esingangaphambi kwesidigri kunye noluhlu lwemisebenzi oluhambelanayo kulawulo kuya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi ngendlela yokwenza izinto kolawulo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yesebe likawonke-wonke nendlela zokwenza izinto. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zephulo zemali nendlela zokwenza izinto. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeenkqubo zokulawula imali kunye nokulawula iketshani yezinto. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office). Amakhono amabalwe wokunxibelelwana (ebhaliweyo nokuqhutshiweyo). Amakhonyokubhala iingxelo. Amakhono amabalwe wokuhlukanisa nabanin uluntu. Amakh ono amabalwe wolungiselelo nokuqamba iindlela. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza iiveki ezide ngamaphuphu uze uqambe iindlela phantsi koxinzelelo. Ukuba nakho ukuqokelela nokuqonda ulwazi. Ukuba nakho ukulandela imigaqo, ukusebenza wedwa, nokusebenza nqanaba labantu.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo nengqeqesho kwiDirectorate: qokelela ubhalise iindaba ezizayo nasezihambayo. Yenza amakopi. Y nkxaso kwiindaba zemali encinci nasekuphulweni kwemfanelo zofiso. Ulawulo lwerekhodi. Ulahlekisiswa kwamaxwebhu ngesiquphelo nesimfihlo. Yenza iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuhamba ngabasebenzi. Phatha iingxelo zokuhamba. Hlala ulawula uluhlu oluvela kwiDirectorate. Dala iifolda kwiMicrosoft Teams. Nika inkxabo zolawulo ezibhaliweyo zangaphakathi kubasebenzisi. Thuma iingxelo zeDirectorate ngeveki/ngenyanga kwindlela ezibhaliweyo zokulawula. Qhkelela uze ulawule uluhlu lwemali yangaphakathi ye-sub-directure nyanya ngenyanga. Nika inkxaso yokugqitywa kwemfundo kwizikqobo ezibhaliweyo zangaphakathi. Hlala ulawula uluhlu lwabantu abagqityiweyo imfundo. Nkxasa ekulawulweni imali ngaphakathi kwiDirectorate. Phula imali yezinto nesebe bezinikwa ngenrila echanekileyo. Lungiselela iingxelo ze-ephulo yemali ngeveki ngeveki ngeDirectorate. Qinisekisa ukuba i-oda zenziwe, kwaye i-invoisise zihlawulwa ngexesha.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Travel Administration
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: An administration clerk is sought to manage travel administration tasks including fruitless expenditure tracking, no-show reporting, and procurement coordination in Pretoria.

Understanding of financial and procurement procedures. Ability to prioritise work. Knowledge of BAS and LOGIS. Knowledge and understanding of procurement policy. Computer literacy. Good communication (Written and verbal) and interpersonal skills. Ability to work under pressure.

Reconcile the BAS payment advice with the statement from suppliers.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Reisadministrasie
af.summary: Daar word gesoek na 'n administratiewe klerk om reisadministratiewe take te bestuur, insluitend die naspoor van vrugtelose bestedings, no-show-verslagdoening en verkrygingskoördinering in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. 'n Post-matrikulasiekwalifikasie en ervaring in reisadministrasie sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van administratiewe en klerklike prosedures. Begrip van finansiële en verkrygingsprosedures. Vermoë om werk te prioritiseer. Kennis van BAS en LOGIS. Kennis en begrip van verkrygingsbeleid. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie kommunikasie (geskryf en mondeling) en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Administreer vrugtelose en vermorsde besteding /no-shows/laat kansellasies. Kry weekliks (Maandae) 'n lys van no-shows en laat kansellasies by die reisagent. Stel amptenare in kennis van verkeerde handelinge om herhaling te voorkom. Stel 'n lys van no-shows op en versprei dit aan die betrokke DDG's. Verifieer betalings van reisakkommodasie. Ontvang die betaalstompies van Finansies en voeg die uitbetalingsnommer en aksiedatum by die hardkopie langs die betaalde fakture. Stel en konsolideer Weeklikse/Maandlikse Verslae oor No-Shows/Laat Kansellasies. Stuur afskrifte van fakture aan die betrokke toesighouer. Versoening van verslae van Finansies en die Bepalingskomitee. Versoen die BAS-betalingsadvies met die staatment van verskaffers.

zu.title: Iklerki Koluphatho: Ukuphathwa Kwezokuhamba
zu.summary: Kufunwa iklerki koluphatho edlulela ukuphatha imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezokuhamba okuhlanganisa ukulandela ukuchithwa kwemali ngaphandle kwenzuzo, ukubika ukungabikho, kanye nokuhlanganisa ukuthenga izinto ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. Ikhwalifayikheshini ngemuva kwe-matric namava ekuphathweni kwezokuhamba kuzoba yinhlengo. Ulwazi mayelana nemicimbi yoluphatho nobuklerki. Ukuqonda imicimbi yezezimali nokuthenga izinto. Isikhathi sokubeka phambili umsebenzi. Ulwazi mayelana ne-BAS ne-LOGIS. Ulwazi nokuqonda inqubomgomo yokuthenga izinto. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (Okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo) nabantu. Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcindezi.
zu.duties: Ukulawula ukuchithwa kwemali ngaphandle kwenzuzo nangokungalungile /ukungabikho /ukukhansela ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Ukuthola uhlu lwabantu abangekhona nokukhansela ngaphambi kwesikhathi kuMshayeli Wezokuhamba nsuku zonke zesonto (ngoMsombuluko). Ukweluleza izikhulu ngemizamo engalungile ukuze kugwenywe ukuphindwa kwayo. Ukuqamba uhlu lwabantu abangekhona nokuluhlumela kubaphathi abahlelekile (DDGs). Ukuqinisekisa ukukhokhelwa kwesidlale ezokuhamba. Ukuthola amasheke okukhokha ezezimali bese ongeza inombolo yokusatshalaliswa nosuku lwenzenzo kwikopi ebhalwe ngesandlo eceleni kwama-invoisi akhokhiwe. Ukuqamba futhi uhlanganise Okubikiwe Ngesonto Ngenyanga /Okubhalwe Ngaphambi Kwesikhathi. Ukuthumela amakopi ama-invoisi kumphathi ohlelekile. Ukuqinisekisa kabusha okubikiwe ezezimali nesiKhomidi Sokugqoka. Ukuqinisekisa kabusha iseluleko sokukhokha i-BAS nesitatimende esivela kubanikazi bempahla.

xh.title: Iklerk yolawulo: Ukulawula kohambo
xh.summary: Kufunwa iklerk yolawulo ukulawula imisebenzi yolawulo lohambo ehlanganisa ukuqonda ukuchithwa kwemali ngaphandle kwenjongo, ukubika ngokungabikho, nokulungelelanisa inkqubo yomthengiso ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 Iqhobosha langemva kwematric namava kulawulo lohambo kuya kuba yinenzuzo ekhawulezayo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo nengowasekhaya. Ukuqonda imigaqo yemali nengomthengiso. Ikhono lokubeka izinto ngokubaluleka. Ulwazi ngeBAS neLOGIS. Ulwazi nokuqonda umgaqo womthengiso. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Indlela elungileyo yokuzithetha (Ezibhalwayo nangomlomo) namakhono okusebenzisana nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngxam.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuchithwa kwemali ngaphandle kwenjongo nakwezize /okungabikho /ukurhoxisa ngethuba. Zisa uluhlu lwabantu abangabikho nokurhoxisa ngethuba kumqhakamshelwazi wokuHambo ngeveki ngamnye (ngoMvulo). Yalisa iigosa ngemisebenzi engachanekanga ukuyithintela ukuphinda yenzeke. Hlenga uluhlu lwabantu abangabikho uluze kuwongqondilewo kwiDDG ekufanelekileyo. Qinisekisa imali yohambo nendawo yokuhlala. Amkela amaphepha emali eKwindla uwongeze inani lokuthumela nomhla wokwenza kwiphepha eliqinileyo ecaleni kwama-invoice ahlawuliweyo. Hlenga uze Udiqagade iRipoti yeveki/nyanga yabo Abangabikho /Ukurhoxisa Ngethuba. Thumela iikopi zamainvoice kumgcinimfunzi ofanelekileyo. Ulungelelaniso lemibiko evela eKwindla nakwiKomiti yoMgqomo. Lungelanisa isalathiso somalo seBAS nendazana evela kubathengisi.

jobs.title: Security Officer
jobs.department: Department OF, Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Control access, monitor security equipment, and ensure building safety at the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Mpumalanga and Limpopo.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 3. Private Security Industry Regulations Act (PSIRA) Certificate. No experience required. Knowledge of access control procedures. Knowledge of measures for the control and movement of equipment and stores. Knowledge of prescribed security procedures (e.g., MISS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, etc.) and the authority of security officers under these documents. Knowledge of the relevant emergency procedures and security processes. Departmental & Public Services prescripts. CCTV operation. Ability to work long hours voluntarily. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to lead multidisciplinary team. Ability to organise and plan under pressure. Good interpersonal relations skills. Conflict management and resolution. Responsibility and loyalty.
jobs.duties: Perform access control. Ensure that unauthorised person and dangerous objects do not enter the building/premises. Perform proper lock up for all offices and access points. Operate and monitor control room security equipment. Monitor access control movements screen. Ensure safety in the building and premises. Undertake building/premises patrols to identify and check: all the passages and toilets before locking the main glass door and that no official is locked inside the office. Fire hazards exposed electrical contacts and other fire hazards emanating from instance chemicals. Apply emergency procedures (in situation like bomb scares, riots etc.) and alert the emergency service and departmental management. Provide receptionist services. Provide visitor stickers when entering and moving around the department. Ensure that the occurrence register and other register are kept up to date i.e. all incidents are recorded and brought to the attention of the supervisor. Obtain feedback from supervisors on incidents reported.

af.title: Veiligheidsbeampte
af.summary: Beheer toegang, monitor veiligheidstoerusting en verseker gebouveiligheid by die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Mpumalanga en Limpopo.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 3. Private Security Industry Regulations Act (PSIRA)-sertifikaat. Geen ondervinding vereis nie. Kennis van toegangsbeheerprosedures. Kennis van maatreëls vir die beheer en beweging van toerusting en voorrade. Kennis van voorgeskrewe veiligheidsprosedures (bv. MISS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, ens.) en die gesag van veiligheidsbeamptes ingevolge hierdie dokumente. Kennis van die tersaaklike noodprosedures en veiligheidsprosesse. Departementele en openbare diens voorskrifte. CCTV-bediening. Vermoë om lang ure vrywillig te werk. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om 'n multidissiplinêre span te lei. Vermoë om onder druk te organiseer en te beplan. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Konflikbestuur en -oplossing. Verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit.
af.duties: Voer toegangsbeheer uit. Verseker dat ongemagtigde persone en gevaarlike voorwerpe nie die gebou/terrein betree nie. Voer behoorlike sluiting van alle kantore en toegangspunte uit. Bedien en monitor beheerkamer-veiligheidstoerusting. Monitor toegangsbeheer-bewegingskerm. Verseker veiligheid in die gebou en op die terrein. Onderneem gebou/terreinpatrollies om te identifiseer en te kontroleer: alle gange en toilette voordat die hoofglasdeur gesluit word en dat geen beampte in die kantoor toegesluit word nie. Brandgevare, blootgestelde elektriese kontakpunte en ander brandgevare wat byvoorbeeld ontstaan uit chemikalieë. Pas noodprosedures toe (in situasies soos bomdreigemente, onluste ens.) en waarsku die nooddiens en departementele bestuur. Verskaf ontvangsdienste. Verskaf besoekerstickers wanneer hulle die departement betree en daarbinne beweeg. Verseker dat die voorvalregister en ander registers op datum gehou word, d.w.s. alle voorvalle word aangeteken en onder die aandag van die toesighouer gebring. Kry terugvoering van toesighouers oor aangemelde voorvalle.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaNoZephu
zu.summary: Lawula ukungena, buka imishini yokuvikela, futhi qinisekise ukuphepha kwindlu emnyankeni we-Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment e-Mpumalanga kanye naso-Limpopo.
zu.requirements: Izinga le-NQF 3. Isitifikedi se-PSIRA (Private Security Industry Regulations Act). Akukho mkhankaso ofuna. Ukwazi okumayelana nezinhlelo zokuvikela ukungena. Ukwazi okumayelana nezenzo ezilawula ukuhamba kwemishini nezinto ezisetshenziswa. Ukwazi okumayelana nezinhlela ezimisiwe zokuvikela (njengase-MISS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, njl.) kanye namandla abavikeli bomnyango ngaphansi kwalawa mabhuku. Ukwazi okumayelana nezinhlela ezibucayi zezinsiza kanye nezenzo zokuvikela. Izinhlelo zomnyango kanye nezinkomba zamaphoyisa omphakathi. Ukusebenza kwe-CCTV. Isidingo sokusebenza amasikhathi amade ngokuzithandela. Isidingo sokuqoqa kanye nokuhlaziya ulwazi. Isidingo sokubhekana neqembu elihlukene. Isidingo sokuhlela futhi ulungele phansi kwengcindezi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumanisa nabantu. Ukuphathwa nokuxazululwa kwemikhubano. Ithemba kanye nobunkomishwa.
zu.duties: Lawula ukungena. Qinisekisa ukuthi abangagunyaziwe nemicimbi engozayo ngenkela kwindlu/imihlaba. Qedela ukushiywa kwezohlwayo naweminye iminyanya kumakha lezindlu. Sebenzisa nakubuka imishini yokuvikela ikamelo lokulawula. Buka umbhalo wokuthi okungenwayo kuhamba kanjani. Qinisekisa ukuphepha kwendlu nakumahhala. Qedela imayelana nendlu/imihlaba, kufanele uhlole: zonke izigwegwede kanye namalavu ngaphambi kokuba uvale umnyango wegilasi omkhulu futhi uqinisekise ukuthi nakuphi na ompakethi bahlala emakha. Buka noma ziphi na izinkomba zengimfihlakalo nezinye izinkomba ezingabanga engozayo kusukela kumakhemikhali. Sebenzisa izinqubo zezimpilo ezibucayi (ezinjengokuza kwesaba ngamabhomu, ukuhlukana kwabantu, njl.) futhi umemisise izinsiza eziphuthumayo kanye nabaphathi bomnyango. Nikeza abaphakathi ngemisebenzi yokwamukela. Nikeza abaphakathi ngesitshudiso uma bengena futhi behamba kunyaka wonke umnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi umbhalo wezimpanza kanye neminye imibhalo igcinwa ithubele ikhona, okeke. Wonke amaphoyisa abhalwe, afakwe kumaphoyisa omphathi. Thola umbhalo kubaphathi ngesimemphazamo esibhalwe.

xh.title: Iofisa ZoKhuseleko
xh.summary: Lawula ukungena, qwalasele izixhobo zokhuseleko, kwaye qinisekisa ukhuseleko lwesakhiwo kwi Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment e Mpumalanga nase Limpopo.
xh.requirements: NQF inqanaba 3. Isatifikethe se Private Security Industry Regulations Act (PSIRA). Akukho nako mangaphezlu kufunekayo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo lokungena. Ulwazi ngeendlela zolawulo nokunyuka kwemisebenzi nemiqatho. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokhuseleko ezichaziweyo (umz., MISS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, njl.) nengamahlakani baqhuba ngazo iiofisa zokhuseleko. Ulwazi ngeendlela ezifanelekileyo zezigulo ezingalindelekanga kwaye neenkcukacha zokhuseleko. Imigaqo ye Departmental & Public Services. Ukusebenza kwe CCTV. Akho lokusebenza iiyure ezide ngokuzithandela. Akho lokuthola kwaye uhlalutye ulwazi. Akho lokukhokela iqela elinabasebenzi abanobubebe bamabala amaninzi. Akho lokuhlela nokwakha iplani ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amabalwe entlalo. Ukulawula nokusombulula iingxaki. Iyalelo noloyolo.
xh.duties: Yenza ulawulo lokungena. Qinisekisa ukuba abantu abangagunyazisiweyo nanto ezingoziyo zingangeni esakhiweni/ndaweni. Yenza ukuvala ngokuchanekileyo kuzo onke amaofisi nakuwo onke amangeno. Sebenzisa kwaye ulawule izixhobo zokhuseleko kwindlu yolawulo. Qwalasele isikrini sokunyuka kwabantu. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko kwesakhiwo nendawo. Yenza iindwendwe zesakhiwo/ndawo ukuze uzibe kwaye uhlole: onke amagqabhuku naziindlu zangasese phantsiokuvala umnyango wegilasi omtsha ukuqinisekisa ukuba akukho mntu uvaliwe ngaphakathi kwofisi. Iingozi zomlilo ezityholiwe ezidityaniswe ngamandla nezinye iingozi zomlilo ezivela ngokomzekelo kwiikhemikhali. Sebenzisa iendlela zokukhuba (kwimeko yokuba kukho isoyiko sebhombu, ukuzukuxa njl.) ukuze uxhase iinkonzo zokukhawuleza kwaye uxele abalawuli be Department. Nika iinkonzo zendwendwe. Nika iisitika zendwendwe xa kungena nakunyuka kwi Department. Qinisekisa ukuba incwadi yokubhaliwa kwezinto nakwezinye iincwadi zihlaziwa ngokukhawuleza, oko kukuthi onke amacandelo abhalwa aze abise ngasemaphepha kumlawuli ophakathi. Fumana impendulo abalawuli ngemicimbi ebikiweyo.

jobs.title: Forestry Service AID

Produce and process poles (e.g. cutting of poles, drying of poles, and sampling of poles).
