af.title: Bosboudienspraktykant
af.summary: Verskaf bosboustegniekondersteuning, insluitend bosbou, brandbestryding, oes en perkmerkings oor Mpumalanga en Limpopo plantasies.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 1 of 'n tersaaklike gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Kennis van: Planting and firefighting. Persoonlike eienskappe: Beplanning en uitvoering, aanvaarding van verantwoordelikheid, interpersoonlike verhoudings, spanwerk, betroubaarheid, selfdissipline. Vaardighede: Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, beplanning van interpersoonlike vaardighede en luistervaardighede.
af.duties: Lewer bosboufunksies binne plantasies en bosse. Voer die merking van persele, tel en merking van bome uit. Werk 'n verskeidenheid registers by aangaande die aspekte van werk. Bestry bosveldbrand of voer voorgeskrewe brandtake uit. Lewer oesdienste. Monitor die voortplanting van aktiwiteite. Produseer en verwerk pale (byvoorbeeld die sny van pale, droog van pale en monstername van pale).

zu.title: Usizo Lwamasevisi Amahlathi
zu.summary: Hlinzeka ngokweseka amahlathi okuhlanganisa izinto zokulima imithi, ukulwa nomlilo, ukuvuna nokuphawula izinkomba kulo onke amaplanteshi e-Mpumalanga nase-Limpopo.
zu.requirements: NQF Level 1 noma izifundo ezifana nezidingo ezifanele. Ulwazi mayelana nokulima imithi nokulwa nomlilo. Izimpawu zomuntu: Ukucubungula futhi kuqashelwe, ukwamukela izibopho, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, ukusebenza ndawonye, ukuzethemba, nokuzithiba. Amakhono: Amakhono okuxhumana kahle, ukucubungula amakhano abantu kanye namakhono okulalela.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokulima imithi ngaphakathi kwamaplanteshi nasezihlahleni. Wenze ukuphawula kwezinkomba, ukubala nokuphawula imithi. Buyekeza ukwahlukahluka kwezinhlu ezibhalwayo ngokuphathelene nezimo zomsebenzi. Lwe umlilo wamahlathi noma wenze umsebenzi wokushiswa okumisiwe. Yenza amasevisi okuvuna. Qaphela ukusakazeka kwemisebenzi. Yenze futhi ucubungule izinsimbi (isb. ukusika izinsimbi, ukumisa izinsimbi, kanye nokuthatha izampula kwezinsimbi).

xh.title: Inkxaso yeNkonzo yeZihlahla
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso ngabahlahla kubandakanya ukulima kwezihlahla, ukulwa nomlilo, ukuqokelela nokumakisha iiplots kuwo onke amaplanteshi eMpumalanga naseLimpopo.
xh.requirements: NQF Level 1 okanye izifundo ezilinganayo ezifanelekileyo. Ulwazi nge: Ukutyala nokulwa nomlilo. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ukuceba nokuphumeza, ukwamkela ixanduva, uquanano nokuhloniphana nabantu, ukusebenza ngokwembumba, ukuzithembisa, uzithobe. Iakhono: Amaxhobo amaninzi okuthetha, ukuceba ngamakhono obuntu nokuva kakuhle.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokulima kwezihlahla ngaphakathi kwamaplanteshi nasezihlahleni. Yenza ukumakisha kweeplots, ukubala nokumakisha izihlahla. Gazisa uluhlu olahlukeneyo ngeendlela zobomi. Lwa nomlilo wemithi/ntsima okanye yenza umsebenzi wokutsha ocela. Yenza iinkonzo zokuqokelela. Qaphela ukusasaza kolwabiwo lwezinto. Yenza kwaye ulungise iintonga (umz. ukusika iintonga, ukutshisa iintonga, nokuthatha iisampulu zee ntonga).

jobs.title: Chief Director: Public Finance Advisory (PFA)
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 - R1 858 821 per annum (Level 14), (all – inclusive package)
jobs.summary: Lead GTAC's public finance advisory services in Pretoria, overseeing consulting and project delivery to client entities at SMS Level 14.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor’s Degree/ Advanced Diploma/ BTech degree (NQF 7) as recognised by SAQA in Economics, Public Policy, Public Management or related field. A Postgraduate and Master’s degree (NQF 8 and 9) qualification in Economics, Public Policy, Public Management will be advantageous. 5 years of experience at a senior management level. At least 10 - 12 years’ experience working in a government entity and/or consulting environment. Must have broad knowledge of public finance and the functions of Treasuries, Broad knowledge of public service legislation, Excellent communication skills, Policy development skills, Project management skills. Must have ability to diagnose, analyse and make recommendations, good problem-solving skills and good business writing skills.
jobs.duties: To oversee and direct the effective and qualitative provision of public finance consulting and advisory services to client entities in support of GTAC’s mandate and strategy by managing the interface between GTAC clients, technical resource mobilisation, project delivery and administrative processes. PFA strategic and operational management: Participate in and contribute to GTAC strategic planning and manage the review, development, implementation and reporting on the PFA strategy, annual performance plan, operational plan and performance indicators. Manage the PFA financial performance including the development, implementation, review, and, if required, adjustment of the PFA Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), costed operational plan, drawings schedule, in-year monitoring report, Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) schedule, and adjustments report. Manage the quality assurance of and updates to the PFA standard operating procedures and business processes. Manage the PFA systems use and licence agreements, and enhancements to functionality. Manage the PFA structure and filling of posts, delegation of work and development of performance agreements, review of performance and development of performance improvement plans, resolution of issues, and provision of guidance. Oversee the administration of PFA documents, office resources and stationery, and travel arrangements and reimbursements. Manage the preparation for, participation in/chairing of, and reporting on PFA strategic and operational meetings including Ministerial briefings, Executive Committee (EXCO) and Management Committee (MANCO) meetings, Operational Management Meetings (OMM) meetings, PFA team meetings, and Accounting Officer update meetings. Manage PFA governance including ensuring that PFA information and documents are compliant and audit ready, the PFA assets register is updated and correct, and conducting quarterly and annual reviews and updating of the PFA risk register and risk management report. Stakeholder and Client Relations and Strategic Partnerships: Represent GTAC, where required, in ministerial, NT and parliamentary engagements, liaison and communications ensuring compliance with departmental and parliamentary calendars. Manage the production of reports and documents for parliamentary committees, intergovernmental forums, technical working groups, and other high-level consultations. Establish, build and maintain strategic partnerships with National Treasury, government departments, public entities, municipalities, and development partners. Manage the building and establishment of client relationships and conducting client satisfaction surveys. Manage participation in interdepartmental networking, and knowledge exchange and sharing. PFA Service Offerings and Knowledge Products Management and Promotion: Lead, guide and control the development, management, capacity building and continuous improvement of PFA service offerings and quality assurance frameworks and related guides, templates, tools and evaluation grids. Manage the identification/assessment of new advisory and technical assistance opportunities, development/review and approvals of business development and project pursuit decisions, and the strategic positioning and publishing of PFA service offerings. Manage, review and address quality assurance outcomes regarding systemic technical risks across projects, major quality concerns identified through QA processes, and emerging technical or strategic issues. Manage the identification and development of PFA knowledge products (guides, methodologies, toolkits) and presentations for GTAC webinars and publishing on the GTAC website. Manage the preparation of advisories for presentation to Ministers, the Presidency, Cabinet processes, intergovernmental forums, MTEC, Budget Council and parliamentary engagements on public expenditure policy and budget reforms, costing and risk analysis of public finance legislation and policy proposals and design of governance frameworks and implementation plans, and institutional reform initiatives in the outcomes system, performance agreements, delivery agreements, and public-sector monitoring systems at municipal, provincial and national level. Lead and guide the preparation of advisories and provide support to the NT DG and DDGs’ Budget Group on studies and improvements to allocative efficiencies of Government goals, sectors, policies, programmes and institutions, approaches to improving budgetary and public expenditure analysis processes to support NTs’ strategic role, and gaps and inefficiencies in financial policies and public financial management. Lead and guide the preparation of advisories for Ministers and departments on the efficiency, effectiveness and alignment of government spending with national priorities and on areas of waste, inefficiency or misalignment to enable informed decisions that optimise the use of public funds. Projects Governance and Management: Lead and guide the maintenance and continuous improvement of the GTAC project management framework including methodologies, processes and controls, and training materials and guides. Manage the establishment, development and maintenance of the PFA project governance framework system, processes and controls, and training materials and guides. Lead and guide the identification and establishment of multidisciplinary collaboration across practice areas and GTAC projects requiring integrated advisory support, ensuring joint QA arrangements across practice areas. Lead and guide monthly and quarterly reviews of technical and operational reports on practice management, technical coordination across projects, resource and capability considerations, technical risks and mitigation measures, project quality monitoring, and cross- practice integration. Manage the review, verification and approval of PFA projects reporting and documents including the monthly PFA projects progress report, PFA projects financial management reports, quarterly PFA projects list and information reports, and PFA projects narrative reports for inclusion in the Ministers Report. Lead and monitor the review and resolution of project implementation issues including delivery bottlenecks and technical risks, multidisciplinary coordination challenges, cross-cutting technical issues, and systemic quality concerns and emerging risks. Professional Services Provider Panel Management: Lead, guide and monitor the refreshment and maintenance of the PFA professional services provider panel including the procurement, contracting, onboarding, induction and ongoing business knowledge development of technical advisors. Lead, guide and monitor the productivity and performance of PFA technical advisors including reviewing contract usage and performance reports, conducting performance reviews, addressing performance issues, confirming contract continuation or termination, and reviewing and signing contract closure reports. PFA projects establishment and management: Lead and guide the initiation of PFA projects including processing of client requests and Ministerial instructions, management of client engagements and conducting of exploratory and scoping meetings. Manage the establishment of PFA projects including the development and preparation of client Memoranda of Agreements (MoAs), review of draft project charters and proposed scope, resourcing and costing, and confirmation of project teams and budgets. Monitor and control the registration of projects on the GTAC master project register, allocation of project numbers and cost centres, and uploading of project charters and client MoAs. Manage the allocation of technical advisors including checking rotation, approving instructions to perform work, registration of LTA assignments, and removing/adding team members as requested. Manage the procurement of project resources including approving terms of reference and memo/request for quotation, approving bid nomination letter, attending Bid Evaluation Committee meetings as required, checking service provider contract file (checklist, award memo, draft award letter, and draft contract) and signing contracts. Manage and approve project extensions / amendments requests, including preparation of contract-related motivations and memos, project terms of reference, and proposed discrete project budget adjustments. Project Delivery and Quality Assurance: Lead, guide and review the production and quality assurance of project inception reports including project workplans, technical approaches, governance, stakeholder engagement plans, and project risk management plans. Lead, monitor and manage the implementation and management of projects and compliance to the project charter and agreements including project scope, deliverables, timelines, and budget across all project cycle stages including planning, implementation and post evaluation. Manage PFA client relationships and services quality including responding to client queries, attending project meetings and providing advice as required/needed, resolving any emerging service problems, and conducting PFA client. Lead, monitor and manage project progress reviews and quality assurance of project deliverables, and identification and resolution of emerging technical risks, challenges and quality concerns or escalation to the Head: GTAC surveys. Monitor and ensure all project documents are properly stored, version-controlled and made available for institutional learning (including reports, presentations, spreadsheets, research, records, datasets, models, templates and tools). Project Budget Management, Reporting and Closure: Oversee, verify and approve monthly project budget and expenditure reports management and submission. Manage the review and approval of TA time records per project/assignment, TA electronic records, and TA disbursement claims. Oversee, approve and control project travel, logistics and arrangements and disbursement claims, and time sheets, contract usage and invoicing. Oversee, guide and control the closure of PFA projects including reviewing and approving project closure reports and follow up proposals and recommendations, evaluating lessons learnt reports, and updating project guidelines as relevant. Oversee, guide and control the recovery of project costs including preparing submission to Finance and reviewing, approving and monitoring client invoicing and payments.
jobs.applications: Only online applications will be accepted. Applications not accompanied by a comprehensive CV and a fully completed Z83 form will not be considered. Please register, or if you are already registered, sign in and apply for this position on the GTAC eRecruitment website https://erecruitment.gtac.gov.za/erecruitment/
jobs.notes: Only South African Citizens, and Permanent Residents need to apply as per PSR 2016. Applications should be accompanied by a duly completed and signed Z83 form (obtainable from any Public Service department). The post title and reference number must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. A recent comprehensive CV should be submitted. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be required to be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview from shortlisted candidates. All short-listed candidates will be subjected to security vetting to confirm employment, personnel suitability checks. Short-listed candidates must make themselves available for a panel interview on the date determined by GTAC. Late applications, and those not meeting the requirements, will not be considered. Should you not receive feedback from GTAC within 2 months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. GTAC reserves the right to fill or not fill the advertised post. Preference will be given according to EE and Gender target. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. In accordance with the DPSA Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days and Minimum requirements, this SMS level appointment will be subject to the completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Government. The applicants should therefore have proof that they have registered for the pre-entry certificate and have completed the course before the appointment. The cost of the pre-entry certificate is at the candidate’s expense. To access the pre-certificate course, please visit: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           The GTAC is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applications from women and people with disabilities. Our buildings are accessible to people with disabilities and reasonable accommodation is provided for persons with disabilities. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Openbare Finansies Advisering (PFA)
af.summary: Lei GTAC se openbare finansies adviesdienste in Pretoria en hou toesig oor konsultasie- en projeklewering aan kliëntentiteite op SMS-vlak 14.
af.requirements: Baccalaureusgraad/ Gevorderde Diploma/ BTech-graad (NQF 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Ekonomie, Openbare Beleid, Openbare Bestuur of 'n verwante veld. 'n Nagraadse en Meestersgraad (NQF 8 en 9) kwalifikasie in Ekonomie, Openbare Beleid, Openbare Bestuur sal voordelig wees. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak. Ten minste 10 - 12 jaar se ervaring wat in 'n regeringsentiteit en/of konsultasie-omgewing gewerk het. Moet breë kennis van openbare finansies en die funksies van Tesourieë hê, Breë kennis van openbare dienswetgewing, Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede, Beleidsontwikkelingsvaardighede, Projekbestuursvaardighede. Moet die vermoë hê om te diagnoseer, te analiseer en aanbevelings te doen, goeie probleemoplossingsvaardighede en goeie besigheidsskryfvaardighede.
af.duties: Om toesig te hou oor en die effektiewe en kwalitatiewe voorsiening van openbare finansieskonsultasie- en adviesdienste aan kliëntentiteite te bestuur ter ondersteuning van GTAC se mandaat en strategie deur die koppelvlak tussen GTAC-kliënte, tegniese hulpbronmobilisering, projeklewering en administratiewe prosesse te bestuur. PFA strategiese en operasionele bestuur: Neem deel aan en dra by tot GTAC strategiese beplanning en bestuur die hersiening, ontwikkeling, implementering en verslagdoening oor die PFA-strategie, jaarlikse prestasieplan, operasionele plan en prestasie-aanwysers. Bestuur die PFA-finansiële prestasie insluitend die ontwikkeling, implementering, hersiening, en, indien nodig, aanpassing van die PFA Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), gekoste operasionele plan, skedule vir tekeninge, in-jaar moniteringsverslag, Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE)-skedule, en aanpassingsverslag. Bestuur die gehalteversekering van en opdaterings aan die PFA-standaardbedryfsprosedures en besigheidsprosesse. Bestuur die PFA-stelsels se gebruik en lisensie-ooreenkomste, en verbeterings aan funksionaliteit. Bestuur die PFA-struktuur en vul van poste, afvaardiging van werk en ontwikkeling van prestasieooreenkomste, hersiening van prestasie en ontwikkeling van prestasieverbeteringsplanne, oplossing van probleme, en verskaffing van leiding. Hou toesig oor die administrasie van PFA-dokumente, kantoorhulpbronne en skryfbehoeftes, en reisreëlings en terugbetalings. Bestuur die voorbereiding vir, deelname aan/voorsit van, en verslagdoening oor PFA strategiese en operasionele vergaderings insluitend ministeriële briefings, Executive Committee (EXCO) en Management Committee (MANCO)-vergaderings, Operational Management Meetings (OMM)-vergaderings, PFA-spanvergaderings, en Accounting Officer-opdateringsvergaderings. Bestuur PFA-bestuursbeheer insluitend om te verseker dat PFA-inligting en -dokumente voldoen en ouditgereed is, die PFA-batesregister opgedateer en korrek is, en die uitvoer van kwartaal- en jaarlikse hersienings en opdatering van die PFA-risikoregister en risikobestuursverslag. Belanghebbende- en kliëntverhoudinge en strategiese vennootskappe: Verteenwoordig GTAC, waar nodig, in ministeriële, NT- en parlementêre betrekkinge, skakeling en kommunikasie om versekerde nakoming van departementele en parlementêre kalenders. Bestuur die vervaardiging van verslae en dokumente vir parlementêre komitees, intergouvernementele forums, tegniese werkgroepe, en ander hoëvlak-konsultasies. Stig, bou en onderhou strategiese vennootskappe met National Treasury, regeringsdepartemente, openbare entiteite, munisipaliteite, en ontwikkelingsvennote. Bestuur die bou en vestiging van kliëntverhoudinge en die uitvoer van kliënttevredenheidsopnames. Bestuur deelname aan interdepartementele netwerking, en kennisuitruiling en -deling. PFA-diensaanbiedings en kennisprodukbestuur en bevordering: Lei, begelei en beheer die ontwikkeling, bestuur, kapasiteitsbou en deurlopende verbetering van PFA-diensaanbiedings en gehalteversekeringsraamwerke en verwante gidse, sjablone, gereedskap en evalueringsroosters. Bestuur die identifikasie/assessering van nuwe advies- en tegniese bystandskanse, ontwikkeling/hersiening en goedkeurings van besigheidsontwikkeling en projeknavolgingsbesluite, en die strategiese posisionering en publisering van PFA-diensaanbiedings. Bestuur, hersien en behandel gehalteversekeringsuitslae rakende stelselmatige tegniese risiko's oor projekte heen, vernaamste gehaltessorgsake wat deur QA-prosesse geïdentifiseer is, en opkomende tegniese of strategiese kwessies. Bestuur die identifikasie en ontwikkeling van PFA-kennisprodukte (gidse, metodologieë, nutsgereedskap) en aanbiedings vir GTAC-webinars en publisering op die GTAC-webwerf. Bestuur die voorbereiding van adviese vir aanbieding aan Ministers, die Presidency, Kabinetsprosesse, intergouvernementele forums, MTEC, Budget Council en parlementêre betrekkinge oor openbare bestuursbeleid en begrotingshervormings, koste- en risiko-anise van openbare finansiewetgewing en beleidsvoorstelle en ontwerp van bestuursraamwerke en implementeringsplanne, en institusionele hervormingsinisiatiewe in die uitkomste-stelsel, prestasieooreenkomste, leweringsooreenkomste, en openbare-sektor moniteringstelsels op munisipale, provinsiale en nasionale vlak. Lei en begelei die voorbereiding van adviese en verskaf ondersteuning aan die NT DG en DDGs se Budget Group oor studies en verbeterings tot allocatiewe doeltreffendheid van Regeringsdoelwitte, sektore, beleide, programme en instellings, benaderings om begrotings- en openbare bestuursanalise-prosesse te verbeter om NT se strategiese rol te ondersteun, en gapings en ondoeltreffendhede in finansiële beleide en openbare finansiële bestuur. Lei en begelei die voorbereiding van adviese vir Ministers en departemente oor die doeltreffendheid, effektiwiteit en belyning van regeringsbesteding met nasionale prioriteite en oor areas van vermorsing, ondoeltreffendheid of wanbelyning om ingeligte besluite moontlik te maak wat die gebruik van openbare fondse optimeer. Projekte se bestuursbeheer en bestuur: Lei en begelei die instandhouding en deurlopende verbetering van die GTAC-projekbestuursraamwerk insluitend metodologieë, prosesse en kontroles, en opleidingsmateriaal en gidse. Bestuur die vestiging, ontwikkeling en instandhouding van die PFA-projekbestuursbeheerraamwerkstelsel, prosesse en kontroles, en opleidingsmateriaal en gidse. Lei en begelei die identifikasie en vestiging van multidissiplinêre samewerking oor praktykareas en GTAC-projekte wat geïntegreerde adviesondersteuning vereis, om gesamentlike QA-reëlings oor praktykareas te verseker. Lei en begelei maandelikse en kwartaal hersienings van tegniese en operasionele verslae oor praktykbestuur, tegniese koördinasie oor projekte, hulpbron- en vermoënoorwegings, tegniese risiko's en mitigasiemaatreëls, projekgehaltemonitering, en kruis-praktyk-integrasie. Bestuur die hersiening, verifikasie en goedkeuring van PFA-projekte se verslagdoening en dokumente insluitend die maandelikse PFA-projekte vorderingverslag, PFA-projekte se finansiële bestuursverslae, kwartaal PFA-projeklys en inligtingsverslae, en PFA-projekte se narratiewe verslae vir insluiting in die Ministersverslag. Lei en monitor die hersiening en oplossing van projekimplementeringprobleme insluitend leweringsknelpunte en tegniese risiko's, multidissiplinêre koördinasie-uitdagings, kruisnywende tegniese kwessies, en stelselmatige gehaltessorgsake en opkomende risiko's. Bestuur van professionele diensverskafferpaneel: Lei, begelei en monitor die verfrissing en instandhouding van die PFA-paneel vir professionele diensverskaffers insluitend die verkryging, kontraktering, aanboordbring, inleiding en deurlopende besigheidskennisontwikkeling van tegniese adviseurs. Lei, begelei en monitor die produktiwiteit en prestasie van PFA-tegniese adviseurs insluitend die hersiening van kontrakgebruik en prestasieverslae, die uitvoer van prestasie-hersienings, die aanpak van prestasiekwessies, die bevestiging van kontrakvoortsetting of -beëindiging, en die hersiening en ondertekening van kontraksluitingsverslae. PFA-projekte vestiging en bestuur: Lei en begelei die inisieering van PFA-projekte insluitend die verwerking van kliëntversoeke en ministeriële instruksies, bestuur van kliëntbetrekkinge en die hou van verkenning en omlydingsvergaderings. Bestuur die vestiging van PFA-projekte insluitend die ontwikkeling en voorbereiding van kliënt Memoranda of Agreements (MoAs), hersiening van konsepprojekhandveste en voorgestelde omvang, hulpbronvoorsiening en kosteberekening, en bevestiging van projekte en begrotings. Monitor en beheer die registrasie van projekte op die GTAC-meesterprojekregister, toekenning van projekte-nommers en kostesentrums, en oplaai van projekhandveste en kliënt-MoAs. Bestuur die toekenning van tegniese adviseurs insluitend die nagaan van rotasie, goedkeuring van instruksies om werk te verrig, registrasie van LTA-opdragte, en verwydering/Toevoeging van spanlede soos versoek. Bestuur die verkryging van projekhulpbronne insluitend die goedkeuring van terme van verwysing en memo/versoek om kwotasie, goedkeuring van bodbenoemingsbrief, bywoning van Bid Evaluation Committee-vergaderings soos nodig, nagaan van diensverskaffer se kontraklêer (kontrolelys, toekeningsmemo, konseptoekeningsbrief, en konsepkontrak) en ondertekening van kontrakte. Bestuur en goedkeur projekverlengings-/ wysigingsversoeke, insluitend voorbereiding van kontrakverwante motiverings en memo's, projekte terme van verwysing, en voorgestelde diskrete projekbegrotingsaanpassings. Projeklewering en gehalteversekering: Lei, begelei en hersien die vervaardiging en gehalteversekering van projekinsiepverslae insluitend projekwerkplanne, tegniese benaderings, bestuursbeheer, belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsplanne, en projekrisikobestuursplanne. Lei, monitor en bestuur die implementering en bestuur van projekte en nakoming van die projekhandvest en ooreenkomste insluitend projekomvang, lewerings, tydlyne, en begroting oor alle projeksiklusfases insluitend beplanning, implementering en post-evaluering. Bestuur PFA-kliëntverhoudinge en diensgehalte insluitend die reageer op kliëntnavrae, bywoning van projekvergaderings en verskaffing van advies soos benodig/vereis, oplossing van enige opkomende diensprobleme, en die uitvoer van PFA-kliënt. Lei, monitor en bestuur projekvorderinghersienings en gehalteversekering van projeklewerings, en identifikasie en oplossing van opkomende tegniese risiko's, uitdagings en gehaltessorgsake of eskalasie na die Hoof: GTAC-opnames. Monitor en verseker dat alle projekdokumente behoorlik gestoor, weergawebeheer en beskikbaar gestel word vir institusionele leer (insluitend verslae, aanbiedings, sigblaaie, navorsing, rekords, datastelle, modelle, sjablone en gereedskap). Projekbegrotingsbestuur, verslagdoening en sluiting: Hou toesig oor, verifieer en keur maandelikse projekbegrotings- en bestedingsverslae se bestuur en indiening goed. Bestuur die hersiening en goedkeuring van TA-tydrekords per projek/opdrag, TA elektroniese rekords, en TA-uitbetalings-eise. Hou toesig oor, keur goed en beheer projekreis, logistiek en reëlings en uitbetalings-eise, en tydstate, kontrakgebruik en faktureering. Hou toesig oor, begelei en beheer die sluiting van PFA-projekte insluitend die hersiening en goedkeuring van projeksluitingsverslae en opvolgvoorstelle en -aanbevelings, die evalueer van lesse-geleer-verslae, en die opdatering van projekriglyne soos relevant. Hou toesig oor, begelei en beheer die herstel van projekkoste insluitend die voorbereiding van voorleggings aan Finance en die hersiening, goedkeuring en monitering van kliëntfakture en betalings.

zu.title: Umphathi oMkhulu: Ukweluleka ngeMali Yomphakathi (PFA)
zu.summary: Okokuqala ukuletha izinsizakalo zokweluleka ngeMali Yomphakathi kwa-GTAC ePretoria, ukubuka ngaphezulu ukweluleka nokuletha izinhlelo kubantu abathola izinsizakazo ezinga la-SMS Level 14.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor’s Degree/ Advanced Diploma/ BTech degree (NQF 7) njengoba kuhlonishwa u-SAQA ku-Economics, Public Policy, Public Management noma enye indawo ephathelene nalokho. Iziqu ze-Postgraduate kanye ne-Master’s degree (NQF 8 and 9) ku-Economics, Public Policy, Public Public Management zizoba nomonde. 5 years of experience at a senior management level. Okungenani 10 - 12 years’ experience ukusebenza kunyumba kahulumeni kanye/noma endaweni yokweluleka. Kumele babe nolwazi olubanzi ngeMali Yomphakathi kanye nemisebenzi ye-Treasuries, ulwazi olubanzi ngemithetho yomphakathi, amakhono okukhuluma ahamba phambili, amakhono okuthuthukisa amapholisi, amakhono okuphatha izinhlelo. Kumele bakwazi ukuhlonza, hlaziya bese nikela izinkomba, amakhono amahle okuxazulula izinkinga kanye namakhono amahle okubhala ngwezamabhizinisi.
zu.duties: Ukuze kubukeke ngaphezulu kanye nokuhola ukunikezwa ngempumelelo nangobujulubunge kokweluleka ngeMali Yomphakathi nokweluleka izinsizakazo kubantu abathola izinsizakazo ukusekela umnqopho kanye nokuqondisa kwe-GTAC ngokuphatha uXhumo phakathi kwamakhasimba e-GTAC, ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zobuchwepheshe, ukuletha izinhlelo kanye nokuqhuba izinqubo zokuphatha. Ukuphatha ngokuyaqondisa kanye nokusebenza kwe-PFA: Ukubambe iqhaza futhi unikeze umnikelo ekulandelwa kwesu lokwakheka kwe-GTAC kanye nokuphatha ukubuyekeza, ukuthuthukisa, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqinisekisa ngokusukela esu lokusebenza le-PFA, isicwangciso sonyaka sokusebenza, isicwangciso esisebenzayo kanye nezinkomba zokusukeka. Ukuphatha impumelelo yezimali ye-PFA okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa, ukubuyekeza, futhi, uma kudingeka, ukulungisa i-PFA Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), isicwangciso sezimali, isheduli yokuhlanzwa, ingxoxo yokuqinisekisa kwangaphakathi ngenyaka, isheduli ye-Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE), kanye nengxoxo yokulungiswa. Ukuphatha ukuqinisekiswa kobuningi kanye nokulungisa izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza ze-PFA kanye nokuqhuba amabhizinisi. Ukuphatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ze-PFA kanye noma izivumelwano zelayisense, nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Ukuphatha isakhiwo se-PFA kanye negcwalisa izikhundla, ukwabelana nomsebenzi nokuthuthukisa izivumelwano zokusukeka, ukubuyekeza ukusukeka kanye nokuthuthukisa izicwangciso zokuthuthukiswa kokusukeka, ukuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nokunika isiqondiso. Ukubuka ukuphatha ukuqinisekiswa kwemibhalo ye-PFA, izinsiza zohhovisi kanye nesithiyetshi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhamba nokuqinisekiswa ukubuyiselwa imali. Ukuphatha ukulungiselela, ukubamba iqhaza/ukubusa, nokuqinisekisa ngemihlangano ephathelene nesu nokusebenza kwe-PFA okuhlanganisa ukwaziswa kukaNgqongqoshe, i-Executive Committee (EXCO) kanye nemihlangano ye-Management Committee (MANCO), imihlangano ye-Operational Management Meetings (OMM), imihlangano yeqembu le-PFA, kanye nemihlangano yokuvuselelwa i-Accounting Officer. Ukuphatha ukuqondiswa kwe-PFA okuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi kanye nemibhalo ye-PFA ihambisana nemigomo kanye nokulungele ukuhlotshwa, ukuthi u register wempahla ye-PFA uvuselelwe futhi ulungile, nokwenza ukubuyekeza ngokwemikhathi yenyanga noma ngokunyaka nokuvezwa komaphepha okuthwala ingozi ye-PFA kanye nengxoxo yokuqondiswa kwezingozi. Ukuxhumanisa ngqo nezindikimba, ubudlelwano namakhasimba, kanye noBudlelwano obuhle Bokuqondiswa: Ukumela i-GTAC, lapho kudingeka khona, ekuzibandakanyeni nasekuqwashweni phakathi kwengozi yezwe, i-NT kanye nensiwe, ukuxhumana nokubika ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nama calendar a umnyango kanye nesive. Ukuphatha ukukhiqwa kwangxoxo nemibhalo emihlanganweni yesive, kumafomu phakathi kahulumeni, kwamaqembu okusebenza ngobuchwepheshe, kanye nabalwelisinyathelo abanye abaphezulu. Ukusungula, ukwakha kanye nokugcina ukuxhumana okuqondiswe ne-National Treasury, izinkingi kahulumeni, izindikimba zomphakathi, umakhaya, kanye nabathuthukisi. Ukuphatha ukwakha kanye nokusungula ubudlelwano namakhasimba kanye nokwenza ucwaningo lokwaneliseka kwamakhasimba. Ukuphatha ukubandakanyeka ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinyumba kanye nokushintshiselana ulwazi. Ukuphatha nokunikeza amakhono ezinsizakazo e-PFA: Ukuhola, ukuletha ukulawula ukuthuthukiswa, ukuphatha, ukwakha ikhono nokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo izinsizakazo ze-PFA kanye namaphula wokuqinisekisa ubujulubunge kanye nama-guide ohambisanayo, ama-template, amathuluzi namaphula ekuhlola. Ukuphatha ukuhlola/isibalo sezinye izinsizakazo ezintsha zokweluleka kanye nobusizo ngobuchwepheshe, ukuthuthukisa/ukubuyekeza kanye nokugunyaza izinqumo zokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi noku landela iphulo, kanye nokumela nokuvezwa kwezinsizakazo ze-PFA. Ukuphatha, ukubuyekeza kanye nokuxazulula izinfluzo zokuqinisekiswa kobujulubunge ngokuphathelene nobungozi bezobuchwepheshe ngokuzenzakalelayo kuzo zonke izinhlelo, izinkinga ezinkulu ezitholwa ngesinqubo se-QA, kanye nezinkinga ezithi zibonakale ngobuchwepheshe noma eziqondiswayo. Ukuphatha ukuhlola nokuthuthukisa imikhiqizo yolwazi ye-PFA (ama-guide, izindlela, ama-toolkit) namaphefumbulu kuma-webinars e-GTAC nokuyavezwa ku-website ye-GTAC. Ukuphatha ukulungiselela ukweluleka ukuvezwa kuwo oNgqongqoshe, oMongameli, nasezinqumweni zeNkantolo, kumafomu phakathi kahulumeni, ku-MTEC, ku-Budget Council nasekuqashweni esive ngepholisi yokusebenzisa imali kahulumeni kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezimali kanye nokuqondiswa kwezimali, ukuqinisekiswa kobungozi kanye nenkomba yomthetho we-Mali Yomphakathi, kanye namapholisi abhiywe kanye nokulunga amapulasi: imimomo kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha, kanye nokuqalisa imizamo yokulungiswa kwezindikimba kusuyinhlelo yemvelaphi, izivumelwano zokusukeka, izivumelwano zokuwerha, kanye namaphula okuhlola umphakathi kumakhaya, esifundazweni, nakuzwelonke. Ukuphatha kanye nokuletha ukulungiselela ukweluleka nokunika isekela ku-NT DG kanye no-DDGs’ Budget Group ekucwaningweni nokuphuculeni ukusebenza okubalulekile ngezinhloso zikahulumeni, amaphesenti, amapholisi, izinhlelo nezikoleji, indlela yokuphucula izinqubo zokuqhola kwezimali zikahulumeni ukuze kwesekele indima ephilayo ye-NT, kanye namaphula ephule kanye nobudenge kumapholisi wezimali kanye nokuphatha imali yomphakathi. Ukuphatha kanye nokuletha ukulungiselela ukweluleka kuwo oNgqongqoshe kwezinkingeni ngempumelelo, ukusebenza kahle kanye nokuhambisana kokusebenzisa imali kahulumeni nangamaphojwe ezwe kanye nasezindaweni okuphetha, okungalungele noma okungahambisani ukuze banikeze izinqumo ezilungile ezizosebenzisa imali yomphakathi ngendlela efanele. Ukuqondiswa kokuphatha kanye nokulawula izinhlelo: Ukuhola kanye nokuletha ukugcina nokuphucula ngokwemikhuba ukuphatha amaphula we-GTAC okuhlanganisa izindlela, izinqubo kanye nokuqhathanisa, futhi ukhulule imali yokuziqeqesha nama-guide. Ukuphatha ukusungula, ukuthuthukisa, nokugcina amaphula wokuqondiswa kohlelo lwe-PFA, izinqubo kanye nokulawula, namaphula wokuqeqesha nama-guide. Ukuphatha kwaye ukuqondise ukuhlola ukubuyekeza ngeyinyanga nangenyanga ngokuyaqondisa, ukubuyekeza imibhalo ngobuchwepheshe nangokusebenza ngendlela yokuphatha ukwenziwa, ukuhlangana ngobuchwepheshe kuyo yonke imiphakathi, ukucatshangelwa izinsiza namandla, ubungozi ngobuchwepheshe kanye nezindlela zokunciphisa, ukuhlola ubujulubunge benhlelo, kanye nokuqondisa ukuxhumanisa phakathi kwemikhakha. Ukuphatha ukubuyekeza, ukuqinisekisa kwaye ukugunyaze ukubikiwe ngemibhalo kwezinhlelo ze-PFA okuhlanganisa ingxoxo evela kwinyanga nenyanga ngokusukeka kwezinhlelo ze-PFA, ingxoxo evela kumaphula ebhalwe ngokuphatha imali kwezinhlelo ze-PFA, nenguqubo yalolu hlu lwemibhalo ngezinhlelo ze-PFA, kanye nengxoxo engumumo wezinhlelo ze-PFA eqoqwelwe engxoxweni yeNgqongqoshe. Ukuphatha kwaye uqondise ukubuyekeza nokuxazulula izinkinga ezithinta ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo okuhlanganisa izinkinga zokuqhuba kanye nobungozi ngobuchwepheshe, izinkinga zokuqondisa phakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene, izinkinga ezidabula phakathi kwemikhakha ngobuchwepheshe, kanye nokuqinisekisa ubujulubunge obuvamile nobungozi obuhlayo. Ukuphatha ibhodi labathunywa abanikela izingxoxo zezezinkalo: Ukuphatha, ukuqondisa kwaye ubuke ukubuyiswa kanye nokugcina ibhodi yezinkonzo ezingamakhono e-PFA okuhlanganisa ukuthola impahla, ukwenza izinkontilaka, ukufakazisa, ukungena entwini, kanye nokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo ulwazi lobhizinisi lobusizo ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuphatha kwaye ubuke ukukhiqwa ukuphumelela nokusebenza kwe-PFA ngamababu ngezinsizakazo zikabuchwepheshe okuhlanganisa ukubuyekeza ukusetshenziswa kwezinkontilaka kanye nengxoxo yokusukeka, ukwenza ukubuyekeza ukusebenza, ukuxazulula izinkinga zokusebenza, ukuqinisekisa ukuqhubeeka noma ukuvalwa kwezinkontilaka, kwaye ukubuyekeze kwaye usayine ingxoxo yokubika ukuvalwa ngenkontilaka. Ukusungula nokuphatha izinhlelo ze-PFA: Ukuhola kwaye uqondise ukuqalisa kwezinhlelo ze-PFA okuhlanganisa ukuqhuba izicelo zamakhasimba nemiyalo kaNgqongqoshe, ukuphatha ukubamba iqhaza kwamakhasimba nokwenza imihlangano yokuuhlola kwaye uhlole. Ukuphatha ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo ze-PFA okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukisa nokulungiselela ama-Memoranda of Agreements (MoAs) ekhasimba, ukubuyekeza umyalelo ophephile wesu bese kuphakunywa ngokusungulwa, ukubeka abantu abazothumela imali nokusebenzisa imali, bese kuqinisekiswa amaphenya abantu abazosebenza emabhajethini. Ukubuka kwaye ulawule ukubhalisa izinhlelo kumaster project register we-GTAC, ukwabelana amanani wephulo kwaye udle amaphula, kanye nokulayisha iphulo nalawo ma-MoA. Ukuphatha ukubhalisa abasizi ngobuchwepheshe okuhlanganisa ukubuka ukujikelezwa, ukugunyaza imiyalo yokuqhuba umsebenzi, ukubhalisa izabelo ze-LTA, kanye nokususa/ukufaka amalunga ephula njengoba kuceliwe. Ukuphatha ukuthola abantu abazosiza emsebenzini okuhlanganisa ukugunyaza amagama nemibhalo futhi ufune kwesinye isikhathi ukuya emihlanganweni ye-Bid Evaluation Committee njengoba kudingeka, kanye nokubuka umphakela wegazi lenkontilaka (ishejuli, imvume eqoshiwe, inkinga evela emaphathini, kanye nolu lwazisiso olunamatshiswe kuyo, futhi usayine izinkontilaka. Ukuphatha kwaye uvume ukwandiswa/kulungiswa ukuceliwe kwephulo okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela imibhalo ebusa ngokunika inkontilaka, iphulo, kunye nokuqinisekiswa kwamaphojwe ahambisana nalokho. Ukuletha kwaye uqondise ukukhiqwa kubhalwe nokuhlola ukulunga kwegatsha lokuqala kwezinhlelo okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela ukusebenza kwephulo, izindlela zobuchwepheshe, ukuphatha, amaphula okuhambisana, kanye namaphula ephulwa ubungozi bephulo. Ukuhola, ukubuka kwaye ukuphatha ukusungulwa nokuphatha izinhlelo kanye nokuhambisana nekhadi lephulo kanye nezivumelwano okuhlanganisa inani, izinto eziletshwayo, isikhathi, kanye neshedi yonke lesikhathi kusukela ekwenziweni, kuqhubekela ekuphatheni kwezinhlelo bese kubuyekezekwa emva kokuhlolelwa. Ukuphatha ubudlelwano nezenzo zenzele kakhulu namakhasimba e-PFA okuhlanganisa ukuphendula imibuzo, ukubamba iqhaza emihlanganweni yesu kwaye nikela ulwazi njengoba kudingeka/kuqinisekwe, ukuxazulula noma iyiphi inkosi ephumayo yokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe, kwaye uqhube ucwaningo oluthinta ngqo namakhasimba we-PFA. Ukuphatha, ukubuka kwaye ukuphatha ukubuyekeza ukusukeka kwezinhlelo, ukubuyekeza kwezinsimbi, ukubukeka kwezinto ezinika isandla ekwenziweni, kanye nohlolo lwezinkinga eziphuma ngobuchwepheshe, ukujika, nokuhlola ubujulubunge, noma ukudlulisela eNkosini: ukwenza ucwaningo lwabantu be-GTAC. Ukubuka ukuze iqinisekiswe ukuthi lonke ulwazi lwamaphulo olusetshenzisiwe luyiyo, lunolawulo lwamapheshana, futhi lutholakala ukulolonga (okuhlanganisa nengxoxo, ukubukeka, okubhalwe ku-tibhodi, ukufunda, ulwazi oluyisibali, okubhalwe emapuleni, okuqhathaniswa, i-template namathuluzi). Ukuphatha imibhalo ibhalwe ngokusebenza, kwaye uze ubike ukubuyisa imali esebenziswe ekwenziweni kwephulo ngokwamaphulo: Ukubuka, ukuqinisekisa kwaye uvume ukubalwa imali yamaphulo ngemali kanye nokuvezwa kokwenza impumelelo. Ukuphatha ukubuyekeza kwaye uvume isikhathi esibhalwe abasizi abaningi ngamaphulo/nasemsebenzini, ukubhalwa kwemali kwabo basebenzela ukubhala, kwaye bazibhalele bona ngokubuyiswayo. Ukubuka, uvume kwaye ulawule ukuhamba kwemali, izinto kanye nokuqinisekiswa ezinhlelweni, kwaye imali ebuyiswayo, amaphepha esikhathi, ukusetshenziswa kwezinkontilaka, kwaye izinsiza ezibhalwe ngokwenza impumelelo ziqhube isidingo. Ukubuka kwaye uqondise ngolawulo lokuvaleka izinhlelo ze-PFA okuhlanganisa ukubuyekeza ukubhalwa ngokuphela nokubuyekeza nangokubika, nangemibuzo esekela kumaphoyisa ephulo ayibukela, kwaye uvuselele ngalokho okufundile. Ukubuka, uqondise kwaye ulawule ukubuyiswa imali yokwenza isu okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela ukulandiswa ekuMnyameni wezimali, nokubuyekeza, ukuvuma kanye nokubuka imali etholwa ngamakhasimba kwaye kufakwe emapuleni.

xh.title: Umongameli Ongenamthunywa: Iingcebiso zezeMali zikaRhulumente (PFA)
xh.summary: Qhuba iinkonzo zengcebiso zezeMali zikaRhulumente ze-GTAC ePretoria, ulawule ukunconelwa nokuhamba kwamaprojekthi kumacandelo axhamlayo kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 14.
xh.requirements: I-Degree yokuqala/ i-Advanced Diploma/ i-BTech degree (NQF 7) njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA kwi-Economics, i-Public Policy, i-Public Management okanye elinye icandelo elithathelelene nalo. Isiqinisekiso se-Postgraduate ne-Master's degree (NQF 8 and 9) kwi-Economics, i-Public Policy, i-Public Management siza kuba luncedo. Iminyaka yam-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo. Ubuncinane iminyaka engama-10 - 12 yamava ukusebenza kundlu kaRhulumente nakunokusebenza kwendawo yokunconelwa. Kufuneka ube nolwazi olubalulekileyo lwemali yorhulumente nemisebenzi ye-Treasuries, ulwazi olubalulekileyo lwe-mithetho yamakonzo karhulumente, amandla aphambili wokunxibelelana, amandla okuphuhliswa kweempolisa, namandla okulawula amaprojekthi. Kufuneka ube nokuqonda, ukwahlula nokwenza izindululo, amandla amabalugama yokuxazulula iingxaki, nokuqamba amagama abalugama emisebenzeni.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokukhokela ukubonelelwa okusebenzayo nangomgangatho iinkonzo zokunconelwa nengcebiso yezeMali karhulumente kumacandelo axhamlayo ngokuxhasa idyumbuakamandla nomgama we-GTAC ngokulawula uqhagamshelo phakathi kwezixhobo zamaxhoba ze-GTAC, iindlela ezisetyenziswa ukuzisa amakhono, ukuhamba kwamaprojekthi, neenkqubo zolawulo. Ulawulo oluyiluleko nolusebenzayo lwe-PFA: Thatha inxaxheba kwaye uncede ngokucwangciswa ngokuyiluleko kwe-GTAC ulawule ukuphonononga, ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenziswa, nokuchazwa ngomgama we-PFA, icebo lemveliso yomnyaka, icebo lokusebenza, neziqinisekiso zemveliso. Lawula imveliso yemali ye-PFA kuquka ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenziswa, ukuphonononga, kwaye ukuba kuyimfuneko, ulungiselelo lwe-PFA Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), icebo lokusebenza elibhekisiweyo kwixabiso, uluhlu lwemiyalezo, umbhalo wonyaka wokuqwalasela, i-Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE) schedule, nombhalo wolungiselelo. Lawula ukuqinisekiswa komgangatho nolungiselelo lweendlela zokusebenza ezisemgangathweni neenkqubo zeshishini ze-PFA. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kweekqubo ze-PFA nemvume yokusebenzisa amagama abalugama, nokuphucula ukusebenza. Lawula isakhiwo se-PFA nokuzalisa izithuba, ukwabelana komsebenzi nokuphuhliswa kweziqinisekiso zemveliso, ukuphonononga imveliso nokuphuhliswa kweeplani zokuphucula imveliso, ukuxazulula iingxaki, nokunika izikhokelo. Lawula ukulawula kwamagama abalugama o-PFA, amakhulo esixhobo, noluhlu lwemibhalo, kanjalo nokuqwalaselwa kweziyalezo zoburhulumente nokubuyiswa kwemali. Lawula ulungiselelo loku-, ukuthabatha inxaxheba/ukuba nguSihlalo, nokuchaza ngokumanyano lweyiluleko nakusebenzayo kwe-PFA okubandakanya izaziso kwiNkumbulo, ipali yurhulumente, ngabaphathi i-Executive Committee (EXCO) nepali yomanyano i-Management Committee (MANCO) meetings, i-Operational Management Meetings (OMM) meetings, iinkqubo zePFA phakathi kwethimba, nokuqwalaselwa ngemibuzo ye-Accounting Officer. Lawula urhulumente wePFA kuquka ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkcazelo kunye namagama abalugama o-PFA ziyahambelana nolungile ngokwakhangcolwa, uluhlu lwempahla ye-PFA luhlaziywe kwaye lilungile, kanjalo nokwenza ukuqwalasela kwaxeshanga kunyaka wonyaka nokuhlaziya uluhlu lwengozi ze-PFA nombhalo wokulawula iingozi. Unxibelelwano lwabanyweni nabaXhoba kwaye uQhagamshelwano ngokuyiluleko: Mela i-GTAC, apho kufuneka khona, kwindibano yamaKhomannda, i-NT nakwiPalamente, uqhagamshelwano nokunxibelelana kuqinisekisa ukuhambelana nekhaleda yesebe nakweyasePalamente. Lawula ukuphuhliswa kwemibhalo namagama abalugama angaweKomiti yePalamente, amagumbi welawulo phakathi karhulumente, amaqela abasebenzi ngokobugcisa, nakunye ngxoxo ezingangeni kwinqanaba eliphezulu. Misela, yakha, ugcine amaqhagamshelwano oyiluleko ne-National Treasury, amasebe karhulumente, izikhulu zorhulumente, iindawo zolawulo zengingqi, kunye nabaxhasi bokuphuhliswa. Lawula ukwakhiwa nokumiselwa kweqhagamshelwano namaxhoba, nokwenza uphando ngokwaneliseka kwexhoba. Lawula ukuthathwa kwexhaba kulungelelaniso phakathi kwamasebe, nokutshintsha kolwazi nokwabelana ngako. Iinkonzo ze-PFA nokulawula nokukhuthaza iimveliso zolwazi: Khokela, khokela ulawulo, ukuphuhliswa, ukulawula, ukwakha amandla, nokuphucula ngokoluvo iinkonzo ze-PFA kwaye uqinisekise iikhrwesimithi zomgangatho, iincwadana ezinxulumeneyo, iitempleyiti, izixhobo, neenkqubo zokuqwalasela. Lawula ukuqapha/ukubona amathuba amatsha engcebiso nokuncedwa ngobugcisa, ukuphuhliswa/ukuphonononga nokuvunywa kwezindululo zokuphuhliswa kweshishini namagama abalugama okukhangela amaprojekthi, ukubekwa ngokuyiluleko nokushicilelwa kweekonzo ze-PFA. Lawula, phonononga uzalise iziphumo zokuqinisekiswa komgangatho ngokuhamba kwamaxhoba, ingxaki enkulu yomgangatho efunyanwe ngeenkqubo ze-QA, neengxaki ezintsha zobugcisa okanye ezoyiluleko. Lawula ukuqapha nokuphuhliswa kweemveliso zolwazi ze-PFA (iincwadi zokukhokela, iindlela ezisebenzayo, iithulethi zemigangatho) nezipresentheshi zegumbi le-GTAC webinars nakushicilelwa kwindawo yonke i-GTAC website. Lawula ulungiselelo lweekhankhulisiwo zokuqulunqa kubukiwe kuNzimamabinzisa, iNkundla yoLungelelaniso lweZiko, iinkqubo zeKhabhinethi, amagumbi wolawulo phakathi karhulumente, iMTEC, uRhulumente wokuGqiba ngoMthimba kunye nendibano yasePalamente ngomgama wemali yorhulumente nakulungiselelo lwesini, ukwahlula iingozi nolungiselelo lomthetho weemali karhulumente kwaye usindulule imigangatho yolawulo neenkqubo ezizuzisayo zoyilo wakhe, iinkqubo zoqhagamshelwano lwasemizini yombuso owenziwa kwinkqubo yokuqwalasela, isini sokubonelelwa ngemali, ukubonelelwa ngokuyiluleko ngemigaqo, ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo zolawulo kwaye zolungelelaniso, nokuqulunqa iinkqubo zokuziphendulela ezikumgaqo-siseko woburhulumente nasekuhlaziyweni kweziko kwindlela ezingaveliswa ngayo iziphumo, iinkqubo zolungelelaniso ezingamanzi, iinkqubo zokubonelelwa, kwaye iinkqubo zokuqwalasela zorhulumente kwizinga lomasipala, lommandla nakolawulo. Qhuba khokela ulungiselelo lweekhankhulisiwo zeNjineli yasepalamente neZiko labaPhathi beBhajeti kubafundi nokuphucula ukuhamba ngokwemigaqo yohambo lweRhulume, ngokulungelelaniswa kolunye uhlolojio lwemigangatho eyahlukeneyo yamagatya, ngendlela zokuphucula iinkqubo zokuqonda nokwahlula imali yorhulumente neendlela ezizuzisayo ezixhasa iNdima ethile yolawulo lwe-NT, nasekuboniseni iindawo ezithathu ngokuthuthuza iimpolisa zamandla noburhulumente. Khokela phakathi nje ngemibuzo yeNjineli yesebe ezilungiselelwe kuKhwankqisela nokunxibelelana ngakumbi olusuka ePalamente, iiNkosi, uRhululeli wengingqi kunye noMthunywa weMbande, isakhono esilawulwayo sokuphunga iindleko ezingalunganga, noxanduva loyilo lweendlela ezilawulayo ezikwazi ukubonelela ngoncedo mayelana nophuhliso ngokulungelelaniswa kwemali yorhulumente ngokuhamba kwemigangatho yolawulo ekhoyo. Ulawulo lwamaprojekthi: Qhuba, khokela ukulondoloza nokuphucula ngokuqhubeka inkqubo yokulawula amaprojekthi i-GTAC equlunqe iindlela ezahlukeneyo, iinkqubo, iindlela zokuqinisekisa uxanduva, iincwadi zokuhamba kwamagama, neencwadi zokukhokela. Lawula ukumiselwa, ukuphuhliswa nokulondolozele inkqubo yoyiluleko lwe-PFA ekulawulweni, iinkqubo, namagama abalugama, iincwadi zokuhamba nokuqinisekisa amagama. Qhuba khokela ukubonisiswa nokumiselwa kobudlelwane phakathi kweminye imimandla yamaphupha namaprojekthi a-GTAC efuneka kwoyiluleko olubandakanyiweyo, kuqinisekisa oluhlangeneyo kulwabiwo lwe-QA phakathi kwemimandla yamaphupha. Qhuba khokela ukuphonononga kwamanye iinyanga naxeshanga ngemibhalo yobugcisa nolusebenzayo ngokulawula ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi, ukulawulwa ngokubumbana kwamaprojekthi, iingcamu namakhono, iingozi zobugcisa nemigangatho yokuqwalasela nokulawula, ukuqwalasela ngomgangatho weprojekthi, nokudityaniswa ngokwemigaqo. Lawula ukuphonononga, ukuqinisekisa nokuvuma iimveliso zamaprojekthi neemibhalo e-PFA eguquguqulelwa njalo ngenyanga kwindima yokuhamba kwamaprojekthi e-PFA, iimibhalo yemali yamaprojekthi i-PFA, uluhlu lwamaprojekthi ngenyanga yamakhwerhwerha neemibhalo yamaprojekthi, neemibhalo echazayo yamaprojekthi i-PFA ezongezwa kuMthunywa oRhungileyo eMbandeni. Qhuba ulawule ukuphonononga nokuxazulula iingxaki ezikhoyo kwinkqubo yamaprojekthi aquka iintlobo zokuhamba nemingeni yamathambo, iingozi zobugcisa, ukungabinakho kolungelelaniswa ekubudlelwaneni obungenasiseko, iingxaki zobugcisa ezingadityaniyo, neengxaki ezibangelwa kukungabikho komgangatho weendalo ezingaqediyo, kwaye zibangelwa yimicimbi ehlwayo ithi ngamanye amaxesha ihlale ixakekile. Ulawulo lwePhanele yabaSebenzi ngeNkonz'ebugcisa: Khokela, khokela ulawulo lokulunga nokugcina uxhaxhe lweenkonz'ezahlukeneyo zobugcisa eziphakathi kwamagunya i-PFA aquka ukuthenga, ukusayina konwabe, ukungenisa kwindawo yomsebenzi, ukulungiselela, nolwazi lwashishini oluqhubelekayo kubakeli bobugcisa. Khokela, khokela ulawulo ngokomsebenzi namandla abakeli bobugcisa be-PFA aquka ukuphonononga isiseko somthwalo wekhontrakthi nezipho zobudlululo bomsebenzi, ukwenza ukuqwalasela kokusebenza, ukubeka iingxaki ezingekayo ngokusebenza, ukuqinisekisa ukuqhubekeka okanye ukupheliswa kolwabiwo, nokuphonononga nokusayina iimibhalo yokuvalwa koshishino. Iinkqubo zamaprojekthi i-PFA nokulawulo kwazo: Qhuba khokela ukuqalisa kwamaprojekthi i-PFA aquka ukulungelelanisa izicelo zabaxhoba nemiyalezo yezaziso, ukulawula iindibano namaxhoba, nokuqulunqa iindibano zokuqonda ngokusetyenziswa kolwimi nakumgangatho. Lawula ukumiselwa kwezikhundla ze-PFA ngemibhalo kubaxhoba ekuqinisekisa ukuvumelana nemithetho ekhoyo kwiinkqubo ekuxoxwa ngayo, ukuphonononga iiprojekthi ezisandula kumiselo kunye nendawo efunwa ngumsebenzi, imigaqo efunwa ngakumbi, ukubonelelwa ngemali, ukuqinisekisa iithimba zamaprojekthi namabhajethi. Qwalasela ulawula ukubhaliswa kwamaprojekthi kwinkqubo enkulu ye-GTAC yokubhalisa amaprojekthi, ukwaba iinombolo zamaprojekthi namaziko ezixhobo, nokuvezwa koluhlu lokuhamba okubalulekileyo lokwakha iiprojekthi. Lawula uluhlu lwezikhundla ezahlukeneyo zabakeli bobugcisa, kuqwalasela intshukumo ekhethwa ngakumbi ngumsebenzi, ukuvumela imiyalelo yokubonelela ngamanye amathuba ngokubonelela ngolwazi, ukubhalisa kwamagunya azakuziwa ngokukhankanywa kwamanye amathuba, nokuvela kwamanye amava ngokuhamba kwamagunya. Lawula ukuthengwa kolwazi ngezinto ezahlukeneyo ngemiprojekthi, kuquka ukuvumela ukusetyenziswa kwezindululo nemiqulu kweekhonthule ngokumisela ixabiso ekuzakusebenza ngalo, ukuvumela iimvume ezahlukeneyo ngokusetyenziswa kweqhina labakeli ngokuxhomekeke ekunikelweni, ukungena kwiKomiti yokuphonononga amakhontrakthi ukuya akhethwe amanye amava ngokufunwa kakhulu, ukuqhathanisa isiseko ngemali sabasebenzi kushishino, (uluhlu lwemigangatho, umqulu okhethwa ngayo ixabiso, incwadi yokuzibekela ngomvuzo olungileyo, kunye nekhontrakthi ebandakanywe kushishino), ukusayina amakhontrakthi. Lawula ukuba uvume okanye ulawule ukugqithiswa/okulungiselelwa ukuba ngaphezulu okanye ngaphantsi koluhlu lolunye lukhetho, nokuquka ukulungiselelwa ngokusebenzisa iimvisi ezingahoyekiyo nekhontrakthi efunwa ukuba ngaphantsi kwemigaqo yolawulo namakhontrakthi abe nexabiso elifunwa ngokuthengiswa kwamanye amakhwerha eprojekthi. Ukuhamba kwamaprojekthi nokuQinisekiswa koBukhulu bukaMsebenzi: Qhuba khokela ukuphonononga nomgangatho weemibhalo yeemveliso ezisuka kumva wamaprojekthi aquka ukwakhiwa kwamagama ngeeplani zamaprojekthi, ukuziphatha ngemigangatho, ukuqinisekiswa kwamakhulu amaxhoba, iindlela zokubakela abaxhoba, kunye neeplani zokulawula iingozi zamaprojekthi. Qhuba, qwalasela ulawula ukuphuhliswa nokulawulwa kwamaprojekthi kwaye uvumele ukusebenza ngokomgomo kunye nokuqinisekiswa koluhlu lokuqwalasela, okubandakanya ukubakelwa kolunye uhlolojio nolonikezelo lomsebenzi okuzuzisa uluntu, ukuhamba ngokweendlela ezilawulwa nguSihlalo, nokuphuhliswa kokuhamba okuhambelana nobudlelwane kolunye ixesha. Lawula ukubakelwa kolunye uhlolojio lolunikezelo lolunye ukuziphatha ngokusuka kwiziphumo ezahlukeneyo zokubonelela ngolwazi olubalulekileyo, ukubakela abakeli, ukuphendula nawuphi na umbuzo ongavela ngomsebenzi olinganga ndlela, kunye nokuqwalasela imibuzo ngemisebenzi elungele ukuqwalaselwa. Qhuba, qwalasela ukulawula ukuhamba kwamaprojekthi ngokuqinisekiswa komgangatho weemibhalo eveliswa nakuqwalaselwa kweemiba eqhuba phakathi kwexesha elidlulayo, ekuboniseni nokuxazulula iingxaki ezintsha ezifunwa kubugcisa nokuphucula umgangatho ngokuyiluleko okanye ngokubakela iNkosi yoBukhosi: ngeziphulo zokukhangela i-GTAC. Qwalasela ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iincwadi zamaprojekthi zihlale zigcinwe, zilawulwe, kwaye zenzeke isigqebhemukhondo sezo kufundo ezithile kwiziko (ukuquka iimibalelo nokuqulunqa iinkcukacha, iisireditsi, okuqhagamshelwaneni, iindawo zokuphonononga, imibhalo, amaxhaxha eeyure nabakeli, ukusebenzisa amakhosi ezinto ezikumgama wobugcisa). Ulawulo lweBajethi yeprojekthi, ukuchaza nokubakela: Lawula, uqinisekise kwaye uvume ukuba uhamba njalo ngenyanga kwamakhontrakthi ephakathi kwentsimbi yexabiso, iimali ezidityaniswe ngokomsebenzi nokuphuhliswa nokuqhutywa kolunye ukubonelelwa. Lawula ukuphonononga nokuvumwa kwamaxabiso akhoyo kwiithoshi ezahlukeneyo ze-Master's Degree nakwinkqubo yokubonelela ngomsebenzi onikwe iimvume, ii-tha Kunye nolunye ukuchaza imibuzo ngexesha elifunwa ngexabiso elifunwa kwizinto ezahlukeneyo ekuyimfuneko ukuzisebenzisa. Lawula ukubonelela ngomsebenzi, ukugqibelela ngokuyiliko, nomzobo wokuhamba okuhambelana nokulungelelanisa ukubonelela ngakumbi amanye amava, nokumisela okuqhutywa nguMntu oRhungileyo weBhajethi: i-GTAC okanye ukumiswa kolunye ukubonelela ngamakhontrakthi ngokubakela amaxesha amaninzi awalungelelanisa iinkqubo zeemfuno zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Lawula, khokela nokulawula ukuvalwa kwamaprojekthi i-PFA kuqulunqa ukubakela nokuvumelwa nokuqwalaselwa ngemibalelo yokuvala amanye amakhontrakthi anengxaki apho angaqondwa ukuba ngowaphi na urhulumente ongachazanga, ukubakela isigqebhemukhondo, nokulunga iimibalelo emva kokuthatha iinkqubo ezize ngokutsha. Lawula, khokela nokulawula ukubuyiswa kwemali esebenziswa kwindlela yokugqibela kwamakhontrakthi angenisa ngokulunga iimali ezahlukeneyo eziguqulwayo, nokubakela iifom okuxhomekeke kuko ukubonelela ngokuyiliko.

jobs.title: Director-general
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R2 446 749 per annum (Level 16), (all-inclusive remuneration package), comprising of basic salary (70% of package), employer’s contribution to Government Employee Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion. A non-pensionable allowance equal to 10% of the annual all-inclusive remuneration package is payable.
jobs.summary: Director-general sought to lead the Department of Higher Education and Training, requiring postgraduate qualifications and ten years of senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: A senior certificate, an undergraduate qualification and a postgraduate qualification (NQF Level 8) in Business Administration/Public Management or any other related qualification as recognized by SAQA. Possession of a doctoral degree will be a distinct advantage. A relevant senior executive management and leadership certificate will be an added advantage. Ten (10) years of experience at senior managerial level. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed as endorsed by NSG. Knowledge of the Post-Schooling Education and Training system as a whole; Knowledge of the Constitution, Public Service Act (PSA) and Regulations, Public Management Act, 2014 (PAMA), Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) (1999 and Regulations, and any other relevant prescript within the system of government. An understanding of the emerging Higher Education, Science and Innovation (HESI) landscape. Solid working knowledge of the following: White Paper on PSET; University Education, Skill Development; Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Community Education and Training (CET) legislation and policies; National Development Plan (NDP); Government Programme of Action; and the Human Resource Development Council Strategy. Advanced knowledge and experience in Public Administration and Public Management; Knowledge of the Auditor-General’s Audit Framework; Extensive experience in leading and managing a large- scale, complex organisation or program is an added advantage; Extensive knowledge and experience in policy research, policy analysis and policy development; A proven track record in conducting monitoring, evaluation and impact assessments; Advanced knowledge in government’s Human Resource Management and Labour related legislation. Advanced experience in establishing and managing complex relationships and partnerships. Computer literacy. Core Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership, solid understanding of the political-administrative interface; Programme and Project management, advanced financial skills, Change management, People Management and Empowerment. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will, as the Head of Department, plan, implement, coordinate and communicate the Departmental vision, values, policies, statutory and strategic frameworks in terms of the relevant legislation and advise the Minister in determining policy, strategy, norms and standards as required by the Constitution and all relevant statuses; provide strategic direction to intergovernmental relations, stakeholder support and management of post-school education and training partner institutions and public entities in line with national policy, strategy, norms and standards; provide strategic leadership in monitoring and evaluating policy, governance, risk and compliance in order to achieve planned outcomes and impact for equitable access to, success of and institutional quality of the post-school education and training system, and report on the departmental performance to the Minister and other oversight structures including the Audit and Risk Committee, Parliament, National Treasury, Departments of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) and Performance Monitoring and Evaluation (DPME). The successful candidate will participate in and represent the Department in Governance and Administration structures including the committee for Directors-General (FOSAD) and any other structure as directed by the Minister. As the Accounting Officer, the successful candidate will, in terms of the PFMA, ensure that the department has and maintains effective, efficient and transparent systems of financial and risk management and internal controls, as well as ensure the efficient, economical and transparent use of the resources of the department; be responsible for the management, including the safeguarding and maintenance of the assets and liabilities, keep full and proper records of the financial affairs of the department and prepare annual financial statements; ensure the administration, implementation and documentation of international instruments relevant to the mandate and work of the Department. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply
jobs.notes: follow the easy prompts/instructions. Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit:   https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. “DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representatives in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation”. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements

af.title: Direkteur-generaal
af.summary: Direkteur-generaal gesoek om die Departement of Higher Education and Training te lei, met die vereiste van nagraadse kwalifikasies en tien jaar se bestuurservaring op senior vlak.
af.requirements: 'n Seniorsertifikaat, 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie en 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Level 8) in Business Administration/Public Management of enige ander verwante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Besit van 'n doktorsgraad sal 'n duidelike voordeel wees. 'n Relevante sertifikaat in senior uitvoerende bestuur en leierskap sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Tien (10) jaar se ervaring op senior bestuursvlak. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed soos deur NSG onderskryf. Kennis van die Post-Schooling Education and Training-stelsel as geheel; Kennis van die Constitution, Public Service Act (PSA) and Regulations, Public Management Act, 2014 (PAMA), Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) (1999 and Regulations, en enige ander relevante voorskrif binne die regeringstelsel. 'n Begrip van die ontluikende Higher Education, Science and Innovation (HESI)-landskap. Deeglike werkende kennis van die volgende: White Paper on PSET; University Education, Skill Development; Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Community Education and Training (CET)-wetgewing en -beleid; National Development Plan (NDP); Government Programme of Action; en die Human Resource Development Council Strategy. Gevorderde kennis en ervaring in Public Administration and Public Management; Kennis van die Auditor-General's Audit Framework; Uitgebreide ervaring in die leiding en bestuur van 'n grootskaalse, komplekse organisasie of program is 'n bykomende voordeel; Uitgebreide kennis en ervaring in beleidsnavorsing, beleidsontleding en beleidsontwikkeling; 'n Bewese rekord in die uitvoer van monitering, evaluering en impak assessments; Gevorderde kennis van die regering se Human Resource Management and Labour-verwante wetgewing. Gevorderde ervaring in die vestiging en bestuur van komplekse verhoudings en vennootskappe. Rekenvaardigheid. Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, deeglike begrip van die politiek-administratiewe koppelvlak; Programme and Project management, gevorderde finansiële vaardighede, Change management, People Management and Empowerment. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal, as die Hoof van Department, die departementele visie, waardes, beleid, statutêre en strategiese raamwerke beplan, implementeer, koördineer en kommunikeer ooreenkomstig die relevante wetgewing en die Minister adviseer by die bepaling van beleid, strategie, norme en standaarde soos vereis deur die Constitution en alle relevante statute; strategiese rigting verskaf aan intergovernmental relations, belanghebbende ondersteuning en bestuur van post-school education and training-partnerinstellings en openbare entiteite in ooreenstemming met nasionale beleid, strategie, norme en standaarde; strategiese leierskap verskaf by die monitering en evaluering van beleid, bestuur, risiko en nakoming om beplande uitkomste en impak vir billike toegang tot, sukses van en instellingsgehalte van die post-school education and training-stelsel te bereik, en oor departementele prestasie rapporteer aan die Minister en ander toesigstrukture insluitend die Audit and Risk Committee, Parliament, National Treasury, Departments of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) en Performance Monitoring and Evaluation (DPME). Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal deelneem aan en die Departement verteenwoordig in Governance and Administration-strukture insluitend die committee for Directors-General (FOSAD) en enige ander struktuur soos deur die Minister aangewys. As die Accounting Officer sal die suksesvolle kandidaat, ooreenkomstig die PFMA, verseker dat die departement effektiewe, doeltreffende en deursigtige stelsels van finansiële en risikobestuur en interne kontroles het en behou, asook die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en deursigtige gebruik van die departement se hulpbronne verseker; verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur, insluitend die bewaking en onderhoud van die bates en laste, volledige en behoorlike rekords van die finansiële sake van die departement hou en jaarlikse finansiële state voorberei; verseker die administrasie, implementering en dokumentering van internasionale instrumente relevant tot die mandaat en werk van die Departement. N.B. Alle gekortelysde kandidate sal vereis word om 'n relevante bevoegdheidoefening te voltooi.

zu.title: Umongameli-jikelele
zu.summary: Kufunwa umongameli-jikelele ozokuba nguhola kwa Department of Higher Education and Training, ofuna izifundo ezinenhla kweziqu kanye neminyaka yishumi yemvelo kokuphathwa esiphakeme.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esiphakeme, iziqu ezingezona ezingezansi kanye neziqu ezingenhla kweziqu (NQF Level 8) ku-Business Administration/Public Management noma nanoma yisiphi esinye isifundo esihlobene njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukuba nedigri yenqondo kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Isitifikedi esihlobene sokuphathwa esiphakeme kwezobakhokheli nesiphathamazwi kuzoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Iminyaka yishumi (10) yemvelo ezingeni eliphakeme lokuphathwa. Ukuphothula ngempumelelo i-Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed njengokuvunyiwe yi-NSG. Ulwazi ngesistimu yezemfundo nokuqeqeshwa ngemva kwesikolele yenke; Ulwazi ngo-Constitution, Public Service Act (PSA) kanye neziyalezo, Public Management Act, 2014 (PAMA), Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) (1999) kanye neziyalezo, kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye iziyalezo ezihlobene ngaphakathi kwesistimu kahulumeni. Ukuqonda umhlaba we-emerging Higher Education, Science and Innovation (HESI). Ulwazi oluzinzile lokusebenza ngalokhu okulandelayo: White Paper on PSET; University Education, Skill Development; Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Community Education and Training (CET) legislation and policies; National Development Plan (NDP); Government Programme of Action; kanye ne-Human Resource Development Council Strategy. Ulwazi oluthuthukile nemvelo ku-Public Administration kanye ne-Public Management; Ulwazi nge-Auditor-General's Audit Framework; Imvelo eningi ekubeni uhola futhi uphathe inhlangano noma uhlelo olukhulu oludidayo kuyinzuzo eyengeziwe; Ulwazi oluningi nesphephandlu ngemigomo, ukuhlaziya imigomo kanye nokuthuthukisa imigomo; I-record etholakalayo ekwenzeni ukuqapha, ukuhlola kanye ne-impact assessments; Ulwazi oluthuthukile ku-government's Human Resource Management kanye nemithetho ehlonyenwe nolunye; Imvelo ethuthukile ekusekeleni nasekuphatheni ubudlelwano obudidayo kanye namaphathi. Ukubhalisele ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha. Amandla abalulekile: Amandla kanye nobuholi obuhleliwe, ukuqonda okuzinzile kobudlelwano phakathi kwezombusazo nobokuphathwa; Ukuphathwa kwahlelo lamaprojekthi, amandla ezezimali athuthukile, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukuphathwa kwabantu nokunika amandla. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Umphakanyekhi ophumelelayo uzobe njengenhloko yomnyango, ehlela, iphumeza, ihlele futhi yethule inkomasi, amagugu, imigomo, izakhiwo eziyimithetho nangamazinga aphakeme komnyango ngokomthetho ohlobene futhi welule umphathi ekuqumeni imigomo, izindlela, amaphuzu namazinga njengoba kudingwa yi-Constitution kanye nanoma yimuphi umthetho ohlobene; ukunikeza isiqondiso esiphezulu ezindabeni zohlelo lolawulo lwaphakathi kuhulumeni, ukusekela iziphatamandla kanye nokuphathwa kwezikhungo ezingamaphathi zemfundo nokuqeqeshwa ngemva kwesikolele kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi ngokwezindlela ezisemthethweni, imigomo, amaphuzu namazinga kazwelonke; ukunikeza ubuholi ekuqapheni nokuholisisa imigomo, ukuphathwa, ingozi kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho ukuze kufezeke okuhlosiwe kanye nesiphumo sokufinyelela okulinganayo, ekuwphumeleleni nasenhlalweni yezikhungo zezemfundo nokuqeqeshwa ngemva kwesikolele, futhi abeke ngokomnyango ukuthi usebenza njani kumphathi kanye namanye amakomidi okuqapha okuhlanganisa i-Audit and Risk Committee, Parliament, National Treasury, Departments of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) kanye ne-Performance Monitoring and Evaluation (DPME). Umphakanyekhi ophumelelayo uzobe ngomunye futhi amele umnyango kumakomidi okuphathwa nokuqaphwa okuhlanganisa ikomiti lebo mongameli-jikelele (FOSAD) nanoma yiliphi elinye isakhiwo njengoba ethwaumphathi. Njengenhloko yezimali, umphakanyekhi ophumelelayo uzobe ngokwe-PFMA, siqinisekisa ukuthi umnyango unogcina futhi unezinsiza ezisebenza, ezihlakaniphile nezibonakalayo zokuphathwa kwezimali nangozi ezilawula ngaphakathi, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza okuhlakaniphile, okugcinwa kakhulu nezibonakalayo sezinsiza zomnyango; uzobe uyibe nomthwalo wekhanda ukuphathwa, okuhlanganisa ukugcina futhi ukulondoloza izimpahla, amafutha nokubhaliswa okuphelele kwezimali zomnyango futhi alungise izitatimende zezimali zonyaka zonke; qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukuphumeza nokubhala ngokomthetho izinsiza zamazwe ngamazwe eziyimithetho ezihlobene nemandla kanye nomsebenzi womnyango. Qaphela. Bonke abaphakanyekhi abakushiwe kuhlu bazodingeka ukuba bagcwalise isenzo esihlobene namandla.

xh.title: UMongameli-jikelele
xh.summary: Kufuneki kutsatywe uMongameli-jikelele onokuzisa ibambekelo kwisebe le-Department of Higher Education and Training, ngefuna izifundo zangaphezu kwe-degree kwaye anamashumi eminyaka yamava kwelona nqanaba liphezulu lobuqhankqalaza.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samatyuju, izifundo ze-undergraduate kunye ne-postgraduate (NQF Level 8) kwi-Business Administration/Public Management okanye naziphi na ezinye izifundo ezinxulumene nayo njengoko zaziwa yi-SAQA. Ukuba ngedigri yedoctora kuya kuba ngumphumo omhle kakhulu. Ukuba ngesatifikethi esinxulumene nokuba ngumqhankqalazi oyintloko phezulu kolawulo nolawuleka kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Amashumi (10) eminyaka yamava kwelona nqanaba liphezulu lolawulo. Ukuphumelela ukugqiba i-Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed njengoko ixhaswa yi-NSG. Ulwazi ngokuziisonjalo se-Post-Schooling Education and Training yonke; Ulwazi ngoMgaqo-siseko, i-Public Service Act (PSA) kunye noMthetho weRhetjikulayo, uMthetho woLawulo kaRhulumente, 2014 (PAMA), uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA) ka-1999 noMthetho weRhetjikulayo, nakuziphi na ezinye imigaqo ephakathi kwephakamiso ligama lolawulo karhulumente. Ukuqonda ngohlaziyo lwe-Higher Education, Science and Innovation (HESI). Ulwazi olunyani lokusebenza ngokulandelayo: i-White Paper on PSET; i-University Education, i-Skill Development; i-Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Community Education and Training (CET) ngokwemigaqo-nethetho; i-National Development Plan (NDP); i-Government Programme of Action; kunye ne-Human Resource Development Council Strategy. Ulwazi oluphezulu kwaye namava kwi-Public Administration nakuLawulo kaRhulumente; Ulwazi nge-Audit Framework ka-Auditor-General; Amava amaninzi ekokuzeni nokolawula i-organisation okukhulu okanye inkqubo inkqubo yonke kusazo olwenzelelwayo; Ulwazi namava amaninzi kwipolisi yokuphand, nokuhlalutywa nokuyilwa kweempolisa; Isalathiso esibonakalayo sokwenza ulwazi lokujonga, ukuhlalutywa nokulinganisa ingqiqo; Ulwazi oluphezulu kokuLawulwa koBuntu boluRhulumente nakoMthetho onxulumene nomsebenzi. Amava amakhulu ekusekweni nasekulawulweni kweziqu ezikhwakhwazileyo zobudlelwane noko busebenzisana. Ukuba ngumntu oqonda iikhompyutha. Iimpawu eziyimfuneko eziphakathi kwengqondo: Ikhowudi yokuziphatha ekuzimisela kwaye kuba ngumkhoki, ukuqonda okuziisonjalo koludwe ngokwendyikityha-politiko yolawulo; uLawulo loMceli-manyano noLawulo lweziNgqungqutha, izakhono ezibalaseleyo zeemali, uLawulo oluTshintshayo, uLawulo loBuntu nokuBusa. Ilayisensi yokushayela ekusemthethweni.
xh.duties: Umphakathiweyo, njengentloko yesebe, uya kucwangcisa, ukuyisebenzisa, ukulungelelanisa nokusasaza iimbono zesebe, amaxabiso, iimpolisa, iinkqubo zomthetho nezicwangciso ngokwemigaqo-nethetho efanelekileyo wacebiswa kuNgangezikhondo kwinkqubo yokumisela iimpolisa, iindlela zokuqonda, imigangatho nemithelela njengoko kufunwa nguMgaqo-siseko naziphi na ezinye iinkqubo ezinxulumene nayo; ukunika isikhokelo esicwangcisiweyo kuludwe lolwabanye abarhulumente, ukuxhasaabanomdla nokulawula iziko ezikwimfundo zangemva kwesikolo zokuthuthuzela nokuqeqesha nezinye i-entities zabaphakathi njengoko kukhankanyiwe kwinkqubo karhulumente, iindlela ezicwangcisiweyo, imigangatho nemithelela; ukunikela isikhokelo ngenkqubo yokujonga nokuqonda iimpolisa, urhulumente, ingozi nokuzithwala ngokweenjongo zokufezekisa iziphumo ezicwangcisiweyo nemithelela ngokulingana kwangangonke ekufikeleleni, ekuhenyulweni nakulungiselelweni loluntu lweziko zemfundo zangemva kwesikolo nokuqeqesha, waze wachaza ngemisebenzi yesebe kuNgangezikhondo nakwezinye iinkqubo ezijonga kuwo onke abakho ngelo ndawo i-Audit and Risk Committee, iNdlu yoWiso-mthetho, i-National Treasury, iziCandelo zoLawulo karHulumente nabakonke neNkonzo (DPSA) nokuQonda uPhumelelo nokulinganisa iMisebenzi (DPME). Umphakathiweyo uya kwabelana kuze akhankanye iSebe kwiNkqubo zokuLawula nokuBusa okuquka i-komiti yabaBhalwe-jikelele (FOSA) nakuziphi na ezinye iinkqubo njengoko alawulwa nguNgangezikhondo. Njengomntu oLawula iimali, umphakathiweyo, ngokwe-PFMA, uya kuqinisekisa ukuba isebesinoluLawulo oluSebenzayo, olulondoloza kakuhle noluQonde lweendlela zokulawula iimali nengozi ngaphakathi nakulawula oluNgenisa, waza waqinisekisa ukusebenza okulungele, okugcina imali echithwa ngokucacileyo kwisebe; uya kuba nawo umthwalo wolawulo, kuquka ukuzigcina nokuLondoloza izinto ezinje nkgezo nokutshatshalaliswa, ugcine izibalo ezipheleleyo ezicacileyo ngemali yesebe waze walungiselela iinkcukacha zemali zonyaka; aze waqinisekisa ukulawula, ukusebenzisa nokubhala iinkqubo zamazwe aphesheya ezithintela nomsebenzi wesebe. N.B. Onke amakandida akhetiweyo aya kufuna ukugqiba inkqubo efanelekileyo yokulinganisa iimpawu.
