jobs.title: Senior ICT Technician
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Central Johannesburg TVET College, Central Office
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum (Level 08), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: A senior ICT technician is sought to provide service desk, server and network support at the Central Johannesburg TVET College central office.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. A recognised three-year National Diploma / Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or equivalent NQF Level 6 qualification, ITIL V3/V4 Foundation or COBIT and Server Administration Certification are required. Candidates must have at least three years’ relevant experience in ICT support and hands on server experience, a valid driver’s licence, and proven experience in hardware, software, networking and ICT infrastructure support. Knowledge of server administration, desktop support, Wi-Fi, Active Directory, DHCP, VoIP, ICT security, help desk operations and second line IT support is essential. Relevant ICT certifications such as CCNA, MCSE, HCIA, VMware, Microsoft Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate and CompTIA Security+ will be an added advantage. Strong communication, customer service, problem-solving, planning and time- management skills, as well as the ability to work under pressure and extended hours when required, are essential.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and providing service desk, desktop, second and third-line ICT support; installing, maintaining and troubleshooting ICT hardware, software, network infrastructure, Wi-Fi, servers, Active Directory, DHCP and VoIP systems; supporting ICT security, backups and asset management; liaising with service providers on technical support, maintenance, upgrades and licences; user support and awareness initiatives; compiling ICT reports and technical information to the relevant manager; supporting ICT projects and infrastructure improvements; supervising and monitoring ICT Technicians; prioritising, resolving and escalating ICT incidents and requests; contributing to the continuous improvement of ICT services, systems, infrastructure and digitalization processes.
jobs.applications: The Central Johannesburg TVET College (CJC) invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by clicking on this link https://cjcz83.ngnscan.co.za/apply
jobs.notes: Apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions. If you apply for the first time, you will be required to register by clicking the register button to register. After registering, you will be allowed to log in and apply for your chosen post (s). Upload the supporting document namely, a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. The shortlisted candidates will also be requested to submit confirmation or service letter from their previous employer, confirming their employment status/ history. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualification(s) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointment promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The college reserves the right not to make appointment. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. CJC is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements. Due to the college financial constraints, candidates will be responsible for their traveling and accommodation.

af.title: Senior IKG-tegnikus
af.summary: 'n Senior IKG-tegnikus word gesoek om dienslessenaar-, bediener- en netwerksteun by die sentrale kantoor van Central Johannesburg TVET College te verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 / Senior Sertifikaat. 'n Erkende driejaar-Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Inligtingstegnologie, Rekenaarwetenskap of 'n ekwivalente NQF Vlak 6-kwalifikasie, ITIL V3/V4 Foundation of COBIT en Bedieneradministrasiesertifisering word vereis. Kandidate moet oor ten minste drie jaar se relevante ervaring in IKG-steun en praktiese bedienerervaring beskik, 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê, en bewese ervaring in hardeware-, sagteware-, netwerk- en IKG-infrastruktuursteun hê. Kennis van bedieneradministrasie, werkskermsteun, Wi-Fi, Active Directory, DHCP, VoIP, IKG-sekuriteit, helplessenaarbedrywighede en tweedelyns-IT-steun is noodsaaklik. Relevante IKG-sertifikasies soos CCNA, MCSE, HCIA, VMware, Microsoft Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate en CompTIA Security+ sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Sterk kommunikasie-, kliëntediens-, probleemoplossings-, beplannings- en tydbestuursvaardighede, asook die vermoë om onder druk en oor langer ure te werk wanneer vereis, is noodsaaklik.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur en verskaffing van dienslessenaar-, werkskerm-, tweede- en derdelyns-IKG-steun; die installering, onderhoud en probleemoplossing van IKG-hardeware, sagteware, netwerkinfrastruktuur, Wi-Fi, bedienaars, Active Directory, DHCP en VoIP-stelsels; die ondersteuning van IKG-sekuriteit, rugsteune en batebestuur; die skakeling met diensverskaffers oor tegniese steun, onderhoud, opgraderings en lisensies; gebruikersteun en bewustheidsinisiatiewe; die opstel van IKG-verslae en tegniese inligting aan die relevante bestuurder; die ondersteuning van IKG-projekte en infrastruktuurverbeterings; die toesig en monitering van IKG-tegnici; die prioritisering, oplossing en eskalering van IKG-voorvalle en versoeke; die bydrae tot die voortdurende verbetering van IKG-diens, stelsels, infrastruktuur en digitaliseringsprosesse.

zu.title: Umchwili we-ICT Ophakeme
zu.summary: Kufunwa umchwili we-ICT ophakeme ohlinzeka ngesikhwama sezenzo le-service desk, inikela ngokwesiphixhi kanye nokuxhasa inethiwekhi ehhovisi elikhulu le-Central Johannesburg TVET College.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. Kudingeka kube nesidiploma / iziqu ezigunyaziwe zezingaki eminyakeni emithathu ku-Information Technology, Computer Science noma iziqu ezingango NQF Level 6 ezilinganayo, i-ITIL V3/V4 Foundation noma i-COBIT kanye ne-Server Administration Certification. Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nokuhlangenwe nakho okuncike kakhulu eminyakeni engaphezulu kweyisithathu ekuxhaseni i-ICT kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okusezandleni kumasiphixhi, ilayisense yomshayeli evunyiwe, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokuhlangenwe nakho kwingxenye yempahla egqamayo, isoftware, inethiwekhi kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezinsimbi ze-ICT. Ukwazi ukuphatha abaphathi besiphixhi, ukuxhasa idesktop, i-Wi-Fi, i-Active Directory, i-DHCP, i-VoIP, ukuvikeleka kwe-ICT, izindlela zokusebenza zesikhwama sezenzo zosizo kanye nokuxhasa i-IT esimweni sesibili kuyimfuneko. Izitifikedi eziyelelana ne-ICT ezinjenge-CCNA, i-MCSE, i-HCIA, i-VMware, i-Microsoft Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate kanye ne-CompTIA Security+ kuzoba yinzuzo. Amandla okuxhumana, ukukhonza iklayenti, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela kanye namakhono okuphatha isikhathi, kanye nendlela yokusebenza ngaphezulu kwesivinini nangamahora angeziwe ngenxa yezidingo, kuyimfuneko.
zu.duties: Umuntu ozothunywa kumele abe ngaphansi kukwenzakalayo ekuphatheni nasekunikeleni ngesikhwama sezenzo le-service desk, idesktop, ukuxhasa i-ICT esimweni sesibili nesesithathu; ukufaka, ukugcina kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga zempahla egqamayo ye-ICT, isoftware, izinsimbi ze-inethiwekhi, i-Wi-Fi, abaphathi besiphixhi, i-Active Directory, i-DHCP kanye nezinhlelo ze-VoIP; ukuxhasa ukuvikeleka kwe-ICT, ukugcina okubuyiselwe kanye nokuphatha impahla; ukuxhumana nezinkonzi zokunikela zezobuchwepheshe ekuxhaseni ukusebenza, ukugcina, ukwenza izinhlobonhlobo kanye namalayisensi; ukuxhasa abasebenzisi kanye nokuqalisa izinkomba zokwazisa; ukulungiselela imibiko ye-ICT kanye nezinkulungwane eziyelelana nezobuchwepheshe kumphathi othintekayo; ukuxhasa amaphrojekthi e-ICT kanye nokuthuthukisa izinsimbi; ukugada kanye nokulawula abachwili be-ICT; ukubeka ngaphambili, ukuxazulula kanye nokukhuphula izinkinga nezicelo ze-ICT; ukufaka isand ekuthuthukiseni ngokungapheli izinkonzi ze-ICT, izinhlelo, izinsimbi kanye nezenklame yokwenza kube yidijithali.

xh.title: Omgangatho Ophezulu weTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT)
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe umgangatho ophezulu weTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT) onikeze inkxaso yedeski yesebenzo, iiseva nenethiwekhi kwisikhulumba senginginya seCentral Johannesburg TVET College.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 / iSenior Certificate. Kufunelwa ukuba nesiQinisekiso seDiploma yesiZwe samakhulu amathathu / iDegree ekuqatshelwa kwiTeknoloji yoLwazi, iComputer Science okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo seNQF Level 6, iITIL V3/V4 Foundation okanye iCOBIT kwaye kufunelwa nesiQinisekiso soLawulo lweSeva. Abafaki-zicelo kufuneka benokho nobugcisa obungazali langa bokusebenza kwiinkxaso zeTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT) isithuba seminyaka engangathi elithathu, bakho namalayisensi yokushayela anikwe igunya, bakhe babe namava abonwayo ekusebenzeni nengqwalasela iintsingiselo ezingabonwayo, iinkqubo ezifakiweyo, iinethiwekhi nokuqhutywa kwesiseko senkcubeko yexesha lethu. Kubalulekile ukuba bakho nolwazi ngolawulo lweeseva, inkxaso yedeski lokusebenza, i-Wi-Fi, i-Active Directory, i-DHCP, i-VoIP, ukhuseleko lweTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT), iinkqubo zendawo yokubuza ncedo kunye neenkxazo zesigaba sesibini kwiTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT). Iziqinisekiso ezimalunga neTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT) ezinjenge-CCNA, MCSE, HCIA, VMware, Microsoft Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate kunye ne-CompTIA Security+ ziba ngaphezulu kwemvuzo. Kubalulekile ukuba namandla okuthetha, ukukhuluma, ukukhonza abathengi, ukuzisombulula iingxaki, ukucwangcisa nokuzigcina ngexesha, kunye nolwazi lokwazi ukusebenza ngantsokotsi kwaye ungene emawotshu amaninzi xa kuyimfuneko.
xh.duties: Omele atsityiweyo unoxanduva lokulawula nokunika inkxaso yedeski yokusebenza, ideski, iinkxazo zesibini nesesithathu zeTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT); ukufaka, ukugcina nokuqhawula iintsingiselo ezingabonwayo zeTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT), iinkqubo ezifakiweyo, isiseko senkcubeko yexesha lethu, i-Wi-Fi, iiseva, i-Active Directory, i-DHCP kunye nenkqubo ye-VoIP; ukuxhasa ukhuseleko lweTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT), iindlela zokugcina iindlela zokwenza izigqibo kunye nolawulo lwamalungu egazi; ukubonisana nabahanjiswa kwingcebano yokunika inkxaso yentsingiselo, ukugcina, ukuphucula kunye namalayisensi; ukuxhasa abasebenzisi nokuqhuba amabalasi okuzikhathaza; ukulunga iingcwethekisa zokubika ngeTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT) kunye nolwazi ngentsingiselo kumlawuli ohambelanayo; ukuxhasa amaprojekthi weTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT) nokuqhutywa kolona luzuko lwesiseko senkcubeko yexesha lethu; ukulawula nokulandelela oobugcisa beTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT); ukubeka ngaphambili, ukuzisombulula nokuqhankqalaza iiganeko nezicelo zeTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT); ukuphumeza ngqo nangaphandle kwemigaqo ngokuchanileyo ukuphuculwa kwamasebenze eTeknoloji yokuThumela uLwazi (ICT), iinkqubo, isiseko senkcubeko yexesha lethu kunye nenkqubo yokuzezelwa ngekhompyutha.

jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum (Level 08), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: Chief Personnel Officer to supervise HR administration, conditions of service and personnel transactions at Central Johannesburg TVET College.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. A recognised three-year National Diploma / Degree in Human Resource Management, Human Resource Development, Personnel Management, Public Management or equivalent qualification at NQF Level 6. 3–5 years’ relevant experience in Human Resource Management / Administration. Practical knowledge and experience of PERSAL; relevant PERSAL certification will be an advantage. Sound knowledge of Public Service legislation, HR policies, regulations and collective agreements. Knowledge of conditions of service, remuneration, leave administration, employee benefits and personnel administration. Knowledge of personnel records management. Computer literacy, particularly MS Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Good communication, interpersonal, analytical, problem-solving, planning and report-writing skills. Ability to supervise staff, work under pressure and meet deadlines. Valid driver's licence.
jobs.duties: Supervise and coordinate HR administration within the College. Administer conditions of service, remuneration, leave and employee benefits. Process and monitor appointments, transfers, promotions, terminations and other personnel transactions. Maintain accurate and confidential personnel records and employee files. Process and monitor PERSAL transactions and resolve personnel and salary-related queries. Provide HR administrative support to recruitment and selection, performance management and other HR functions. Advise employees and management on HR policies, conditions of service and applicable legislation. Compile HR statistics, reports and submissions. Ensure compliance with DHET HR policies, Public Service prescripts and applicable legislation. Assist with HR audits and compliance requirements. Supervise, allocate and monitor the work of HR staff. Promote effective, professional and customer-focused HR service delivery. Perform other related HR duties assigned by the supervisor.

af.title: Hoofpersoneelbeampte (HR)
af.summary: Hoofpersoneelbeampte om HR-administrasie, diensvoorwaardes en personeeltransaksies by Central Johannesburg TVET College te bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Senior Sertifikaat. 'n Erkende driejaar Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling, Personeelbestuur, Publieke Bestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6. 3–5 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Administrasie. Praktiese kennis en ervaring van PERSAL; tersaaklike PERSAL-sertifisering sal 'n voordeel wees. Deeglike kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing, HR-beleide, regulasies en kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Kennis van diensvoorwaardes, vergoeding, verlofadministrasie, werknemervoordele en personeeladministrasie. Kennis van personeelrekordbestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid, veral MS Word, PowerPoint en Excel. Goeie kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike, analitiese, probleemoplossings-, beplannings- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Vermoë om personeel te bestuur, onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestaan en koördineer HR-administrasie binne die Kollege. Administreer diensvoorwaardes, vergoeding, verlof en werknemervoordele. Verwerk en monitor aanstellings, oorplasings, bevorderings, beëindigings en ander personeeltransaksies. Handhaaf akkurate en vertroulike personeelrekords en werknemerlêers. Verwerk en monitor PERSAL-transaksies en los personeel- en salarisverwante navrae op. Verskaf HR-administratiewe ondersteuning vir werwing en keuring, prestasiebestuur en ander HR-funksies. Adviseer werknemers en bestuur oor HR-beleide, diensvoorwaardes en toepaslike wetgewing. Stel HR-statistieke, verslae en voorleggings op. Verseker nakoming van DHET HR-beleide, Openbare Diens-voorskryfte en toepaslike wetgewing. Bystand verleen met HR-oudits en nakomingsvereistes. Bestuur, verdeel en monitor die werk van HR-personeel. Bevorder doeltreffende, professionele en kliëntgerigte HR-dienslewering. Voer ander verwante HR-pligte uit wat deur die toesighou toegewys word.

zu.title: Induna Yabasebenzi (HR)
zu.summary: Induna Yabasebenzi ukuze abeke isandla ekulawuleni ukuphathwa kwe-HR, izimo zokusebenza kanye nokushintshana kwabasebenzi ku-Central Johannesburg TVET College.
zu.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. Isitshibi sezwe seminyaka emithathu esemthethweni i-National Diploma / i-Degree ekuphathweni kwabasebenzi, ekuthuthukisweni kwabasebenzi, ekuphathweni kwabantu, ekuphathweni kazwelonke noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF Level 6. Ukuhlolwa okweminyaka engu-3–5 ekuphathweni kwabasebenzi / ekuphathweni kwe-HR. Ulwazi lwezobuciko kanye nokuqhubana okuqukethe i-PERSAL; izitifiketi ezihambisana ne-PERSAL zizoba yincongo. Ukuqonda okujulile kwemithetho yomsebenzi kazwelonke, emigomo ye-HR, emithethweni naseminqwethwini yokuqoka. Ulwazi ngezimo zokusebenza, ekuhlinzwa ngemali, ekuphathweni kweholo, emizuzweni yabasebenzi kanye nokuphathwa kwabantu. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kumarekhodi abasebenzi. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha, ikakhulukazi i-MS Word, PowerPoint kanye ne-Excel. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle, axhumanayo, ahlaziyayo, oxazulula izinkinga, ohlela nekubhala imibiko. Ikhono lokubeka isandla ekuphathweni kwabasebenzi, ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegcino kanye nokugcina izinsuku eziyigugu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Beka isandla ekulawuleni nokuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwe-HR ngaphakathi Kolishi. Phatha izimo zokusebenza, ukuhlinzwa ngemali, iholo nemizuzo yabasebenzi. Shintsha futhi ulandele ukumiselwa kubasebenzi, ukudluliswa, ukukhushulelwa, ukuphela kwebhaso nokunye ukushintshana kwabasebenzi. Gcina amarekhodi abasebenzi abaningi futhi abuyelekile kanye namafayela abasebenzi. Shintsha futhi ulandele ukushintshana kwe-PERSAL bese uxazulula imibuzo ehambisana nabasebenzi neholo. Nikeza inkxaso yokuphathwa kwe-HR ekuthathweni kokubhaliswa nokukhethwa, ekuphathweni kokusebenza kahle kanye namanye omisebenzi we-HR. Ingele abasebenzi kanye nalabo abaphatha ngezinhlelo-mgomo ze-HR, izimo zokusebenza kanye nemithetho esebenzayo. Qamba izibalo ze-HR, imibiko kanye nezinto ezithunyelwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunamathela nezinhlelo-mgomo ze-HR ze-DHET, imiyalo yomsebenzi kazwelonke kanye nemithetho esebenzayo. Siza ngemibuzo ye-HR kanye nemithelela yamathelayo. Beka isandla,abel bese ulandela umsebenzi abasebenzi be-HR. Khuthaza ukuphathwa ngokusebenzayo, ngobungcweti kanye nokuzinisa kumakhasimende ekulekeleleni ngomsebenzi we-HR. Yenza omunye umsebenzi we-HR ongahlobene ongayinikwa ngumlawuli wakho.

xh.title: ISikhulu esiPhambili Sabasebenzi (I-HR)
xh.summary: ISikhulu esiPhambili Sabasebenzi sokulawula lolawulo lwe-HR, iimeko zomsebenzi kunye nokuqhutywa kweenkqubo zabasebenzi kwi-Central Johannesburg TVET College.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 / Isatifikethi Esiphakamileyo. I-National Diploma / I-Degree eminyaka emithathu evunyiweyo kwi-Human Resource Management, i-Human Resource Development, i-Personnel Management, i-Public Management okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF Level 6. Iimvelaphi zokwaziswa kwiminyaka engama-3-5 kwi-Human Resource Management / Lolawulo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo kunye namava nge-PERSAL; isatifikethi se-PERSAL esifanelekileyo siza kuba lusizo. Ulwazi oluchanekileyo malunga nemigaqo yesebe lolawulo likarhulumente, iinkqazo ze-HR, iimigaqo kunye nezivumelwano zenani. Ulwazi ngeemecko zomsebenzi, intlawulo, lolawulo lokuxhomekeka kwindlu, izinzuzo zabasebenzi kunye nolawulo lwabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwerekhodi zabasebenzi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ngokukodwa i-MS Word, i-PowerPoint kunye ne-Excel. Amakhono amabalwe ekunxibelelaneni, abantu, ekuhlalutyweni, ekuqondiseni iingxaki, eceba kunye nokubhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokulawula abasebenzi, ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo kunye nokuqwalasela iindlela ezisisigqibo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evunyiweyo.
xh.duties: Lawula kwaye uhlanganise lolawulo lwe-HR ngaphakathi kwiKholeji. Lawula iimeko zomsebenzi, intlawulo, ukuxhomekeka kwindlu kunye neenzuzo zabasebenzi. Qhumba kwaye ulawule ukwabiwa kwabasebenzi, iinduliswa, ukukhushulwa, ukuyeka umsebenzi kunye nezinye inkqubo zabasebenzi. Gcina iirekhodi zabasebenzi echanekileyo nezifihlakeleyo kunye namafayile abasebenzi. Qhumba kwaye ulawule iinkqubo ze-PERSAL kwaye uxoluse imibuzo ngeabasebenzi nentlawulo. Nikezela ngokulawuleka kwe-HR kwinkqubo yokuqokelela kunye nokhetho, lolawulo lwenkqubo yokusebenza kunye nezinye iinkqubo ze-HR. Yaleka abasebenzi kunye nobaphathi ngeenkqazo ze-HR, iimeko zomsebenzi kunye nemigaqo ethile. Hlanganisa izibalo ze-HR, iingxelo kunye nezinto ezithunyelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqazo ze-HR ze-DHET, iimigaqo yesebe lolawulo likarhulumente kunye nemigaqo ethile. Ndixa ngevavanyo le-HR kunye neemfuno zokuthobela. Lawula, wabela kwaye ulawule umsebenzi wabasebenzi be-HR. Khuthaza ukuze kubekho inkqubo ye-HR esebenza ngokuchanekileyo, ngobuchwephesha kwaye ijolise kumthengi. Zenza eminye imisebenzi ye-HR ethunyelwe ngumphathi.

jobs.summary: Senior state accounting officer needed at Central Johannesburg TVET College to coordinate financial planning and management accounting functions.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate or equivalent. An appropriate three (3) year Diploma/bachelor’s degree in accounting / financial management or equivalent qualification. 3-5 years’ experience in the financial and / or management accounting environment. Knowledge of the Public Service Financial legislations, NSFAS regulations, PERSAL, etc. Experience in preparations of annual financial statements and interaction with external auditors. Computer literate and competent in Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Good verbal and written communication skills, presentation and report writing skills. A valid driver’s licence. Analytical and ability to pay attention to detail. Ability to work under pressure and willingness to work extended hours when required.
jobs.duties: Coordinate, review, analyse and quality assure the financial supporting information for planning purposes. Coordinate and review the necessary financial supporting documents required for the strategic and annual performance planning process. Analyse and quality assure the relevant financial information required in the evaluation and development of business and project plans. Check and verify the supporting information for various financial planning processes. Coordinate, review, analyse and quality assure the budget preparation process. Develop templates for the collection of budget information from line functionaries. Align budget statements with the annual performance plan, strategic plan and national spending priorities. Analyse and interpret the requirements for the monthly cash flow and adjusted cash flow as prescribed and recommend corrective action where required. Undertake the planning and supervise the preparation and consultation process in the implementation of the estimates for adjustments. Assess where shifting of funds/virements is required and possible by reviewing expenditure against budget and make recommendations. Supervise the recording of adjustments and provide feedback to the relevant components. Provide information for the preparation of the annual financial statements. Ensure that all shifts/virements are included in the adjusted budget. Analyse requests for roll overs and make recommendations in compliance with prescripts (including funds committed but not spent). Administer college revenue and receivables for student accounts. Provide internal control over revenue, receivables and expenditure. Improve cash flow through accelerated debt collection strategies. Handle and resolve campuses’ queries on student accounts. Assist with the implementation of debt management policies. Supervise the collection of revenue from debtors. Compile ad-hoc financial reports. Ensure that accurate and valid tuition fees are loaded on MIS system. Monitor student fees on student statement for accuracy. Provide accurate financial and management reports on all projects undertaken by the college. Supervise staff in the unit.

af.title: Senior Staatsrekeningkunde: Bestuursrekeningkunde
af.summary: 'n Senior staatsrekeningkundige beampte word benodig by Central Johannesburg TVET College om finansiële beplanning en bestuursrekeningkundige funksies te koördineer.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. 'n Toepaslike drie (3) jaar Diploma/baccalaureusgraad in rekeningkunde / finansiële bestuur of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in die finansiële en / of bestuursrekeningkundige omgewing. Kennis van die Openbare Diens se finansiële wetgewing, NSFAS-regulasies, PERSAL, ens. Ervaring in die opstel van jaarlikse finansiële state en interaksie met eksterne ouditeure. Rekenaargeletterd en bevoeg in Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, voorleggings- en verslagskrywingsvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Analities en in staat om aandag aan besonderhede te gee. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en gewilligheid om lang ure te werk wanneer dit vereis word.
af.duties: Koördineer, hersien, analiseer en verseker die gehalte van die finansiële ondersteunende inligting vir beplanningsdoeleindes. Koördineer en hersien die nodige finansiële ondersteunende dokumente wat vir die strategiese en jaarlikse prestasiebeplanningsproses vereis word. Analiseer en verseker die gehalte van die tersaaklike finansiële inligting wat benodig word in die evaluering en ontwikkeling van besigheids- en projekplanne. Kontroleer en verifieer die ondersteunende inligting vir verskeie finansiële beplanningsprosesse. Koördineer, hersien, analiseer en verseker die gehalte van die begrotingsopstelproses. Ontwikkel sjablone vir die insameling van begrotingsinligting van lynfunksionarisse. Belyn begrotingsstate met die jaarlikse prestasieplan, strategiese plan en nasionale bestedingsprioriteite. Analiseer en interpreteer die vereistes vir die maandelikse kontantvloei en aangepaste kontantvloei soos voorgeskryf en beveel corrigerende optrede aan waar dit vereis word. Onderneem die beplanning en hou toesig oor die voorbereidings- en konsultasieproses by die implementering van die raming vir aanpassings. Assesseer waar verskuiwing van fondse/viremente nodig en moontlik is deur besteding teenoor begroting te hersien en doen aanbevelings. Hou toesig oor die opteken van aanpassings en verskaf terugvoer aan die tersaaklike komponente. Verskaf inligting vir die opstel van die jaarlikse finansiële state. Verseker dat alle verskuiwings/viremente in die aangepaste begroting ingesluit word. Analiseer versoeke vir oorrol en doen aanbevelings in ooreenstemming met voorskrifte (insluitend fondse wat verbind is maar nie bestee is nie). Administreer kollege-inkomste en vorderings vir studenterekeninge. Verskaf interne beheer oor inkomste, vorderings en besteding. Verbeter kontantvloei deur versnelde skuldinvorderingsstrategieë. Hanteer en los kampusse se navrae oor studenterekeninge op. Bystand verleen met die implementering van skuldbestuurbeleide. Hou toesig oor die invordering van inkomste by skuldenaars. Stel ad hoc-finansiële verslae op. Verseker dat akkurate en geldige studiegelade op die MIS-stelsel gelaai word. Monitor studentegelde op studentestate vir akkuraatheid. Verskaf akkurate finansiële en bestuursverslae oor alle projekte wat deur die kollege onderneem word. Hou toesig oor personeel in die eenheid.

zu.title: Izabelomali Zezwe: Izabelomali Zabaphathi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wezabelomali wezwe ohlethwe ku Central Johannesburg TVET College ukuba ahlole izinhlelo zezimali nemisebenzi yokuphatha izabelomali.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade 12 noma esilinganayo. I-Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) efanelekile/noma ibhalori yedigri ebukhonweni bezabelomali / ekuqondweni kwezimali noma iziqu ezinganayo. Uluvu lweminyaka engu-3-5 kubuquqethi bezabelomali / noma kokuphatha izabelomali. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezezimali yesevisi kahulumeni, izimiso ze-NSFAS, i-PERSAL, njll. Uluvu ekulungiseni izinkulumo zezabelomali zonyaka nasekuhlanganyeleni nabahloli bangaphandle. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuba nokuziqonda kwi-Word / i-Excel / i-PowerPoint / i-Outlook / ama-Teams. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala, okwenziwa kwamaprezenteshi nokubhala amarekhodi. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ukuhlaziya nokuba nakhono ukunaka imininingwane. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxuzu nokuzithoba ekusebenzeni amasikhathi amade nxa kudingeka.
zu.duties: Hloleza, phinda ubuke, hlaziya futhi qinisekisa izinga lolwazi olusekela izimali ngenjongo yokuhlela. Hloleza uphinde ubuke imibhalo efoleka yezimali edingekayo enkambeni yokuhlela okubalulekile nokuhlela ukusebenza kwamakhono onyaka. Hlaziya futhi qinisekisa ulwazi oluhlobene nezimali oludingekayo ekuhloleni nasekuthuthukiseni izinhlela zebhizinisi namaphrojekthi. Hlola futhi qinisekisa ulwazi olusekela izinkambu ezahlukene zokuhlela izimali. Hloleza, phinda ubuke, hlaziya futhi qinisekisa izinga lenkambu yokulungiselela ibhajethi. Thuthukisa amathempleythi ukuze kuqoqwe ulwazi ngebhajethi kubasebenzi bamagatsha. Linganisela izinkulumo zebhajethi ngenkambu yokusebenza kwamakhono onyaka, inhlelo ekhethekile futhi nangabaluleko kokuchitha izimali kazwelonke. Hlaziya futhi chaza izidingo zokuqhweba kwemali yenyanga nokuqhweba okulungisiwe njengoba kumisiwe futhi ucaphule isenzo sokulungisa lapho kudingeka. Zenzele ukuhlela futhi ulawule ukulungiselela nenkambu yekonsalthi ekuphoyektheni kokwaziswa okulinganisiwe. Hlola ukuthi kuyadingeka futhi kungenzeka yini ukushintsha kwemali/ukudluliswa kwemali ngokuqapha ukuchithwa kube yibhajethi futhi wenze izindikimba. Lawula ukubhalwa kokushintshwa okulungisiwe futhi unikeze umbiko emaqenjini ahlobene. Nikeza ulwazi ngenjongo yokulungiselelwa izinkulumo zezabelomali zonyaka. Qiniseka ukuthi konke ukushintshwa/ukudluliswa kuhlongakwayo kufakwe ebhajethini elilungisiwe. Hlaziya izicelo zokugcinwa kungachitheki imali futhi wenze izindikimba ngokuhambisana nemiyalo (kuhlanganise nemali ethenjiswe kepha engachitheki). Phatha imali engenayo nezinkokhelwa zesikole sekholeji nge-akhawunti zabafundi. Nikeza nolawulo olungaphakathi ngaphezu kwemali engenayo, izinkokhelwa kanye nokuchithwa. Thuthukisa ukuqhweba kwemali ngokuqashwa okusheshayo kwezikweletu. Lawula futhi uxaze imibuzo yamasikholi nge-akhawunti zabafundi. Siza ekuphoyektheni kwezinqubomgomo zokuphatha izikweletu. Lawula ukuqoqwa kwemali engenayo kubazikweletu. Hlela amabhuku wezimali adingwa ngesikhathi esithile. Qiniseka ukuthi izinkokhelo zokufundisa ezinembile nezsemthethweni zilayishiwe esistimini ye-MIS. Qapha izinkokhelo zabafundi esitatimethini sabafundi ukuthi zinembi na. Nikeza amabhuku ezimali nokuphathwa kwawo ngawo wonke amaphrojekthi athunywa yikholeji. Lawula izisebenzi egatsheni.

xh.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sezabalizo Lommba: Ulawulo Lwezimali
xh.summary: Kufuneka isikhulu esiphezulu sezabalizo lommba kwi-Central Johannesburg TVET College sokulungelelanisa iplani nezimali nemisebenzi yolawulo lwezimali.

Isidanga sezimali i-Diploma/bachelor's degree kwiminyaka emithathu (3) ezifanelekileyo / kulawulo lwezimali okanye isifundo esilinganayo. Iminyaka yamava emi-3-5 kwimeko yezimali nakwayo / okanye kulawulo lwezimali. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezimali yoLuntu, iimeli ze-NSFAS, iPERSAL, njl. Amava kwilungiselelo lemiganeko yemali yonyaka nonxibelelwano nabalawuli bangaphandle. Ukuba nobuchule bokusebenza ngokwekhompyutha nokuqonda kwi-Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Amakhono amabalwe ahleliweyo nekubhalwayo, amakhono abonisio namakuqamba amabali. Ilayisenisi yokushayela eyasebenzayo. Uhlalutyo namandla okuqaphela iinkcukacha. Amandla okusebenza ngengcinezelo nokuzithanda ukusebenza iiyure ezinde xa kufuneka.
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa, phinda ucocise, uhlaluthe uze uqinisekise ukhwalithi yolwazi oluxhasa izimali ngenjongo zokuCwangcisa. Lungelelanisa uphinde ucocise oonxibelelwano abayimfuneko bezimali abaxhasa inkqubo yokuCwangcisa ngokusesiqu nangomnyaka wokusebenza. Hlaluthe uze uqinisekise ukhwalithi yolwazi olusesiqu lwemali olufuneka kwinkqubo yokuhoywa nokuphuhliswa kweplani yeshishino namaprojekthi. Qaphela ukuqinisekisa ulwazi oluxhasa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zocwangciso lwemali. Lungelelanisa, phinda ucocise, uhlaluthe uze uqinisekise ukhwalithi yenkqubo yolungiselelo lobugcisa. Puhla iithempleyiti zokuqokelela ulwazi lobugcisa kubasebenzi bemisebenzi. Linganisa amanane ezimali nepalini yokusebenza yonyaka, iplani yesiqu nangokubaluleka kokusebenzisa inyunyana. Hlaluthe uze utolike iimfuno zokuqaqamba kwemali yenyanga nakuguqulwa kwemali njengoko kumiselwe uze ucele intsengo olungileyo apho kufuneka khona. Yocwangciso ulungelelanise uphinde ulawule inkqubo yokulungiselela nangombandela wokuqaliswa kokulinganiselwa kolungiso. Hlola apho kuhanjiswa khona iimali / iintsomiso ezifuneka nokwenzeka ngokubuka ukusebenzisa kwemali ngokumelana nobugcisa uze wenze izindululo. Lawula ukubhalwa kolungiso uze unike ithuba lokuphendula amacandelo afanelekileyo. Nikezela ngolwazi malunga nokulungiselelwa kwemiganeko yemali yonyaka. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iintshintsho / iintsomiso zifakwa kwibhajethi elungisiweyo. Hlalutha izicelo zokugqibela ukusingatha izinto uze wenze izindululo ngokumelana neemila (kuquka iimali ezibhengeziweyo kodwa ezingatshatshwanga). Lawula ingeniso le-college nangokufunyanwa kwezimali kwi-akhawundi zabafundi. Nikezela ngolawulo langaphakathi kwingeniso, ngokufunyanwa kwezimali nakusebenziseni. Phucula iqaqamba lemali ngamaqhinga okukhawulezisa ukulunga okwetyisiweyo. Phatha uze usombululo imibuzo yamasampasi kwii-akhawundi zabafundi. Nceda ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo lwetyala. Lawula ukuqokelelwa kwingeniso kubatyali. Hlanganisela iibali ezizezekhaya zemali. Qinisekisa ukuba iimali ezifanelekileyo nezisesiko zefundi zifakelwa kwinkqubo yeMIS. Qaphela iimali zabafundi kwibali lesitudenti ukuqinisekisa ukungabi nakuphukuphu. Nikezela ngemibhalo ehleliweyo nangolawulo kuyo yonke imisebenzi ezenziwa yicollege. Lawula abasebenzi kwicandelo.

jobs.title: Senior Risk and Fraud Prevention Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Central Johannesburg TVET College, Central Office
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum (Level 08), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: Senior Risk and Fraud Prevention Officer needed at Central Johannesburg TVET College to coordinate risk management, conduct risk assessments, and maintain the College Risk Register.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/Senior Certificate. A recognised three (3)-year National Diploma/Degree (NQF Level 6 or higher) in Risk Management, Internal Auditing or another relevant qualification. Three to five years' relevant experience in Risk Management, Fraud Prevention, Investigations, Ethics and Integrity Management or a related field. Knowledge and understanding of the Public Sector Risk Management Framework, relevant legislation, regulations and prescripts. Knowledge and understanding of risk, fraud, ethics and integrity management principles. Knowledge of risk identification, assessment, mitigation and monitoring. Knowledge of fraud and corruption prevention and investigation processes. Computer literacy. A valid driver's licence. Good communication, report-writing, analytical and problem-solving skills. Good planning, organising and coordination skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and implement the College's risk management framework and processes. Conduct and facilitate strategic, operational and process-level risk assessments. Maintain and update the College Risk Register and monitor risk- mitigation plans. Monitor and report on identified risks and outstanding corrective actions. Coordinate the implementation of the Fraud and Corruption Prevention Plan. Conduct fraud and corruption risk assessments and recommend preventative controls. Assist with the assessment and investigation of alleged fraud, corruption and irregularities, in accordance with approved procedures. Monitor implementation of recommendations arising from fraud and corruption investigations. Coordinate ethics and integrity management and promote ethical conduct within the College. Facilitate risk, fraud, ethics and integrity awareness and training programmes. Monitor compliance with relevant legislation, policies, regulations and internal controls. Liaise with Internal Audit, Audit and Risk Committee and other governance structures on risk and fraud matters. Compile risk, fraud, ethics and compliance reports and submissions for management and relevant committees. Maintain accurate records, registers and supporting evidence relating to risk and fraud management. Provide technical advice and support to management, campuses and staff on risk, fraud prevention and ethics matters. Perform other related duties assigned by the supervisor.
jobs.applications: The Central Johannesburg TVET College (CJC) invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by clicking on this link https://cjcz83.ngnscan.co.za/apply
jobs.notes: Apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions. If you apply for the first time, you will be required to register by clicking the register button to register. After registering, you will be allowed to log in and apply for your chosen post (s). Upload the supporting document namely, a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. af.title: Senior Risiko- en Bedrogvoorkomingbeampte
af.summary: Senior Risiko- en Bedrogvoorkomingbeampte word by Central Johannesburg TVET College benodig om risikobestuur te koördineer, risikobevalings uit te voer en die Kollege se Risikoregister by te hou.
af.requirements: Grade 12/Senior Certificate. 'n Erkende drie (3)-jaar Nasionale Diploma/Grade (NQF Level 6 of hoër) in Risikobestuur, Interne Oudit of 'n ander relevante kwalifikasie. Drie tot vyf jaar se relevante ervaring in Risikobestuur, Bedrogvoorkoming, Ondersoeke, Etiek en Integriteitsbestuur of 'n verwante veld. Kennis en begrip van die Openbare Sektor Risikobestuursraamwerk, relevante wetgewing, regulasies en voorskrifte. Kennis en begrip van risiko-, bedrog-, etiek- en integriteitsbestuursbeginsels. Kennis van risiko-identifikasie, -evaluering, -mitigasie en -monitering. Kennis van bedrog- en korrupsievoorkoming- en ondersoekprosesse. Rekenaargeletterdheid. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Goeie kommunikasie-, verslagskrywing-, analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie beplannings-, organiseer- en koördineringsvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom.
af.duties: Koördineer en implementeer die Kollege se risikobestuursraamwerk en -prosesse. Voer en fasiliteer strategiese, operasionele en prosesvlak-risikobevalings uit. Hou die Kollege se Risikoregister by en werk dit op en monitor risikomitisasieplanne. Monitor en rapporteer oor geïdentifiseerde risiko's en uitstaande korrektiewe maatreëls. Koördineer die implementering van die Bedrog- en Korrupsievoorkomingsplan. Voer bedrog- en korrupsie-risikobevalings uit en beveel voorkomende kontroles aan. Bystand verleen met die evaluering en ondersoek van beweerde bedrog, korrupsie en onreëlmatighede, in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde prosedures. Monitor die implementering van aanbevelings wat voortvloei uit bedrog- en korrupsie-ondersoeke. Koördineer etiek- en integriteitsbestuur en bevorder etiese gedrag binne die Kollege. Fasiliteer risiko-, bedrog-, etiek- en integriteitsbewustheids- en opleidingsprogramme. Monitor nakoming van relevante wetgewing, beleide, regulasies en interne kontroles. Skakel met Interne Oudit, die Oudit- en Risikokomitee en ander bestuursstrukture oor risiko- en bedrogsake. Stel risiko-, bedrog-, etiek- en nakomingsverslae en voorleggings op vir bestuur en relevante komitees. Hou akkurate rekords, registers en ondersteunende bewyse rakende risiko- en bedrogbestuur. Verskaf tegniese advies en ondersteuning aan bestuur, kampusse en personeel oor risiko-, bedrogvoorkomings- en etieksake. Voer ander verwante pligte uit wat deur die toesighouer toegewys word.

zu.title: Umphathi Wesikhundla EsiPhezulu SoKulawula Ingozi Nokuvikela Ukwenza Amaphuzu
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wesikhundla esiphezulu wokulawula ingozi nokuvikela ukwenza amaphuzu e-Central Johannesburg TVET College ukuze ahlole ngokubambisana ukulawula ingozi, enze ukuhlola kwezingozi, azigcine futhi azibuyekele i-College Risk Register.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/Senior Certificate. Isitifikedi seziqu kazwelonke esithathu (3) samahora (i-National Diploma/Degree) (i-NQF Level 6 noma ngaphezulu) kokuLawula Ingozi, Ukuhlola Ngaphakathi noma ngesinye isifiso esihambisana nalokho. Ukubekezelele iminyaka eyisithupha kuya kubhali emsebenzini ohlobene nokuLawula Ingozi, Ukuvikela Ukwenza Amaphuzu, Iziphophomvume, I-Ethics kanye Nokulawula Ukuziphatha noma esikhundleni esihlobene nalokho. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Public Sector Risk Management Framework, umthetho, imithetho yesibalo namaphuzu ahambisana nalokho. Ulwazi nokuqonda izimiso zengozi, ukwenza amaphuzu, i-ethics nokulawula ukuziphatha. Ulwazi ngokuqhamuka ingozi, ukuhlola ukuthutha kanye nokulawula. Ulwazi ngezinqamleli zokwenza amaphuzu nokuvikela umonakulo nokuhlola izinqubo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle, okubhala imibiko, okuhlazisisa nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono ohlelo lokubeka izinhloso-msebenzi, hlela futhi ahlole ngokubambisana. Isikhathi sokusebenza kodwa futhi nangaphandle kwelinye iqembu. Ukusebenza ngesibindi futhi ngaphantsi koxanduva noma phakathi kwesikhathi.
zu.duties: Hlela futhi usebenzise izimiso kanye nezinqubo zokuLawula Ingozi zase-College. Yenza futhi uhole ekwenzeni ukuhlola kwezingozi ezinkulu, ngemisebenzi nangazinga lenqubo. Gcina futhi ubuyekeze i-College Risk Register bese ulawula amahlela okunciphisa ingozi. Qaphela futh wenze imibiko ngezingozi ezitholakele nangemikhawulokuhlehlisa okungakapeli. Linganisa nokuphatha ngemiyalo Yokuqaphela Ukwenza Amaphuzu nokuvikela umonakulo. Yenza ukuhlola ingozi yokukhohlakala nokuvikela imiphumela yezomthetho. Siza ekwenzeni ukuhlola imiphumela yezinsimbi yabantu abangaziwa nokungajwayelekile, ngokuhambisana nemiyalo evunyelwe. Hlolela imiphumela yezinsimbi yabantu abangaziwa nokungajwayelekile. Hola imiphumela yethemba lokuhlolwa ngokucacileyo nokuthobela imithetho yesibini. Zivumelanise nobulumko bokuba nelunga elikhulu phakathi kwe-College. Siza futhi ufunde ngesikhundla semiphumela yethemba lemfundo ekungeniseni imisebenzi. Qaphela nokuvumela ukuthi kuhlonitshwe imithetho yezwe, imikhawulokuhlehlisa, izimiso zomthetho namaphuzu angaphakathi. Xhumana NokuLawula Ngaphakathi, i-Audit Committee, kanye nezinye izigaba zobuhleli ngezindaba zengozi nokungahambisana namaphuzu. Hlela imibiko ngezingozi, amaphuzu, izimiso nokuhambisana nalemiholo kanye namakomidi ohlelo. Gcina imibiko, izikolo ezinemiholo, imiqondo ephiwa ngamaphuzu. Nikeza imibono yesikhashana abakwaziyo futhi bakhombise inkundla ngamaphuzu angahambisani namaphuzu ne-Ethics. Wenze imisebenzi ehlotshaniswa nalenkungaziswa ngumphathi.

xh.title: Umntu Ophakamileyo Wokulawula Iingozi Nokuthintela Ukukrakula
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMntu Ophakamileyo Wokulawula Iingozi Nokuthintela Ukukrakula kwi-Central Johannesburg TVET College ukulungelelanisa ulawulo lweengozi, ukuqhuba iindleko zengozi, nokugcina iBhalansi yeNgcwatyana lweengozi zeKholeji.
xh.requirements: Iklasi ye-12/Isetyenzwa ngesiNguni ePhakamileyo. I-National Diploma/Level 6 ye-NQF okanye ngaphezulu) kwisiXhobo sokulawula iingozi, ukulinganisa ngaphakathi okanye naliphi na isigqibo esihambelana nalomsebenzi. Iminyaka ezingamashumi amathathu (3) ukuya kwamahlanu (5) yamava ahambelana nalomsebenzi ekuLawulweni kweengozi, Ukuthintela Ukukrakula, iindleko zokuphonononga, ukuLawulwa kweMigaqo nokuzinikela, okwilabhu ethile. Ulwazi nokukuva ngeNkqubo yoLawulo lweNgozi kwisebe likarhulumente, umthetho, iimigaqo namagunya ahambelana nayo. Ulwazi nokukuva ngeengozi, ukukrakula, imigaqo nokuLawulwa kwezigaqo. Ulwazi lokuqonda iingozi, ukulinganisa, ukunciphisa nokuhlola. Ulwazi lokuthintela nokuphonononga ukukrakula nokukhohlakala. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Amaphepha amabalwe okuthetha nokubhala iingxelo, ukuhlalutya nokusombulula iingxaki. Amaphepha amabalwe okucwangcisa, ukulungelelanisa nokuhlanganisa. Isakhono sokusebenza yedwa nangaphezu kwesigaba. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinezelelo nokugqiba kumnye wemihla.
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa nokusebenzisa iNkqubo yoLawulo lweengozi kunye neenkqubo zeKholeji. Qhuba futhi lungelelanisa iindleko zengozi ezibeka ngakumbi, ekuSebenzeni nakwiNqanaba leNkqubo. Gcina futhi hlaziya iBhalansi yeNgcwatyana lweengozi zeKholeji uze ulolule iNkqubo yokunciphisa iingozi. Hlola futh uve iingxelo ngeengozi ezifunyaniweyo nangezenzo zokuLungelelanisa ezingagqitywanga. Lungelelanisa ukusebenzisa iNkqubo yoKuthintela ukukrakula noKhukhohlakala. Yenza iindleko zengozi zokukrakula nokukhohlakala uze uphakamise izilawulo zokuthintela. Nceda ukulinganisa nokuphonononga ukukrakula okusolayo, ukukhohlakala nokungahambelani nemigaqo, ngokuhambelana neenkqubo ezamkelekileyo. Hlola ukusebenzisa iziphakamiso eziphuma kwiindleko zokukrakula nokukhohlakala. Lungelelanisa imigaqo nokuLawulwa kokuZinikela uze ukhuthaze izenzo ezihambelana nemigaqo ngaphakathi kweKholeji. Yenza iinkqubo zokwazisa nokuzifundisa ngeengozi, ukukrakula, imigaqo nokuzinikela. Hlola ukuzinikela ngokuhambelana nomthetho, iinkqubo, iimigaqo nokulawula ngaphakathi. Thetha neSebe eliPhonononga ngaphakathi, iKomiti yoPhononongo lweengozi nakwezinye iinkqubo zolawulo ngeengozi nokukrakula. Qumba iingxelo ezingamashumi amabini (20) zamagama ngokwemiQobo yesiXhosa kuphela. Hlola ukuzinikela ngokuhambelana nomthetho, iinkqubo, iimigaqo nokulawula ngaphakathi. Thetha neSebe eliPhonononga ngaphakathi, iKomiti yoPhononongo lweengozi nakwezinye iinkqubo zolawulo ngeengozi nokukrakula. Qumba iingxelo ngeengozi, ukukrakula, imigaqo nokuzinikela nokuzithintelwa ngeenkqubo ngeNkokeli nakwamakomiti ahambelana nayo. Gcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo, iingcwatyana nobungqina obusekelayo ahambelana nokuLawulwa kweengozi nokukrakula. Nikela nceda yonke ingcebiso ngokusebenzisa isixhobo kwiNkokeli, nakuMmandla nakwisebe ngokuphathelele iingozi, ukuthintela ukukrakula namaxa. Yenza namanye amsebenzi ahambelana nawo abekiweyo nguMphathi.

af.title: Senior Kwaliteitsbestuursbeampte
af.summary: Senior Kwaliteitsbestuursbeampte benodig by Central Johannesburg TVET College om gehalteversekering, nakomingstoelig en die College Kwaliteitsbestuursplan te koördineer.
af.requirements: Grade 12/Senior Sertifikaat. 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma/Gradoe op NQF-vlak 6 of hoër in Kwaliteitsbestuur, Onderwys, Monitering en Evaluering, Publieke Bestuur, Besigheidsbestuur of 'n relevante veld. Drie tot vyf jaar se relevante ervaring in gehalteversekering, kwaliteitsbestuur, monitering en evaluering, nakomingstoelig of 'n verwante veld. Relevante ervaring in die TVET-, onderwys- en opleidings- of openbare sektor-omgewing sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis en begrip van die TVET College-omgewing en DHET-vereistes. Kennis van gehalteversekeringsbeginsels, kwaliteitsbestuurstelsels en deurlopende kwaliteitsverbetering. Kennis van monitering, evaluering, nakomingstoelig en instellingele prestasieverslagdoening. af.duties: Koördineer en implementeer gehalteversekerings- en kwaliteitsbestuursaktiwiteite dwarsdeur die College. Help die College met voorbereiding vir DHET, Umalusi, QCTO en ander relevante gehalteversekeringshersienings en moniteringsprosesse, waar van toepassing. Koördineer en onderhou gehalteversekeringsbewyse en dokumentasie. Voer kampusmoniteringsbesoeke en gehaltehersienings uit. Stel gehalteversekeringsverslae, bevindings en aanbevelings vir bestuur en relevante komitees op. Ontwikkel en onderhou gehalteversekeringsinstrumente, sjablone, kontrolelyste, registers en databasisse. Help met die ontwikkeling en hersiening van gehalteversekeringsbeleid, prosedures en riglyne. Fasiliteer gehaltebewustheidsessies en verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan personeel. Analiseer gehalte- en prestasie-inligting en identifiseer areas wat verbetering benodig. Monitor belanghebbende/studenteterugvoer en ondersteun toepaslike kwaliteitsverbeteringsintervensies. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes oor gehalteversekeringsaangeleenthede. Bevorder 'n kultuur van deurlopende kwaliteitsverbetering dwarsdeur die College. Voer enige ander verwante pligte wat deur die toesighouer toegewys word uit.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohleziwe Wokuphathwa Kwekhwalithi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi ohleziwe wokuphathwa kwekhwalithi Central Johannesburg TVET College ukuba ahlele ukugunyaza ikhwalithi, ukulawula ukuvumelana kanye nohlelo lokuphathwa kwekhwalithi Kolishi.
zu.requirements: Irekhodi lokuphela kwesikolo samabanga aphakeme/Ithifikheyithi Ephakeme. I-diploma/Idigri ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 noma eziphezulu kuyo ekuphathweni kwekhwalithi, ezemfundo, ekubhekeni nasekuhloleni, ekuphathweni kwomphakathi, ekuphathweni kwebhizinisi noma enkundleni ehlobene. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinhlanu eziyisithupha zomzobo ekuqinisekiseni ikhwalithi, ekuphathweni kwekhwalithi, ekubhekeni nasekuhloleni, ekulawulen ukuvumelana noma enkundleni ehlenga kuleyo. Amava ahlukene eTVET, ezemfundo nasekuqeqeshweni noma endaweni yomphakatha kuzoba ngusizo. Ulwazi nokubonisana nendawo ye-TVET College nezidingo ze-DHET. Ulwazi ngemigomo yokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi, izinhlelo zokuphatha ikhwalithi nokuqhuba nokuphucula ikhwalithi. Ulwazi ngokubheka, ukuhlola, ukulawula ukuvumelana nokubika ngokusebenza kwesikhungo. Amakhono amahle okuhlaziya, ukucwaninga nokubhala okuhle. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa nokubhala. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhomphyutha, ikakhulu i-MS Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint. Amakhono amahle okuhlela, ukulungiselela, ukuhlanganisa nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikono lokusebenza wedwa nangaphakathi kwenqembu. Ilungele ukuhamba phakathi kwamasampulas ekolishi uma kudingeka. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile izoba ngusizo.
zu.duties: Hlela futhi usebenzise izenzo zokuqinisekisa nokuphatha ikhwalithi kulo lonke iKolishi. Hlola ikhwalithi, ukubuyekezwa kanye nokuhlola ukuvumelana emasampulas naseminyangweni yaseKolishi. Siza ekwakheni, ekusebenziseni nasekuhloleni ihelelo lokuphatha ikhwalithi elibhaliweyo seKolishi. Hlola ukuvumelana nezinqamuleli, izinqubo, izinga nezidingo zeKolishi ezamukelekile. Qoqa, qinisekisa, hlaziya futhi ulondoloze ukwaziswa kanye nobufakela bokulawula ikhwalithi. Qaphela izikhala bese usiza ekuhleleleleni izinkinga futhi usize ekuhlelelela izinga lokuphatha ikhwalithi. Hlola ukusetshenziswa kwezenzo futhi usize ekuhlelelela ukuphucula ikhwalithi. Siza iKolishi ekuqinisekisweni kwe-DHET, Umalusi, QCTO kwezinye izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi ezihlobene lapho kufanele khona. Hlanganisa futhi ulondoloze ukwaziswa kokulawula ikhwalithi kanye nabafakazi. Hlola amasampulas bese uqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Qoqa imibiko yokulawula ikhwalithi, izincazelo nezincomo kubaphathi futhi ahlale njalo nakumanethiwekhwe. Qamba futhi ulondoloze amathuluzi, amafayela, amakhadi okuhlola okuhlobene nelungiselelo lwayo. Siza ekuqoqweni nasokuqinisekiseni izinqamuleli, izinqubo nezinqumo zenkambiso yakho mayelana nokuvumelana namazinga. Siza ekuphathweni nasokuqinisekiseni izinqamuleli namazinga okusebenza. Hlinzeka ngolwazi lobuchwepheshe mayelana nezinkinga ezivela ekuphathweni kwekhwalithi. Hlaziya ulwazi lwemisebenzi yakho nokuqinisekisa kahle mayelana nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi. Babazise ngokuzibophezela kwakho futhi usize kakhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezihlobene nokuphathwa nemisebenzi ekhaya. Siza ekuhleleleni futhi ekuhloleni izinqamuleli mayelana nezinto ezifanele ukwenziwa ekuphuculeni ikhwalithi emsebenzini. Sebenzisana nabantu abahlukene ngokuphathwa kweKolishi. Hlinzeka ngezinye izinsizakusebenza ezingezona ezimali mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi nezinhlelo mayelana nokusebenza kwakho ekuphathweni kwe-Kolishi. Susa amathulusi futhi uhlele umqondo wakhe wokusebenza mayelana nesikhungo esifuna ukuphathwa ngokusimemezelekileyo. Singatha isikhundla esisha ohlelweni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Babazise izenzo ezihlukene ukungena ezinhlelweni ezingezona ezimali mayelana nenhlelo yakhe ngokusebenzisa imithetho esemthethweni yesikhathi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Ophakamileyo Wokuqonda Ngomgangatho
xh.summary: Kufuneka ngumsebenzi ophakamileyo wokuqonda ngomgangatho kwi-Central Johannesburg TVET College ukulungisa izinto ezinqamlezela ukuzinza komgangatho, ukulawula ukuthobela imigaqo nokuphathwa kweGcina loMgangatho weKholeji.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12/iNqanaba leSikhundla Esephezulu. INational Diploma/iDigri elifanelekileyo kwiNqanaba le-NQF Level 6 okwaphezulu kwiNqununu loMgangatho, eMfundeni, ekulawuleni nasekuhlolweni, ekuqothweni kuBuphangela, ekuqothweni koshishino okanye kwicala elihambelanayo. Amava amatatu ukuya kwamakhulu amathathu okuhambelana nalo msebenzi ekuzinziseni umgangatho, ekuqondeneni ngomgangatho, ekulawuleni nasekuhlolweni, ekuqothweni ekulawuleni imigaqo okanye kwicala elinxulumene nalo. Amava ahambelana nendawo ye-TVET, yemfundo nokuqeqeshwa okanye kwisebe lafasheya kuya kuba ngumonde o Khangelelweyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iindawo ze-TVET College nokuqonda iimfuno ze-DHET. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokuzinza kumgangatho, iinkqubo zokuqonda ngomgangatho nentla yokuphucula umgangatho ngokuya namba. Ulwazi ngokuqonda, ukuhlola, ukulawula ukuthobela imigaqo nokwenza ingxelo ngemveliso yesebe. Amakhono amahlwempuzo aphakamileyo okuhlengahlengisa iinkcukacha, kuphandaphando nasekuhleni iingxelo. Amakhono amabe mpethu abhalwe nokuqhathanisa nabanye abantu. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokukodwa i-MS Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint. Amakhono amabe mpethu okulungiselela, ukuziphathela, ukunxibelelana nomgxobankabi, nobudlelwane nabasebenzi. Isakhono sokusebenza ngodwa nasekuhleni iqela labantu. Isifungo sokuhamba phakathi kwekampasi za sekholeji xa kuyimfuneko. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba ibe yimfuneko kuya kuba ngumonde oKhangelelweyo.
xh.duties: Nxibelelana phantsi kwaye usebenzise izinto ezinqamlezela umgangatho nokuqonda ngomgangatho kulo lonke uBakeli beKholeji. Qalisisa ukumila ngomgangatho, kuphando nokulawula imigaqo kumaziko nakuqiwo yeKholeji. Ncedisa ekuyilweni, ukusebenzisa nasekuqondeni ngeGcina loMgangatho weKholeji. Qwalasela ukuthobela imigaqo eamkelekileyo yeKholeji, iinkqubo nemiqathango nemfuneko yomgangatho. Qokelela, qinisekisa, hlengahlengisa kwaye ulondoloze iinkcukacha zemigangatho nembekiswa phantsi kweenkcukacha ezizinzisiweyo. Phawula iindawo ezingamilanga ngokwemfuneko kwaye uncedise ekuyilweni iinkqubo ezilungisayo nokuza kwinqanaba elibe Ngcono. Qwalasela ukusebenza kwezinto eziphucula umgangatho nezigqibo ezinikwayo. Ncedisa iKholeji ekulungiseleleni iinkqubo zokuqonda, ukuhlola nokuqwalasela i-DHET, i-Umalusi, i-QCTO nakuwo nawuphi na uphando nokuqonda okusemthethweni, apho kuyimfuneko khona. Nxibelelana phantsi nasekulondolozeni imigangatho yemigaqo nemibhalo yemigangatho efunekayo. Qhuba ukundwendwela iindawo zamaziko kwaye wenze ukuyila ukuya kulwazi lokuzinza komgangatho. Hlanganisela iinkcukacha nokuqonda ngomgangatho, iindleko nezigqibo ngezinto ezingoyena mgangatho kulawulo nekomiti elibalulekileyo. Yila kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo ezinceda ekuzinziseni umgangatho, iindlela ezifana namaxwebhu, iindlela ezibekiweyo, iindlela ezibekiweyo nokuyila ngokomgangatho woxinzelelo. Nceda ekuyilweni nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zokuzinza komgangatho, iinkqubo nemikhomba. Phatha iinkqubo zokuzinza komgangatho kwaye unikeze inkxaso ebalulekileyo kubasebenzi. Qwalasela iinkcukacha ezikwinqanaba elingangqinelana nobudlelwane bezithengi zigqitha kummandla obalulekileyo.

jobs.title: Senior Management Information System Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Central Johannesburg TVET College, Central Office
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum (Level 08), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: Manage the TVETMIS system at Central Johannesburg TVET College, overseeing data capturing, validation, quality control and reporting for college business processes.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate or equivalent. A recognised three (3) year National Diploma (NQF level 6) / Bachelor’s Degree in Information Management / Data Management or equivalent qualification. 3-5 years working experience in Data Management / TVETMIS environment or any relevant knowledge. Computer literate and competent in Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook/Teams. Good verbal and written communication skills. Presentation and report writing skills. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge of policies and governance environment of TVET Colleges including knowledge of the TVETMIS and annual reporting requirements by the Higher Education Institutions. Knowledge and understanding of Information Management. Knowledge, understanding, application and interpretation of office management, data warehouse and IT prescripts. Good administrative, planning, organising, problem-solving, project management, team leadership, analytical, client orientation and team leadership skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure proper management of TVETMIS as well as the capturing and extraction of college data. Perform validation of data on a regular basis. Set up the system in readiness for enrolment and support other business processes. Control the quality of captured data and report if there are errors. Maintain the college TVETMIS. Manage student and staff data. Use various tools and extract data to facilitate statistical reporting. Interact with the service provider regarding upgrades and request for assistance. Capture all the approved enrolments / registrations and assessments on the system by the predetermined time. Ensure the compilation and submission of reports. Provide statistical information weekly, monthly, quarterly etc. Ensure the compilation, monitoring of academic examination and staff statistics of the college and submit reports on quarterly basis to management and DHET. Compile monthly, quarterly and annual reports as requested. Ensure the maintenance and capturing of inputs captured on COLTECH system and other related systems. Set up the student system for registration of students and ensure creditability and reliability. Monitor the capturing, quality control, validation, run procedure, create file and ensure that entries are submitted on time. Ensure efficient and effective administration of all academic related student system administration for programmes, course and qualification. Oversee the load general system, student programmes, lecturing timetables, assessment marks, class groups, census dates and academic qualifications curriculum. Maintain calculation criteria as per guidelines from Head Office. Ensure that MIS licenses are renewed before expiry dates. Ensure the effective and efficient maintenance of the TVETMIS. Management of human, physical and financial resources.
jobs.applications: The Central Johannesburg TVET College (CJC) invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by clicking on this link https://cjcz83.ngnscan.co.za/apply
jobs.notes: Apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions. If you apply for the first time, you will be required to register by clicking the register button to register. After registering, you will be allowed to log in and apply for your chosen post (s). Upload the supporting document namely, a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. The shortlisted candidates will also be requested to submit confirmation or service letter from their previous employer, confirming their employment status/ history. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualification(s) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointment promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The college reserves the right not to make appointment. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. CJC is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements. Due to the college financial constraints, candidates will be responsible for their traveling and accommodation.

af.title: Senior Bestuursoffisier vir Bestuursinligtingstelsel
af.summary: Bestuur die TVETMIS-stelsel by Central Johannesburg TVET College en hou toesig oor datavaslegging, validering, gehaltebeheer en verslagdoening vir sakeprosesse van die kollege.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. 'n Erkende drie (3) jaar se Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6) / Baccalaureusgraad in Inligtingsbestuur / Databestuur of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar se werkervaring in Databestuur / TVETMIS-omgewing enige relevante kennis. Rekenaarvaardig en bevoeg in Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook/Teams. Goedge verbale en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Voorlegging en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van beleide en die bestuursomgewing van TVET Colleges, insluitend kennis van die TVETMIS en die jaarlikse verslagdoeningsvereistes van die Higher Education Institutions. Kennis en begrip van Inligtingsbestuur. Kennis, begrip, toepassing en interpretasie van kantoorbestuur, data warehouse en IT-voorskrifte. Goeie administratiewe, beplannings-, organiserings-, probleemoplossings-, projekbestuurs-, spanleierskaps-, analitiese, kliëntoriëntasie- en spanleierskapsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verseker behoorlike bestuur van TVETMIS asook die vaslegging en onttrekking van kollegedata. Voer gereeld validering van data uit. Stel die stelsel gereed vir registrasie en ondersteun ander sakeprosesse. Beheer die gehalte van vasgelegde data en rapporteer as daar foute is. Onderhou die kollege se TVETMIS. Bestuur student- en personeeldata. Gebruik verskeie instrumente en onttrek data om statistiese verslagdoening te vergemaklik. Skakel met die diensverskaffer met betrekking tot opgraderings en versoeke om bystand. Vaslegging van al die goedgekeurde registrasies / registrasies en assesserings op die stelsel binne die voorafbepaalde tyd. Verseker die opstel en indiening van verslae. Verskaf weekliks, maandeliks, kwartaalliks ens. statistiese inligting. Verseker die opstel en monitering van akademiese eksamen- en personeelstatistieke van die kollege en dien kwartaalliks verslae in by bestuur en DHET. Stel maandelikse, kwartaalse en jaarlikse verslae op soos versoek. Verseker die onderhoud en vaslegging van insette wat op die COLTECH-stelsel en ander verwante stelsels vasgeleg is. Stel die studentestelsel op vir registrasie van studente en verseker geloofwaardigheid en betroubaarheid. Monitor die vaslegging, gehaltebeheer, validering, voer prosedures uit, skep lêers en verseker dat inskrywings betyds ingedien word. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe administrasie van alle akademiese verwante studentestelseladministrasie vir programme, kursusse en kwalifikasies. Hou toesig oor die lading van die algemene stelsel, studentprogramme, lesingroosters, assesseringspunte, klasgroepe, sensusdatums en die kurrikulum vir akademiese kwalifikasies. Onderhou berekeningskriteria volgens riglyne van die Hoofkantoor. Verseker dat MIS-lisensies voor vervaldatums hernu word. Verseker die effektiewe en doeltreffende onderhoud van die TVETMIS. Bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne.

zu.title: Isikhundla esiphakeme somgcinimafa wolwazi wesistimu
zu.summary: Phatha isistimu ye-TVETMIS e-Central Johannesburg TVET College, ubuke ukubhalwa kwedatha, ukuqinisekiswa, ukulawula inani nokubika imigomo yebhizinisi lekolishi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 noma okulingana naso. I-Diploma yezwe leyonyaka (3) (NQF level 6) / i-Bachelor's Degree ekuphathweni kolwazi / ekuphathweni kwedatha noma iziqu ezilingana. Uzotho emsebenzini wonyaka we-3-5 ekuphathweni kwedatha / kumgcangqa we-TVETMIS noma naluphi ulwazi oluhlobene. Ukubhalisele kakhulu kumthombo wazulwini futhi ukwazi ukusebenza ngocingo / Excel / PowerPoint / Outlook / Teams. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Amakhono okwethula umbiko nokubhala imibiko. Ilayisensi yokushayela ehloliswayo. Ulwazi lomgomo nomkhakha wolawulo we-TVET Colleges kufaka phakathi ulwazi ngohlelo lokusebenza i-TVETMIS nezidingo zokuvela ngokwemibiko yonyaka ngamagatsha emfundo ephakeme. Ulwazi nokuqonda ekuphathweni kolwazi. Ulwazi, ukuqonda, ukusebenzisa nokutolikwa kohlelo lokuphathwa kwezofisini, idatha yokugcina kanye nokulawula idatha kumatshini wamakhompiyutha. Amakhono amahle okulawula ngaphakathi, ukuhlela, ukuhlela, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphatha imigomo, ukukhokha iqembu, ukuhlaziya, ukubheka ngakwesobala ngomthengi nokukhokha iqembu.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwe-TVETMIS ngendlela efanele kanye nokubhala nokukhipha idatha yekolishi. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kwedatha njalo. Lungelela isistimu ukuze ilungele ukubhaliswa kwabafundi kanye nekusekela eminye imigomo yebhizinisi. Lawula inani ledathi ebiyiwe bubeke umbiko uma kukhona amaphutha. Gcina i-TVETMIS yekolishi. Phatha idatha yabafundi nabasebenzi. Sebenzisa izinto ezahlukene bese ukhipha idatha ukuze kusize ukwenza imibiko yezibalo. Xhumana nomhleli wenkonzo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwayo kanye nokucela usizo. Bhala konke ukubhaliswa / ukubhaliswa nokuhlola okugunyaziwe kwesistimu ngesikhathi esihleliwe. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa nokuhambiswa kwemibiko. Hlinzeka ngolwazi olunezibalo masonto onke, nyanga zonke, kota lonke njll. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa kwayo, ukulandelwa kwezibalo zokuhlola izifundo ezibalulekile nezabasebenzi zekolishi bese uhambisa imibiko kota ngalinye kubaphathi naku-DHET. Hlanganisa imibiko yanyanga zonke, yekota nonyaka njengoba iceliwe. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokubhala kwezinto ezingeni ezingeni ezibhaliwe kusistimu ye-COLTECH nakwezinye izistimu ezihlobene. Lungelela isistimu yabafundi ukuze babhaliswe futhi uqinisekise ukuthembeka nokuzinza. Qapha ukubhala, ukulawula inani, ukuqinisekisa, ukugijima kwemigomo, ukudala ifayela bese uqinisekisa ukuthi okufakiwe kuhambiswa ngosuku oluhleliwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kwe-administrative yonke yesistimu yabafundi ehlobene nezifundo, izifundo noma iziqu. Buka ukulayishwa kwesistimu jikelele, izinhlelo zabafundi, izingxoxo zesikhathi, ukuhlola amamaki, amaqembu emakilasi, izinsuku zokuqamba izibalo kanye nezinhlelo zeziqu ezibalulekile. Gcina izimalinganiso zokubala njengoba kuholiswe ngahhovisi elikhulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi ilayisensi ze-MIS zibuyiselwa ngaphambi kokuba kuphele isikhathi. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwe-TVETMIS. Ukuphathwa kwemithombo yabantu, yezomnotho nabezimalimu.

xh.title: Iofisa eliphezulu leSphithuphu Solwazi lokuLawula Sebe
xh.summary: Lawula inkqubo ye-TVETMIS kwi-Central Johannesburg TVET College, ulawule ukuqokelelwa kweekhombolo, ukuqinisekisa, ulawulo lomgangatho nokuxela ngamashishino akholeji.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Garde 12 okanye esilingana neso. I-National Diploma (NQF level 6) yeminyaka elithathu (3) evunyiweyo / i-Bachelor’s Degree ekwi-Information Management / Data Management okanye ngesiqualification esilingana neso. 3-5 yeminyaka yamava omsebenzi ekwi-Data Management / kwindalo ye-TVETMIS okanye nanayo nawuphi na ulwazi oluhambelana nalo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kunye nokuba nobuchule kwi-Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook/Teams. Amabakhono amabalawulo olusuko nolubhaliweyo. Amabakhono okubonisa nokubhala iingxelo. Ilayisensi yomqhubi evunyiweyo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo nendalo yolawulo kuma-TVET College kuquka ulwazi nge-TVETMIS neemfuno zexelo zonyaka ezibekwa zi-Higher Education Institutions. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Information Management. Ulwazi, ukuqonda, ukusebenzisa nokutolika ulawulo lofisi, idata warehouse ne-IT prescripts. Amabakhono alawulo lofisi, olucwangcisa, oluqamba izisombululo, olawula iiprojekthi, okukhokela iqela, okuhlenga, okujolise kuxhaso lwabathengi nokukhokela iqela.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ulawulo lululo lwe-TVETMIS nokuqokelela nokukhupha iingcombolo zekholeji. Yenza iqinisekiso leengcombolo ngamaxesha athile. Misela inkqubo ukuze iphulaphule ukubhalisa kwabafundi uxhasa nezinye iinkqubo zoshishino. Lawula umgangatho weengcombolo ezokuqokelelweyo kwaye uxuke ukuba kukho iimpazamo. Londoloza i-TVETMIS yekholeji. Lawula iingcombolo zabafundi nabal basebenzi. Sebenzisa izixhobo ezahlukene kwaye ukhuphe iingcombolo ukuze uluncedo loxelo ngokwezibalo. Sebenzisana nenkonzo yonikezelo ngakumbi ngophuculo neemfuno zosazo. Qokelela konke ukubhalisa / ukubhaliswa kokusesikweni nokuhlola kwamagunya kwinkqubo ngexesha elichaziweyo. Qinisekisa ukuqulunqwa nokungeniswa kweephondo. Nikezela ngeenkcukacha ezibalulekileyo ngeveki, ngenyanga, kwikota njl. Qinisekisa ukuqulunqwa, ulondolazo lwezibalo zovavanyo lwemfundo nezibalo zabasebenzi zekholeji kwaye ugenise iingxelo kwikota kubaphathi nakwi-DHET. Qulunqa iingxelo zenyanga, zekota ngenyaka njengoko celwa. Qinisekisa ulondolazo nokuqokelelwa kweenkanganyiso ezingeniswe kwindlela ye-COLTECH nakwezinye iinkqubo ezahlangene. Misela inkqubo yabafundi yokubhalisa kwabafundi kwaye uqinisekise ukwethembeka nokuqina. Qwalasela ukuqokelelwa, ulawulo lomgangatho, uqinisekiso, ukuhamba kwenkqubo, ukudalwa kwefayile kwaye uqinisekise ukuba izinto zingeniswa ngexesha elichanekileyo. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluzeleko nolusebenzayo lweenkqubo zonke zabafundi ezihlobene nemfundo kwii-program, iinkosi ezifundwayo nezidanga. Qwalasela ukulayisha inkqubo jikelele, iinkqubo zabafundi, iishedyuli zokufundisa, amaphuzu okuhlola, amaqela abafundi, iithuba zesithathi kwaye kwimimiselo yemfundo. Londoloza imigangatho yokubala njengoko kelwa yiNtloko yeOfisi. Qinisekisa ukuba iilayisenisi ze-MIS zivuselelwa phambi kokuba ziphelelwe lixesha. Qinisekisa ulondolazo olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo lwe-TVETMIS. Ulawulo lwemithombo yabantu, yezinto nakwezimali.

jobs.title: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Central Johannesburg TVET College, Central Office
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum (Level 08), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: Senior state accountant handling payments, reconciliations and financial reporting at Central Johannesburg TVET College, requiring a finance diploma or degree.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate or equivalent. An appropriate bachelor’s degree/ national diploma (NQF Level 6) in Finance/Accounting/ and/or a related qualification. Preference will be given to candidates with five (5) years of financial experience, who have in-depth knowledge of expenditure, fixed assets, inventory, revenue functions, clearing of accounts and reconciliations. A minimum of three (3) years of supervisory experience. Knowledge of Basic Accounting Systems (BAS). In-depth knowledge of the requirements of the CET Act, PFMA and Treasury Regulations; good interpersonal, communication and managerial skills; experience in the management of accounts; ability to work under pressure with strict deadlines and good computer literacy skills (MS Office, SAGE and ITS). A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Assisting with the payment of authorized departmental expenses. Monthly reconciliations of creditors, inventory and fixed assets. Preparation of inventory, fixed assets and expenditure reports for management, on a monthly basis. Ensuring maintenance of accurate records of stock levels, transactions, and movements of inventory items. Ensuring stock is accurately accounted for in the accounting system. Conducting regular spot counts. Ensuring maintenance of detailed records of fixed assets. Ensuring accurate calculation and recording of depreciation for all college fixed assets. Ensuring accurate classification of assets and ensuring that purchases should be capitalized as fixed assets. Ensure proper data capturing of expenditure transactions. Prepare inputs to financial statements relevant to expenditure management. Ensure that expenditure transactions are brought to the book. Management of suspense accounts related to expenditure. Management of the clearing of ledger accounts. Management of the reconciliation of accounts to ensure that invoices are paid on time. Management and reconciliation of travel accounts of the department. Attend to queries related to payments. Management of the issuing of departmental claims and confirmation of balances and Management of staff. Requesting BAS reports when required. Communications with internal: Colleagues and managers within the Department. Communications with external: Suppliers, National Treasury and the Auditor-General.

It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualification(s) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointment promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance.
