af.title: Senior Staatsrekenaar: Finansiële Rekenkunde
af.summary: Senior staatsrekenaar wat betalings, afstemmings en finansiële verslagdoening by Central Johannesburg TVET College hanteer, met 'n vereiste van 'n finansies diploma of graad.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. 'n Toepaslike baccalaureusgraad/ nasionale diploma (NQF Level 6) in Finansies/Rekenkunde/ en/of 'n verwante kwalifikasie. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan kandidate met vyf (5) jaar se finansiële ervaring, wat oor diepgaande kennis van besteding, vaste bates, voorraad, inkomste-funksies, skoonmaak van rekenings en afstemmings beskik. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se toesigervaring. Kennis van Basic Accounting Systems (BAS). Diepgaande kennis van die vereistes van die CET Act, PFMA en Treasury Regulations; goeie interpersoonlike, kommunikasie- en bestuursvaardighede; ervaring in die bestuur van rekenings; vermoë om onder druk met streng sperdatums te werk en goeie rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office, SAGE en ITS). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bystand met die betaling van gemagtigde departementele uitgawes. Maandelikse afstemmings van krediteure, voorraad en vaste bates. Voorbereiding van voorraad-, vaste bates- en uitgawesverslae vir bestuur, op 'n maandelikse basis. Verseker van die onderhoud van akkurate rekords van voorraadvlakke, transaksies en bewegings van voorraaditems. Verseker dat voorraad akkuratelik in die rekenkundige stelsel verreken word. Uitvoer van gereelde steekproeftellings. Verseker van die onderhoud van gedetailleerde rekords van vaste bates. Verseker van akkurate berekening en registrasie van afskrywing vir alle kollege vaste bates. Verseker van akkurate klassifikasie van bates en verseker dat aankopen as vaste bates gekapitaliseer moet word. Verseker behoorlike datavaslegging van uitgawetransaksies. Voorbereiding van insette tot finansiële state wat relevant is tot uitgawe-bestuur. Verseker dat uitgawetransaksies geboek word. Bestuur van wagrekenings wat verband hou met uitgawes. Bestuur van die skoonmaak van grootboekrekenings. Bestuur van die afstemming van rekenings om te verseker dat fakture betyds betaal word. Bestuur en afstemming van reisrekenings van die departement. Hantering van navrae wat verband hou met betalings. Bestuur van die uitreiking van departementele eise en bevestiging van saldo's en Bestuur van personeel. Versoek van BAS-verslae wanneer nodig. Kommunikasie met interne: Kollegas en bestuurders binne die Department. Kommunikasie met eksterne: Verskaffers, National Treasury en die Auditor-General.

zu.title: Omlondoluzwe Ophakeme: Ukubhalwa kwezimali
zu.summary: Omlondoluzwe ophakeme ongazela ukukhokhelwa, ukuqondanisa nokubika ngemali kwa Central Johannesburg TVET College, ofuna iziqu noma i-diploma kwezemali.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 noma esingalinganayo. I-degree yeziqu noma i-national diploma (NQF Level 6) eifanelekile kwezemali/ezimali/noma iziqu eziphathelene nalokhu. Kuzothandwa abafaki izicelo abaneminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yokuhlola imali, abanolwazi olujulile ngokushelelwa kwemali, izimpahla ezingabuyiswa, izinto ezisetshenziswa, imisebenzi ehlobene nemali engenayo, ukuqeda izinkolo kanye nokuqondanisa. Ubuncwane obungaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) yokuqondisa abanye. Ulwazi lwesimiso sokubala izimali (BAS). Ulwazi olujulile ngezidingo ze-CET Act, PFMA kanye nezimiso zeTreasury; amakhono amahle abantu, ukuxhumana kanye nokuqonda imisebenzi; ulwazi lokuphatha izinkolo; ikhono lokusebenza ngocindezeli ngesikhathi esibekiwe kanye namakhono amahle ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (MS Office, SAGE kanye ne-ITS). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukusiza ekukhokhelweni kwemali yemisebenzi evunyiwe komnyango. Ukuqondaniswa kwanyanga zonke kwabanikeli, izinto ezisetshenziswa kanye nezimpahla ezingabuyiswa. Ukulungiswa kwezimphahla ezibekiwe ukusetshenziswa, izimpahla ezingabuyiswa nokubika ngokushelelwa kwemali kubaphathi, nyanga zonke. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwezinkampani ezifanele zezigaba zempahla, uthengiso, kanye nokuhenyiswa kwezinto ezisetshenziswa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izimpahla zibhalwe ngokuchanekileyo kusimiso sokubala imali. Ukuhlola izinto ngokuvamile ngokungalindelekile. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwezinkampani ezicazululekile zezimpahla ezingabuyiswa. Ukuqinisekisa ukubala ngokuchanekileyo nokubhalwa kokwehla kwentengo kwayonke imali yempahla ezingabuyiswa yasekolishi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhlelwa ngokuchanekileyo kwemali kwayo yonke imipahla kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuba izinto ezithengwayo kufanele zibhalwe njengempahla ezingabuyiswa. Ukulondolozwa okufanelekile kolwazi lokuqhathaniswa imali ekushelelweni. Ukulungiswa okufanelekile kolwazi lwezimali ezijwayele ukushelelwa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba imali eshiywe ihambiswe ngekhaya esibukweni. Ukuphathwa kwezinkampani ezibambezele ezingeyinhlobo zokushelelwa imali. Ukuphathwa kokuhlanza izinkampani. Ukuphathwa kokuqondanisa izinkampani ukulandela ukuba izikweletu zikhokhelwe esikhathini. Ukuphathwa nokuqondaniswa kwamanye amakhomishini kahulumeni kwezimali. Ukuphendula imibuzo ephathelene nokukhokhelwa. Ukuphathwa kokunikwa ngemali yemibusela kahulumeni nokuqinisekiswa kokuqondana kwezimali kanye nokuphathwa kwabasebenzi. Ukucela izibiko ze-BAS lapho kudingeka. Ukuxhumana kwangaphakathi: Abasebenzi nabaphathi ngaphakathi komnyango. Ukuxhumana ngaphandle: Abahlinzeki, i-National Treasury kanye ne-Auditor-General.

xh.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu seLizwe ngezezimali: izezimali
xh.summary: Isikhulu esiphezulu selezwe esibhekisa kokuhanjiswa kwemali, ukuqwalaselwa kwezinto ezahambelanayo nokuxela ngemali kwiKholeji yama-Central Johannesburg TVET, kufuneka kubekho idiploma okanye isidanga kwezezimali.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Grade 12 okanye esithotho. Isidanga se-bachelor's/diploma yezizwe (NQF Level 6) kwe-ezimali/ukuBala kwaye/nokuphi ukufaneleka okuhambelana naloo nto. Kuya kubakho Inkqubela ngakumbi kubaphumeleli abaneminyaka elihlanu (5) yokuba ngamava kwezezimali, abanolwazi oluñzulu ngemali echithwayo,impahla egciniweyo, izinto ezikhoyo, imisebenzi yemali ezingenayo, ukucoca ii-akhawunti nokukwa ñqwalaselwa kwezinto ezahambelanayo. Ukuza ñqonomgemva kweminyaka elithathu (3) yamava okuba ngumlawuli. Ulwazi ngamasentimu ekuBala izezimali (BAS). Ulwazi oluñzulu ngeemfuno ze-CET Act, PFMA namalungu eTreasury; amakhono amahle okuhamba nabantu, okuthetha nokulawula; kuqala ngamava ekuLawulweni kwe-akhawunti; ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo nemigaqo egqithisileyo kwaye unobuko obuhle bekhompyutha (MS Office, SAGE ne-ITS). Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Inkxaso ekuhanjiselweni kwemali yemali echithwayo esebe evunyiweyo. Ukuqwalaselwa kwamaxesha onyaka kwezimali ezibolekwayo, izinto ezikhoyo nempahla egcinwayo. Ulungiselelo lwezigxibo zokubika ngezinto ezikhoyo, impahla egciniweyo ngezeimali echithwayo. Iinkcukacha nolawulo lwemali kwiakhawunti yekholeji, ekuhambeni kwethanga nethonye. Kuqinisekiswe ulwazi oluñqamlezileyo lwezinga lezinto ezikhoyo, iintengiso kunye neentshukumo zezinto ezikhoyo. Kuqinisekiswe iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokubala ezibali kwindlela yokubala izezimali. Ukwenza njalo ukubala ngokutsha kwemali ngokuthe ngcemba. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemigaqo eqhelekileyo ngezinto ezihlala zingatshintshiyo. Iminikelo eqinisekileyo kwesixhobo esihlala singatshintshiyo sokubala nokubalwa kokuthotyhwa kwexabiso lempahla yekholeji yonke egciniweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukwahlulwa okuchanekileyo kwempahla nokuchanekileyo kokuba nokuba iinto eziziwa ngokuthengwa kufuneka zibale njengempahla egciniweyo eqhelekileyo. Ukuqinisekisa ingxoxo efanelekileyo yemali echithwayo etshatshaliweyo kwindlela ye-Financial Management System. Ukulungiselela iminikelo kumagama ezezimali ahambelana nalawo aphethwe ngumlawuli wezezimali. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba imali echithwayo igqitywa indlela ka-FMS. Ulawulo Iiakhawunti ezinqamlezileyo ngaphantsi kwexabiso lemfundo. Ulawulo lokuqhuba iindlela zokucoca i-bank account echithwayo. Ulawulo lokuqwalaselwa iindlela zokuhamba emsebenzini kwindlela ekugqitywa kwayo. Ulawulo kwaye kwenziwe uqwalaselwa kwe-Auditor General nasekuqwalaselweni kokugqitywa kwentengiso ngokuthe ngcemba. Urhweba ngokululeka ngenkxaso-mali ekuthengisweni kwemali echithwayo kolawulo. Ulawulo lokunikwa ngemali yakwindlela entengiso ngaphakathi kunye nokuqinisekiswa kwe-Financial Management System. Ulawulo lokuqwalaselwa kwindlela yokubakho kwezimali ezikuyo i-closing balance ye-Education account nokulawulo lwabasebenzi. Ukucela iinkcukacha ezibekiweyo zokuba ngumlawuli we-CET kolunye ulwazi kwindlela ekubalwa kuye iintengiso emsebenzini. Unxibelelwano ngaphakathi: nabasebenzi ngokuthamsanana nabo kunye nabaphathi kwicandelo lobuLawuli besebenza emariwo. Unxibelelwano ngaphandle: kwabathengisi, iNtengiso eNginguqi yeeNtlango nakwiNgingqi yamaphakathi anesilumkiso sokulawulwa ngokusesikweni semali engenayo ephethwe yidyunivesi eziphikwana ngokusesikweni somthetho wekhalenda yocwangciso lwezimali ukuba ligqitywe ngokomthetho ngaphandle kokuba ayikho Mntu onikezela ngokusesikweni ngomhla wemihla yonke ngokulandelana kweekhomishini ezinikezelwa ngokusesikweni ekuqwalaselweni iintengiso ezahambelana nokunikwa ngokusesikweni kolawulo Izinga elingenayo ngokusesikweni iNtengiso ngokuthi yenziwe ngokusesikweni emsebenzini yomhla wemihla ngokusesikweni kulawulo lokunikwa kwentengiso ngokusesikweni eya kubakho kwindlela yokwenza isicwangciso sokubakho kolunye ulwazi lwabathengisi ekuhambeni kwexesha elingakanani na iindlela ezingathunyelwa kubathengisi kodwa ijonge phambili nangokuthotho Iindleko ezingaphakathi kwethemba lokuba nguLawuli wezemali esuka eKholejini ukuba ufumane isatifikethi.

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent- Kantoor van die Prinsipaal
af.summary: Verskaf uitvoerende en sekretariële ondersteuning aan die prinsipaal en kollege-bestuursstrukture by Central Johannesburg TVET College.
af.requirements: Graad 12/ Matrik of Ekwivalent. Erkende Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie/Openbare Bestuur, Regte, Sosiale Wetenskappe of verwante kwalifikasies. Ervaring in die ontwikkeling van beleide/implementeringstrategieë. Praktiese ervaring in Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie/Openbare bestuur. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in die relevante terrein/terreine sal 'n voordeel wees. 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring in 'n administratiewe omgewing. Kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing en beleide. Kennis van PSET. Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET-administrasie. Begrip van die Hoër Onderwys-sektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Begrip van kostesentrum se begrotings-, bestedings- en kontantvlootbestuur, Wet op Indiensneemgelykheid, Openbare Diensregulasies en Openbare Dienswet, Arbeidsverhoudingswet en enige ander verwante wetgewing. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê.
af.duties: Lewer administratiewe / uitvoerende ondersteuningsdienste in die kantoor van die prinsipaal. Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning aan die Kollegeraad, Raadskomitees, Akademiese Raad, Senior Bestuur en ander eksterne belanghebbendes. Verskaf strategiese bestuurs-, moniterings- en evalueringsdienste. Oorsien en handhaaf logistiek binne die kantoor van die prinsipaal. Reël alle vergaderings (Subkomitee, Raad, EXCO en ander eksterne belanghebbendes). Reël alle Akademiese Raad en Akademiese Raad-komitees. Reël en ondersteun opleidingsintervensies. Koördineer die binneversiering, uitleg, voedselvoorsiening, uitnodigings en mediaprotokolvereistes vir funksies wat deur die kollege aangebied word. Handhaaf voorraad van standaardvorms en stasienerie. Ontwikkel agenda's en skryf notule vir die kollege-vergadering en forum se Rekordbestuur. Bestuur van alle menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid. Verseker voltooiing van prestasieooreenkomste deur alle werknemers in die eenheid. Toesig oor personeel.

zu.title: Usizo Lomuntu Siqu- Ehhovisi Likamongameli
zu.summary: Nikeza usizo lokuphatha nokubhala amaminithi kumongameli nasezinhlelweni zokulawula ikholoji e-Central Johannesburg TVET College.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/ I-Matric noma okulinganayo. I-National Diploma (NQF6) evunyiweyo kokuqasha amahhovisi nobuchwepheshe/okuqasha izindaba ezenzakalayo, umthetho, isayensi yomphakathi noma izifundo ezihlobene. Uqeqesho ekwakheni izinqamuleli/izinindlela zokuphumeza. Uqeqesho lokusebenza ekuqashweni amahhovisi nobuchwepheshe/okuqashwa izindaba ezenzakalayo. Isifundo esithuthukile esikhundleni esihlobene sizoba yinzuzo. Uqeqesho oluncane lweminyaka engu-3-5 nendaweni yokuphatha. Ulwazi ngomthetho nezinqamuleli zesevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi nge-PSET. Ulwazi nokuzuva okuphelele ngokuphathwa kwe-TVET/CET. Ukuqonda ngomkhakha wezifundo eziphezulu kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukuqonda imali yokubheka isikhungo, ukusebenzisa imali nokuphatha ukugeleza kwenhlobo yemali, umthetho wokulingana kolusebenzo, izinqamuleli zesevisi yomphakathi nomthetho wesevisi yomphakathi, umthetho wezimali ezimala umsebenzi nanoma yimuphi umthetho ohlobene. Kufanele abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yokuphatha/usizo lokuphatha ehhovisi likamongameli. Nikeza usizo ngokubhala amaminithi kuKhansela yekholoji, Amafelwa eKhansele, iBhodi yezifundo, Abapathi abaphakeme nanoma abanye abahlanganyeli bangaphandle. Nikeza usizo ngokuqondisa, ukubheka nokuqinisekisa izinkonzo. Qaphisize futhi ulondoloze ukuhamba kwezinsizakusebenza ehhovisi likamongameli. Hlela wonke amameethini (Amafelwa abancane, iKhansele, i-EXCO nanoma abanye abahlanganyeli bangaphandle). Hlela wonke amabhodi ezifundo namafelwa amabhodi ezifundo. Hlela futhi ukwesekwa ukungena ekulolongweni. Hlanganisa izinto zokuhombisa, isimo, ukulethwa kokudla, izimemo nemigomo yabezindaba izidingo zokuhlelwa amasiko ePhethe ikholoji. Hlale isitoko sezakhi ezivamile namaphepha okubhala. Bumba ohlelweni lokuhlanganyela futhi ubhale amaminithi ameethini ebanzi kanye nendlela yokuphatha amafayela wekholoji. Ukuphatha konke okuyimizi, imali nanoma yimiphi eminye imithombo yomnyango wakho. Qinisekisa ukugcwaliswa kwesivumelwano nokusebenza ngamandla ngawo wonke abasebenzi bawo womnyango wakho. Ukulawula abasebenzi.

xh.title: Mnini wezabantu- Iofisi yePrinciple
xh.summary: Kuqatshwe inkxaso yabaphathi abakhulu nabanabulele ku principle nakumatrhulo wolawulo wekholeji e Central Johannesburg TVET College.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12/ Matric okulingana nayo. INational Diploma (NQF6) evunyiweyo k Office Management and Technology/Public Management, Law, Social Science okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nazo. Isiphiwo sokusebenza kuphuhliso lwezilawulo/amasu okuzalisa. Isiphiwo esibonakalayo k Office Management and Technology/ Public management. Iqhalo lokugqitha efundeni ethintekayo liza kuba lulumkelo. Iminyaka elithathu (3-5) yokhade kwindawo yolawulo. Ulwazi ngemithetho ngezilawulo za Public Service. Ulwazi lwe PSET. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawulwa kwe TVET/CET. Ukuqonda ummandla we Higher Education kuya kuba lulumkelo. Ukuqonda i Cost centre kwimali yokusebenzisa, iindleko nolawulo lwemali egqithayo, i Employment Equity Act, i Public Service Regulations ne Public Service Act, i Labour Relations Act nananye imithetho enxulumene nayo. Kufunke ube nelayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Kuqatshwe iinkonzo zolawulo/inkxaso yabaphathi abakhulu kiofisi yePrinciple. Kufake inkxaso kwi College Council, kwi Council Committees, kwi Academic Board, kwi Senior Management nakwezinye iindidi ngaphandle. Kufikelela kwinkonzo yolawulo, ukuqwalasela nokuhlolwa. Kuqwalaselwe kugcinwe izinto ezingeniswa nazo zikhutshwa kofisini yePrinciple. Kulungiselwe onke amadayimokhulu (iSub-committee, iCouncil, iEXCO nezinye iindidi). Kulungiselwe onke amadayimokhulu we Academic Board nabeemi be Academic Board. Kulungiselwe inkxaso yokusingathwa kokuzimasa. Kuhlelwa iyakho ukuyilo, indlela yokubekwa kwezinto, ukukhutshwa kokutya, iimemo kuzo zimfuneko zemigaqo yabezindaba kumamnyhadala abaqatshwe yikholeji. Ligcinwe isitokhwe samapapadi aqhelekileyo nezixhobo zokubhala. Kwenziwa ihlelo lobucwelana kubhalwe imizuzu yedayimokhulu yekholeji kwisebe legcina amagama. Kulawulwa onke amandla, imali nezinye izixhobo zale candelo. Kuqiniseqwa ukuba onke abasebenzi kule candelo bagqibile imigalelo yemisebenzi yabo. Kuyaqwalaselwa abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Campus Administrator Officers
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Central Johannesburg TVET College, Central Office
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum (Level 07), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: Provide administrative support at Central Johannesburg TVET College, including enrolment planning, report compilation, and meeting coordination.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. A Degree / Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Public Administration or Office Management and Technology or Public Management or equivalent qualification. A minimum of one (1) year work experience in an administrative environment. Knowledge: Knowledge of office administration, Knowledge of Public Service legislations and policies, Knowledge and understanding of the TVET/CET Administration, Understanding of the Higher Education sector, Understanding Cost centre budgetary, expenditure and cash flow management, Employment Equity Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act, Public Financial Management Act, Batho Pele Principles and any other related legislation. Skills: Planning and organizing, Financial management, Report writing, Communication and interpersonal, Problem solving, Computer literacy, Analytical, Client oriented, Project management, Team leadership, Planning and organizing, People management.
jobs.duties: Render administrative support services; Draw up a campus enrolment plan for both NCV, report 191and occupational programmes, gather departmental information and compile a report for A-TEAM and Campus Management; Prepare reports, presentations, and other correspondence. Arrange meetings, conferences, workshops and other gatherings as required. Provide other secretarial support services to campus management. Administer and coordinate human resource services, Coordinate Leave forms and submit to central office. Coordinate PMDS documents and submit to central office. Coordinate all relevant documentation pertaining to disciplinary cases and grievances. Follow up and resolve all human resource administration queries and issues emanating from campus staff, Maintain human resource records administration. Monitor the attendance register for staff. Coordinate the compilation of duty registers and payment for part-time lectures. Support the implementation of the college staff wellness programme at campus level. Provide procurement services; Recommend purchase requisitions to Campus Manager, Draft procurement memo. Complete requisition form, receive goods and services, Coordinate and submit invoices to Central Office for processing. Verify the correctness of goods and services supplied against the appropriate documentation, Follow-up on campus requisitions made, Maintain a proper filing system, Maintain files for all campus staff, Filing of all relevant documentation according to QMS requirements and national achieve Act, Keep record of postage received from central office and ensure that the distribution is done accordingly and register is kept by the relevant official, Administer student registration and examination process; Assist in the registration of students. Store student portfolios of evidence and student records, Scan documents of students, Capture and reconcile information for students, ensure data exceptions and corrections, Process the details of applications for programmes and credits, Coordinate the student registration process, Coordinate the examination process.
jobs.applications: The Central Johannesburg TVET College (CJC) invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by clicking on this link https://cjcz83.ngnscan.co.za/apply
jobs.notes: Apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions. If you apply for the first time, you will be required to register by clicking the register button to register. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements. Due to the college financial constraints, candidates will be responsible for their traveling and accommodation.

af.title: Kampusadministratiewe beamptes
af.summary: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning by Central Johannesburg TVET College, insluitend registrasiebeplanning, verslagopstelling en koördinering van vergaderings.
af.requirements: Grade 12 / Senior Certificate. 'n Graad / Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Publieke Administrasie of Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie of Publieke Bestuur of 'n equivalente kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar werkervaring in 'n administratiewe omgewing. Kennis: Kennis van kantooradministrasie, Kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing en beleide, Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET-administrasie, Begrip van die Hoër Onderwyssektor, Begrip van kostesentrum begrotings, besteding en kontvloei-bestuur, Employment Equity Act, Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act, Public Financial Management Act, Batho Pele-beginsels en enige ander verwante wetgewing. Vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering, Finansiële bestuur, Verslagskryfwerk, Kommunikasie en interpersoonlik, Probleemoplossing, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Analities, Kliëntgerig, Projekbestuur, Spanleierskap, Beplanning en organisering, Mensebestuur.
af.duties: Lewer administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste; Stel 'n kampusregistrasieplan op vir beide NCV-, Report 191- en beroepsprogramme, versamel departementele inligting en stel 'n verslag op vir A-TEAM en Campus Management; Berei verslae, aanbiedings en ander korrespondensie voor. Rêre vergaderings, konferensies, werkswinkels en ander byeenkomste soos vereis. Verskaf ander sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste aan kampusbestuur. Administreer en koördineer menslike hulpbron Dienste, Koördineer verlofvorms en stuur dit na die sentrale kantoor. Koördineer PMDS-dokumente en stuur dit na die sentrale kantoor. Koördineer alle relevante dokumentasie rakende dissiplinêre sake en klagtes. Volg alle menslike hulpbronadministrasie-navrae en probleme wat van kampuspersoneel spruit op en los dit op, Onderhou menslike hulpbronrekordadministrasie. Monitor die bywoningsregister vir personeel. Koördineer die opstelling van diensregisters en betaling vir deeltydse lesings. Ondersteun die implementering van die kollege se personeelwelstandsprogram op kamuspvlak. Verskaf prosurementsdienste; Beveel aankoopversoeke by die Campus Manager aan, Stel 'n prosurement-memo op. Voltooi die versoekvorm, ontvang goedere en dienste, Koördineer en stuur fakture na Central Office vir verwerking. Verifieer die korrektheid van goedere en dienste wat verskaf is teen die toepaslike dokumentasie, Volg kampusversoeke wat gedoen is op, Onderhou 'n behoorlike lêerstelsel, Onderhou lêers vir alle kampuspersoneel, Lêer alle relevante dokumentasie volgens QMS-vereistes en die National Archives Act, Hou rekord van pos wat van die sentrale kantoor ontvang is en verseker dat verspreiding dienooreenkomstig gedoen word en die register deur die relevante beampte gehou word, Administreer studentregistrasie en eksamenproses; Help met die registrasie van studente. Berg studentportefeuljes van bewyse en studentrekords, Skandeer dokumente van studente, Voer inligting vir studente in en rekonsilieer dit, verseker data-uitsonderings en -korreksies, Verwerk die besonderhede van aansoeke vir programme en krediete, Koördineer die studentregistrasieproses, Koördineer die eksamenproses.

zu.title: Babe Basebenzi Bolawulo Bwesikhungo
zu.summary: Nikela ngenkusekelo yolawulo e-Central Johannesburg TVET College, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela ukubhaliswa kokufunda, ukuqoqa imibiko, nokuhlelanisa itherididi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 / Isitifiketi Esiphakeme. I-Degree / Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwi-Public Administration noma i-Office Management and Technology noma i-Public Management noma iziqu ezingequqwa. Okungenani unyaka owodwa (1) weminyaka yokuqashwa kwindawo yolawulo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngolawulo lwehhovisi, Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye nezinqumela ezinkonzweni zomphakathi, Ulwazi futhi ukuqonda ukulawulwa kwe-TVET/CET, Ukuqonda ingxenye ye-Higher Education, Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwebhajethi, okuchithwayo nokuphathwa kwemali kunesikhungo sezindleko, i-Employment Equity Act, i-Public Service Regulations kanye ne-Public Service Act, i-Public Financial Management Act, Izimiso ze-Batho Pele kanye nanoma yimuphi omunye umthetho ohlobene. Amakhono: Ukuhlela nokuhlela, Ukuphathwa kwezimali, Ukubhala imibiko, Ukuxhumana nobuntu, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Ulwazi lwamakhompyutha, Ukuhlaziya, Ukuqondiswa nokunakekelwa kwezikhasimndeni, Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, Ukuphatha iqembu, Ukuhlela nokuhlela, Ukuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Nikela ngezinkonzo zokusekela ezindaweni zolawulo; Hlela icephu lokubhaliswa kwesikhungo kokufunda ngakho kokubili i-NCV, i-report 191namahlela okusebenza, qoqa ulwazi lweminyango uphinde uqoqe umbiko we-A-TEAM kanye noLawulo Lwesikhungo; Lungiselela imibiko, okwethulwayo, kanye nanye nenye imeyili. Hlela itherididi, izikhathi zokuhlangana, amakilasi okusebenza kanye nanoma yikuphi okunye okuhlangene njengoba kudingeka. Nikela ngezinye izinkonzo zokusekela ezibhalweni ezifihliwe kubaphathi besikhungo. Phatha futhi uhlelanise izinkonzo zamathalenta abantu, Hlelanisa amafomu e-Leave uwathekele ehhovisi elikhulu. Hlelanisa amadokhumenti e-PMDS uwathumele ehhovisi elikhulu. Hlelanisa wona wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nezinqaba zokuqeqesha kanye nezikhalazo. Landelela futhi uxazulule yonke imibuzo kanye nezinkinga zolawulo lwamathalenta abantu ezivela kubasebenzi basesikhungweni, Gcina ulawulo lwemibhalo yamathalenta abantu. Bheka ubukhona besithihi sabasebenzi. Hlelanisa ukuqoqwa kwamafomu okusebenza kanye nokukhokhelwa kwezifundo zesikhathi esinqunqiwe. Sekela ukusetshenziswa kwenkqubo yezempilo yabasebenzi ikolishi ezingeni lesikhungo. Nikela ngezinkonzo zokuthenga; Phakamisa izicelo zokuthenga kubaphathi besikhungo, Bhala imemorathamu yokuthenga. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, thamela impahla kanye nezinkonzo, Hlelanisa futhi uthumele amabhili ehhovisi elikhulu ukuze kuhlolwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi impahla nezinkonzo ezinikezwe zihambisana nedokhumenti efanele, Landela izicelo zokuthenga ezenziwe esikhungweni, Gcina indlela efanele yokugcina amafayela, Gcina amafayela abasebenzi bonke besikhungo, Ukugcina wona wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene ngokuhambisana nezidingo ze-QMS kanye ne-National Achieve Act, Gcina irekhodi lezinhlekelela ezitholakale ehhovisi elikhulu futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ukusatshazwa kwenziwe ngendlela efanele futhi irekhodi ligcinwe ofishane ohlobene, Phatha ukuqanjwa kwabafundi kanye nokuqeqeshwa kokuhlolwa; Siza ekubhaliseni abafundi. Gcina amapothofoliyo abafundi obufakazi kanye nemibhalo yabafundi, Skena amadokhumenti abafundi, Faka ulwazi futhi ulinganise ulwazi lwabafundi, ukuqinisekisa iziphazamiso zeminingwane kanye nezilungiso, Hlela imininingwane yezicelo zamahlela kanye namakhredithi, Hlelanisa inqubo yokubhaliswa kwabafundi, Hlelanisa inqubo yokuhlolwa.

xh.title: IiOfisi zorhwebo zeNqanaba leKholoji
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwiCentral Johannesburg TVET College, kuquka uqulunqo lwenkqubo yobhaliso, ukuqulunqa iingxelo, nolungelelaniso lweemihlangano.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 / Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo. IDigri / IDiploma (NQF Level 6) kwiPublic Administration okanye kwiOffice Management and Technology okanye kwiPublic Management okanye isimelifikeshini esilinganayo. Amava amancinci emyeye wenyanga (1) yokusebenza kwindawo yolawulo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngolawulo leofisi, Ulwazi ngemigaqo namagqabantshintshi karhulumente, Ulwazi nokuqonda i-TVET/CET Administration, Ukuqonda ingingqi yeHigher Education, Ukuqonda i-Cost centre budgetary, expenditure and cash flow management, i-Employment Equity Act, i-Public Service Regulations ne-Public Service Act, i-Public Financial Management Act, iimvisiswano zeBatho Pele nakwenye naluphi na umthetho ohlobene nalo. Amakhono: Uqulunqo nolungelelaniso, ulawulo lweemali, ukubhala iingxelo, Unxibelelwano nokuhamba nabantu, ukuxazulula iingxaki, ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha, ukwahlahlwa-hlwa, ukujolise kumxhasi, ulawulo lweenkqubo, inkokheli yeqela, uqulunqo nolungelelaniso, ulawulo labantu.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zonxibelelwano zolawulo; Yila inkqubo yobhaliso yekholoji yomaxesha wonke we-NCV, report 191 nomenzi-msebenzi, qokelela ulwazi lwesebe uze uqulunqe ingxelo ye-A-TEAM nabaLawuli beKholoji; Lungiselela iingxelo, iinkcazelo ezigqithisayo, nanyana iphepha-ncedha elithile. Lungelelanise iimihlangano, iingqungquthela, amawebhusopho nakunye okuqokelelwayo njengoko kufunekayo. Nika ezinye iinkonzo zolawulo njengesikweri kubalawuli bekholoji. Lawula ulungelelanise iinkonzo zemithombo yabantu, Lungelelanise iifomu zokurhoxa emsebenzini uzithumele kwindawo ephakathi. Lungelelanise amaxwebhu e-PMDS uzithumele kwindawo ephakathi. Lungelelanise onke amaxwebhu ahlobene neemeko zemikhandlela neengxaki. Landelela uze uxazulule onke amabuzo namaxa olawulo lwemithombo yabantu asuka kubasebenzi bekholoji, Gcina amafa wolawulo lwemithombo yabantu. Qaphela irejista yokubakho kwabasebenzi. Lungelelanise uqulunqo lwarejista zomsebenzi nentlawulo yabafundisi abasebenza ixesha elifutshane. Nxaxha inkqubo yokusebenza kumalungiselelo abasebenzi bekholoji kwinqanaba lekholoji. Nika iinkonzo zokuthenjiswa kwemisebenzi; Phakamisa iimfuno zokuqengesha kumLawuli weKholoji, Bhala imemo yokuthenga. Gcwalisa ifomu lokufuna, amkele imisebenzi neenkonzo, Lungelelanise uthumele iinvoyisi kwindawo ephakathi ukwenza inkqubo. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwemisebenzi neenkonzo ezinikiwe ngokomaxwebhu afanelekileyo, Landelela iimfuno ezithethwe ekholoji, Gcina inkqubo efanelekileyo yokulondolozwa kwamaxwebhu, Gcina amafa onke abasebenzi bekholoji, Ukugcina kwamaxwebhu ahlobene nawo wonke ngokweemfuno ze-QMS ne-National Archives Act, Gcina irekhodi yemipho efumene kwindawo ephakathi uze uqiniseke ukuba ukusasazwa kwenziwa ngokufanelekileyo nirejista igcinwa ngumsebenzi ofanelekileyo, Lawula inkqubo yobhaliso lwabafundi nolwaviwo; Nceda ebhaliseni abafundi. Gcina izikhtsha zobumbeko zabafundi namarekhodo, Skeni amaxwebhu abafundi, Faka ulwazi uze ulungise ulwazi lwabafundi, qinisekisa iingxaki zedata nelungiso layo, Yila iinkcukacha zemifuno yeenkqubo namamanyuzo, Lungelelanise inkqubo yobhaliso yabafundi, Lungelelanise inkqubo yokuviwa.

jobs.summary: Examination officer needed at Central Johannesburg TVET College to manage exam marks capture, enrolments, permits and venue preparation on the ITS system.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric certificate or NC (V) Level 4 certificate. A three (3) year National Diploma / Degree in Management Assistant / Office Administration or equivalent qualification. At least 1 - 2 years’ experience at a TVET College or in an educational institution. Knowledge of White Paper on PSET. Knowledge of Public TVET sector and its regulatory and legislative framework. Knowledge and understanding of TVETMIS, and ITS, TVET National Examination Policies, Government Gazette: Conduct of Examination, DHET Punctuality Policy, Examination requirements for Exam Centres. Sound knowledge of legislation regulating examinations and assessments, Excellent computer skills/knowledge of Microsoft Office packages. Good leadership skills. Ability to write reports. Must be able to work under pressure, in a team, independently and for longer hours. Use problem-solving techniques to tactfully address queries / concerns. Ability to perform routine tasks and meet deadlines. Effective organisational, administration, time management, communication (verbal and written) and planning skills. Computer literate in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook and internet). A valid driver's license.

Issuing of term mark sheets for completion and returning. Issuing of exam permits and preparing exam venues to be conducive enough to run exams. Compile the daily examination reports and submit to the Curriculum Implementation. Submit examination irregularities to the DHET National and Examination irregularity committee. Ensure that there is a smooth receiving, collating and dispatching of both full-time and part-time scripts to the National Examination marking centres. Be a Distribution Point manager during the examination period. Oversee the implementation of DHET/College Management plans regarding examinations. Be the liaising person between the college and DHET on all the examination related matters. Implement the College examination related policies. Verify and declare students qualifying for graduation to the graduation committee. Issuing of statement of results, examination permits, certificates and diploma applications. Timeous completion of preliminary schedule to make amendments and send to the department for corrections. Assist with the submission of outstanding ICASS/POE’s and keep electronic records. Execution of examination duties according to the national Examination Policy for National Certificate Vocational (NCV) and Report 191 (NATED). Application for examination concessions to the DHET. Ensure the provision of examination services; facilitate the process of invigilation training, pre-examination meeting for students, markers and data Capturers; Establish the function of Irregularity Committee; Ensure proper administration of the examination unit; Manage all human, financial and other resources in the unit. Ensure record management and reporting every examination cycle. Execution of any other duties assigned.

af.title: Eksamensamptenare
af.summary: Eksamensamptenaar benodig by Central Johannesburg TVET College om eksamenpuntvaslegging, inskrywings, permitte en lokaalvoorbereiding op die ITS-stelsel te bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12/ Matrik-sertifikaat of NC (V) Vlak 4-sertifikaat. 'n Drie (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Bestuursassistent / Kantooradministrasie of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Ten minste 1 - 2 jaar se ervaring by 'n TVET College of in 'n opvoedkundige instelling. Kennis van White Paper on PSET. Kennis van die openbare TVET-sektor en sy regulatoriese en wetgewende raamwerk. Kennis en begrip van TVETMIS, en ITS, TVET Nasionale Eksamenbeleid, Government Gazette: Conduct of Examination, DHET Stiptheidsbeleid, Eksamenvereistes vir Eksamensentrums. Deeglike kennis van wetgewing wat eksamens en assesserings reguleer. Uitstekende rekenaarvaardighede/kennis van Microsoft Office-pakkette. Goeie leierskapsvaardighede. Vermoë om verslae te skryf. Moet onder druk, in 'n span, onafhanklik en vir langer ure kan werk. Gebruik probleemoplossingstegnieke om op 'n taktvolle wyse navrae/ kwessies aan te spreek. Vermoë om roetine-take uit te voer en sperdatums na te kom. Doeltreffende organisatoriese, administratiewe, tydbestuur-, kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik) en beplanningsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardig in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook en internet). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Opdatering en verifikasie van finale eksamenpunte op die ITS-stelsel; verifikasie van vasgelêde finale eksamenpunte. Leg eksameninskrywings op die ITS-stelsel vas. Uitreiking van termpuntstaatblaaie vir voltooiing en terugbesorging. Uitreiking van eksamenpermitte en voorbereiding van eksamenlokale om genoegsaam geskik te wees om eksamens te laat plaasvind. Stel die daaglikse eksamenverslae op en dien dit by die Kurrikulumimplementering in. Dien eksamenonreëlmatighede by die DHET Nasionaal en Eksamenonreëlmatigheidskomitee in. Verseker dat daar 'n gladde ontvangs, kollasie en versending van beide voltydse en deeltydse skrifte na die Nasionale Eksamennasieningsentrums is. Tree as 'n Distribusiepuntbestuurder gedurende die eksamenperiode. Hou toeveligting oor die implementering van DHET/College-bestuursplanne rakende eksamens. Wees die skakelpersoon tussen die kollege en DHET oor alle eksamenverwante aangeleenthede. Implementeer die kollege se eksamenverwante beleide. Verifieer en verklaar studente wat vir gradeplegtigheid kwalifiseer aan die gradeplegtigheidskomitee. Uitreiking van uitslaatafleidings, eksamenpermitte, sertifikate en diploma-aansoeke. Tydige voltooiing van voorlopige skedule om wysigings aan te bring en na die departement te stuur vir korreksies. Bystand met die indiening van uitstaande ICASS/POE's en hou elektroniese rekords. Uitvoering van eksamenpligte volgens die nasionale Eksamenbeleid vir National Certificate Vocational (NCV) en Report 191 (NATED). Aansoek doen om eksamenkessies by die DHET. Verseker die voorsiening van eksamendienste; fasiliteer die proses van toesighoueropleiding, pre-eksamenvergaderings vir studente, nasienaers en datavasleggers; vestig die funksie van die Onreëlmatigheidskomitee; Verseke behoorlike administrasie van die eksamenteenheid; Bestuur alle menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne in die eenheid. Verseker rekordbestuur en verslagdoening elke eksamensiklus. Uitvoering van enige ander toegewysde pligte.

xh.title: Ii-Officer zeNxaxheba
xh.summary: Kufunekwa i-officer yenxaxheba kwi-Central Johannesburg TVET College ukulawula ukungenisa amanqaku enxaxheba, ukubhalisa, iipermits nokulungiselela iindawo zenxaxheba kwinkqubo ye-ITS.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi seGrade 12/ Matric okanye isatifikedi se-NC (V) Level 4. I-National Diploma / Degree yeminyaka emithathu (3) kwize-Management Assistant / Office Administration okanye ngesikwalifelo esilinganayo. Ubuncinane ngamava eminyaka engu-1 - 2 kwikholejhi ye-TVET okanye kwindalo yo-gnxolo. Ulwazi nge-White Paper on PSET. Ulwazi ngesector ye-Public TVET nakumaziko alo okulawula nokuqambela umthetho. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-TVETMIS, ne-ITS, Ii-National Examination Policies ze-TVET, i-Government Gazette: Conduct of Examination, i-DHET Punctuality Policy, iimfuno zenxaxheba kumaziko e-Exam. Ulwazi olululo ngomthetho olawula iinxaxheba nokuhlola, amakhono amaninzi ekhompyutha/ulwazi lweenkqubo ze-Microsoft Office. Amakhono amahle okukhokela. Amandla okubhala iingxelo. Makakwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo, kwindyikitha, eyedwa nangamaxa amaninzi. Sebenzisa iindlela zokusombulula iingxaki ukuze ubhekise ngobubele kwiimbuzo / iinkxwaleko. Amandla okwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo nangokuzeledlane neemveliso. Amakhono abalulekileyo e-organisational, administration, time management, communication (verbal and written) neplanning. Ukuba lulwazi lwekhompyutha kwi-MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook nointanethi). Ilayisensi yomqhubi evumelekileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuhlaziya nokuqinisekisa amanqaku okugqibela enxaxheba kwinkqubo ye-ITS; ukuqinisekisa amanqaku okugqibela enxaxheba ayongenisiweyo. Ukungenisa ukubhalisa kwenxaxheba kwinkqubo ye-ITS. Ukuphiwa kwekati zamanqaku ethemu ezingeniswa nakuqhubeka zibuyiswa. Ukuphiwa kwee-permits zenxaxheba nolungiselela iindawo zenxaxheba zibe zilungele ukwenza iinxaxheba. Ukuqamba iingxelo zenyanga zangemini zenxaxheba kwaye zithunyelwe ku-Curriculum Implementation. Ukuthumela iingxaki zenxaxheba kwi-DHET National nakwi-Examination irregularity committee. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho ukwamkela, ukuqokelela nokuthumela ngokucothayo amaskripthi abo babexeshayo nabo bexeshana kumaziko okumaka i-National Examination. Ukuba ngumlawuli we-Distribution Point ngeloxesha lenxaxheba. Ukulawula ukusebenza kwe-DHET/College Management plans malunga neenxaxheba. Ukuba ngumntu oqhagamshelana phakathi kwekholejhi ne-DHET kuzo zonke izinto ezinxulumene nenxaxheba. Ukusebenzisa iindlenga ezinxulumene nenxaxheba zekholejhi. Ukuqinisekisa kwaza kubhengeza abafundi abafanelekayo ukugqibela kwikomiti yegraduation. Ukuphiwa kwe-statement of results, ii-exam permits, iisatifikedi nokufaka izicelo ze-diploma. Ukugqibelela ngexesha elifanelekileyo i-preliminary schedule ukwenza utshintsho kwaye ithunyelwe kwisebe ukulungisa. Ukuncedisa nokuthumela ezo-ICASS/POE ezingazange zithunyelwe kwaye kugcinwe irekhodi yazo yomabhalo. Ukwenza imisebenzi yenxaxheba ngokwe-National Examination Policy ye-National Certificate Vocational (NCV) ne-Report 191 (NATED). Ukufaka isicelo sokuncedwa senxaxheba kwi-DHET. Ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngeenkonzo zenxaxheba; ukuqhuba inkcubeko yokuzidla ngokuvavanywa kwe-invigilation training, iindibano zangaphambi kwenxaxheba zabafundi, abamaki nabaqoqi-bedatha; Ukuseka umba we-Irregularity Committee; Ukuqinisekisa ulawulo olufanelekileyo lowunyazo lwecxaxheba; Ukulawula onke amakhaya, ezo-mali nempilo yonke eminye imithombo klowunyazo. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawulwa kweerekhodi nokubika ngonyaka woxesha wenxaxheba. Ukuwenza nawuphi na umnye umsebenzi onikelweyo.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Central Johannesburg TVET College, Central Office
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 per annum (Level 05), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: Provide clerical and administrative support in demand and acquisition management at Central Johannesburg TVET College, capturing and maintaining procurement documentation.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification. A recognised post- school qualification in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Procurement, Public Management, Finance or a related field will be an added advantage. Basic knowledge of Supply Chain Management policies, procedures and practices. Basic knowledge and understanding of the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and applicable SCM prescripts. Knowledge of demand and acquisition, logistics, asset and inventory management processes will be an advantage. Computer literacy, particularly MS Word and MS Excel. Good communication, interpersonal and administrative skills. Good organisational and record-keeping skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Ability to work under pressure and meet prescribed deadlines.
jobs.duties: ender general Supply Chain Management clerical and administrative support. Provide clerical support in demand and acquisition management processes. Assist with the preparation, processing and recording of quotations and procurement documentation. Receive, capture, verify and maintain procurement-related documents and records. Provide logistical support relating to the receipt, storage and issuing of goods. Receive requests for goods and services from end users and process documentation accordingly. Maintain and update SCM registers, databases and filing systems. Assist with asset management, including verification and maintenance of asset records. Assist with stocktaking, inventory control and reconciliation of stock records. Receive and verify goods delivered by suppliers and maintain relevant records. Assist with the maintenance of supplier and contract-related records. Capture and update information on relevant electronic SCM systems. Ensure that SCM documentation is properly filed, scanned and retrievable. Provide administrative support to the Supply Chain Management Unit as required. Perform any other related duties assigned by the supervisor or manager.
jobs.applications: The Central Johannesburg TVET College (CJC) invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by clicking on this link https://cjcz83.ngnscan.co.za/apply
jobs.notes: Apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions. If you apply for the first time, you will be required to register by clicking the register button to register. After registering, you will be allowed to log in and apply for your chosen post (s). Upload the supporting document namely, a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. The shortlisted candidates will also be requested to submit confirmation or service letter from their previous employer, confirming their employment status/ history. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualification(s) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointment promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The college reserves the right not to make appointment. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. CJC is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements. Due to the college financial constraints, candidates will be responsible for their traveling and accommodation.

af.title: Voorsieningskettingklerk
af.summary: Verskaf klerklike en administratiewe ondersteuning in aanvraag- en verkrygingsbestuur by Central Johannesburg TVET College, deur inkoopdokumentasie vas te lê en te onderhou.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Senior Sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 'n Erkende post-skoolse kwalifikasie in Voorsieningskettingbestuur, Logistiek, Inkoop, Openbare Bestuur, Finansies of 'n verwante veld sal 'n voordeel wees. Basiese kennis van Voorsieningskettingbestuurbeleide, prosedures en praktyke. Basiese kennis en begrip van die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en toepaslike VKB-voorskrifte. Kennis van aanvraag en verkryging, logistiek, bates en voorraadbestuursprosesse sal 'n voordeel wees. Rekenaarvaardigheid, veral MS Word en MS Excel. Goeie kommunikasie, interpersoonlike en administratiewe vaardighede. Goeie organisatoriese en rekordhouvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en voorgeskrewe sperdatums na te kom.
af.duties: Verskaf algemene Voorsieningskettingbestuur-klerklike en administratiewe ondersteuning. Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning in aanvraag- en verkrygingsbestuursprosesse. Bystand verleen met die voorbereiding, verwerking en opname van kwotasies en inkoopdokumentasie. Ontvang, lê vas, verifieer en onderhou inkoopverwante dokumente en rekords. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuning met betrekking tot die ontvangs, berging en uitreiking van goedere. Ontvang versoeke vir goedere en dienste van eindgebruikers en verwerk dokumentasie dienooreenkomstig. Onderhou en werk VKB-registers, databasisse en lêerstelsels by. Bystand verleen met batesbestuur, insluitend verifikasie en onderhoud van bate-rekords. Bystand verleen met voorraadopname, voorraadbeheer en rekonsiliasie van voorraadrekords. Ontvang en verifieer goedere wat deur verskaffers gelewer word en onderhou tersaaklike rekords. Bystand verleen met die onderhoud van verskaffer- en kontrakverwante rekords. Lê inligting op toepaslike elektroniese VKB-stelsels vas en werk dit by. Verseker dat VKB-dokumentasie behoorlik geliasseer, gescan en ontrekbaar is. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Voorsieningskettingbestuureenheid soos vereis. Voer enige ander verwante pligte uit wat deur die toesighouer of bestuurder opgedra word.

zu.title: Umlobi Wezokulethwa Nokusatshaliswa Kwezimpahla
zu.summary: Nikela ngenkxaso yabahleli futhi ngokuphathwa kwezindaba ezikuwohloka kokuqondiswa nokutholwa kwezimpahla e-Central Johannesburg TVET College, ukubhala nokugcina amadokhumenti okuthenga izimpahla.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu noma izifundo ezilinganayo. Isitifiketi esivunyiwe sephasinda isikole kokuqondiswa nokusatshaliswa kwezimpahla, ukulethwa kwezimpahla, ukuthenga izimpahla, ukuphathwa kwezomphakathi noma izimali noma indawo ehlobene kuzoba yindlela ekungeza inzuzo. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana namapholisi, izinqubo nezindlela zokuqondiswa nokusatshaliswa kwezimpahla. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo nokuzuqonda i-PFMA, Izimiso Zezimali Zesikhwama namapholisi ahlobene nokuqondiswa nokusatshaliswa kwezimpahla. Ulwazi ngokuqondiswa nokutholwa kwezimpahla, ukulethwa kwezimpahla, amafa nokuqondiswa kokugcinwa kwempahla kuzoba yindlela ekungeza inzuzo. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha, ikakhulukazi i-MS Word ne-MS Excel. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, nokuba nobuhlobo kanye nokuphathwa kwezindaba. Amakhono amahle okuhlela nokugcina amarekhodi. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi nokuhlangabezana namadebayidi abekiwe.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokwesijwayezo ngenkxaso yokuhlela nokuphathwa kwezindaba ekuqondisweni nokusatshalisweni kwezimpahla. Nikela ngenkxaso yokuhlela kumaprocessi okuqondiswa nokutholwa kwezimpahla. Siza ekulungiseni, ekucubunguleni nasekubhaleni amasikweleti namadokhumenti okuthenga izimpahla. Thola, bhala, qinisekisa futhi ugcinwe amadokhumenti namarekhodi ahlobene nokuthenga izimpahla. Nikela ngenkxaso yokulethwa kwezimpahla mayelana nokwamukelwa, ukugcinwa nokukhiqizwa kwempahla. Thola izicelo zezimpahla nezinkonzo kubasebenzisi bakuqala ubhalise amadokhumenti ngokufanele. Gcina futhi ubuyekeze okubhalisiwe, izizinda solwazi namasistimu okugcina amafayela e-SCM. Siza ekuphathweni kwempahla, okuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa nokugcina amarekhodi empahla. Siza ekubaleni izimpahla, ekulawuleni izimpahla ezikhona nasekuqondiseni amarekhodi wempahla. Thola futhi qinisekise izimpahla ezithunyelwe abahlinzeli zigcinwe amarekhodi ahlobene. Siza ekugcineni amarekhodi ahlobene nabahlinzeli namasivini. Bhala futhi ubuyekeze ulwazi kwamasistimu we-elekthronikhi we-SCM ahlobene. Qinisekisa ukuthi amadokhumenti we-SCM abhalwe ngendlela efanele, askanwe futhi angatholakala kalula. Nikela ngenkxaso yokuphathwa kwezindaba kwiNyuko Yokuphathwa Kokulethwa Nokusatshaliswa Kwezimpahla njengoba kudingeka. Yipho namanye amaphuzu ahlobene anikwe umphathi noma umphathi jikelele ukuthi awenze.

xh.title: Ileki yokuLawula ukuHambela kolwandle ngamathani
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yenkonzo yofele kunye nolawulo ekuqweni nokulawuleni ukufunyanwa kwayo nokutengiswa koluntu kwi Central Johannesburg TVET College, ukubhala nokugcina ixwebhu lokutenga.
xh.requirements: Ithoba leyesi 12/Isetifikathi esiphakamileyo okanye isiqu esilinganayo. Isiqu esaziwayo senkolo esingaphandle kwesikolo sokulawula ukuhamba kolwandle ngamathani, ukulawulwa kwemizekelo, ukutengiswa, ulawulo loluntu, ezimali okanye elidingo elicohliweyo siza kuba luluncedo. Ulwazi olusetyenziswa ngokulawula iinqobo zeenkqubo nokuzilolonga kwangaphambili kwesikolo sika供应链 Management, iindlela zokwenza izinto, namalungu ahamba phambili axela imisebenzi eqengqelekayo ekugqibeleni koluntu. Ulwazi lokuqonda kwaye ulazi iinkqubo ezibhekisa kwizikhwama zokusetyenziswa kwezi ntho ngokukhawuleza okanye ngokutsha komzimba okulungelelanisiweyo njengoko kuqatshelwe kuluntu, ngokutsha kwamathanga ezinkqubo ezibalulekileyo koluntu, ngaphakathi kwekhaya elisebenzayo elidala. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha ngokukodwa kwi MS Word kunye ne MS Excel. Ikhono elihle lokuzithethela nabantu, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezihamba phambili ekubeni ngumntu osahlukeneyo nomnye kwinani elincinci. Ikhono elihle lokuzihlenga iinkqubo ezihamba phambili koluntu namathuba ahamba phambili. Ulwazi lokwenza umsebenzi ngokutsha kwexesha elifanelekileyo nelityhafayo. Ulwazi lokuzimela ngokutsha emsebenzini wakho nokutsha kwabanye emsebenzini.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yenkonzo efanelekileyo koluntu. Nika inkxaso kwizicelo ezifike ngomsebenzi ophakathi koluntu. Yenza isicelo sokwenza imisebenzi kwaye udibanise iinkcukacha ezifunwa ngumsebenzi kwindawo engahlelwayo. Yamkela iinkcukacha ezifunwa ngumsebenzi wakho ophakathi koluntu kwaye uzigcine uzinceda. Nika ulwazi oluqinileyo ngelixa ulungiselela inkxaso kwilizwe lonke eliqondwa yiNkqubo. Phakamisa inkxaso kwizicelo eziza kwindawo ngokutsha kwelizwe elisebenzayo kwaye ulungiselele imisebenzi yalawo mzeko ngokutsha kwelizwe elisebenzayo. Gcina ulwazi olutsha koluntu nolunye iinkqubo ezihamba phambili koluntu. Nceda ulungele inkxaso ngokutsha kwezinto ezahlukeneyo ezihamba phambili koluntu kwaye ulungelele izitsha ezahlukeneyo eziyakusetyenziswa koluntu. Gcina ulungelelaniso ngokutsha kwelizwe kwaye ulungele inkxaso ehamba phambili koluntu ekunzima ukuyiseka. Nika inkxaso ngokutsha koluntu ekulungelelweni koluntu eqengqelekayo kwaye udibanise ulwazi olutsha koluntu. Yenza iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezihamba phambili ngokutsha kwelizwe koluntu kwaye ulungele ulwazi ngemisebenzi yakho. Phakamisa inkxaso ngokutsha koluntu ekulungelelweni koluntu elibhala iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo koluntu ngokutsha koluntu. Nceda ulungele izicelo eziza kwindawo ngokutsha koluntu kwaye ulungelele imisebenzi yakho koluntu. Sebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezingalunganga ezihamba phambili ngokutsha koluntu kwaye ulungele inkxaso ngokutsha koluntu ngokutsha koluntu.

xh.title: Mmeli wezeMali
xh.summary: Kufuneka kusityeke uMmeli wezeMali kwi-Central Johannesburg TVET College ukugcina irekhodi yezemali, iinkqubo zokugcina iifayile, noku nikela inkxaso kumashishini okufumanisa kunye nokuhlawula imali, nakwindlela yokuthenga ibhalwe ngexesha.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 /Senior Certificate okanye esinye isiqinisekiso esinamandla afanayo. I-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) okanye i-bachelor's degree kwilamulo lezemali, ukuBala, okanye ngesiNqinisekiso esinxulumene nalo. Nokuba inqanelo lobomi obungaphezulu kwesisihla s1 kwizemali okwilamabala elinxulumene nokubala, ukuqonda okusiseko ngemisebenzi yezemali, iinkqubo nokwazi ukugcina idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa iinkcazelo ezimalini, ulwazi olusiseko ngezithetho, iinkqubo kunye noLweso-mthetho lweliQhawe laseBurhulumente (PFMA, GRAP, CET ACT 16 OF 2006). Iimpawu zokuSebenza, Iakhobhathi kunye namakhono: Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nqamlezo nemiqathango esisiseko yezemali, ikakhulu ikhono lokwenza umsebenzi ngokwaneleyo nangendlela ecwelwayo nangantsixa nangantsixa phantsi koxinzelelo, amakhono onxibelelwano olubhalwayo noluthethwayo, ukuziphatha ngendlela echanekileyo kwii-MS office suite, ulwazi nge-ITS luya kuba lusisongezo.
xh.duties: Gcina uluhlu olulungeleyo Iwesayensi ngokutsha jike ngesiga kwiinkcukacha zokusingathwa. Yenza uluhlu olukhawulezayo nechanekekileyo kwiindlela zokubeka ixesha elo zotywe ngalo ukugcina inkcazelo ngemali. Sebenza kakhulu ngakumbi nomsebenzi onxulumene noMmeli-wochongo kumashishini obandakanya amaxwebhu olawulo malunga nokugcinwa koluntu nolungeniswayo Iwabatali kunye nephulo lesiNqamlezo eziko imali.

af.title: Finansieklerk
af.summary: Finansieklerk benodig by Central Johannesburg TVET College om finansiële rekords en lêerstelsels te onderhou, en ontvangbare rekeninge, betaalbare rekeninge enverkope-bedrywighede te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Graad 12 /Senior Sertifikaat of ekwivalent. 'n Drie (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma/baccalaureusgraad in finansiële bestuur, Rekeningkunde, of verwante kwalifikasie. Ten minste 1 jaar se ervaring in finansies of 'n rekeningkundige verwante veld. Basiese begrip van finansiële funksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en finansiële inligting bye te bring. Basiese kennis van die Openbare Diens se finansiële wetgewing, prosedures en Tesourie Regulasies (PFMA, GRAP, CET ACT 16 OF 2006). Bevoegdhede, Vermoëns en Vaardighede: Kennis van basiese finansiële beginsels en prosedures, vermoë om voldoende en metodies onder druk te funksioneer, mondelinge en geskrewe kommunikasievaardighede, bedryflikheid in MS office suite. Kennis van ITS sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Onderhou opdatum rekords vir beide ontvangbare en betaalbare rekeninge. Onderhou 'n sistematiese en akkurate lêerstelsel vir alle finansiële dokumentasie, insluitend fakture, kwitansies en betalingsrekords. Werk nou saam met die finansiespan, die registrateur se kantoor en dieverkope-afdelings om vlotte bedrywighede en tydige verwerking van finansiële transaksies te verseker. Verskaf noodsaaklike dokumentasie en ondersteuning gedurende interne en eksterne oudits wat verband hou met ontvangbare en betaalbare rekeninge.

zu.title: Ikliliki Ezezimali
zu.summary: Ikliliki Ezezimali ifuna ibe e-Central Johannesburg TVET College ukugcina izinketholo ezezimali, izinhlelo zokuqonda amafayela, kanye nokusekela imisebenzi yokuthola nokukhokha imali kanye nokuzelelwa kwemikhiqizo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 /I-Senior Certificate noma okulingana nayo. I-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) noma ibachelor's degree kumanqement ezimali, e-Accounting, noma izifundo ezihlobene nalezondaba. Okungenani ungamuhla weminyaka engu-1 wokuhlola kuqoqo lezezimali noma i-Accounting, Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngemisebenzi ezezimali, izendlela zokwenza kanye namandla okungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa ulwazi lwezimali, Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemithetho, izinqubo namandla okuqondisa ezezimali aseKhomishini Yomphakathi (PFMA, GRAP, CET ACT 16 OF 2006). Ikhono, amandla nanhlahlathimilo: Ulwazi ngemiqondo nezinqubo ezezimali eziyisisekelo, amandla okusebenza ngokwanele nangendlela eqondile ngaphansi kwezinga eliphezulu, ikhono lokuxhumana nokubhuka ngokushaywayo nokubhaliwe, ukukhuzeka kwi-MS office suite, Ulwazi nge-ITS kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe.
zu.duties: Gcina izinketholo ezibukekile zokuthola nokukhokha imali. Gcina isinhlelo esiqondile nesibukekile sokuphatha amafayela yonke imibhalo ezezimali, okuhlanganisa ama-invoices, izitshulu zokuqinisekisa ukukhokha, kanye nemitjhadoro yokukhokha. Sebenza kakhulu phakathi komgange wetemali, ihhovisi lesibhalwa sezentengiselwano, namanyango wokuthola imikhiqizo ukunqininkisa ukuthi kuhamba kahle konke nokuthi kucutshungwa ngokushesha imisebenzi yemali ethunyelwayo. Hlinzeka ngemibhalo edingekayo nokusekela ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwangaphakathi nangaphandle okuhlobene nama-accounts okuthola nokukhokha imali.

jobs.title: Drivers
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Central Johannesburg TVET College, Central Office
jobs.salary_text: R201 093 per annum (Level 04), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: Drive vehicles to transport passengers and deliver mail at Central Johannesburg TVET College, requiring a code 10 licence and PDP.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 / Std 8 qualification. A valid code 10 / EC1 driver’s licence. Valid Professional Driving Permit (PDP). 2-5years relevant experience. Knowledge: Knowledge of relevant legislation, prescripts, policies and procedures. Knowledge of procedure for motor maintenance of motor vehicle. Knowledge of storage requirement. Knowledge of messenger services. Knowledge of routing office support i.e. registry. Knowledge of secondary function of making copies. Knowledge of procedure to operate the motor. Knowledge of procedure to obtain trip authorization. Knowledge of completion of logbook of the motor vehicle. Knowledge of writing of fuel consumables. Knowledge of writing of kilometres services. Skills: Driving, reading, writing, fixing/ changing flat tyres, and cleaning of vehicles.
jobs.duties: Drive light and heavy motor vehicles to transport passengers and deliver other items (mail and documents). Do routine maintenance on the allocated vehicle and report defects timely. Complete all the required and prescribed records and logbooks regarding the vehicle and the goods that you handle. Render a clerical support to the relevant office. Provide a massager service in the relevant office. This would, inter alia, entail assisting in the registry; assist with photocopying and faxing document as well as collecting and delivering documentation and related items in the college.

af.title: Bestuurders
af.summary: Bestuur voertuie om passasiers te vervoer en pos by Central Johannesburg TVET College af te lewer, waarvoor 'n kode 10 lisensie en PDP vereis word.
af.requirements: Grade 10 / Std 8 kwalifikasie. 'n Geldige kode 10 / EC1 bestuurderslisensie. Geldige Professional Driving Permit (PDP). 2-5years relevante ervaring. Kennis: Kennis van relevante wetgewing, voorskrifte, beleide en prosedures. Kennis van prosedure vir motoronderhoud van motorvoertuig. Kennis van bergingsvereistes. Kennis van boodskapperdienste. Kennis van roouteringskantoorondersteuning d.w.s. register. Kennis van sekondêre funksie van maak van kopieë. Kennis van prosedure om die motor te bedryf. Kennis van prosedure om ritmagtiging te verkry. Kennis van voltooiing van logboek van die motorvoertuig. Kennis van aan te teken brandstofverbruik. Kennis van aan te teken kilometerdienste. Vaardighede: Bestuur, lees, skryf, herstel/vervang van plat bande, en skoonmaak van voertuie.
af.duties: Bestuur ligte en swaar motorvoertuie om passasiers te vervoer en ander items (pos en dokumente) af te lewer. Doen roetine-onderhoud aan die toegewysde voertuig en rapporteer gebreke betyds. Voltooi al die vereiste en voorgeskrewe rekords en logboeke aangaande die voertuig en die goedere wat jy hanteer. Lewer kantoorondersteuning aan die relevante kantoor. Verskaf 'n boodskapperdiens in die relevante kantoor. Dit sal onder andere behels om in die register behulpzaam te wees; help met fotokopiëring en faks van dokumente asook die versamel en aflewer van dokumentasie en verwante items by die kollege.

zu.title: Abashayeli
zu.summary: Shayela izimoto ukuthutha abagibeli nokuletha iposi e-Central Johannesburg TVET College, kudingeka ilayisensi ye-code 10 ne-PDP.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ze-Grade 10 / Std 8. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela ye-code 10 / EC1. I-Professional Driving Permit (PDP) evumelekile. Uzotho iminyaka engu-2-5 ohambweni ngokushayela. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngemithetho, izimiso namaphoyisa ahlobene nokushayela. Ulwazi ngenqubo yokugcina kuhle izimoto. Ulwazi ngemfuneko yokugcina izinto. Ulwazi ngabenikeli besevisi. Ulwazi ngenqubo yokusekela ihhovisi njengeregistry. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokwenza amakhophi. Ulwazi ngenqubo yokuphatha izimoto. Ulwazi ngenqubo yokuthola mvume yokuhamba. Ulwazi nge-logbook yemoto. Ulwazi ngokubhala ukusetshenziswa kwaphephula. Ulwazi ngokubhala amakhilomitha asetshenziswa. Amakhono: Ukushayela, ukufunda, ukubhala, ukulungisa / ukushintsha amataya, nokuhamba ngemoto ekwenziwe kuhle.
zu.duties: Shayela izimoto ezincane nezinkulu ukuthutha abagibeli nokuletha ezinye izinto (iposi namadokhumenti). Yenza ukugcina kuhle izimoto ezinikeziwe ubike ngesikhathi ngemikhiqizo ephukileyo. Qedela yonke imibhalo namalogbook ahlayo ngeimoto nangalezinto ezisezandleni zakho. Nikela ngokusekela okubhalwe ibhuku ehhovisi elithile. Nikela ngesisebenzi sokuthutha ehhovisi elithile. Lokhu kubandakanya, phakathi kwakunye, ukusizaeregistry; ukusiza ngokwenza amakhophi nokuthumela amafeksi okhumentu kanye nokuthola nokuletha okhumentu nezinto ezingeyohlobo ekolishi.

xh.title: Abayali
xh.summary: Kuba shishi kunye nokuhamba abagqithi kwaye kulethe iposi kwi Central Johannesburg TVET College, kufuneka kube nalayisensi ye code 10 kunye ne PDP.
xh.requirements: Isifundo se Grade 10 / Std 8. Ilayisensi ye code 10 / EC1 esemthethweni. Ilayisensi yokushayela ngobungcali (PDP) esemthethweni. Isipho sobuchule se 2-5years. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngemithetho, imigaqo, iinkqubo namalungiselelo ahambelana nalo. Ulwazi lenkqubo yolondolozo lwemoto. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokugcina izinto. Ulwazi lweenkonzo zomthunywa. Ulwazi lokuqhelisa inkxaso yehovisi njengoko kwenza ibali. Ulwazi lomsebenzi wokwenza iikopi. Ulwazi lenkqubo yokusebenzisa imoto. Ulwazi lenkqubo yokuwfumana igunya lokuhamba. Ulwazi lokugqibezela ileyibhuku yemoto. Ulwazi lokubhala ngokusetyenziswa kwamafutha. Ulwazi lokubhala ngeekhilomitha. Amapasi: Ukushayela, ukufunda, ukubhala, ukulungisa / ukutshintsha amataya adolophayo, nokucoca izithuthi.
xh.duties: Shayela izithuthi ezazisisindo nangobukhulu bazo kuze kuhambe abantu kwaye uze ulethe ezinye izinto (iposi namaxatiba). Yenza ulondolozo olumiselwe kwisithuthi esinikiweyo kwaye uchaze impazamo ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Gqibezela zonke iirekhodi neleyibhuku ezifunekayo nemelelwa ngokumalunga ngesithuthi nangamashishini okuphatha. Nikeza inkxaso yenhlanganiselo kwofiso elifanelekileyo. Nikeza inkonzo yomthunywa kulawo ofiso. Oku kuya kubandakanya ukuncedisa kwibali; ukuncedisa ngeendlela zokwenza iikopi nokuwathumela iifeksi, njengoko nakokuba kukuthutha nokuletha iindokhumenti nemicimbini ehambelana nayo kulolandiso.

jobs.title: Handyman

jobs.centre: Central Johannesburg TVET College, Central Office

jobs.summary: Handyman position at Central Johannesburg TVET College requiring Grade 12 and a plumbing, electrical or carpentry qualification to perform general building maintenance duties.

A recognised Trade test certificate will be advantageous. 0-6 months’ experience in similar working environment. Knowledge of building maintenance. Knowledge building laws; safe keeping of tools, storage, and equipment. Computer literacy and basic software (outlook, Excel, and word). Communication skills, team participation, reliability innovative. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements. A valid driver’s licence may be an advantage (Code 10 / EC1)
jobs.duties: Execute minor general building and maintenance equipment, attend to minor plumbing, electrical capacity, and handyman. Conduct routine weekly and monthly inspections of the building. Conduct inspection to determine defects. Repair broken furniture. Paint buildings as per request. Ensure tools are cleaned and stored in a safe environment. Maintain main kitchen fat drain. Clean gutters. Maintain storm water channels. Report the need for major maintenance to the supervisor. Perform any other ad hock activities in relation to functions attached to this post. Repair furniture and paint buildings as per request. Ensure tools are cleaned and restored in a safe environment.

zu.title: Umuntu ongaphandle nhlangothi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somuntu ongapanhlangothi e-Central Johannesburg TVET College esifuna i-Grade 12 nesiqu sokuhamba amathuluzi, kagesi noma ukushicilela kwemithetho ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi jikelele yokugcinwa kwesakhiwo.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate/ Grade 12/ Standard 10 noma okulinganayo. Isiqu sokuhamba amathuluzi, kagesi noma ukushicilela kwemithetho. Isitifikedi samabhizinisi esimtolo ngokusekelwa. Ukushesha okuphelele kwethuluzi zomsebenzi ngokuhlangenwe ekuhambeni. Iminikelo yekhono: i-Occupational Health and Safety Act; ulwazi ngokuthi yini ukusakaza amathuluzi, ulwazi ngokuthi yini imithetho yezezimali; ulwazi ngokuthi yini izakhiwo ezivela ezinkundleni. Ulwazi ngemithetho yokuqinisekisa izinto. Ulwazi ngokugcinwa kwesakhiwo. Ulwazi ngemithetho yesakhiwo; ukugcinwa okuphephile kwethuluzi, ukulondoloza, kanye nemishini. Ulwazi lokusetshenziswa ikhompyutha kanye nesofthiwe esiyisisekelo (i-outlook, Excel, kanye neword). Amakhono okuxhumana, ukubamba iqhaza eqenjini, ukuthembeka okushintshashintshayo. Bonke abantu abakhethiwe bayokwenza isivivinyo sokungenisa esingaphambilini njengengxenye yendlela yokuhlola ukuze kutholwe ukufaneleka komuntu ophakanyiswayo ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zobuchwepheshezejikelele zalesi sikhundla. Ivaraythi yelayisensi yokushayela ingaba yinzuzo (i-Code 10 / EC1)
zu.duties: Qhuba umsebenzi omncane jikelele wezokwakha nokugcinwa kwemishini, uphathe izinto ezincane zezimblini, kagesi, futhi ube ngumuntu ongapanhlangothi. Yenza ukuphenya ngajikelele ngesonto nangenyanga kwesakhiwo. Bika ukunyakaza kungemthetho kwemishini. Bika ukulimele ukukhwabanisa impahla neminikelo. Yenza ukugcinwa okuncane okunjengokuvula izinkulungwane, i-urinal namathoyilethi. Beka amathambo amatsha. Yenza ukuphenya ukuze kutholwe iziphazamisi. Lungisa ithuluzi eliphusile. Phenda izakhiwo njengoba kuceliwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izithuli zihlanzekile futhi zibekwe endaweni ephephile. Gcina isikhululo esiyinhloko samafutha esikhicheni. Hlanza amagodo. Gcithe amabhakede amanzi. Bika isidingo sokugcinwa okukhulu kumphathi. Yenza noma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi ebolele kule nsiza ebambeze leli sikhundla. Lulunga ithuluzi futhi phende izakhiwo njengoba kuceliwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izithuli zihlanzekile futhi zibuyiselwe endaweni ephephile.

xh.title: Umanyano wokuQwalasela
xh.summary: Isithuba somanyano wokuQwalasela kwiCentral Johannesburg TVET College sifuna isiQinisekiso seGredi 12 nesitifikhethi sokubumba amanzi, kagesi okanye kokwenza iinkuni ukwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo yokunonophela iinfoquo zokwakha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sikaMazwe iQela eliPhakamileyo/ iGredi 12/ iStandard 10 okanye into efanayo. Isitifikhethi kwinkqubo yokubumba amanzi, kagesi okanye kokwenza iinkuni. Isatifikethi esamkelweyo sovavayo lobugcisa siza kuba lusizo. Unyaka wokuqonda o0-6 ngenyawo kulawo mmandla okufanayo wokusebenza. Amaphepha nokuziphatha: uMthetho woKwakhwa nokhoLiseka koMsebenzi, ulwazi lokusebenzisa izixhobo ezisandla namandla, ulwazi ngendlela ebeswe zifakelwe iinfoquo zokwakha. Ulwazi ngamagunya eemayikhro-inkqubo. Ulwazi lokunonophela iinfoquo zokwakha. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokwakhiwa; ukugcina izixhobo ngokhuseleko, ukugcina, nempahla. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kunye nesoftware esiseko (i-outlook, i-Excel, ne-word). Isakhono sokunxibelelana, inkxaso ekwindlu, ukuthembeka nokusuka. Bonke abagqithiswe baza kwenza uvavayo olusezantsi ngokuphumelelayo njengenxalenye yendlela yokuvakalatha ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza komsebenzi usekelwe kwiimfuno zobuchule kunye nabo bana bebuziweyo kulesi sithuba. Ilayisenisi yomqeshi esemthethweni inokuba lusizo (iKhowudi 10 / EC1)
xh.duties: Ukuphumeza imisebenzi encinci eqhelekileyo yokuakha nokunonophela inkqubo, ukuqwalasela imisebenzi encinci yokubumba amanzi, kagesi, nobugcisa bokwenza zonke iinkqubo. Ukwenza ukuqwalasela okupheleleyo ngesonto nakwenyanga kwakuyo infoquo yokwakha. Ukuchaza umnqweno ongavunyelwanga wentshukumo yempahla. Ukuchaza ukonakaliswa ngenjongo kwempahla nakumagugu. Ukuqwalasela ukunonophela okuncinci ukuz. ukuvula iziphango, ama-urinary nakwisebele. Ukutshintsha amacwecwe. Ukuqwalasela ukuqinisekisa iziphazamiso. Kulungisa iinkqubo ezingasebenziyo zomzimba weMeko. Uyipethe iinkqubo zakho njengoko celwayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izixhobo zihlanjwa zigcinwe kwilaba elikhuselekileyo. Ukunonophela isiphango esikhulu sesinki ekhichini. Ukucoca izigqoki. Ukunonophela imixholo yamanzi iphela. Ukuchaza izifiso zokunonophela okukhulu kumlawuli wemisebenzi. Ukwenza nasiphi na isenzo ngexesha elifutshane kubhalwe kwipateni kwiindawo ezinye ezikulo esi sithuba. Ukulungisa impahla yakho eendawini eziphukileyo uyipethe iinkqubo zakho njengoko celwayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izixhobo zihlanjwa zibuyiselwe kwilaba elikhuselekileyo.

af.title: Handwerkman
af.summary: Handwerkman-pos by Central Johannesburg TVET College vereis Graad 12 en 'n loodgieter-, elektriese of skrynwerkkwalifikasie om algemene gebou-onderhoudspligte te verrig.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/ Graad 12/ Standaard 10 of gelykwaardig. 'n Kwalifikasie in loodgieterswerk, elektrisiteit of skrynwerkersertifikaat. 'n Erkende ambagsertifikaat sal voordelig wees. 0-6 maande se ervaring in 'n soortgelyke werksomgewing. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, kennis van hoe om hand- en kraggereedskap te gebruik, kennis van gebou-infrastruktuuruitlegte. Kennis van infrastruktuurbeleid. Kennis van gebouonderhoud. Kennis van gebouwette; veilige berging van gereedskap, stoor en toerusting. Rekenaarvaardigheid en basiese sagteware (outlook, Excel en word). Kommunikasievaardighede, spandeelname, betroubaarheid, innoverend. Alle kortlyskandidate sal 'n voor-toetreding praktiese oefening onderneem as deel van die assesseringsmetode om die kandidaat se geskiktheid te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie kan 'n voordeel wees (Kode 10 / EC1)
af.duties: Voer algemene gebou- en onderhoudstoerusting uit, hanteer geringe loodgieterswerk, elektriese vermoë en handwerkman-take. Voer roetine weeklikse en maandelikse inspeksies van die gebou uit. Rapporteer ongemagtigde beweging van toerusting. Rapporteer opsetlike skade aan eiendom en bates. Verrig geringe onderhoud d.w.s. ontstop dreine, urinele en toilette. Vervang kraane. Voer inspeksie uit om defekte te bepaal. Herstel gebreekte meubels. Verf geboue soos versoek. Verseker dat gereedskap skoongemaak en in 'n veilige omgewing gestoor word. Onderhou hoofkombuis vetdrein. Maak dakgotte skoon. Onderhou stormwaterkanale. Rapporteer die behoefte aan groot onderhoud aan die toesighouer. Verrig enige ander ad hoc-aktiwiteite in verband met funksies wat aan hierdie pos verbonde is. Herstel meubels en verf geboue soos versoek. Verseker dat gereedskap skoongemaak en in 'n veilige omgewing herstel is.

Promote legal awareness and understanding across the department and among stakeholders. Engage with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective legal advisory support.
