af.title: Direkteur: Regs- en Ondersoekdienste
af.summary: 'n Direkteur word gesoek om strategiese leierskap te bied vir Regs- en Ondersoekadviesdienste by die Independent Police Investigative Directorate in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n LLB/ B. Proc.-graad (NQF7) soos deur SAQA erken. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Bestuurslisensie. Toegelate prokureur/advokaat met relevante ervaring as 'n praktiserende prokureur of advokaat. Kennisvereistes: Kennis en begrip van die IPID-wet, PFMA en ander relevante wetgewing en regulasies wat die Openbare Diens regeer, insluitend kennis van korporatiewe en administratiewe reg. Litigasie-ervaring in die hantering van korrupsie/sistemiese korrupsiesake. Ervaring in die opstel van wetgewing, ondergeskikte wetgewing en/of ondersoeke en Standaardbedryfsprosedures. Begrip van die kernprioriteite van regering. Kennis van Suid-Afrikaanse reg en siviele prosedures. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskapsvaardighede. Analitiese denke. Beplanning en organisering. Probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Innovasie en kreatiwiteit. Regshofadministrasie-vaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Strategiese beplanningsvaardighede. Vermoë om reg te interpretereer. Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Verslagskryfvaardighede. Die vermoë om die reg te interpreteer en te ondersoek. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Veranderingsbestuursvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Kliëntoriëntasie en klieNSfokus. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Strategiese leierskap en beplanning: Bied strategiese rigting vir die eenheid Regs- en Ondersoekadviesdienste. Identifiseer prioriteitsgebiede en formuleer doelwitte en die departement se strategiese doelstellings. Monitor, evalueer en rapporteer oor die prestasie van die komponent teenoor operasionele doelwitte. Regsbeleidontwikkeling en -bestuur: Vestig, hersien en handhaaf regbeleide, stelsels en prosesse in ooreenstemming met toepaslike regulasies en beste praktyke. Rig die implementering van regsprosedures, stelsels en interne kontroles om nakoming en doeltreffendheid te verseker. Stel praktyknotas en direktiewe op om regs- en ondersoekpraktyke te lei. Regsadvies en wetgewingsondersteuning: Hersien en verskaf regsmenings, advies, korrespondensie om gehaltebeheer en nakoming van wetgewing, regulasies en departementele beleide te verseker. Voer regsnavorsing uit en verskaf aanbevelings oor konsepwetgewing en regulasie-raamwerke. Verseker belyning van regsadvies met departementele en nasionale regsstandaarde. Ondersoekregsaansiens: Rig en bestuur die verwerking van aansoeke om beleidvoogde in ooreenstemming met regsmagte. Hou toesig oor en bestuur administratiewe appèlle en verseker prosesmatige billikheid en regsnakoming. Verskaf regsaansiens en leiding by ondersoeke en verseker nakoming van regsstandaarde en etiese praktyke. Hou toesig oor, bestuur en verbeter die verwerking van PAIA-versoeke binne 30 dae van ontvangs. Regskapasiteit en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid: Voer werkswinkels en oefensessies oor regspraktyknotas en -direktiewe uit. Bevordel regsbewustheid en -begrip regdeur die departement en onder belanghebbendes. Raak betrokke by interne en eksterne belanghebbendes om doeltreffende regsadviesondersteuning te verseker.

zu.title: Umdweba: Isevisi Yomthetho Nokuphenya
zu.summary: Sifuna uMdweba wokunikeza ubuholi obusesiphilweni kwisevisi yokunika izeluleko zomthetho nokuphenya e-Independent Police Investigative Directorate e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-LLB/ B. Proc. (NQF7) njengoba kuqashwe yi-SAQA. 5 iminyaka yohlelo ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi/phezulu. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba. I-Attorney/Advocate evunyiwe ohambisana nalohlelo njengoba kukhomba umthetho. Izidingo zokuqonda: Ulwazi nokuqonda i-IPID Act, i-PFMA kanye Neminye imithetho elandelayo eqamba umthetho wobuso, okuhambisana nolwazi lomthetho wenkampani nomthetho wocingo. Uholo lwezinhlelo zokuphenya ezibhekene nezenzo ezingcolile/ezinkambu. Uholo lwezinhlelo zokuphenya oluthwese iNQF7 imithetho okuzinzileyo nesigcini seetheses zotho. Ulwazi lomthetho waseNingizimu Africa kanye nezinqubo ezingowiso. Amandla weze Ngqondweni: Amandla wokuhlela amakha amandla okubaluleka kakhulu. Ukucabanga okukhululekile. Ukucutshungula futh uhlele. Isixazululo somthetho kanye namandla okwenza iziqombo. Isipho kanye nobuciko bomthetho. Amandla wokulawula inkantolo yomthetho. Amandla okuphatha imigwaqo. Amandla wokucazula imigomo. Amandla okuhumusha umthetho. Amandla okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuKhulunywa). Amandla okubhala imibiko. Amandla okuhumusha kanye nokucwaninga umthetho. Amandla okuphatha imigwaqo. Amandla okuxhumana ngokuzwana. Ukwethembeka nokungcolile. Amandla okushintsha okubhalwe. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha, amandla okuphatha imali. Uqondisise kumthengi kanye nokubukela umthengi. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
zu.duties: Ukubusa ngokubaluleke kwezinhlelo kanye noKuhlelela: Nikeza isiqondiso esibaluleke kwezinhlelo kwilungu leMinyuzo kanye Nesevisi Yokuphenya. Zikhomba izindawo eziphambili futhi wakhe imigomo namagugu abaluleke kwezinhlelo womnyango. Qaphela, hlola futh wenze umbiko ngezenzakalo elungwini uma kuqhathaniswa nemigomo yamasebenzi. Ukuthuthukiswa kokumiswa kwemithetho kahulumeni kanye noKulawula: Misa, hlola, futhi gcina izinkambiso zomthetho, izinhlelo namasu ngokuhambisana nemithetho elandelayo nendlela ehamba phambili. Qondisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo zomthetho, izinhlelo nokulawula okwangaphakathi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthobela kanye nokusebenza kahle. Bala amanothi wokuqamba izindlela nomyalo osekela ukwenza komthetho kanye nokuphenya. Iminyuzo kanye noKwesekwa komthetho: Hlola futhi nikeza izinhlamvu zomthetho, izeluleko, ukuthumelana izincwadi ukuze kuqiniseke ukulawula ikhwalithi nokuqinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho, imithetho, kanye nezinkambiso zomnyango. Yenza ucwaningo lomthetho futhi unikeze izincomo ngabomthetho abalwayo kanye nezinhlelo zomthetho. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana kwezeluleko zomthetho kwezinga elincane lomnyango nelinguzwelonke. Ukubuka ngokomthetho ukuphenya okusemthethweni: Qondisa futh uphathwe izicelo zamandla okhokho emthethweni ngokuhambisana nemiyalo yomthetho. Qaphela futhi uphathe izikhalazo zobuso, ukuqinisekisa ubulungiswa bezinqubo nokuthobela umthetho. Nikeza ukubuka ngokomthetho nesiqondiso ekuphenyeni, ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana kwezinga lomthetho nokuqamba izindlela okusesibiyeni. Qaphela, phatha futh ithuthukise ukuthuthwa kwezicelo ze-PAIA ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 zokuthola isicelo. Ikhono lomthetho nokuXhumanisa nabathintekayo: Yenza izikhungazisi futhi amasezsensi okololwa ngenothi zokwenza komthetho umyalo. Khuthaza ukuqonda komthetho nokukuqonda umnyango wonke nakubathintekayo. Xhumana nabathintekayo bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekise usekelo oluseduze ngokomthetho olusebenzayo.

xh.title: Umphathi: Iinkonzo zezeMthetho nezoPhando
xh.summary: Kufunwa uMphathi onikezela inkokhela yolawulo mayela neNkonzo yoNcedo lweMthetho noPhando kwi-Inkangeleko yeNyangano yoPhando lwePolisi ezimeleyo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB/ B. Proc. (NQF7) esamkelwe yi-SAQA. Iiminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba lompathi ongum tapes aphakathi/owenzeleyo. Ilayisense yokushayela. uMmeli ongammeli/oNcedisi weligqawe namava ahambelana nokusebenza njengommeli ongammeli okanye oNcedisi weligqawe. Iimfuno yolwazi: Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho we-IPID, i-PFMA namanye omthetho namagqabantshintshi alawula inkonzo kaRhulumente, kuquka ulwazi ngomthetho webhodi nolawulo. Amava kwicala lokuhamba kwamagumbi emthetho kwizinto ezinxulumene nokukhukhumeza/inkqubo yokukhukhumeza. Amava ekubhaleni umthetho, umthetho ongaphantsi noma/nokuphando kwaye nokuSebenza ngokuQondileyo. Ukuqonda iingqwalasela ezibalulekileyo karhulumente. Ulwazi ngomthetho wesizwe sewingingqi namapheqendu esini. Amakhono namava: Ikhono elakhelwe bokulinga ukulawula nolawulo. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutyiweyo. Uluntu nokuhlela. Ikhono lokuxazulula iingxaki nokuza kwinigwevo. Ukutsha okutsha nokudala. Ikhono lolawulo lwegumbi lemithetho. Ikhono lolawulo lophando. Ikhono lokuQamba Isixhobo. Ikhono lokuhumusha umthetho. Amakhono okunxibelelanisa (okubhaliweyo nokuThethwayo). Ikhono lokubhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokuhumusha nokuPhanda ngomthetho. Ikhono lolawulo lophando. Ikhono lokuNgamela. Inyaniso nokuzithoba. Ikhono lolawulo lokuTshintsha. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, namakhono olawulo lemali. Imboniselo yomthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo.
xh.duties: Inkokhela yolawulo noQulu: Nikela isalathiso ngokusesikweni seYunithi yeNkonzo yoNcedo lweMthetho noPhando. Phawula iindawo eziphambili uze udidiide iinjongo neegqoziwolawulo zeSebe. Lilinde, ihlazo ngokuchaza kwaye ibale ingqibelho eloCandwe kumgangedo wokuSebenza. UPhuhliso koGqabantshintshi weMthetho noLawulo: Lulise, liphonononge, kwaye ligcine iingqinantshiso zamthetho, iinkqubo neenkqubo ngokwamagqabantshintshi asetyenziswayo nangokwemigaqo yamava ephezulu. Qamba ukusebenziswa kweenkqubo zamthetho, iinkqubo nolawulo olungaphakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela nokuSebenza kakuhle. Bhala iimemo zokuSebenza neemiyalelo ukuyalatha iinkqubo zamthetho namaphando. UNcedo lweMthetho nokuNxibelelana ngoMthetho: Phonononga kwaye unikeze iimboniso zamthetho, izindaba, ooncedo, ukwenzela ukuqinisekisa ukulawula umgangatho nokuthobela umthetho, amagqabantshintshi, namagqabantshintsiso esebe. Yenza uphando ngomthetho kwaye unikeze izindululo malunga nokuBhalwa koomthetho neenkqubo zolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana kooncedo bomthetho neemilinganiso zamthetho zesebe nezesizwe. ULawulo lophando ngokuseMthethweni: Qamba kwaye ulawule ukuqhubwa kweenkqabiso zamandla egunya ngokwemigangatho yolawulo. Qengenyela kwaye ulawule izikhalazo zolawulo, ukuqinisekisa ukulingana ngokwenkqubo nokuthobela umthetho. Unikeze ukujonga ngokuseMthethweni nokuqonda ngokuchanekileyo kwamaphando, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iimilinganiso zamthetho neenkqubo zengaqelo. Qengenyela, ulawule kwaye uphucule ukuqhubwa kweenkqabiso ze-PAIA kwangaphakathi kweentsuku ezingama-30 zokuSefa. Isakhono seMthetho nokunxibelelana nabaNgeneleli: Qhube iindlela zokuzilolonga nemigaqo yokuzilolonga malunga nememo zokuSebenza neemiyalelo zamthetho. Khuthaza ulwazi ngokuseMthethweni nokuqonda kuwo wonke isebe naphakathi kwabangeneli. Xhumana nabaBamba nxulumo abangaphakathi nabangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe oNcedo abasebenzayo bokwenzela iNgcebiso ngokuseMthethweni.

jobs.title: Chief State LAW Adviser
jobs.department: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 – R2 124 237 per annum (Level 15), (an all-inclusive remuneration package).
jobs.summary: Lead the drafting and certification of Bills and legislation as Chief State Law Adviser at the Department of Justice, based in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An NQF Level 8 in Law or as recognised by SAQA. Admission as an Advocate or Attorney in the High Court of South Africa is essential. A minimum of eight (8) years' experience at senior management level in a similar environment. Extensive knowledge of Bills and legislation, legislative drafting and certification processes, legal advisory services, public and international law, public administration, government decision-making processes, and the statutory and regulatory framework governing the Public Service, including the Public Service Act, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations and related prescripts. Sound understanding of Government priorities, organisational governance, strategic planning and professional legal ethics. Skills and Competencies: Exceptional strategic capability and leadership with the ability to provide strategic direction, develop legal policy and lead a specialised legal advisory environment. Demonstrated capability in programme and project management, financial management, organisational transformation, change management, knowledge management and service delivery innovation. Strong analytical, planning and problem-solving capability, with excellent people management, stakeholder engagement, communication and client orientation skills. Proven ability to build strategic partnerships, manage complex legal matters, influence decision-making and lead multidisciplinary professional teams. High levels of professionalism, ethical leadership, accountability and commitment to the values and principles of the Public Service.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the certification and drafting of Bills, including the provision of preliminary legal opinions, certification of legislation and legal advisory support throughout the parliamentary process. Oversee the scrutiny, drafting and certification of subordinate legislation and provide authoritative legal opinions and advisory services to Government departments and other organs of state. Direct the scrutiny of international agreements to ensure consistency with the Constitution and domestic law and oversee the provision of legal advice relating to international legal obligations. Lead the strategic management and governance of the Office of the Chief State Law Adviser through effective strategic planning, operational performance monitoring, risk management, audit compliance, financial management and resource utilisation. Oversee the translation and editing of legislation and other legal documents into the official languages to support legislative accessibility and constitutional compliance. Provide strategic legal opinions on contracts, legal documents, settlements and disputes referred by Government departments and organs of state. Ensure sound governance, people management, financial stewardship, asset management, organisational performance and compliance with all statutory and regulatory prescripts within the Office of the Chief State Law Adviser.
jobs.applications: Quoting the relevant reference number, direct your application to: https://forms.office.com/r/X2XaVPasWu or Postal address: The Human Resources: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development, Private Bag X81, Pretoria, 0001 OR Physical address: Application Box, First Floor Reception, East Tower, Momentum Building, 329 Pretorius Street, Pretoria.
jobs.notes: Applicants are invited to submit applications, quoting the relevant reference number to the link and or address indicated in each specific advertisement. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021, obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za), citing the correct post number and job title; a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date (dd/mm/yy), job title, detailed duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of three contactable employment references and copies of educational qualifications. Applicants who possess foreign qualification(s), are furthermore required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. These assessments are aimed at assessing candidate’s professional and technical competency against the job requirements and duties, general job fit, integrity and digital literacy). All shortlisted candidates for SMS positions will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural, emotional intelligence and integrity. All suitable candidates will be subjected to mandatory pre-employment screening/ suitability checks/ verification (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, employment pending disciplinary action and professional registration. Suitable candidates for Senior Management Service positions will also be required to successfully complete the online Nyukela Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services course, which can be accessed via: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates wishing to be considered for appointment, are encouraged to enrol for the course as soon as possible. Due to high volumes anticipated, communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development (DOJ&CD) seeks to appoint exceptional, ethical and visionary leaders to join its executive leadership team in advancing constitutional democracy. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. The Department is committed to providing equal opportunities and affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofstaatsregadviseur
af.summary: Bied leiding aan die opstel en sertifisering van Wetsontwerpe en wetgewing as Hoofstaatsregadviseur by die Department of Justice, gevestig in Pretoria.
af.requirements: NQF Level 8 in die Regte of so deur SAQA erken. Toelating as Advokaat of Prokureur by die Hooggeregshof van Suid-Afrika is noodsaaklik. 'n Minimum van agt (8) jaar se ervaring op seniorbestuursvlak in 'n soortgelyke omgewing. Uitgebreide kennis van Wetsontwerpe en wetgewing, wetgewende opstel- en sertifiseringsprosesse, regsaadsiendienste, publiek- en internasionale reg, publieke administrasie, regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse, en die statutêre en regulerende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens beheer, insluitend die Public Service Act, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations en verwante voorskrifte. Deeglike begrip van regeringsprioriteite, organisasionele beheer, strategiese beplanning en professionele regsetiek. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Uitsonderlike strategiese vermoë en leierskap met die vermoë om strategiese rigting te bied, regbeleid te ontwikkel en 'n gespesialiseerde regsaadsiende omgewing te lei. Bewese vermoë in program- en projektebestuur, finansiële bestuur, organisasievernuwing, veranderingsbestuur, kennisbestuur en diensleweringsinnovasie. Sterk analitiese, beplannings- en probleemoplossingsvermoë, met uitstekende mensebestuurs-, belanghebbendebetrokkenheids-, kommunikasie- en kliëntgerigtheidsvaardighede. Bewese vermoë om strategiese vennootskappe te bou, komplekse regsaangeleenthede te bestuur, besluitneming te beïnvloed en multidissiplinêre professionele spanne te lei. Hoë vlakke van professionaliteit, etiese leierskap, aanspreeklikheid en toewyding aan die waardes en beginsels van die Openbare Diens.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en toesig oor die sertifisering en opstel van Wetsontwerpe, insluitend die verskaffing van voorlopige regsmenings, sertifisering van wetgewing en regsaadsiesteun deur die parlementêre proses. Hou toesig oor die ondersoek, opstel en sertifisering van ondergeskikte wetgewing en verskaf gesaghebbende regsmenings en adviesdienste aan regeringsdepartemente en ander staatsorgane. Lei die ondersoek van internasionale ooreenkomste om ooreenstemming met die Grondwet en binnelandse reg te verseker en hou toesig oor die verskaffing van regsadvies rakende internasionale regverpligtinge. Lei die strategiese bestuur en beheer van die Kantoor van die Hoofstaatsregadviseur deur effektiewe strategiese beplanning, operasionele prestasie monitering, risikobestuur, audite nakoming, finansiële bestuur en hulpbronnutiging. Hou toesig oor die vertaling en redigering van wetgewing en ander regsdokumente in die amptelike tale om wetgewende toeganklikheid en grondwetlike nakoming te ondersteun. Verskaf strategiese regsmenings oor kontrakte, regsdokumente, skikking en geskille wat deur regeringsdepartemente en staatsorgane verwys is. Verseker deeglike beheer, mensebestuur, finansiële rentmeesterskap, batebestuur, organisasieprestasie en nakoming van alle statutêre en regulerende voorskrifte binne die Kantoor van die Hoofstaatsregadviseur.

zu.title: ISikhulu Esiphezulu Sezelwe Umthetho
zu.summary: Hola ekubhalweni nasekuqinisekiseni koMthetho nakulezi zomthetho njengoba kwenza iNkundla Ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika, okuyikhaya kwaPitoli.
zu.requirements: I-NQF Level 8 kuMthetho noma njengoba kuqashelwa i-SAQA. Kuyadingeka ukumukelwa njengommelomangalelo noma mmeli enkundleni Ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili (8) yezikhathi ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha kwezobuholi endaweni efana nale. Ulwazi oluningi ngeBills nomthetho, izinqubo zokubhala nokuqinisekisa umthetho, izinsiza zokweluleka ngomthetho, umthetho kazwelonke nowamanye amazwe, okuphathwa kwezomphakha, izinqubo zokuqumisa izinqumo kuhulumeni, kanye nezinhlobo zemithetho nezomthetho ephatha Inkonzo Yomphakha, okuhlanganisa uMthetho Wezinsiza Zomphakha, uMthetho Wokuphatha Imali Yolunwe, Imithetho Yeshadi namanye amaphreskripti. Ukuqonda okuhluziyo ngamaphathiside kaHulumeni, ukuhlanzwa kwezinhlangano, ukuhlelwa okuhle kakhulu kanye nesiko elingasese lomthetho. Amakhono namandla: Amandla aphakeme kakhulu wezinhlelo nokuhola, kanye nesidlondlobala sokunika umthumo wokuqonda, ukuthuthukisa umthetho wezomthetho, nokuba ngumhola emkhakheni wezokweluleka ngomthetho. Ukuboniswa kwamandla ekuphathweni kohlelo nasezinhlelweni, ekuphathweni kwemali, ekushintsheni kwenhlangano, ekuphathweni koshintsho, ekuphathweni kolwazi, nasemisizeni yokuletha izinto ezintsha. Amandla amakhulu okuhlaziya, ukuhlela nokuxazula izinkinga, ngamakhono aphakeme okuphatha abantu, ukuhlanganyela nabathintekayo, ukuxhumana, nokubekezelela abathengi. Isidlondlobala esivezwa sokwakha ubuhlobo bokuhlela, ukuphatha izindaba ezinzima zomthetho, ukunegxa ekwenzeni izinqumo, nokuba ngumhola kumakhasimende abanemikhakha ehlukene. Izinga elikhulu lesiko elingasese, ukuhola okuzelwe isiko, ukuziphendulela nokuzinikela kuma-values kanye nemigomo yenkalo yomphakha.
zu.duties: Nika umthumo ophakeme kakhulu wokuqhuma, ukuqinisekisa nokubhala iBills, okuhlanganisa nokunikeza imibono yomthetho yokucima, ukuqinisekisa umthetho kanye nokusekela ngeluleko lomthetho kunqubo yonke yephalamente. Qaphela ukuqaphela, ukubhala nokuqinisekisa umthetho ongaphansi kwenye imigomo, unikeze imibono yomthetho egqamile kanye nezinsiza zokweluleka emimnyango kaHulumeni nasemnyameni wesizwe. Hola ekubuqapheleni ngemithetho yezivumelwano zamazwe ngokuqinisekisa ihambisana nomthethosisekelo nomthetho wekhaya, unake izeluleko zomthetho ezimala nezibopho zamazwe ngamanye. Hola ekuphathweni okuhle kakhulu nesiqu kwezinhlelo kweMnyango weNkundla Ephakeme ngesikhathi esiphathwa kahle, ukuhlela okusebenzayo, ukulawula imigomo, ukulawula izengozi, ukuhambisana nezindikimba zokuhlola, ukuphatha imali, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo. Yenza izindaba ezihunyushwe nokuqinisekiswa komthetho namadokhumende omthetho ngamalimi asemthethweni ukuze kusekelwe ukufinyelela komthetho nokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo. Nikeza izeluleko zomthetho ezihle kakhulu ngezinhlolojongo zomthetho, amadokhumende, ukuxazulula, nasezindabeni ezithunyelwe imimnyango kaHulumeni kanye nesibopho sesizwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuphathwa kwemali, ukuphathwa kwezimpahla, ukusebenza kwezinhlangano, nokuhambisana namaphreskripti omthetho nakwezomthetho ngaphakathi kweMnyango weNkundla Ephakeme.

xh.title: Igunya eliPhambili leNxibelelaniso ngoMthetho leSizwe
xh.summary: Qonda ekubhalweni nasekuqinisekiseni kweMithetho yesiBhungo nemithetho njengeGunya eliPhambili leNxibelelaniso ngoMthetho leSizwe kwiSebe leZobulungisa, kusePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso seNQF inqanaba 8 kuMthetho okanye njengokuqatshiwe yiSAQA. Ukwamkelwa njengoMmeli okanye nguMmeli woMthetho eNkantolo ePhakamileyo yoMzantsi Afrika kubalulekile. Ubuncinane beminyaka elisi (8) yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo kwimeko efanayo. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeMithetho yesiBhungo nemithetho, iinkqubo zokubhala nokuqinisekisa imithetho, iinkonzo zengcebiso ngomthetho, umthetho wommatic bulungisa namazwe ngamazwe, ulawulo lwezobulungisa zikawonkewonke, iinkqubo zokuthatha izigqibo kurhulumente, nendlela yomthetho namacebo okulawula iNkonzo zikaWonke-wonke, kuquka uMthetho weNkonzo zikaWonke-wonke, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali zikawonkewonke, iMigaqo yeNgxowa-mali kunye neemila ezinxulumene nayo. Ukuqonda okubalulekileyo ngokubaluleka kwezigqibo kaRhulumente, ulawulo loluntu, iplani ezoluleke kakhulu kwaye ngokomthetho wabaphathi bemigaqo, iplani yokuziphatha ngokunyamezelela kwaye ngokomthetho. Amakhono namandla: Ulawulo oluphezulu lobuchule ekuyilweni iplani nezakhiwo zokulawula kunye namandla okunika isalathiso senkqubo, ukuyila iplani yomthetho wemigaqo yobulumko ekunika ulwazi kwindawo ethile ekukhunjuzwa ngayo ngumthetho. Amandla abonakalisiweyo ekulawulweni kwenkqubo namaphulo, ekulawulweni kwemali, ekwenzeni uluntu lunyuke, ekulawulweni iinguqu, ekulawulweni ulwazi kwiiNkonzo ezintsha zokwenzisa iNkonzo. Amandla aqinisekileyo, opleani nokusombulula iingxaki, ngekhono elihle lokulawula abantu, ukuququzelela abantu abathunyelwe, ukunxibelelana kolwazi namandla eNkonzo. Amandla obonakalisiweyo ukwakha ubudlelwane boluntu oluhle, ukulawula iingxaki ezinzima ngomthetho, nokuququzelela iingxaki nokuqhuba amaqela. Ukuziphatha okuphezulu ngokusemthethweni, ukuziphatha okuhle ngokomthetho, uxanduva, novimba ngamaxabiso nemiqathango yeNkonzo zikaWonke-wonke.
xh.duties: Nika isalathiso esibalulekileyo nelawulo ekubhalweni nasekuqinisekiseni kweMithetho yesiBhungo, kuquka ukunikela nengcebiso yokuqala ngomthetho, ukuqinisekisa imithetho kunye nokuvela iingcebiso ngomthetho lonke ixesha lenkqubo yesiBhungo. Lawula ukuqwalasela, ukubhala nokuqinisekisa imithetho engaphantsi kweMithetho yesiBhungo nikele ngengcebiso ethile ngomthetho yonke iimbono ezahlukeneyo kuRhulumente kwaye nawo onke amanyathelo angaphakathi. Qondisa ukuqwalaselwa kolwazi lwamanyathelo ngamazwe ngamazwe ukuze kuqiniseke ukuhambelana noMthethosiseko kunye nomthetho wezwe lawo lawula imfuyo yangaphakathi, ulwazi olubanzi nolwazi lokunika iingcebiso ngomthetho olongezelelekileyo ezidityaniswe ngeNkqubo yeGunya leSizwe elingoomama nolawulo lobulumko. Qhuba ukulawula uluntu olugqibeleleyo negunya eliphezulu leGunya eliPhambili leNxibelelaniso ngoMthetho leSizwe ngenkqubo ekahle yokulinganisa iplani, ukuqwalaselwa kwenkqubo, ukuqwalaselwa kweengozi, uvavanyo lothile, ulawulo lweMali nokusebenzisa izixhobo. Lawula ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi nokuqwalaselwa kolwazi nasekuhlehleni kolwazi oluqinisekileyo iNkqubo iqaqambile ngoMthetho nolunye ulwazi lwemithetho ngalo onke amagama ahlukeneyo esizwe ukuxhasa ukusetyenziswa kwamathetho nalawo achazwe ngomthetho. Nikeza ngengcebiso ethile ngomthetho mayela nemithetho yamathuba ezahlukeneyo, ulwazi ngomthetho oluhle, iinkqubo ezizodwa nezidityaniswe yiSebe leRiphabhlikhi kunye namanye amagunya esiZwe.

jobs.title: Chief Town and Regional Planner
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 143 468 - R2 108 922 per annum, (The salary will be determined in accordance with the OSD)
jobs.summary: Manage and lead spatial planning, land development projects and technical assistance for town and regional planning in the Free State.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a Bachelor's Degree in Town and Regional Planning / Urban and Regional Planning. Compulsory registration with South African Council for Planners (SACPLAN) a Professional Town and Regional Planner on appointment. Minimum of 6 years post qualification in Town and Regional Planning experience. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Programme and project management. Town and regional legal and operational compliance. Town and regional principles and methodologies. Town and regional planning processes and procedure. Research and development. Computer-aided applications. Creating high performance culture. Technical consulting. Job related skills: Strategic management and direction. Analytical thinking. Creativity and self-management. Communication (verbal and written). Language proficiency. Computer literacy. Change management. Negotiation and conflict resolution. Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Provide town and regional spatial planning future forecasting. Lead and manage the application of town and regional planning principles in land development. Provide technical assistance to professional teams on all aspects regarding town and regional planning projects. Monitor the implementation of development in compliance with applicable legislation and town and regional planning standards and guideline. Manage the compilation and adoption of technical and planning standards, norms and guidelines. Formulate and interpret planning legislation, guidelines, policies and regulations. Provide spatial planning and land use management services in liaison with National Office. Implement tools, systems, guidelines, policies, programmes and legislations for spatial planning and land use management at a provincial level. Provide governance. Allocate, monitor and control resources. Compile risk logs and manage significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organisational requirements. Provide technical consulting services for the operation of architectural related matters to minimise possible architectural risks. Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives e.g. short-term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational reequipments and return on investment. Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. Effective management of external and internal stakeholder. Provide development planning support to departmental programmes and rural development at the provincial level. Render planning support and advice to the departmental programmes. Manage the development of spatial plans at National, Regional, Provincial and Municipal levels.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 136 Charlotte Maxeke Street, SA Eagle Building, Bloemfontein, 9300 or by email to Post236@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoofstads- en Streekbeplanner
af.summary: Bestuur en lei ruimtelike beplanning, grondbontwikkelingsprojekte en tegniese bystand vir stads- en streekbeplanning in die Free State.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Bachelorsgraad in Stads- en Streekbeplanning / Stedelike en Streekbeplanning hê. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Council for Planners (SACPLAN) as 'n Professionele Stads- en Streekbeplanner by aanstelling. Minimum van 6 jaar na kwalifisering se ervaring in Stads- en Streekbeplanning. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projektebestuur. Regs- en operasionele nakoming van stads- en streekbeplanning. Stads- en streekbeginsels en -metodes. Stads- en streekbeplanningsprosesse en -prosedures. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde toepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsultasie. Werksverwante vaardighede: Strategiese bestuur en rigting. Analitiese denke. Kreatiwiteit en selfbestuur. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Taalvaardigheid. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Veranderingsbestuur. Onderhandeling en konflikoplossing. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Verskaf toekomstige vooruitskattings vir stads- en streekbeplanning. Lei en bestuur die toepassing van stads- en streekbeplanningsbeginsels in grondbontwikkeling. Verskaf tegniese bystand aan professionele spanne oor alle aspekte rakende stads- en streekbeplanningsprojekte. Monitor die implementering van ontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en stads- en streekbeplanningsstandaarde en riglyne. Bestuur die samestelling en goedkeuring van tegniese en beplanningsstandaarde, norme en riglyne. Formuleer en interpreteer beplanningswetgewing, riglyne, beleide en regulasies. Verskaf ruimtelike beplanning en grondbestuursdienste in samewerking met die Nasionale Kantoor. Implementeer instrumente, stelsels, riglyne, beleide, programme en wetgewing vir ruimtelike beplanning en grondbestuur op provinsiale vlak. Verskaf bestuur. Allokateer, monitor en beheer bronne. Stel risiko registers op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgens goeie risikobestuurspraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes. Verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die werking van argitektuurverwante aangeleenthede om moontlike argitektuurrisiko's te minimaliseer. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe bv. korttermynopdragte en uitleenings binne en dwarsoor operasies, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor deurlopend die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Effektiewe bestuur van eksterne en interne belanghebbendes. Verskaf ontwikkelingsbeplanningssteun aan departementele programme en landelike ontwikkeling op provinsiale vlak. Verskaf beplanningssteun en advies aan departementele programme. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van ruimtelike planne op Nasionale, Streek-, Provinsiale en Munisipale vlakke.

zu.title: Uhleli Oyinhlofunde Wezindawo Nakwesifundazwe
zu.summary: Phatha bese uholela ukuhlela isikhala, amaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa izwe kanye nensiza yezobuchwepheshe ekuhleleni izindawo nakwesifundazwe e-Free State.
zu.requirements: Izidingo eyisisekelo: Abafaki izicelo kumele babe nesiqtitshadi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree kokuHlela Izindawo nakwesifundazwe / ukuHlela izindawo zakwedolobhe nakwesifundazwe. Ukwabhalisa ngaphandle kokukhethwa ku-South African Council for Planners (SACPLAN) njengomhleli wezindawo nakwesifundazwe ngokuhloniphekile emsebenzini. Ukuze kube yisidingo esincane kumele kube khona iminyaka engu-6 ngemva kokuthola iqtitshadi ngokuhlela izindawo nakwesifundazwe. Ilayisense yokushayela eliyasebenza. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. ukuHambisana komthetho kanye nezinqubo ezisebenzayo zokuHlela Izindawo nakwesifundazwe. Izimiso kanye nezindlela zokuHlela izindawo nakwesifundazwe. Inqubo kanye nemigidingo yokuHlela izindawo nakwesifundazwe. Ukuqeqeshwa kokubuyisela izinkulumo zonke kanye nokwakha. Izinhlelo ezisekelwa ikhompyutha. Ukwakha isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. ukubonisana ngokobuchwepheshe. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: ukuphatha ngohlelo nokubhekwa phezulu. ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukukhiqiza okusha nokuzilawula. ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukuqonda izilimi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ukuphatha izinguquko. Ukuxoxisana nokuxazulula izinkinga. ukuzimisela ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Hlaabezela ngokuqagela ikusasa ekubhekene nokuhlela isikhala sezindawo nakwesifundazwe. Hola bese_phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezimiso zokuhlela izindawo nakwesifundazwe ekuthuthukisweni kwamazwe. Nikeza usizo olusemthweni amaqembu abhungcwathi ngezindaba ezihlukene ezibhekene namaphrojekthi okuhlela izindawo nakwesifundazwe. Bheka isimo sendlela yokwenziwa kokuthuthukiswa ukuze kuhambisane nomthetho osebenzayo nemigidingo yokuhlela izindawo nakwesifundazwe. Phatha ukulungiswa nokamamiswa kwemigidingo yezobuchwepheshe nokuhlela, kanye nezinqubo nezimaluleze. Bumba bese uchaza umthetho wokuhlela, imigidingo, izinqubomgomo namalungiselelo. Hlinzeka ngesevisi yokuhlela isikhala nokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwabelo ngokusebenzisana ne-National Office. Setshenziswa izinsiza, izinhlelo, imigidingo, izinqubomgomo, amaphrojekthi nomthetho wokuhlela isikhala nokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwabelo ezingeni lesifundazwe. Hlinzeka ngokuphathwa kwezombusazwe. Aba, ulawule bese ulawula izinsiza. Hlela amalogi engozi bese uphatha ingozi ebalulekile ngokuya ngemigidingo yokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezingozi nezidingo zendawo yokusebenza. Hlinzeka ngezinsiza zokubonisana ngobuchwepheshe ngokuhlobene nokusebenza kwezindaba zezakhiwo ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi ezingaba khona ezibhekene nezakhiwo. Phatha bese usebenzisa izinkambu zokwabelana ngolwazi ezifana namaphrojekthi amafushane nokunikezwa kwemisebenzi ngaphakathi nakubukele eminye imisebenzi, ngokusekela izinkambu zokuqeqesha abantu, izidingo zokusebenza nenzalo yotshalo. Qhubeka ubheke ukushintshiselana nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kokusebenza nabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kolwazi okusebenzayo ngokuhambisana nemigomo yomnyango. Ukuphatha ngokusebenzayo abanye abantu abaphatshe ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Nikeza usizo lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa kwamaphrojekthi omnyango nakuthuthukiswa kwamakhaya ezingeni lesifundazwe. Nikeza usizo lolwazi mayelana nokuqeqeshwa kwamaphrojekthi. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlela zokuhlela isikhala ezingeni likazwelonke, lesifundazwe, lesifundazwe nasezingeni lasendaweni.

xh.title: Umntu ophethe uphando nezicwangciso zendawo kwilali nakwiphondo
xh.summary: Lawula uphando lwendawo nakwiphondo, imisebenzi yokulungisa umhlaba nokunceda nolwazi lobuchwephesha kwizicwangciso zendawo kwilali nakwiphondo kwi Free State.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafake izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi samabanga a-12 naye Bachelor's Degree kwizicwangciso zendawo kwilali nakwiphondo / Urban and Regional Planning. Ukubhalwa ngokuyinyaniso kwi South African Council for Planners (SACPLAN) njengomcwangcisi wezicwangciso zendawo kwilali nakwiphondo xa egqiba ukusebenza. Ubuncinane i-6 yeminyaka yamava emva kwaloo mangabiso kwizicwangciso zendawo kwilali nakwiphondo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluthintene nomsebenzi: Ukuqonda iinkqubo nomsebenzi. Ulwazi ngemithetho namagunya obuchwephesha bezicwangciso zendawo kwilali nakwiphondo. Iinkqubo nemisebenzi yezicwangciso zendawo kwilali nakwiphondo. Iinkqubo namacebo okucwangcisa indawo kwilali nakwiphondo. Uphando nolwazi lobuchwephesha. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nikeza iingcinga zangaphambili ezimalunga negcino lendawo kwilali nakwiphondo. Bumba uphando loyilo lwendawo kwilali nakwiphondo. Nikela ngolwazi lobuchwepheshe kumagqabantshintshi ngemisebenzi ephathelene nezicwangciso zendawo kwilali nakwiphondo. Lilisebenziso lendalo ngokuthobela imithetho esebenzayo nemigaqo yezicwangciso zendawo kwilali nakwiphondo. Lawula ubumbeko lwamava ngokuthobela imithetho esebenzayo nemigaqo yezicwangciso zendawo kwilali nakwiphondo.

af.title: Hoofstedelike en Streeksbeplanner
af.summary: Hoofstedelike en Streeksbeplanner-pos in Mahikeng wat 'n graad, SACPLAN-registrasie en ses jaar se ervaring vereis om ruimtelike beplanning- en grondontwikkelingsprojekte te lei.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Bachelorsgraad in Stads- en Streeksbeplanning / Stedelike en Streeksbeplanning. Verpligte registrasie met South African Council for Planners (SACPLAN) as 'n professionele stads- en streeksbeplanner by aanstelling. Minimum van 6 jaar postkwalifikasie in stads- en streeksbeplanningservaring. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projekbestuur. Regs- en operasionele nakoming van stads- en streeksbeplanning. Stads- en streeksbeginsels en -metodologieë. Stads- en streeksbeplanningsprosesse en -prosedures. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde toepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsultasie. Werksverwante vaardighede: Strategiese bestuur en rigting. Analitiese denke. Kreatiwiteit en selfbestuur. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Taalvaardigheid. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Veranderingsbestuur. Onderhandeling en konflikoplossing. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Verskaf toekomstige vooruitskattings vir stads- en streeksruimtelike beplanning. Lei en bestuur die toepassing van stads- en streeksbeplanningsbeginsels in grondontwikkeling. Verskaf tegniese bystand aan professionele spanne oor alle aspekte rakende stads- en streeksbeplanningsprojekte. Monitor die implementering van ontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en stads- en streeksbeplanningsstandaarde en riglyne. Bestuur die opstel en aanvaarding van tegniese en beplanningsstandaarde, norme en riglyne. Formuleer en interpreteer beplanningswetgewing, riglyne, beleide en regulasies. Verskaf ruimtelike beplannings- en grondebruikbestuursdienste in samewerking met die nasionale kantoor. Implementeer instrumente, stelsels, riglyne, beleide, programme en wetgewing vir ruimtelike beplanning en grondebruikbestuur op provinsiale vlak. Verskaf bestuur. Allokateer, monitor en beheer hulpbronne. Stel risiko-log op en bestuur noemenswaardige risiko's volgens goeie risikobestuurspraktyk en organisasionele vereistes. Verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die bedryf van argitektuurverwante aangeleenthede om moontlike argitektuurrisko's te minimeer. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe bv. korttermynopdragte en uitleenings binne en dwarsoor operasies, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor voortdurend die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om doeltreffende kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Doeltreffende bestuur van eksterne en interne belanghebbendes. Verskaf ontwikkelingsbeplanningsondersteuning aan departementele programme en landelike ontwikkeling op provinsiale vlak. Lewer beplanningsondersteuning en advies aan die departementele programme. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van ruimtelike planne op nasionale, streek-, provinsiale en munisipale vlakke.

zu.title: Umhleli Omkhulu Wokuhlela Kwezidluliswa Nomasipala
zu.summary: Isikhundla somhleli omkhulu wokuhlela kwezidluliswa nomasipala eMahikeng esifuna iziqu, ukubhalisa kwiSACPLAN, kanye neminyaka eyisithupha yamava ukuze uhola izinhlela zokuhlela isikhala nentuthuko yomhlaba.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafakeli kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neziqu zeBachelor's Degree kwi-Town and Regional Planning / Urban and Regional Planning. Ukubhalisa ngokuphoqelele kwi-South African Council for Planners (SACPLAN) njengomhleli wezidluliswa nomasipala ohlinzayo ngokufakwa esikhundleni. Okuncane iminyaka eyi-6 yamava emumva kokuthola iziqu ekuhleleni kwezidluliswa nomasipala. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwezinhlela namagepha. Ukuhambisana komthetho nentengo yezidluliswa nomasipala. Izinhlobo nezindlela zezidluliswa nomasipala. Inqubo nezindlela zokuhlela kwezidluliswa nomasipala. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelana ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukudala isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Ukubonisana ngobuchwepheshe. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphatha ngohlaka nokunika isiqondiso. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukwakha nokuziphatha. Unxibelelwano (lwenkomishi nolwelimi). Ukuqonda ulimi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuphatha izinguquko. Ukuxoxisana nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngokuhlela isikhala sezidluliswa nomasipala nokubikezela ikusasa. Hola uphathe ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlobo zokuhlela kwezidluliswa nomasipala entuthukweni yomhlaba. Nikeza ngosizo lwobuchwepheshe amaqembu ohlinzayo kuzo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nezinhlela zokuhlela kwezidluliswa nomasipala. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwentuthuko ukuhambisana nomthetho osebenzayo kanye nemigomo yezidluliswa nomasipala. Phatha ukubhalwa nokwamukelwa kwezidingo nobuchwepheshe zemigomo yokuhlela. Hlela uhluze umthetho wokuhlela, imigomo, izinqubomgomo nemithetho. Nikeza ngamasevisi wokuhlela isikhala nokuphatha ukusetshenziswa komhlaba ubuhlobo le-National Office. Faka izinsiza, izimiso, imigomo, izinqubomgomo, izinhlela nomthetho wokuhlela isikhala nokuphatha ukusetshenziswa komhlaba kwazinga lesifundazwe. Nikeza ngokuphathwa. Aba, qapha ulawule izinsiza. Qamba amafayela ezinkinga uphatle izinkinga ezinkulu ngokuhambisana namasizo okuphatha izinkinga ngezidingo zenhlangano. Nikeza ngamasevisi okubonisana ngobuchwepheshe ekusebenzeni kwezindaba zokwakha ukuze unciphise izinkinga ezitholakala ekwakheni. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinhlela zokwabelana ngolwazi isb. ukwabiwa kwemisebenzi emifushane nokuthunyelwa kubanye endaweni nangaphandle kokuqhubekayo, ukusekela izinhlela zentuthuko yomuntu ngamunye, izidingo zokuqhubekayo nokubuyela kwemali yesithakazelo. Phatha ngokuqhubekayo ukushintshiselana nokuvikelwa kwolwazi phakathi kokuqhubekayo nabantu ukunikeza ukuphathwa kwolwazi okusebenzayo ngokuhambisana namagcaphezo omnyango. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwabahlobo bangaphandle nangaphakathi. Nikeza ngokusekelwa kokuhlela kwentuthuko izinhlela zomnyango nentuthuko yasemaphandleni kwazinga lesifundazwe. Nikeza ngokusekelwa kolwazi kanye neluleko ezinhlenhleni zomnyango. Phatha entuthukweni yezinhlela zokuhlela isikhala kumazinga e-National, Regional, Provincial kanye ne-Municipal.

xh.title: Isigqebeli esiNgqonge nesiMmandla Sokucwangcisa
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi ongqonge wolwakhiwo nolwesimandla eMahikeng, sifuna idigiri, ukubhalisa kwi-SACPLAN, namava eminyaka engamashumi amathandathu ukuba ehlelo ekuyileni iinkqubo zokucwangcisa isithuba neentengiso zophuhliso kolawulo lwamazwe.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisisiseko: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se-Graji 12 nidigiri ye-Bachelors kwicwangciso yasezidolophini nasemimandla / kwicwangciso yasedolophini nasemimandla. Ukubhalisa ngokuyimfuneko kwiSouth African Council for Planners (SACPLAN) njengesigqebeli se-Town and Regional Planning ngexesha lokwamkelwa. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-6 emva kokuzuzwa kwamava kwicwangciso yasezidolophini nasemimandla. Ilayisense yomqeshi esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi. Ukuzithoba ngokomthetho nangokwemisebenzi kwindawo yasezidolophini nasemimandla. Iinkqubo nezindlela zokusebenza ezidolophini nasemimandla. Iinkqubo nezithethwo zokucwangcisa iidolophu nemimandla. Uphononongo nophuhliso. Iinkqubo ezisezixhobo ezingenamakhondo azelelweyo. Ukuyila inkqubo yolwenziwa olusemgangathweni ophezulu. Iingcebiso ngamabala. Ubuchule obuhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo oluhleliweyo nokuqhuba. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutyo. Ukuyila nokuzilawula. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ukuqonda iilwimi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulawulo lotshintsho. Iingcebiso nokuxazulula iingxabano. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Nika iimbonakaliso zexesha elizayo kucwangciso lwesithuba kumazwe amaninzi nakuwo onke. Phatha nokulawula ukusebenza kweenkqubo zokucwangcisa iindawo ezidolophini namazwe amaninzi kuluhlaziyo lwemivalo. Nika inkxaso yamava kwiqela leengcali ngeenkqubo zonke ezihlobene namaprojekthi zokucwangcisa iidolophu namazwe amaninzi. Qonda ukusetyenziswa koluhlaziyo ngokwanga isigqibo somthetho nangokwemilinganiselo nangokwemiqathango yamagunya wokucwangcisa iidolophu namazwe amaninzi. Lawula ukuqokelelwa nokwamkelwa kwemilinganiselo yamava, nemigangatho yemisebenzi nemiqathango yendlela. Yila ukuqondisisa nomthetho wokucwangcisa imigangatho, iinkqubo nemigaqo. Nika iinkonzo zokucwangcisa isithuba nokulawula imivalo ngokudibana noluntu kolwandle. Zisebenzisa izixhobo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokulawula imisebenzi, imigaqo, amacebo amadede nomthetho weqela elilodwa ekucwangcisweni kwezithuba nakulawulweni lomhlaba kumazwe amaninzi nakuwo onke. Nika ulawulo lweenkqubo zoluntu. Lawula, qonda kwaye ulawule izixhobo zokusebenza. Qamba iingxelo zengozi ezinkulu kwaye ulawule umngcipheko ongaphakathi komothetho womoya woluntu. Nika iingcebiso ngamabala abucala ngezinto ezinzulu. Yila inkqubo yolwazi olusebenzayo. Lawula nokulawula ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Implementering van Grondhervorming
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur benodig om die implementering van gemeenskaplike grondeienaarskaphervorming in Bloemfontein te koördineer, wat 'n sosiologiese diploma of LLB en junior bestuurservaring vereis.

Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op junior bestuursvlak in die relevante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Deeglike kennis van sake rakende sekuriteit van grondeienaar. zu.title: Phini Lomqondisi: Ukuphethwa Kwezinqubomlando Zomhlaba
zu.summary: Kudingwa iPhini Lomqondisi elizobaqondisa ekuphethweni kwezolimo komhlaba komphakathi eBloemfontein, elidinga iDiploma yeziSocial Sciences noma i-LLB namava ekuqondiseni abalingana bokulawula.
