Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 yamava ekuqondiseni abalingana bokulawula emkhakheni ohambisanayo. Ilayisense yokushayela elivunyelwe. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olujulile ngemikhawulo yokuphathwa komhlaba. Umthetho namapholisi ahambisana nezinqubomlando zomhlaba. Ukuhlela ngokwezinhlelo. Ukulawula abantu. Ukulawula imali. Ukulawula uwoyelo wokulethwa kwezinto. Ulwazi ngozomnotho. Public Service Act. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlaziya ucabango. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhbala imibiko. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ubudlelwano nabantu. Ukwenza imihlangano nokwethula. Ukucwaninga nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuxhuman nabantu. Ukulawula iqembu. Ukuqondiswa kubathengi nakabathengi abahamba ngesikhathi. Ukubikezela ngokwezibalo. Ukulungele ukuhamba nokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi usize ekuphethweni kohlelo lwezolimo komhlaba komphakathi. Hlela izinhloso zokwazisa nokwakha amandla ngokuqashwa komhlaba komphakathi nemithetho ehambisana nawo kubaphathi bezezinto. Nikeza usizo izakhiwo ezilawula amalungelo omhlaba ngokunikeza ukuvikelwa ngokomthetho nokwazisa. Qedelela futhi ube isiphathi esimaphakathi ezimeni zokuphulwa kwamalungelo omhlaba nasezinxeseneni ngomhlaba komphakathi ngokusho komthetho ohambisanayo. Qondisa ukuphethwa kwezinhlela zokuthuthukisa izinqubomlando zomhlaba komphakathi. Qondisa futhi usize ekuphethweni kwezinhlela zamalungelo omhlaba. Qapha yonke imibuzo mayelana nezinhlelo zamalungelo omhlaba. Nikeza usizo izakhiwo ezilawula amalungelo omhlaba ngokunikeza ukuvikelwa ngokomthetho nokwazisa. Qondisa inqubo yokuxazulula nokuqumba ngamalungelo omhlaba. Qondisa ukuphethwa kwezinhlela zokuthuthukisa amalungelo omhlaba. Qapha Isikhungo Sokulawula Amalungelo Omhlaba. Qondisa futhi usize ekusungulweni nasekusekelweni izinhlelo zempahla yomphakathi. Qedelela ukusungula nokuphatha izinhlangano zempahla yomphakathi (CPA). Gcina idatha yezinhlangano ze-CPA nezinye ezifanayo. Qondisa ukwaziswa ngenzindaba ze-CPA. Yenza iziphathimandla futhi ungene ezindabeni. Qedelela ezinkulumweni zokuxazulula izinkinga nasezinqamuleweni ze-CPA. Nikeza usizo lokuphatha ekubuqeqeshweni bokulawula ngokwezinhlelo nokusekelwa kwezinhlelo zezinqubomlando zomhlaba. Lawula iplani yesifunda yokuphatha izinhlelo zezinqubomlando zomhlaba. Qondisa ubudlelwano nabaphathi bezezinto. Mela futhi wethule isiqondiswa kumafora ahlukene. Khuthaza ukuhambisana kwe-CPA nomthetho. Qondisa izivivinyo zangaphandle nangaphakathi. Lawula ukuphethwa kweplani yosenzo. Qondisa iplani yosenzo yezingozi nezivivinyo. Hlanganisa imibiko.

xh.title: Umlawuli Onxweme: Ukusebenza kokuZinza kweNqanaba lokuHlawula
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho Umlawuli Onxweme oza kwenza isihloko kumatyala abemi ngokusesiko kwezithuba zomhlaba kwaye alawule olu phando ngokusesiko kwemithetho yomhlaba kwilizwe lase South Africa. Lo msebenzi uza kubakho kwindawo ethi Bloemfontein, kwaye kufuneka abe nemvuzo we Social Sciences diploma okanye LLB, aneminye imisebenzi ekwindawo ezingangqina ngamandla okulawula.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingqinelana nomsebenzi: Kufuneka abafaki zelindlela babe nesiTyhophu seGrade 12 kunye neDiploma yelizwe kwindawo yezenzululwazi zomntu / LLB okanye isifundo esingqamana noko (iNQF Level 6). Kufuneka abe nomava omncinane we-3 years ejameni le-junior management kummandla ongqamana noko. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi olungqamana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olujulile ngemiba yokhuseleko kwamalungu obomi bomhlaba. Imithetho neengqiniseleko zokubeka umhlaba ngokwemigaqo. Uqhelaniselwe kokucwangcisa iindaba ezibalulekileyo. Ulawulo lwamagunya abasebenzi. Ulawulo lweenkonzo zemali. Ulawulo lwezenkqubo zokuqokelela iinkonzo. Ulwazi ngamandla okuqhuba imali. Imithetho yamagunya eNkonzo yoLuntu. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuhlalutya ngokucinga. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalweyo). Ukuqwalasela nokuhlela. Ukufunda ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubhala iingxelo. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Umxholo woxhumo lobudlelwane bomntu nomntu. Ukwenza kube lula ukusetyenziswa kolwazi nokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi. Ukuqhuba iingxoxo nokusombulula iingxabano. Ukuzinza ngokwemigaqo yolwazi. Ulawulo loqhqho. Ukuzinza ngokwemigaqo yolwazi. Ukubeka iingxelo ngezibalo. Ukuzimisela okuhambelela nakunxibeke ngokusebenza ngokucingelezayo.
xh.duties: Yenza isihloko kwaye uxhase ukusetyenziswa kwenzululwazi yomhlaba jikelele ngokusesiko. Cwangcisa iindaba zokwenza ulwazi olutsha nokwakha amandla ngokulawula umhlaba ngokusesiko nemithetho ezalathwayo kubantu abathile. Nika inkxaso kwisiseko esilawula amagunya omhlaba ngokunika inkxaso ngomthetho nokwenza ulwazi. Yenza kube lula kwaye ulawule iindonga ezikwizinga elingagqibekanga kwimiba yamagunya omhlaba nagxaki ezingxabana ngomhlaba ngokusesiko ngokwemithetho eziphilayo. Yenza isihloko kokusebenza kweendonga zokuphucula iinkqubo zokubeka umhlaba ngokusesiko. Yenza isihloko kwaye uxhase ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zamagunya omhlaba. Qaphele yonke imibuzo yeenkqubo zamagunya omhlaba. Nika inkxaso kwisiseko esilawula amagunya omhlaba ngokunika inkxaso ngomthetho nokwenza ulwazi. Yenza isihloko kokungenisa iingxoxo nokugqiba kwamagunya omhlaba. Yenza isihloko kokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokuphucula amagunya omhlaba. Qaphele iNkonzo yoLawulo loMhlaba. Yenza isihloko kwaye uxhase ukusekwa kwaye uxhase iindonga zomhlaba ngokusesiko. Yenza kube lula ukusekwa nokusetyenziswa kweendonga ezikwizinga (i-CPA). Gcina usukululu iinkcukacha ze-CPA nezinye iindonga. Yenza isihloko kwimigaqo yokulwazi ngeendaba ze-CPA. Yenza uphando kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwindalo yomhlaba. Yenza kube lula kwimigaqo yokungenisa iingxoxo nokusombulula iingxabano ze-CPA. Nika inkxaso ngokusebenza ngokubonelela nangolwazi ngokulawula kweendonga ezibalulekileyo nokwenza ulwazi ngokuhlawula umhlaba. Lawula inkqubo yomsebenzi yephondo ngokuhlawula umhlaba. Yenza isihloko kwimigaqo yabantu. Mela kwaye mize inkqubo kumaziko amaninzi. Khuthaza ukuzinza ngokwemithetho kwe-CPA. Yenza isihloko kwiindonga ezibhetele ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yomsebenzi. Yenza isihloko kwinkqubo yengozi neenkcukacha ezibhetele. Qokelela iingxelo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director Project Management and Quality
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS)
jobs.summary: Manage project planning and quality assurance for internal audit, coordinating strategic plans and reporting to the Chief Audit Executive.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Auditing / Accounting (NQF Level 6) or relevant related qualification. Minimum of 3 years of junior management experience in the internal audit project management and quality assurance field. A valid driver's licence. Job related knowledge: Project management best practice. The Standards of the Institute of Internal Auditors. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written). Analytical and problem-solving ability. Project management. Computer literacy. Financial management. Risk and control assessment. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
jobs.duties: Co-ordinate the compilation of the strategic and operational plans for approval of the Chief Audit Executive (CAE), monitor and report to the CAE on the implementation of the project plans to achieve the targets set out in the strategic and operational plans monthly. Coordinate the compilation of the Chief Directorate's strategic plan and the Chief Directorate and Directorates' operational plans by March each year. Measure and report progress with the achievement of the operational and strategic objectives to the CAE monthly. Co-ordinate the compilation of the internal audit operational and process risk registers by all directorates for sign-off by the CAE by April each year. Measure the implementation of risk register action plans and prepare a monthly progress report for the CAE. Manage the development and updating of methodologies, policies and procedures in line with best practise and the International Standards of the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) and the Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) Professional Standards on an annual basis. Manage the review of methodologies, policies and procedures in line with best practice and standards of the IIA and the ACFE annually. Manage research on latest methodologies and trends to improve methodologies, policies and procedures. Manage continuous improvement of methodologies, policies and procedures. Provide training to all internal Audit staff on improved methodologies, policies and procedures as well as the Teammate system annually. Provide continuous support to all Internal Audit staff on improved methodologies, policies and procedures as well as the Teammate system. Manage the performance of Quality Assurance reviews on the annual internal audit plan projects on a continuous basis, the Internal Quality Assessment Review annually and the five yearly External Quality Assessment Review. Perform and manage Quality Assurance Reviews and report on compliance with the Internal Audit Methodology of all deliverables of all audit projects prior to submission to the CAE. Perform annual Internal Quality Assessment review. Coordinate the External Quality Assessment Reviews performed every five years. Manage the measurement and reporting on progress with the Project Plans of the Chief Directorates' Annual Internal Audit Plan Projects and Forensic Investigations Case Management Register Projects monthly; and reporting on the implementation of management action plans on all Internal Audit reports and Forensic Investigations reports on a quarterly basis. Manage the measurement of deliverables and preparation of monthly progress reporting for the execution of the Chief Directorate's annual audit plan and annual case management register (in-house, co-sourced and outsourced). Manage the secretariat function of monthly progress meetings. Manage the creation of all projects on the Electronic Auditing Software system. Manage the updating of deliverables on the Electronic Auditing Software System-version control and replicas and signoffs. Manage the review of the completeness of the Electronic Auditing Software file after completion of the audit projects. Manage the distribution of all Audit Reports on all audit projects. Manage the administration, service level agreement and periodic upgrades of the electronic auditing software. Manage the quarterly requests for progress reports from line management on the implementation of action plans on all internal audit reports and implementation of recommendations on all forensic investigation reports on a quarterly basis. Co-ordinate the analyse of the reports and clarification with line managers of the progress reports from line management on the implementation of action plans on all internal audit reports and implementation of recommendations on all forensic investigation reports on a quarterly basis. Manage the preparation of progress reports on the implementation of management action plans and recommendations presentations to the Audit Committee on a quarterly basis. Manage the co-ordination of the Chief Directorate's financial management, document and information management and governance processes and report on progress monthly. Manage and review the compilation of the annual Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE) and Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) budgets, budget shifts, financial reconciliations, monthly cash flow and expenditure deviation reports for the Chief Directorate for Directors and CAE sign-off. Manage the identification, declaration and reprioritisation of the Chief Directorate's budget allocations and submit savings if required. Manage asset management of the Chief Directorate. Verify integrity of procurement requests, payments, claims and advance. Verify travel arrangement for and payments to audit committee members. Verify the reporting on the project budget and spending of outsourced and co-sourced internal audit and forensic investigations project. Manage the implementation of an effective and efficient document reference system, filing system and document control and information security audits to ensure compliance to the prescribed systems. Manage the preparation of the annual Employment Equity (EE), SDP, Health and Safety and all other transformation plans and the measurement of and reporting on the implementation of transformation plans action plans and progress reporting to the CAE on a quarterly basis. Co-ordinate the management of the driver and messenger functions in the Chief Directorate. Perform the audit committee secretariat function. Perform all the written communication with audit committee members and attendees, including co-ordination of signing of appointment letters and contracts. Manage distribution of meeting documentation. Manage the performance of logistical arrangements for meetings. Act as the secretariat in meetings. Compile the minutes of all audit committee and audit in-committee meetings. Manage the payment of audit committee members.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivered during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van der Walt Street), Berea Park, Pretoria, 0002 or by email to Post241@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur Projekbestuur en Kwaliteit
af.summary: Bestuur projekbeplanning en gehaltversekering vir interne oudit, coördineer strategiese planne en doen verslag aan die Hoofoudituitvoerende beampte.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Oudit / Rekenkunde (NQF Vlak 6) of 'n relevante verwante kwalifikasie. Minimum van 3 jaar se junior bestuurservaring in die interne oudit projekbestuur en gehaltversekeringsveld. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Beste praktyke in projekbestuur. Die standaarde van die Instituut van Interne Ouditeurs. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Analitiese en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Projekbestuur. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Finansiële bestuur. Risiko- en beheerassessering. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom.
af.duties: Coördineer die opstel van die strategiese en operasionele planne vir goedkeuring deur die Hoofoudituitvoerende beampte (CAE), monitor en doen maandeliks verslag aan die CAE oor die implementering van die projekte om die teikens wat in die strategiese en operasionele planne uiteengesit is, te bereik. Coördineer die opstel van die Hoofdirektoraat se strategiese plan en die Hoofdirektoraat en Direktorate se operasionele planne teen Maart elke jaar. Meet en doen maandeliks verslag oor vordering met die bereiking van die operasionele en strategiese doelwitte aan die CAE. Coördineer die opstel van die interne oudit operasionele en prosesrisikoregisters deur alle direktorate vir ondertekening deur die CAE teen April elke jaar. Meet die implementering van risikoregister-aksieplanne en berei 'n maandelikse vorderingverslag vir die CAE voor. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en bywerking van metodologieë, beleide en prosedures in ooreenstemming met beste praktyk en die Internasionale Standaarde van die Instituut van Interne Ouditeurs (IIA) en die Vereniging van Sertifiseerde Bedrogondersoekers (ACFE) se professionele standaarde op 'n jaarlikse basis. Bestuur die hersiening van metodologieë, beleide en prosedures in ooreenstemming met beste praktyk en standaarde van die IIA en die ACFE jaarliks. Bestuur navorsing oor die jongste metodologieë en tendense om metodologieë, beleide en prosedures te verbeter. Bestuur deurlopende verbetering van metodologieë, beleide en prosedures. Verskaf jaarliks opleiding aan alle interne ouditpersoneel oor verbeterde metodologieë, beleide en prosedures asook die Teammate-stelsel. Verskaf deurlopende ondersteuning aan alle interne ouditpersoneel oor verbeterde metodologieë, beleide en prosedures asook die Teammate-stelsel. Bestuur die uitvoering van gehaltversekerings hersienings op die jaarlikse interne ouditplanprojekte op 'n deurlopende basis, die Interne Kwaliteitsassesseringshersiening jaarliks en die vyfjaarlikse Eksterne Kwaliteitsassesseringshersiening. Voer gehaltversekeringshersienings uit en bestuur dit en doen verslag oor nakoming van die Interne Ouditmetodologie van alle lewerings van alle ouditprojekte voor voorlegging aan die CAE. Voer jaarlikse Interne Kwaliteitsassesseringshersiening uit. Coördineer die Eksterne Kwaliteitsassesseringshersienings wat elke vyf jaar uitgevoer word. Bestuur die meting en verslagdoening oor vordering met die projekplanne van die Hoofdirektorate se jaarlikse interne ouditplanprojekte en Forensiese Ondersoeksaakbestuursregisterprojekte maandeliks; en verslagdoening oor die implementering van bestuursaksieplanne oor alle interne ouditverslae en forensiese ondersoekverslae op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die meting van lewerings en die voorbereiding van maandelikse vorderingverslae vir die uitvoering van die Hoofdirektoraat se jaarlikse ouditplan en jaarlikse saakbestuursregister (in-huis, mede-bron en uitgekontrakteer). Bestuur die sekretariaatfunksie van maandelikse vorderingsvergaderings. Bestuur die skepping van alle projekte op die Elektroniese Ouditagteware-stelsel. Bestuur die bywerking van lewerings op die Elektroniese Ouditagteware-stelsel — weergawebeheer en replikas en ondertekenings. Bestuur die hersiening van die volledigheid van die Elektroniese Ouditagteware-lêer na voltooiing van die ouditprojekte. Bestuur die verspreiding van alle ouditverslae oor alle ouditprojekte. Bestuur die administrasie, diensvlakooreenkoms en periodieke opgraderings van die elektroniese ouditagteware. Bestuur die kwartaallikse versoeke om vorderingverslae van lynbestuur oor die implementering van aksieplanne oor alle interne ouditverslae en implementering van aanbevelings oor alle forensiese ondersoekverslae op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Coördineer die ontleding van die verslae en opheldering met lynbestuurders van die vorderingverslae van lynbestuur oor die implementering van aksieplanne oor alle interne ouditverslae en implementering van aanbevelings oor alle forensiese ondersoekverslae op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die voorbereiding van vorderingverslae oor die implementering van bestuursaksieplanne en aanbiedings van aanbevelings aan die Ouditkomitee op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Bestuur die coördinering van die Hoofdirektoraat se finansiële bestuur, dokument- en inligtingsbestuur en goederneerprosesse en doen maandeliks verslag oor vordering. Bestuur en hersien die opstel van die jaarlikse Skattings van Nasionale Uitgawes (ENE) en Mediumtermyn Uitgaweraamwerk (MTEF) begrotings, begrotingsverskuiwings, finansiële reconciliaties, maandelikse kontantvloei en uitgawe-afwykingsverslae vir die Hoofdirektoraat vir ondertekening deur Direkteurs en die CAE. Bestuur die identifisering, verklaring en herprioritisering van die Hoofdirektoraat se begrotingstoekenning en dien besparings in indien nodig. Bestuur batesbestuur van die Hoofdirektoraat. Verifieer integriteit van verkrygingsversoeke, betalings, eise en voorskotte. Verifieer reëlreëlings vir en betalings aan ouditkomiteelede. Verifieer die verslagdoening oor die projekbegroting en besteding van uitgekontrakteerde en mede-bron interne oudit- en forensiese ondersoekprojekte. Bestuur die implementering van 'n doeltreffende en doeltreffende dokumentverwysingstelsel, lêerstelsel en dokumentbeheer en inligtingssekuriteitsoudits om nakoming van die voorgeskrewe stelsels te verseker. Bestuur die voorbereiding van die jaarlikse Indiensnemingregverdigheidsplan (EE), SDP, Gesondheid en Veiligheid en alle ander transformasieplanne en die meting van en verslagdoening oor die implementering van transformasieplan-aksieplanne en vordering wat kwartaalliks aan die CAE gerapporteer word. Coördineer die bestuur van die bestuurder- en boodskapperfunksies in die Hoofdirektoraat. Voer die ouditkomitee se sekretariaatfunksie uit. Voer alle skriftelike kommunikasie met ouditkomiteelede en bywoners uit, insluitend coördinering van ondertekening van aanstellingsbriewe en kontrakte. Bestuur die verspreiding van vergaderingsdokumentasie. Bestuur die uitvoering van logistieke reëlings vir vergaderings. Tree as die sekretariaat in vergaderings op. Stel die notule van alle ouditkomitee- en oudit-in-komiteevergaderings op. Bestuur die betaling van ouditkomiteelede.

zu.title: UMbekiselikhombisi Umphathi Wokuphatha Amaphrojekthi Nohlelo
zu.summary: Phatha ukuhlelwa kwamaphrojekthi nokuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi yokuhlola okwangaphakathi, ukuhomphanisa izinhlelo ezinkulu nokubika kumphathi omkhulu wokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingavunyelwe ukuba zingabikho: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe ekuHlolweni / ekuBhalweni kwemali (NQF Level 6) noma izifundo ezihlobene nezidingo. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-3 yemva yokuhlolwa emphathini wesigaba esincane kumkhakha wokuphatha amaphrojekthi okuhlola okwangaphakathi nokuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Amasu aphezulu okuphatha amaphrojekthi. Izindingo ze-Institute of Internal Auditors. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Isakhono sokuhlaziya nokuvezwa izinkinga. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukubuka ukuqonda ikhompyutha. Ukuphatha imali. Ukulinganisa ingozi nolawulo. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkinga futhi uhlangabezane nemithelela.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa ukuqoqwa kwezinhlelo ezinkulu nezokusebenza ukuze kuvunyweumphathi omkhulu wokuhlola (CAE), qapha futhi umele ku-CAE inqubo yokuphatha amaphrojekthi ukuze kufezeke izinhloso ezibekiwe ezinhlelweni ezinkulu nezokusebenza njalo ngenyanga. Hlanganisa ukuqoqwa kohlelo olukhulu lwe- Chief Directorate kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ze- Chief Directorate kanye ne- Directorates ngo-March minyaka yonke. Linganisa futhi umele inqubo yokufeza izinhloso zokusebenza nezinkulu ku-CAE njalo ngenyanga. Hlanganisa ukuqoqwa kwemibhalo yengozi yezokusebenza nenzqondo yamaphrojekthi okuhlola okwangaphakathi yonke i- directorates ukuze usayine i-CAE ngo-April minyaka yonke. Linganisa ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi zombhalo wengozi futhi ulungise umbiko wokuqhubela phambili njalo ngenyanga we-CAE. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokubhalwa phansi kwezindlela, kwezinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo ngokuvumelana namasu aphezulu kanye Nezindingo Zomhlaba Ze- Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) kanye ne- Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) Professional Standards ngaphezulu komnyaka wonke. Phatha ukuhlola izindlela, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo ngokuvumelana namasu aphezulu nezidingo ze-IIA kanye ne-ACFE minyaka yonke. Phatha ucwaningo ngezindlela ezisha nezimo zokuthuthukisa izindlela, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo. Phatha ukuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo kwezindlela, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo. Nikeza ukwenziwa kolwazi kubo bonke abasebenzi bokuHlola okwangaphakathi ngezindlela ezithuthukisiwe, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo kanye nenhlelo ye- Teammate minyaka yonke. Nikeza ukwesekwa ngokuqhubekaya kubo bonke abasebenzi bokuHlola okwangaphakathi ngezindlela ezithuthukisiwe, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo kanye nenhlelo ye- Teammate. Phatha ukwenziwa kokuHlola ukuQinisekiswa kweKhwalithi kumaphrojekthi ohlelo lokuhlola lwangaphakathi lwenyaka ngokuqhubekayo, ukuHlolwa kokuQinisekiswa kweKhwalithi Ngaphakathi minyaka yonke kanye nokuHlolwa kokuQinisekiswa kweKhwalithi Kwangaphandle emuva kweminyaka eyisihlanu. Yenza futhi uphathe ukuHlolwa kokuQinisekiswa kweKhwalithi futhi umele ngokuqondana nendlela yokuHlola okwangaphakathi kwayo yonke imikhiqizo yamaphrojekthi okuhlola ngaphambi kokunikwa i-CAE. Yenza ukuHlolwa kokuQinisekiswa kweKhwalithi Ngaphakathi minyaka yonke. Hlanganisa ukuHlolwa kokuQinisekiswa kweKhwalithi Kwangaphandle okwenziwa emuva kweminyaka eyisihlanu. Phatha ukulinganisa nokubika inqubo kwezinhlelo Zamaphrojekthi ze- Chief Directorates eHlelweni lokuHlola lwangaphakathi lwenyaka namaphrojekthi e- Forensic Investigations Case Management Register njalo ngenyanga; futhi ukubika ngokuqondana nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi zomphathi kuyo yonke imibiko yokuHlola okwangaphakathi kanye nemibiko ye- Forensic Investigations njalo kwikota. Phatha ukulinganisa kwemikhiqizo nokulungisa ukubika inqubo yokuqhubela phambili njalo ngenyanga ukuze kusetshenziswe ohlelweni lokuhlola lwenyaka lwe- Chief Directorate kanye nombhalo wokuqashwa kweenyaka ( ngaphakathi, ngokuhlanganyela, kanye nokuthunyelwa ). Phatha umsebenzi wokuba yibhalansi njalo ngenyanga kumihlangano yokuqhubela phambili. Phatha ukudalwa kwawo wonke amaphrojekthi kwizinhlelo ze- Electronic Auditing Software. Phatha ukubhalwa phansi kwemikhiqizo kuzinhlelo ze- Electronic Auditing Software ukulawula izinguquko kanye nezinguye futhi usayine. Phatha ukuhlola ukuqeda kwayo yonke imibhalo ye- Electronic Auditing Software ngemuva kokuphothulwa kwamaphrojekthi okuhlola. Phatha ukwkwhabelana kwawo wonke ambiko okuhlola kumaphrojekthi wonke okuhlola. Phatha izindaba, isivumelwano sezinkonzo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi samakhompyutha okuhlola. Phatha izicelo zokuqoqwa kwemibiko yokuqhubela phambili okuvela kumphathi wezigaba ngokuqondana nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi kuyo yonke imibiko yokuhlola okwangaphakathi kanye nokusebenzisa izincomo kuyo yonke imibiko yokuphenya ngokwedlulelo kwesono njalo kwikota. Hlanganisa ukuhlola imibiko kanye nokucaciswa kumphathi wezigaba ngemibiko yokuqhubela phambili esuka kumphathi wezigaba ngokuqondana nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi kuyo yonke imibiko yokuhlola okwangaphakathi kanye nokusebenzisa izincomo kuyo yonke imibiko yokuphenya ngokwedlulelo kwesono njalo kwikota. Phatha ukulungiswa kwemibiko yokuqhubela phambili ngokuqondana nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi zomphathi kanye nezincomo eziphethwe ku- Audit Committee njalo kwikota. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa kwe- Chief Directorate kokuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphatha imibhalo kanye nokuqondana kolwazi kanye nenzqubo yolawula futhi umbike ngokuqhubela phambili njalo ngenyanga. Phatha futhi uhlaziye ukuqoqwa kwezabelo zemali zenyaka ze- Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE) kanye ne- Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), izinguquko zamanani, ukuqondanisa imali, ukuphuma kwemali njalo ngenyanga kanye nemibiko yokwehluka kwetolo ye- Chief Directorate ukuba kusayinwe ngabaphathi kanye ne-CAE. Phatha ukuhlonza, ukubika futhi ukwabelwa kabusha izabelo zembukiso ye- Chief Directorate futhi uhluze izigulo uma kunesidingo. Phatha imali yamalungu enhhlabathi ye- Chief Directorate. Qinisekisa ukuzinza kwezicelo zokuthenga, izinkokhelo, izimangalo kanye namali esikhashana. Qinisekisa izinhlelo zokuhamba kanye nezinkokhelo zamalungu e- Audit Committee. Qinisekisa ukubika ngosabelo bomphrojekthi kanye nokusebenzisa amaphrojekthi okuhlola okwangaphakathi kanye okuphenywa isono ngokuthunyelwa nangokuhlanganyela. Phatha ukusebenzisa uhlelo lokuqondisa amadokhumenti olusebenza kahle, uhlelo lokuqaqa amafayili kanye nokuqondisa ukulawula ulwazi kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha kolwazi ukuvumelana nezinhlelo ezibekiwe. Phatha ukulungiswa kwe- Employment Equity (EE) yenyaka, i- SDP, ukuPhepha nokuQinisekiswa kanye nazo zonke ezinye izinhlelo zokuguqula kanye nokulinganisa nokubika ngokuqhubela phambili mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi zokuguqula futhi kubikwe i-CAE njalo kwikota. Hlanganisa ukuphatha imisebenzi yokushayela kanye nomgibeli we- Chief Directorate. Yenza umsebenzi wokuba yibhalansi yomhlangano we- Audit Committee. Yenza yonke imibhalo yokuxhumana nalabo abayilunga le- Audit Committee kanye nabathintekayo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlanganiswa kokusayina kwamagama okubekwa emsebenzini kanye nemigwalo. Phatha ukwabelwa imibhalo yomhlangano. Phatha ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo zezinsiza zomhlangano. Yima njengesekelethari emihlanganweni. Hlela amaminithi yonke imihlangano ye- Audit Committee kanye ne- Audit in-committee. Phatha izinkokhelo zamalungu e- Audit Committee.

xh.title: Isekela Mongamabaprojekthi Wokuqondisa kunye Noholo
xh.summary: Ukulawula ucwangciso lwamaprojekthi nokuqinisekisa kwihlobo ukugqitha ngaphakathi, ukuqhanga iicwangciso ezingumgama kwaye uxela kuGqirha Oyintloko Wokuqondisa Ngaphakathi.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrede 12 kunye neDiploma yaseZizwe kwi-Auditing / Accounting (NQF Level 6) okanye nelifikeshoni elinxulumene nelo. Ubuncinane i-3 years yamava olawulo abafundi kwindawo yolawulo lwamaprojekthi ekuqondiseni ngaphakathi nokuqinisekisa ihlobo. Ilayisensi yomqhubi evakalayo. Ulwazi oluxhomekeke kumsebenzi: Izilumko ezilungileyo zolawulo lwamaprojekthi. Iziqendu ze-Institute of Internal Auditors. Amakhono axhomekeke kumsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (olubhalwayo noluthethwayo). Ikhono lokuhlola kunye noku应对 iingxaki. Ulawulo lwamaprojekthi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulawulo lwezemali. Nconvulwa nokuhlolwa kweengozi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi komfutho nokubambelela kumaxesha aqhelisiweyo.
xh.duties: Ukuqhanga ukuqokelelwa kweecwangciso ezingumgama nezosebenzo zokuze zivunywe nguGqirha Oyintloko Wokuqondisa Ngaphakathi (CAE), ukuqwalasela kwaye uxelele i-CAE ngokuqatywa kweecwangciso zamaprojekthi ukuze kufikelelwe kwiiqagqamba ezibekiweyo kwiicwangciso ezingumgama nezosebenzo nyanga nganye. Qhenga ukuqokelelwa kweecwangciso ezingumgama zeNdikwe ndlela eNkulu kunye neecwangciso zosebenzo zeNdikwe ndlela eNkulu nabaNiniNtlobo ngoMatshi ngamnye. Linganisa kwaye uxela inkqubela kokuqatywa kwamagqabantshintshi aqondiswayo nangumgama ku-CAE nyanga nganye. Qhenga ukuqokelelwa kweeregistri zeengozi zosebenzo nokuqhuba kokuqondisa ngaphakathi ngazo zonke iindwebo ukuze zityikitywe ngama-CAE ngoTshazimpunzi ngamnye. Linganisa ukuphunywa kweendwendwe zeregistri yengozi kwaye ulungise ingxelo yenkqubela nyanga nganye ye-CAE. Lawula ukuphuhliswa nokuhlaziya iindlela, iinkqubo kunye neendlela ngokwemigaqo elungileyo nokuqinisekiswa ngamazinga e-International Standards of the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) kunye ne-Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) Professional Standards ngonyaka ngamnye. Lawula ukuhlolwa kwezindlela, iinkqubo kunye neendlela ngokwemigaqo elungileyo nokuqinisekiswa ngamazinga e-IIA nase-ACFE ngonyaka ngamnye. Lawula uphando ngeendlela namathrendi asentlakuhlengwa ukuphucula iindlela, iinkqubo kunye neendlela. Lawula ukuphucula ngokoqhubela iindlela, iinkqubo kunye neendlela. Nikeza isikolo bonke obasebenzayo abakuqondisweni ngaphakathi ngeendlela, iinkqubo kunye neendlela eziphuculiweyo kunye nenkqubo yemate yethu ngamnye. Nikeza inkxaso ngokoqhubela bonke obasebenzayo abakuqondisweni ngaphakathi ngeendlela, iinkqubo kunye neendlela eziphuculiweyo kunye nenkqubo yemate yethu. Lawula ukwenziwa kokuqinisekisa kohlobo ulawulo kuwo onke amaprojekthi oloqondiso lwangaphakathi olucwangciswe ngonyaka ngamnye ngokoqhubela, ulawulo lwangaphakathi lokuhlola kahle ngonyaka ngamnye kunye nokubuyekezwa ngaphandle kwohlobo phakathi kweminyaka emihlanu. Yenza kwaye ulawule ukuqinisekisa kohlobo ulawulo kwaye uxele ngeempawu zokuzigqatsa kwindlela yokuqondisa ngaphakathi yazo zonke iziphatho eziphuma kuwo onke amaprojekthi e-odit ngaphambi kokuzenza i-CAE. Yenza ulawulo lwangaphakathi lokuhlola kahle ngonyaka ngamnye. Qhenga ukubuyekezwa kokubuyekezwa kohlobo ngaphandle okwenziwa emva kweminyaka emihlanu. Lawula ukulinganisa nokuxela ngenkqubela ngeeNdlela zeProjekthi zamaprojekthi oloqondiso lwangaphakathi lweNdikwe ndlela eNkulu lonyaka kunye neregistri yoLawulo lweNyanga lweMe Investigative yobuqhwala nyanga nganye; kwaye ukuxela ngokuphunywa kweekhondo ezilawulayo zoLawulo kuzo zonke iingxelo zoqondiso ngaphakathi kunye neengxelo zophando I-Forensic kwisikwelo ngamnye. Lawula ukulinganisa kweziphatho nokuqokelelwa kwingxelo yenkqubela nyanga nganye ngokuphunywa kweNdikwe ndlela eNkulu icwangciso loqondiso ngaphakathi lonyaka neregistri yoLawulo Iwenyanga (endlini, ngabanye, kunye nokukhweliswa). Lawula umsebenzi wokuba ngumabhalane phakathi kwemigqyeko yomthetho wenkqubela nyanga nganye. Lawula ukudalwa kwawo onke amaprojekthi kwinkqubo ye-Electronic Auditing Software system. Lawula ukuhlaziya kweziphatho kwinkqubo ye-Electronic Auditing Software System-ukulawula kweesiNdede kunye namakhophi nokutyikitywa. Lawula ukuthelekisa kobuninzi befayile ye-Electronic Auditing Software emva kokugqitywa kwamaprojekthi o-odit. Lawula ukusasazwa kuzo zonke iingxelo zo-odit kuwo onke amaprojekthi o-odit. Lawula ulawulo lomsebenzi, isivumelwano yamakhono okukhonza kunye nokuvuselela ngesikhathi esithile inkqubo ye-electronic auditing software. Lawula iindingelelo ezisuka kulawulo lomgca zenkqubela kwizingxelo ngokuhamba kwesikwela ngokuphunywa kweekhondo ezilawulayo kuzo zonke iingxelo zoqondiso ngaphakathi nokuphunywa kweengcebiso kuzo zonke iingxelo zophando i-forensic kwisikwela ngamnye. Qhenga ukuhlalutywa kweengxelo kwaye ucacise nalaba balawulo abagama phakathi kweengxelo zenkqubela kulawulo lomgca ngokuphunywa kweekhondo ezilawulayo kuzo zonke iingxelo zoqondiso ngaphakathi nokuphunywa kweengcebiso kuzo zonke iingxelo zophando i-forensic kwisikwela ngamnye. Lawula ukuqokelelwa kweengxelo zenkqubela ngokuphunywa kweekhondo ezilawulayo eziphumo zinengcebiso kwamaboniso kuKomiti yo-odit kwisikwela ngamnye. Lawula ukuqhanganiswa kolawulo lweemali zefama zendlu enkulu nolonocedo, iinkqubo zolawulo lweefayile iinkqubo nolononcedo ngokulwa kweenkqubo zeemfanelo ukuya apho kuya kulinzwa khona ngokulwa iinkqubo ngokwemigaqo eqheliswayo nokuxela ngenkqubela nyanga nganye. Lawula kwaye uhlule ukuqokelelwa kweyam nyaka ze-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE) kunye ne-Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) amabudjethi, amashipti ebhajethi, izibalo zemali, ukusuka kwemali yesikhathi kunye neengxelo zexesha zemali ngendlela ehlukileyo zeNdikwe ndlela eNkulu kwabaBalulekileyo naku-CAE ukuze bazityikitye. Lawula ukuzichaza, ukuzalathisa nokubuyela emva kokwabelwa kwamabudjethi endlu enkulu nendlela yokulawula kwaye ungenise noku gcina apho kuyimfuneko khona. Lawula ulawulo lwamafa eNdikwe ndlela eNkulu. Qinisekisa ubuqhetseba bokufuna izinto ngokutenga, iindlela zokuqinisekiswa ngemali, izimangalo kwaye qhubela phambili nangaphambili. Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa koluhambiso-iindwendwe zokwenzela kubalulekile abo bahlala bekumagqabantshintshi abaqinisekiswa oodit kwaye bahlawulwe njalo. Qinisekisa ingxelo ngebhajethi nokusetyenziswa ngokubakwa kwemali yamaprojekthi oqondiso ngaphakathi alawulwayo ukuba abe mnye nolawulwayo ngokwemigaqo yophando i-forensic. Lawula ukubakwa kwenkqubo yosebenzo oluyimfuneko yemigaqo ebalulekileyo norhwebo ikakhulu, indlela yokuqhelanisa neefayile nomsebenzi kwaye kuhlalwe luqhakamshelwano ngokulawulwa kolunconco nolukhuselekileyo kweefayile nolwazi kuqinisekiso lokuzigqatsa kwazo zonke iinkqubo eziqheliswayo. Lawula ukuqokelelwa kwemingaqo yolungelelwaniso lomsebenzi uluntu nolungelelwaniso lonyaka lwe-Employment Equity (EE), SDP, impilo nolondolozo nako konke okunye ukuguqulwa kweecwangciso nokulinganisa nokuxela ngokuphunywa kwazo ukuya kwi-CAE kwisikwela ngamnye. Qhenga ulawulo lomsebenzi womqhubi nosithunywa endlwini enkulu. Yenza umsebenzi wokuba ngumabhalane weKomiti yodit. Yenza wonke unxibelelwano olubhaliweyo namalungu eKomiti yodit nabathathwayo ngokuhambisana noqhakamshelwano lokutyikitya amagama eqhinga kwaye noqhakamshelwano nemiqathango. Lawula ulwandiso lwamaxwebhu othungelwano. Lawula imisebenzi yolwandiso olukhuselekileyo lomthungo wokwenza umsebenzi. Yiba ngumabhalane kumgqyeko. Yenza ukubhaliswa kwawo onke amagqabantshintshi okuqondisa ngaphakathi kunye neKomiti yodit phakathi kwaye ikhule ngokubhaliswa okukhoyo kwaye iqhutywa inyanga nganye. Qhenga ukuqhanganiswa kolawulo lwezimali zenhlanhla yokwakhiwa kulawulo lwenkonzo yegama lokuhlawulela phakathi kwelinye inyanga phakathi kweminyaka.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Logistics and Transport Services
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role overseeing logistics and transport services in Bloemfontein, requiring a logistics-related diploma and three years of supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Logistics Management / Financial Management / Public Administration / Public Management / Purchasing Management or related equivalent qualifications (NQF Level 6). Minimum of 3 years’ supervisory experience in Logistics and Transport environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Public Service Policies and Regulations. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations and Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Knowledge of Basic Accounting System (BAS) and Logistical Information System (LOGIS), Ability to monitor budget. Ability to liaise at different levels of management and ability to perform supply chain management services. Job related skills: Computer literacy, Communication (verbal and written). Organising ability. Ability to supervisory and liaison. Ability to work in a team.
jobs.duties: Implement logistics management systems, procedures and processes. Manage user profiles. Asset classifications. Link supplier Item Control Number (ICN), unit price, etc. Coordinate year-end closure for audit purposes as required. Provide management information, statistics and reports. Monitor movement of requests. Ensure the integrity of LOGIS. Verify compliance before capturing on LOGIS. Ensure processing of orders. Manage inventory levels. Initiate payments for goods, services and assets. Ensure payments within 30 days. Validate and reconcile payment for goods, services and assets. Manage creditor’s reconciliation. Manage stores and warehousing. Ensure effective systems aimed at improving service turnaround times (0 to 9). Ensure optimum utilisation of stores and warehousing. Manage fleet services and travel arrangements. Management of Official Flight, Transport and Accommodation Request (OFTAR) and Departmental Official Transport Request (DOTR) requests. Reconcile payments against OFTAR and DOTR requests. Administer Government Garage (GG) and subsidised vehicles. Administer fleet and travel management services.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 136 Charlotte Maxeke Street, SA Eagle Building, Bloemfontein, 9300 or by email to Post237@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

xh.title: Ulawulo Lwezixhobo Eziqhelisayo Nakunye Neendlela Ezili-12
xh.summary: Indima kaLawuli oLawula iNkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezingundoqo ngobuchwepheshe eBloemfontein, efuna isidanga ngobuchwepheshe esihlobene nendlela ezisetyenziswa kunye namava unyaka othathu ekulawuleni abantu abasetyenzisa amakhono.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neSatiwanede sakho gunman kunye neDiploma yaseMzantsi Afrika kwilawulo lezinto ezidityaniswe nendlela ezisetyenziswa / ilawulo lemali / ilawulo likarhulumente / ilawulo leempahla / ilawulo lokuthenga okanye izidanga ezilinganayo ezihlobene nendlela ezisetyenziswa (NQF Level 6). Amava amisela xesha afunekayo ubuncinane iya kuba ngu-3 kwimisebenzi yokulawula kwendawo yokulawula izinto ezidityaniswe nendlela ezisetyenziswa. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi malunga namacebo okulawula ezenza ukuba kuphathwe ngokomthetho okusemisweyo urhulumente namacebo okulawula amaphoyisa. Ulwazi malunga namacebo okulawula iimali zorhulumente noMthetho wokuLawulwa kweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA). Ulwazi malunga neNkqubo yeZibalo eziPhantsi (BAS) kunye neNkqubo yoLwazi ngeempahla ezidityaniswe nendlela ezisetyenziswa (LOGIS), ukuba nakho ukulawula umgangatho wemali. Ukuba nakho ukuxhumana namalinge ahlukeneyo obulungisa kunye namandla okwenza iinkonzo zokulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezisetyenziswa kwindawo yokusetyenziswa. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukufunda nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Unxibelelaniso (ngokuthetha nokubhala). Ukuba nakho ukulawula nokulungelelanisa. Ukuba nakho ukulawula ukulawula. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza kwiqela.
xh.duties: Phatha iinkqubo, iindlela namaxesha okulawula izinto ezidityaniswe nendlela ezisetyenziswa. Lawula iiprofayile zabasebenzisi. Ukwahlulwa kweempahla. Qamba inani lokulawula into yomthengisi (ICN), ixabiso leyunithi, njl njl. Lungiselela kuqala ngenkqubo yokuvula unyaka ekupheleni kwawo ngenjongo yokusingathwa kwengxelo malunga nexabiso lemali. Yenza iinkcukacha ezimfutshane ngendlela ebonisa ngqo iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo, iindaba ngokubalwa kwabantu ngeendidi ezahlukeneyo, neemviwo ezahlukeneyo eziboniswe ngokupela. Qwalasela iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezingundoqo ngobuchwepheshe ekulawulweni kweendlela. Qinisekisa ukuba ngokutsha kwexabiso lemali kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Qwalasela ukuchaneka kweendaba ezifunwa ngokukhawuleza ekubhalweni kwexabiso lemali kwinkqubo ye-LOGIS. Qinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa iindlela ezahlukeneyo eziya kwenza ukuba ixabiso lemali liqatshelwe ngokukhawuleza. Lawula amanqanaba okulondolozo kwempahla. Qalisa imali yokuhlawula iimpahla, iinkonzo namachweba eempahla ezahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukuba imali yomsebenzi ihlawulwa kwiintsuku ezili-30. Qinisekisa nokulinganisa imali yokuhlawula iimpahla, iinkonzo namachweba eempahla ezahlukeneyo. Lawula ukulinganiselwa kweemali ezahlulwayo ezahlukeneyo phakathi kweendlela ezahlukeneyo ezilawulwa kukabaphathi beemali. Lawula ukugcinwa nokulondolozwa kweempahla nendawo ezisetyenziswa kuyo. Qinisekisa iinkqubo ezisebenzayo ezijolise ekuphuculeni iixesha zokubuyisela inkonzo (0 ukuya kwi-9). Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokupela kwendawo yokugcina nokulondolozwa kweempahla. Lawula iinkonzo zeendawo ezihamba ngesixhobo esithengiweyo nendlela yokuhamba. Lawula iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezimiselweyo ngokusesikweni malunga nezicelo ezahlukeneyo ezibizwa ngokuba zii-OFTAR nee-DOTR. Linganisa imali yokuhlawula iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo ezimiselweyo. Lawula ukugcinwa nokulondolozwa kweendawo ezinikezelwa ngurhulumente nakwiindawo ezinikezelwa ngesixhobo esithengiweyo esetyenziswa yi-Square yase-Government Garage (GG). Lawula iinkonzo zokuhamba ezahlukeneyo.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Logistiek en Vervoerdienste
af.summary: Assistent-direkteurpos wat toesig hou oor logistiek en vervoerdienste in Bloemfontein, waarvoor 'n logistiekverwante diploma en drie jaar se toesigervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Logistieke Bestuur / Finansiële Bestuur / Publieke Administrasie / Publieke Bestuur / Aankoopbestuur of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies (NQF Vlak 6). Minimum van 3 jaar se toesigervaring in 'n logistiek- en vervoeromgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Publieke Diensbeleide en Regulasies. Kennis van Tesourie Regulasies en Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Kennis van Basic Accounting System (BAS) en Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Vermoë om begroting te monitor. Vermoë om op verskillende bestuursvlakke te skakel en vermoë om voorsieningskettingbestuursdienste te lewer. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid, Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Organisasievermoë. Vermoë tot toesig en skakeling. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Implementeer logistieke bestuurstelsels, prosedures en prosesse. Bestuur gebruikersprofiele. Bateklassifikasies. Koppel supplier Item Control Number (ICN), eenheidsprys, ens. Koördineer jaareindsluiting vir ouditdoeleindes soos vereis. Verskaf bestuursinligting, statistiek en verslae. Monitor beweging van versoeke. Verseker die integriteit van LOGIS. Verifieer nakoming voordat dit op LOGIS vasgelê word. Verseker verwerking van bestellings. Bestuur voorraadvlakke. Inisieer betalings vir goedere, dienste en bates. Verseker betalings binne 30 dae. Valideer en reconcilieer betaling vir goedere, dienste en bates. Bestuur skuldeiser se reconciliastie. Bestuur winkels en berging. Verseker doeltreffende stelsels gemik op die verbetering van diensomkeertye (0 tot 9). Verseker optimale benutting van winkels en berging. Bestuur vlootdienste en reëreling vir reise. Bestuur van Official Flight, Transport and Accommodation Request (OFTAR) en Departmental Official Transport Request (DOTR) versoeke. Reconcilieer betalings teen OFTAR- en DOTR-versoeke. Administreer Government Garage (GG) en gesubsidieerde voertuie. Administreer vloot- en reisbestuursdienste.

zu.title: Umcolekisi Weziqu: Izinsizakalo Zokuhambisa Iimpahla Nezokuthutha
zu.summary: Indima kaMcolekisi Weziqu obuka izinsizakalo zokuhambisa iimpahla nezokuthutha eBloemfontein, ofuna idiploma ehlobene nokuhambisa iimpahla kanye neminyaka emithathu yomphumela obhekene nokubusa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingavunyelwe ukuba ngaphansi kwazo: Abafakela kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neDiploma Yezwe eYilawulenzi Yempahla / EYilawulenzi Yezimali / EYilawulenzi Yoluntu / EYilawulenzi Yabalandeli / EYilawulenzi YokuThenga noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezihlobene (i-NQF Level 6). Ukwazi ukubusa okuncane kweminyaka engu-3 endaweni yokuhambisa iimpahla nezokuthutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemigomo namasiko oLuntu. Ulwazi ngamasiko weTreasury kanye noMthetho WokuYilawula Imali Yoluntu (PFMA). Ulwazi ngokuYilawulwa Kohlelo Lokubala Okuyisiseko (BAS) nokuYilawulwa Kohlelo Lolwazi Ngempahla (LOGIS), ikhono lokubuka isabelo somali. Ikhono lokuxhumana emazingeni ahlukene yolawulo kanye nakhono lokunika izinsizakalo zokuLawula Kuyilatshi. Amandla ohlelo oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ikhono lokuhlela. Ikhono lokubusa nasekuxhumeleni. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini.
zu.duties: Yilawula izindlela, amasiko kanye namaphrosesi yokuhambisa iimpahla. Yilawula iphrofayela yomsebenzisi. Ukulinganisa iimpahla. Xhuma inamba Yokulawula Into Yomphakeli (ICN), inani leyunithi, njll. Bumba ukugcwala kwamakhulu eminyaka ngenhloso yokuhlolwa njengoko kudingekile. Nikeza ulwazi oluwulawulo, izibalo namabhuku. Buka ukunyakaza kwezicelo. Qinisekisa ukuzinza kwe-LOGIS. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwamasiko ngaphambi kokuwufaka kwi-LOGIS. Qinisekisa ukucutshatshulwa kwezinto ezithengwayo. Lawula izinga lezimpahla. Qala izinkokhelo zamaphahla, amasiko nezinto. Qinisekisa izinkokhelo kumalanga angu-30. Hlola bese ulinganisa inkokhelo yamaphahla, amasiko nezinto. Lawula ukuhlanganiswa kwabakhiwayo. Lawula izitolo nezindawo zokugcina. Qinisekisa amaphulo asebenzayo ahlose ekwenzeni isikhathi sokuPhendula Kuhamba Kancane (0 kuye ku-9). Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhamba kahle kwezitolo nezindawo zokugcina. Lawula izinsizakalo zeqembu lezimoto futhi hlela izinhlelo zokuhamba. Ukuphathwa kwesicelo Sokuhamba Ngendiza Esisemthethweni, Sokuthutha kanye Nesokulala (OFTAR) nesicelo Sokuthutha Ngaphandle Kwezinyawo Komnyango (DOTR). Linganisa izinkokhelo ngokumelana nezicelo ze-OFTAR ne-DOTR. Phatha Igaraji kahulumeni (GG) nezimoto ezifakelwa inkinga. Phatha izinsizakalo zokuLawula Iqembu kanye NokuHamba.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Financial Management
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Manage budget coordination and MTEF processes as an Assistant Director in Financial Management for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Accounting / Cost and Management Accounting / Financial Management or related equivalent qualification (NQF Level 6). Minimum 3 years’ supervisory experience in the financial management field. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Policies, procedures and prescripts, Financial systems including Basic Accounting System (BAS), Public Financial Management Act, Treasury regulations, Budget and reporting procedures. Job related skills: Financial management, Supervision, Corporate governance, Communication (verbal and written), Ability to produce management reports and presentations, Supervision and Interpersonal. Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Control and coordinate the budget. Manage and coordinate the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), drawings, budget adjustment and Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE) process. Ensure that the appropriate budget of the branch is correctly allocated to the relevant responsibilities / cost centres. Realign the budget in line with operational needs for the branch. Manage the funds shift process. Manage restitution households and current payment. Ensure compliance to internal and external financial prescripts when processing payments. Verify and authorise payments inline with the delegated responsibilities. Ensure that payments are processed within the laid down time frames and correctly in terms of SCOA allocations. Manage expenditure. Analyse and monitor the expenditure trends against the spending plans and drawings. Ensure that the expenditure of the branch is in line with allocated budget of the branch. Take effective and appropriate steps to avoid unauthorised, irregular and fruitless and wasteful expenditures. Compile and coordinate financial reports. Report on spending against the monthly cash flow projections (IYM) and spending plans for the branch. Provide expenditure reports and projects analysis reports to line managers. Provide financial management information and advice to line managers.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivered during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van der Walt Street), Berea Park, Pretoria, 0002 or by email to Post241@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Bestuur begrotingskoördinasie en MTEF-prosesse as Assistent-direkteur in Finansiële Bestuur vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Rekenkunde / Koste- en Bestuursrekenkunde / Finansiële Bestuur of 'n verwante equivalente kwalifikasie (NQF Level 6). Minimum 3 jaar se toesigervaring in die finansiële bestuursveld. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Beleide, prosedures en voorskrifte, Finansiële stelsels insluitend Basic Accounting System (BAS), Public Financial Management Act, Tesourieregulasies, Begrotings- en verslagdoeningsprosedures. Werksverwante vaardighede: Finansiële bestuur, Toesig, Korporatiewe goeweransie, Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), Vermoë om bestuursverslae en voorleggings op te stel, Toesig en interpersoonlik. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Beheer en koördineer die begroting. Bestuur en koördineer die Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), trekkings, begrotingsaanpassing en Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE)-proses. Verseker dat die toepaslike begroting van die tak korrek aan die relevante verantwoordelikhede / kostesentra toegewys word. Herbelyn die begroting in ooreenstemming met operasionele behoeftes vir die tak. Bestuur die fondsverskuiwingsproses. Bestuur restitusie-huishoudings en huidige betaling. Verseker nakoming van interne en eksterne finansiële voorskrifte by die verwerking van betalings. Verifieer en magtig betalings in lyn met die gedelegeerde verantwoordelikhede. Verseker dat betalings binne die vasgestelde tydraamwerke verwerk word en korrek is in terme van SCOA-toewysings. Bestuur besteding. Analiseer en monitor die bestedingstendense teenoor die bestedingsplanne en trekkings. Verseker dat die besteding van die tak in lyn is met die toegewysde begroting van die tak. Neem effektiewe en toepaslike stappe om ongemagtigde, onreëlmatige en vrugtelose en vermorsende bestedings te vermy. Stel op en koördineer finansiële verslae. Rapporteer oor besteding teenoor die maandelikse kontantvloeprojekies (IYM) en bestedingsplanne vir die tak. Verskaf bestedingsverslae en projekanaliseverslae aan lynbestuurders. Verskaf finansiële bestuursinligting en advies aan lynbestuurders.

zu.title: Sikhulu Esibusayo: Ukuphathwa kweZimali
zu.summary: Phatha ukuhlobo imali-mbihla kanye nezinqubo ze-MTEF njengoSikhulu Esibusayo ekuPhathweni kweZimali woMnyango Wokulungiswa Komhlaba Nakuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo zasemakhaya oPretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwalezi: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi samabanga aphansi kakhulu somfundo (Grade 12 Certificate) kanye neDiploma Yezwe kubuNhlolvini / ezoBunhlolvini bezindleko kanye noKuphathwa kwezimali noma ngokulinganayo ngokufana (izinga le-NQF 6). Okungenani amaphoyisa amakhulu amathathu njengomphathi abo ngokuphathwa kwezimali. Ilaysensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izinqubomgomo, izinqubo kanye nemiyalo, Izinhlelo zezimali kufaka phakathi Isimiso Esibekiwe SoBunhlolvini (BAS), uMthetho WoKuphathwa Kwamaholo Mbuso, izimiso ze-Ngcenye, imali-mbihla kanye nezinqubo zokubika. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwezimali, Ukubeka izindinganiso nokuqapha, ukubusa ngokomthetho, Unxibelelwano (olwenziwa ngomlomo nolubhaliwe), Ikholo lokukhiqiza imibiko yokuphathwa nezethulo, Ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye Nokuhlobana nomuntu qho. Ukuzithoba ukugwazula.
zu.duties: Qaphaza futhi uhlobonde imali-mbihla. Phatha futhi uhlobonde Inqubo Yokusebenzisa Imali Esikhathi Esiphakathi (MTEF), ukudweba, ukuhlelwa kwemali-mbihla kanye nesiqondiso Senani Loku—setshenziswa Kwezwe (ENE) inqubo. Qinisekisa ukuthi imali-mbihla efanele yesigaba ihlelwe kahle kumaba oholekayo / izikhungo sezindleko. Hlela kabusha imali-mbihla ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokusebenza zesigaba. Phatha inqubo yokushintshwa kwemali. Phatha amakhaya okubuyiselwa nomkhokho wamanje. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa imiyalo yangaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nezimali uma kucutshungulwa imikhokho. Qinisekisa futhi uvume imikhokho ngokuhambisana nemithetho ebekwe ngamandla. Qinisekisa ukuthi imikhokho icutshungulwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe futhi ngendlela efanele mayelana nokuhlelwa kwe-SCOA. Phatha izindleko. Hlaziya futhi ulawule ukuthi kuthatha kanjani izindleko uma kuqhathaniswa namaphuzu okusebenzisa kanye nokudweba. Qinisekisa ukuthi izindleko zesigaba zihambisana nemali-mbihla ehanjisiwe yesigaba. Thatha izinyathelo ezisebenzayo futhi ezifanele ukuze kugwenywe izindleko ezingavunyiwe, ezingavunyelwe, ezingenasiphuzo futhi ezingalahlekile. Qamba futhi uhlobonde imibiko yezimali. Umbiko mayelana nokusebenziswa kwemali uma kuqhathaniswa nokubikezelwa koku—geleza kwemali yanyanga zonke (IYM) namaphuzu okusebenzisa yesigaba. Nikeza imibiko yezindleko kanye namaphuzu okuhlaziya amaphrojekthi abaphathi bomugqa. Nikeza ulwazi ngapandle kobunikelo bomhlaba kanye ncamashi ngokuphathwa kwezimali abaphathi bomugqa.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNjingalwazi: uLawulo lwezeMali
xh.summary: Lawula ulungelelwaniso lwebhajeti nenkqubo ye-MTEF njengoMncedisi weNjingalwazi kuLawulo lwezeMali kwiSebe leLand Reform and Rural Development ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Kufuneka abafaki bacelwe babe nesatifikethi seGraji ye-12 kwaye beNesidanga seSizwe kwi-Accounting / Cost and Management Accounting / Financial Management okanye isidanga esilinganayo esinxulumeneyo (NQF Level 6). Kangangeminyaka engama-3 ubudala ngaphezulu uluhlu lweNqanaba elithile lemisebenzi ekulawulweni kwezemali. Ilayisensi yomqhubi ethethwe ngokusemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Iindlela zeliso nezenzo nemigaqo, iinkqubo zezezimali kuquka neBasic Accounting System (BAS), uMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zikawonke-wonke, iimigaqo zeTreasury, iindlela zebhajeti nokubika. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: ulawulo lwezemali, ulawulo labantu ngasentla, ulawulo ngokomthetho weshishini, unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangobhalo), amandla okwenza iingxelo zoLawulo nokubonisa izinto, ulawulo labantu ngasentla nobunxibelelwano nabantu. Ukulungele ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Lawula ulungelelwaniso lwebhajeti. Lawula ulungelelwaniso lweMedium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), iindatshu, ulungelelwaniso lwebhajeti nenkqubo yeEstimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Qinisekisa ukuba ibhajeti efanelekileyo yecandelo ihlakanjiswa ngokuchaneka kumaxwebhu ohlobo olungalunga namanzi / iindawo zeendleko zimali. Lungelelwanisa ibhajeti ngokweemfuno zokusebenza zecandelo. Lawula inkqubo yokushiywa kweemali. Lawula abantu basekhaya abafumana izinxulumene nolungelelwaniso namaxhesho angokwangoku. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba kwemigaqo yangaphakathi nangaphandle yezemali xa kucutshungulwa amaxhesho. Qinisekisa uvume amaxhesho ngokuhambiselana nemisebenzi enikelweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba amaxhesho acutshungulwa kwicala lokuba akumiselwe ixesha kwaye ngokuchaneka ngokohluvo lwe-SCOA. Lawula ukuchithwa kwemali. Lungelelwanisa kwaye ulandele iindlela zokuchithwa kwemali kwicala loovuza iimali kwaye kwindlela yokuchithwa kwemali efunwa ngenkqubo yecandelo. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuchithwa kwemali kwicala kuhambelana neseqela lecala ngokuhambiselana nokuhanjiswa kwemali kulinwe kwibhajeti yecandelo. Thatha iinganyelwano ezisebenzayo nanezangomso ukuze ugqibekele ukuchithwa kwemali ngaphandle kwelungelo, ngaphandle komthetho nokuchithwa kwemali ngokungafanelekanga. Hlanganisa ulungelelwaniso lweenkangeleko zezimali. Xela ngokuchithwa kwemali ngokuchasene neenkqubo zeentsasa zenyanga zethamsanqa (IYM) ngeenkqubo zokuchithwa kwecandelo. Zize iingxelo zokuchithwa kwemali nongqamvano lweenkqubo abaphathi abaqhuba imisebenzi yecandelo. Zize iingxelo zolawulo lwezemali namacebiso abaphathi abaqhuba imisebenzi yecandelo.

af.title: Hoofmoniterings- en evalueringsontleder
af.summary: Lei monitering en evaluering van organisatoriese prestasie vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Sosiale Wetenskappe / Ontwikkelingsstudies / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur of 'n verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in monitering en evaluering, navorsing of strategiese beplanning. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis en begrip van die regeringsbreë monitering- en evalueringsstelsel. Kennis van regeringsmonitering- en evalueringsbeleide, standaardbedryfsprosedures, werktuie, inligtingstelsels, beplanning, navorsingsmetodologie en verwante wetgewing. Tesourieregulasies. Prestasie-ouditering. Projekte- en programbestuur. Kwaliteitsverbetering. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om voor te lê. Verslagskryfvermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Projekte- en programbestuur. Inligtingversameling, -analise en -interpretasie. Analitiese denke. Vermoë om inligting aan te pas en te verpak volgens gebruikervereistes. Vermoë om te reis.
af.duties: Koördineer organisatoriese prestasie teen vooraf bepaalde doelwitte. Verskaf insette tydens die departement se beplanningsproses. Skeduleer prestasieverifieringsessies met programme op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Voer inligtingverifiering uit op prestasie-inligting. Berei prestasieverifieringsverslaagliedswerktuie voor. Hou terugvoersessies met verskeie programme om oor prestasie te reflekteer vir besluitneming. Bied hulp met die ontwikkeling van raamwerke, riglyne en stelsels om departementele programmeprestasiemonitering te fasiliteer. Koördineer organisatoriese prestasieverslagdoening. Stel departementele programmeprestasieverslae op (kwartaalliks, middeljaar en jaarliks) op grond van geverifieerde prestasie. Stel strategiese en ad hoc-verslae op. Koördineer ouditversoeke rakende prestasie-inligting. Bestuur tak-antwoorde op ouditversoeke, bevindings en navrae. Stel bestuursantwoorde op vir ouditbevindings / navrae. Kapasiteer takke oor die grondbeginsels van prestasie-ouditering. Voer kapasiteitsopbou / -opleiding uit oor die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Voer kapasiteitsopbou uit oor verslagdoening. Lewer aanbiedings oor die bestuur van 'n portefeulje van bewyse.

zu.title: Isihlabamsoketi Sokuhlola Nokuqonda Imidalashele,
zu.summary: Ukuqondisa ukuhlola nokuqonda imidalashele yezinto ezenziwe ukubonisa kahle isimo se-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwesibalo: Abafakelayo kufanele babe nesiqinisekiso se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma kwezifundo ezingokomphakathi / izifundo zentuthuko / Public Administration / Public Management noma iziqiniseziso ezilinganayo. Umkhathi osukunyanga eminyaka engu-3 ngokusebenza ekuhloleni nasekuqondeni, kuphenyo noma ekuhleni izinhloso. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi nokuqonda isistimu kahulumenti yokuhlola nokuqonda imidalashele. Ulwazi ngemithetho kahulumenti yokuhlola nokuqonda imidalashele, izinqumo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza, amathuluzi, izistimu zolwazi, ukuhlela, indlela yokuphenya nemithetho ehlobene nalokho. Imithetho ye-Treasury. Ukuhlola imidalashele. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi namaphrogramu. Ukuthuthukisa izinga. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokwethula. Ikhono lokubhala imibiko. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhaliwe). Izindlela zokuhlobana nabantu. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi namaphrogramu. Ukuthola uhlolojohluzo, ukuhlaziya nokuhumusha. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokwenza ulwazi luhambisana nezidingo zabasebenzisi. Ikhono lokuhamba.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa imidalashele yezinto ezenziwe uma ziqondiswa nalezinhlongo eziqajisiwe. Ukunika umbhalo ngesikhathi senqubo yokuhlela komnyango. Ukuhlela izikhathi zokuqinisekisa imidalashele namaphrogramu qo e nyakeni. Ukuqinisekisa ulwazi ngemidalashele yezinto ezenziwe. Ukuhlela amathuluzi okubika ngokuqinisekiswa kwemidalashele. Ukwenza izikhathi zokuphendula namaphrogramu ahlukene ukuze kuboniswe imidalashele yezinto ezenziwe ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo. Ukusiza ngokwakheka kwezikhungo zokuqondisa, ingqondiso nezistimu ukuze kube lula ukuhlola imidalashele yamaphrogramu omnyango. Ukuhlanganisa ukubika imidalashele yezinto ezenziwe. Ukuhlanganisa imibiko yamaphrogramu yomnyango ngephethe (qo e nyakeni, phakathi kwenyaka kanye ne minyaka yonke) ngokusekelwe emidalashele e qinisekisiwe. Ukuhlanganisa imibiko ezinhlosothile nangokwesibelekiselo. Ukuhlanganisa izicelo zokuqondisa ezihlobene nalwazi ngemidalashele. Ukuphatha izimpendulo zamagatsha eziyisiphendulo kuzicelo zokuqondisa, iziphumo nezibuzo. Ukuhlanganisa izimpendulo zabalawu ngeziphumo / izibuzo zokuqondisa. Ukuqeqesha amagatsha ngezisekelo zokuqondisa imidalashele. Ukwenza ukwakhiwa kwamandla / ukuqeqesha ekuphathweni kwemidalashele yolwazi. Ukwenza ukwakhiwa kwamandla ekubika. Ukuhlabelela ngokuphathwa komsako wezibonakaliso.

xh.title: Uphando loVavvo nokuQinisekisa oNgundoqo
xh.summary: Qondanisa ukulandelelana nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza koluntu le Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e Pretoria .
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikhethi sesiGqeba 12 kwaye beNeDiploma eLizwe yezoBuntu / uPhando loPhuhliso / uLawulo kaRhulumente / uLawulo kaRhulumente okanye nelifana nalo. Ubuncinane iiminyaka eyi-3 yamava kwikuqondanisa nokuqinisekisa, uphando okanye ucwangciso olubalulekileyo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi olunxulumene nesebe: Ulwazi kuqondisisa indlela yovavvo nokuqinisekisa kurhulumente jikelele. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yovavvo nokuqinisekisa kurhulumente, iinkqubo ezisezantsi eziqhelekileyo zokusebenza, izixhobo, iinkqaba wolwazi, ucwangciso, iindlela zophando namagunya alawulayo. Imlawulo yeNgena. Ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza. ULawulo lweProjektheyo neyenkqubo. Ukuphucula umgangatho. Amakhono anxulumene nesebe: Ukufunda ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokubonisa. Ikhono lokubhala iinkqubo. Unxibelelwano (ngemilomo nangokubhalwa). Unxibelelwano nomntu. ULawulo lweProjektheyo neyenkqubo. Ukuqokelela, ukuhlalutya nokutolikwa kolwazi. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya. Ikhono lokulungelelanisa nokuhlela ulwazi ngokweemfuno zabasebenzisi. Ikhono lokuhamba.
xh.duties: Qondanisa ukusebenza koluntu kwantlukwano namajelo abekiweyo. Nikeza isalathiso ngexesha lenqanaba lokucwangcisa lesebe. Cwangcisa iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ukusebenza namajelo kwikota ngalinye. Yenza ukuqinisekisa kolwazi ngolwazi lokusebenza. Lungiselela izixhobo zokubika zokuqinisekisa ukusebenza. Yenza iinkqubo zempendulo namajelo ahlukahlukenyo ukujonga ngokusebenza ngenjongo yokwenza izigqibo. Nceda ngenkqubo yophuhliso lweendlela, isalathiso nendlela ezakunceda ukulinda ukusebenza kwejelo lesebe. Qondanisa ukubika ukusebenza koluntu. Hlanganisa iinkqubo zokubika ukusebenza kweejelo lesebe (ikota, ngokuhambako kweminyaka yaphakathi negqwethe) ngokusekelwe ukusebenza eqinisekisiweyo. Hlanganisa iinkqubo eziyimigca ebalulekileyo nangobunyza. Qondanisa iimfuno zovavvo ezinxulumene nolwazi lokusebenza. Lawula iimpendulo zamasebe kwiimfuno zovavvo, iimpawu ezifunyenweyo namaxwebhu. Hlanganisa iimpendulo kolawulo kwiimpawu ezifunyenweyo ngovavvo / amaxwebhu. Yenza amandla amasebe ngokwesiimo zokuqinisekisa ukusebenza. Yenza ukwakhiswa kwamandla / uqeqesho ngolawulo lolwazi lokusebenza. Yenza ukwakhiswa kwamandla ngokubika. Yenza iinkcazelo ngolawulo lwebheji yolwazi lwesiqinisekiso.

jobs.title: Survey Technician (GRADE A-C)
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R407 337 – R610 131 per annum, (Salary will be in accordance with the OSD requirements)
jobs.summary: Survey Technician needed in Pietermaritzburg to provide technical survey services, maintain survey documents and perform survey computations for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Survey or Cartography (NQF Level 6). Compulsory registration with South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as a Survey Technician / Surveyor. Minimum of 3 years post qualification technical survey experience. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Programme and project management. Survey design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer-aided survey applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Creating high-performance culture. Job related skills: Decision-making. Team leadership. Analytical thinking. Creativity and innovation. Self-management. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Problem solving and analysis. People management.
jobs.duties: Provide technical survey services and support. Provide technical services in terms of examination, maintenance, archiving and information supply of survey documents and submit for evaluation / approval by the relevant authority. Perform surveys and survey computations. Promote safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Evaluate plans, existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Provide Geographic Information System (GIS), mapping and information supply services. Perform administrative and related functions. Provide inputs into the budgeting process as required. Compile and submit reports as required. Provide and consolidate inputs to the technical survey operational plan. Develop, implement and maintain databases. Supervise and control Candidate Survey Technicians / Officers and related personnel and assets. Conduct research and development. Render continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research / literature studies on technical survey technology or new survey techniques to improve expertise. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on survey related matters.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 1st Floor, 270 Jabu Ndlovu Street (formerly known as Loop Street), Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or by email to Post240@dlrrd.gov.za
