af.title: Opnemings tegnikus (GRAAD A-C)
af.summary: Opnemings tegnikus word in Pietermaritzburg benodig om tegniese opnemingsdienste te verskaf, opnemingsdokumente te onderhou en opnemingsberekeninge vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development uit te voer.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Opneming of Kartografie (NQF Vlak 6) hê. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) as 'n Opnemings tegnikus / Opnemer. Minimum van 3 jaar na-kwalifikasie tegniese opnemingservaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van opnemingsontwerp en -ontleding. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde opnemingstoepassings. Kennis van regsonderhouning. Skryf van tegniese verslae. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Werksverwante vaardighede: Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Analitiese denke. Kreatiwiteit en innovasie. Selfbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mensebestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf tegniese opnemingsdienste en -ondersteuning. Verskaf tegniese dienste ten opsigte van ondersoek, onderhoud, argivering en inligtingverskaffing van opnemingsdokumente en dien in vir evaluering / goedkeuring deur die relevante gesag. Voer opnemings en opnemingsberekeninge uit. Beveilig veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes. Evalueer planne, bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie in te lyf. Verskaf Geografiese Inligtingstelsel (GIS)-, karterings- en inligtingverskaffingsdienste. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses soos vereis. Stel verslae op en dien in soos vereis. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese opnemingsoperasionele plan. Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou databasisse. Superviseer en beheer Kandidaat Opnemings tegnici / Beamptes en verwante personeel en bates. Doen navorsing en ontwikkeling. Lewer deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing / literatuurstudies oor tegniese opnemingstegnologie of nuwe opnemings tegnieke om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor opnemingsverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Survey Technician (GRADE A-C)
zu.summary: Kudingwa i-Survey Technician e-Pietermaritzburg ukuze kuhlinzwe ngezinsiza zobuchwepheshe zesigidi, kugcinwe imibhalo yesigidi kanye nokuqedwa amaphuzu wesigidi e-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingezansi: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesatifikhethi se-GRADE 12 kanye ne-Diploma yesizwe kwi-Survey noma i-Cartography (NQF Level 6). Ukubhaliswa ngokuphoqeleleko ne-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengoba-Survey Technician / Surveyor. Ubulwelwazi bezingu-3eminyaka kokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe besigidi emva kokuthweswa iziqu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ilawulo lenhlekelele neprojekthi. Ulwazi lokuqamba isigidi nokuhlukahluka. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zesigidi ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhalwa kwebiko lobuchwepheshe. Ukudalwa kwenhlalo yomphumela omuhle. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwenza isinqumo. Ukuphatha iqembu. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukudala futhi kuble imibono. Ukuzilawula. Ilawulo lemalI. Ukuqondiswa ikhasimende futhi kuphendule. Ukuxhumana (ngokuthi futhi okubhaliwe). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuphatha futhi ulungise. Ukuphatha ingxabano. Ukuxazulula izinkinga futhi uhlaziye. Ilawulo labantu.
zu.duties: Hlabisa ngezinsiza zobuchwepheshe zesigidi. Hlabisa izinsiza zobuchwepheshe ngokubhekise ekuhlolweni, ekuhlalweni kuhle, ekugcineni imibhalo yesigidi kanye nokuhlinzeka nolwazi, bese kuthunyelwa ukuze kuqashelwe / kuvunyelwe ngumnyango ofanele. Qedela izigidi kanye neziphimo zesigidi. Khuthaza ukuphepha ngokuvumelana nezidingo ezisemthethweni nangomthetho. Hlola amaphulani, imibhalo yobuchwepheshe ekhona, izithombe ezingaguqukiyo nezinqumo ukuze kufakwe inkumbulo entsha. Hlinzeka ngezinsiza ze-Geographic Information System (GIS), ukwenza amaphuzu kanye nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi. Qedela imisebenzi yolawulo kanye nalawo ebandakanyayo. Nikeza izinto ezibhaliwe enkambisweni yebhajethi njengoba kudingekayo. Qamba futhi uthumele amabiko njengoba kudingekayo. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise izinto ezibhaliwe ohlelweni lokusebenza lobuchwepheshe besigidi. Bumba, phumeza futhi ulondoloze idathabhesi. Qaphasisa futhi ulawule abaFundi abaThweswe iziqu bobuchwepheshe besigidi / Abasebenzi kanye nabantu abahlobene nabo nempahla. Yenza ucwaningo nentuthuko. Hlabisa ngentuthuko evulekile yobuchwepheshe ukuze ulandele inkambiso entsha kanye nezinqumo ezisha. Yenza ucwaningo / imfundvo yezincwadi ngobuchwepheshe besigidigidi noma izindlela ezisha zesigidi ukuze kube khona ukuphucula ulwazi. Xhumana namagugu / amakhansela afanele ezindabeni ezingokwesigidigidi.

xh.title: Survey Technician (GRADE A-C)
xh.summary: Kufuneka iSurvey Technician ePietermaritzburg ukunikela ngeenkonzo zobulungisa-obugcisa, ukulondoloza amaxwebhu obulungisa, nokwenziwa kweebalo zobulungisa kwiDepartment of Land Reform and Rural Development.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinci: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi samabanga a-12 kunye neDiploma yesiLwimi esiziNqanaba ze-6 kwiNQF kwiSurvey okanye iCartography. Ukbhaliso ngokuyimfuno kwiSouth African Geomatics Council (SAGC) njengeSurvey Technician / Surveyor. Ubuncinane i-3 yeminyaka yamava obulungisa-obugcisa emva kweziqu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Ulwazi lokuqulunqa nokwahlulahlula kobulungisa. Uphando nophuhliso. Iinkqubo zokushicilela iziphakamiso ezingagqibekanga ngesixhobo. Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho. Ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa. Ukudalwa kwenkcubeko yomgangatho ophezulu wokusebenza. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izigqibo. Ulawulo loluntu lokusebenza ndawonye. Okuqwalaselayo. Ubuciko nentluko. Ukuzilawula. Ulawulo lweemali. Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqamba kwaye ulungise. Ulawulo lweengxabano. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuwahlulahlula. Ulawuloabantu.
xh.duties: Bonezela iinkonzo zobulungisa-obugcisa kunye nenkxaso. Bonezela iinkonzo zobugcisa ngokwokuqwalasela, ukugcina, ukulondoloza iifayile, kunye nokunikwa kolwazi lwamaxwebhu obulungisa, uze uzithobele ukuqwalaselwa / ukuvunywa ngumsingathi ohambelanayo. Qhuba iindwendwe zobulungisa nokubala ngenxaxheba yobulungisa. Khuthaza ukhuseleko ngokwemigaqo yomthetho nemimiselo. Qwalasela iiplani, iimanuali zobugcisa ezikhoyo, iimzobo ezisemgangathweni, kunye namanyathelo ukwazisa iiteknoloji ezintsha. Bonezela iinkonzo zeNkqubo yolwazi ngejografi (GIS), ukuzoba iimephu, nokunikwa kolwazi. Qhuba imisebenzi yophalo kwaye ngokwemisebenzi ehambelanayo. Zisa izigqibo kwinkqubo yebhajeti njengoko kufuneka. Hlela uze unike iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Nikeze uze udibanise izigqibo kwiplani yokusebenza yobulungisa-obugcisa. Yakha, yisebenze, ulondoloze iindatabezi. Qondise ulawule abaQeqeshwa babaBali beNdwendwe / abaPhathi kunye nabasebenzi abahambelanayo nempahla. Qhuba uphando nentluko. Bonezela uphuhliso lobugcisa olungapheliyo ukuze ugqamele iiteknoloji namanyathelo amatsha. Qhuba uphando / iifundo ngolwazi kwiteknoloji yobulungisa-obugcisa okanye iindlela ezintsha zobulungisa ukuphucula amandla okusebenza. Thintela namabhunga / iindonga ngeendaba ezihambelana nobulungisa.

jobs.title: Principal Security Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Principal Security Officer to operate and monitor security systems and control room equipment at Mbombela, requiring Grade 12, PSIRA registration and 3 years security experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and Certificate in Security Supervisory Management and Grade B Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA) Registered. Minimum of 3 years security experience (including experience as a Security Guard). A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of access control procedures, control room operations, measures for the control and movement of equipment and stores. Knowledge of prescribed security procedures, Private Security industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA), Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS), Minimum Physical Security Standards (MPSS) and Protection of Information Act, etc and the authority of security officers under these documents. Knowledge of the relevant emergency procedures, know departmental disaster management plan. Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety Act. Knowledge of the control room procedure (CCTV surveillance systems). Knowledge of the Criminal Procedure Act and Knowledge of Minimum Information Security Standards document. Job related skills: Computer literacy. Communication (verbal and written). Report writing. Telephone etiquette. Interpersonal relations and Investigation. Willingness to work shifts.
jobs.duties: Operate and monitor security system. Operate and monitor security equipment in the control room (CCTV cameras, Public Address, Fire Panel, Lift Intercom etc.), where applicable. Monitor working condition of security equipment’s in the control room. Issue officials with access cards. Activate and deactivate security access cards. Maintain accurate record of data recordings. Record on / off-duty shifts and incidents in the Occurrence Book (OB). Report all defaults on available safety and security systems and equipment. Render fingerprint screening services. Conduct patrols and inspection on security. Ensure that clients entering and exiting the DLRRD premises are security screened. Protect employees, information and property of the department. Inspect all security registers, aids and irregularities and make an entry in the Occurrence Book (OB) and report to supervisor. Ensure regular patrols per site are conducted effectively. Monitor the electronic surveillance equipment used in the premises. Participate on the implementation of Occupational Health and Safety Act. Escort visitors on the premises where applicable. Monitor the movement of equipment’s and assets of the Department. Monitor the movements of private and Government Garage (GG) vehicles in the parking area. Prevent unauthorised persons and dangerous objects entering the building / premises. Participate in evacuation exercise during emergency situations. Test functionality of all security equipment on regular basis. Keep the exit points clear off any possible blockages. Compile report on evacuation exercises and non-compliant officials. Conduct after hours inspections to all offices. Monitor guard services in terms of the Service Level Agreement.

Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoof Sekuriteitsbeampte
af.summary: Hoof Sekuriteitsbeampte om sekuriteitsisteme en beheerkamer-toerusting by Mbombela te bedryf en te monitor, waarvoor Graad 12, PSIRA-registrasie en 3 jaar se sekuriteitservaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Sertifikaat in Sekuriteits toesighoudende bestuur en Graad B Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA) Geregistreer. Minimum van 3 jaar sekuriteitservaring (insluitend ervaring as 'n Sekuriteitswag). 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van toegangsbeheerprosedures, beheerkamerbedrywighede, maatreëls vir die beheer en beweging van toerusting en stores. Kennis van voorgeskrewe sekuriteitsprosedures, Private Security industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA), Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS), Minimum Physical Security Standards (MPSS) en Protection of Information Act, ens en die gesag van sekuriteitsbeamptes kragtens hierdie dokumente. Kennis van die tersaaklike noodprosedures, ken die departementele rampbestuursplan. Kennis van die Occupational Health and Safety Act. Kennis van die beheerkamerprosedure (CCTV-bewakingstelsels). Kennis van die Criminal Procedure Act en kennis van die Minimum Information Security Standards-dokument. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Verslagskrywing. Telefoonetiket. Interpersoonlike verhoudings en ondersoek. Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk.
af.duties: Bedryf en monitor sekuriteitsisteem. Bedryf en monitor sekuriteitstoerusting in die beheerkamer (CCTV-kameras, Public Address, Fire Panel, Lift Intercom ens.), waar van toepassing. Monitor werkende toestand van sekuriteitstoerusting in die beheerkamer. Verskaf beamptes met toegangskaarte. Aktiveer en deaktiveer sekuriteitstoegangskaarte. Onderhou akkurate rekord van data-opnames. Rekord aan/af-diens skofte en voorvalle in die Occurrence Book (OB). Rapporteer alle foute op beskikbare veiligheids- en sekuriteitsisteme en toerusting. Lewen vingerafdruk-skermingsdienste. Voer patrollies en inspeksies op sekuriteit uit. Verseker dat kliënte wat die DLRRD-persele binnekom en verlaat sekuriteitsgesif word. Beskerm werknemers, inligting en eiendom van die departement. Inspekteer alle sekuriteitsregister, hulpmiddels en onreëlmatighede en maak 'n inskrywing in die Occurrence Book (OB) en rapporteer aan toesighouer. Verseker dat gereelde patrollies per terrein doeltreffend uitgevoer word. Monitor die elektroniese bewakingstoerusting wat in die persele gebruik word. Neem deel aan die implementering van die Occupational Health and Safety Act. Eskorteer besoekers op die persele waar van toepassing. Monitor die beweging van toerusting en bates van die Departement. Monitor die bewegings van privaat en Government Garage (GG) voertuie in die parkeerarea. Voorkom ongemagtigde persone en gevaarlike voorwerpe wat die gebou/persele binnekom. Neem deel aan ontruimingsopleiding gedurende noodsituasies. Toets funksionaliteit van alle sekuriteitstoerusting op gereelde basis. Hou die uitgange vry van enige moontlike blokkasies. Stel verslag op oor ontruimingsopleiding en nie-nakomende beamptes. Voer buite-ure inspeksies uit aan alle kantore. Monitor wagdienste in terme van die Service Level Agreement.

zu.title: Isikhundla Esikhulu Sokuvikela
zu.summary: Isikhundla Esikhulu Sokuvikela sokusebenza kanye nokuqapha izimiso zokuvikela nempahla yekamelo lokulawula e Mbombela, esidinga ibanga lesi-12, ukubhalisa kwi-PSIRA kanye neminyaka emi-3 yamava okuvikela.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafakeli kufanele ukuthi babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nesitifiketi kwi-Security Supervisory Management kanye nokuba babhalisile ku-Grade B Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA). Ubuncane beminyaka emi-3 yamava okuvikela (okuhlanganisa amava njengoba-Mmela Wokuvikela). Ilayisense evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokulawula ukungena, imisebenzi yekamelo lokulawula, izindlela zokulawula nokuqhagamshelwa kwempahla nemiqolomba. Ulwazi ngemigaqo ekukhethiwe yokuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka, Private Security industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA), Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS), Minimum Physical Security Standards (MPSS) kanye ne-Protection of Information Act, njll kanye namandla abavikeli ngaphansi kwalalemikhombandlela. Ulwazi ngemigaqo ehlobene nezimo eziphuthumayo, ukwazi iplani yokuphathwa kwezinsiza ezingalindelekile komnyango. Ulwazi nge-Occupational Health and Safety Act. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yekamelo lokulawula (izimiso zokuqapha i-CCTV). Ulwazi nge-Criminal Procedure Act kanye nolwazi ngohlu lwamafayela e-Minimum Information Security Standards. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhomyutha. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukubhala imibiko. Izindlela zokuziphatha ngocingo. Ubudlelwano bomuntu nomuntu kanye nokuphenya. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngamashifthi.
zu.duties: Ukusebenzisa kanye nokuqapha isimiso sokuvikela. Ukusebenzisa kanye nokuqapha impahla yokuvikela ekamelweni lokulawula (amakhamera e-CCTV, Public Address, Fire Panel, Lift Intercom njll), lapho kufanele khona. Ukuqapha isimo sokusebenza kwempahla yokuvikela ekamelweni lokulawula. Ukunikeza amakhasi okungena abasebenzi. Ukuvula kanye nokuvala amakhasi okungena okuvikela. Ukugcina irekhodi eliqinisekisiwe lokugcinwa kwemininingwane. Ukurekhoda amashifthi okuqala / okuphela kanye nezenzakalo kuOccurrence Book (OB). Ukubika wonke amaphutha kuzimiso zamokuphepha nokuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka nempahla. Ukunikeza inkonzo yokuhlolwa kwezidayimbo zeminwe. Ukuqhuba ukuhamba nokuhlola ukuvikeleka. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abathintwayo bengena kanye nokuphuma kwindawo ye-DLRRD bahlolelwe ukuvikeleka. Ukuvikela abasebenzi, ulwazi nempahla bomnyango. Ukuhlola wonke amarejista okuvikela, izinto ongakusiza kanye nokungalunga futhi kungeniswe okutholakele kuOccurrence Book (OB) kanti kubikwe kumlawuli. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhamba njalo kwesayithi kwenziwe ngempumelelo. Ukuqapha impahla yokuqapha kagesi esetshenziswa endaweni. Ukuhlanganyela ekusebenzeni kwe-Occupational Health and Safety Act. Ukuphathisa abavakashi endaweni lapho kufanele khona. Ukuqapha ukunyakaza kwempahla namafa omnyango. Ukuqapha ukunyakaza kwemoto yabucala kanye naleyo kahulumeni (GG) endaweni yokupaka. Ukuthintela abantu abangavunyelwe kanye nezinto ezingozi ukuthi bengena esakhiweni / endaweni. Ukuhlanganyela ekuzivocavoceni ukushiywa ngesikhathi ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlola ukusebenza kwempahla yonke yokuvikela njalo. Ukugcina amaphoyinti okuphuma akhululekile kunoma yisiphi isivalo esingenzeka. Ukuhlela umbiko ngokuqhuba okuyisivocovo sokushiya nasebusebenzini abangahambisana namagaqo. Ukuqhuba ukuhlola emva kwamahola kuzo zonke izihhovisi. Ukuqapha inkonzo yabavikela ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano sezenzakalo (Service Level Agreement).

xh.title: IBango eliphambili loKhuseleko
xh.summary: IPrincipal Security Officer ukusebenza nokulawula iinkqubo zokhuseleko nzeixhobo zegumbi lokulawula eMbombela, kufuneka iGrade 12, ibhaliswe kwiPSIRA kwaye ibene minyaka eliyi-3 yamava okhuseleko.
xh.requirements: Izifiso ezingundoqo: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seQela le-12 neSatifikethi kuLawulo loLilo lokuQondisa iNgcinga yolwelo loKhuseleko weQela B be-Authority Regulatory (PSIRA) yaye kubhaliswe. Ukuqonda ubudala be-3 yeminyaka yamava okhuseleko (kuquka namava njengoMkhuseli weKhuseleko). Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemigqango yolawulo lokungena, iinkqubo zegumbi lolawulo, izithintelo zolawulo nokushukuma kwezixhobo nemicimbo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokhuseleko efunekayo, Private Security industry Regulatory Authority (PSIRA), Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS), Minimum Physical Security Standards (MPSS) noMthetho woKhuselo loLwazi, njl.njl. nangamagunya abaphathi bokhuseleko ngaphantsi kwala maxwebhu. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo ezifunekayo zomngcipheko wexesha elide, ukuqonda icebo lokulawula iingozi lesebe. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woNyango noMkhondo wabaSebenzi. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yegumbi lolawulo (iinkqubo zokuqwalasela i-CCTV). Ulwazi ngoMthetho weNkqubo yoLwazi noLwazi lwezomthetho weNqanaba eliNcolu lolwazi lwamaxwebhu. Amava olwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha. Unxibelelwano (olwenziwa ngomlomo nolubhalwayo). Ukubhala iingxelo. Izipho zocingo. Unxibelelwano nabantu noPhando. Ilungiselelo lokusebenza iishifthi.
xh.duties: Sebenza kwakhona ulwavelwano lwezokhuseleko. Sebenza kwakhona ulwavelwano lwesixhobo sokhuseleko egumbi lokulawula (iikamara ze-CCTV, iNkonzo yoNgentlalutye lwaPhakathi, iPhaneli yoMlilo, i-Intercom yeLifti njl.njl.), apho kufanelekileyo. Qwalasela imeko yokusebenza kwezixhobo zokhuseleko egumbi lokulawula. Yabua abaRhwebi ngamakhadi okungena. Vula kwakhona uvala amakhadi okungena okhuseleko. Gcina irekhodi elochweni lemida yedata. Bhala iishifthi zokuqala nokuvala kwakhona neenkaneko kwisiNencwadi seenzakalo (OB). Nika ingxelo ngazo zonke iintsolo ezikhoyo kwezokhuseleko nokhuseleko lwezixhobo. Phatha iinkonzo zokuqwalasela izigxivizo sezandla. Qhuba iindwendwe kwakhona ukuqwalasela ukhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukuba abathengi bengena baphuma kwinkqubo yendlu ye-DLRRD baqwalaselwa ngokhuseleko. Khusela abasebenzi, iinkcukacha, izinto zesebe. Qwalasela zonke izikelo zokhuseleko, izixhobo ezifunekayo, iingxaki zeendlela ezahlukeneyo kwaye wenze ingxelo kwisiNencwadi seenzakalo (OB) wenze ingxelo kumlawuli. Qinisekisa ukuba iindwendwe ezithe ngqo kwindawo nganyeziqhingi zenziwa ngokuchanekileyo. Qwalasela izixhobo zokulawula kwindawo ethileyo ezisebenza ngabakho. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yoMthetho wezaKhuseleko loNyango noMkhondo wabaSebenzi. Hambisa abendi kwiziko apho kufanelekileyo. Qwalasela ukusuka kwindawo ethile iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo zokulawula izixhobo zesebe. Qwalasela ukusuka kwindawo ethile iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ze-Garage (GG) yangasese nkarhi eyahlukileyo. Thintela abantu abangagunyaziswanga izinto ezilahlekileyo zingena esakhiweni / kwinkqubo. Thatha inxaxheba kwivhugumani esixhobo samava ngexesha leendwendwe ezahlukeneyo. Vavanya ukusebenza kwazo zonke izixhobo zokhuseleko kwizithili ezahlukeneyo. Gcina iindwendwe ezilawulwayo zingenamthalaluphelelo. Xela ingxelo kwivhugumani kwindawo ethileyo ngokuchanekileyo nokubhala ingxelo ngaloo ndwendwe ethileyo abangagunyaziswanga. Yenza iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zokuqwalasela iofisi ngemini emva kweyure. Qwalasela inkonzo yabakhuseli ngokweSivumelwano seNqanaba leNkonzo.

jobs.title: Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Capture and maintain cadastral survey data for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in East London, requiring a Grade 12 certificate and a National Certificate in Geomatics.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Completion of the training prescribed in order to fulfil the required qualification. Job related knowledge: Computer literacy. Understanding spatial data. Knowledge of the functions of Surveyors’-General Offices. Job related skills: Good interpersonal relations. Good communication (verbal and written). Computer software. Good organising ability.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of all cadastral documents: Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted Cadastral documents and undertake mathematical consistency checks and data verification for proposed new land parcels. Update Cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document to maintain an electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify Historical Cadastral documents. Maintenance of Cadastral Documents in accordance with legislated processes: Perform Withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Amend approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements: Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Perform technical examination of diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of sectional title plans. Supply cadastral information to internal and external clients: Issue Survey data to Land Surveyors when required. Disseminate cadastral information to the public as required, in hard copy or digital formats. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from NGI according to signed service level agreements. Capture, maintain and update spatial data: Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add all newly created land parcels to the spatial datasets. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement, or withdrawal: Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 1A Waverley Office Park, 31 – 33 Phillip Frame Road, Chisehurst, East London or by email to Post238@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Kadastrale Beampte
af.summary: Vaslegging en instandhouding van kadastrale opnamedata vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in East London, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatics vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatics of 'n Survey Officer-sertifikaat (NQF Level 5). Voltooiing van die voorgeskrewe opleiding om aan die vereiste kwalifikasie te voldoen. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaargeletterdheid. Begrip van ruimtelike data. Kennis van die funksies van Surveyors'-General Offices. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goede interpersoonlike verhoudings. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarprogrammatuur. Goeie organiseervermoë.
af.duties: Vaslegging, instandhouding en bywerking van alfanumeriese data van alle kadastrale dokumente: Vang alfa- en numeriese inligting uit nuut ingediende kadastrale dokumente en onderneem wiskundige konsekwentheidskontroles en dataverifikasie vir voorgestelde nuwe grondpersele. Werk kadastrale opnamedatabasisse by deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument om 'n elektroniese alfa-numeriese bewaarplek in stand te hou. Vang en verifieer historiese kadastrale dokumente. Instandhouding van kadastrale dokumente in ooreenstemming met wetgewende prosesse: Voer onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente uit. Trek af, kanselleer en ondekteken kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde grondpersele, huurkontrakte of servitute. Wysig goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Voeg alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief in. Haal kadastrale rekords uit en reik dit uit. Herlê teruggestuurde kadastrale rekords. Herstel en hou kadastrale rekords in 'n goeie bruikbare toestand. Voer tegniese ondersoek van kadastrale dokumente uit. Kontroleer aanduidings van nuut ingediende voorleggings: Werk die aantekeningvelle by deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale grondperceel. Voer tegniese ondersoek van diagramme en algemene planne uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van opnamerekords uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van afdelingstitelplanne uit. Verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte: Reik opnamedata aan landopnemers uit wanneer vereis. Versprei kadastrale inligting aan die publiek soos vereis, in gedrukte of digitale formaat. Verskaf lugfoto's, geregistreerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte van NGI ooreenkomstig ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Vang, hou in stand en werk ruimtelike data by: Vang nuut ingediende dokumente om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Voeg alle nuut geskepte grondpersele by die ruimtelike datastelle. Voeg data by, werk dit by en hou 'n akkurate datastel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting in stand, insluitend die byvoeging en bywerking van historiese data. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, ondektekening of onttrekking: Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Herskandeer alle bygewerkte kadastrale dokumente. Koppel die gedeponeerde geskandeerde beelde aan die alfanumeriese data.

zu.title: Inkantolo Yezindawo
zu.summary: Qamba futhi ugcine idatha yesivivinyo sezindawo somnyango we Land Reform and Rural Development e East London, okudinga isitifiketi se Grade 12 nesitifiketi se National Certificate in Geomatics.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingavunyelwe ukuba ngaphansi kwazo: Abafakeli kumele babe nesitifiketi se Grade 12 nesitifiketi se National Certificate in Geomatics noma i Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Ukuqedela ukulekelelwa okumisiwe ukuze kugcwaliswe izifundo ezidingekayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukubeka ukuthi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda idatha yesikhala. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yamahhovisi as Surveyors'-General. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ubuhle bokuba nobudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ukuxhumana ngokuhle (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Isoftware yekhompyutha. Ikono elihle lokuhlela.
zu.duties: Qamba, gcina futhi uvuse idatha yamagama nemininingwane yazo zonke izinhlamvu zamadokhumenti zezindawo: Qamba ulwazi lwamagama namininingwane ezinhlamvuni kudokhumenti ezintsha zezindawo ezenziwe futhi wenze ukuhlolwa kokuhambisana kwemathemathiki kuqinisekiswe idatha yezinkaba ezintsha zomhlaba. Vuse izidabazimi zesivivinyo sezindawo ngokufaka noma ukulungisa yonke idokhumenti evunyiwe ukuze kugcinwe indawo yamagama nemininingwane yamakhompyutha. Qamba futhi uqinisekise izinhlamvu zamadokhumenti zezindawo. Ukugcinwa kwamadokhumenti wezindawo ngokusho kwenqubomgomo esemthethweni: Yenza ukukhipha noma ukukhansela amadokhumenti wezindawo. Susa, khansela futhi ugqize amadokhumenti wezindawo ezinombolo zomhlaba ezenzelwe imininingwane, iziqophiso noma izinkonzo. Lungisa amadokhumenti wezindawo avunyiwe futhi ebhalisiwe. Faka yonke idokhumenti entsha evunyiwe yezindawo kweshiofili. Khhipha futhi unike amadokhumenti wezindawo. Phinda uwafake kushiofili amadokhumenti wezindawo abuyiwe. Lungisa futhi ugcine amadokhumenti wezindawo endaweni enhle yokusetshenziswa. Yenza ukuhlola ngobuchwepheshe amadokhumenti wezindawo. Hlola izinhlobo zamadokhumenti amasha abhaliswe: Vuse amakhasi okubekisa ngokufaka zonke izinkaba ezintsha zomhlaba zezindawo ezivunyiwe. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngobuchwepheshe kumadayagramu nezinhlelo ezijwayelekile. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngobuchwepheshe kurekhodi zesivivinyo. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngobuchwepheshe kwezinhlelo zamaphuphu amaphane. Nikela ngolwazi lwezindawo kubaklayenti bangaphakathi nangaphandle: Nikeza idatha yesivivinyo kubasilinganisi bomhlabo uma kudingwa. Saza ulwazi lwezindawo kuzakhamuzi njengoba kudingwa, ngokubhaliwe noma ngobunjingi. Nikeza izithombe zomhlaba ezindaweni, izithombe ezilungiswe ngokobunjingi namashi efu e NGI ngokusho kwezivumelwano ezibhaliswe ngesimo esisesikhathini. Qamba, gcina futhi uvuse idatha yesikhala: Qamba idokhumenti ezintsha abhaliswe ukuze kutholakale ukuthi zikhona yini izigaxa zezindawo phambi kokwamukelwa. Faka zonke izinkaba ezintsha zomhlaba ohlelweni lwedatha yesikhala. Faka idatha, vuse futhi ugcinwe isiqu sedatha esiqinisekile selwazi lwezindawo, okuhlanganisa ukufakwa nokuvuseka kwedatha yomlando. Skene wonke amadokhumenti wezindawo uma ewamukelwe, ulungiswa, egqiziwe noma ekhishwe: Skene amadokhumenti amasha ezindawo avunyiwe. Phinda uskene wonke amadokhumenti wezindawo avusekiwe. Xhuma izithombe ezibhaliswe ezikeni namagama nemininingwane yezinhlamvu.

xh.title: Umphathi weKadastral
xh.summary: Ukuyibala nokugcina idatha yesicelo sekadastral kwi Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e East London, kufuneka kube nesiqinisekiso se Grade 12 kunye ne National Certificate kwi Geomatics.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesiqinisekiso se Grade 12 kunye ne National Certificate kwi Geomatics okanye isiQinisekiso somPhathi woPhando (NQF Level 5). Ukugqitywa kwesifundo esibaluliweyo ukuze kuzaliseke ngesidanga esifunekayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda idatha yendawo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yee Surveyors'-General Offices. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Unxibelelwano oluhle (lwesinye nolwabhalwe phantsi). Isofthiwe yekhompyutha. Isakhono esihle sokuhlela.
xh.duties: Ukuyibala, ukuyigcina nokuhlaziya idatha yamanani namagama emibhalo yonke yekadastral: Ukubala ulwazi lwamagama namanani kwemibhalo elitsha yekadastral elihtyiweyo nokwenza iindlela zokuqinisekisa ngokubala nokuvavanya idatha kwentsimi entsha ecelelweyo. Ukuhlaziya iisiseko zedatha zophando lwekadastral ngokongeza okanye ulungisa elunye naliphi na ixesha elamkelekileyo ukugcina indawo yamagama namanani ngqo. Ukubala ukuqinisekisa imibhalo yekadastral yemandulo. Ukugcinwa kwemibhalo yekadastral ngokwemigaqo esemthethweni: Ukwenza ukutsalwa okanye ukurhoxiswa kwemibhalo yekadastral. Ukutshintsha, ukurhoxisa nokuvakalisa imibhalo yekadastral nentsimi ebhalisiweyo, iilezi okanye iinkonzo ezithintelweyo. Ukulungisa imibhalo yekadastral eyamkelekileyo nebhalisiweyo. Ukufaka bonke umBhalo oTsha owamkelekileyo wekadastral kwindawo yokugcina. Ukukhupha nokuphiwa kwerekhodi yekadastral. Ukubuyisela kwindawo yayo irekhedi yekadastral ebuyisiweyo. Ukulungisa ukugcina irekhedi yekadastral esimweni esihle sokusetyenziswa. Ukuza kuvavanyo lobuchwepheshe bemibhalo yekadastral. Ukuvavanya iindawo ezibhalisiweyo kulwazi olutsha olufakelwayo: Ukuhlaziya amakhasi okubeka iindaba ngokongeza nthu na na iparceli yentsimi yekadastral eyamkelekileyo. Ukwenza uvavanyo lobuchwepheshe bedayigram namacebo ajikelezayo. Ukwenza uvavanyo lobuchwepheshe berekhodi zophando. Ukwenza uvavanyo lobuchwepheshe bemibhalo yamagama esigaba. Ukuhlaziya ulwazi lwekadastral kumxhasi ongaphakathi nangaphandle: Ukunika idatha yophando kuLand Surveyors xa kufuneka. Ukwabelana nolwazi lwekadastral_nomphakathi njengoko kufuneka, ngokubhaliweyo okanye ngokwesayithi. Ukunika iifoto ezithabathiweyo ngaphezulu, imifanekiso elungisiweyo namakhasi avela kwi NGI ngokwezivumelwano ezifakiweyo. Ukubala, ukugcina nokuhlaziya idatha yendawo: Ukubala imibhalo elitsha ehtyiweyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba ngaba kukho naziphi na iindawo ezidibana ngaphambi kokwamkelwa. Ukongeza zonke iiparceli zentsimi ezidaliweyo kudatha yendawo. Ukongeza idatha, ukuhlaziya ukugcina idatha ethembekileyo yolwazi lwekadastral lendawo, kuquka ukongeza nokuhlaziya idatha yamandulo. Ukuskana zonke imibhalo yekadastral xa iwamkelekile, ilungisiwe, ivakalisiwe, okanye itsaliwe: Ukuskana imibhalo yekadastral elitsha eyamkelekileyo. Ukuskana ngokutsha yonke imibhalo yekadastral ehlaziyiweyo. Ukudibanisa imifanekiso eskiniweyo efake idatha yamagama namanani.

Job Purpose: To lead the institution-wide curriculum support and ETD practitioner Professionalisation functions, positioning the National School of Government as a credible, innovative, and quality-driven education and training provider, constitutional values, public sector capability requirements, and the higher education and skills development mandate of the institution
jobs.title: Chief Director: Curriculum Support and Trainer
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), an inclusive remuneration package
jobs.summary: Chief Director sought to develop and implement curriculum policies and ETD frameworks at the National School of Government in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent (NQF level 7). A post-graduate qualification will be an added advantage. Registration with a relevant professional body will also be an advantage. The successful applicant will be subjected to security vetting at an appropriate clearance level for senior managers. Experience: Extensive proven and relevant experience of which five (5) years must be at a senior managerial level, leading curriculum design and development in education, training, or public sector capacity building. Proven experience in: Curriculum development of courses, occupational qualifications, skills programmes, and higher education programmes. Proven experience in developing curriculum qualifications registered on the National Qualifications Framework. Leading large-scale education or professionalisation programmes. Managing multidisciplinary teams and budgets. Stakeholder engagement at the executive level (government, academia, international bodies). Demonstrated experience in driving innovation in learning and digital education. Experience in applied research, publication in curriculum, and development of curriculum frameworks. Knowledge: Higher education and skills development frameworks. Curriculum design, instructional design models, and outcomes-based education principles. Knowledge and understanding of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa and public sector legislation (including the Public Service Act, Public Administration Management Act, Municipal Systems Act, Municipal Structures Act, Skills Development Act, Public Finance Management Act, Municipal Finance Management Act, National Qualifications Framework Act and related Policies, Higher Education and Training Act. ETD practitioner professionalisation frameworks, standards, and competency models. Public sector governance, administration, and policy environment. Digital learning ecosystems, e-learning platforms, and emerging EdTech trends. Research methodologies, knowledge management, and policy development in public education sectors. Financial management, budgeting, and MTEF processes within government. Change management, organisational development, and institutional transformation. Skills Curriculum architecture design for multi-course blended programmes. Advanced design and management of complex simulations and action learning. Strategic selection and procurement of new learning technologies. Learning analytics by linking data from other systems (e.g., LMS). Change management to drive adoption of new learning technologies and methods. Mentoring and leadership of curriculum and instructional design teams. High level of integrity and ethical conduct. Intellectual leadership and credibility in the education and public sector space. Results driven with a strong sense of accountability. Innovative and forward-thinking mindset. Strong interpersonal and influencing ability. Resilience and ability to operate under pressure. Commitment to public service values and transformation. Attention to detail balanced with strategic perspective. Proven advanced writing, proofreading, and editing skills. Good conflict management skills. Public presentation & engagements. Advanced computer skills in MS Office Suite and Adobe. Competencies: Must be able to initiate and support organisational transformation and change to successfully implement new initiatives and deliver service delivery commitments. Must be able to promote the generation and sharing of knowledge and learning to enhance the collective knowledge of the organisation. Must be able to explore and implement new ways of delivering services that contribute to improving organisational processes to achieve organisational goals. Must be able to systematically identify, analyse, and resolve existing and anticipated problems to reach optimum solutions in a timely manner. Must be able to manage and encourage people, optimise their outputs, and effectively manage relationships in order to achieve organisational goals. Must be willing and able to deliver services effectively and efficiently to put the spirit of customer service (Batho Pele) into practice. Must be able to exchange information and ideas in a clear and concise manner appropriate for the audience to explain, persuade, convince, and influence others to achieve the desired outcomes. Must be able to display and build the highest standards of ethical and moral conduct to promote confidence and trust in the Public Service. Personal Attributes: Participate in professional development growth activities for maintaining professional knowledge and staying current with curricular trends. Ability to multi-task and organise, prioritise and follow multiple projects and tasks through to completion with attention to detail. Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment. Ability to analyse problems, identify solutions, take appropriate action, and resolve conflicts using independent judgment and decision-making. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with management, employees, stakeholders, and the public. Integrity and honesty, detail-oriented, creative and innovative, ability to work under pressure. Domestic and international travel and extended work hours when required. Preference will be given to African Males, Youth, African and Coloured Males and people with disability in accordance with our employment equity requirements.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for the following Key Results Areas: Develop, review, and implement curriculum policies, norms, standards, and institutional curriculum frameworks aligned with national priorities and organisational strategy. Lead the design and implementation of a comprehensive ETD practitioner professionalisation framework, including competency standards, learning pathways, and continuous professionals’ development programmes. Oversee the incorporation of Africanised and decolonised perspectives through a formal curriculum transformation plan incorporating inclusivity, citizen-centered service delivery, and social justice principles to enhance cultural relevance and responsiveness to the public sector needs. Oversee the planning and development and management of qualification and programme pipelines aligned to NQF level descriptors and institutional priorities. Integrate digital learning strategies and innovation frameworks into curriculum planning and delivery. Lead and manage the design, development, review, and continuous improvement of accredited and non-accredited programmes. Develop and implement standardised curriculum development methodologies, tools, and templates. Support other units to maintain quality assurance systems, including moderation, peer review, and continuous improvement processes. Lead the development of modular, stackable, and credit-bearing programmes including micro-credentials and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL). Facilitate the integration of digital learning technologies and innovative instructional methodologies into programme delivery. Ensure alignment between curriculum architecture, accreditation requirements, learner pathways, and institutional strategy. Implement rigorous quality assurance mechanisms including accreditation, moderation, peer review, continuous improvement, and impact evaluation to ensure curriculum relevance, effectiveness, and compliance with accreditation standards across accredited and non-accredited programmes. Integrate cutting edge educational technologies and diverse instructional methodologies within a coherent digital leaning ecosystem, informed by learning analytics and emerging EdTech trends to enhance accessibility and learner impact. Contribute towards programme effectiveness, including learner performance, impact, and continuous improvement interventions. Conduct benchmarking exercises to align programmes with national and international best practices. Identify, establish, and manage strategic partnerships with government institutions, higher education institutions, SETAs, and international organisations. Design and implement capacity-building and continuous professional development initiatives for ETD practitioners. Provide advice and support to public sector institutions on curriculum development and professionalisation. Plan and facilitate knowledge-sharing platforms, including workshops, seminars, and communities of practice. Identify and secure funding opportunities, partnerships, and sponsorships to support curriculum and professionalisation initiatives. Design and tailor programme offerings to meet the needs of diverse learner groups. Facilitate collaboration and coordination with internal units and external stakeholders to strengthen curriculum and professionalisation initiatives. Provide secretariat and technical support to academic, curriculum and Professionalisation governance structure including the preparation of reports, submissions and compliance documentation. Establish, chair, and manage interdepartmental and intergovernmental forums, higher education institutions, Setas, professional bodies and international organisation to support curriculum development, Professionalisation, accreditation and research initiatives. Initiate and manage collaborative programmes with local and international institutions. Represent the institution at national and international platforms, forums and conferences, providing intellectual and Professionalisation leadership in public-sector education and training. Develop and maintain partnerships to support curriculum and professional development.
