af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Kurrikulumondersteuning en Opleier
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur word gesoek om kurrikulumbeleid en ETD-raamwerke by die Nasionale Skool van Regering in Pretoria te ontwikkel en te implementeer.
af.requirements: Minimum 'n bachelorsgraad of ekwivalent (NQF-vlak 7). 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Registrasie by 'n relevante professionele liggaam sal ook 'n voordeel wees. Die suksesvolle aansoeker sal aan sekuriteitsondersoek op 'n toepaslike vrywaringsvlak vir senior bestuurders onderwerp word. Ervaring: Uitgebreide bewese en relevante ervaring waarvan vyf (5) jaar op 'n senior bestuursvlak moet wees, met leierskap in kurrikulumontwerp en -ontwikkeling in onderwys, opleiding, of openbare sektor kapasiteitsbou. Bewese ervaring in: Kurrikulumontwikkeling van kursusse, beroepskwalifikasies, vaardigheidsprogramme, en hoër onderwysprogramme. Bewese ervasing in die ontwikkeling van kurrikulumkwalifikasies geregistreer op die Nasionale Kwalifikasieraamwerk. Leiding van grootskaalse onderwys- of professionaliseringsprogramme. Bestuur van multidissiplinêre spanne en begrotings. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid op uitvoerende vlak (regering, akademie, internasionale liggame). Getoonde ervaring in die aandryf van innovasie in leer en digitale onderwys. Ervaring in toegepaste navorsing, publikasie in kurrikulum, en ontwikkeling van kurrikulumraamwerke. Kennis: Hoër onderwys- en vaardigheidsontwikkelingsraamwerke. Kurrikulumontwerp, onderrigontwerpmodelle, en uitkomsgebaseerde onderwysbeginsels. Kennis en begrip van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika en openbare sektorwetgewing (insluitend die Public Service Act, Public Administration Management Act, Municipal Systems Act, Municipal Structures Act, Skills Development Act, Public Finance Management Act, Municipal Finance Management Act, National Qualifications Framework Act en verwante beleide, Higher Education and Training Act. ETD-beoefenaar professionaliseringsraamwerke, standaarde, en bevoegdheidsmodelle. Openbare sektor se bestuur, administrasie, en beleid omgewing. Digitale leer-ekosisteme, e-leerplatforms, en opkomende EdTech-neigings. Navorsingsmetodologieë, kennisbestuur, en beleidontwikkeling in openbare onderwyssektore. Finansiële bestuur, begroting, en MTEF-prosesse binne die regering. Veranderingsbestuur, organisatoriese ontwikkeling, en institusionele transformasie. Vaardighede: Kurrikulumargitektuurontwerp vir multikursusgemengde programme. Gevorderde ontwerp en bestuur van komplekse simulasies en aksieleer. Strategiese keuse en verkryging van nuwe leertegnologieë. Leeralaet deur data van ander stelsels (bv., LMS) te koppel. Veranderingsbestuur om die aanvaarding van nuwe leertegnologieë en -metodes te dryf. Mentorskap en leierskap van kurrikulum- en onderrigontwerpspanne. Hoë vlak van integriteit en etiese gedrag. Intellektuele leierskap en geloofwaardigheid in die onderwys- en openbare sektorruimte. Resultaatgedrewe met 'n sterk sin van verantwoordelikheid. Innovatiewe en vorentoedenkende ingesteldheid. Sterke interpersoonlike en beïnvloedingsvermoë. Veerkragtigheid en vermoë om onder druk te funksioneer. Toewyding aan openbare dienswaardes en transformasie. Aandag aan detail in balans met 'n strategiese perspektief. Bewese gevorderde skryf-, proeflees-, en redigeervaardighede. Goeie konflikbestuursvaardighede. Openbare voorleggings en betrokkenheid. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardighede in MS Office Suite en Adobe. Bevoegdhede: Moet in staat wees om organisatoriese transformasie en verandering te inisieer en te ondersteun om nuwe inisiatiewe suksesvol te implementeer en diensleweringverpligtinge na te kom. Moet in staat wees om die generering en deling van kennis en leer te bevorder om die kollektiewe kennis van die organisasie te verbeter. Moet in staat wees om nuwe maniere van dienslewering te ondersoek en te implementeer wat bydra tot die verbetering van organisatoriese prosesse om organisatoriese doelwitte te bereik. Moet in staat wees om sistematies bestaande en verwagte probleme te identifiseer, te analiseer, en op te los om tydig optimale oplossings te bereik. Moet in staat wees om mense te bestuur en aan te moedig, hulle lewerings te optimiseer, en verhoudinge doeltreffend te bestuur om organisatoriese doelwitte te bereik. Moet gewillig en in staat wees om dienste effektief en doeltreffend te lewer om die gees van kliëntediens (Batho Pele) in die praktyk te stel. Moet in staat wees om inligting en idees duidelik en bondig uit te ruik wat toepaslik is vir die gehoor om te verduidelik, te oortuig, te oorreed, en ander te beïnvloed om die gewenste uitkomste te bereik. Moet in staat wees om die hoogste standaarde van etiese en morele gedrag te toon en op te bou om vertroue en geloof in die Openbare Diens te bevorder. Persoonlike eienskappe: Deelneem aan professionele ontwikkelingsgroeiaktiwiteite om professionele kennis te handhaaf en tred te hou met kurrikulumneigings. Vermoë om veelvuldige take uit te voer en te organiseer, te prioritiseer en veelvuldige projekte en take tot voltooiing te volg met aandag aan detail. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk terwyl bygedra word tot 'n spanomgewing. Vermoë om probleme te analiseer, oplossings te identifiseer, toepaslike aksie te neem, en konflikte op te los deur onafhanklike oordeel en besluitneming te gebruik. Vermoë om effektiewe werksverhoudinge met bestuur, werknemers, belanghebbendes, en die publiek op te bou en te handhaaf. Integriteit en eerlikheid, besonderheid-georiënteerd, kreatief en innovatief, vermoë om onder druk te werk. Binnelandse en internasionale reis en verlengde werksure wanneer vereis. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan Afrika Mans, Jeug, Afrika en Bruin Mans en persone met gestremdhede in ooreenstemming met ons indiensnemingsregvereistes.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die volgende Sleutelresultaatgebiede: Ontwikkel, hersien, en implementeer kurrikulumbeleid, norme, standaarde, en institusionele kurrikulumraamwerke wat in lyn is met nasionale prioriteite en organisatoriese strategie. Lei die ontwerp en implementering van 'n omvattende ETD-beoefenaar professionaliseringsraamwerk, insluitend bevoegdheidsstandaarde, leerroetes, en deurlopende professionele ontwikkelingsprogramme. Hou toezig op die inkorporering van Afrikangerigte en gedekoloniseerde perspektiewe deur 'n formele kurrikulumtransformasieplan wat inklusiwiteit, burgergesentreerde dienslewering, en sosiale regverdigheidsbeginsels inkorporeer om kulturele relevansie en reaksie op die behoeftes van die openbare sektor te verbeter. Hou toezig op die beplanning en ontwikkeling en bestuur van kwalifikasie- en programpypleidings wat in lyn is met NQF-vlakbeskrywers en institusionele prioriteite. Integreer digitale leerstrategieë en innovasieraamwerke in kurrikulumbeplanning en -lewer. Lei en bestuur die ontwerp, ontwikkeling, hersiening, en deurlopende verbetering van geakkrediteerde en nie-geakkrediteerde programme. Ontwikkel en implementeer gestandaardiseerde kurrikulumontwikkelingsmetodologieë, gereedskap, en sjablone. Ondersteun ander eenhede om gehalteversekeringsstelsels te handhaaf, insluitend moderering, portuurbeoordeling, en deurlopende verbeteringsprosesse. Lei die ontwikkeling van modulêre, stapelbare, en kredietdraende programme insluitend mikro-kwalifikasies en Erkenning van Vorige Leer (EVL). Fasiliteer die integrasie van digitale leertegnologieë en innoverende onderrigmetodologieë in programlewering. Verseker belyning tussen kurrikulumargitektuur, akkreditasievereistes, leererroetes, en institusionele strategie. Implementeer streng gehalteversekeringsmeganismes insluitend akkreditasie, moderering, portuurbeoordeling, deurlopende verbetering, en impakevaluering om kurrikulumrelevansie, doeltreffendheid, en nakoming van akkreditasie standaarde oor geakkrediteerde en nie-geakkrediteerde programme te verseker. Integreer vooruitstrewende opvoedkundige tegnologieë en diverse onderrigmetodologieë binne 'n samehangende digitale leerekosisteem, inligtinggewing deur leeralaet en opkomende EdTech-neigings om toeganklikheid en leerderimpak te verbeter. Dra by na doeltreffendheid van programme, insluitend leerderprestasie, impak, en deurlopende verbeteringsintervensies. Voer vergelykingsoefeninge uit om programme met nasionale en internasionale beste praktyke in lyn te bring. Identifiseer, vestig, en bestuur strategiese vennootskappe met regeringsinstellings, hoër onderwysinstellings, SETAs, en internasionale organisasies. Ontwerp en implementeer kapasiteitsbou- en deurlopende professionele ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe vir ETD-beoefenaars. Verskaf advies en ondersteuning aan openbare sektorinstellings oor kurrikulumontwikkeling en professionalisering. Beplan en fasiliteer kennisdelingplatforms, insluitend werkswinkels, seminare, en gemeenskappe van praktyk. Identifiseer en sekureer befondsingsgeleenthede, vennootskappe, en borgskappe om kurrikulum- en professionaliseringsinisiatiewe te ondersteun. Ontwerp en pas programaanbiedinge aan om aan die behoeftes van diverse leerdergroepe te voldoen. Fasiliteer samewerking en koördinering met interne eenhede en eksterne belanghebbendes om kurrikulum- en professionaliseringsinisiatiewe te versterk. Verskaf sekretariaat- en tegniese ondersteuning aan akademiese, kurrikulum en Professionalisering bestuursstrukture insluitend die voorbereiding van verslae, voorleggings en nakomingsdokumentasie. Vestig, voorsit, en bestuur interdepartementele en interregeringsforums, hoër onderwysinstellings, SETAs, professionele liggame en internasionale organisasies om kurrikulumontwikkeling, Professionalisering, akkreditasie en navorsingsinisiatiewe te ondersteun. Inisieer en bestuur samewerkingsprogramme met plaaslike en internasionale instellings. Verteenwoordig die instelling op nasionale en internasionale platforms, forums en konferensies, en verskaf intellektuele en Professionalisering leierskap in openbare-sektor onderwys en opleiding. Ontwikkel en handhaaf vennootskappe om kurrikulum- en professionele ontwikkeling te ondersteun.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu: Ukusekelwa Kwezifundo Nokuhlolwa Kwabasebenzi
zu.summary: Kufunwa umphathi omkhulu ukuze athuthukise futhi asuse ezomphathweni izinqubomgomo zezifundo kanye nezisekelo ze-ETD e National School of Government e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Idegree yesibili noma okulinganayo okuncane (NQF level 7). Ikhwalifayeshini yokuya ngemva kweziqu izokuba yinzuzo. Ukubhaliswa emkhakheni ofanele wezobuchwepheshe kuzoba nenkinga enkulu nempumelelo. Umfaki isikhelo ozophumelela uzobe ehlotshaniswa nokuhlolwa kwezokuphepha esigabeni esifanele sobaphathi abaphezulu. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esikhulu esibonisiwe futhi esihlobene, lapho iminyaka emihlanu (5) kufanele ibe ngolesigaba sabaphathi abaphezulu, ehola ukwakhiwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezifundo emfundweni, uqeqesho, noma ukwakhiwa ikhaphasithi ebalulekile. Isipiliyoni esibonisiwe kulezi: Ukuthuthukiswa kwezifundo zamakilasi, ama-qualifications wobuchwepheshe, izinhlela zamakhono, kanye nezinhlela zemfundo ephakeme. Isipiliyoni esibonisiwe ekuthuthukiseni ama-qualifications ezifundo abhaliswe ku National Qualifications Framework. Ekuholeni izinhlela zemfundo noma zokuchwepheshe ezinkulu. Ekuphatheni amaqembu ahlukene kanye namabhajethi. Ukuxhumana ngaleso sigaba nobaphathi (hulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izithili zabamanye amazwe). Isipiliyoni esiboniswe ekushukumisweni izinto ezintsha ekuqeqeshweni nemfundo yedijithali. Isipiliyoni ekuphenyweni okuhlotshanisiwe, ekushicilelweni ezifundweni, nasekuthuthukiseni izisekelo zezifundo. Ulwazi: Izisekelo zemfundo ephakeme nokuqeqeshwa amakhono. Ukuklama izifundo, ukwakhiwa kwezifundo, kanye nemigomo yemfundo eqondiswe kumiphumela. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda umthethosisekelo we Republic of South Africa kanye nomthetho wesektharhi yomphakathi (okuhlanganisa Public Service Act, Public Administration Management Act, Municipal Systems Act, Municipal Structures Act, Skills Development Act, Public Finance Management Act, Municipal Finance Management Act, National Qualifications Framework Act kanye nezinqubomgomo ezihlotshanisiwe, Higher Education Act. Izisekelo, amaphuzu kanye nemikhuba yokuchwephesheka kwabakhi be-ETD. Ukuphathwa, ukulawula kanye nezemigomo zesection yomphakathi. Isimoz sphakathi sokufunda sidijithali, amaphulatifomu e-e-learning, kanye namaphuzu amasha we-EdTech. Indlela zokuphanda, ukuphathwa kwolwazi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemigomo emaphandleni emfundo yomphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali, amabhajethi, kanye nama-MTEF processes. Ukuphatha inguquko, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo, kanye nokuguqulwa kwezikhungo. Amakhono: Ukuklama isakhiwo sezifundo sezinhlela eziningi ezidayiselwa. Ukuklama okuphezulu nokuphatha izi-simulations eziyinkimbinkimbi kanye nokufunda ngokwenza. Ukukhethwa ngokobuchule kokuthola izobuchwepheshe ezintsha zokufunda. Ukuhlaziywa ukufunda ngokuqhagamshelwa kwemininingwane kwezinye izimiso (isb, LMS). Ukuphathwa kwezinguquko ukushukumisa ukumukelwa kwezobuchwepheshe ezintsha kanye nezindlela zokufunda. Ukuqeqesha nokukhokha amaqembu ekuhlakanipheni kwezifundo. Izinga eliphezulu lobuqotho kanye nokuziphatha okuhle. Ukukhokha ngekhono kanye nokwaziwa kumkhakha wemfundo nowomphakathi. Ukugxila kumiphumela ngokuzethulela ngamandla. Ukuba nomcabango oshukumisayo futhi obuka phambili. Amandla okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokubakholekisa. Ukuzinza nokuzeke ngaphansi komfutho. Ukuqonda ukuzinza kwamagugu omphakathi nangukuguqukela. Ukugqamisa phansi kokubuka isibuyelo. Ulwazi oluphezulu lokubhala, ukuhlola kanye nokuqamba amagama. Amakhono aphezulu okuphatha ukungqubuzana. Eziphatfweni ezinkomomphakathi kanye nokuvakatshela. Amakhono aphezulu ekhompyutha ku-MS Office Suite kanye e Adobe. Amandla: Kufanele ukwazi ukuqalisa kanye nokusekela ukuqakambiswa nenguquko yenhlelo ukuze kusebenze izinto ezintsha ngempumelelo kanye nokuphumeza izibopho zokuletha. Kufanele ukwazi ukuxhasa ukudalwa nokwabiwa kolwazi kanye nokufunda ukukhulisa ulwazi oluhlangene lwesikhungo. Kufanele ukwazi ukuphenya futhi usebenze izindlela ezintsha zokuqeqesha ezingeza ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlela ukuze kufikelelwe emigqeni. Kufanele ukwazi ukuthola ukuthi yini, ukuhlaziya, bese uxazula izinkinga ezikhona naloluqashelwe ukuze kufikelelwe ekixazulweni okuhle. Kufanele ukwazi ukuphatha kanye no kukhuthaza abantu, ukuthuthukisa umphumela wabo, futhi aphathe ubudlelwano kahle ukuze kughqwe imigomo yesikhungo. Kufanele ukwazi ukuletha izinkonzo ngempumelelo nokusebenza kahle ukufeza imoya yokusebenzela abathengi (Batho Pele). Kufanele ukwazi ukushintshanisa ulwazi namaphupho ngendlela ecacile futhi elula ehambisana nesitsha sabantu ukuchasisa, ukukholisa, nokuphoqa ukufeza okufunwayo. Kufanele ukwazi ukubonisa futhi ahe amaphuzu aphezulu ezokuziphatha okuhlakaniphile ukuze kube nokwesaba kanye nokwethemba e Public Service. Izimpawu zabantu: Ukubamba iqhaza kokuqeqesha okuthuthukisa ukukhula nokugcina ulwazi ngokuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlala ulwazi lwakamuva. Amandla okusebenza izinto eziningi kanye nokuhlela, ukugqamisa futhi ulandelwe izinhlelo eziningi kanye nemisebenzi ukuze kuqedwe ngokuqaphela imininingwane. Amandla okusebenza eyedwa ngenkathi unika isandla isitsha. Amandla okuhlaziya izinkinga, thola izixazuliwo, wenze okulandelayo, bese uxazula izinkinga usebenzisa ukuhlakanipha nokuzethula. Amandla okwakha futhi ahlale kuleso sibili sebudlelwano nabaphathi, abasebenzi, abaxhumayo, nomphakathi. Ukuzethemba kanye nokuqotho, kuqaphela imininingwane, ukukhaliqwa, nokungamandla, nokusebenza ngaphansi komfutho. Ukuhamba kulelo zwe kanye namazwe omhlaba kanye nenani lamahora lapho kudingeka. Izithembwa uma sikhethwa izinsizwa zabantu base Africa, intsha, amadoda abansundu nakwabamnyama nabantu abasikhombe ngokwemisebenzi yethu yezobulinga.
zu.duties: Omutsha uzobekwa emgqeni wale mikhakha ephathelene nemiphumela: Ukuthuthukisa, ukuhlola kanye nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo zezifundo, izindingo, izindlela, kanye nolwazi lwesikhungo lwezifundo oluhlangabezana nezinhloso ezinkulu nezinhlelo zombuso. Ukukhokha ekuhleleni nokusebenziseni ihlelo eliphelele lokuchwephesheka kwabakhi be-ETD, okuhlanganisa izinga lekhono, izindlela zokufunda, nezinhlela zokuqeqeshwa ngokuchwephesheka ngokuphazima. Ukubukeka ukusakazwa kwezinkalo zika-Afrika nokuqakambisa imibono kungeniswa ngemva kwehlela elisedwayo lokuguqulelwa izifundo, okuhlanganisa ukubaliswa, ukulethwa kwezinkonzo ezenzelwa abantu, kanye nokuqonda kwezomphakathi ukukhulisa ukuhlobana ngamasiko nokusabela izidingo sektion yomphakathi. Ukubuka ukuhlela nokuthuthukisa nokuphatha ukudalwa kwezifundo kanye nezindlela ezihambisana nendlela ezinhloko ze-NQF level kanye nezinhloso zesikhungo. Ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokufunda zedijithali kanye nezisekelo zokuqakambisa izinto ekuhleleni nokulethwa kwezifundo. Ukukhokha kanye nokuphatha ekuhleleni, ekuqakambiseni, ekuhloleni, nakokuthuthukisa izinhlela eziqinisekisiwe nangazo ezingaqinisekisiwe. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izindlela ezijwayelekile zokuthuthukiswa kwezifundo, amathuluzi, kanye nezifanekiso. Ukusekela amanye amayunithi ukugcina iziso ezikuqinisekisa izinga, okuhlanganisa ukulinganisa, ukuhlola ngokulingana, kanye nokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinqubo. Ukukhokha ekuqakambiseni izinhlela ezingxenyeni, ezingahlanganiswa, ezinezikweletu, okuhlanganisa ama-micro-credentials kanye nokubalwa kolwazi lokwangaphambili (RPL). Ukwenza kube lula ukuhlanganiswa kwezobuchwepheshe zokufunda kwedijithali kanye nezindlela ezingahleliwe kulethwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana phakathi kwesakhiwo sezifundo, izidingo zokuqinisekiswa, izindlela zalaba bafundi, kanye nenhlelo yesikhungo. Ukusebenzisa izinqubo zokuqinisekiswa ezibukhali eziningana ukuqinisekiswa, ukuhlola, ukubuka ngokulingana, ukuthuthukisa okuqhubekayo, kanye nokuqinisekisa isikhathi ezifundweni ukunikeza isikhathi, ukusebenza, kanye nokuhambisana nemigomo yokuqinisekiswa phakathi kwezinhlela eziqinisekisiwe nalokuqinisekiwe. Ukuhlanganisa izobuchwepheshe zemfundo ezingezansi kanye nezindlela ezihlukile ngaphakathi kwesikelo esiqondile sezezimali sidijithali, ezilawulwa ngokuqa umbono ngolwazi olulandela izitayela ze-EdTech ukukhulisa ukungena nomthelela wabafundi. Ukuletha kuleso sibili impumelelo yohlelo, okuhlanganisa ukusebenza kwabafundi, ukuthinta, kanye nokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izindlela. Ukuqhuba imiyalo yokulinganisa izinhlela nangamaphuzu aqinisekisiwe kazwelonke namazwe omhlaba. Ukuthola, ukwakha, kanye nokuphatha ubudlelwano obucacile nezikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, ama-SETA, kanye nezinhlangano zamazwe omhlaba. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izindlela zokwakha ukhaphasithi nokuthuthukisa izinhlela ngokuchwepheshe kubakhi be-ETD. Ukunikela ngeluleko nasekusekeleni izikhungo zomphakathi ekuthuthukisweni kwezifundo nangokuchwephesheka. Ukuhlela futhi kuncede ezinhlelweni zokwabelana ngolwazi, okuhlanganisa ama-workshops, ama-seminars, namabhlanganiswele wobuchwepheshe. Ukuthola kanye nokulondoloza izikhathi zokuqashwa ubudlelwano, izixhumanisi, kanye nama-sponsorship ukusekela izifundo kanye nokuqakambiswa kwamakhono. Ukuhlela nokwenza izindlela eziningi ezihambisana nezidingo zalabo bafundi abahlukene. Ukubeka isandla ekuxhumaniseni nasekuhumeleni namayunithi angaphakathi kanye nabanikela ngemiyalo futhi athuthukise izifundo nokuqakambiswa kwezinhlela. Ukwakha ubudlewano futhi unikezele ngesekela okubhalwe ngokuchwepheshe esihlwini sokugcina ubuchwepheshe, izifundo, nokuchwephesheka, okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela imibiko, izibhalo, kanye nemiqulu yemithetho. Ukuthola, ukuba ngumongameli, futhi uphathe amapholom angaphakathi nangaphakathi kwamakhosi ahlangene, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, ama-Setas, izikhungo zobuchwepheshe, namazwe aselezinye izwe ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwezifundo, ukuchwephesheka, ukuqinisekiswa, nakophando. Ukuqala futhi uphate izinhlelo ezixhumene nezikhungo zendawo kanye namazwe omhlaba. Ukumela isikhungo kumapholomu kazwelonke nakuwezamazwe omhlaba, kumapholomu, nakoma kuma-conferences, ukunikeza isikhathi esikahle ngokuchwepheshe nasemkhakheni we-Professionalisation kwezemfundo nokugqilaza. Ukuthuthukisa futhi kugcinwe ubudlelwano bokusekela izifundo kanye nokuthuthukiswa ngokuchwepheshe.

xh.title: Umlawuli Omkhulu: Inkxaso yoMthetho wesifundo noMtlolozi
xh.summary: Kufuneka iMlawuli Omkhulu ukuyila kwakwayo nokuphumeza iinkqubo zemigaqo yemifundo namakhefu e-ETD kwiiSikolo seZikarhulumente ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kwesimali esinye okanye esilinganayo (NQF level 7). Imaqumbu emfundo yamangesi after-degree iya kuba ngelixa elongezelelekileyo. Ukubhalisa kwelungundothiyo lomsebenzi oluhambelana nalo nalo iya kuba ngelixa elongezelelekileyo. Umfundi ophumeleleyo uya kujongwa ngokhuseleko kwinqanaba elifanelekileyo labaphathi abakhulu. Isipili: Isipili esibanzi, esiqinisekisiweyo neshushumbayo esinengamaxa apho eminye iminyaka emihlanu (5) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokulawulwa kwabaphathi abakhulu, kukhokelo ekuyileni nasekuqweneni imifundo kwimfundo, uqeqesho, okanye ukwakhiwa kwamandla kwelungundothiyo karhulumente. Isipili esiqinisekisiweyo: Kukuyila nokuphuhlisa imifundo yemifundo ezikolweni, izimiso zomsebenzi, iinkqubo zemakhono, namakhefu abafundi abafunde iyunivesithi. Isipili esiqinisekisiweyo ekuyileni imigaqo yemifundo eballiweyo kwiSikhokelo seZidanga eZizwe. Ekukhokeleni iinkqubo zemfundo okanye ukwenza umsebenzi ngokuchanekileyo kwisakhizi esikhulu. Ekulawuleni amaqela ahlukeneyo nemixhoba. Ekuzibandakanyeni nabaqaphi-baqaphi kwinqanaba lesigqeba (karhulumente, ezemfundo, amazwe ngamazwe). Isipili esibonakalisiweyo ekukhokeleni iindlela ezintsha zemfundo nemfundo yamakhompyutha. Isipili ekuphandweni okusebenzisekayo, nokushicilela kwimifundo, nokuyila amakhefu emifundo. Ulwazi: Amakhefu emfundo yamagesi amakhulu nokuqeqesha kwamakhono. Uyilo lwemifundo, iimodelo zoyilo lokufundisa, nemiqathango yemfundo esekelwe kwimigaqo. Ulwazi nokuyiqonda uMgaqo-siseko waseNingizimu Afrika namagazethi karhulumente (kuquka uMthetho woMsebenzi woLuntu, uMthetho woLawulo woQobo, uMthetho weNkqubo zeNdlu zouRhulumente, uMthetho weNkqubo zamaBhunga, uMthetho woPhuhliso lweZakhono, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yeNdlu zouRhulumente, uMthetho weZikhokelo zeZidanga iZizwe nemiQathango ehambelana nayo, uMthetho yoPhuhliso lweMfundo eNqamlezweni namakhefu abasebenzi be-ETD nemiQathango namakhefu abasebenzi be-ETD namakhefu ekufundeni kwenkqubo, nemiqathacho yokwenza umsebenzi. Ulwazi ngexesha lokuqonda noGqoziwo, nokuqonda izigqeba, nokumisela iinkqabo kwimfundo ebalulekileyo. Iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokufundisa kwikhompyutha, nasekusebenziseni iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokufunda ngokutsha, nokuqonda ngamakhompyutha amakhulu.
xh.duties: Lo mntu uya kuba negunya lokwenza aze achuze nokuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zemfundo ziyahambelana nezigqibo zemfundo ezinamagunya ngokuhambelana namagunya abakho namakhono asemagazini.

jobs.title: Invitation to Serve AS AN Audit Committee Member
jobs.salary_text: Members will be remunerated for preparation and attendance of meetings (in line with Treasury Regulations par. 20.2.3).
jobs.summary: The National School of Government invites experienced professionals to serve as Audit Committee Members, providing oversight on risk, governance, audit and compliance matters.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should: Have a relevant degree in Accounting/Auditing/Risk/Legal/ Information Technology. A relevant postgraduate qualification would be an added advantage. At least 10 years’ experience in a senior / executive role in Accounting /Auditing/ Legal / Information Technology / Risk and Compliance environments. At least 5-10 years’ experience of serving in Audit Committees or Risk Committees in the Public Sector. Membership of a professional body in the respective fields will be an added advantage. Knowledge: PFMA, Modified Cash Standards, GRAP or GAAP. Attributes: Integrity, dedication, understanding public sector business and controls, good communication skills, inquisitiveness and independent judgment.
jobs.duties: Execute oversight responsibilities regarding risk management, control, governance, information technology, compliance, external and internal audit, management accounts and annual financial statements. Advise the Accounting Officer in the effective execution of his/her responsibilities. Assist in building trust and confidence in how the Department is managed through effective oversight. Regulate and discharge all responsibilities as contained chapter 3 of Treasury Regulations issued in terms of the PFMA as well as the Audit Committee Charter.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Takalani Madzole Tel No: (012) 441 6151 or nsg.internalaudit@thensg.gov.za
jobs.applications: Should be addressed to: The Accounting Officer: The National School of Government and be submitted in the following manner: E-mail: nsg.internalaudit@thensg.gov.za or hand delivery to The National School of Government, 70 Meintje Str, Trevenna Campus, Sunnyside, Pretoria.
jobs.notes: The Audit Committee will report to the Executive Authority and Accounting Officer of the National School of Government. Preference will be given to applicants who are citizens of the Republic of South Africa. The Audit Committee shall meet at least four (4) times per financial year. Applications must be accompanied by a comprehensive curriculum vitae as well as certified copies of qualifications and identity document. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.

af.title: Uitnodiging om te dien AS 'n Ouditkomiteelid
af.summary: Die National School of Government nooi ervare professionele persone uit om as Ouditkomiteelede te dien en toesig te verskaf oor risiko-, bestuurs-, oudit- en nakomingsake.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet: Oor 'n tersaaklike graad in Rekenkunde/Oudit/Risiko/Regte/Inligtingstegnologie beskik. 'n Tersaaklike nagraadse kwalifikasie sal 'n voordeel wees. Ten minste 10 jaar se ervaring in 'n senior/uitvoerende rol in Rekenkunde-/Oudit-/Regte-/Inligtingstegnologie-/Risiko- en Nakomingsomgewings. Ten minste 5-10 jaar se ervaring in die diens van Ouditkomitees of Risikokomitees in die Publieke Sektor. Lidmaatskap van 'n professionele liggaam in die onderskeie velde sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis: PFMA, Modified Cash Standards, GRAP of GAAP. Eienskappe: Integriteit, toewyding, begrip van openbare sektor besigheid en beheer, goeie kommunikasievaardighede, nuuskierigheid en onafhanklike oordeel.
af.duties: Voer toesigverantwoordelikhede uit rakende risikobestuur, beheer, bestuur, inligtingstegnologie, nakoming, externe en interne oudit, bestuursrekeninge en jaarlikse finansiële state. Adviseer die Rekenpligtige Beampte in die doeltreffende uitvoering van sy/haar verantwoordelikhede. Help om vertroue en geloof in die wyse waarop die Departement bestuur word, op te bou deur doeltreffende toesig. Reguleer en voer alle verantwoordelikhede uit soos vervat in hoofstuk 3 van Tesourie-regulasies wat ingevolge die PFMA uitgevaardig is, asook die Ouditkomitee-handves.

zu.title: Isimemo Sokuba Yilungu LeKomidi Yokuhlola
zu.summary: iNational School of Government imema abochwepheshe abanamava ukuba bakhonze njengabalungu beKomidi Yokuhlola, beknika isevisi yolawulo kwezindlela zengozi, ukuphathwa kwebuso, ukuhlola nokuthobela imithetho.
zu.requirements: Abafakizinto kufanele: Babe nediploma ehambisanayo ezifundeni zokuBala izimali / Ukuhlola / Izingozi / Ezomthetho / Itheknoloji yolwazi. Iqualifications yesiqu samabanga aphezulu ezo kuba yinzuzo engeziwe. Okungenani unyaka owengu-10 wobuchwepheshe esikhundleni esiphezulu / sobakhwenda ezimeni zokuBala izimali / Ukuhlola / Ezomthetho / Itheknoloji yolwazi / Izingozi nokuthobela umthetho. Okungenani unyaka owengu-5 kusiya kwangu-10 wobuchwepheshe bokusebenza kuKomidi Zokuhlola noma amaKomidi Wezingozi eMkhandlwini woMphakathi. Ukuba yilungu lomzimba omcathi ohlukaniswe ezinkundleni ezo kuba yinzuzo engeziwe. Ulwazi: PFMA, Amagabelo AsiGuquliwe Awasemalenomini, GRAP noma GAAP. Izimpawu: Ukwethembeka, inkanuko, ukuqonda ibhizinisi lomphakathi nokulawula, amakhono ethuluzi lokuxhumana, ukubuza imibuzo nesipho sokwahlulela ngokuzimele.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yokulawula ngeqhaza ngokuphathwa kwezingozi, ukulawula, ukuphathwa kwebuso, itheknoloji yolwazi, ukuthobela umthetho, ukuhlola ngaphandle nangaphakathi, izinkulu zezimali kanye nezinkampani zemali zonyaka. Luleta iNkosi Eziimali ekuphethweni ngempumelelo kwezimisebenzi zakhe. Siza ekwakheni isithembu nethemba ekutheni umnyango uphathwa kanjani ngokulawula okusebenzayo. Ulawule uphatha yonke imisebenzi njengoba kushiwo esigabeni 3 semithetho yolawulo yeTreasury edayiswe ngokusezinhlelweni zomthetho we-PFMA kanye noMthethosisekelo woKwiKomidi Yokuhlola.

xh.title: Isimemo sokuba lIlungu leKomiti yeVavanyo
xh.summary: Isikolo sikaRhamentyunyu sibiza ootitshala abajongeleyo ukuba basebenze njengeelungu leKomiti yeVavanyo, libonelele ngolawulo ngengozi, intlalo yolawulo, ukuhlolwa nokuvumelana.
xh.requirements: Iinkokheli: zibe neNqaba echazwe kwisikhokelo ngemisebenzi ngeesikhwama SeMali/IsiBalo ngokusebenzayo kwaye kwingingqi yokusetyenziswa imali emva kwendlu xa kusetyenziswa iingcinga ezahlukeneyo kwisenzo sokuphumeza iinkqubo. Iimfuno eziya kubakho iiNqaba zoxhomekekeko kwisikhokelo esimhlophe zokwenza imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo ekwindawo yeNkosi ngoonyaka obaliweyo. Unyaka obaliweyo wokwazi ngokubakho kwenkundla yeSiseko okanye iKomiti yengozi kwicandelo loLuntu. Ulungiselelo loluntu kwiiNkundla ezahlukeneyo luya kubakho isebenziso esongezelelweyo. Ulwazi: PFMA, IziP templiv zokuSebenza eziLungisiweyo, GRAP okanye GAAP. Iimpawu: ukuzithemba, ulwazi, ukuqonda imisebenzi nolawulo loluntu, amakhono abalulekileyo othungelwano, ukubuza imibuzo nokwahlula ngokuzimela.
xh.duties: Phatha iimvisiswano ezimalunga nokuqonda iingozi, ulawulo, intlalo yolawulo, iTeknoloji yolwazi, ukuvumelana, nokuhlolwa ngaphakathi nangaphandle, iiaxhente zolawulo nemigca yeemali yonyaka.nika isalathiso kumsebenzi weziNxibelelaniso ekusebenzeni ngokusebenzayo kwemisebenzi yakhe./yokuyenza. Yenza isithiyo sokwakha ukuthembeka nokholo ndlela elawulwa ngayo iNgcwele ngokusebenzayo kweziNtaba. Lungelelanise kwaye uphumeze onke amanqanaba njengoko kubhalwe kwisahluko 3 kolawulo lwesixeko ezezeko ngeziMfuno zeRiphabhlikhi squatsha kwiNzululwazi kaRhamentyunyu, kwaye ibe kwiNgcaca yokuQinisekiswa.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff: Private Office of the Chief Justice
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 – R1 858 821 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive package), consisting of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Chief of Staff in the Private Office of the Chief Justice providing strategic leadership and managing administration at the Midrand national office.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate and an LLB or equivalent qualification in Law (NQF 7) as recognized by SAQA. A postgraduate qualification in Management or Legal will be an added advantage. A minimum of five (5) years’ appropriate experience at Senior Management level. Experience in management either in the public or private sector. One of the minimum entry requirements for Senior Management Service is the pre-entry certificate. For more details on the pre-entry course, visit: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. The successful candidate will be required to complete this prior to appointment. af.title: Stafhoof: Privaatkantoor van die Hoofregter
af.summary: Stafhoof in die Privaatkantoor van die Hoofregter wat strategiese leierskap bied en administrasie by die Midrand nasionale kantoor bestuur.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n LLB of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in Regte (NQF 7) soos deur SAQA erken besit. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Bestuur of Regte sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se toepaslike ervaring op Seniorbestuursvlak. Ervaring in bestuur òf in die publieke of private sektor. Een van die minimum toetredevereistes vir Seniorbestuursdiens is die voor-toetredingsertifikaat. Vir meer besonderhede oor die voor-toetredekursus, besoek: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om dit voor aanstelling te voltooi. Bewese vermoë om hoogs komplekse beleidsdokumente en regsinstrumente op te stel en gehaltebeheer daaroor te doen. 'n Begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse regstelsel. Uitgebreide kennis van die funksionering van 'n uitvoerende kantoor en verwante administratiewe stelsels. Organisatoriese vermoë en analitiese skerpheid. Gevorderde navorsings- en skryfvaardighede. Gevorderde kennis van die toepassing van MS Office-toepassings. Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om te reis wanneer vereis en lang ure te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Die kandidaat moet aan die vereistes vir 'n top-geheime veiligheidsklarering voldoen. Attribute en bevoegdhede: Selfgedrewe, toon inisiatief, vermoë om streng sperdatums te haal en onder druk te werk, 'n sin vir aandag aan besonderhede, en uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, programma- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, kennisbestuur, diensleweringsinnovering, probleemoplossing en analise, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus, kommunikasie, eerlikheid en integriteit.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die Privaatkantoor van die Hoofregter. Bestuur en verseker die doeltreffende en doelmatige administrasie van die Privaatkantoor van die Hoofregter. Tree op as hoofkontakpunt tussen die Privaatkantoor van die Hoofregter en die Kantoor van die Sekretaris-Generaal van die OCJ. Bestuur finansiële, menslike en ander hulpbronne wat aan die Privaatkantoor van die Hoofregter toegewys is. Verskaf en koördineer protokol-, sekuriteits- en verwante tegniese of regte administrasieondersteuningsdienste. Verskaf uitvoerende en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Hoofregter en die Adjunkhoofregter, insluitend huishoudelike ondersteuningsdienste. Verskaf binnelandse en internasionale belanghebbende-verhoudingsbestuursdienste. Hou toesig oor die beplanning van groot internasionale en binnelandse geleenthede wat deur die Hoofregter aangebied word. Verskaf uitvoerende skakeldienste aan die Hoofregter en die Adjunkhoofregter ter ondersteuning van hul seremoniële funksies en wisselwerking met die Uitvoerende en Wetgewende Takke van die Staat. Ontwikkel, handhaaf en implementeer administratiewe (dokument- en ander bestuurs)stelsels vir die Privaatkantoor van die Hoofregter. Ontwikkel, bestuur en koördineer die voorbereiding van konseptoele toesprake, navorsing en verwante dokumente soos deur die Hoofregter en die Adjunkhoofregter vereis.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiyinhloko: Private Office of the Chief Justice
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esiyinhloko e-Private Office of the Chief Justice esinikeza ubuholi obuyisuqu kanye nokuphatha kwabasikhulu e-Midrand.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-LLB noma isiqu esilinganayo kwiNdzaba (NQF 7) njengoba samukelwa yi-SAQA. Isiqu sokuya esikhundleni esiphezulu sokuphatha noma somthetho kuzoba yithuba elihle. Okuncane eminyakeni emihlanu (5) okuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana naleso esikhundleni se-Senior Management. Okuhlangenwe nakho kokuphatha komunye umphakathi noma kwezinkampani. Omunye wemfuno yokungena esikhundleni se-Senior Management Service uyisitifiketi sokuqala. Ukuze wazi kabanzi ngocwaningo lokuqala, vakasha kwi: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Umenziwe kuzomele abeke ucwaningo oluhle kakhulu njengoba beqanjwe amaphuzu amakhulu e-Midrand. Ubufakazi bokuthi ungakwazi ukubhala futhi ulawule inani lamadokhumenti amabinzima kakhulu komthetho. Ukuqonda kwesistimu yomthetho yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi olunzulu lokusebenza kolunye uhlelo lwabasikhulu nezinye izinhlelo zokuphatha. Ikhono lokuhleleka kanye nokuqonda. Iziqu eziphezulu zokucwaninga nokuqamba. Ulwazi oluphezulu lokusebenzisa izinhlelo ze-MS Office. Ikhono kanye nesifiso sokuvakasha kanye nokusebenza amahora amanengi. Ilayisense lokushayela elivunyelwe. Ubufakazi bokuthi ungakwazi ukuthola isitifiketi sokungena ezindaweni eziyimfihlo. Ikhono elinengqi: Ukwazeka ngokwakho, ukubonisa inqubomgomo, ikhono lokuzuza isikhathi futhi ukusebenza ngokucindezelwa, ukuqaphela kabanzi, kanye nenhloso enhle yokuxhumana. Ikhono lokuhola, ukuphatha amaphulo nemisebenzi, ukuphatha imali, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukuvuselela ukulethwa kwezinsiza, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphatha abantu kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwabo, ukugxila kumthengi, ukuxhumana, ukuzithoba nokwethembeka.
zu.duties: Nika abaholi ababalabewonke e-Private Office of the Chief Justice. Phatha futhi uqiniseke ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nokuqondile kwesikhungo se-Private Office of the Chief Justice. Yiba ngomunye wamaphoyinti abalulekile okuxhumana phakathi kwe-Private Office of the Chief Justice ne-Office of the Secretary General of the OCJ. Phatha izinsizakusebenzi eziyimali, abantu neminye eznikezwe i-Private Office of the Chief Justice. Nika futhi ulawule amacebo okuziphatha, ukuvikeleka neminye imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe noma ngomthetho. Nika abasikhulu nasezobuphatheli usekelo iNkantolo Yenkantolo Nkulu kanye neNkantolo Yenkantolo Ehloniphekile, okuhlanganisa nemisebenzi yasekhaya. Nika imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezindaba zomhlaba wonke kanye nezwe lonke. Buka ucociselo lwezinkathi ezinkulu zomhlaba wonke nangeswe lonke ezibambe iNkantolo Yenkantolo Nkulu. Nika abasikhulu abahleli imisebenzi yokusekela iNkantolo Yenkantolo Nkulu kanye neNkantolo Yenkantolo Ehloniphekile ekwenzeni imisebenzi yawo yamahloniphe futhi kwabanye abasikhulu bombuso. Lakha, gcina futhi usebenzise izinto zokuphatha (amadokhumenti kanye nokunye) ezikhungweni se-Private Office of the Chief Justice. Lakha, phatha futhi ulawule ukulungiswa kwezinkulumo, ucwaningo neminye imibhalo njengoba iNkantolo Yenkantolo Nkulu kanye neNkantolo Yenkantolo Ehloniphekile eyifunayo.

xh.requirements: Kufuneka abafaki isicelo babe nesatifikethi se Grade 12 kunye ne LLB okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo kwiMthetho (NQF 7) njengokuvunywe yi SAQA. Isifanekiso sesiqu ngemva kwesidanga kuLawulo okanye kwiMthetho siya kuba ngelinye inzuzo. Ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava afanelekileyo kwinqanaba leNkululeko Yolawulo. Amava eLAWULO nokuba ngummandla wentlangano kahulumendi okanye yabucala. Elinye leminyani yemfuno yokungena kwi Senior Management Service yisatifikethi sokungenisa. Iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe malunga nekhosi yokungenisa, ndwendwela: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme. Umthunywa ophumeleleyo uya kufuneka afake isicelo sekhosi ngaphambi kokwamkelwa. Ikakhulu labo banokubhala kunye nolawulo lokhwalithi kwamaxwebhu epolisi anobungako bokubucoxa kunye nezixhobo zemithetho. Kuqondwa kwinkqubo yomthetho yase Mzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga nokusebenza kwofisi yomzekamo kunye nezinkqubo zolawulo ezingenelelo. Ikhono leNtlangano kunye nobuchule bokuhlalutya. Amakhono aphakamileyo okuphanda kwaye abhale. Ulwazi oluphakamileyo lokusebenzisa iinkqubo ze MS Office. Ikhono lokuze kulindeleke ukuhamba xa kufuneka kwaye usebenze iiyure ezinde. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Umthunywa kufuneka ahlangabezane nemfuno yokuqinisekiswa kwesicwangciso sokhuseleko esiyimfihlo. Iimpawu namakhono: uzimelayo, abonise ukuzithanda, ikhono lokuhlangabezana nemigca yesixa epheleleyo nokusebenza ngociniseko, inkanuko yokutsha ulwazi, kunye namakhono abalulekileyo ekunxibelelaneni (ebhalwe nasekuhleni). Ikhono nesikhokelo kumapoli, ulawulo lenkqubo nemisebenzi, ulawulo lwemali, ulawulo lolwazi, iindlela ezitsha zokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuwahlalutya, ulawulo labantu nakubaphuhlisa, inxibelelwano namakhasi, ukunyaniseka nokuqiniseka.
xh.duties: Kunikela inkokhelo esisigqini kwi Ofisi Yabucala Yomahluleli Omkhulu. Lawula kuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo olusebenzayo olusemgangathweni we Ofisi Yabucala Yomahluleli Omkhulu. Zenza njengenqanaba elinesimo lokudibana phakathi kwe Ofisi Yabucala Yomahluleli Omkhulu ne Ofisi kaBhalane Jikelele we OCJ. Lawula imali, abantu kunye namanye amacebo anikiweyo kwi Ofisi Yabucala Yomahluleli Omkhulu. Nikela uze uhlele inkonzo yemithetho, ukhuseleko kunye nenkxaso yamacebo okanye yemithetho yolawulo edibana nayo. Nikela inkxaso yomsekamo nolawulo kuMahluleli Omkhulu nakusomyoki weMahluleli Omkhulu kuquka nemisebenzi yenkxaso yendlu. Nikela inkonzo yolawulo lobudlelwane nabathathi-nxaxheba bendlu nakwamanye amazwe. Qhuba ucwangco lomsebenzi womhlaba wonke oqulunqwe ngumMahluleli Omkhulu. Nikela inkonzo yokunxibelelana komsekamo kuMahluleli Omkhulu nakusomyoki weMahluleli Omkhulu ukuxhasa imisebenzi yabo yesiko nokungxamelana nabasekamo neMigaqo esemthethweni yoMmandla. Yakha, ulondoloze, kuze usebenzise inkqubo yolawulo (amaxwebhu namanye olawulo) we Ofisi Yabucala Yomahluleli Omkhulu. Yakha, ulawule uze uhlele ulungiselelo lweenkcaso ezikluqwayo, uphando namaxwebhu ahambelana nawo njengoko kufunwa ngumMahluleli Omkhulu nakusomyoki weMahluleli Omkhulu.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Dcrs
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig om digitale hofopname-toerusting te bedryf en administratiewe ondersteuning by die Western Cape High Court in Cape Town te verskaf.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak four (4) soos deur SAQA erken besit. Geen ondervinding word vereis. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar ondervinding in hofopnames, blootstelling aan hofverwante funksies en 'n bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. af.duties: Voer voor die begin van hofverrigtinge toetse uit en bedien opname-toerusting; voer digitale opnames van hofverrigtinge uit en verseker die integriteit van sodanige opnames; verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning by sittingshowwe; versamel statistieke; verskaf algemene administratiewe ondersteuning vir hofprestasie en saakvloei-bestuur; verskaf enige ander administratiewe ondersteuning in verband met saakvloei, HR, Finansies en Voorsieningsketting soos vereis deur die Regbank, Hofbestuurder, Hoofregistrateur en toesighouer.

xh.summary: Kufuneki ibe nguclerki wolawulo ukubasebenzisa izixhobo zokurekhoda ikhotho yedijithali kwaye anike inkxaso yolawulo kwi-Western Cape High Court e-Cape Town.
xh.requirements: Abafake izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se-Grade 12 okanye nelifanelekwanga kwinqanaba le-NQF elinesi four (4) njengokuvunyelwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mfundo yamava edingekayo. Ukwahluleka kwexesha elingaphezulu kwesinye (1) umnyaka wamava ekurekhodweni kweekhotho, kuqondiswa kumsebenzi ohlobene nekhotho nepaliyensi yokushayela kuya kuba yintsengo e ongeziweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngohlahle lwokurekhoda ngemidiya yedijithali, ukuqhuba iinkqubo zovavanyo nokusebenzisa imishini ye-DCRS/CRT. Ukhwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office), ukunxibelelana (ngokuthetha nangokubhala), ulawulo lwamagama, inkonzo yabathengi, amakhono okunxibelelana nabantu nokusombulula iingxaki. xh.duties: Phambi kweenkqubo zekhotho hlola kwaye usebenzise izixhobo zokurekhoda, wenze ukurekhoda ngemidiya yeenkqubo zekhotho uze uqinisekise ukuzinza kweekopi ezo, zinike inkxaso yolawulo kwiikhotho ezijikelezayo, qokelela iibalo, nike inkxaso yolawulo ngokubanzi kuqondo lweekhotho nolawulo lwamava amacala, nike nawo nasiphi na inkxaso yolawulo ngokuhambelana namacala, i-HR, i-Finance kunye ne-Supply Chain njengoko kufunwa yi-Judiciary, i-Court Manager, i-Chief Registrar kunye ne-Supervisor.

jobs.title: Data Capturer
jobs.centre: Western Cape Division of The High Court: Cape Town
jobs.salary_text: R201 093 – R236 877.per annum (Level 04). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement
jobs.summary: The Office of the Chief Justice seeks a Grade 12 data capturer for the Western Cape High Court in Cape Town to manage data entry, verification, and backups.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate or equivalent qualification at NQF level four (4) as recognised by SAQA. No experience required. A valid drivers’ license will serve as an added advantage Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, Batho Pele principles and working procedures in terms of the working environment. Skilled in communication (written and verbal), interpersonal relations, computer literacy, customer service, planning, organising, problem solving, analytical and numeracy skills. Along with the following attributes: ability to work under pressure, flexible, motivated, meticulous and self-driven.
jobs.duties: Capture data from available records into the required formats e.g. databases, table, spreadsheet, verify missing data and errors observed during data entry, review and validate all data from the records, submit data and make regular backups of data, update registers and statistics, keep and maintain records and files, ensure records and files are properly sorted and secured, provide information to components, provide support to the verification personnel with availing data sources required and files, collect correspondence from general office, distribute files and correspondence to Registrars, send and receive emails when requested, report all IT problems immediately to supervisor, provide any other support as required by the judiciary, Court Manager and/or supervisor and provide information to responsible components, keep and maintain records and files in an organised method, ensure that all case records/court documents for data capturing are kept safely while in your possession, attend to Attorneys queries with respect to quasi-judicial matters, review and validate all data from the files, open files, sort and distribute incoming data to be captured equally, update registers and statistics ENQUIRIES Technical Related Enquiries: Ms. S Ndou Tel No: (021) 480 2635 HR Related Enquiries: Mr. SD Hlongwane Tel No: (012) 482 3809
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/137/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. af.title: Data-vanger
af.summary: Die Kantoor van die Hoofregter soek 'n Graad 12-data-vang vir die Western Cape High Court in Cape Town om data-invoer, verifikasie en rugsteun te bestuur.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak vier (4) soos deur SAQA erken. Geen ervaring vereis nie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te vang, Batho Pele-beginsels en werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Vaardig in kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), interpersoonlike verhoudings, rekenaargeletterdheid, kliëntediens, beplanning, organisering, probleemoplossing, analitiese en syfervaardighede. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: vermoë om onder druk te werk, buigsaam, gemotiveerd, noukeurig en selfgedrewe.
af.duties: Vang data vanaf beskikbare rekords vas in die vereiste formate bv. databasisse, tabelle, sigblaaie, verifieer ontbrekende data en foute wat tydens data-invoer waargeneem word, hersien en valideer alle data vanaf die rekords, dien data in en maak gereelde rugsteun van data, werk register en statistieke by, hou en onderhou rekords en lêers, verseker dat rekords en lêers behoorlik gesorteer en veilig gestoor word, verskaf inligting aan komponente, verskaf ondersteuning aan die verifikasielpersoneel deur die benodigde databronne en lêers beskikbaar te stel, versamel korrespondensie vanaf die algemene kantoor, versprei lêers en korrespondensie aan Registrateurs, stuur en ontvang e-posse wanneer versoek, rapporteer alle IT-probleme onmiddellik aan die toesighouer, verskaf enige ander ondersteuning soos deur die regbank, Hofbestuurder en/of toesighouer vereis en verskaf inligting aan verantwoordelike komponente, hou en onderhou rekords en lêers op 'n georganiseerde wyse, verseker dat alle saakrekords/hofdokumente vir datavasvanging veilig gehou word terwyl dit in u besit is, hou hom/haar besig met prokureurs se navrae rakende kwasi-regterlike aangeleenthede, hersien en valideer alle data vanaf die lêers, maak lêers oop, sorteer en versprei inkomende data wat vasgevang moet word gelykmatig, werk register en statistieke by NAVRAE Tegnies-verwante navrae: Me. S Ndou Tel No: (021) 480 2635 HR-verwante navrae: Mnr. SD Hlongwane Tel No: (012) 482 3809

zu.title: Umqambi Wezilawuli
zu.summary: IOfisi yeNkosana Yezomthetho ifuna umqambi wezilawuli onezinga le-12 we-Western Cape High Court eCape Town ukuphatha ukuqamba imininingwane, ukuqinisekisa nokwenza amakophi okulondoloza.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level four (4) njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mva oludingwa. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile izoba yinzuzo eyengeziyo Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yabahleli, izendlela zokwenza imisebenzi kanye nenhloso yokubamba imininingwane, imigomo ye-Batho Pele kanye nendlela yokusebenza ngokwezindinganiso zokuqasha. Ukuba nikhoni ekuxhumaneni (ebhaliwe nasenkulumeni), ebudlelwaneni nobuntu, ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha, enkonzweni yabathengi, ekuhleleni, ekuqweni, ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ekuhlaziyeni nakubalweni. Kanye nale minqondo elandelayo: ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo, ukuba ukuguquguqukayo, ukuba nomdlandla, ukuba nocophelelo kanye nokuziqhayisa ngokuzenzela.
zu.duties: Qamba imininingwane esixukwini esitholakalayo besifaka kumafomethi adingekayo njengesixuku somininingwane, ithebula, ispredishidi, qinisekisa imininingwane engekho namaphutha abonwa ngesikhathi sokuqamba imininingwane, hlola futhi uqinisekise yonke imininingwane esixukwini, thumela imininingwane futhi wenze amakophi okulondoloza njalo, buyekeza okubhaliwe nezibalo, gcina futhi ulondoloze imibhalo namafayela, qinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo namafayela acazulwa kahle futhi avikelekile, nikeza ulwazi kumalunga, nikeza inkuseleko abantu bokuqinisekisa ngokusinika imithombo yemininingwane edingekayo namafayela, qoqa uthi okuvela kofisini jikelelo, aba amafayela nothi kuma-Registrar, thumela futhi wamukele ama-email lapho kucelwa khona, beka noma yiliphi inkinga ye-IT ngaso sonke isikhathi kumlawuli ophezulu, nikeza noma yikuphi ukusekela njengoba kudingwa uhlelo lokwezomthetho, Umphathi WeNkantolo kanye/noma umlawuli ophezulu bese unikeza ulwazi kumalunga abhekene nayo, gcina futhi ulondoloze imibhalo namafayela ngendlela ecazulwe kahle, qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibhalo yamacala/amadokhumenti enkantolo aqambe imininingwane igcinwe ngokuphephile ngesikhathi ekubeni bowo, babazise ngemibuzo yama-Attorney mayelana namacala asemiqoka ngokomthetho, hlola futhi uqinisekise yonke imininingwane emafayeleni, vula amafayela, acazule futhi abe imininingwane engenayo okufanele iqambe ngokulingana, buyekeza okubhaliwe nezibalo IMIBUZO Imibuzo Ebandakanya Ithhendeji: Nkosikazi. S Ndou Tel No: (021) 480 2635 Imibuzo Ebandakanya I-HR: Nk. SD Hlongwane Tel No: (012) 482 3809

xh.title: Umbhali-wamanani
xh.summary: IOfisi kaNobhalula-mphezulu yoMba wabambe-mthetho ifuna umbhali-wamanani weQqenge 12 weNkantolo Ephakamileyo yoNtshona Koloni eKapa ukulawula ungeniso lwamanani, uqinisekiso, neendawo ezikhuselekileyo zokugcina iindaba.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seQqenge 12 okanye ngesidanga esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF elinesi (4) njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mqondo wokusebenza ofunekayo. Ilayisenesi yokushayela evumelekileyo iya kubakho njengesoncedo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokulungiselela izixhobo, iinkqubo nakakhulu amandla okubhala iindaba, iingcalu zeBatho Pele kunye neendlela zokusebenza ngokwemeko yokusebenza. Unobuchule bokunxibelelwana (elibiweyo nokuvalwa ngomlomo), ezixhumanayo nakwabanye, ulwazi ngakhompyutha, inkonzo yakho fakelwa, iplani, ukuhlela, ukusombulula iingxaki, uhlalutyo kunye namakhono ezibalo. Kunye nazo ezi nzibe zemveliso: amandla okusebenza ngexesha legxixa, ukuguquguquka, ukhuthazo, ukucinga ngokucokisekileyo nokuziqhayisela.
xh.duties: Bhala iindaba kwimithi efumanekayo kwifomathi efunekayo njengakwiidathabhesi, itheyibhile, ispredishiti, qinisekisa iindaba ezilahlekileyo neziphoso ezebonwayo ngelixa kusenziwa ibhalwe iindaba, phinda ujonge uze uqinisekise onke amanani afunyenwe kwimithi, ngenisa amanani uze wenze iibhakhi aph ezidliwayo njalo kwamanani, hlaziya izitili kunye neestatistiki, gcina uze ulondoloze imithi neefayili, qinisekisa ukuba imithi neefayili zihlelwangokulungileyo zize ziphinde zikhuselwe, zincike ulwazi kwicandelo, nikeza inkxaso abantu abaqinisekisayo ngokuzisa iindaba ezifunekayo namafayili, qokelela iindawo zokubhalelana ezivela kwiofisi jikelele, yahlula iindawo zokubhalelana nama-fayili kumaRajara, thumela uze wamkele i-imeyile xa kucelwa, chaza ngokukhawuleza onke amadinga e-IT kumlawuli, nikeza nankxaso yamanye amaxesha njengoko kufunwa ngumbuso, uMphathi weNkantolo nakumlawuli uze unike ulwazi kwicandelo elibhekene nalo, gcina uze ulondoloze imithi neefayili ngendlela eshiyekelelweyo, qinisekisa ukuba onke amathinya amacala/amanxwebhe enkantolo okubhalwa kawo amanani agcinwe ngokhuselekileyo nakuzo, phendula imibuzo ye-Attorneys mayela namacala asemthethweni, phinda ujonge uze uqinisekise onke amanani afunyenwe kwiifayili, vula iifayili, hlela uze wahlule amanani asengethwayo afuna ukubhalwa ngokulinganayo, hlaziya izitili neestatistiki.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer: Mechanical (GRADE A)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 108 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (total to be structured in accordance with the rules of the OSD)
jobs.summary: Chief Engineer: Mechanical at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Gqeberha, requiring an engineering degree, ECSA registration, and six years of experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of Engineering degree (B Eng/ BSC (Eng) or relevant qualification. Six years post qualification experience. Compulsory registration with Relevant council (ECSA) as a Professional Engineer. A valid driver's license. Knowledge of mechanical engineering best practices and aspects of the building and construction environment, extensive knowledge and experience in the development, implementation and oversight of recovery plans when projects are lagging. Knowledge of PFMA, OHSA Supply Chain Management, Contract Management, good technical and innovative problem-solving abilities. Computer literacy and experience in the application of Mechanical Engineering software in the use of dashboards to track progress. Good interpersonal and negotiation skills. Applied knowledge of all Built Environment legislatives/ regulating requirements. Excellent writing and presentation skills. The ability/ willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Provide technical lead in proposal preparations, define technical resources requirements for successful work execution, perform final review and approval or audits on new engineering designs according to design principles, set maintenance standards specifications and service levels according to organisational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Compile risk logs and manage significant risk and provide technical consulting services for the operation on engineering related matters, Allocate, control, monitor expenditure according to budget, check tender documentation for inviting tenders. Monitor the performance of and exercise control over appointed consultants in connection with the design and execution of work, as well as maintenance to existing structures, infrastructure, scrutinize and approve fee accounts of consulting engineers. Mentor train and develop candidates and related technical personnel to promote skills/knowledge. Transfer. Develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning.

af.title: Hoofingenieur: Meganies (GRAAD A)
af.summary: Hoofingenieur: Meganies by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Gqeberha, wat 'n ingenieursgraad, ECSA-registrasie en ses jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n Ingenieursgraad (B Eng/ BSC (Eng) of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Ses jaar se ervaring na kwalifikasie. Verpligte registrasie by die Relevante raad (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieur. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van meganiese ingenieurswese se beste praktyke en aspekte van die bou- en konstruksie-omgewing, uitgebreide kennis en ervaring in die ontwikkeling, implementering en toesig van herstelplanne wanneer projekte agter raak. Kennis van PFMA, OHSA, Voorsieningskettingbestuur, Kontrakbestuur, goeie tegniese en innoverende probleemoplossingsvermoëns. Rekenaargeletterdheid en ervaring in die toepassing van Meganiese Ingenieurswese-sagteware in die gebruik van dashboards om vordering na te spoor. Goeie interpersoonlike en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Toegepaste kennis van alle Bou-omgewingswetgewende/regulerende vereistes. Uitstekende skryf- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Die vermoë/bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Verskaf tegniese leierskap tydens voorstelvoorbereiding, definieer tegniese hulpbronnevereistes vir suksesvolle uitvoering van werk, voer finale hersiening en goedkeuring of oudite op nuwe ingenieursontwerpe volgens ontwerpbeginsels uit, stel instandhoudingsstandaardspesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om optimale operasionele beskikbaarheid te verseker. Stel risikologs op en bestee beduidende risiko's en verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die operasie aangaande ingenieursverwante aangeleenthede. Allokasie, beheer en monitering van besteding volgens begroting, kontroleer tenderdokumentasie vir die uitnooi van tenders. Moniter die prestasie van en oefen beheer uit oor aangestelde konsultante in verband met die ontwerp en uitvoering van werk, asook instandhouding aan bestaande strukture en infrastruktuur, ondersoek en keur fooirekenings van raadgewende ingenieurs goed. Mentor, oplei en ontwikkel kandidate en verwante tegniese personeel om vaardighede/kennis oor te dra. Ontwikkel, implementeer en moniter werkstelsels en prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker.

zu.title: Injinja Ephambili: Isaysensi yamashishino (GRADE A)
zu.summary: Injinja Ephambili: Isaysensi yamashishino e Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e Gqeberha, idinga idigri yokujinja, ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA, neminyaka emithandathu yokuhluleka.
zu.requirements: Ubuncane bedigri Yokujinja (B Eng/ BSC (Eng) noma izifundo ezihambisana naleyi. Iminyaka eyisithuphu yokuhluleka ngemva kokuthola izifundo. Ukubhalisa ngokuyimaphakathi kunikela obala ebhungweni elihambisana nalo (ECSA) njengenjinja oyingcwaba. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ehamba phambili yesaysensi yamashishino kanye nezinkomba zendawo yokwakha nokuqamba, ulwazi olumgangatho futhi oluthathwa ngokuhlangenwe nayo indabuko ekuthuthukisweni, ukusetshenzisweni nasekuqapheleleni izinhlelo zokulungisa lapho amaphrojekthi ehuba. Ulwazi mayelana ne-PFMA, OHSA Supply Chain Management, Contract Management, amandla okuxazulula izinkinga ngezindlela ezinhle zesayensi futhi ezintsha. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho ekusetshenzisweni kwesoftware yesaysensi yamashishino ekusetshenzisweni kwamadashibhodi ukuze kulandelwe inqubo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu kanye nezinkulumo eziyisivumelwano. Ulwazi olusetshenziswayo mayelana nemithetho yawo wonke amazwe aseakhiwe noma okuhlongozwayo. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokuyibonakalisa. Amandla/ isifingo sokuhamba.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso sesayensi ekulungiseleleni izinkampana, chaza izidingo zamathuluzi wesayensi ukuze kuphumelele ukwenza umsebenzi, yenza ukubuyekeza kokugcina nokugunyaza noma ukuhlola izinhlelo ezintsha zokujinja ngokuhambisana nemigomo yokuhlonga, hlela imithetho yokugcina nokuqashelwa kwamazinga okuphathwayo kanye namazinga enkonzo ngokuhambisana nemigomo yenhlangano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala okuhle ekusebenzeni. Qamba amalogu okuba sengozini ulawule engozini enkulu futhi nikeza izinsiza zokuqashelwa kwesayensi ngemisebenzi ephathelene nokujinja enziwayo, Yabelile, lawula, qapha ukushiswa kwemali ngokwebajethi, hlola amadokhumenti emikhuba yokuqasha ukwenza imisebenzi. Qapha ukusebenza futhi ulawule abaluleki abakhethiwe mayelana nokuhlonga nokwenza umsebenzi, kanye nokuqashelwa kwezinto ezivele zikhona, izinto eziyisisekelo, buka futhi gunyaza izinkulu zamakhredithi abajingela. Qedisa, hlakanisa futhi thuthukisa abagijimi kanye nabantu abahlobene nesayensi ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono/ ulwazi. Dlulisela. Thuthukisa, setha futhi qapha izinhlelo zemisebenzi kanye nokuqhutywa kwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuyimphumelelo futhi okusebenzayo.

xh.title: UmLawuli weNkundla: Imishini (GRADE A)
xh.summary: Inkokheli: Umsebenzisi wemishini (GRADE A) kwiSebe loLuntu kuze kubekho iNkundla yaseGqeberha, ifuna izidanga zobunkokheli.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zobunkokheli ezingaphantsi kwezinga (B Eng/ BSC (Eng) okanye iziqu ezifanelekileyo. Iminyaka yamava emisiwe emva kokuphumelela isidanga. Ingathangathi ukubhalwa kwelungu kwiBhunga elifanelekileyo (ECSA) njengomgcini weNkundla. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi emihle yobunkokheli bemishini nakumacandelo obakhiwo bemiba yokwakhiwa, ulwazi olubanzi namava ekuphuhliseni, ukusebenziseni nasekulawuleni iinkqubo zokubuyisela iiprojekthi xa zibambezeleka. Ulwazi lwePFMA, OHSA, ulawulo lweziqendu zethutho ezilungele uluntu, ulawulo lweenkqubo zobugcisa obulungileyo nobuchwepheshe obutsha bokusombulula iingxaki. Ukuba lilungu lekhompyutha namava ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zesoftwe yobunkokheli bemishini ekusebenziseni amadashibhodi ukuze kujongwe inkqubo. Amakhono amabalisa ahlobene nokuthetha nabantu. Ulwazi ngayo imithetho yokuqwalaselwa koluntu lokwakhiwa nakumagunya alo. Ukubhalisa kakuhle nokubonisa ngeenkqubo ezifundwayo. Ukuba nakulungele ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Nika inkokelela enyanisweni kwisiqendu sobuchwephesha kulungiselelo lepropozala, chaza iimfuno zamathuba obuchwephesha ukwenza umsebenzi uphumelele, yenza ukuqwalaselwa kokugqibela kwaye uvume okanye wenze iindlela zokuvavanya kwiidisayini ezintsha zobunkokheli ngokweemvisiswano zedisayini, misela iinkqubo zobungcali bolondolozo nezidinganiso kunye namanqanaba abasebenzi ngokwezinjongo zoluntu oluqhelanayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufumaneka okusemngangathweni wokusebenza. Hlela iirekodi zeengozi zinoyingozi, zilawule kananjalo ubuchwepheshe benkokelela iinkonzo ezalathelwe kumisebenzi ehambelana nobunkokheli kwimiba enjengaloo. Yabelana, lawula, ulandele ukuchithwa kwemali ngokweyurethi, qwalasela amaxwebhu okumema abanye abantu ukuba baziphathe. Landela inkqubo yabasebenzi basebenzela uluntu, ulawule abo bagqithiswa njengabaphathi kumsebenzi ohlobene nokudweba nokwenza umsebenzi, kwanakwolondolozo kwezakhiwo ezikhoyo, nolwakhiwo lwentlalo-ntlalo, qwalasela uvume neentengiso zeemali zabaphathi bomsebenzi. Yale, khulisa, uphuhlise abaginyiyo nabantu abahlobene nobuchwepheshe ekukhuliseni amakhono/ulwazi, Dlulisa ulwazi. Phuhlisa, phumeza ulandele iinkqubo zemisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kusebenza kakuhle nangokusebenziseyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Management Accounting
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Middle Management service)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Management Accounting at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office in Pretoria, responsible for budgeting and financial management.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Accounting or Cost & Management Accounting Financial Relevant years of work experience in budgeting and financial management at a junior manager or Assistant Director equivalent level. Knowledge: Working knowledge of estimating, budgeting, cash flow management and policy, procedure and processes regarding budget management in the public service. In-depth knowledge of BAS, LOGIS and Vulindlela and ability to prepare and conduct effective decision briefs and presentations. A thorough working knowledge of the financial processes of the public service. Proficient in financial regulatory frameworks in the public sector, augmented with sound working knowledge of acquisition/procurement policies, processes and procedures. Best practice budget management skills, including the drafting and submission of decision briefs, estimates of expenditure and revenue, cash flow plans and providing sound financial advice to clients to ensure informed decisions. Abilities: Able to understand and interpret financial prescripts of the Public Service. Able to effectively apply budget policy and financial regulatory frameworks. Ability to apply forecasting models. Ability to both lead a team and work as part of a team. Accuracy and attention for details. Ability to analyse financial reports for decision-making. Effective communication and collaboration with stakeholders Capability: Demonstrate capability to interpret budget guidelines and convert them to programme guidelines, negotiation skills, data analytical skills and computer literacy. Ensure, enhance and apply the departmental system of financial management and internal control inclusive of budget preparation, budget control, reporting and financial misconduct management. Excellent analytical and numerical abilities, particularly regarding the financial management of multi-year acquisition projects, adjudication of project submissions and forecasting models.
jobs.duties: Ensure that budget and expenditure are managed in line with relevant legislation, regulations, frameworks, and departmental policies and procedures. Monitor legislative and regulatory prescripts relating to public finance management and accounting including the PFMA and Treasury Regulations to inform recommendations for amendment to financial policies and procedures where relevant and ensure compliance with National Treasury reporting requirements. Provide advice and guidance to budget managers on budget planning, expenditure estimates and forecasting methods and tools. Analyse and quality assure the financial information requirements for the evaluation budget inputs. Analyse, interpret, and communicate the Treasury Guidelines on budget processes (MTEF, ENE, AENE & Rollover). Develop templates for the collection of budget information from budget managers. Review and analyse the annual budgets and ensure alignment with the departmental annual performance plan and the strategic plan. Coordinate the preparation and consultation for the MTEF budget process. Align budget statements with the. Analyse and interpret the requirements for the annual and adjusted cash flow projections as prescribed by Treasury. Compile presentations to inform management decisions on budget planning and financial performance. Record minutes and implement resolutions on budget and expenditure management. Assess where shifting of funds/ virements are required and recommend budget adjustments. Oversee implementation of approved budget adjustments and provide feedback to the relevant components. Issue budget allocation letters and ensure reconciled ENE and AENE budget. Coordinate and consolidate roll-over submissions. Ensure that compliance requirements for budget rollover and retained surplus requests are disseminated to programme managers and in compliance with the NT guidelines. Monitor expenditure trends, assess additional funding requirements for the adjustment estimates process, and develop proposals on the virement or shifting of funds. Evaluate information on monthly reports for spending variance analysis and recommend corrective measures. Compile monthly and quarterly financial performance reports for and ensure timely submission of In- Year Monitoring Report. Compile information for the interim and annual financial statements. Manage the financial delegations and participate in the internal and external audit reviews. Coordinate the Auditor-General South Africa (AGSA) and internal audit process related to financial management. Supervise subordinates.
jobs.applications: for the position of Deputy Director: Management Accounting must be emailed to: Recruitment26-75@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /SMS-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. OTHER POSTS
