zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSomqondisi Ohlewayo: Isibalo sezezimali Sezempilo
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSomqondisi Ohlewayo: Isibalo sezezimali Sezempilo eNhlokweni Yeqhaza le-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure ePretoria, ebhekene nokuhlela isabelomali nolawulo lwezezimali.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-tertiary ezincane ezinhlobonhlobo ezithatha iminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwi-Accounting noma i-Cost & Management Accounting. Eminyakeni ehambisanayo yomhlalaphiwayo ekwenzeni isabelomali nolawulo lwezezimali ezingeni lomphathi ojongene noma osiza umqondisi ohlobene. Ulwazi: Ulwazi lokusebenza kokulinganisela, ukwenza isabelomali, ukulawula ukugibela kwemali nesinqumo, izinqubo nezinhlela eziphathelene nokulawula isabelomali emphakathini kahulumeni. Ulwazi olujulile nge-BAS, LOGIS kanye ne-Vulindlela kanye namandla okulungisa futhi uqobe izincomo zezinqumo nobeke imibhalo ephathiswayo. Ulwazi oluzinile lokusebenza ngezinqubo zezimali zomphakathi kahulumeni. Ukwazi kahle izakhiwo ezingekho emthethweni ezilawula izimali emkhakheni kahulumeni, okwandiswe ulwazi lokusebenza ngezenzo/nemigomo yokuqasha izinto, izinqubo nemithetho. Amakhono aphezulu okulawula isabelomali ngendlela ehle kakhulu, okuhlanganaye ukulunga nokuhlolwa kwezincomo zezinqumo, ukulinganisela ukuchithwa nemali engenayo, izinhlela zokugibela kwemali kanye nokunikeza izeluleko eziqinile ezingamathamsanqa ngemali ukuze kuqiniseke izinqumo ezinolwazi. Amandla: Ukwazi ukuqonda futhi uhhumushe imiyalo yezimali yomphakathi kahulumeni. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ngokuphumelelayo umgomo wesabelomali nezakhiwo ezilawula imali. Amandla okusebenzisa izinhlela zokuqagela. Amandla okuba umhola iqembu noma ukusebenza njengesigxobo seqembu. Ukuqinisekisa ukunemba nokunakisisa imininingwane. Amandla okuhlaziya imibhalo yemali ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo. Ukuxhumana ngokuphumelelayo nokusebenzisana nabahlobene nomsebenzi. Amakhono: Aubike izikhono zokuqonda imihlahlandlela yesabelomali nokuyiguqule ibe yimihlahlandlela yohlelo, izikhono zoxhumo, izikhono zokuhlaziya idatha kanye nokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Qinisekisa, ukhuphule futhi usebenzise isistimu yomnyango yokulawula imali nokulawula okwangaphakathi ehlanganisa ukulungiselela isabelomali, ukulawula isabelomali, ukubika nokulawula ubugebengu bezimali. Amandla aphezulu okuhlaziya nokuqhathanisa izibalo, ikakhulukazi maqondana nolawulo lwezezimali emikhakheni yamaphulo okuthenga iminyaka eminingi, ukuqondisisa izibhalo zamaphulo kanye nezinhlela zokuqagela.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthi isabelomali nokuqoqwa kwemali kuyalawulwa ngokuvumelana nomthetho, imithetho, izakhiwo, nemigomo kanye nezinqubo zomnyango. Qaphula imiyalo yomthetho kanye nalawo abalawula imali kahulumeni kanye nesibalo, okuhlanganisa i-PFMA kanye nemithetho yamatholikulu, ukuze kwakhiwe izincomo zokulungisa imigomo kanye nezinqubo zezimali lapho kunesidingo, futhi uqinisekise ukuvumelana nezidingo zokubika ze-National Treasury. Nikela ngeseluleko nezindlela kubaphathi besabelomali mayelana nokuhlela isabelomali, ukulinganisela izimali ezichithwayo, kanye nezindlela nezinsiza zokuqagela. Hlaziya futhi uqinisekise izinga lebhalo lemininingwane yezimali efunekayo ukuze kuqoqwe okufakwe kwisabelomali. Hlaziya, humushe, futhi uxhumanise imihlahlandlela ye-Treasury ngezingxenye zokwenza isabelomali (MTEF, ENE, AENE & Rollover). Bheqa izifanekiso ezingamathumba zokuqoqa incazalo yesabelomali kubaphathi besabelomali. Cabangisisa futhi uhlaziye izabelomali zonyaka ukuze zihambisane nenani elihle liwezinhlobo eziphumelelayo zomnyango kanye nenani elihle lezinhloso ezibalulekile. Hlehlisa ukulungiselela kanye nokuqondana ngokwenza isabelomali ngohlelo lwe-MTEF. Linganisa izinkulumo yesabelomali. Hlaziya futhi humushe izidingo zokuqagela ukugibela kwemali konyaka nangokulungiswa njengoba kuqondiswe i-Treasury. Lungisa imibhalo ephathiswayo ukuze iveze izinqumo zabaphathi ngokuhlela isabelomali kanye nokusebenza kwemali. Bhalo amaminithi futhi usebenzise izinqumo ngokulawula isabelomali nokuqoqwa kwemali. Hlola lapho kudingeka khona ukushintshwa kwemali noma ukudluliswa, futhi unicome ukulungiswa kwesabelomali. Buka ukusebenziswa kokulungiswa kwesabelomali okugunyaziwe futhi unikeze impendulo ezingxenyeni ezihlobene. Nikeza amagunya okubhalisa isabelomali futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izabelomali ze-ENE kanye ne-AENE ziyahambisana. Hlehlisa futhi uhlanganise izibhalo zokususa isabelomali sonyaka odlule. Qinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zokuvumelana mayelana nokususwa kwesabelomali kanye nezicelo ezigcinwayo zethuba elidlule zithunyelwe kubaphathi bezenzo futhi zihambisana nemihlahlandlela ye-NT. Qaphula izimpawu zokuqoqwa kwemali, hlola izidingo ezengeziwe zezimali ezengeziwe zohlelo lokulinganisela ukulungiswa, futhi ake izinhlelo mayelana nokudluliswa noma ukushintshwa kwemali. Linganisela incazalo emibhalweni yenyanga zonke yokuhlaziya inani elichithiwe futhi unqobe izinyathelo zokuqondisa. Bhalo imibiko yokuqoqwa kwemali yaminyaka yonke nango-nyaka nesikhashana futhi uqinisekise ukuthi inikwa ngokushesha i-In Year Monitoring Report. Qoqa incazalo ngemibiko yezimali yaphakathi nomyaka wonke. Lawula amandla okunikeza igunya mayelana nezimali futhi ukwazi ukuqeqesha izikhalazo ezihlobene nekhandlela langaphakathi nangaphandle. Hlehlisa inqubo yekhandlela le-Auditor-General South Africa (AGSA) nangaphakathi ngokuphathelene nolawulo lwezezimali. Qondisa abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho.

xh.title: Deputy Director: Management Accounting
xh.summary: I-Deputy Director: Management Accounting kwiNdlu Engundoqo yeDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure ePretoria, echaphazele ukucwangciswa kwemali kunye nolawulo lweemali.
xh.requirements: Iminikelo yemfundo ephakamileyo kwakhona ineminyaka emithathu yeNQF Level 06 / National Diploma kwi-Accounting okanye i-Cost & Management Accounting Financial. Iimfuno zokusebenza kwakhona zikumgangatho weNQF Level 07. Ulwazi: Ukuba ulwazi olusebenzayo lokulinganisa, ukucwangcisa imali, ukulawula ukugqithiswa kwemali kunye namacebo, iinkqubo kunye neenkqubo ezithintela ukulawulwa kwemali kwinkonzo yoluntu. Ulwazi oluphakamileyo malunga ne-BAS, i-LOGIS kunye ne-Vulindlela nokuba nakho ukulungisa nokubumba izindululo ezisebenzayo nezibonelo. Ukuba nolwazi olusebenzayo oluchanekileyo malunga neenkqubo zemali zenkonzo yoluntu. Ukuba Nakho ekubeni ulawulo lwemigaqo-sikhokelo yemali kwicandelo likawonke-wonke, olunyukela nolwazi olusebenzayo malunga namacebo, iinkqubo namathango okuthenga. Amabom awo ngamathambo, kuquka nokubumba nokunikela izindululo ezineenkcukacha malunga nokuchithwa kwemali, iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokwenza iimali, namacebo abakho. Iimfuno zokuba namava okusebenza njengomphathi okanye ongumncedisi weDirector ekuqwalaselweni kweekhondo ezahlukeneyo zemali kunye nolawulo lweemali. Ikhono: Ukuba nakho ukuqonda nokutolikwa iimiyalelo yemali zenkonzo kaWonke-Wonke. Ukuba nakho ukusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo amacebo eemali kunye nemiqathango yolawulo. Ikhono lokusebenzisa iindlela ezimele ukubikeka. Ikhono lokulawula iqela labantu nokuba setyenzini. Ukuba nothando lokwenza izinto ngokuchanekileyo nokuchaziweyo. Ikhono lokuhlola iinxalenye zemali ukuze kwenziwe izindululo. Unxibelelwano olusebenzayo kunye nobudlelwane nabantu. Ikhono: Ukubonisa ukuba nakho ukuqonda amagqabantshintshi eemali ukuze uyiguqule ibe ngamagqabantshintshi eenkqubo, amava okuxoxa, amava okuhlola ulwazi kunye nokuba nolwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Ukuba nakho ukugxininisa ukusetyenziswa kwamacebo kaSebe kwaye ulawule iinkalo zemali ezahlukeneyo ezinexesha elide, uxwebhu lwemali kwimisebenzi, nokubikeka. Ikhono elibalulekileyo lokuhlola iinxalenye zemali, ngokukodwa malunga nokulawulwa kweekhondo ezahlukeneyo zokuthenga eminyaka emininzi, ukubeka iinkqubo kunye neendlela ezimela ukubikeka.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba umgangatho weedindlela nokuchithwa kwemali kulawulwa ngokwemithetho, iimithetho, iinkqubo, namacebo esebe. Lilindelela imithetho nemiqathango ehilelekela ulawulo lwemali yoluntu nobungcali bee-akhawunti kuquka i-PFMA namathango eTreasury ukuze nikwazi ukunika izindululo malunga nokulungiswa kwamacebo namathango eemali apho kufunekayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwamkelwa kwemfuno yokubika kwase-National Treasury. Nikela izindululo namacebo abaphathi bemali malunga nokucwangciswa kwemali, ukulinganisa ukuchithwa kwemali, iindlela namathongo okubikeka. Hlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ikhwalithi yolwazi malunga neemali olufunekayo ukulinganisa izifiki zemali. Hlola, ulandule, uze unike ulwazi malunga namaQondo eTreasury malunga neenkqubo zemali (i-MTEF, i-ENE, i-AENE & i-Rollover). Bhala iitempleyiti zokuqokelela ulwazi ngemali kwabaphathi bemali. Phinda uhlole ulungelelanise imali yonyaka nokwamkelwa kwesebe ngomgangatho womnyaka weplani yokusebenza neyolwakhiwo. Lungiselela inkqubo yokubika okanye kuvakalisho ngokucwangciswa kwemali ye-MTEF. Lungiselela amashishini eemali ngoku. Hlola ulandule imfuno yomgangatho weprojekthi yemali yonyaka nokuqwalaselwa njengoko kuchaziwe yiTreasury. Hlanganisela izibonelo ukunikela izindululo abaphathi malunga nokucwangciswa kwemali nokusebenza kolwazi lwemali. Bhala imizuzu yokuqwalaselwa nokusebenza kwemiqulu yamagqabantshintshi. Qinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu okubika i-In-Year Monitoring Report abhalwa ngokuchanekileyo, abe esethunyelwa ngexesha. Bhala iinxalenye zeemali ezingatshitshiywa nokulawulwa okulula kwabaphathi. Lungiselela iinkqubo zokuqwalaselwa kwemali yaLuntu nabantu balawula iinkalo zamanye amanani. Phatha iinkqubo zomanyano nemiyalelo esuka kwindawo entsha ukuya kwindawo edala, ukuqwalaselwa kweziqendu zomanyano namacebo abakho. Phatha iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zolawulo lweemali kuquka i-delegations, ukubeka iinkqubo ezikumgangatho weemali, ukubika iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zolawulo, nokulawula imigibe yemali. Lilindelela iinkqubo ezihamba phambili nokubakho kolunye ulwazi lwemali xa kunokwenzeka kusetyenziswa iindlela ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed in Pretoria to manage state property utilisation, verify property details, maintain PMIS, and liaise with stakeholders.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Real Estate Management Services, Property Management, Town and Regional Planning. Relevant years of experience in property management and Property Management Information System (PMIS). A valid driver’s license and must be prepared to travel. Knowledge of Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA); Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Broad- Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE), Property Law, Treasury Regulation. Knowledge of the Property Management Information System (PMIS) and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) will be an added advantage. High degree of computer literacy, good communication and interpersonal skills, Report writing skills, analytical skills, Accounts and Numerical Skills. Ability to work under stressful conditions.
jobs.duties: Conduct physical verification to ensure that state owned properties are utilized efficiently and optimally. Verify property details and maintain the Property Management Information System (PMIS). Keep track of developments in property management trends. Liaise with all relevant stakeholders and units to ensure that property information is captured correctly and in good time. Ensure State properties are adequately secured to prevent illegal occupation and vandalism and take rectification action where necessary. Take measures against unlawful occupations. Identify and ensure properties to be cleared of overgrown vegetation and to clear fire breaks. Liaise with all spheres of Government (s) in respect of property related matters. Negotiate with potential tenants and conclude lease agreements in line with the requirement of PFMA, Treasury Regulations and other prescripts and policies of the Department. Manage the implementation of the conditions of lease agreements, particularly regarding contract milestones. Carry out debt management functions. Conduct budget for the unit. Investigate the utilization potential of State properties. Attend relevant committees in the performance of your duties. Undertake site visits and conditions surveys to determine utilization potentials. Participate in the letting-out process of the Department. Facilitate the processing and issuance of relevant documentation in respect of land development applications and landowners’ consent by the delegated authority. Ensure the optimal utilization of State properties. Facilitate cost determinations and verifications. Identify superfluous State-owned property for disposal. Supervise employees to ensure effective delivery service. General supervision of employees. Allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by supervisees. Assist in the preparation of reports to top management and all relevant stakeholders. Liaise with client departments to ensure optimal utilization of State-owned properties and to determine their needs and reserve properties to Client departments. Supervision of staff and management performance.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Benutting en Kontrak
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig in Pretoria om staats eiendomsbenutting te bestuur, eiendomsbesonderhede te verifieer, PMIS te onderhou, en met belanghebbendes te skakel.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Real Estate Management Services, Property Management, Town and Regional Planning. Relevante jare van ervaring in eiendomsbestuur en die Property Management Information System (PMIS). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en moet bereid wees om te reis. Kennis van die Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA); Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Broad- Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE), Property Law, Treasury Regulation. Kennis van die Property Management Information System (PMIS) en Geographic Information Systems (GIS) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Hoë mate van rekenaarvaardigheid, goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, Verslagskryfvaardighede, analitiese vaardighede, rekeningkundige en numeriese vaardighede. Vermoë om onder stresvolle toestande te werk.
af.duties: Doen fisiese verifikasie om te verseker dat staatseiendom doeltreffend en optimaal benut word. Verifieer eiendomsbesonderhede en onderhou die Property Management Information System (PMIS). Hou tred met ontwikkelinge in eiendomsbestuurstendense. Skakel met alle relevante belanghebbendes en eenhede om te verseker dat eiendomsinligting korrek en betyds vasgelê word. Verseker dat staats eiendom voldoende beveilig is om onwettige okkupasie en vandalisme te voorkom en neem regstellende stappe waar nodig. Neem maatreëls teen onwettige okkupasies. Identifiseer en verseker dat eiendomme van oorgroeiende plantegroei skoongemaak word en brandgange skoongemaak word. Skakel met alle sfere van die Regering(s) rakende eiendomsverwante aangeleenthede. Onderhandel met potensiële huurders en sluit huurooreenkomste aan ooreenkomstig die vereistes van PFMA, Tesourieregulasies en ander voorskrifte en beleide van die Department. Bestuur die implementering van die voorwaardes van huurooreenkomste, veral rakende kontrakmylpale. Voer skuldbestuursfunksies uit. Stel die begroting vir die eenheid op. Ondersoek die benuttingspotensiaal van staats eiendomme. Woon relevante komitees by in die uitvoering van u pligte. Ondernem werfbesoeke en toestandopnames om benuttingspotensiale te bepaal. Neem deel aan die verhuringsproses van die Department. Fasiliteer die verwerking en uitreiking van relevante dokumentasie rakende grondontwikkelingsaansoeke en grondeienaars se toestemming deur die gedelegeerde gesag. Verseker die optimale benutting van staats eiendomme. Fasiliteer kostebepalings en verifikasies. Identifiseer oortollige staatsbesit eiendom vir beskikking. Outelei werknemers om doeltreffende dienslewering te verseker. Algemene toesig oor werknemers. Wys pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur toesigdragendes gelewer word. Bied hulp by die voorbereiding van verslae aan topbestuur en alle relevante belanghebbendes. Skakel met kliënt departemente om optimale benutting van staatsbesit eiendomme te verseker en om hul behoeftes te bepaal en eiendomme vir kliënt departemente te reserveer. Toesig oor personeel en bestuursprestasie.

zu.title: Onozinti Osizi: Ukusetshenziswa Nesevisi Yasekhishini
zu.summary: Kudingeka Onozinti Osizi ePretoria ukuze aphathe ukusetshenziswa kwempahla kahulumeni, aqiniseke imininingwane yempahla, agcine i-PMIS, axhumane nabalayelo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sonyaka wezifundo wesikhathi esingu-three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Real Estate Management Services, Property Management, Town and Regional Planning. Umkhulu weminyaka yomuzwa ekuphathweni kwempahla naku-Property Management Information System (PMIS). Ilayisensi yokushayela eliyiso futhi kumele alungele ukuhamba. Ulwazi nge-Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA); Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Broad- Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE), Property Law, Treasury Regulation. Ulwazi nge-Property Management Information System (PMIS) kanye ne-Geographic Information Systems (GIS) kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ikhono elikhulu lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okuxhumana kahle nabantu kanye nobudlelwano obuhle, amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okuhlaziya, amakhono e-Accounts kanye namakhono ezibalo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinenginkinga.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuqinisekisa okubonwayo ukuze qinisekiswe ukuthi izimpahla ezinikwe uhulumeni zisetshenziswa ngokusebenza kahle nangokugcwele. Qinisekisa imininingwane yempahla futhi ulugcine i-Property Management Information System (PMIS). Landela izinto ezisha ngezindlela ezisha ekuphathweni kwempahla. Xhumana nabalayelo abasondelene namayunithi ukuze qinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi ngempahla lutholwa ngokufanele nangesikhathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimpahla zikahulumeni zivikelekile kahle ukuvikela ukuthathwa ngaphandle komthetho nokubhalulelwa futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Thatha izinyathelo ngokuhlolwa kwabantu abahlala ngaphandle komthetho. Qapha futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhlanzwe izinhla ezikhulele kakhulu ezimpahleni futhi kuhlanze izibambo zemililo. Xhumana namaphiko onke kahulumeni mayelana nezindaba ezihlobene nempahla. Xoxisana nabathengi abangaba khona uphoqe izivumelwano zasesikhishini ngokuhambisana nesidingo se-PFMA, Treasury Regulations kanye nemiyalo nemigomo yesinye nesikhungo. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezimo zezivumelwano zasesikhishini, ikakhulukazi mayelana nezinqameli zesivumelwano. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha izikweletu. Yenza isabelo somntwana womsebenzi. Phenyaisisebenziseki kwempahla yomphakathi. Hlanganyela kumakomidi ahlobene ekwenzeni imisebenzi yakho. Thatha ukuvakashela izinkalo ukuze uhlole isisebenziseki. Hlanganyela ekuyeni kwesikhungo. Yenza kube lula ukucubungula nokukhishwa kwemibizo ephathelene nezicelo zokuthuthukiswa komhlaba nesivumelwano sabanikazi bomhlaba ngamandla abekwe esikhundleni. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okugcwele kwempahla yomphakathi. Yenza kube lula ukucaciswa nokuyiwaqinisekisa imali. Qapha ukuthi kuyiphi impahla yomphakathi ezele ukuthi ithengiswe. Qapha futhi ulawule abasebenzi ukuze qinisekiswe ukulethwa kwesevisi ngokusebenza kahle. Ukulawula ngokuvamile kwabasebenzi. Yaba imisebenzi futhi wenze ukulawula ikhwalithi kulokhu okulethwe ngabantu abalawulwayo. Siza ekulungiseni imibiko kubaphathi abaphezulu nabalayelo abasondelene. Xhumana namaphiko abakhasimende ukuze qinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa okugcwele kwempahla yomphakathi futhi uqinisekise izidingo zawo uze ugcine impahla kwamaphiko abakhasimende. Ukulawula abasebenzi nokuqapha ukusebenza ngokusebenza kahle.

xh.title: Siza lownoLawuli: uLuliSebenziso neKontrakti
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNkululeko yoncedo ePretoria ukulawula ulawulo oluNgunye oluvunyelweyo KarhuUmntu, ukusetyenziswa kolawulo kokuLawula kwePahla, ukuba ziyi iNkundla neeNkcukacha ezingafakwanga kwaye KweNyukulu yamaDabi eKoloLawuLo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNqanaba lesithathu NQF Level 06 okanye i National Diploma kwi Real Estate Management Services, Property Management, Town and Regional Planning. Iiminyaka yamava echanekileyo ekulawulweni kwempahla nakwi Property Management Information System (PMIS). Ilayisensi yokuqesha eyasebenzayo kwaye kufuneka ulungele ukuhamba. Ulwazi ngama Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA); Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Broad- Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE), Property Law, Treasury Regulation. Ulwazi nge Property Management Information System (PMIS) ne Geographic Information Systems (GIS) luya kuba lusizo. Ukusebenza kakuhle ngekhompyutha, amakhono obuNthunywa obuLula kunye nabantu, amakhono okubhala iingxelo, amakhono oNtsingoziwo, amakhonyo eAccount, amakhono eBali. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza phantsi kweemeko ezinomingqa.
xh.duties: Yenza isiqinisekiso sobungakanani ukuzeqinisekisa ukuba izinto zikawoluntu ezisezandleni karhulumente zisetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo nangokufanelekileyo. Qinisekisa iinkcukacha zempahla zigcinwa kwaye zihlolwe ngononophelo kwi Property Management Information System (PMIS). Landela ngokuchanekileyo iindlela ezitsha ekulawulweni kwempahla. Xhumana nabathintekayo nakwiwo onke amagumbi ukuzeqinisekisa ukuba iinkcukacha ngempahla zibhalwe ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba izinto karhulumente ziyivikelwa kakuhle ukuze kungangenwa ngemigaqo nakubonakaliswe ngendlela ebiyo kwaye uthathe izigqibo zolungiso apho kufuneka khona. Yenza iinyameko ngokuchasene nokungangenwa ngemigaqo. Batya iimpahla ezifanele ukuba zicutyiwe ithiinti ekhulayo kwaye wenze iindlela zokutshisa. Xhumana namaphiko onke karhulumente ngemiba enamanQlanahleEmpahla. Xoxisela nabanQlanelwe ukubQana nabo Qugqibelela iinkqubo zokubQana ngokuQhamQa kwiinkQubo ze PFMA, Treasury Regulations nezinye iinkqubo neenkqubo zesebe. Lawula ukuSetyenziswa kweemiQaqambele yoFakelo bhala, ngokukQOkqo kwemigangatho yekontrakti. Phatha imisebenzi yokulawula amatyala. Lungiselela iNgcwele yoFakelo phakathi kwesebe nakumazwe angaphandle. Phengula iNgcwele yolonQulo olukhoyo. Qalisa imisebenzi yefotiyo. Qeqesha abasebenzi nabaQashi abatsha abaQashiyo.

Manage laboratory data, records and technical reporting. Supervise, mentor and develop laboratory personnel. Provide technical support and promote continuous improvement. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van water- en afvalwaterkwaliteitstoetsingsbeginsels, analitiese metodologieë, monsternemings- en monsterhanteringsprosedures, laboratoriumkwaliteitsversekering en -beheerstelsels, laboratoriumgesondheid en -veiligheid, wetenskaplike metodologieë, toepaslike wetgewing en regulatoriese vereistes, laboratoriumtoerusting en -instrumentasie, data-analise en -interpretasie, tegniese verslagskrywing en rekenaargesteunde wetenskaplike toepassings. Kennis van program- en projektebestuur, finansiële en hulpbronbestuur, personeelsbestuur en prestasie-ontwikkeling sal 'n voordeel wees. Die volgende bevoegdhede word vereis: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; tegniese en analitiese vaardighede; professionele oordeel; besluitneming; probleemoplossing; beplanning en organisering; kommunikasie; rekenaarvaardigheid; personeelsbestuur; konflikbestuur; veranderingbestuur; klieënsfokus en reaksievermoë; en aandag aan besonderhede.
af.duties: Bestuur en toesig oor die daaglikse bedrywighede van die Water Testing Laboratory. Bestuur en oorsien waterkwaliteitstoetsing en analitiese dienste. Implementeer en handhaaf laboratoriumkwaliteitsbestuurstelsels. Bestuur laboratoriumtoerusting, chemikalieë, reense en verbruikbare items. Verseker laboratoriumgesondheid, -veiligheid en regulatoriese nakoming. Bestuur laboratoriumdata, -rekords en tegniese verslagdoening. Toesig hou oor, mentor en ontwikkel laboratoriumpersoneel. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en bevorder deurlopende verbetering. Bestuur en koördineer laboratoriumbeplanning en tegniese bestuur. Bestuur die verkryging en beskikbaarheid van laboratoriumverbruikbare items, reense en toerusting.

zu.title: Ithekinisiyane Yesayensi EsiQondisayo (GRADE A): Ukulingwa Kwamanzi
zu.summary: Qondisa imisebenzi yebhofisi lokulinga ikhwalithi yamanzi futhi uphathe izinsizakulo zokuqonda izinto, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zekhwalithi e-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-tertiary zeminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwi-Water Care Science noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-6 yokusebenza ngokobuchwepheshe/esayensi emva kweziqu ekulingweni kobuhle bentutho, emisebenzini nakwisayensi yamanzi kanye namantutho. Ukubhaliswa ngamagunya ku-SACNASP njengoba kwakudityaniswa kwesiCience seSazisi. Isiqiniseko sokushiywa kwesihawu kwefowuni ye-Water Care Science noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-6 yokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe/ngezensi emva kweziqu ekuvivinyweni kwekwalithi yamanzi, emisebenzini yenkqubo yokuqeda amanzi namantutho kumatshini wobuchwepheshe. Ukubhaliswa njengomuntu oku-SACNASP njengo-Certificated Natural Scientist kuyadingeka. Idrayiva elungile. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-6 yokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe nge-sayensi emva kweziqu ekulingiseni ikhwalithi yamanzi, ekusebenzeni nasekuqedeni amanzi kanye namantutho. Ukuqeqeshwa noma ukuphathwa kwebhofisi lokulinga ikhwalithi yamanzi, okuhlanganisa ikhwalithi yebofu lokulinga kanye nokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi, izindlela zokuqonda izinto, ukuthatha amanzi namantutho nokulingwa kwawo, izinsiza zebhofisi lokulinga, ama-reagents kanye nezinto ezisetshenziswa, ukuphathwa kwedatha nekubika ngokobuchwepheshe, kuzobe yinikezelo elingezela inzuzo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngamazinga okulinga ubuhle bentutho kanye namantutho, izindlela zokuqonda izinto, ukuthatha izampula kanye nendlela yokuphatha izampula, izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi kanye nokuqinisekisa ukulawula ibhofisi lokulinga, impilo kanye nekhwalithi yebhofisi lokulinga, izindlela zesayensi, imithetho ehambisanayo kanye nezidingo zomthetho, izinsiza zebhofisi lokulinga kanye namathuluzi okuhlola, ukuhlaziya idatha kanye nokuqonda, ukubika ngokobuchwepheshe kanye nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zesayensi ezisekelwe kwiakhomputha. Ulwazi ngohlelo kanye nokuqondwa kweprojekthi, ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye namaphrojekthi, ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kokusebenza kahle kuzobe yinikezelo elingezela inzuzo. Lawa mahono adingekayo: Ikhono lokubona kabanzi nokuqondisa; amakhono obuchwepheshe nokuqonda izinto; isibalo esihle sokwahlulela; ukuthatha izinqumo; ukuxazulula izinkinga; ukuhlela futhi ulungelelanise; ukuxhumana; ukusebenzisa ikhakhomputha; ukuphatha abantu; ukuphatha izingxabano; ukuphatha ushintsho; ukugxila kumthengi futhi uphendule; kanye nokunakisisa imininingwane.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi qondise imisebenzi yansuku zonke ye-Water Testing Laboratory. Phatha futhi lawula ukuhlolwa kokulingana kwamanzi nezinsizakalo zokuhlola. Yenzise futhi gcina izinhlelo zokuphathwa kokulingana kwebhofisi lokuhlola. Phatha izisetshenziswa, amakhemikhali, ama-reagents nokusetshenziswa okujwayelekile ebhofini lokuhlola. Qinisekisa impilo, ukuphepha nobuhambelayo bamakhemikhali kanye nokuhambisana nemithetho ebhofini lokuhlola. Phatha idatha yebhofisi lokuhlola, amarekhodi nokubika ngokobuchwepheshe. Qondise, fundisa futhi thuthukise basebenzi bebofu lokuhlola. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe futhi khuthaza ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo. Phatha futhi huhlela icandza lokuhlola futhi lawula ubuchwepheshe bebofu lokuhlola. Phatha ukuthenga nokuboneka kwamakhemikhali amakhemikhali, ama-reagents kanye nezinsiza zokusebenza zebhofisi lokuhlola

xh.title: Control Scientific Technician (GRADE A): Water Testing
xh.summary: Lawula amaxwebhu amanzi kwaye ulawule izixhobo ezi-3 kunye namaxwebhu e-Project Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
xh.requirements: A maxaka a-A amaningi amanzi a-nqamle a-akulutsha (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwi-sayensi yamanzi noma nqamle e-fanelekileyo. A amaminanga a-6 aPHEZULU kwamava e-teknical/sayensi kwinkqubo yamanzi, amanzi kunye namaza a-wastewater. A amanzi e-SACNASP njengombono o-Natural Scientist. A license yomshishi wamanzi. Amava e-supervision ekuphathweni kwelaboratori yokuvavanya amanzi, aquka i-laboratory quality assurance nemaphethelo, i-analytical methods, amanzi kunye nokusampula kwakho-wastewater, i-laboratory equipment, i-reagents kunye namagama, imiphathi ye-data kunye ne-technical reporting, kuya kuba yinto e- added advantage.
xh.duties: Lawula uphondo lemisebenzi yansuku zonke yelaboratori yoVavolwa lwamanzi. Lawula uphendlo lweemveliso kunye neziko lamanzi kunye namachwithi e_ANALYTICAL. Qonda uLawulo oluPhambili koluntu olunesiseko se-pedagogical.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Internal Audit
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Internal Audit at the Mthatha Regional Office, conducting audit, risk management and governance processes for the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
jobs.requirements: minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Auditing/Accounting. Internal Audit Technician (IAT)/Professional Internal Auditor (PIA). Practicing Internal Auditor with appropriate years of experience as a senior internal auditor /Internal auditor. Registration with the Institute for Internal Auditors. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge of Global Internal Audit Standards, National Treasury Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Institute of Internal Auditors Code of Ethics, phases of internal audit process, Departmental business systems and processes, Departmental policies and procedures, best practices regarding systems of risk management, internal control and governance processes, accounting standards. Proficient computer literacy, numeracy, advanced communication (verbal and written), language and linguistic skills, project management skills. Report writing skills, organization and co-ordination, interpersonal skills, negotiation skills, analytical thinking, interviewing skills, ability to assess and analyse information and make relevant findings, problem solving skills, ability to influence others, conflict management, integrity, tenacity, dedication, honesty, objectivity, diligence, avoid conflict of interests in performing duties. Exercise prudence with confidential information, innovation, adaptability and creative. Solution orientated ability to design ideas without direction. Ability to work under stressful situations and against deadlines. Must be prepared to travel and expected to work overtime. Must be prepared to disclose impairments to their independence or objectivity. Security clearance.
jobs.duties: Conduct audit, risk management, internal control and governance processes; supervise audit fieldwork and collect relevant, sufficient and useful audit evidence. Assess and evaluate audit evidence, ensure the development of audit working papers, ensure conclusions on audit findings, develop draft and final internal audit reports. Ensure the provision of administrative functions of Internal Audit component; ensure co-ordination in the administration of the office and office management systems. Examine financial and operating records and reports through audit programmes, ensure that controls over record-keeping and reporting are adequate and effective. Reconcile financial reports with reconciliation statements to ensure accurate record of transactions. Review and ensure compliance regarding policies, plans, procedures, legislation and regulations, review systems established to ensure compliance. Confirm the existence and use of the asset register, verify the physical existence of the assets, utilize appropriate audit procedures in verifying the assets, appraise the economy and efficiency with which the resources are employed. Review operations/programmes to ascertain whether results are consistent with established goals and objectives, establish whether operations are carried out as planned, and submit findings and recommendations to the component. Supervise employees.
jobs.applications: for the position of Assistant Director: Internal Audit must be emailed to: RecruitMTH26-21@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /SMS-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Interne Oudit
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Interne Oudit by die Mthatha Streekkantoor, wat oudit-, risikobestuur- en bestuursprosesse vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure uitvoer.
af.requirements: Minimum drie-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Auditing/Accounting. Internal Audit Technician (IAT)/Professional Internal Auditor (PIA). Praktiserende interne ouditeur met toepaslike jare ervaring as 'n senior interne ouditeur /interne ouditeur. Registrasie by die Institute for Internal Auditors. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van Global Internal Audit Standards, National Treasury Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Institute of Internal Auditors Code of Ethics, fases van die interne ouditproses, departementele besigheidsisteme en -prosesse, departementele beleide en prosedures, beste praktyke rakende stelsels van risikobestuur, interne beheer en bestuursprosesse, rekeningkundige standaarde. Bevoeg in rekenaargeletterdheid, syfergeletterdheid, gevorderde kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), taal- en taalkundige vaardighede, projekbestuursvaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede, organisasie en koördinasie, interpersoonlike vaardighede, onderhandelingsvaardighede, analitiese denke, onderhoudvoervaardighede, vermoë om inligting te assesseer en te analiseer en toepaslike bevindings te maak, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, vermoë om ander te beïnvloed, konflikbestuur, integriteit, volharding, toewyding, eerlikheid, objektiwiteit, ywer, vermy belangenbotsings by die uitvoer van pligte. Omsigtigheid met vertroulike inligting toepas, innorasie, aanpasbaarheid en kreatiwiteit. Oplossingsgerigte vermoë om idees sonder rigting te ontwerp. Vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede en teen sperdatums te werk. Moet bereid wees om te reis en word verwag om oortyd te werk. Moet bereid wees om beperkings van hul onafhanklikheid of objektiwiteit te openbaar. Sekuriteitsklarering.
af.duties: Voer oudit-, risikobestuur-, interne beheer- en bestuursprosesse uit; hou toesig oor oudit-veldwerk en versamel toepaslike, voldoende en bruikbare ouditbewyse. Assesseer en evalueer ouditbewyse, verseker die ontwikkeling van ouditwerkdokumente, verseker gevolgtrekkings oor ouditbevindings, ontwikkel konsep- en finale interne ouditverslae. Verseker die voorsiening van administratiewe funksies van die Interne Oudit-komponent; verseker koördinasie in die administrasie van die kantoor en kantoorbestuurstelsels. Ondersoek finansiële en bedryfsrekords en -verslae deur middel van ouditprogramme, verseker dat beheer oor rekordhouding en verslagdoening voldoende en doeltreffend is. Herfinansier finansiële verslae met rekonsiliasie-verklarings om 'n akkurate rekord van transaksies te verseker. Hersien en verseker nakoming rakende beleide, planne, prosedures, wetgewing en regulasies, hersien stelsels wat ingestel is om nakoming te verseker. Bevestig die bestaan en gebruik van die bate-register, verifieer die fisiese bestaan van bates, gebruik toepaslike ouditprosedures by die verifiëring van bates, beoordeel die ekonomie en doeltreffendheid waarmee hulpbronne aangewend word. Hersien bedrywighede/programme om vas te stel of resultate in ooreenstemming is met gevestigde doelwitte en oogmerke, bepaal of bedrywighede soos beplan uitgevoer word, en dien bevindings en aanbevelings by die komponent in. Hou toesig oor werknemers.

zu.title: Umuntu ongumncedi weSikhundla: Ukulinganisa Ngaphakathi
zu.summary: Umuntu ongumncedi weSikhundla lokulinganisa ngaphakathi eMthatha Regional Office, ophatha inqubo yokulinganisa, ulawulwa kwezingozi kanye namanye amaqiniso e-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphezulu kukanqaka emva kweminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kokulinganisa nasekuqotheni. Internal Audit Technician (IAT)/Professional Internal Auditor (PIA). Ukulingisa njengomlingisi wangaphakathi oneminyaka eminingi yomuzwa njengomlingisi ophakeme wangaphakathi /omlingisi wangaphakathi. Ukubhalisa kwi-Institute for Internal Auditors. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi nge-Global Internal Audit Standards, National Treasury Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Institute of Internal Auditors Code of Ethics, izingxenye zesigaba sokulinganisa ngaphakathi, izinhlelo zomsoco noma inqubo zomnyango, izinhlela zomnyango nemiyalo yaso, izindlela ezinhle ngokulawulwa kwezingozi, ulawulo lwangaphakathi nokuqoqwa kwamaqiniso, izinga lokubala. Ukuzazi kahle kwesikhombi, ukubala, ukuxhumana ngokuthuthukiswa (ngokuthi ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe), amakhono olimi kanye nolimi, amakhono okuphathwa komqondo wesibonelo. Amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukuhlelwa nokuhlanganiswa, amakhono okubudiliza abantu, amakhono okuxoxisana, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, amakhono okubuzisa abantu, ikono lokuhlola kanye nokuhlaziya ulwazi futhi wenze iziphetho ezifanele, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ikono lokukhuthaza abanye, ukuphatha izingxabhano, ukuzipatha kahle, ukuma ngokubambekile, inkinga, ukuqotho, ukuzithoba, ukuzipatha ngokweqiniso, ukukhathalela imisebenzi, ukugwema izinkinga ezithintelwe ekwenzeni imisebenzi. Ukugcina ulwazi oluyimfihlo ngokuqaphela, ukuvuselela, ukuzivumelanisa nokudala. Ikono lokuma ngokombono wokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphandle kokwaziswa. Ikono lokusebenza ezimeni ezinodlame nasekuhambeleni nesikhathi esimisiwe. Kufanele ukulungele ukuhamba futhi kulindeleke ukusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi esivunyelwe. Kufanele ulungele ukwembula izinkezo ezingawenzeli ukuzimela noma ukubuka izinto ngokungabhandlwa. Ukucaciswa ngokuphepha.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukulinganisa, ukulawula izingozi, ulawulo lwangaphakathi nokuqoqwa kwamaqiniso; ukuqapha umsebenzi wangasese wokulinganisa ukuze uthole iziqiniseko ezifanele, ezanele futhi ezibusisayo. Ukubuka futhi ukulinganisela iziqiniseko, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kwakhiwa amaphepha okulinganisa, ukuthi kubhaqwe iziphetho, ukuthi kwakhiwe imibiko yokulinganisa okungukama ngaphakathi. Ukwenza inqubo yokusebenzela ngokuphathwa kolwazi kolwandle ngaphakathi komnyango; ukuqinisekisa ukubambisana ekuphathweni kohhovisi nasezinhlelweni zokuphathwa kohhovisi. Ukubuka amarekhodi wezimali nokuqhuba imibiko ngezinhlela zokulinganisa, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulawulo ekugcineni nasekubhaleni imibiko luhambelana futhi lusebenza. Ukulinganisela imibiko yezimali nemibiko yokulinganisela ukuba ibhalwe ngokuchanekile. Ukubuka futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela izinhlela, izenzo, imithetho kanye namalungu, ukubuka izinhlela ezingeniselwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela imithetho. Ukusiza ekuboniseni ukuthi ukhona yini futhi usetshenziswa yini ihhovisi lemininingwane, ukuqinisekisa ukuba khona kwempahla, ukusebenzisa izinqubo ezifanele zokulinganisa ekubukeni impahla, ukuhlola isimali kanye nokusebenza kwezinsizakalo. Ukubuka imisebenzi/izinhlelo ukuze ubone ukuthi iziphetho ziyahambisana nemigomo nenhlelomgomo, ukubona ukuthi imisebenzi iyenziwa njengokuhlelwe, futhi usethe iziphetho nezindlela ezingcono. Ukuphatha abasebenzi.

xh.title: i-Assistant Director: Internal Audit
xh.summary: i-Assistant Director yeNdzilo yoQobo loLawulo eMthatha Regional Office, ezenza iinkqubo zokuhlola, zolawulo loyingo nobulungeleko kwi-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sobuchwepheshe esingaphantsi kweenyanga ezintathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwi-Auditing/Accounting. Iat/Professional Internal Auditor (PIA). Practicing Internal Auditor oneminye iminyaka egqithisiweyo yamava njengomhloli ophakamileyo wangaphakathi /Internal auditor. Ukubhalisa kwi-Institute for Internal Auditors. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi nge-Global Internal Audit Standards, i-National Treasury Regulations, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Institute of Internal Auditors Code of Ethics, amanqanaba enkqubo yokuhlola ngaphakathi, iinkqobo zoshishino zesebe, iinkqubo namagqabantshiyesi asebe, iinkqubo ezilungileyo ezimalunga nenkqubo yolawulo loyingo, lolawulo lwangaphakathi nobulungele, iinkqubo ezitolikayo njengesixa esibalulekileyo solwazi, lolawulo lwangaphakathi nobulungele, iinkqobo zokuhlela izimali nenhlahlalo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amanani, iindlela zothetha nokuqamba (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo), iimpawu zolwimi, izakhono zolawulo lweenkqubo. Izakhono zokubhala iingxelo, ulawulo nokuqondanisa, izakhono zoxhumano nabantu, izakhono zokuxoxisana, i-thinking analysis, izakhono zokupholisha, ikhono lokulinganisela nokuhlola ulwazi nokwenza iziphumo ezifanelekileyo, izakhono zokusombulula iingxaki, ikhono lokomeleza abanye, ulawulo lweengxaki, inkathazo, inkxaso, inyaniso, into ethanda into ethanda, ukuzinza, ukuphepha iingxaki ezithintelweyo ekuweni imisebenzi. Zwezela ukuqonda ngolwazi oluyimfihlo, iinkqubo ezintsha, ukuzivumela nokwenza izinto. Ikhono lokubakho ngaphandle kokulawuleka kokwenza iinkqubo zokusombulula iingxaki. Ikhono lokusebenza kwiimeko ezinzima nangokuchasana neemigibe. Kufuneka alungiselelwe ukuhamba ajonge ukusebenza ngaphezu kweenyanga ezimisiweyo. Kufuneka alungiselelwe ukutyhila iingozi ezikumda ukuzimela okanye ukuzinza. Isiqinisekiso sokhuseleko.
xh.duties: Qhuba iinkqubo zokuhlola, zolawulo loyingo, lolawulo lwangaphakathi nobulungele; lawula umsebenzi wendawo yokuhlola ukuze uqoke ubungqina obubalulekileyo, obaneleyo obusebenzayo. Linganisela ukuze ulinganise ubungqina bokuhlola, qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kwamaphepha okusebenza okuhlola, qinisekisa izigibo ezimayela nemitapo yolwano yokuhlola, phuhlisa iingxelo ezityhiliweyo nezigqityiweyo zokuhlola lwangaphakathi. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwemisebenzi yolawulo lolawulo lwesithundithundu seNdzilo yoQobo loLawulo; qinisekisa ukuqondaniswa kulawulo lweofisi nasekweni inkqubo yolawulo lweofisi. Phonononga irekhodi neengxelo zezimali nokuqhutywa kwezoshishino ngeenkqubo zokuhlola, qinisekisa ukuba kulawulo olwaneleyo nolusebenzayo kugcinwo kwerekothi nakubika. Qondanisa iingxelo zezimali nengxelo yokuqondanisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukugcinwa okuchanekileyo koshishino. Phinda uqinisekise ulandelo ngemigaqo, iiplan, iinkqubo, umthetho nemigaqo, phinda ujonge iinkqubo ezisungulweyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulandelo. Qinisekisa ukubakho nokusetyenziswa kwesiksi samaxhosa, qinisekisa ukubakho kobomi bezinto eziyimo, sebenzisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokuhlola ekuqinisekiseni izinto, linganisa ukugcinwa kwezimali nentsebenzo enokusetyenziswa ngayo imithobo. Phinda ujonge ukusebenza/eenkqubo ukuze uqinisekise ukuba iziphumo ziyahambelana neenjongo ezisungulweyo, qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi iyenziwa njengoko kulungiweyo, uze unikeze iziphumo neengcebiso kwisithundithundu. Lawula abasebenzi.

jobs.summary: Senior Internal Auditor role at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, requiring a diploma in Internal Auditing or Accounting and relevant auditing experience.

Treasury Regulations. Public Finance Management Act. Institute of Internal Auditors Code of Ethics. Possession of an Internal Audit technician (IAT) and or Professional Internal Audit Technician (PIAT) qualification will be an added advantage. Identify and analyse critical risks from the Department’s Risk Management plan that requires Internal Audit Activity focus and the controls put in place to mitigate them. Establish risk-based plans to determine the priorities of the IAA consistent with the organisation’s goals. Align the operational plan to the overall objectives of the organisation. Provide inputs in the development of Internal Audit Operational plan. Determine focus areas for IA activities. Determine IA scope in relation to the scheduled assignments. Allocate resources to planned audit assignments. Establish the timing of performance of the audit assignments. Determine the reporting requirements and deadlines. Perform activities of the IAA at each level of operation to ensure that they are consistently performed in accordance with the IIA’s standards. Conduct reviews as per approved annual plan and/or approved ad hoc requests. Identify process weaknesses and provide appropriate recommendations for improvement. Monitor the implementation of recommendations by management. Report on the internal audit Activity’s engagement findings and conclusions. Provide Secretarial services to the audit and Risk Management. Committee of the Department. Render administrative support services. Administer the co-sourcing activities within the Directorate. Ensure the effective flow of information and documents to and from the office. Ensure the safekeeping of all documentation in the office in line with relevant legislation and policies. Obtains inputs, collates and compiles reports, e.g. progress reports, monthly reports and management reports. Respond to enquiries received from internal and external stakeholders. Collect, analyse and collate information requested by superiors. Ensure that travel arrangements are well coordinated. Manage the leave register and telephone accounts for the unit. Handle the procurement of standard items like stationery, refreshments etc. for the activities for the manager and the unit.

af.title: Senior Interne Auditeur
af.summary: Senior Interne Ouditrol by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, wat 'n diploma in Interne Ouditering of Rekeningkunde en toepaslike ouditeringservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n drie-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 06)/ Nasionale Diploma in Interne Oudit/Rekeningkunde. Toepaslike jare van ervaring in die veld in Ouditering. Registrasie by die Instituut vir Interne Auditeurs. Sekuriteitsklaring. Kennis van die IOA Handves. IOA Metodologie. IOA Standaarde. Standaarde vir Professionele Praktyk van Interne Ouditering. Tesouriereëlings. Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet. Instituut van Interne Auditeurs se Kode van Etiek. Besit van 'n Interne Oudit tegnikus (IOT) en/of Professionele Interne Oudit Tegnikus (PIOT) kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Gevorderde Ouditproses en geassosieerde fases Departementele besigheidsisteme en prosesse. Departementele beleide en prosedures. Rekeningkundige standaarde. Spanmaat Oudit-sagteware. Vaardighede: Gevorderde kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Gevorderde verslagskrywing. Organisasie en koördinasie. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Onderhandeling. Analitiese denke. Vermoë om inligting te assesseer en te ontleed en toepaslike bevindings te maak. Rekenaar geletterd. Wees in staat en voorbereid om onder druk te werk. Wees 'n spanspeler. Wees kreatief en in staat om aan besonderhede aandag te gee. Vermoë om binne 'n spesifieke tydraamwerk te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf insette by die ontwikkeling van Interne Oudit Strategiese Planne. Identifiseer en ontleed kritieke risiko's uit die Departement se Risikobestuursplan wat Interne Oudit-aktiwiteitsfokus vereis en die kontroles wat in plek gestel is om dit te vermig. Stel risikogebaseerde planne op om die prioriteite van die IOA te bepaal wat in ooreenstemming is met die organisasie se doelwitte. Lijn die operasionele plan aan met die algemene doelwitte van die organisasie. Verskaf insette by die ontwikkeling van die Interne Oudit Operasionele plan. Bepaal fokusareas vir IO-aktiwiteite. Bepaal die IO-omvang in verband met die geskeduleerde opdragte. Allokeer bronne aan beplande ouditopdragte. Bepaal die tydsberekening van die uitvoering van die ouditopdragte. Bepaal die verslagdoeningsvereistes en sperdatums. Voer aktiwiteite van die IOA uit op elke vlak van werking om te verseker dat dit konsekwent uitgevoer word in ooreenstemming met die IIA se standaarde. Voer hersienings uit ooreenkomstig die goedgekeurde jaarlikse plan en/of goedgekeurde ad hoc-versoeke. Identifiseer prosesswakheides en verskaf toepaslike aanbevelings vir verbetering. Monitor die implementering van aanbevelings deur bestuur. Rapporteer oor die interne Oudit-aktiwiteit se betrokkenheidsbevindings en gevolgtrekkings. Verskaf sekretariële dienste aan die oudit- en Risikobestuurskomitee. Van die Departement. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Administreer die mede-bron aktiwiteite binne die Direktoraat. Verseker die doeltreffende vloei van inligting en dokumente na en van die kantoor. Verseker die veilige bewaring van alle dokumentasie in die kantoor in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en beleid. Verkry insette, kolligeer en stel verslae op, bv. vorderingverslae, maandelikse verslae en bestuursverslae. Reageer op navrae wat van interne en eksterne belanghebbendes ontvang is. Versamel, ontleed en kolligeer inligting wat deur meerderes aangevra word. Verseker dat reisreëlings goed gekoordineer is. Bestuur die verlofregister en telefoonrekeninge vir die eenheid. Hanteer die verkryging van standaarditems soos skryfbehoeftes, verversings ens. vir die aktiwiteite vir die bestuurder en die eenheid.

zu.title: i-Senior Internal Auditor
zu.summary: Indima ka-Senior Internal Auditor e-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e-Pretoria, edinga isidanga se-diploma kwi-Internal Auditing noma i-Accounting kanye nalolu hlelokusebenza lokuhlola oluhlelekile.
zu.requirements: Izidingo: Kumele kubekhona isidanga somkhakha wezamabanga aphakeme (NQF Level 06) seminyaka emithathu/ National Diploma kwi-Internal Auditing/Accounting. Iminyaka ethile yemfundo ngomkhakha wokuqashwa kokuqapha. Ukubhaliswa kwi-Institute for Internal Auditors. Isiqiniseko sokuphuma esigabeni. Ulwazi nge-IAA Charter. Indlela yokusebenza ye-IAA. Izindingo ze-IAA. Izindingo zomsebenzi we-Professional Practice of Internal Auditing. I-Treasury Regulations. I-Public Finance Management Act. I-Institute of Internal Auditors Code of Ethics. Ukuba nesidanga se-Internal Audit technician (IAT) kanye noma i-Professional Internal Audit Technician (PIAT) kuzoba yihle. Inqubo ephakeme yokuhlola kanye namaphuzu ahlobene nalawo. Izinhlelo namaphuzu emikhakha yomnyango. Amapholisi kanye nemithetho yomnyango. Izindingo zokubalwa kwezimali. I-Team-mate Audit Software. Amakhono: Unobuntu ekuxoxweni (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukuqamba amabiki aphakeme. Ukuhlela kanye nohlelo. Amakhono onke abantu. Ukuze abhekane nabantu. Ukucabanga okuhlaziya. Ikhono lokubuka futhi uhlaziye imininingwane bese ukha iziphetho ezifanele. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngokwemikhumbi. Ukwazi futhi ukuzijwayeza ukusebenza phansi koxanduva. Ukuba ngumuntu osebenza ngokomkhakha. Ukuba nomcabango othile kanye nokuqapha izinhlamvu. Ikhono lokusebenza kwesikhathi esinqunywe.
zu.duties: Nikela ngeminikelo ekuthuthukiseni Amaphuzu Ekuqondisa Okubheke Phambili Ekuhlolweni Kwangaphakathi. Hlola futhi uhlaziye izingozi ezibalulekile ezitholakala kuHlelo Lokuphathwa Kwezingozi Lomnyango, ezidinga ukugxila kokuQashwa Kokuqapha Kwangaphakathi kanye nezilawuli ezisetshenziselwa ukunciphisa lezo zingozi. Misela amaphuzu okuhlela ngokususelwa ezingozini ukuze kunqunywe izinto ezibaluleke kakhulu kuQashwa Kokuqapha Kwangaphakathi, okuhambisana namaphuzu ahlose umkhakha. Hlanganisa indlela okusebenza ngayo nendima ezime ngayo namaphuzu ohlelo lumelayo. Nikela ngeminikelo ekuthuthukisweni koHlelo Lwemisebenzi Yokuqapha Kwangaphakathi. Qinisekisa izindawo okumele kugxilwe kuzo ekwenzeni imisebenzi Yokuqapha Kwangaphakathi. Qinisekisa icala lohlelo lokusetshenziswa okuhlelwe ngalo. Yabelana ngemithombo yasimboni ohlelweni lokuhlola. Misela isikhathi sokwenza imisebenzi yokuhlola. Qinisekisa imithesho yokubika nemikhawulo. Yenza imisebenzi yeQashwa Kokuqapha Kwangaphakathi kwalezona zinga zonke zokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iyenziwa ngokuhambisana nemithesho ye-IIA. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngokohlelo lweminyaka yonke oluvunyiwe noma izicelo ezingahleliwe ezivunyiwe. Hlola izithena ezingase zibe khona ekusebenzeni futhi unikeze izincomo ezifanele zokuthuthukiswa. Qapha ukuphathwa kwezincomo abaphathi. Bika ngemiphumela kanye nesiphetho senqubo yokuhlola. Nikela amasevisi abhalwe ongikwazi ohlelweni lokuhlola kanye nokuPhathwa Kwezingozi Ehlelweni Lomnyango. Nikela ngamasevisi okwesekela okuphathwayo. Phatha imisebenzi yokuhlanganisa imithondo yokusebenza ngaphakathi kolegalimu. Qinisekisa ukugeleza kweminingwane namadokhumenti esiya futhi evela ohhofisini. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kokuphepha kwawo wonke amadokhumenti ohhofisini ngokuhambisana nomthetho kanye namapholisi ahlobene. Thola iminikelo, qoqa futhi uhlele imibiko, njengemibiko yequbhejana, imibiko yenyanga zonke kanye namabiko okuphathwa. Phendula imibuzo etholakala kubandakanyekile bakhuphe kanye nabangaphakathi. Qoqa, hlaziya futhi uqoqa imininingwane eceliwe ngabaphezulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuhamba zihlelwe kahle. Phatha umhlahlando weholo kanye ne-akhawunti zocingo zeYunithi. Phatha ukuthenga izinto ezijwayelekile njengesihlahla sombhalo, iziphuzo njll. emisebenzini yomphathi kanye neYunithi.

xh.title: Senior Internal Auditor
xh.summary: Isithuba somQondi oPhakamileyo ongaphakathi kwi-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure ePretoria, efuna idiploma kwi-Internal Auditing okanye i-Accounting kunye namava odithi ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Iyonke i nqanaba lesithathu lemfundo ephakamileyo (NQF Level 06)/ National Diploma kwi-Internal Auditing/Accounting. Iminyaka engowona yokulingana emmandla we-Auditing. Ubinda kwii-Institute for Internal Auditors. Isiqinisekiso sokhuseleko. Ulwazi nge-IAA Charter. Iindlela zokusebenza ze-IAA. Amagqabantshintshi e-IAA. Amagqabantshintshi eNkonzo yeNgcali yoQonda olungaphakathi. Ii-Treasury Regulations. UMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente. Ikhodi yokuziphatha ye-Institute of Internal Auditors. Ukuba nengeno nange资质 I-Internal Audit technician (IAT) okanye i-professional Internal Audit Technician (PIAT) iya kuba lusango oluluncedo. Iindlela eziphambili ze-Odithi namaphulo ayo. Iinkqubo nezinqubo zesebe namacebo esebe. Imigaqo nendlela zokusebenza yesebe. Amagqabantshintshi e-Accounting. I-Team-mate Audit Software. Amakhono: Unxibelelwano oluphambili (oluthethwayo nolubhalwayo). Ukubhala iingxelo eziphambili. Uqoqosho nolungelelwaniso. Amakhono obudlelwane nabantu. Iingxoxo. Okucinga ngeyokuhlaziya. Amandla okulinganisa ngeyokwahlaziya ulwazi kwaye wenze iziphumo ezifanelekileyo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nakulungelelana nokusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo. Ukuba ngumntu othanda ukusebenza nabantu. Ukuba nomdla wokuyila kwaye ukwazi ukunaka iinkcukacha. Amandla okusebenza kwixesha elithile.
xh.duties: Nika izinto ezithunyelwe kwiphulo lokwakha iindlela zokuqonda ezingaphakathi ezicwangcisiweyo. Phawula kwaye uhlaziye iingozi ezibalulekileyo kwindlela yoLawulo lweengozi yesebe eadinga ukugqithiswa kuqonda kumsebenzi ongaphakathi kunye nezithintelo ezisiweyo ukunciphisa ezo ngingozi. Seka iindlela ezingesisigqibo sezingozi ukuze umiswe izinto eziphambili ze-IAA ezihambelana namaphupu echweba. Yiba ngokuhambelana iplano yokusebenza namaphupu apheleleyo echweba. Nika izinto ezithunyelwe kwiphulo lokwakha iplano yokusebenza yoQonda olungaphakathi. Misela iindawo ezijongwe kumisebenzi ye-IA. Misela ummandla we-IA unxulumene nomsebenzi ocwangcisiweyo. Sabela izabelo kwimisebenzi ye-odithi ecwangcisiweyo. Misela ixesha lokwenza imisebenzi ye-odithi. Misela iimfuno zokubika nemihla yokupheliswa. Yenza imisebenzi ye-IAA kwinqanaba ngalinye lokuqhuba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba iyenziwa ngokuhambelana namagqabantshintshi e-IIA. Qamba iingqondo njengoko kucwangciswe kwiplano yonyaka egunyaziweyo okanye izicelo ezivela ngaphandle ezigunyaziweyo. Phawula iintsingiselo zenkqubo unike izindululo ezifanelekileyo zokuphucula. Lilulela ukusetyenziswa kwezindululo ngabaphathi. Bika ngeziphumo kunye neendawo ezifunyanisweyo kumsebenzi woQonda olungaphakathi. Nika iinkonzo zokuba ngum蜡ebi we Komiti ye-odithi kunye noLawulo lweengozi yesebe. Nikeza iinkonzo zoqxathululo. Lawula imisebenzi yokubambisana namanye amaqela ngaphakathi kweQela. Qinisekisa ukusasazwa kwexesha elilungeleleenyo lwemaxwebhu asiya kwaye esivela kwindlu. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwamaxwebhu onke ofisini ngokuhambelana namthetho nemigaqo ephathelene nokuloo nto. Fumana izinto ezithunyelwe, uqokelele kwaye udibanise iingxelo, umzekelo iingxelo zendlela, iingxelo zenyanga kunye neengxelo zabaphathi. Phendula imibuzo efunyanwayo kubantu abahambelanayo abangaphakathi nangaphandle. Qokelela, hlaziya kwaye udibanise ulwazi oluceliweyo ngabaphezulu. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwamacebo okuhamba kakuhle. Lawula irejista yokuphumla kunye nama-akhawunti efowuni yeqela. Phatha ukuthengwa kwezinto ezisetyenziswa njengengowona, njengezixhobo zokubhala, ukutya nokunye ukwenzelwa imisebenzi yomphathi neqela.
