af.title: Senior Personeelpraktisyn: Werwing en Beplanning
af.summary: Senior Personeelpraktisyn-rol by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, met die fokus op werwings- en HR-beplanningsprosesse.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06)/ Nasionale Diploma in Human Resource Management of 'n verwante studieveld. Toepaslike jare se werkervaring in Menslike Hulpbronne-werwing. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis: Standarde, praktyke, prosesse en prosedures wat verband hou met HR-werwing. Struktuur en funksionering van die departement, Public Service Act en Regulasies. Employment Equity Act. Kennis van PERSAL. Basic Condition Act. Public Finance Management Act. Besoldigingskodes. Konflikbestuur. Projekbestuur. Vaardighede: Geletterdheid in wiskunde. Interpersoonlike en diplomatieke vaardighede. Adviesvaardighede. Toesighoudende vaardighede. Algemene administratiewe en organisatoriese vaardighede. Rekenaargebruik. Analitiese denke. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kommunikasie- en verslagdoeningsvermoëns. Persoonlike eienskappe: Kreatief. Vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk. Vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer. Mense-georiënteerd, Stiptheid, Selfversekerd, Ywerig, Selfgemotiveerd, Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Fasiliteer en implementeer die advertensieproses. Ontvang en implementeer personeelversoekvorms en motivering vir poste wat geadverteer moet word. Fasiliteer die opstel van advertensies. Implementering van werwings- en seleksieprosesse. Hou rekord van aansoeke. Sortering van ontvangde aansoeke. Verseker ontwikkeling van aansoekerprofiele. Fasiliteer die uitnodiging van gekortelysde aansoekers. Verteenwoordig Menslike Hulpbronne tydens kortlysskepping en onderhoude van gekortelysde aansoekers. Kommunikeer met suksesvolle aansoekers. Verifieer resultate, sertifkate en kwalifikasies. Fasiliteer die opstel van aanstellingsbriewe. Fasiliteer persoonlike beplanningsvereistes. Stel, onderhou en kommunikeer die menslike hulpbronplan. Onderneem die menslike hulpbronassesserings soos voorgeskryf. Bevorder die bereiking van indiensnemingsgelykheid en ondersteun die indiensnemingsgelykheidsplan. Bly op hoogte van veranderinge in indiensnemingswetgewing en verseker dat verwante HR-prosesse daarmee in lyn gebring word. Supersiseer werknemers om doeltreffende dienslewering te verseker. Wys pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur toesigtiges gelewer word. Adviseer en lei toesigtiges met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk. Bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van toesigtiges. Verseker dat alle toesigtiges opgelei en ontwikkel word om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te kan lewer.

zu.title: Umphathi WeNdlu Yabasebenzi Osemthethweni: Ukubumba & Ukuhlela
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi weNdlu Yabasebenzi Esemthethweni e Department of Public Works and Infrastructure ePretoria, sigxile ekubumbeni abasebenzi nakumanqubo e-HR Planning.
zu.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06)/ National Diploma in Human Resource Management or related field of study. Appropriate years of working experience in Human Resource Recruitment. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge: Standards, practices, processes and procedures related to HR Recruitment. Structure and functioning of the Department, Public Service Act and Regulations. Employment Equity Act. Knowledge of PERSAL. Basic Condition Act. Public Finance Management Act. Codes of Remuneration. Conflict Management. Project Management. Skills: Numeracy. Interpersonal and diplomacy skills. Advisory skills. Supervisory skills. General administration and organization skills. Computer utilization. Analytical thinking. Problem solving skills. Communication and report writing abilities. Personal Attributes: Creative. Ability to work under stressful situations. Ability to communicate at all levels. People Orientated, Punctuality, Assertive, Hard-working, Self- motivated, Ability to work independently.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi usebenzise inqubo yokushaya izikhangiso. Wamukela futhi usebenzise amafomu okucela abasebenzi kanye nesimo sokuba amaphuzu okushaywa izikhangiso. Qondisa ukubhalwa kwesikhangiso. Ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokubumba nokukhethwa. Gcina irekhodi lezicelo. Bahlukanise izicelo ezitholwe. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemibhalo yonkwenzwayo. Qondisa ukumemwa kwabafaka izicelo abakhethiwe. Mela Imisebenzi Yabantu ngesikhathi sokukhethwa nokuxoxwa ngokubuzwa imibuzo nabafaka izicelo abakhethiwe. Thintana nabafaka izicelo abaphumelele. Qinisekisa imiphumela, izitifiketi namagezu. Qondisa ukuhlanganiswa kwamagweme abekwayo. Qondisa izidingo zokuhelelwa komuntu. Hlanganisa, zigcine futhi wazise iholo elifakiwe bantu. Yenza okuhlonzwa ngomsebenzi wabantu njengoba kuqanjwe. Phakamisa ukufeza ibhalanso yomsebenzi futhi useke ihlelo lebhulansi. Gcina ulwazi olusha ngemithetho yomsebenzi futhi uqinisekise ukuba inqubo yokuhlelela ihambisana nayo. Qondisa abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwemisebenzi ngempumelelo. Abawise imisebenzi futhi wenze ukulawula izinga emsebenzini okulethwe ngabaseduze. Lulele futhi uhole abaseduze mayelana nakho konke okuphathelene nomsebenzi. Phatha ukusebenza ngokugqama nokulawula, nokuxwayisa kwabaseduze. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abaseduze bafundiswa futhi bathuthukiswa ukuze bakwazi ukuletha umsebenzi ozingeni elidingekayo ngokusebenza ngempumelelo.

xh.title: Umprathisi Ophakamileyo wabasebenzi: Ukuqesha & Uplani
xh.summary: Indima yomprathisi ophakamileyo wabasebenzi kwisebe lezoQhagamshelwano zikaRhulumente nakoKwakhiwa ePretoria, ijolise kwindlela zokuqesha nezicwangciso ze-HR.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwamaxesha amathathu esi fundweni saseyunivesithi (NQF Level 06)/ National Diploma kwabasebenzi bamathuba abanjelwe ngokwemigaqo yendalo. Iminyaka elungileyo yokusebenza ngokuqesha kwabasebenzi bamathuba abanjelwe ngokwemigaqo yendalo. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Izinga, iindlela, iinkqubo nemithetho ngokusesweni ngokuhambelana namathuba abanjelwe ngokwemigaqo yendalo. Ukulungelelaniswa nokusebenza kweSebe, umthetho wezeNkonza zikaRhulumente nemiGaqo. Umthetho woQeqesho ngokulinganisa abantu. Ulwazi ngePERSAL. Umthetho weMimoya yokuQhelaniswa neMeko. Umthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente. Ikhodi zoVuzo. Ukuqhelaniswa neengozi. Ukuqhelaniswa neenkqubo. Amakhono: Ukuqonda izibalo. Amakhono okuchaneka abantu kwaye unomdla wokuziphatha. Amakhono okunceda. Amakhono okulawula. Amakhono obunkqonkqo bokusingatha ngokubanzi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda ngokucoca ngokubanzi. Iindlela zokuzonakalisa. Amakhono okuthetha nokubhala iingxelo. Iinkcazelo zomntu: Umdla wokwenza. Isiqendu sokusebenza ngomzimba ophezulu. Isiqendu sokuthetha kuzo zonke iindlela. Umdla wokuzinika abantu, ukufika ngexesha, ukuzimisela ngokugqithisileyo, ukusebenza nzima, ukuzimisela, isiqendu sokusebenza ngokuzimela.
xh.duties: Yenza kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zokwenza iindaba. Yamkela kwaye usebenzise iifomu zesicelo sabasebenzi nengqineliselo yezithuba eziza kuqhankqadlwa. Yenza inkqubo yokubhala iindaba. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuqesha nokukhetha. Phatha iirekhodi zesicelo. Ukuhlela izicelo ezifunyenweyo. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kweeprofayile zabafaki isicelo. Yenza inkqubo yokumema abafaki isicelo abakhethiweyo. Mela abasebenzi bamathuba abanjelwe ngokwemigaqo yendalo ngelixa kukhethwa kunye nangaphezulu nabafaki isicelo abakhethiweyo. Thetha nabafaki isicelo abaphumeleleyo. Qinisekisa iziphumo, izatifikethi nezifundo. Yenza ukuqokelelwa kwamagama okuqeshwa. Yenza iinkqubo zesicatshulwa sabasebenzi. Qokelela, gcina kwaye uxoxe ngendlela yeplani yabasebenzi bamathuba abanjelwe ngokwemigaqo yendalo. Yenza imikhawulo yabasebenzi bamathuba abanjelwe ngokwemigaqo yendalo njengoko kumiseliwe. Khuthaza ukuphumelela kwabasebenzi bamathuba abanjelwe ngokwemigaqo yendalo kwaye uxhase iplani yokulinganisa abantu basebenza bamathuba abanjelwe ngokwemigaqo yendalo. Gcina ulwazi ngotshintsho kwimithetho yokulinganisa abantu basebenzi bamathuba abanjelwe ngokwemigaqo yendalo kwaye uqinisekise ukuba iinkqubo ze-HR ezahlangene nazo zihambelana nayo. Lawula abasebenzi ukunqinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Misela imisebenzi kwaye usebenzise olu lawulo olusanda lwenziwa ngabasebenzi abalawulwayo. Nika ingcebiso kwaye ukhokele abasebenzi abalawulwayo ngakumbi ngokuphathelele konke okusemgangathweni. Lawula ukwenza umsebenzi, ukuziphatha nokulawula kwabasebenzi abalawulwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abasebenzi abalawulwayo baqeqeshiwe kwaye baphuhliswe ukuba bakwazi ukubonelela ngomsebenzi olinganiselweyo ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant (INTER-GOVERNMENTAL Relations)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Personal Assistant providing secretarial and diary management support for inter-governmental relations at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Secretarial, Public Management, Public Administration, Business Management, Management, Office Support, Management Assistant or related as recognised by SAQA. In addition, the incumbent must have: Relevant years of experience in office administration, as a clerk, assistant officer or administrative assistant. A valid driver's license. An understanding of policies and procedures, governance/secretarial protocol generally, document management and archiving, planning, organising, and coordinating. Good computer skills, report writing, time management, and minute-taking skills should be the strengths of those aspiring for this appointment. A good understanding of financial matters. Skills in communication, interpersonal relations, and Microsoft Office. Organisational, budgeting, financial management, time management, planning, problem-solving, decision-making, technical proficiency, and leadership skills.
jobs.duties: The Personal Assistant will prioritise and schedule appointments, meetings and conferences and alert to appointments. In addition, the incumbent will: Act as a first point of contact, dealing with correspondence and phone calls. Managing diaries and organising meetings and appointments. Manage access control to the manager/executive. Booking and arranging travel, transport and accommodation. Organising events and conferences. Reminding the manager/executive of important tasks and deadlines. Typing, compiling and preparing reports, presentations and correspondence. Managing databases and filing systems. Implementing and maintaining procedures/administrative systems. Liaising with staff, suppliers and clients. Collating and filing expenses. Conducting research and write reports on behalf of the manager. Skills: Basic analytical and problem-solving skills, strategic thinking, and project management capabilities. Strong communication skills (including advanced report writing and presentation skills) and interpersonal skills. Research skills. Proven planning and organising skills, with proficiency in research and financial analysis. Personal Attributes: The incumbent must be efficient, discrete, flexible, self-motivated, organised, proactive and a good communicator. Advanced-level skills in Word for Windows and Microsoft PowerPoint. And at least an intermediate-level knowledge of Microsoft Excel. An added advantage will be proficiency in report writing and management of sensitive and high- profile stakeholders.
jobs.applications: for the position of Personal Assistant must be emailed to: Recruitment26- 77@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /SMS-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent (INTER-GOVERNMENTAL Relations)
af.summary: Persoonlike assistent wat sekretariële en dagboekbestuurondersteuning vir intergoerumentele betrekkinge by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure se hoofkantoor in Pretoria verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Sekretariële, Publieke Bestuur, Publieke Administrasie, Besigheidsbestuur, Bestuurswese, Kantoorondersteuning, Bestuursassistent of verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. Daarnaas moet die ampsdraer beskik oor: Relevante jare se ervaring in kantooradministrasie, as 'n klerk, assistentbeampte of administratiewe assistent. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n Begrip van beleide en prosedures, bestuurs-/sekretariële protokol in die algemeen, dokumentbestuur en argivering, beplanning, organisering en koördinering. Goed rekenaarvaardig, verslagskryf, tydbestuur en notuleneemvaardighede moet die sterk punte wees van diegene wat vir hierdie aanstelling hoop. 'n Goeie begrip van finansiële aangeleenthede. Vaardighede in kommunikasie, interpersoonlike betrekkinge en Microsoft Office. Organisatoriese, begrotings-, finansiële bestuurs-, tydbestuurs-, beplannings-, probleemoplossings-, besluitnemings-, tegniese bevoegdheids- en leierskapsvaardighede.
af.duties: Die persoonlike assistent sal afsprake, vergaderings en konferensies prioritiseer en skeduleer, asook herinner aan afsprake. Daarnaas sal die ampsdraer: As eerste kontakpunt optree en korrespondensie en telefoonoproepe hanteer. Dagboeke bestuur en vergaderings en afsprake organiseer. Toegangsbeheer tot die bestuurder/uitvoerende beampte bestuur. Reisaanbiedings vervaardig, asook vervoer en akkommodasie reël en bespreek. Gebeurtenisse en konferensies organiseer. Die bestuurder/uitvoerende beampte aan belangrike take en sperdatums herinner. Verslae, aanbiedings en korrespondensie tik, saamstel en voorberei. Databasisse en lêerstelsels bestuur. Prosedures/administratiewe stelsels implementeer en in stand hou. Met personeel, verskaffers en kliënte skakel. Uitgawes versamel en lê. Navorsing doen en namens die bestuurder verslae skryf. Vaardighede: Basiese analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede, strategiese denke, en projekbestuursvermoëns. Sterk kommunikasievaardighede (insluitend gevorderde verslagskryf- en aanbiedingsvaardighede) en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Navorsingsvaardighede. Bewese beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, met bevoegdheid in navorsing en finansiële analise. Persoonlike eienskappe: Die ampsdraer moet doeltreffend, diskreet, buigsaam, selfgemotiveerd, georganiseerd, proaktief en 'n goeie kommunikeerder wees. Gevorderde vlak-vaardighede in Word for Windows en Microsoft PowerPoint. En ten minste intermediêre vlak-kennis van Microsoft Excel. 'n Bykomende voordeel sal bevoegdheid in verslagskryf en bestuur van sensitiewe en hoëprofiel-belanghebbendes wees.

zu.title: Isekeli Loqunde (Izinhlobonhlobo Zokusebenzisana phakathi Kahulumeni)
zu.summary: Isekeli Loqunde onikeza inkxaso yokwazisa kanye nokuphatha idayari yezinhlobonhlobo zokusebenzisana phakathi Kahulumeni eNdiwandeni yezaMsebenzi Kazwelonke nokuQashwa Izinto eNtengiselwano ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi kwamathathu eminyaka yezifundo eziphakeme (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kusezimweni zokwazisa, eziphathwa Kahulumeni, ezolawula kahulumeni, eziphathwa yizinhlangano, ekulawulweni, ekuwesekeleni ofisini, ukwesekela ekulawuleni noma okuhlobene njengokuhlonishwa i-SAQA. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lowo owayo kufanele abe nokuqondana kweminyaka ekulawulweni ofisini, njengomkhulu ohlinzeka ngomsizi, ofisa wesikhundla noma umkhulu ohlinzeka ngomsizi. Ifayidi yokushayela ehlotshiwe. Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo nendlela yokwenza izinto, imithetho yokwazisa / isiko lezinhlelo, ukuphatha amafayela nokuqwashisa imibhalo, ukucubungula, ukuhlela, kanye nohlelo lokulawula emisebenzini. Ubucbe bokusebenza ngokwesibhamu, ukubhala imibiko, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nobucbe bokubhala imibiko emihlanganweni kufanele kube amandla alowo ofuna le simo. Ukuqonda okuhle ngezindaba zama-finansiyali. Amandla ekuxhumeni, ekuqhathaneni nobuhlobo, kanye nokuMicrosoft Office. Ubucbe bokulawula nenhlangano, ukwabiya amaholo, ukulawula ama-finansiyali, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukucubungula, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ukukwazi kwesibhamu, kanye namandla okuba ngumholi.
zu.duties: Isekeli Loqunde uza kuqamba futhi alungiselele izinhlelo zomhlangano, imihlangano kanye nemihlangano futhi alule ngemihlobiso. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lowo owayo uza ku: Yiba ngumuntu wokuqala ongathinteka, ekwenziseni ukubhala namakholi. Ukuphatha idayari nokuqamba imihlangano kanye nezinhlelo zomhlangano. Ukulawula ukungena komnikazi wezimiso / qhaza. Ukubhukha kanye nokulungiselela ukuhamba, ukuthutha nokuhlala. Ukuqamba imicimbi nemihlangano. Ukukhumbuza umnikazi wezimiso / qhaza ngemisebenzi ebalulekile nasemikhawulweni. Ukuthayiphela, ukuthumela imibiko ekuxhumeni nokulungiselela imibiko, imibhalo yaphesheya kanye namakholi. Ukuphatha izinhlaka zemibhalo nemikhando yamafayela. Ukufaka kanye nokugcina izinqubomgomo / izimiso zokuphatha. Ukuxhumana nabasebenzi, abanikezeli namakhasimende. Ukuqoqa kanye nokufaka imali ekhokhwayo. Ukwenza ucwaningo kanye nokubhala imibiko ngaleso cele. Amandla: Amandla amsulwa wokuhlolisisa kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukucabanga ngokuhlolisisa, kanye namandla okuphatha iphrojekthi. Amandla amakhulu okuxhumana (kuhlanganise namandla aphezulu okubhala imibiko kanye nezinkomba ezingezansi) kanye namandla okuxhumana nabantu. Amandla okucwaninga. Amandla abonwayo ekuqambeni kanye nokuqambeni, ngokukwazi kokucwaninga kanye nokuqonda ama-finansiyali. Izici Zomuntu: Lowo owayo kufanele abe omsebenzi kahle, abe nesiqu, aflexibhile, izimotivheyithi zakhe, ahlele kahle, abe nothando lokwenza izinto ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kanye nokuba ngumuntu ongumxhumi omkhulu. Amandla aphezulu ngezinga kuWord for Windows kanye neMicrosoft PowerPoint. Kantsi ngesikhathi esingangenwa ngaso, ukwazi okungenaphakathi kokuMicrosoft Excel. Ithuba elivezwe kakhulu liza kuba ukwazi ukubhala imibiko kanye nokuphatha izakhamuzi eziyindaba eziyimfihlo kanye neziphakeme.

xh.title: Umncedi (Izinto ze-Ndibaniselwano phakathi koRhulumente)
xh.summary: Umncedi onika inkxaso yemisebenzi yobungosekela nolawulo lwe-dairei kwizinto zendibaniselwano phakathi koRhulumente kwiNtloko eNkulu yeSebe lezaSebenzo zoLuntu nezeMpahla ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sezifundo eziphakamileyo esingaphantsi kweminyaka emithathu (i-NQF Level 06) / i-National Diploma kwi-Secretarial, i-Public Management, i-Public Administration, i-Business Management, i-Management, i-Office Support, i-Management Assistant okanye nakwinto enye ephathelene nayo njengoko kuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Ngaphezu koko, lowo ube kule sithuba kufuneka abe nayo: Iminyaka ethile yamava kulawulo le-ofisi, njengomsebenzisi, njengomncedi wolungiselelwo okanye njengomncedi wolawulo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo nemithetho, i-protocol yolawulo/eyobungosekela ngokubanzi, ulawulo lwamaxwebu nolugcino lwamaxwebu, uqulunqo-lwakho, uqeqesho-lwakho, nolungelelwaniso-lwakho. Iakhono eliliso kakhulu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha, ekubhalweni kwiingxelo, ekulawuleni ixesha, nasekuthathweni kwamaminithi kufuneka zibe ziiqwalaselo zabo bagqibeleyo ukuba bafumane le nqumlomsebenzi. Ukuqonda kakuhle ngemiba yemali. Iakhono ekunxibelelaneni, ekubudiseni nabantu, nasekusetyenzisweni kwe-Microsoft Office. Iakhono lolulawulo, lwejejwe, lolawulo lwezimali, lolawulo lwexesha, loqulunqo-lwakho, lokusombulula iingxaki, lokwenza iigqibo, lembiko-tekhnoloji, nolawa.
xh.duties: Umncedi uza kuqwalasela waye alungelelanise iinhlanganiselo, iintlanganiso namagqibo ezindaba azise kweliso. Ngaphezu koko, lowo ube kule sithuba uza ku: Beka njengesiphithiphathi sokuqala, ejongene neendaba zokunxibelelana kunye namafowuni. Lawula iidaieri aze alungelelanise iintlanganiso naye alungelelanise iinhlanganiselo. Lawula ngenkululeko yokungena kumlawuli/oyilo-mthetho. Rhweba waye alungelelanise indlela yohambo, ezothutha nendawo yokuhlala. Lungiselela iiganeko neengqungquthela. Khumbuza umlawuli/oyilo-mthetho ngemisebenzi ebalulekileyo neemvalo zamanethuba. Bhala, qokelela waye ulungiselele iingxelo, iingcamango nendaba zokunxibelelana. Lawula i-data nemithetho yokugcina iifayile. Zisebenzise waye zigcine iinkqubo/iinkqubo zolawulo. Thintana nabasebenzi, abanikezeli kunye nabo bafuna iinkonzo. Qokelela waye ugcine iindleko. Qhuba uphando waye ubhale iingxelo ngenkululeko yenkqubo yomlawuli/oyilo-mthetho. Iakhono: Iakhono elisisiseko lokuhlalutya nokusombulula iingxaki, iimbono ezingqinelana nexesha elizayo, nolawulo lweenkqubo zamaprojekhthi. Iakhono elinamandla lokunxibelelana (kuquka nokubhala iingxelo ezingangqamana namaxesha amaninzi nokuvelisa iingcamango) nasekunxibelelaneni nabantu. Iakhono lophando. Iakhono elicholwa ngalo uqulunqo-lwakho nolungelelwaniso-lwakho, elinamava ekuphandoni nasekuhlalutyeni iimali. Iimpawu zobuntu: Lowo ube kule sithuba kufuneka afunde kakuhle, angatshintshi izinto azithethayo, azikwazi ukwenza ngendlela ezimelayo, aze ayikhuthaze ngokwakhe, alungelelane, aphakamise izinto ngaphambi kokuba zenzekiswe, abe ngumntu ongxamile nakunxibelelano lokubonisana. Iakhono elingangqamana namaxesha amaninzi kwi-Word for Windows nakwi-Microsoft PowerPoint. Kwaye ubengaphezulu ngesiqondo esiphakathi ngako ukusetyenziswa kwe-Microsoft Excel. Iya kuba luncedo ukuba unobugcisa ekubhalweni kwiingxelo nasekulawuleni abantu abaneengxaki ezinzima kwaye ebaluleke kakhulu.

Skills: Numeracy Interpersonal and diplomacy skills; advisory skills; supervisory skills; general administration and organisational skills; computer utilization; analytical thinking; problem solving skills; communication and report writing abilities.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the ordering and distribution of cleaning material and equipment: Prepare documentation for requisitions. Capture requests on LOGIS. Recommend the purchasing of cleaning materials and equipment. Verify the purchase and distribution of cleaning materials and equipment. Order cleaning material and equipment from suppliers. Maintain supplies inventory by checking stock to determine inventory level. Execute the supervision of cleaning services to maintain hygienic environment-: Administer cleaning schedules for clients. Administer requests from client departments. Monitor services rendered by in house staff and private contractor. Ensure preparation and allocation of uniform for new employees. Provide support in financial administration for cleaning services. Determine the financial for stock needed. Provide budget input for cleaning services. Assist with verification invoices that come from suppliers’ clients’ queries and complaints. Assist in ensuring implementation of Service Level Agreement (SLA). Render general administration and supervisory work-: Supervise performance of subordinates. Administrate office correspondence, documents and reports. Provide information for audit queries. Organise relevant meetings and workshops and document record thereof.

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Skoonmaakdienste
af.summary: Bestuur die verkryging, verspreiding en toesig van skoonmaakmateriaal en -toerusting by die Pretoria Streekskantoor.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Openbare Administrasie of verwante veld. Relevante jare van werkervaring in die relevante velde. Kennis van verkrygings- en tendervorskrifte; Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid; Arbeidsverhoudingswet; Openbare Finansies Bestuurswet. Vaardighede: Geletterdheid en syfervaardigheid; interpersoonlike en diplomatieke vaardighede; advisering vaardighede; toesighoudende vaardighede; algemene administratiewe en organisatoriese vaardighede; rekenaargebruik; analitiese denke; probleemoplossingsvaardighede; kommunikasie en verslagdoeningsvermoëns.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die bestelling en verspreiding van skoonmaakmateriaal en -toerusting: Berei dokumentasie vir aansoeke voor. Vang versoeke op LOGIS vas. Onderhou voorraadvoorraad deur voorraad na te gaan om voorraadvlak te bepaal. Voer toesig oor skoonmaakdienste uit om higiëniese omgewing te handhaaf: Administreer skoonmaakskedules vir kliënte. Bystand met verifikasie van fakture wat van verskaffers se kliënte se navrae en klagtes kom. Bystand verseker implementering van Service Level Agreement (SLA). Lewer algemene administratiewe en toesighoudende werk: Oulêer prestasie van ondergeskiktes. Administreer kantoorkorrespondensie, dokumente en verslae. Verskaf inligting vir ouditnavrae. Reël relevante vergaderings en werkswinkels en dokumenteer rekords daarvan.

zu.title: Umsizi weNhlaka: Imininingwane yokuhlanza
zu.summary: Phatha ukuthenga, ukusatshalaliswa, kanye nokuqondisa imishini yokuhlanza namaphenyu wesikhungo samaphoyisa ePitoli.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sonyaka wezinkomba ezintathu zemfundo ephakeme (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Public Administration noma inkambu ehlobene nayo. Unyaka ohleliwe wemisebenzi ezinkambini ezihlobene. Ulwazi mayelana nomthetho wokuthenga nemithetho yentengo; Umthetho wezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi; Umthetho wobudlelwano basebenzi; Umthetho wezimali zikahulumeni. Amandla: Ubuchwepheshe bokubala; amandla okuxhumana nobungcaphephi; amandla okweluleka; amandla okuphatha; amandla okuphatha imiholo ehleliwe nakwemininingwane; ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha; ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya; amandla okuxazulula izinkinga; amandla okuxhumana nokubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukuthengwa nokusatshalaliswa kwemishini yokuhlanza kanye nemicimbi yokuhlanza. Lungiselela amadokhumenti ezicelo. Faka izicelo ku-Luqisi. Phakamisa ukuthengwa kwemishini yokuhlanza kanye nemicimbi yokuhlanza. Qinisekisa ukuthengwa nokusatshalaliswa kwemishini yokuhlanza kanye nemicimbi yokuhlanza. Thenga imishini yokuhlanza kanye nemicimbi yokuhlanza kubanikezeli. Gcina inani lemitshingo ngokuqhuba izinga elifana kwendawo. Hlola imisebenzi yokuhlanza ukuze igcinwe isimo esihle sokuhlanzeka: Phatha izikhathi zokuhlanza kumayisithi. Phatha izicelo ezingamaphi amaphuzu ayimayisithi. Qedelela imiphingqamulo okubaneka izinto kwezinsizakusebenza zangaphakathi nakubathengisi. Qedelela ukuphelelwa komhlaba omtsha okubaneka ukulungiselelwa kwentsha. Phetha iholo leminyaka yonke ekuqoqeni imisebenzi yokuhlanza. Qedelela iholo elikhoyo lomhlaba odingekayo. Phakamisa okufakwa kwesabelo semisebenzi yokuhlanza. Siza ukulungiselela izikweletu ezithola kubayisithi abafunda imibuzo kanye nezinkathazo. Siza ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwegunya eliveza kahle mayisithi. Phetha umsebenzi ohleliwe njengoba inani elikhoyo: Phatha imisebenzi yamalungu asebenzayo. Phatha ukubhala kwamaphepha, amadokhumenti kanye nemibiko. Phakamisa izinkomba zombuzo wokuqoqa. Lungiselela amahlatshi ohlangano nemikhankaso, ulondoloze amaphhephandaba.

xh.title: Iofisi yoLawulo: Iinkonzo zoKucoca
xh.summary: Qondisa ukuthengwa, ukusasazwa, nokuqonda iinkqubo zokuqonga nezixhobo zokucoca ePretoria Regional Office.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphezulu kakhulu kwisakhulu sendalo iye kwisakhulu sesithathu (NQF Level 06) / i-Diploma yaseBhashe kwiNtengiso yoLawulo loluntu okanye indawo edibana nayo. Iiminyaka efanelekileyo yamava basebenzi kumimandla edibana nayo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokuthengwa nemigaqo yentengiso; i-Occupational Health and Safety; uMthetho weNgxoxo yeZentlalo; uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu. Amandla: Ukubala; amandla obuntu bomntu nobunoxhosa; amandla okupha ingcebiso; amandla okulawula abantu; urhwebo olubanzi lolawulo noluhlelo; ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; ukucinga ngokuhlalutya; amandla okusombulula iingxaki; amandla okuthetha nokuvelisa iingxelo.
xh.duties: Qhoboshela ukulungiselela ukutyala nokusasaza inkqubo nezixhobo zokucoca: Lungiselela amaxwebhu ezingxelo zesicelo. Gcina iisicelo kwi-LOGIS. Lingisa ukuthengwa kwenkqubo nezixhobo zokucoca. Qinisekisa ukuthengwa nokusasazwa kwenkqubo nezixhobo zokucoca. Tyala inkqubo nezixhobo zokucoca kubathengisi. Phatha iresi yempahla ngokuqhubekisela imeko yokugcina impahla. Lawula ulawulo lweenkonzo zokucoca ukuze kugcinwe indawo ehlanjiweyo-: Lawula iinkqubo zesikhele zabathengi. Lawula iisicelo ezivela kumasebe abathengi. Qhubekisisa iinkonzo ezenziwa ngabasebenzi basekhaya nakubaphangeli bangaqlwanga. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo nokuqabisa impahla yokusebenza abasebenzi abasha. Nikela inkxaso kulawulo lweemali ngeenkonzo zokucoca. Misela iimali efunekayo zempahla egcinwe kusetyenziswa. Nikela isalathiso semali ezingeniso ngeenkonzo zokucoca. Siza ekungqinisweni kwamanxiben amvela kubathengisi eziyimibuzo yabathengi neziyizingelamano. Siza ekuqinisekiseni ukusetenziswa kwe-Service Level Agreement (SLA). Zenza urhwebo lolawulo nolokulawula abantu-: Lawula ukusebenza koluntu. Lawula urhwebo lwe-correspondence yofisi, amaxwebhu neengxelo. Nikezela intsingiselo yemibuzo yokuvavanya. Hlela iindibano kunye ne-workshops ezifanelekileyo uze ugazele amaxwebhu aqhubekayo.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Werkswinkel
af.summary: Verskaf werkswinkeladministrasie en klerklike ondersteuning, insluitend werkkaartbestuur en besteldienste by die Pretoria Regional Office.

Kennis: Works Control System (WCS); Basic Accounting System (BAS); Public Finance Management Act (PFMA); Treasury Regulations; finansiële bestuur en administrasie; Staatsbegrotingsstelsels besigheids-, rekeningkundige en finansiële stelsels. Vaardighede: Geletterdheid in wiskunde; rekeningkunde; organiseringsvermoë; interpersoonlike vaardighede; diplomasie; vermoë om 'n proaktiewe en kreatiewe probleemoplossingsbenadering te volg; kommunikasie rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaf administrasie van werkkaarte: - Registreer en lê nuwe werkkaarte. Doen opvolg op uitstaande werkkaarte. Monitor die bywerk van inligting op werkkaart. Sirkuleer inligting oor werkkaarte. Stel navrae en probleme oor werkkaarte. Verskaf algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste: - Help met die bestelling van werkswinkelmateriaal en toerusting. Lui, organiseer, stoor, vat en haal korrespondensie en data. Werk registers en statistieke by. Maak fotostate soos benodig. Versprei dokumente/pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos benodig. zu.title: Isikhundla soBhali: iWokishobha
zu.summary: Nikela ngohlelo lwewokishobha lokusebenza nokusekelwa okubhalwayo okuhlanganisa uphatho lwezikhulu zomsebenzi kanye nezinsizakalo zoku-oda ePretoria Regional Office.
zu.requirements: Uthole ibhulukwe lesikole / isitifikedi se-Grade 12. Akukho ngokuhlanganyela okudingekayo. Ulwazi: Works Control System (WCS); Basic Accounting System (BAS); Public Finance Management Act (PFMA); Treasury Regulations; financial management and administration; State budgetary systems business-, accounting- and financial systems. Logis. Amakhono: Numeracy; accounting; organising; interpersonal skills; diplomacy; ability to follow a pro-active and creative problem-solving approach; communication computer literacy.
zu.duties: Hlela izikhulu zomsebenzi: -Bhalisa futhi ulondoze izikhulu zomsebenzi ezisha. Landelela izikhulu zomsebenzi ezingaqediwe. Qaphela ukubuyekeza ulwazi esikhulwini somsebenzi. Saza ulwazi mayelana nezikhulu zomsebenzi. Misela imibuzo nanenkinga ezikhulwini somsebenzi. Yeza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yobhalo: - Siza kokuthenga izinto zewokishobha nemishini. Bhala, hlela, gcina, faka futhi uthole imibhalo nedatha. Buyekeza izibalo namarekhodi. Yenza amakhophi njengoba kudingeka. Yaba amafayela/amaphakheji kubahlaleli abahlukene njengoba kudingeka. Phatha izikhalazo nemibuzo yamakhasimende: -Gcina irekhodi elimbuzweni elisebenzayo leyunithi. Phendula imibuzo noma uyadlulisela kubaphathi abadingekayo. Landelela izikhalazo nemibuzo ezingaqediwe. Nikela amakhasimende imiphumela mayelana nezikhalazo. Hlela izinkomishi zabahlaleli futhi wenze eminye imisebenzi yobhalo -: Qinisekisa ukuthi abahlaleli abadingekayo bakho. Hlela izinkomishi futhi uthathe amaminithi ngesikhathi senkomishi. Hlela izinto ezingadingekayo zezinkomishi. Lungiselela futhi usaze amafayela njengoba kuhoxiwe. Yezela imisebenzi yabasebenzi neyemali ehhovisi elingaphansi: -Faka futhi ubuyekeze izink zimali zehhovisi elingaphansi. Hlola ukuqonda kwezink zimali zokuhamba zabaluleke bese zithunyelwa kubaphathi bavunyelwe. Phatha ama-akhawunti efoni nomali encane yaleyunithi.

xh.duties: Kuqatshwe iikhadi zemisebenzi: -Bhalisa kwaye ulungelelanise iikhadi zemisebenzi ezintsha. Landela iikhadi zemisebenzi ezingagqitywanga. Qonda ukuhlaziya kolwazi kwikhadi lomsebenzi. Saza ulwazi malunga nekhadi lomsebenzi. Misela imibuzo neengxaki kwikhadi lomsebenzi. Zeza iinkonzo ezintathu zolawulo: - Nceda nok odla izixhobo nemisebenzi yewotshoko. Bhala, lunga, gcina, faka kwaye uphinde ulwazi kunye nedatha. Hlaziya iirejista kunye neestatistiki. Yenza iikopi njengoko kufuneka. Saza amaxwebhu/iiphakheji kubaphathi abahlukeneyo njengoko kufuneka. Lawula iingxaki kunye nemibuzo yabathengi: -Gcina irejista esebenzayo yemibuzo yeyunithi. Phendula imibuzo okanye uyithumele kumanejala ofanelekileyo. Landela iingxaki nemibuzo ezingagqitywanga. Nikela abathengi nolwazi malunga neengxaki. Lawula iintlanganiso nabaphathi kwaye wenze eminye imisebenzi yolawulo: - Qinisekisa ukubakho kwabaphathi abafunekayo. Lungiselela iintlanganiso kwaye uthathe imizuzu ngexesha leentlanganiso. Lungiselela izinto ezifunekayo eziyilogistics zentlanganiso. Ilungelelanise kwaye isaze amaxwebhu njengoko kalathiwe. Zeza inkonzo yolawulo lwabantu nezimali kwesuba-directorate: -Faka kwaye uhlaziye iindleko zesuba-directorate. Qaqambisa ukuchaneka magama abasebenzi kwaye uzithumele kumanenjala ukuze avunywe. Lawula ii-akhawunti zefowuni kunye nemali encinci yecandelo.

jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Supervise cleaning services, equipment management and housekeeping operations at the Pretoria Regional Office.

Basic knowledge of cleaning, Office Administration, Operating cleaning equipment, Occupational health and safety, Personnel practices and Labour Relations Act. Skills: Effective communication skills, numeracy, observation abilities, ability to work with consultants, professionals and staff at various levels, relationship management, interpersonal and diplomacy skills, analytical thinking, problem solving skills, decision making skills, conflict resolution, motivational skills.
jobs.duties: Manage and control equipment and materials: identify resource requirements and special operational needs. monitor the condition and availability of equipment. Ensure replacement or repair of faulty/outdated equipment. Supervise the provisioning of housekeeping, cleaning, safeguarding & maintenance services: -Ensure cleanliness, tidiness, hygiene and safety of all areas allocated for cleaning. Perform administration functions associated to housekeeping & cleaning services. Identify hazards in the buildings/offices related to fire and electricity. Perform physical inspection of cleaned areas-: Ensure the removal of refuse in the offices and around the buildings. Ensure the inspection of logistics and physical environment to ensure clean maintained environment adherence to OHS. Perform general supervision and support the administration of the Section-: Identify staff requirements in terms of training and development. Review employees’ performance. support the administration of human resources. assist with maintenance of discipline and time keeping. Assist with records management.

af.title: Bestuurder: Skoonmaakdienste
af.summary: Bestuur skoonmaakdienste, toerustingbestuur en huishoudelike bedrywighede by die Pretoria Regional Office.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van Graad 9/ ABET vlak 4. ('n Minimum van twee jaar relevante skoonmaakdiens-omgewingservaring sal as 'n bykomende voordeel gebruik word). Basiese kennis van skoonmaak, Kantooradministrasie, Die bedryf van skoonmaaktoerusting, Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid, Personeelspraktyke en Arbeidsverhoudingswet. Vaardighede: Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede, geletterdheid in syferkennis, waarnemingsvermoëns, vermoë om met konsultante, professionele persone en personeel op verskillende vlakke te werk, verhoudingsbestuur, interpersoonlike en diplomatiese vaardighede, analitiese denke, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, besluitnemingsvaardighede, konflikoplossing, motiveringsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur en beheer toerusting en materiaal: identifiseer hulpbronvereistes en spesifieke operasionele behoeftes. Monitor die toestand en beskikbaarheid van toerusting. Verseker vervanging of herstel van defekte/verouderde toerusting. Bestuur die verskaffing van huishoudelike, skoonmaak-, veiligheids- en instandhoudingsdienste: -Verseker netheid, orde, higiëne en veiligheid van alle areas wat vir skoonmaak toegewys is. Voer administratiewe funksies uit wat met huishoudelike- en skoonmaakdienste verband hou. Identifiseer gevare in die geboue/kantore wat verband hou met brand en elektrisiteit. Voer fisiese inspeksie van skoongemaakte areas uit-: Verseker die verwydering van vullis in die kantore en rondom die geboue. Verseker die inspeksie van logistiek en fisiese omgewing om 'n skoon, onderhoude omgewing en nakoming van OHS te verseker. Voer algemene toesig uit en ondersteun die administrasie van die Afdeling-: Identifiseer personeelvereistes ten opsigte van opleiding en ontwikkeling. Hersien werknemers se prestasie. Ondersteun die administrasie van menslike hulpbronne. Help met die handhawing van dissipline en tydhou. Help met rekordbestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi: Isevisi Yokuhlanzwa
zu.summary: Ukuqondisa isevisi yokuhlanzwa, ulawulo lwezinsimbi nokuphatha izindlu enkantolo yendawo yakwaPretoria.
zu.requirements: Okungenani ibanga le-9/ i-ABET level 4. (Okungenani iminyaka emibili ohlakaniphileko eqenjini lesevisi yokuhlanzwa kuzokusetshenziswa njengento eholela phambili). Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lokuhlanzwa, Ukuphatha Ofisi, Ukusebenzisa izinsimbi zokuhlanzwa, Izingozi zomsebenzi nokuphephiswa, Izendlela zokuphatha abantu kanye neNqubo yabasebenzi. Amandla: Amandla okuxhumana ngokusebenzayo, ukubala, amandla okubuka, ikghono lokusebenza nabatshintshi, ochwepheshe kanye nabasebenzi kumazinga ahlukene, ukulawula ubudlelwano, amandla abantu kanye nobubele, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, amandla okuxazulula izinkinga, amandla okuthatha izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amandla okukhuthaza.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi ulawule izinsimbi nezinto ezidingekayo: qinisekisa okudingekayo kanye nezidingo ezikhetheke zokusebenza. Qaphela isimo kanye nokutholakala kwezinsimbi. Qinisekisa ukushintshwa noma ukulungiswa kwezinsimbi ezonakele/ezidala. Qondise ukunikezwa kokuphatha izindlu, ukuhlanzwa, ukugcina nokulondolozwa kwezinto: -Qinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zonke ezibekelwe ukuhlanzwa zicoce, zihle, zinempilo futhi zivikelekile. Yenza imisebenzi yokuqondisa ohlotsheni lokuphatha izindlu nokuhlanzwa. Qinisekisa izinsila ezikumakade aphiqwe ngomlilo kagesi. Yenza ukubheka ngokomzimba kwezindawo ezihlanjiwe-: Qinisekisa ukususwa kwezinto ezingezandle ehhovisi nasezindlineni ezikude. Qinisekisa ukubheka izinto zokuqedela kanye nendawo ezungezile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo ihlanzekile, ilondolozwe ngokulandela i-OHS. Yenza ukulawula jikelele futhi usekele ukulawulwa komnyango: Qinisekisa izidingo zabasebenzi mayelana nokufundiswa nokuthuthukiswa. Hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Usekele ukulawula abantu. Siza ekugcineni isithunzi nokugcina isikhathi. Siza ekulawulweni kwezinkomba.

xh.title: Mphathi weeNkonzo zoKucoceka
xh.summary: Ukuphatha iinkonzo zokucoceka, ulawulo lwesixhobo nemisebenzi yokonza indlu kwiOfisi yendlu yengingqi yasePretoria.
xh.requirements: Ubuncinane bemigangatho yebanga le-9/ ABET level 4. (Ubuncinane beminyaka emibini yamava emveli kwinkonzo zokucoceko kuya kusetyenziswa njengesongezo). Isiqondo esisisiseko sokucoceka, ulawulo lweofisi, ukusebenzisa iinkonzo zokucoceka, impilo yoluntu nakho kukhuseleko ezintlalweni, iinkqubo zabasebenzi noMthetho wezMiba zoBunyangwe. Ikhono: Ikhono elisebenzayo lokunxibelelana, ukubala ukuya kwamabala, amandla okuqapha, ikhono lokusebenza nabaphandi, oogqithisa nabasebenzi kumanqanaba ahlukeneyo, ulawulo loludwe, ikhono elingommelwano nolobunyulu, ukucinga ngokuhlaziya, ikhono lokuxazulula iingxaki, ikhono lokwenza izigqibo, ukuxazulula iingxabano, namakhono okukhuthaza.
xh.duties: Lawula ulawule iisixhobo namaxhobo: chonga iimfuno zokhululo neemfuno ezikhethekileyo zomsebenzi. Qaphela imeko nokufumaneka kweesixhobo. Qinisekisa ukutshintshwa okanye kulungiswe iisixhobo ezonakeleyo/ezidulileyo. Phatha ukunikezelwa kwezinkonzo zokonza indlu, ukucoca, ukhuseleko namasebe eemfuno nokulungiswa: -Qinisekisa ukucoca, ukuhlelwa kahle, ukhuseleko lohlobo lwempilo nakho kukhuseleko kuyo yonke indawo enikiwe ukuba icocwe. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo ehambelana neenkonzo zokonza indlu nokucoca. Chonga iingozi kumakomkhulu/iiofisi ezinxulumene nomlilo nobumbane. Yenza isimo sokujonga ngokomzimba kwendawo ecociwe-: Qinisekisa ukususwa kokuchithwayo kwiiofisi nakuzo zonke iindawo ezikumakomkhulu. Qinisekisa ukuphononwa kwezinto ezihamba nendlu nezimo ezibonakalayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba indawo icociwe igcinwe kulandele i-OHS. Yenza ulawulo olubanzi uze useke ulawulo lwesebe-: Chonga iimfuno zabasebenzi malunga nokulungiselelwa nokuqhuba. Phinda ucocise ulumeleko labasebenzi. seke ulawulo lwabantu abangoomntu. ncede ekugcineni kolwesimi nakwexesha. Nceda ekulawulweni kweerekhodi.

jobs.title: Boiler Operator: Workshop
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Boiler operator needed at the Pretoria Regional Office to manage boiler chemicals, water quality and equipment maintenance, requiring Grade 10 and a national steam certificate.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of Grade 10 and equivalent recognised national steam certificate. A minimum of one (1) year experience in the field will be an added advantage). Knowledge of Boiler Operation, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Operation of equipment, tools and materials. Knowledge of general built environment. Operation of machinery skills. Interpersonal skills. Basic literacy skills. Technical skills. Motivational skills. Supervisory skills. Planning and organising skills. Accuracy. Effective communication skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure correct usage and flow of chemicals-Request chemicals from stores as required. Test quality of water of softeners as well the returning flows of condensate water. Fill chemical tank with required chemicals as prescribed. Top up salt in brine tank. Check working conditions of chemical pumps. Test total dissolve solids (TDS) and blow-down according to prescripts. Monitoring boiler pressure in accordance with demand Monitor the steam pressure constantly. Check the correct temperature of hot well pumps. Adjust the stoker for efficient steam delivery. Report all defects immediately. Monitoring the water/fuel level in the boiler-Check the feed water pumps-level and hot well tanks for sufficient water supply to the boiler. Make sure that standby boilers and funnel is full of water and chemical at all times. Control the flow of fuel. Ensure adherence and compliance with occupational and heath standards and the occupational health and safety act. Ensure that the boiler environment is well maintained. To ensure the removal ash from boilers, grit arrester and smoke box.

zu.title: Umsebenzeli Weboiler: I-Workshop
zu.summary: Kudingwa umsebenzeli webhayela ePretoria Regional Office ukuphatha amakhemikhali webhayela, umgangatho wamanzi kanye nokugcinwa kwesisetshenziswa, kadingeka iGrade 10 kanye nesitifikedi sezitimu ssezwe.
zu.requirements: Okuncane ibe yiGrade 10 kanye nesitifikedi sezitimu ssezwe esivunyelwe esilinganayo. Okuncane kube uyisikhathi esiyisikhathi esiyikhulu (1) saminyaka yamava kule ndawo kuyoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi mayelana nokusebenza kweBoiler, uMthetho Wezokuphepha Nakho Konke Ezempilweni Nakomsebenzi, ukuphatha izisetshenziswa, amathuluzi namakhemikhali. Ulwazi ngesimo sakho konke okwakhiwe. Amandla okuphatha imishini. Amandla okusebenza nabantu. Amandla okufunda nokubhala. Amandla obuchwepheshe. Amandla okukhuthaza. Amandla okulawula. Amandla okuhlela futhi ahlele. Ukunemba. Amandla okuxhumana okusebenzayo.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okulungile kanye nokugeleza kwamakhemikhali-Cela amakhemikhali kwisitoreji njengoba kudingeka. Hlola umgangatho wamanzi ahlanzekile kuma-softeners kanye nokuvela kolwelo lwamanzi oluncibilikiswa. Gcwala ithangi lamakhemikhali ngamakhemikhali adingekayo njengoba kumisiwe. Geleza usawoti ethangini le-brine. Hlola izimo zokusebenza zamapompa amakhemikhali. Hlola konke okuncibilikayo (TDS) kanye nokukhishwa komoya ngokemithetho. Ukubheka ingcindezi yebhayela ngokukaudingo Bheka ngokungapheli ingcindezi yomusi. Hlola izinga lokushisa elungile kwamapompa asehot-well. Lungisa i-stoker ukuletha umusi osebenza kahle. Bika wonke amaphutha ngokushesha. Ukubheka izinga lamanzi/izibaso kubhayela-Hlola amapompa amanzi-izinga namathangi asehot-well ukuze kube namanzianele kubhayela. Qinisekisa ukuthi amabhayela alindele kanye nephondo ligcwele amanzi nakhemikhali ngesikhathi sonke. Lawula ukugeleza kwesibaso. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa nokuhambisana nemitshilo yezempilo nakomsebenzi kanye noMthetho Wezokuphepha Nakho Konke Ezempilweni Nakomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yebhayela igcinwe kahle. Ukuqinisekisa ukususwa kwabafutho kumabhayela, i-grit arrester nesibokisi somsi.

af.title: Keteloperateur: Werkswinkel
af.summary: Keteloperateur benodig by die Pretoria Streekskantoor om ketelchemikalieë, waterkwaliteit en toerustingsonderhoud te bestuur, met Graad 10 en 'n nasionale stoomsertifikaat as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van Graad 10 en 'n gelykwaardige erkende nasionale stoomsertifikaat. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar ondervinding in die veld sal 'n voordeel wees). Kennis van ketelbedryf, die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, bedryf van toerusting, gereedskap en materiaal. Kennis van die algemene bou-omgewing. Vaardighede in die bedryf van masjinerie. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Basiese geletterdheidsvaardighede. Tegniese vaardighede. Motiveringsvaardighede. Toesighoudende vaardighede. Beplannings- en organiseervaardighede. Akkuraatheid. Doeltreffende kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verseker korrekte gebruik en vloei van chemikalieë-Vra chemikalieë vanaf die magasin aan soos benodig. Toets die kwaliteit van water van sagtmakers asook die terugvloei van kondensatiewater. Vul chemiese tenk met die vereiste chemikalieë soos voorgeskryf. Vul sout in die pekeltenk aan. Kontroleer werkende toestand van chemiese pompe. Toets totaal opgeloste vaste stowwe (TDS) en voer uitblaas volgens voorskrifte uit. Monitor keteldruk in ooreenstemming met vraag-Monitor die stoomdruk konstant. Kontroleer die korrekte temperatuur van warmbrunpompe. Stel die stoker vir doeltreffende stoomlewering. Rapporteer alle defekte onmiddellik. Monitor die water/brandstofvlak in die ketel-Kontroleer die voedingswaterpompe-vlak en warmbruntenks vir voldoende watervoorsiening na die ketel. Maak seker dat bystandsketels en skoorsteen te alle tye vol water en chemikalieë is. Beheer die vloei van brandstof. Verseker nakoming en voldoening aan beroeps- en gesondheidsstandaarde en die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Verseker dat die ketelomgewing goed onderhou word. Om die verwydering van as vanuit ketels, gruishouer en rookkas te verseker.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi weBoiler: IWorkshop
xh.summary: Kufuneka umsebenzisi we-boiler ePretoria Regional Office ukulawula iibhemikhali ze-boiler, ikhwalithi yamanzi nolondolozo lweqistrosa, kudingeka ibanga leGrade 10 nesatifikethi sesizwe sebhalo.
xh.requirements: Ubuncinane beGrade 10 nesesatifikethi esifanayo esivunyiweyo sesizwe sebhalo. Ubuncinane bomnye (1) umyaka wamava kwindawo kuya kuba lusizo ekwenzeleni izinto. Ulwazi ngokuSebenza kwiBoiler, iOccupational Health and Safety Act, ukuSebenza kweqistrosa, amaceba nemithi. Ulwazi ngemiba yakhiwo jikelele. Amandla okusebenza ngemishini. Amandla okuhambelana nabantu. Amandi okufunda nokubhala. Amandla obuchwepheshe. Amandla okukhuthaza. Amandla okulawula abanye. Amandla okucwangcisa nokuhlela. Uchane. Amandla okusebenzisana ngokuchanekileyo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa nokuhamba kolana kwamachemicals-Cela amachemicals kwindawo yokugcina njengoko kufuneka. Vavanya ubukhulu bamanzi kwi-softeners nangokuhamba kobuyekezelo bamanzi o-condensate. Gcwalisa itanki ngamachemicals afunekayo njengoko kucetyisiwe. Yongeza uswthi kwitanki yebrine. Khangela iimeko zokusebenza zamapampa amachemicals. Vavanya i-total dissolve solids (TDS) kwaye wenze i-blow-down ngokomthetho. Ukuqokelela ingcinezelo ye-boiler ngokwemfuno Qokelela ngamaxesha onke ingcinezelo yebhalo. Khangela ukushisa okuchanekileyo kweepampa ezishushu. Lungisa i-stoker ukuba idlulise ibhalo ngokusebenza kakuhle. Chaza wonke amaxhaka ngoko nangoko. Ukuqokelela inqanaba lamanzi/amatshisi kwi-boiler-Khangela iinqanaba zeepampa ezidlulisela amanzi nemitanki egcwele amanzi ashushu ukwanela amanzi avela kwi-boiler. Qinisekisa ukuba i-boiler ezime ngasese ne-funnel zigcwele amanzi namachemicals ngawo onke amaxesha. Lawula ukuhamba kwamatshisi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela nokuvumelana nezinga lemfuno yesebe loyilo nokuGcina umthetho woLawulo lwezeMpiIlo nokuKhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukuba indawo ye-boiler igcinwe kakuhle. Ukuqinisekisa ukususwa kwe-ash kwiiboiler, i-grit arrester naku-smoke box.

jobs.title: Supervisor: Grounds Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Supervisor needed at the Pretoria Regional Office to manage grounds services, oversee equipment maintenance and coordinate horticultural staff.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of ABET level 4/ Grade 9. Relevant experience of horticultural practices and clerical services will be an added advantage). Knowledge of Garden maintenance practices; Office Administration. Operating horticultural equipment; Occupational health and safety; Personnel practices. Labour Relations Act. Effective communication skills. Good communication, leadership and organizational skills. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Manage and control equipment and materials-: Identify resource requirements and special operational needs. Monitor the condition and availability of equipment. Ensure the maintenance/servicing of equipment and other outdoor maintenance tasks-: Prepare, implement and monitor maintenance schedules. Ensure that weeds and grass on bedding are removed. Supervise the fertilization of soil on flower beds. Perform physical inspection of worked ground areas-: Ensure the removal of garden rubbish/refuse around buildings. Ensure the inspection of logistics and physical environment to ensure clean maintained environment adherence to OHS. Perform general supervision and support the administration of the Section. Identify staff requirements in terms of training and development. Assist with performance reviews of subordinates. Support the administration of human resources.
jobs.applications: for the position of Supervisor: Ground Services must be emailed to: RecruitPTA26-61@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /SMS-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Bestuurder: Gronddienste
af.summary: Bestuurder benodig by die Pretoria Regionale Kantoor om gronddienste te bestuur, toerustingonderhoud toes te hou en tuinboupersoneel te koördineer.
af.requirements: Minimum van ABET vlak 4/ Graad 9. Relevante ervaring van tuinboupraktyke en klerke dienste sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van tuinonderhoudspraktyke; Kantooradministrasie. Bestuur van tuinboutuurstelling; Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid; Personeelspraktyke. Arbeidsverhoudingswet. Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede. Goede kommunikasie, leierskap en organisatoriese vaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur en beheer toerusting en materiale-: Identifiseer hulpbronvereistes en spesiale operasionele behoeftes. Monitor die toestand en beskikbaarheid van toerusting. Verseker die instandhouding/onderhoud van toerusting en ander buitemuurse instandhoudingstake-: Berei instandhoudingskedules voor, implementeer en monitor dit. Verseker dat onkruid en gras op bedding verwyder word. Hou toesig oor die bemesting van grond op blombeddings. Voer fisiese ondersoeke van bewerkte grondareas uit-: Verseker die verwydering van tuinafval/vullis rondom geboue. Verseker die ondersoek van logistiek en fisiese omgewing om skoon, onderhoude omgewing en nakoming van OHS te verseker. Voer algemene toesig uit en ondersteun die administrasie van die Afdeling. Identifiseer personeelvereistes ten opsigte van opleiding en ontwikkeling. Bystand verleen met prestasie-evaluerings van ondergeskiktes. Ondersteun die administrasie van menslike hulpbronne.

xh.title: Olawulayo: Iinkonzo ze-Grounds
xh.summary: Kufuneka umphathi wezixhobo kwindawo yokusebenza yendawo i-Pretoria Regional Office ukulawula iinkonzo zendlu yokutyala izityalo, uqaphele ukugcinwa kwezixhobo aze ulawule abasebenzi bolimi abalime izityalo.
xh.requirements: Ubuncinane bemigangatho ye-ABET level 4/ Grade 9. Ulwazi olufaneleyo malunga neendlela zokulima izityalo neenkonzo zolawulo lwebhodiya kuya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi ngendlela zokulondoloza ilungu ye garden; Ukulawulwa kwe-Office Administration. Ukusebenzisa izixhobo zokulima izityalo; Ukhuselo nokhathalo kwindawo yomsebenzi; Iindlela zabasebenzi. Umthetho woManyano lwabaB basebenzi. Amakhono amabaliselekileyo okunxibelelana. Amakhono amabaliselekileyo okunxibelelana, abaqhubi kwaye ahlelayo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Qondisa kulawulo izixhobo neziphakamiso-: Chonga iimfuno zeziphakamiso neemfuno ezithile zokusebenza. Qaphela imeko nokubakho kwezixhobo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwesixhobo nokwenziwa kwezinye iinkqubo ezingaphandle-: Lungisa, phumeza uze ulawule iinqubo zokugcina. Qinisekisa ukuba kususwa iintsiba namakhula ezibalongxube. Qondisa ukondza kwemihlaba kwiilote ezineeblomu. Yenza ukutyalwa kwamehlo okujonga indawo ezityaliweyo-: Qinisekisa ukususwa kwengxwabo yasendlelwini/iindwengo ezisedongweni. Qinisekisa ukuqwalaselwa kwezinto zolawulo nendalo yendawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathazo lokugcinwa kwindalo ehlanziweyo ngesiqhobo noMthetho woKhuseleko nokhathalo loMsebenzi. Yenza ulawulo olubanzi uze uxhase ukulawulwa kweSebe. Chonga iimfuno zabasebenzi malunga noqeqesho nophuhliso. Nceda ngeenkqubo zokuqwalaselwa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Xhasa ukulawulwa kwezinto zabantu.

zu.title: Omunyathi: Izinkonzo Zokugcina Umhlaba
zu.summary: Kudingeka umnunyathi e-Pretoria Regional Office ukuphatha izinkonzo zokugcina umhlaba, okubuka ukulondolozwa kwezinsimbi kanye nokuqhube izisebenzi ezindabeni zezululwane.
zu.requirements: Okungenani ABET level 4/ Grade 9. Isipiliyoni esihambisana nezindlela zezululwane kanye namakholonzo kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu). Ulwazi ngendlela zokulondolozwa kwensimu; Office Administration. Ukusebenzisa izinsimbi zezululwane; Occupational health and safety; Izindlela zabasebenzi. Labour Relations Act. Amakhono okuxhumana aphezulu. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, abukhosi kanye nokuhlela. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi ulawule izinsimbi nezinto ezidingekayo-: Qaphela izidingo zezinsiza kanye nezidingo ezikhethekile zokusebenza. Lilise isimo nokuitholakala kwezinsimbi. Qinisekisa ukulondolozwa/ukulekelelwa kwezinsimbi kanye neminye imisebenzi yokulondolozwa ngaphandle-: Lungiselela, sebenzisa futhi ulilise izinhlelo zokulondolozwa. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngokomzimba kwendawo ezesebwe-: Qinisekisa ukususwa kwezinhlanzi zeziyalo / ukungalahlwa kwemfucumfucu emakade awo. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwezokuhamba kanye nendawo yomzimba ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ehlanzekile egciniwe ukulandela imithetho ye-OHS. Yenza ukubuka okujwayelekile futhi usekele ukuphathwa kweSigaba. Qaphela izidingo zabasebenzi maqondana nokuhlolwa nokuthuthukisa. Siza ngokuqhathaniswa kokusebenza kwabaphansi. Sekela ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomuntu.

jobs.title: Director: Youth Development, Empowerment and

This inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the states’ contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured i.t.o. the applicable rules. The successful candidate will be required to enter into a performance agreement and to sign an employment contract.
jobs.summary: Director position to lead youth development policy, programmes and stakeholder partnerships at the Department of Social Development in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF level 7 qualification in the field of Development Studies/ Social Sciences as recognised by SAQA Plus 5 years’ experience at middle/ senior management in the relevant field. Knowledge of the Constitution of South Africa. Knowledge of the relevant Public Service Act and Regulation. Knowledge and understanding of White Paper on Social Welfare. Knowledge and understanding of Anti-Poverty Strategy. Knowledge of the Public Service Legislative frameworks. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act and Treasury Regulations. Knowledge and understanding of the NPO Act. Knowledge and understanding of involvement in international structures/ stakeholders (UN Convention and AU). Knowledge and understanding of National Development Plan (NDP). Knowledge and understanding of National Development Agency Act. Knowledge and understanding of National Youth Commission Act. Knowledge and understanding of National Youth Development Framework. Knowledge and understanding of National Youth Policy. Knowledge and understanding of District Development Model. Competencies needed: Programme and Project management. Information and Knowledge management. People management and empowerment. Problem solving and change management. Policy analysis and development. Client orientation and customer focus. Strategic capability and leadership. Service delivery innovation. Financial management. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Stakeholder management. Planning and coordination. Presentation and facilitation. Monitoring and evaluation. Critical thinking. Analytical Skills. Collaboration. Attributes: Good interpersonal relations. Innovative and creative. Ability to work under pressure. Ability to work in a team and independently. Adaptability. Emotional intelligence. Independent thinker. Cost consciousness. Honesty and integrity. Assertiveness.
jobs.duties: Manage the development, review, and monitor the implementation of policies, frameworks, guidelines related to youth development. Develop and implement programmes and interventions for youth development. Coordinate and facilitate stakeholder participation, partnerships, and the integration of youth development programmes. Manage and report on the budget, human resources, and performance of the Directorate in line with the set regulations and prescripts.
jobs.applications: Please forward your application, quoting the relevant reference number, to the Director-General, Department of Social Development, Private Bag X901, Pretoria, 0001. Physical Address: HSRC Building, 134 Pretorius Street In the event of hand delivery of applications, applicants must sign an application register book as proof of submission. Applicants may also email their applications to the following email address: Director: Youth Development, Empowerment and Programme Implementation- e-recruit.YDEPI@dsd.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Mr R Khobatha
jobs.notes: In terms of the Department’s employment equity targets, Coloured, Indian and White males as well as African, Coloured and White females. Persons living with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Curriculum vitae with a detailed description of duties and the names of two referees must accompany your signed application for employment (Z83). If applying for more than one position, applicants must submit separate applications for each position. Shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and identity documents on the date of the interview. Applicants are advised that from 1 January 2021, a new application for employment (Z83) form is effective and must be completed in full, failure to use the new Z83 will result in disqualification. The new form can be downloaded online at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies. Applicants applying for SMS posts are required to successfully complete the Certificate for entry into the SMS (submitted prior to appointment) and full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/. Applicants are expected to pay for the course and may enroll for it at a cost of R417.00. The duration of the course is 120 hours. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine the candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will sign an annual performance agreement, complete a financial discloser form and will also be required to undergo a security clearance. Candidates nominated for posts on salary levels 2 - 12 may be subjected to a competency assessment during the selection process. If the candidate is applying for an OSD post, certificates of service must be submitted on the date of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Failure to submit the requested documents will result in your application not being considered. Personnel suitability checks will be conducted on shortlisted candidates, and the appointment is subject to positive outcomes of the checks. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. The selection of candidates will be done with due regard to the relevant aspects of the selection process as set out in the Public Service Amendment Regulations, 2023, Regulation 67. Applications received after the closing date will not be taken into consideration. If you have not been contacted within three months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Candidates requiring additional information regarding the advertised post may direct their enquiries to the person as indicated above. Internal applicants must submit and register their employment applications at the register book in the DSD reception area for the attention of Mr R Khobatha. af.title: Direkteur: Jeugontwikkeling, Bemagtiging en
af.summary: Direkteurspos om jeugontwikkelingsbeleid, programme en belanghebbendevennootskappe by die Department of Social Development in Pretoria te lei.

Kennis van die Grondwet van Suid-Afrika. Kennis van die tersaaklike Openbare Dienswet en Regulasie. Kennis en begrip van die Witboek oor Maatskaplike Welsyn. Kennis en begrip van die Armoede-teenwerkingsstrategie. Kennis van die Openbare Diens-wetgewende raamwerke. Kennis van die Wet op Openbare Finansiële Bestuur en Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis en begrip van die NPO-wet. Kennis en begrip van betrokkenheid by internasionale strukture/belanghebbendes (VN-konvensie en AU). Kennis en begrip van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NDP). Kennis en begrip van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsagentskap-wet. Kennis en begrip van die Nasionale Jeugkommissie-wet. Kennis en begrip van die Nasionale Jeugontwikkelingsraamwerk. Kennis en begrip van die Nasionale Jeugbeleid. Kennis en begrip van die Distrikontwikkelingsmodel. Bevoegdhede benodig: Program- en projektebestuur. Inligting- en kennisbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Probleemoplossing en veranderingsbestuur. Beleidanalise en -ontwikkeling. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Dienslewering-innovasie.
