Bestuur en verslag doen oor die begroting, menslike hulpbronne en prestasie van die Direktoraat in ooreenstemming met die vasgestelde regulasies en voorskrifte.

xh.title: UMlawuli: uPhuhliso, uNikelo lamandla nokuQinisekisa iNtsha
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguMlawuli ukuze akhoke iinkqabo, amaphulo namaqabane abathathi-nxaxheba kwiSebe loPhuhliso lwentlalo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-NQF level 7 kwinkundla yezifundo zoPhuhliso / iNzululwazi loLuntu njengoko ivunywe yi-SAQA kunye neminyaka emi-5 yamava ebuncwini / kuphatho lwesigaba esiphezulu kwinkundla echankathileyo. Ulwazi ngoMgaqo-siseko waseMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente ochankathileyo nemiYalelo yawo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iNqadhamba-mathanga eMhlophe ngokweMigaqo yeNtlalontle. Ulwazi nokuqonda iNdlela yokulwa Nobusweli. Ulwazi ngeenkqabo zoMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente nemiYalelo yeNgoro yamali. Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho we-NPO. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukubandakanyeka kwiindawo zamazwe ngamazwe / kubathathi-nxaxheba (iNqumano ye-UN nedaye ye-AU). Ulwazi nokuqonda uCwangciso loPhuhliso lwelizwe (i-NDP). Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho weSebe loPhuhliso lwelizwe. Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho weKomishini yoLutsha lwelizwe. Ulwazi nokuqanda iNkqubo yoPhuhliso loLutsha lwelizwe. Ulwazi nokuqonda iNkqabo yoLutsha lwelizwe. Ulwazi nokuqonda iModeli yoPhuhliso loMmandla. Iimfuno zokuzipatha: UPhatho lweenkqubo namaphulo. Ulawulo lolwazi nolwazi oluluntwini. UPhatho labantu namandla okusinika amandla. Ukusombulula iingxaki nophatho lootshintsho. Ukwahlula-hlula kwaye uphuhlise iinkqabo. Umda wabathengi nogqaliselo labathengi. Amandla okuyila iindlela nokuqhatha. Intsingiselo yokuvelisa iindlela ezintsha zokunikela inkonzo. ULawulo lweemali. Unxibelelwano (olubhalwayo noluthethwayo). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. UPhatho labathathi-nxaxheba. Uplani nokulungisanisa. Ukubonisa nokukhokelela ingxoxo. Ukuphonononga nokuqonda. Ukucinga ngokuchanekileyo. Amandla okuhlola. Ukusebenzisana. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ubudlelwane obuhle namanye abantu. Ukuyila iindlela ezintsha nokudala. Amandla okusebenza ngoxinzelelo. Amandla okusebenza nqo kwaye uzimele. Ukuzinza. Ukuqonda iimvakalelo. Ukucinga uzimele. Ukuqonda iindleko. Inyaniso nokuzithoba. Ukuzimisela.
xh.duties: Phatha uphuhliso, ukuphonononga, nokuqonda ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zoqeqesho, iinkqubo, neenkhokeleza ezimalunga nophuhliso lwentsha. Yila uphuhliso kwenzeke iinkqubo namanyathelo okungena phakathi nophuhliso lwentsha. Lungisanisa kwaye ukhokele inkxaso-mali yabathathi-nxaxheba, amaqabane, nokudibanisa iinkqubo zophuhliso lwentsha. Phatha kwaye wenze ingxelo ngeemali, abantu abasebenzayo, nempumelelo yeSebe ngokwemigaqo nemiyalelo esetiweyo.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwabasha, Ukunikeza Amandla Nokuthuthukisa
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi sokuhola inqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa kwabasha, izinhlelo kanye nubudlelwano nabashadakhulu e-Department of Social Development e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele se-NQF level 7 esiwinkalo lokuqonda i-Development Studies/ Social Sciences njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA kanye namava eminyaka eyi-5 ekuqondeni/uphatho ophezulu ewindeni elihambisanayo. Ulwazi ngoMthethosisekelo wase-Ningizimu Afrika. Ulwazi ngomthetho kanye nomgwinqo wePublic Service ofanele. Ulwazi kanye noqonde ngalolu paper Mhlophe weSocial Welfare. Ulwazi kanye noqonde nge-Anti-Poverty Strategy. Ulwazi nemiThetho yePublic Service. Ulwazi ngoMthetho we-Public Finance Management Act kanye nama-Treasury Regulations. Ulwazi kanye noqonde ngomthetho weNPO Act. Ulwazi kanye noqonde ngokubandakanyeka kwezinhlangano zamazwe ngamazwe abashadakhulu (i-UN Convention kanye ne-AU). Ulwazi kanye noqonde nge-National Development Plan (NDP). Ulwazi kanye noqonde ngomthetho we-National Development Agency Act. Ulwazi kanye noqonde ngomthetho we-National Youth Commission Act. Ulwazi kanye noqonde nge-National Youth Development Framework. Ulwazi kanye noqonde nge-National Youth Policy. Ulwazi kanye noqonde nge-District Development Model. Amakhono ayadingek: uphatho wezinhlelo kanye nomaqaphamba. Uphatho lwolwazi kanye nolu lwazi oluqoqwe. Uphatho kwabantu kanye nokunikeza amandla. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqashwa komgwenqo osha. Ukwenza isibonelo kanye nokuqonda kwezinqubomgomo. Ukugxila kumthengi. Ikhono lokubusa kanye nekhono lokuhlelela. Ukusungula izindlela ezintsha zokuholela. Uphatho kwemali. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo kanye nokubhali). Ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha. Uphatho kwabashadakhulu. Uhlelo kanye nokuqashwa kwendaba. Ukubhala imibhalo yokwazisa kanye noqeqesho. Ukwengamela kanye nokuqagela. Ukucabanga ngokujulile. Amakhono ukuhlaziya. Ukusebenza ndawonye. Izinkomba: Ukuba nomuhle kwezomunye nomunye. Ukuba mucabango osha kanye nonovuyo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ikhono lokusebenza ndawonye kanye nokuvumelekile. Ukujwayelana nemigogo. Ukuzidela. Ukuzimela ecabangweni. Ulwazi ngemali. Ukuqiniseka kanye nokwethembeka. Ukuzimela.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuka kabusha nokuhlela ukuphumelela kwezinqubomgomo, izinhlelo, izinkomba ezihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwabasha. Bese wakha futhi uphele izinhlelo kanye nokuqashwa kwendaba yokuthuthukisa abasha. Hlela kanye noqeqeshe ukubandakanyeka kwabashadakhulu, ubudlelwano kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abasha. Phatha kanye nibike ngemali, abantu kanye nokuqhuba kwendlu yokuhlela ngokuthula kweziyalezo nemigwelo eqhutshwe.

jobs.title: Director: Office of the Director-general
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.centre: Pretoria REQUIREMENT   :   Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification. An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Sociology/ Public Management & Governance/ Public Administration/ Public Management/ Business Management/ Business Administration/ Office Management or any relevant qualification; Successful completion of the Pre- entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) as endorsed by the National School of Government; 5 years relevant experience at a Middle (Deputy Director level) /Senior Management level in governance administration, committee management, parliamentary liaison, stakeholder relations, intergovernmental relations, or any institutional coordination environment. Valid driver’s licence; Knowledge of Public Service Regulation, Public Service Act and relevant prescripts; Knowledge and understanding of governance structures; Knowledge and understanding of protocol processes; Knowledge and understanding intergovernmental relations and system; Knowledge and understanding of District Development Model (DDM) Framework; Knowledge and understanding of relevant policies and procedures; Knowledge and understanding of PFMA; Strategic capability and Leadership; People management and Empowerment; Programme and Project Management; Service Delivery Innovation (SDI); Problem Solving and Analysis; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; Presentation skills; Research and Analytical skills; Good communication and Interpersonal relations; Computer literacy.
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), consisting of a basic salary (70% of the total remuneration package), State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules and guidelines.
jobs.summary: Director role in the Office of the Director-General at the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture, managing governance structures, parliamentary liaison and stakeholder coordination in Pretoria.
jobs.duties: Manage Governance Structures, Parliamentary and Stakeholder Coordination- Manage the implementation of governance and transformation initiatives in support of the department's strategic objectives; Coordinate the functioning of governance structures, committees and forums within the office of the Director- General; Coordinate FOSAD Cluster activities, governance forums and institutional policy coordination processes; Manage parliamentary liaison services, including the coordination of parliamentary questions, committee responses, briefing notes and submissions; Monitor the implementation of decisions and resolutions arising from governance structures and provide progress reports; Develop and implement governance systems, procedures and standard operating processes to strengthen institutional governance; Coordinate stakeholder engagement and institutional governance initiatives with relevant stakeholders; Facilitate governance-related planning, monitoring, evaluation and reporting processes; Conduct research and provide technical advice on governance and departmental institutional effectiveness; Manage and coordinate administrative support to the District Development Model (DDM)-Manage the provision of administrative, secretariat and coordination support services within the office of the DG; Manage registry, records and document management services within the office of the DG, ensuring compliance with records management framework; Coordinate the department's participation in DDM structures and related activities, meetings and reporting requirements; Monitor implementation of DDM commitments, resolutions, action plans and provide progress reports to management; Facilitate collaboration and information sharing with national, provincial and local government stakeholders to support DDM implementation; Coordinate departmental participation in DDM initiatives; Coordinate administrative systems and support processes to improve operational efficiency; Provide recommendations for improved operational efficiency within executive support structures; Review and consolidate submissions within the Chief Directorate; Coordinate departmental input into MINMEC, NEDLAC and related intergovernmental forums; Coordinate Institutional Governance Compliance and Reporting-Manage and monitor compliance with governance policies, frameworks, procedures and applicable prescripts; coordinate the compilation and submission of governance, parliamentary and executive administrative reports; Manage and track implementation of governance-related commitments and recommendations arising from governance structures and oversight bodies; Identify governance, compliance and operational risks requiring management intervention; Coordinate departmental responses to governance-related audit findings and monitor the implementation of action plans; Monitor compliance with governance information and reporting requirements and ensure the timely submission of reports to relevant oversight structures; Provide governance support and advice to management and relevant stakeholders; Coordinate Intergovernmental and Stakeholder Relations-Manage and coordinate the department’s participation in intergovernmental structures and forums; Coordinate engagements with government departments, public entities and other relevant stakeholders to support the achievement of departmental objectives; Develop and maintain stakeholder databases and engagement plans to strengthen institutional coordination; Monitor implementation of stakeholder commitments, resolutions and action plans and provide progress reports to management; Facilitate information sharing coordination and collaboration within spheres of government; Coordinate departmental participation in governance, parliamentary and stakeholder platforms to ensure the timely preparation of briefing documents, reports and submissions; Provide secretariat and administrative support for stakeholder and intergovernmental forums; Manage the Directorate-Provide strategic leadership, management and performance oversight of human, financial, information and other resources within the Directorate; Develop, implement, monitor and review the Directorate's operational and performance plans to ensure alignment with departmental priorities; Manage performance, risks, internal control and audit processes, and ensure the implementation of corrective action plans arising from audit findings and risk assessment; Consolidate and coordinate reports, submissions and presentations on governance structures;
jobs.applications: Applicants must use this link below to access DSAC E-Recruitment System https://erecruit.dsac.gov.za/public/login_test.php Hand delivery: Sealed envelope addressed to Chief Director: Human Resource Management and Development, Sechaba House, 202 Madiba Street, Pretoria Central. Postal mail to The Chief Director: Human Resource Management and Development, Private Bag X897, Pretoria, 0001.
jobs.notes: Please create a user profile by completing all required personal information and setting up your login credentials. Once registration is complete, log in to the system and you will be directed to the “Welcome Page”. From the Welcome Page, you may browse all vacant positions opportunities listed below. Applicants are strongly advised to complete all information required for the electronic Z83 form on the system before applying for any position. The Z83 form has been adopted into the system, and applications cannot be processed unless all mandatory fields are completed. After completing your profile and Z83 information, you may apply for any relevant advertised position through the system. Ensure that your application is fully completed and submitted before the closing date, as incomplete or late applications will not be considered. Once submitted, the system will provide a confirmation message indicating that your application has been successfully received. The e- Recruitment portal is also accessible via smartphones and other mobile devices. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring certified copies of ID, Driver’s licence (where required) and qualifications on or before the interview. Should you be in possession of any foreign qualification(s), it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA); Applicants must be South African citizens. Shortlisted candidates must avail themselves for a virtual or in-person panel interview at a date and time determined by DSAC. The applicant should make own arrangement for access to internet connectivity and equipment for this purpose. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks and references will be conducted once they are shortlisted. The appointment is also subject to a positive outcome on these checks, including security clearance, security vetting, qualification/study verification, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, previous employment verification and criminal record. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. We encourage all applicants to declare any criminal and/or negative credit records. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment, the logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and sign an annual performance agreement. The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its Employment Equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of these posts. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes, thus withdrawing this advert by notice on its communication channels. Prior to appointment for SMS post, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by the DPSA, which is an online course endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full    details     can     be      sourced    from      the     following   link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Kantoor van die Direkteur-generaal
af.summary: Direkteurspos in die Kantoor van die Direkteur-generaal by die Department of Sport, Arts and Culture, wat bestuursstrukture, parlementêre skakeling en belanghebbende-koördinasine in Pretoria behartig.
af.duties: Bestuur van bestuursstrukture, parlementêre en belanghebbende-koördinasie- Bestuur die implementering van bestuurs- en transformasie-inisiatiewe ter ondersteuning van die departement se strategiese doelwitte; Koördineer die funksionering van bestuursstrukture, komitees en forums binne die kantoor van die Direkteur-generaal; Koördineer FOSAD-clusteraktiwiteite, bestuursforums en instellingsbeleidkoördinasieprosesse; Bestuur parlementêre skakelingsdienste, insluitend die koördinasie van parlementêre vrae, komitee-antwoorde, kennigewings en voorleggings; Monitor die implementering van besluite en besluite wat uit bestuursstrukture voortspruit en verskaf vorderingverslae; Ontwikkel en implementeer bestuurstelsels, prosedures en standaardbedryfsprosesse om instellingsbestuur te versterk; Koördineer belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en instellingsbestuursinisiatiewe met relevante belanghebbendes; Fasiliteer bestuursverwante beplanning, monitering, evaluering en verslagdoeningsprosesse; Doen navorsing en verskaf tegniese advies oor bestuur en departementele instellingseffektiwiteit; Bestuur en koördineer administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Distrikontwikkelingsmodel (DDM)-Bestuur die verskaffing van administratiewe, sekretariaats- en koördinasie-ondersteuningsdienste binne die kantoor van die DG; Bestuur register-, rekord- en dokumentbestuursdienste binne die kantoor van die DG, met versekering van nakoming van die rekordbestuursraamwerk; Koördineer die departement se deelname aan DDM-strukture en verwante aktiwiteite, vergaderings en verslagdoeningsvereistes; Monitor implementering van DDM-toewydings, besluite, aksieplanne en verskaf vorderingverslae aan bestuur; Fasiliteer samewerking en inligtingdeling met nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regeringsbelanghebbendes om DDM-implementering te ondersteun; Koördineer departementele deelname aan DDM-inisiatiewe; Koördineer administratiewe stelsels en ondersteuningsprosesse om operasionele doeltreffendheid te verbeter; Verskaf aanbevelings vir verbeterde operasionele doeltreffendheid binne uitvoerende ondersteuningsstrukture; Hersien en konsolideer voorleggings binne die Hoofdirektoraat; Koördineer departementele insette tot MINMEC, NEDLAC en verwante interregeringsforums; Koördineer instellingsbestuursnakoming en verslagdoening-Bestuur en monitor nakoming van bestuursbeleid, -raamwerke, -prosedures en toepaslike voorskrifte; koördineer die opstel en indiening van bestuurs-, parlementêre en uitvoerende administratiewe verslae; Bestuur en spoor implementering van bestuursverwante toewydings en aanbevelings wat uit bestuursstrukture en toesigliggame voortspruit, na; Identifiseer bestuurs-, nakomings- en operasionele risiko's wat bestuursintervensie vereis; Koördineer departementele reaksies op bestuursverwante ouditbevindings en monitor die implementering van aksieplanne; Monitor nakoming van bestuursinligting- en verslagdoeningsvereistes en verseker die tydige indiening van verslae by relevante toesigstrukture; Verskaf bestuersondersteuning en advies aan bestuur en relevante belanghebbendes; Koördineer interregerings- en belanghebbenderelaties-Bestuur en koördineer die departement se deelname aan interregeringsstrukture en -forums; Koördineer betrokkenheid by regeringsdepartemente, openbare entiteite en ander relevante belanghebbendes om die bereiking van departementele doelwitte te ondersteun; Ontwikkel en onderhou belanghebbende-databasisse en betrokkenheidsplanne om instellingskoördinasie te versterk; Monitor implementering van belanghebbende-toewydings, besluite en aksieplanne en verskaf vorderingverslae aan bestuur; Fasiliteer inligtingdeling, koördinasie en samewerking binne regeringsfere; Koördineer departementele deelname aan bestuurs-, parlementêre en belanghebbendeplatforms om die tydige voorbereiding van kennigewings, verslae en voorleggings te verseker; Verskaf sekretariaats- en administratiewe ondersteuning vir belanghebbende- en interregeringsforums; Bestuur die Direktoraat-Verskaf strategiese leierskap, bestuur en prestasietoesig oor menslike, finansiële, inligtings- en ander hulpbronne binne die Direktoraat; Ontwikkel, implementeer, monitor en hersien die Direktoraat se operasionele en prestasieplanne om belyning met departementele prioriteite te verseker; Bestuur prestasie, risiko's, interne beheer en ouditprosesse, en verseker die implementering van korrektiewe aksieplanne wat uit ouditbevindings en risiko-assessering voortspruit; Konsolideer en koördineer verslae, voorleggings en aanbiedings oor bestuursstrukture;

zu.title: Umphathi: Ihhofisi likaMqondisi-Jikelele
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikabaphathi eHhofisini likaMqondisi-Jikelele Kumnqathi wezemidlalo, Bonakaliso namasiko, ephatha izakhiwo zolawulo, ukuxhumana nomkhandlu wedolobha kanye nokuqondanisa abaningisi ePretoria.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha Izakhiwo Zolawulo, Ukuxhumana Nomkhandlu Wedolobha kanye Nokuqondanisa Aboxingisi- Phatha ukuphunyulwa kwezinhloso zolawulo kanye nezinyathelo zokushintsha ukuze kusekelwe imigomo ebalulekile yomnyango; Qondanisa ukusebenza kwezakhiwo zolawulo, amakomidi kanye namapholomu ahlezi ehhofisini likaMqondisi-Jikelele; Qondanisa imisebenzi yamagugu eFOSAD, amapholomu olawulo kanye nezinqubo zokuqondanisa izinqubomgomo zale ngabeke; Phatha izinsiza zokuxhumana nomkhandlu wedolobha, okuhlanganisa ukuqondanisa imibuzo yomkhandlu wedolobha, izimpendulo zamakomidi, okubhaliwe okubalulekile kanye nezithunywa; Qaphela ukuphunyulwa kwezinqumo kanye nemiqondo evela ezakhiweni zolawulo bese uhlinzeka ngemibiko yentuthuko; Lungisa bese uphatha amasistimu olawulo, izinqubo kanye nezinqubo ezivamile zokusebenza ukuze kuqiniswe ulawulo lwe ngabe; Qondanisa ukuzibandakanya kwababoxingisi kanye nezinhloso zolawulo le ngabe nababoxingisi abahlobene; Qedisa ukulungiselela, ukuqapha, ukuhlolisisa kanye nezinqubo zokubika ezihlobene nolawulo; Yenza ucwaningo bese uhlinzeka ngeluleko lezobuchwepheshe ngolawulo kanye nekusasa lokusebenza komnyango; Phatha bese uqondanisa ukusekelwa ngokuphatha kuhlelo lokuthuthukiswa Kwesifunda (DDM); Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuphatha, zokubhala amaminithi kanye nokuqondanisa izinsiza ehhofisini likaDG; Phatha ukuqoshwa kwemiqondo, amarekhodi kanye nezinsiza zokuphatha amafayela ehhofisini likaDG, ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nomqondo wokuphatha amarekhodi; Qondanisa ukuthatha inxaxheba komnyango kumaqembu eDDM kanye nemisebenzi ephathelene nakho, izinkumsha kanye nezidingo zokubika; Qaphela ukuphunyulwa kwezithembiso, izinqumo, izinhlelo zomsebenzi zeDDM bese uhlinzeka ngemibiko yentuthuko kubaphathi; Qedisa ukusebenzisana kanye nokwabelana ngolwazi nababoxingisi kahulumeni wezwe, wesifundazwe kanye nedolobha ukuze kusekelwe ukuphunyulwa kweDDM; Qondanisa ukuthatha inxaxheba komnyango ezinhlosweni zeDDM; Qondanisa amasistimu okuphatha kanye nezin0026nbsp;qubo zokusekelwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle; Hlinzeka ngezincomo zokuthuthukiswa kokusebenza kahle ezakhiweni zokusekelwa abaphathi; Hlolisisa bese uhlanganisa izithunywa eNdimeni yobuNhloko; Qondanisa imibhalo yomnyango kwiMINMEC, NEDLAC kanye namapholomu ahlezi kahulumeni phakathi; Qondanisa ukuhambisana kweNgebe Nolawulo kanye Nokubika- Phatha bese uqaphela ukuhambisana nezinqubomgomo zolawulo, imiqondo, izinqubo kanye nezibhalo ezisebenzayo; qondanisa ukuqoqwa nokuthunyelwa kwemibiko yolawulo, yomkhandlu wedolobha kanye yezokuphatha; Phatha bese ulandela ukuphunyulwa kwezithembiso eziqhathaniswe nolawulo kanye nezincomo eziphuma ezakhiweni zolawulo kanye emaqenjini aqaphayo; Hlola imikhihizo yolawulo, yokuhambisana neyokusebenza edinga ingxenye yabaphathi; Qondanisa izimpendulo zomnyango eziphatelene nokubhekwa kwezolawulo bese uqaphela ukuphunyulwa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi; Qaphela ukuhambisana nolwazi nolawulo kanye nezidingo zokubika bese uqinisekisa ukuthunyelwa ngokushesha kwemibiko ezakhiweni zokuqapha eziyidingo; Hlinzeka ngokusekelwa ngeneluleko ngolawulo kubaphathi nakuwababoxingisi abahlobene; Qondanisa Ubudlelwano Kahulumeni Phakathi kanye Naba Boxingisi- Phatha bese uqondanisa ukuthatha inxaxheba komnyango ezakhiweni nasepholomini kahulumeni phakathi; Qondanisa ukuzibandakanya namaphiwe namanye ababoxingisi abahlobene ukuze kusekelwe ukufeza imigomo yomnyango; Lungisa bese ulondoloza idatha yaba boxingisi kanye nezinhlela zokuzibandakanya ukuze kuqiniswe ukuqondanisa nge ngabe; Qaphela ukuphunyulwa kwezithembiso zababa boxingisi, izinqumo kanye nezinhlelo zomsebenzi bese uhlinzeka ngemibiko yentuthuko kubaphathi; Qedisa ukwabelana ngolwazi ukuqondanisa kanye nokusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinqubomgomo kahulumeni; Qondanisa ukuthatha inxaxheba komnyango kumasistimu olawulo, womkhandlu wedolobha kanye nababa boxingisi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulungiselela ngokushesha kwezibhalo, imibiko nezithunywa; Hlinzeka ngezinsiza zokubhala amaminithi kanye nokuphatha kumapholomu ababa boxingisi nakahulumeni phakathi; Phatha iDimu- Hlinzeka ngobuholo obusemgangathweni, ukuphatha kanye nokuqapha ukusebenza kwezinsiza zabantu, zemali, yolwazi kwezinye eDimentu; Lungisa, phatha, qaphela bese uhlolisisa izinhlelo zokusebenza kwezinhlelo zokusebenza nezinhlelo zokusebenza zesibili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana nezinhloso eziyinhloko zesigungu; Phatha ukusebenza, imikhihizo, ukuqapha ngaphakathi bese uhlela izinqubo zokubuka, bese uqinisekisa ukuphunyulwa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokulungisa ezivela ekubhekweni kwezinto kanye nokuqaphwa kwe mikhihizo; Hlanganisa bese uqondanisa imibiko, izithunywa kanye neziphakamiso ezakhiweni zolawulo;

xh.title: Um lawuli: Ofisi kaM lawuli jikelele
xh.summary: Indima kaM lawuli kwi Ofisi kaM lawuli-Jikelele kwi Department of Sport, Arts and Culture, elawulayo iindawo zolawulo, unxibelelwano nge Palamente nokuququzelelwa kwabahlobo kwi Pretoria.
xh.duties: Ukulawula Iindawo Zolawulo, I Palamente Nokukuququzelela Abahlobo- Lawula ukusebenza kweenjongo zolawulo nentshintsho ngokuxhasa iinjongo ezingundoqo zesebe; Ququzelela ukusebenza kweendawo zolawulo, iikomiti namajelo ngaphakathi kwofisi kaM lawuli-Jikelele; Ququzelela imisebenzi yeFOSAD Cluster, amajelo olawulo neenqubo zokuququzelela iinkqubo zesebe; Lawula iinkonzo zonxibelelwano nge Palamente, kuquka ukuququzelela imibuzo yesi Palamente, iimpendulo zeekomiti, iifayile zomceli kunye neenjongo ezithunyelwayo; Lilonda ukusebenza kwezigqibo kunye nesigqibo evela kwiindawo zolawulo kwaye unike iingxelo ngemvelaphi; Yakha kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo kunye neenqubo ezisezantsi zokusebenza ukuqinisa ulawulo lesebe; Ququzelela unxibelelwano nabahlobo kunye neenjongo zolawulo zesebe nabahlobo abafanelekileyo; Yenza kube lula ukucelelana ngolawulo, ukulonda, ukucinga kunye neenqubo zokwenza iingxelo; Yenza uphando kwaye unike izimvo zobugcisa ngolawulo ngenkqubeleko zesebe; Lawula kwaye uququzelele inkxaso yolawulo kwi District Development Model (DDM)- Lawula ukunikwa kwenkxaso yolawulo, yababhali-magama nokukuququzelela iinkonzo ngaphakathi kwofisi ka DG; Lawula iinkonzo zokubhalisa, zokugcina oovimba bakudala kunye nokulawula amaxwebhu ngaphakathi kwofisi ka DG, kuqinisekiswa ukuzithobela inkqubo yokugcina oovimba bakudala; Ququzelela ukuthatha inxaxheba kwesebe kwiindawo zeDDM nakwezinye iinkalo ezidityaniswe nayo, iintlanganiso kunye neemfuno zokwenza iingxelo; Lilonda ukusebenza kwezithembiso zeDDM, izigqibo, iinkqubo zentshukumo kwaye unike iingxelo ngemvelaphi kulawulo; Yenza kube lulu unxibelelwano nokwabelana ngenkcazelo ngabahlobo kurhulumente welizwe, karhulumente weliphondo karhulumente wedolophu ukuze kuxhaswe ukusebenza kweDDM; Ququzelela ukuthatha inxaxheba kwesebe kwiinkalo zeDDM; Ququzelela iinkqubo zolawulo nentshabalo yeenkxaso ukuphucula inkqubo yemisebenzi; Nikeza izimvo zokuphucula inkqubo yemisebenzi ngaphakathi kweendawo zexhaso elinye ixabiso; Phinda ucocise kwaye udibanise iinjongo ezithunyelwayo ngaphakathi koM lawuli oyiNtloko; Ququzelela izimvo zesebe kwi MINMEC, NEDLAC nakwezinye amajelo karhulumente ongaphakathi; Ququzelela Ukuzithobela Kolawulo Lesebe Nokwenza Iingxelo- Lawula kwaye ulonde ukuzithobela iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo, iindlela kunye nemithetho; ququzelela ukuqokelelwa kunye nokuthunyelwa kweengxelo zolawulo, zesi Palamente nolawulo; Lawula kwaye ulande ukusebenza kwezithembiso ezinxulumene nolawulo kunye nezimvo evela kwindawo yolawulo nakumaziko okulawula; Chonga iingozi zolawulo, zokuzithobela nentengiso ezifuna ukungenelelwa kulawulo; Ququzelela iimpendulo zesebe kwiimfuno zolawulo ezivela kwisikolo kwaye ulonde ukusebenza kweenkqubo zentshukumo; Lilonda ukuzithobela ngenkcazelo yolawulo kunye neemfuno zokwenza iingxelo kwaye uqinisekise ukuzithunyelwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo kweengxelo kwizinto ezifanelekileyo ezilawulayo; Nikeza inkxaso yamava ngolawulo nezimvo kulawulo nakubahlobo abafanelekileyo; Ququzelela Unxibelelwano Karhulumente Nakubahlobo- Lawula kwaye uququzelele ukuthatha inxaxheba kwesebe kundawo zolawulo kunye namajelo karhulumente; Ququzelela ukuthetha nayo iisebe karhulumente, amaziko karhulumente nakunye abanye abahlobo ukuxasa ukufezekiswa kweenjongo zesebe; Yakha kwaye ugcine iidatabhisi zabahlobo ngenkqubo yokuthetha ukuqinisa ukulawula kwesebe; Lilonda ukusebenza kwezithembiso zabahlobo, izigqibo namanqaku entshukumo kwaye unike iingxelo kulawulo; Yenza kube lula ukwabelana ngenkcazelo nokulawula kwaye kwabahlobo ngaphakathi kwamagunya karhulumente; Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring certified copies of ID, Driver’s licence (where required) and qualifications on or before the interview. Should you be in possession of any foreign qualification(s), it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA); Applicants must be South African citizens. Shortlisted candidates must avail themselves for a virtual or in-person panel interview at a date and time determined by DSAC. The applicant should make own arrangement for access to internet connectivity and equipment for this purpose. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks and references will be conducted once they are shortlisted. The appointment is also subject to a positive outcome on these checks, including security clearance, security vetting, qualification/study verification, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, previous employment verification and criminal record. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. We encourage all applicants to declare any criminal and/or negative credit records. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment, the logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and sign an annual performance agreement. The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its Employment Equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of these posts. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes, thus withdrawing this advert by notice on its communication channels. Prior to appointment for SMS post, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by the DPSA, which is an online course endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full    details     can     be      sourced    from      the     following   link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

Hlela izinhloso ezinkulu mayelana nokugcinwa nokulondolozwa; Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho, izindinganiso, imigomo nokusebenza ngemizingcanokwethu emhlabeni jikelele; Hlanganisa imiklamo yokwenza amakhodi ngesikhathi esithile ukuthi abantu bafinyelele kalula futhi bagcine imibhalo yomlando; Beka ngokuqhubekayo imininingwane yokuze kwenzeke ukulondolozwa kwezinto ezibalulekile futhi uhlele imibhalo yazo; Buka isimo sezinto ezithile bese usinquma ukuthi yikuphi ukulondolozwa okufanele kwenziwe; Qinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinyathelo zokuqaphela ukuthi kungabi yinkinga yokonakala kwezinto; Qaphelela imiklamo yokulondolozwa bese uqinisekisa ukuthi izindinganiso ziqhutshwa ngendlela efanele; Yonke into egcinwayo iqinisekiswe ukuthi igcinwe futhi kuhlelwe imithetho yokugcina izinto ezibalulekile eendaweni ezivikelekile- Gcina futhi ulungise imikhakha yokugcina izinto ezingabolulekile; Qaphele imimo yemvelo kanye nokuthi uma kungase kube nobungozi bokwenza okubi, okubandayo, okukhanyayo, noma okukhipha izinambuzane; Qinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zokugcina ezifanele nezinto eziklanyelwe ukugcinwa kwezinto zisaphezulu lokuze kusebenze; Hlela imiklamo yokulungisa izimpahla ezindala noma ezingasebenziseki, bese uhlela imiklamo yokuvikela izinto ezibalulekile ezingase zikhwezwe; Hlola rhoqo imiphumela yezinsulu ukuze uqaphele inkinga ezikuluthaza izinto ezigciniwe; Zifake ezinhloshini ukuzivikela ema-songo amabi angaholela ekubeni isicoco, inkinga yemvelo noma enye inkinga ethize; Celisani izinhlela ezithuthukayo ngokuqonda kakhulu ngakho konke okusha mayelana nekhompyutha nezinye izinhlela- Bhekisisa, phinda ubuke, bese usebenzisa imigomo, izindinganiso, imiyalo, kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile mayelana nokugcinwa, ukulondolozwa kanye nokuguqula izinto zibe ikhodi; Hlela imigomo nokuze kuhambisane nokuze kuthuthukiswe ukubakhulelisa abantu; Nikeza ngeluleko nezinkomba ngokugcinwa, ukulondolozwa kanye nokwenza izinto zibe khodi; Siza ekutheni kube khona ukuzwa cabanga nokuxwayiswa ngemigomo yokuze kugcinwe ngokuthi kuhlelwa imiklamo yokuzilolonga; Hlola imigomo ejwayelekile yokukwazi ukulawula ukusebenza ngokulingene nemigomo yokuze igxile ekuhlanganiseni imigomo yomsebenzi, ukusebenza ngokugxila, imigomo mayelana nokubakhulelisa, isikhathi esihle sokwenza imisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezinga elithile lokuziphendulela; Bhekisisa imigomo mayelana nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi yokugcina imiphumela yezinto emihle, futhi wenze izinto ezinhle ukusebenza ngokuthi kuhlelwangamakhono abantu nokuphatha imiklamo yokuze kube khona ukuxhumana nemiphumela yokusiza ukuphatha imali. Buka imiklamo eqoqo ukuthi kwenzeke ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwemali, izikhulu nabanye abantu; Beka futhi uhlele imigomo eminingi mayelana nokuthi kuhlolwe ngakho okungase kuthi kubangelwa ukuthi kungatholakali ukuphathwa kwezinsulu; Bhekisisa imigomo yokuthi kufanele kubakho ukuba khona kwezinto kanye nokuqoqa imininingwane ehle; Phatha isikhungo sakho, kuhambisana nemigomo yomthetho; Yenza ukubakhulelisa abantu ngokuthi babe nesabelo sokuphathwa kwemisebenzi ehambisana nemigomo yabo; Yenza imigomo mayelana nokuphathwa kwemali ngokuthi kubakho izinhlelo ezithize nokuba khona kwesikhathi esifanele, futhi kwenze abantu bakhule ngokuphatha imali ngokulawulwa kahle; Hlela imigomo yokuze kube khona ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi ngokuthi kwenzeke abantu abathile, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi bayakwazi ukuphatha imali ngokuthi bahlele imigomo ehle; Qoqa imininingwane ngokuze kwaziwe ukuthi abantu bakhuleka ngani kanye nokuze kugcinwe imininingwane yabo; Hlola ukuthi imigomo iphila ngokuthi kuhlelwa imigomo ehle nokuze kwenzeke abantu basebenze kahle; Hlela imigomo ehle yokuphatha imali, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi imali ihleleke ngendlela efanele; Hlela imigomo mayelana nokuthi kufanele kube khona ukulawulwa kwemali ehle ngokuthi kube khona imigomo ehle yokuphatha imali; Bhekisisa imigomo mayelana nokuphathwa kwemali kanti futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ngaphezu kwakho konke kwenzeke abantu basebenze kahle

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Governance Structures and Committees
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package) consisting of a basic salary (70/ 75% of the total remuneration package), State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules and guidelines.
jobs.summary: Coordinate parliamentary and governance matters, manage committee relationships and interactions between the Department and Parliament.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; Minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6) / Degree (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Political Science/ Public Administration/ Government Studies/ Public Policy/ Public Management/ Office Management or any related administration qualification; 3-5 years relevant experience, at least 3 years at an Assistant Director level in parliamentary support services, coordination of government structures, committee administration or any relevant governance administration environment; Knowledge of Parliamentary procedures and processes; Knowledge of public sector governance frameworks, policy and procedures; Knowledge and understanding of Constitution of the Republic of South Africa; Understanding of government and legislative systems; Policy analysis and legislative monitoring; Report writing and presentation skills; Problem-solving and decision-making; Planning and coordination; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; Good communication and Interpersonal relations; Computer Literacy; Project Management Skills; Ability to work as a team; Ability to work under pressure; Professional Integrity; Confidentiality
jobs.duties: Manage the coordination of parliamentary services-Develop and implement systems and processes to coordinate parliamentary and governance matters; Coordinate all interactions between the Department, its entities and Parliament; Manage relationships with parliamentary committees, Members of Parliament, parliamentary support staff and other relevant stakeholders; Coordinate the preparation, quality assurance and submission of parliamentary questions, replies, briefing notes, presentations and other parliamentary documents; Facilitate the attendance and participation of the Executive Authority and departmental officials in parliamentary committee meetings, hearings, oversight visits and other parliamentary engagements; Ensure departmental representation at parliamentary events and official engagements; Monitor compliance with parliamentary procedures, protocols, reporting requirements and prescribed timeframes; Provide advice and guidance on parliamentary procedures, governance matters and legislative processes; Coordinate parliamentary committee support services and monitor the implementation of parliamentary committee resolutions; Prepare and submit parliamentary governance reports and performance reports for management; Manage government structures- Develop and implement governance frameworks, policies and standard operating procedures for departmental governance structures and committees; Coordinate the establishment, review and effective functioning of governance structures and committees; Develop work plans for governance structures and committees; Ensure the effective planning, coordination and administration of governance committee meetings; Review committee agendas, reports and supporting documentation to ensure quality, accuracy and compliance; Monitor the implementation of committee resolutions and track progress on action items; Ensure governance structures comply with legislative, regulatory and departmental requirements; Coordinate the review of committee terms of reference, delegations of authority and governance charters; Provide governance advice and secretariat support to governance structures; Compile governance reports and recommendations for Executive Management; Coordinate the administration of departmental governance committees-Coordinate the end-to-end administrative support for departmental governance committees; Develop and maintain annual meeting schedules and committee calendars; Coordinate the preparation and distribution of meeting notices, agendas and committee packs; Ensure the accurate recording and timely distribution of committee minutes; Maintain an effective system for recording committee decisions and maintaining the resolution register; Maintain governance committee records and ensure effective filing and document management; Coordinate logistical and administrative arrangements for governance committee meetings; Manage stakeholder liaison and governance-Develop and implement stakeholder engagement strategies relating to governance structures and committees; Establish and maintain effective relationships with government departments, public entities, oversight bodies and other governance stakeholders; Coordinate intergovernmental governance forums, committee engagements and stakeholder consultations; Provide governance advice and support to relevant stakeholders; Facilitate communication between governance committees and relevant stakeholders; Coordinate awareness and capacity- building initiatives on governance frameworks, committee processes and compliance requirements; Represent the Department on governance forums, interdepartmental committees and working groups; Prepare governance reports, briefing documents and stakeholder engagement reports; Manage the sub-directorate- Allocate work to subordinates; Provide advice on governance structures and committees; Ensure training and development to subordinates; Facilitate the performance agreement of subordinates; Monitor proper filing for record and audit purposes; Coordinate responses to audit findings; Identify organisational risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures; Ensure sound governance, compliance, ethics and internal control within the Sub- Directorate; Ensure compliance with all applicable legislative and departmental prescripts.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Bestuursstrukture en Komitees
af.summary: Koördineer parlementêre en bestuursake, bestuur komiteeverhoudinge en wisselwerking tussen die departement en die Parlement.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate of ekwivalente kwalifikasie; Minimum driedelige National Diploma (NQF vlak 6) / Degree (NQF vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Political Science/ Public Administration/ Government Studies/ Public Policy/ Public Management/ Office Management of enige verwante administrasiekwalifikasie; 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring, waarvan ten minste 3 jaar op 'n Assistant Director-vlak in parlementêre ondersteuningsdienste, koördinering van regeringsstrukture, komitee-administrasie of enige relevante bestuursadministrasie-omgewing; Kennis van Parlementêre prosedures en prosesse; Kennis van openbare-sektor bestuursraamwerke, beleid en prosedures; Kennis en begrip van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika; Begrip van regerings- en wetgewende stelsels; Beleidsontleding en wetgewende monitering; Verslagskryf- en aanbiedingsvaardighede; Probleemoplossing en besluitneming; Beplanning en koördinering; Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus; Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Projekbestuursvaardighede; Vermoë om as 'n span te werk; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Professionele integriteit; Vertroulikheid
af.duties: Bestuur die koördinering van parlementêre dienste-Ontwikkel en implementeer stelsels en prosesse om parlementêre en bestuursake te koördineer; Koördineer alle wisselwerking tussen die departement, sy entiteite en die Parlement; Bestuur verhoudinge met parlementêre komitees, lede van die Parlement, parlementêre ondersteuningspersoneel en ander relevante belanghebbendes; Koördineer die voorbereiding, gehalteversekering en indiening van parlementêre vrae, antwoorde, kortingsnotas, aanbiedings en ander parlementêre dokumente; Fasiliteer die bywoning en deelname van die uitvoerende gesag en departementele amptenare in parlementêre komiteevergaderings, verhore, toesigbesoeke en ander parlementêre betrokkenhede; Verseker departementele verteenwoordiging by parlementêre geleenthede en amptelike betrokkenhede; Monitor nakoming van parlementêre prosedures, protokolle, verslagdoeningsvereistes en voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke; Verskaf advies en leiding oor parlementêre prosedures, bestuursake en wetgewende prosesse; Koördineer ondersteuningsdienste vir parlementêre komitees en monitor die implementering van parlementêre komiteebesluite; Berei parlementêre bestuursverslae en prestasieverslae voor en dien dit vir bestuur in; Bestuur regeringsstrukture- Ontwikkel en implementeer bestuursraamwerke, beleide en standaardbedryfsprosedures vir departementele bestuursstrukture en komitees; Koördineer die instelling, hersiening en effektiewe funksionering van bestuursstrukture en komitees; Ontwikkel werksplanne vir bestuursstrukture en komitees; Verseker die effektiewe beplanning, koördinering en administrasie van bestuurskomiteevergaderings; Hersien komitee-agendas, verslae en ondersteunende dokumentasie om gehalte, akkuraatheid en nakoming te verseker; Monitor die implementering van komiteebesluite en hou vorderings met aksiepunte dop; Verseker dat bestuursstrukture voldoen aan wetgewende, regulerende en departementele vereistes; Koördineer die hersiening van komitee-voorwaardes van verwysing, magtigingsdelegasies en bestuurshandveste; Verskaf bestuursadvies en sekretariatssteun aan bestuursstrukture; Stel bestuursverslae en aanbevelings vir uitvoerende bestuur saam; Koördineer die administrasie van departementele bestuurskomitees-Koördineer end-tot-end administratiewe steun vir departementele bestuurskomitees; Ontwikkel en handhaaf jaarlikse vergaderskedules en komiteekalenders; Koördineer die voorbereiding en verspreiding van vergaderkennisgewings, agendas en komiteepakkette; Verseker die akkurate optekening en tydige verspreiding van komiteenotule; Handhaaf 'n effektiewe stelsel vir die optekening van komiteebesluite en die handhawing van die besluitregister; Handhaaf bestuurskomiteerekords en verseker effektiewe lêer- en dokumentbestuur; Koördineer logistiese en administratiewe reëlings vir bestuurskomiteevergaderings; Bestuur belanghebbende-skakeling en bestuur-Ontwikkel en implementeer strategiese vir belanghebbende-betrokkenheid met betrekking tot bestuursstrukture en komitees; Vestig en handhaaf effektiewe verhoudinge met regeringsdepartemente, openbare entiteite, toesigliggame en ander bestuursbelanghebbendes; Koördineer intergoreringsbestuursforums, komiteebetrokkenhede en konsultasies met belanghebbendes; Verskaf bestuursadvies en steun aan relevante belanghebbendes; Fasiliteer kommunikasie tussen bestuurskomitees en relevante belanghebbendes; Koördineer bewustheids- en kapasiteitsbou-ineenitiatiewe oor bestuursraamwerke, komiteeprosesse en nakomingsvereistes; Verteenwoordig die departement op bestuursforums, interdepartementele komitees en werkgroepe; Berei bestuursverslae, kortingsdokumente en verslae oor belanghebbende-betrokkenheid voor; Bestuur die subdirektoraat-Ken werk aan ondergeskiktes toe; Verskaf advies oor bestuursstrukture en komitees; Verseker opleiding en ontwikkeling van ondergeskiktes; Fasiliteer prestasie-ooreenkomste van ondergeskiktes; Monitor behoorlike lêerwerk vir rekord- en ouditdoeleindes; Koördineer reaksies op ouditbevindinge; Identifiseer organisatoriese risiko's en implementeer toepaslike verminderingsmaatreëls; Verseker deeglike bestuur, nakoming, etiek en interne beheer binne die subdirektoraat; Verseker nakoming van alle toepaslike wetgewende en departementele voorskrifte.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokumiswa Komqondisi Omncane: Izakhiwo Zokuphatha Nezikomidi
zu.summary: Hlela izindaba zephulamenti nokuphathwa kwezomphathazwe, ziphathe izinhlobonhlobo zezinkomidi kanye nezinxhumanisi phakathi kwezinyango naphakathi kwesigungo somkhandlu.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; Minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6) / Degree (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Political Science/ Public Administration/ Government Studies/ Public Policy/ Public Management/ Office Management or any related administration qualification; 3-5 years relevant experience, at least 3 years at an Assistant Director level in parliamentary support services, coordination of government structures, committee administration or any relevant governance administration environment; Knowledge of Parliamentary procedures and processes; Knowledge of public sector governance frameworks, policy and procedures; Knowledge and understanding of Constitution of the Republic of South Africa; Understanding of government and legislative systems; Policy analysis and legislative monitoring; Report writing and presentation skills; Problem-solving and decision-making; Planning and coordination; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; Good communication and Interpersonal relations; Computer Literacy; Project Management Skills; Ability to work as a team; Ability to work under pressure; Professional Integrity; Confidentiality
zu.duties: Manage the coordination of parliamentary services-Develop and implement systems and processes to coordinate parliamentary and governance matters; Coordinate all interactions between the Department, its entities and Parliament; Manage relationships with parliamentary committees, Members of Parliament, parliamentary support staff and other relevant stakeholders; Coordinate the preparation, quality assurance and submission of parliamentary questions, replies, briefing notes, presentations and other parliamentary documents; Facilitate the attendance and participation of the Executive Authority and departmental officials in parliamentary committee meetings, hearings, oversight visits and other parliamentary engagements; Ensure departmental representation at parliamentary events and official engagements; Monitor compliance with parliamentary procedures, protocols, reporting requirements and prescribed timeframes; Provide advice and guidance on parliamentary procedures, governance matters and legislative processes; Coordinate parliamentary committee support services and monitor the implementation of parliamentary committee resolutions; Prepare and submit parliamentary governance reports and performance reports for management; Manage government structures- Develop and implement governance frameworks, policies and standard operating procedures for departmental governance structures and committees; Coordinate the establishment, review and effective functioning of governance structures and committees; Develop work plans for governance structures and committees; Ensure the effective planning, coordination and administration of governance committee meetings; Review committee agendas, reports and supporting documentation to ensure quality, accuracy and compliance; Monitor the implementation of committee resolutions and track progress on action items; Ensure governance structures comply with legislative, regulatory and departmental requirements; Coordinate the review of committee terms of reference, delegations of authority and governance charters; Provide governance advice and secretariat support to governance structures; Compile governance reports and recommendations for Executive Management; Coordinate the administration of departmental governance committees-Coordinate the end-to-end administrative support for departmental governance committees; Develop and maintain annual meeting schedules and committee calendars; Coordinate the preparation and distribution of meeting notices, agendas and committee packs; Ensure the accurate recording and timely distribution of committee minutes; Maintain an effective system for recording committee decisions and maintaining the resolution register; Maintain governance committee records and ensure effective filing and document management; Coordinate logistical and administrative arrangements for governance committee meetings; Manage stakeholder liaison and governance-Develop and implement stakeholder engagement strategies relating to governance structures and committees; Establish and maintain effective relationships with government departments, public entities, oversight bodies and other governance stakeholders; Coordinate intergovernmental governance forums, committee engagements and stakeholder consultations; Provide governance advice and support to relevant stakeholders; Facilitate communication between governance committees and relevant stakeholders; Coordinate awareness and capacity- building initiatives on governance frameworks, committee processes and compliance requirements; Represent the Department on governance forums, interdepartmental committees and working groups; Prepare governance reports, briefing documents and stakeholder engagement reports; Manage the sub-directorate- Allocate work to subordinates; Provide advice on governance structures and committees; Ensure training and development to subordinates; Facilitate the performance agreement of subordinates; Monitor proper filing for record and audit purposes; Coordinate responses to audit findings; Identify organisational risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures; Ensure sound governance, compliance, ethics and internal control within the Sub- Directorate; Ensure compliance with all applicable legislative and departmental prescripts.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Terminology Coordination-isixhosa
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.summary: Coordinate isiXhosa multilingual technical terminology services, including source and target text development, project management and stakeholder collaboration.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; A minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Language Practice/ Linguistics/ Translation and Interpreting Studies/ BA /BEd with a major in isiXhosa; 2-3 years relevant experience with at least 2 years as a Language Practitioner in a terminological or lexicographical environment; Knowledge of Public Service Regulations; Knowledge of terminological and lexicographical principles; Knowledge of relevant prescripts and Regulations; Knowledge and understanding of Language policies and procedures; Knowledge of Terminology Management System; Strong editing, proofreading, and writing skills; Excellent command of at least two official languages (including English); Project Management skills; advanced computer skills; Problem solving and Analysis; Presentation skills; Good Communication and interpersonal relations
jobs.duties: The purpose of the position is to ensure that a multilingual technical terminology service is rendered in the department through source text development; target text development; compilation of front and back matter; project management; stakeholder collaboration; development of national terminology policy and implementation; publication and dissemination of terminology lists; recording of minutes; translation-oriented terminography; conducting terminology research; management of the Terminology Management System (TMS); management of the National Terminology Register and the National Term Bank; conducting training on principles of terminology management and people management. Collaboration with other language stakeholders and continuous liaison with institutions and members of language communities; Supervise subordinates.
jobs.applications: Applicants must use this link below to access DSAC E-Recruitment System https://erecruit.dsac.gov.za/public/login_test.php Hand delivery: Sealed envelope addressed to Chief Director: Human Resource Management and Development, Sechaba House, 202 Madiba Street, Pretoria Central. Postal mail to The Chief Director: Human Resource Management and Development, Private Bag X897, Pretoria, 0001.
jobs.notes: Please create a user profile by completing all required personal information and setting up your login credentials. Once registration is complete, log in to the system and you will be directed to the “Welcome Page”. From the Welcome Page, you may browse all vacant positions opportunities listed below. Applicants are strongly advised to complete all information required for the electronic Z83 form on the system before applying for any position. The Z83 form has been adopted into the system, and applications cannot be processed unless all mandatory fields are completed. After completing your profile and Z83 information, you may apply for any relevant advertised position through the system. Ensure that your application is fully completed and submitted before the closing date, as incomplete or late applications will not be considered. Once submitted, the system will provide a confirmation message indicating that your application has been successfully received. The e- Recruitment portal is also accessible via smartphones and other mobile devices. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring certified copies of ID, Driver’s licence (where required) and qualifications on or before the interview. Should you be in possession of any foreign qualification(s), it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA); Applicants must be South African citizens. Shortlisted candidates must avail themselves for a virtual or in-person panel interview at a date and time determined by DSAC. The applicant should make own arrangement for access to internet connectivity and equipment for this purpose. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks and references will be conducted once they are shortlisted. The appointment is also subject to a positive outcome on these checks, including security clearance, security vetting, qualification/study verification, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, previous employment verification and criminal record. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. We encourage all applicants to declare any criminal and/or negative credit records. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment, the logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and sign an annual performance agreement. The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its Employment Equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of these posts. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes, thus withdrawing this advert by notice on its communication channels. Prior to appointment for SMS post, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by the DPSA, which is an online course endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full    details     can     be      sourced    from      the     following   link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Terminologie-koördinasie-isixhosa
af.summary: Koördineer isiXhosa veeltalige tegniese terminologiedienste, insluitend bron- en teikenteksonwikkeling, projekbestuur en belanghebbendesamewerking.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie; 'n minimum driejarige National Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF level 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Language Practice/ Linguistics/ Translation and Interpreting Studies/ BA /BEd met 'n hoofvak in isiXhosa; 2-3 jaar relevante ervaring met ten minste 2 jaar as 'n Taalpraktisyn in 'n terminologiese of leksikografiese omgewing; Kennis van Public Service Regulations; Kennis van terminologiese en leksikografiese beginsels; Kennis van relevante voorskrifte en regulasies; Kennis en begrip van taalbeleid en prosedures; Kennis van Terminology Management System; Sterk redigeer-, proeflees- en skryfvaardighede; Uitstekende beheer van ten minste twee amptelike tale (insluitend Engels); Projekbestuursvaardighede; gevorderde rekenaarvaardighede; Probleemoplossing en ontleding; Voorleggingsvaardighede; Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings
af.duties: Die doel van die pos is om te verseker dat 'n veeltalige tegniese terminologiediens in die departement gelewer word deur bronteksonwikkeling; teikenteksonwikkeling; samestelling van voor- en agterwerk; projekbestuur; belanghebbendesamewerking; ontwikkeling van nasionale terminologiebeleid en implementering; publikasie en verspreiding van terminologielyste; registrasie van notule; vertaalgerigte terminografie; uitvoer van terminologie-navorsing; bestuur van die Terminologie-bestuurstelsel (TMS); bestuur van die Nasionale Terminologieregister en die Nasionale Termbank; aanbied van opleiding oor beginsels van terminologiebestuur en mensebestuur. Samewerking met ander taalbelanghebbendes en voortdurende skakeling met instellings en lede van taalgemeenskappe; Ondergeskiktes toesig hou.

zu.title: Umqondisi ongedlebe: Ukuhlanganiswa kwamagama esayensi-isixhosa
zu.summary: Uhlela amagama obuchwepheshe we-isiXhosa ahamba phambili ngokuhlinzeka ngezenzo eziguqulelwa izilimi eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kombhalo wokuqala kanye nowajwayelekile, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi, kanye nokusebenzisana nalabo abathinta izinto.
zu.requirements: Izitifiketi samatikwele / Isitifiketi seMatric / Isitifiketi seGrade 12 noma isiqu esifanayo; Isidiploma sezwe izinkathi ezintathu (NQF level 6) / Isiqu (NQF level 7) esivunywe yi-SAQA kwezobuNgqinti / iziLimi / ukuHumusha kanye nokuChazamagama / i-BA / iBEd enkabeni ye-isiXhosa; 2-3 iminyaka yomuzamo ofanele ongenguqulo 2 iminyaka njengomuntu osebenza ngolimi endaweni yamagama abuchwepheshe noma izichazamagama; Ulwazi ngoMthetho waHulumeni; Ulwazi ngemigidingo yamagama abuchwepheshe kanye namagama esichazimagama; Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene nomgaqo nkqubo; Ulwazi nokuqonda iNqubomgomo kanye neziNqubo zezilimi; Ulwazi ngenqubo yokuphatha amagama abuchwepheshe; Amakhono okulungisa, okuphinda ubuke, kanye nokubhala; Ukumayelana kahle ngokuphelele izilimi ezinhlobonhlobo ezisemthethweni okungenani ezimbili (okuhlanganisa isiNgisi); Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi; amakhono obuchwepheshe bekhompyutha obungehla; Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya; Amakhono okubikezela emaphambilini; Ukuxhumana kahle kanye nabantu
zu.duties: Inhloso yesikhundla ukwenza kube nokuthi kuhlinzekwa inkonzo yobuchwepheshe eguqulela izilimi eziningi kumnqango ngokususwa kwombhalo wokuqala; ukuthuthukiswa kombhalo okujwayelekile; ukuhlanganiswa kokuqala nokuphetha yonke imibhalo; ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; ukusebenzisana namalungu abathintekayo; ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo yezibandakanya nokuqashelwa kwayo; ukushicilelwa kanye nokusatshalaliswa kohlu lwamagama abuchwepheshe; ukubhalwa kwemizuzu; amagama abuchwepheshe ahlongoza ukuhumusha; ukwenza ucwaningo ngamagama abuchwepheshe; ukuphathwa kwenqubo yokuphatha igama elinguqekelayo (TMS); ukuphathwa kweSazisi Samagama Esizwe kanye neBhange Lamagama Esizwe; ukuba ngumfundisi wemigidingo yokuphatha amagama abuchwepheshe kanye nokuphathwa kwabantu. Ukusebenzisana nalabo abathinta izilimi futhi nokuxhumana ngokuphatha izikhungo kanye namalungu omphakathi abakhuluma izilimi; Ukulawula abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho.

xh.summary: Ukulungelelanisa iinkonzo zamagama obuchwepheshe ayiilwimi ezininzi esiXhoseni, kuquka uphuhliso lwembhalo wemvelaphi nombhalo ojongiweyo, ulawulo lweprojekthi nokusebenzisana nabathathi-nxaxheba.

Ukusebenzisana nabanye abathathi-nxaxheba bolwimi nokuqhagamshelana rhoqo nemiqathango namalungu eqela labantu bolwimi; Ukulawula abangaphansi.

jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.summary: Provide translation and editing services between English and Siswati for the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; A minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Language Studies, Linguistics, Translation and Interpreting Studies majoring in the relevant language and/or translation, or relevant language qualification; 2-3 years relevant experience at least 2 years as a Language Practitioner in the translating environment; Knowledge of Public Service Regulations; Knowledge and understanding of relevant language policies and prescripts; Knowledge of translation/ editing/language administration; Excellent command of at least two official languages including English; Strong editing, proofreading, and writing skills; Good communication interpersonal relations; Ability to translate and edit text electronically.
jobs.duties: The purpose of this position is to promote access to information by providing translation and editing services; Translating official documents from English into Siswati and vice versa; Receive and review official documents for translation requirements; Study, analyse and excerpt problematic terms from source documents; Translate documents from English into Siswati; Translate documents from Siswati into English; Consult with subject matter experts or language specialists when necessary; Editing, checking and proofreading official documents translated into Siswati; Editing official documents written in Siswati; Checking and verifying the accuracy of edited documents; Proofreading final versions of official documents translated into Siswati; Ensuring quality and consistency in all translated and edited materials; Performing quality checks on all documents before final approval; Conduct research and develop terminology terms; Conduct research and consultation on translation issues; Review and revise existing terminology for clarity and accuracy–Coin and record new terms; Provide administrative support and liaison service; Archiving all translated and edited documents electronically; Reporting on progress; Liaise with stakeholders; Carry out tasks as requested by the supervisor; Assist and give advice to clients on language matters; Supervision of subordinates–Supervise translation activities of subordinates.
jobs.applications: Applicants must use this link below to access DSAC E-Recruitment System https://erecruit.dsac.gov.za/public/login_test.php Hand delivery: Sealed envelope addressed to Chief Director: Human Resource Management and Development, Sechaba House, 202 Madiba Street, Pretoria Central. Postal mail to The Chief Director: Human Resource Management and Development, Private Bag X897, Pretoria, 0001.
jobs.notes: Please create a user profile by completing all required personal information and setting up your login credentials. Once registration is complete, log in to the system and you will be directed to the “Welcome Page”. From the Welcome Page, you may browse all vacant positions opportunities listed below. Applicants are strongly advised to complete all information required for the electronic Z83 form on the system before applying for any position. The Z83 form has been adopted into the system, and applications cannot be processed unless all mandatory fields are completed. After completing your profile and Z83 information, you may apply for any relevant advertised position through the system. Ensure that your application is fully completed and submitted before the closing date, as incomplete or late applications will not be considered. Once submitted, the system will provide a confirmation message indicating that your application has been successfully received. The e- Recruitment portal is also accessible via smartphones and other mobile devices. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring certified copies of ID, Driver’s licence (where required) and qualifications on or before the interview. Should you be in possession of any foreign qualification(s), it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA); Applicants must be South African citizens. Shortlisted candidates must avail themselves for a virtual or in-person panel interview at a date and time determined by DSAC. The applicant should make own arrangement for access to internet connectivity and equipment for this purpose. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks and references will be conducted once they are shortlisted. The appointment is also subject to a positive outcome on these checks, including security clearance, security vetting, qualification/study verification, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, previous employment verification and criminal record. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. We encourage all applicants to declare any criminal and/or negative credit records. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment, the logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and sign an annual performance agreement. The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its Employment Equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of these posts. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes, thus withdrawing this advert by notice on its communication channels. Prior to appointment for SMS post, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by the DPSA, which is an online course endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full    details     can     be      sourced    from      the     following   link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Vertaling en Redigering-siswati
af.summary: Verskaf vertaling- en redigeringsdienste tussen Engels en Siswati vir die Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12-sertifikaat of ekwivalente kwalifikasie; 'n Minimum driejaar National Diploma (NQF level 6)/Degree (NQF level 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Taalstudies, Linguistiek, Vertaling en Tolkstudie met die relevante taal en/of vertaling as hoofvak, of 'n relevante taalkwalifikasie; 2-3 jaar relevante erv waarvan ten minste 2 jaar as Taalpraktisyn in die vertalingsomgewing; Kennis van Public Service Regulations; Kennis en begrip van relevante taalbeleide en voorskrifte; Kennis van vertaling/redigering/taaladministrasie; Uitstekende beheer van ten minste twee amptelike tale insluitend Engels; Sterk redigeer-, proeflees- en skryfvaardighede; Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings; Vermoë om teks elektronies te vertaal en te redigeer.
af.duties: Die doel van hierdie pos is om toegang tot inligting te bevorder deur vertaling- en redigeringsdienste te verskaf; Vertaal amptelike dokumente van Engels na Siswati en omgekeerd; Ontvang en hersien amptelike dokumente vir vertalingsvereistes; Bestudeer, analiseer en haal problematiese terme uit brondokumente uit; Vertaal dokumente van Engels na Siswati; Vertaal dokumente van Siswati na Engels; Raadpleeg vakkundiges of taalspesialiste wanneer nodig; Redigeer, kontroleer en proeflees amptelike dokumente wat in Siswati vertaal is; Redigeer amptelike dokumente wat in Siswati geskryf is; Kontroleer en verifieer die akkuraatheid van geredigeerde dokumente; Proeflees finale weergawes van amptelike dokumente wat in Siswati vertaal is; Verseker kwaliteit en konsekwentheid in alle vertaalde en geredigeerde materiaal; Voer kwaliteitskontroles op alle dokumente uit voor finale goedkeuring; Doen navorsing en ontwikkel terminologieterme; Doen navorsing en raadpleeg oor vertalingskwessies; Hersien en hersien bestaande terminologie vir duidelikheid en akkuraatheid–Skep en registreer nuwe terme; Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning en skakeldienste; Argiveer alle vertaalde en geredigeerde dokumente elektronies; Rapporteer oor vordering; Skakel met belanghebbendes; Voer take uit soos deur die toesighouer versoek; Bystand en advies aan kliënte oor taalaangeleenthede; Toesig oor ondergeskiktes–Hou toesig oor vertalingsaktiwiteite van ondergeskiktes.
