jobs.title: Assistant Director: Library Policy and Institutions
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.summary: Administer the Legal Deposit Committee, library policy matters and grants to library and information services institutions within the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; Minimum Three-year Degree/National Diploma (NQF level 6) / Degree (NQF Level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Library and Information Science/ Information Studies or any relevant qualification; 2-3 years relevant experience at least 2 years at a librarian level in Library information services, information management, public sector coordination, administration or any relevant environment; Registration with Library and Information Association of South Africa (LIASA); Valid driver’s license; Knowledge of Public Service Regulations; Knowledge of Library and Information Services (LIS) legislation, policies, and strategic frameworks; Knowledge and understanding of the Legal Deposit Act; Knowledge and understanding of conditional grant frameworks and grant administration; Knowledge and understanding of Public Finance Management legislation and Treasury Regulations; Knowledge and understanding of Records and information management; Research and analytical skills; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; Presentation skills; Good communication and Interpersonal relations; Computer Literacy; Project Management Skills; Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: The purpose of this position is to administer the Legal Deposit Committee, LIS policy matters, adhoc grants to LIS and related institutions; Administer legal deposit matters relating to the Legal Deposit Committee-Coordinate the reconstitution of the Legal Deposit Committee; Coordinate and administer meetings of committee; Prepare agendas, minutes, submissions and meeting documentation; Coordinate travel, accommodation and payment of travel and subsistence claims for committee members; Liaise with committee members and monitor implementation of resolutions; Monitor and administer budget allocated to Committee matters; Prepare official correspondence, submissions and reports relating to the Committee matters; Monitor compliance with the Legal Deposit Act and other applicable legislations; Coordinate and administer adhoc grant for national LIS and related institutions and community library conditional grant-Administer ad hoc grants and funding agreements, including Memoranda of Agreement (MoAs) to beneficiaries/institutions (SALB, LIASA, etc).; Facilitate the transfer payments to institutions and beneficiaries; Analyse implementation reports and prepare recommendations for approval; Coordinate engagements with relevant beneficiaries and stakeholders; Prepare presentations and briefing documents for management and stakeholder engagements; Coordinate administrative processes relating to the community library conditional grant; Collect, verify and consolidate programme performance and expenditure on projects and report writing; Assist with monitoring and conduct visits to conditional grant projects; Prepare responses to enquiries relating to the conditional grant; Coordinate the development of policies and research on library information services-Conduct research on library and information services policy matters and emerging issues; Coordinate policy reviews and implementation of relevant legislative frameworks; Support investigations into specialised policy areas, including Legal Deposit, Braille services, copyright and preservation; Coordinate workshops, stakeholder consultations and policy engagements; Update and maintain information relating to LIS policies and programmes on departmental platforms; Manage administrative support within the Directorate-Coordinate records and document management in accordance with departmental policies; Maintain the Directorate file plan and ensure proper record keeping; Supervise and provide guidance to administrative support staff; Monitor compliance with records management requirements; Ensure efficient administrative support to the Directorate.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sikamengameli: Inqubomgomo Yemitapo Yencwadi Nezikhungo
zu.summary: Lawula iKomidi Lokufaka Komthetho, izindaba zenqubomgomo yemitapo yencwadi kanye nabelo ezikhungweni zemisebenzi yemitapo yencwadi yenolwazi ngaphakathi kwUmnyango Wezemidlalo, Bonkomsindo Namasiko.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samatikhethe/Pasipoti yokugqeda ibanga leshumi/Isitifikedi seBanga lesi-12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo; Isiqu seminyaka emithathu/Isidiploma Sezwe (izinga le-NQF 6) / Isiqu (izinga le-NQF 7) njengoba kunikwa isiqiniseko ngu-SAQA kwiMithapo Yencwadi Nolwazi / Izifundo Zolwazi noma noma yisiphi isidingo esihambisana nalokhu; Uzalo lweminyaka engu-2-3 ohambisanayo okungu-2 ubuncane iminyaka ezingeni lomtapo wencwadi kumisebenzi yolwazi yemitapo yencwadi, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukulungiselelana komphakathi, ukuphathwa noma noma ikuphi indawo ehambisanayo; Ukuqashwa kuqhube kweNhlangano Yemitapo Yencwadi Nolwazi YaseNingizimu Afrika (LIASA); Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni; Ulwazi ngemithetho yesevisi yomphakathi; Ulwazi ngomthetho, izinqubomgomo, nezakhiwo ezinomgomo zemisebenzi yemitapo yencwadi nolwazi (LIS); Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho Wokufaka Komthetho; Ulwazi nokuqonda izakhiwo zabelo asemigomeni nokuphathwa kwebandla; Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi kanye Nemithetho Yoholo Lolwazi; Ulwazi nokuqonda ukugcina amarekhodi nolwazi; Amakhono ocwaningo nokuhlaziya; Ukubhekiswa kumthengi nogqozile kumthengi; Amakhano okubukhomba; Ukuthumela kolwazi okuhle kanye nezihloko phakathi kwabantu; Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amakhono okuqamba imisebenzi; Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphezulu kwamandla.
zu.duties: Inhloso yalesi sikhundla ukulawula iKomidi Lokufaka Komthetho, izindaba zenqubomgomo ye-LIS, nabelo ezingajwayelekile kuma-LIS nezikhungo ezihlobene; Lawula izindaba zokufaka komthetho eziphathelene neKomidi Yokufaka Komthetho-Hlanganisa kabusha ukuqanjwa kweKomidi Yokufaka Komthetho; Hlanganisa futhi ulawule izinkomfa zekomidi; Lungela izinhlelo zomsebenzi, amaminithi, izinikelo kanye namadokhumenti okunkomfa; Hlanganisa ukuhamba, ukukhonza kanye nentengo yokuhamba nezeqiniso zokuhlala kubalule de kumalungu ekomidi; Xhumana nabalungu bekomidi futhi ulawule ukuqaliswa kwezinqumo; Lawula futhi uhlele imali ehanjiselwe izindaba zekomidi; Lungela ukuxhumana okusemthethweni, izinikelo kanye nemiyalezo ephathelene nezindaba zekomidi; Hlola ukuthobela umthetho Wokufaka Komthetho kanye nomthetho ongaba khona; Hlanganisa futhi ulawule ukwabelwa ngeke ngajwayelekile kuzikhungo zesizwe ze-LIS nezinhlobonhlobo kanye neliyelo lemigomo yemitapo yencwadi yomphakathi-Lawula nabelo angajwayelekile noma yisiphi isivumelwano semali okubandakanya namamemorandamu ezesivumelwano (MoAs) kubaphathwa/izikhungo (SALB, LIASA, njl.).; Yisa phambili ukukhokhelwa kwezimali kwezikhungo nabaphathwa; Hlaziya imiyalezo yokusetshenziswa futhi ulungela izincomo ukuze avunyelwe; Hlanganisa izexwayiso nabaphathwa abahlobene kanye nabathintekayo; Lungela okubukhosome kanye namadokhumenti okwazisa abaphathi kanye nabathintekayo; Hlanganisa izinqubo zokuphathwa eziphathelene neliyelo lemigomo yemitapo yencwadi yomphakathi; Qoqa, qinisekisa futhihlanganisa ukusebenza kohlelo kanye nokuhloba imali emisebenzini nokubhala imiyalezo; Siza ekubhekeni futhi ukuhambela imisebenzi yamaphrojekthi wobandla womgomo; Lungela izimpendulo ezibuzwa eziphathelene neliyelo lemigomo; Hlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezinqubomgomo kanye nocwaningo ngemisebenzi yemitapo yencwadi-Cwppinga ngemisebenzi yemitapo yencwadi nolwazi izindaba zenqubomgomo nezehlobo elisha; Hlanganisa ukubuyekezwa kwenqubomgomo kanye nokuqaliswa kwezakhiwo zomthetho ohlobene; Sekele iziphoqi ezibhekwe kumikhakha yenqubomgomo ekhethekile, okubandakanya ukuFaka Komthetho, izevisi zeBraille, ilayisensi yokushicilela, nokugcina; Hlanganisa izikoleji, izexwayiso zabathintekayo kanye nokuqanjwa kwenqubomgomo; Buyekeza futhi ugcine ulwazi oluphathelene nezinqubomgomo ze-LIS kanye namaphrojekthi kumapuletfomu komnyango; Phatha ukusekelwa kokuphathwa ngaphakathi kweKhono-Hlanganisa amarekhodi nokuphathwa kwamadokhumenti ngokusho izinqubomgomo komnyango; Gcina ihele lesiKhono futhi uqinisekise ukugcinwa kwamarekhodi okufanele; Qaphula futhi unikeze umqondiso abasebenzi bokuqashwa bokusekela; Lawula ukuthobela izidingo zokuphathwa kwamarekhodi; Qinisekisa ukusekelwa okusebenzayo kweKhono.

xh.title: Umphathi ongcwele: iNqaku le-Baseki nemiVuzo
xh.summary: Lawula iKomiti yeStylistic estratweni, imicimbi yemigaqo yolawulo kunye neendlela zokuFA iziko eBala eNgingesi.
xh.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; Minimum Three-year Degree/National Diploma (NQF level 6) / Degree (NQF Level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Library and Information Science/ Information Studies or any relevant qualification; 2-3 years relevant experience at least 2 years at a librarian level in Library information services, information management, public sector coordination, administration or any relevant environment; Registration with Library and Information Association of South Africa (LIASA); Valid driver’s license; Knowledge of Public Service Regulations; Knowledge of Library and Information Services (LIS) legislation, policies, and strategic frameworks; Knowledge and understanding of the Legal Deposit Act; Knowledge and understanding of conditional grant frameworks and grant administration; Knowledge and understanding of Public Finance Management legislation and Treasury Regulations; Knowledge and understanding of Records and information management; Research and analytical skills; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; Presentation skills; Good communication and Interpersonal relations; Computer Literacy; Project Management Skills; Ability to work under pressure.
xh.duties: The purpose of this position is to administer the Legal Deposit Committee, LIS policy matters, adhoc grants to LIS and related institutions; Administer legal deposit matters relating to the Legal Deposit Committee-Coordinate the reconstitution of the Legal Deposit Committee; Coordinate and administer meetings of committee; Prepare agendas, minutes, submissions and meeting documentation; Coordinate travel, accommodation and payment of travel and subsistence claims for committee members; Liaise with committee members and monitor implementation of resolutions; Monitor and administer budget allocated to Committee matters; Prepare official correspondence, submissions and reports relating to the Committee matters; Monitor compliance with the Legal Deposit Act and other applicable legislations; Coordinate and administer adhoc grant for national LIS and related institutions and community library conditional grant-Administer ad hoc grants and funding agreements, including Memoranda of Agreement (MoAs) to beneficiaries/institutions (SALB, LIASA, etc).; Facilitate the transfer payments to institutions and beneficiaries; Analyse implementation reports and prepare recommendations for approval; Coordinate engagements with relevant beneficiaries and stakeholders; Prepare presentations and briefing documents for management and stakeholder engagements; Coordinate administrative processes relating to the community library conditional grant; Collect, verify and consolidate programme performance and expenditure on projects and report writing; Assist with monitoring and conduct visits to conditional grant projects; Prepare responses to enquiries relating to the conditional grant; Coordinate the development of policies and research on library information services-Conduct research on library and information services policy matters and emerging issues; Coordinate policy reviews and implementation of relevant legislative frameworks; Support investigations into specialised policy areas, including Legal Deposit, Braille services, copyright and preservation; Coordinate workshops, stakeholder consultations and policy engagements; Update and maintain information relating to LIS policies and programmes on departmental platforms; Manage administrative support within the Directorate-Coordinate records and document management in accordance with departmental policies; Maintain the Directorate file plan and ensure proper record keeping; Supervise and provide guidance to administrative support staff; Monitor compliance with records management requirements; Ensure efficient administrative support to the Directorate.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Heraldic Artistry
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.summary: Design and produce heraldic artworks for the Bureau of Heraldry, requiring a diploma in graphic design and at least two years of relevant design experience.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; Minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6) / Degree NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Graphic Design/ Fine Arts/ Visual Arts/ Multimedia Design or any relevant qualification; 2-3 years relevant experience at least 2 years as a graphic designer in conceptualising, designing and producing corporate identity and heraldic artwork or any relevant graphic environment; Knowledge of Public Service Regulations; Knowledge of relevant legislation, policies and procedures applicable to the Bureau of Heraldry; Knowledge graphic design and art; Knowledge of illustration and graphic design techniques; Knowledge of calligraphy and typography; Knowledge of colour theory, composition and visual communication; Knowledge of printing and publishing processes; Ability to work under pressure; Knowledge of digital illustration software and graphic design applications; Knowledge of copyright, intellectual property and design ethics; Knowledge of records management practices; Research and analytical skills; Planning and Organising skills; Strategic thinking and Problem-solving skills; Presentation skills; Good Communication and Interpersonal relations; Computer Literacy; Analytical skills.
jobs.duties: The purpose of this post is to design, paint and register personal and institutional heraldic artworks for clients of the Bureau; Design and develop heraldic artwork-Design and illustrate all heraldic symbols; Develop creative concepts and layouts for publications and materials; Prepare original heraldic artwork using traditional and digital illustration techniques; Draft designs manually and electronically in accordance with heraldic principles; Consult with clients to determine design requirements and symbolism; Produce final approved designs for registration; Ensure all designs accurately reflect heraldic symbolism and artistic quality; Maintain consistency in the application of heraldic colours, charges, shields and other design elements; Produce heraldic certificates and register artwork-Paint heraldic certificates to the required artistic and quality standards; Produce register drawings for inclusion in the South African Heraldic Register; Duplicate approved artwork for official registers and archival purposes; Prepare artwork for printing, reproduction and publication; Ensure all artwork is complete, accurate and free from defects before registration; Maintain the quality and consistency of all painted certificates and register drawings; Archive completed artwork and registered drawings in accordance with prescribed procedures; Support the production of replacement and duplicate certificates were required; Prepare heraldic calligraphy and registration documentation-Produce handwritten and digital calligraphy for heraldic certificates and registers; Write blazons accurately in accordance with heraldic terminology and conventions; Apply appropriate lettering styles to complement heraldic artwork; Ensure all lettering is correctly aligned, centered and professionally presented; Complete certificates with approved calligraphic inscriptions; Verify the accuracy of names, descriptions and heraldic terminology before finalization; Prepare documentation required to support the registration of heraldic representations; Maintain high standards of presentation in all calligraphic work; Ensure heraldic compliance and quality assurance-Compare proposed designs against existing heraldic registers and publications to prevent duplication; Verify that all designs comply with heraldic legislation, policies and standards; Conduct quality assurance reviews of artwork before approval and registration; Recommend amendments where designs do not comply with heraldic requirements; Provide technical advice on heraldic design principles to clients and stakeholders; Maintain consistency and integrity of the South African Heraldic Register; Provide administrative support services within the sub directorate-Participate in exhibitions and heraldic designs awareness campaigns; Liaise with printers, designers, photographers and other service providers to coordinate production; Monitor the quality of printed and published material to ensure compliance with approved standards; Conduct research and provide technical advice to support graphic design and publication projects; Conduct research on heraldic symbols, traditions, history and international practices; Prepare reports and maintain records relating to design projects; Assist with budgeting and procurement processes where required.

jobs.notes: Please create a user profile by completing all required personal information and setting up your login credentials. Once registration is complete, log in to the system and you will be directed to the “Welcome Page”. From the Welcome Page, you may browse all vacant positions opportunities listed below. Applicants are strongly advised to complete all information required for the electronic Z83 form on the system before applying for any position. The Z83 form has been adopted into the system, and applications cannot be processed unless all mandatory fields are completed. After completing your profile and Z83 information, you may apply for any relevant advertised position through the system. Ensure that your application is fully completed and submitted before the closing date, as incomplete or late applications will not be considered. Once submitted, the system will provide a confirmation message indicating that your application has been successfully received. The e- Recruitment portal is also accessible via smartphones and other mobile devices. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring certified copies of ID, Driver’s licence (where required) and qualifications on or before the interview. Should you be in possession of any foreign qualification(s), it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA); Applicants must be South African citizens. Shortlisted candidates must avail themselves for a virtual or in-person panel interview at a date and time determined by DSAC. The applicant should make own arrangement for access to internet connectivity and equipment for this purpose. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks and references will be conducted once they are shortlisted. The appointment is also subject to a positive outcome on these checks, including security clearance, security vetting, qualification/study verification, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, previous employment verification and criminal record. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. We encourage all applicants to declare any criminal and/or negative credit records. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment, the logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and sign an annual performance agreement. The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its Employment Equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of these posts. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes, thus withdrawing this advert by notice on its communication channels. Prior to appointment for SMS post, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by the DPSA, which is an online course endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full    details     can     be      sourced    from      the     following   link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Umhleli Oholiswayo: Ubuciko Bezwi LobuHeraldic
zu.summary: Hlola futhi ukhiqize izinkalo zobuciko ze-Heraldic zeBureau of Heraldry, okudinga i-diploma kwi-graphic design okungenani iminyaka emibili yesipiliyoni sokuhlela esihambisana nalokho.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate noma izifundo ezingoko; Okungenani i-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (NQF level 6) / i-Degree NQF level 7) njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA kwi-Graphic Design/ Fine Arts/ Visual Arts/ Multimedia Design noma noma yisiphi isifundo esihambisana nalokho; 2-3 yiminyaka yesipiliyoni esihambisana nalokho okungenani iminyaka emibili njengomhleli wezithombe ekubumbeni, ekuletheni nasekukhiyizeni ukuzibhalwa kophakade nobuciko bezinkalo ze-Heraldic noma noma imuphi umkhakaza ohlela izithombe; Ulwazi mayelana ne-Public Service Regulations; Ulwazi mayelana nemithetho, izinqubomgomo nezinhlawulo ezisebenza kwi-Bureau of Heraldry; Ulwazi lokuhlela izithombe nobuciko; Ulwazi lokudweba izithombe nobuchwepheshe bokuhlela izithombe; Ulwazi lobuhlakani bokubhala ubuhle kanye ne-typography; Ulwazi lombala othiyori, isakhiwo nokuxhumana ngamehlo; Ulwazi lwenqubo yokushicilela nokushicilela izincwadi; Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela; Ulwazi lwe-software yedijithali yokudweba izithombe kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlela izithombe; Ulwazi lokulondolozwa kwamalungelo ababhali, impahlaengqondo kanye nesimilo sokuhlela; Ulwazi lwezindlela zolawulezinhlayiya; Amandla okucwaninga nokuhlaziya; Amandla okuhlela futhi uhle; Amandla okucabanga ngokusobala kanye nokuqonda izinkinga; Amandla okuhlabisa; Inkomishani ehle kanye nobuhlobo obuhle nabantu; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amandla okuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Inhloso yaleso sikhundla ukwakha, ukupenda futhi ubhalise izinkalo zobuciko ze-Heraldic zobuqu nezobunyokowezinkampani zabakhiphi be-Bureau; Ukwakha futhi ukuthuthukisa ubuciko bezinkalo ze-Heraldic - Kwakha futhi ukudweba wonke amafayidwa e-Heraldic; Ukuthuthukisa imibono yokudala futhi ubeke Izinkalo zobuciko ezkukhishwa ezincwadini nakulezo zithako; Ukulungisa ubuciko bezinkalo ze-Heraldic bakuqobo ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokudweba ngokwesiko nangokwedijithali; Ukuhlaka izakhiwo ngesandla nangekhompyutha ngokuhambisana nemigiqo ye-Heraldic; Ukubonisana namakhasimende ukuthola izidingo zokuhlela nokuqondisisa incazelo; Ukukhiqiza izakhiwo ezivunyiwe sokugcina ukubhaliswa; Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amasakhiwo abonisa ngokuno incazelo ye-Heraldic kanye nisimo sobuciko; Gcina ukuziiswa ekusetshenziseni kwemibala ye-Heraldic, izithiyo, izihlangu kanye nalawanye amaqembu okuhlela; Ukukhiqiza izifanekiso ze-Heraldic futhi ubhalise ubuciko - Pend izifanekiso ze-Heraldic ngokuhambisana nezinga elidingekayo lobuciko nobulinganiso; Ukukhiqiza izithombe zokubhalisa ukuthi zifakwe kwi-South African Heraldic Register; Ukukopisha obuciko obuvunyiwe bokusetshenziswa kwamabhalo asemthethweni nangokugcinwa; Lungisa obuciko bokushicilelwa, ukuphindwa nokushicilelwa kwezincwadi; Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke obuciko buqediwe, bufanele futhi abunalutho ngaphambi kokubhaliswa; Gcina izinga nokuziiswa kuzo zonke izifanekiso ezipendiwe nezithombe zokubhalisa; Gcina obuciko obuqediwe nezigcinezithombe zokubhaliswa ngokuhambisana nezinhlawulo ezinikeziwe; Sekela ukukhiqizwa kwesitifiketi esisha nesiphindwayo lapho kudingeka khona; Lungisa ubhalo obuhle be-Heraldic kanye namadokhumenti okubhaliswa - Khiqiza ubhalo obuhle ngesandla nangokwedijithali kumasitifiketi nezibhalo ze-Heraldic; Bhala izinkinobho ngokunembile ngokuhambisana nokuqondiswa kwezwi le-Heraldic; Faka izitayela ezifanele zokubhala ukugezela ubuciko be-Heraldic; Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke ubhalo ulunge ngokunembile, umaphakathi futhi unikezwa ngobungcweti; Qedela izitifikathi ngokusikwa okuvunyiwe kobhalo obuhle; Qinisekisa ukunemba kwezibhalo, izincazelo kanye nokuqondiswa kwamazwi e-Heraldic ngaphambi kokugcina; Lungisa amadokhumenti adingekayo ukusekela ukubhaliswa kwezinkalo ze-Heraldic; Gcina izinga eliphezulu lokubukiswa kuyo yonke imisebenzi yobhalo obuhle; Qinisekisa ukuziiswa kwe-Heraldic kanye nokuqinisekiswa kobulinganiso - Fananisela izakhiwo eziphakamiswayo namabhalo okutholakala e-Heraldic kanye nakoshicilelo ukugwema ukuphinda; Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amasakhiwo azuzisa imithetho ye-Heraldic, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinga;enza ukucwaningwa kobulinganiso babuciko ngaphambi kokuvuma nokubhaliswa; Phakamisa izinguquko lapho amasakhiwo engazuzisi izidingo ze-Heraldic; Nikeza izeluleko zobuchwepheshe mayelana nemigiqo yokuhlela i-Heraldic kubakhasimende kanye nalabo abadlula kuyo; Gcina ukuziiswa nokuzinika kwe-South African Heraldic Register; Nikeza ukusekela okungoko i-ofisi phakathi kwe-sub directorate - Thatha inhluzo kumakhonsathi nokugqamisa ukwaziswa mayelana nokuhlela i-Heraldic; Xhumana nabashicileli, abahleli, abathathiwezithombe kanye nalabo abanikeza inkonzo ukuze uhle umkhiqizo; Qaphela izinga lomkhiqizo oshicileliwe noshicilelwe ukuze uqinisekise ukuziiswa nezinqubomgomo ezivunyiwe;enza ucwaningo futhi nikeze izeluleko zobuchwepheshe ukusekela ukuhlela izithombe kanye namaphrojekthi okushicilela;enza ucwaningo mayelana ne-Heraldic, izinkalo, umlando kanye nezinto ezibukwa emhlabeni jikelele; Lungisa imibiko futhi ugcine izinkomba mayelana namaphrojekthi okuhlela; Siza ngebhajethi kanye nokuqoqwa kulapho kudingeka khona.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Expenditure and Transfers
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director responsible for monitoring and authorising financial transactions, payment processes and compliance within the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6) or Degree (NQF level 7), as recognised by SAQA, in Financial Management, Management Accounting, Cost and Management Accounting, Accounting or any relevant financial accounting qualification; 2–3 years’ relevant experience, including at least 2 years as a State Accountant or Financial Officer in processing and authorising payments, reconciliations or any financial expenditure management and transfers environment; BAS and LOGIS certificates will be an added advantage; Knowledge of Public Service Regulations; Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act; Knowledge of National Treasury Regulations, instruction notes and financial systems; Knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, norms and standards; Knowledge of Basic Accounting System (BAS) and Logistical Information System (LOGIS); Knowledge and understanding of relevant policies and prescripts; Planning and Organising skills; Strategic thinking and Problem- solving skills; Presentation skills; Good Communication and Interpersonal relations; Computer Literacy; Analytical skills; Team player; Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: The purpose of this post is to monitor and authorise financial transactions and payment processes within the Department; Check compliance with payment procedures and controls; Validate supporting documents for correctness, completeness and accuracy; Identify and correct errors before payment approval; Verify and authorise payments on BAS and LOGIS; Monitor LOGIS and sundry payment processes; Maintain accurate payment records; Process payments to beneficiaries, public entities and provinces; Ensure compliance with PFMA, National Treasury regulations ,procedures and policies; Resolve and follow up on payment queries and discrepancies; Ensure payments of invoices are processed within 30 days as prescribed by National Treasury regulations; Monitor and reconcile suspense accounts including GCIS and disbursement reports; Request various BAS reports; Check and monitor journal processes; Monitor and review payment transactions for accuracy; Provide advice and guidance on payment processes; Supervise subordinates; Ensure training and development of subordinates; Facilitate the performance management of subordinates; Prepare financial reports, reconciliations and audit information relating to expenditure and transfers; Monitor proper filing for record and audit purposes.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Uitgawes en Oordragte
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur verantwoordelik vir die monitering en magtiging van finansiële transaksies, betalingsprosesse en nakoming binne die Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 Certificate of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie; minimum driejaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6) of Degree (NQF level 7), soos erken deur SAQA, in Financial Management, Management Accounting, Cost and Management Accounting, Accounting of enige relevante finansiële rekeningkundige kwalifikasie; 2–3 jaar se relevante ervaring, insluitend ten minste 2 jaar as 'n State Accountant of Financial Officer in die verwerking en magtiging van betalings, afstemming of enige finansiële uitgawebestuur- en oordrag-omgewing; BAS en LOGIS sertifikate sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees; Kennis van Public Service Regulations; Kennis van Public Finance Management Act; Kennis van National Treasury Regulations, instruksienotes en finansiële stelsels; Kennis van rekeningkundige beginsels, finansiële verslagdoening, norme en standaarde; Kennis van Basic Accounting System (BAS) en Logistical Information System (LOGIS); Kennis en begrip van relevante beleide en voorskrifte; Beplannings- en reëlvaardighede; Strategiese denke en probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Aanlegvaardighede; Goede Kommunikasie en Interpersoonlike verhoudinge; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Analitiese vaardighede; Spanspeler; Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Die doel van hierdie pos is om finansiële transaksies en betalingsprosesse binne die departement te monitor en te magtig; Kontroleer nakoming van betalingsprosedures en -beheer; Valideer steundokumente vir korrektheid, volledigheid en akkuraatheid; Identifiseer en korrigeer foute voor betalingsgoedkeuring; Verifieer en magtig betalings op BAS en LOGIS; Monitor LOGIS en diverse betalingsprosesse; Onderhou akkurate betalingsrekords; Verwerk betalings aan begunstigdes, openbare entiteite en provinsies; Verseker nakoming van PFMA, National Treasury regulasies, prosedures en beleide; Los op en volg na op betalingsnavrae en diskrepansies; Verseker dat betalings van fakture binne 30 dae verwerk word soos voorgeskryf deur National Treasury regulasies; Monitor en stem skikkingsrekeninge insluitend GCIS en uitbetalingsverslae af; Verskeie BAS verslae versoek; Kontroleer en monitor joernaalprosesse; Monitor en hersien betalingstransaksies vir akkuraatheid; Verskaf advies en leiding oor betalingsprosesse; Onderskeie hou toesig; Verseker opleiding en ontwikkeling van ondergeskiktes; Fasiliteer prestasiebestuur van ondergeskiktes; Berei finansiële verslae, afstemmings en oudit-inligting rakende uitgawes en oordragte voor; Monitor behoorlike liasseering vir rekord- en ouditdoeleindes.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Osizi: Izinkokhelo Nokudluliswa
zu.summary: Onjiniyela Osizi ofanele ukugqamisa futhi avume izinkokhelo eziyimali, inqubo yezinkokhelo nokuhambisana nemithetho ngaphakathi kwe Department of Sport, Arts and Culture e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 Certificate noma iziqu ezingabalwa; National Diploma (NQF level 6) yeminyaka emithathu ubuncane noma Degree (NQF level 7), njengoba kunikezwa isibopho yi SAQA, ku Financial Management, Management Accounting, Cost and Management Accounting, Accounting noma noma yisiphi isibambi seziqu sezezimali esihambisana nalokhu; okungenani 2–3 iminyaka yobunikezeli ohambisana nalokhu, okuhlanganisa okungenani iminyaka engu-2 njengo State Accountant noma Financial Officer ekwenzeni nokuvumela izinkokhelo, ukuhlanganisa noma noma yisiphi isimo sokuphathwa kwezinkokhelo nezimali ezikhishiwe nokudluliswa; izitifiketi ze BAS ne LOGIS ziba yinzuzo; ulwazi ngemithetho ye Public Service; ulwazi ngomthetho we Public Finance Management Act; ulwazi nge National Treasury Regulations, amanothi okulawula futhi izinhlelo eziyimali; ulwazi ngezimiso zokubala izimali, ukubika ngezimali, izindinganiso namazinga; ulwazi nge Basic Accounting System (BAS) ne Logistical Information System (LOGIS); ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nemiyalo ephathelene nalokhu; amakhono okuhlela futhi ahiqize; amakhono okucabanga ngokusimama nokuxazulula izinkinga; amakhono okubonisa; ukuxhumana kahle nobudlelwano obuhle nabantu; ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; amakhono ahlukanisa futhi ahlaziye; ukubamba iqhaza njengelungu lolungu; ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo.
zu.duties: Inhloso yalesi sikhundla ukugqamisa futhi kuvume izinkokhelo eziyimali nainqubo yezinkokhelo ngaphakathi komnyango; Hlola ukuhambisana nainqubo nezilawuli zezinkokhelo; Qinisekisa ukulunga, ukuphela nokunemba kwamadokhumenti osekelayo; Thola futhi ulungise amaphutha ngaphambi kokuvunyelwa ukukhokha; Qinisekisa futhi uvume izinkokhelo ku BAS naku LOGIS; Gqamisa inqubo yokukhokha kwi LOGIS nokunye okuyizinkokhelo; Gcina irekhodi elinemba lezinkokhelo; Shaja izinkokhelo kubayizimali abazuzwayo, izikhungo zikahulumeni nasemifundeni; Qinisekisa ukuhambisana ne PFMA, National Treasury regulations, izinqubo nezinqubomgomo; Xazulula futhi ulandele imibuzo nokungahambisani kwamakhompyutha; Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo zama-inivhoyisi zishajwa kungakapheli 30 izinsuku njengoba kumiselwe yi National Treasury regulations; Gqamisa futhi uhlanganise izinkhonto zokulinda okuhlanganisa i GCIS namabhaphu ngezinkokhelo ezikhishiwe; CelA amabhaphu ahlukene e BAS; Hlola futhi ugcqaze inqubo yamabhaphu; Gqamisa futhi uhlole izinguquko eziyizinkokhelo ukuthi zinembile yini; Nikeza izeluleko nomhlahlandlela ngainqubo yezinkokhelo; Qondisa abangaphansi kwakho; Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa nokuqhubela phambili kwabangaphansi kwakho; Yenza abagcini bamaphuzu abangaphansi kwakho bahlinzwe; Lungiselela amabhaphu ngezimali, ukuhlanganiswa kolwazi lokuhlola oluphathelene nezinkokhelo nokudluliswa; Gqamisa ukugcinwa kolwazi okulungele ukwenza irekhodi nokuhofoza.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Iindleko kunye noKudluliselwa
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli oqwalaselayo kunye nogunyazisa izigqibo zemali, iinkqubo zentlawulo nokuhambelana nemigaqo ngaphakathi kwiSebe leMidlalo, iNkcubeko nabaBakwaliswa ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi esemthethweni/Isatifikathi seMatric/Isatifikathi seQela le-12 okanye nesiqinisekiso esilinganayo; isidanga sikaRhu-mvaka kwiminyaka emithathu (inqanaba le-6 le-NQF) okanye i-Degree (inqanaba le-7 le-NQF), njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA, kwiLawulo leMali, uBalo weNkululeko malini noLawulo, uBalo weeNkcithi noLawulo, uBalo weeNkcithi okanye naziphi na iziqinisekiso ezimalini nezo zibalwa; 2–3 unyaka wamava ahambelanayo, kuquka konke ubuncinci kwiminyaka engama-2 njengengcali yemali karhulumente okanye nthunyi wemali ekusingathweni nokugunyazisweni kweentlawulo, ulungelelwaniso okanye nakuphi na ukusingathwa kweendleko zemali nendawo yokudluliselwa; amatshizi eBAS neLOGIS aya kuba ngaphezulu kwezinye iziboneelo; ulwazi ngeMigaqo yoBorumazwe baKarhulumente; ulwazi ngeMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaKarhulumente; ulwazi ngeMigaqo yoQuso lweNazionale, iintanda zolayo nezindonga zokuqonda izibalo; ulwazi ngamagama abalo, iingxelo zemali, imigangatho namazinga okusebenza; ulwazi ngeNkqubo yeBalo eSiseko (BAS) nesiQinisekiso soLawulo lweempahla (LOGIS); ulwazi nokuqonda ngokuchanekileyo ngamagama abalo, iingxelo zemali, imigangatho namazinga okusebenza; ulwazi nokuqonda ngeempahla ezingunye noogunyathiweyo; amakhono eCandelo lokuCocwa nokuLungelelanisa; amakhono oQobo lokucinga nokuzisombulula iingxaki; amakhono okubakhulisa; iNxulumano malunga nokuhamba kakuhle nabanye; ulwazi lokusebenza ngeKhompyutha; amakhono oQobo lokwahlula-hlula; uKweluleka kuqotho; ukuba nako ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengxaki.
xh.duties: Injongo yalesi sithuba kukujonga ngokuchanekileyo nokugunyazisa iinkqubo zemali ezingenayo kwisiSebe; uKhangela ukuhambelana neendlela zokuLawula iintlawulo; uQinisekisa amaphepha awaya nento ngokuchanekileyo, ukwaneliseka nokubakho kokubalulekileyo; uQaphela ulungisa iimpazamo ngaphambi kokuvunyelwa intlawulo; uQinisekisa ugunyazise iintlawulo kwiBAS nakuLOGIS; uQaphela iinkqubo zentlawulo zeLOGIS nezongezelelwayo; uGcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zentlawulo; uCwangcisa iintlawulo kubaxhamli, kuqumrhu karhulumente nakumazantsi; uQinisekisa ukuba zihambelana nePFMA, iMigaqo yoQuso lweNazionale, iinkqubo namagama abalo; uSombulula ulandela iingxaki kunye namabala aphiyo entlawulweni; uQinisekisa ukuba iintlawulo ze-invoyisi zicwangciswa ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezingama-30 njengoko kuchazwe ngamagama abalo oQuso lweNazionale; uQaphela ulungelelanisa iintsangano kubungakanani namaxwebhu entlawulo aquka iGCIS neengxelo zokukhulisa amanani avelayo; uCela iingxelo ezahlukeneyo zeBAS; uKhangela uqaphela iinkqubo zokubala kwi-akhawunti; uQaphela ulungelelanisa ulawulo-lwazi kwizigqibo zemali ezingenayo ukuze kubekho ukuchanekileyo; uNika ingcebiso nolwazi ngeendlela zentlawulo; uQalasela ukulawula abasebenzi abangezantsi; uQinisekisa ukuzilolonga nophuhliso lwabasebenzi abangezantsi; uQhuba ulawulo loqeqesho-Iwabiwo kwabasebenzi abangezantsi; uLungiselela iingxelo zemali, ulungelelaniso lolwazi Iwengxelo noluqhutywayo malunga neendleko nokudluliselwa; uQaphela ukulungiselelwa kolawulo-Iwabiwo Iwamaphepha ngokuchanekileyo ngenjongo yokugcina iingxelo nokuqinisekiswa.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Bilateral Relations
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role facilitating bilateral cooperation programmes and agreements with partner countries for the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification; Minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6) / Degree (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in International Relations/ Political Science/ / International Law/ Diplomatic studies or any relevant qualification; 2-3 years relevant experience at least 2 years as an Officer in international relations, diplomacy, bilateral cooperation, intergovernmental relations, or any relevant environment; Knowledge of Public Service Regulations; Knowledge and understanding of international relations and diplomacy; Knowledge and understanding of Bilateral and multilateral cooperation processes and protocols; Knowledge of government policies and international cooperation frameworks; Research and policy analysis; Stakeholder and relationship management; Project and programme coordination; Negotiation and facilitation skills; Planning and organisiting skills; Communication and interpersonal relations; Computer literacy; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to Interact with other officials from other countries; Adapts to changing demands and conditions; Diplomacy, tact, and cultural sensitivity.
jobs.duties: The purpose of this post is to facilitate and strengthen bilateral cooperation programmes and agreements with partner countries in support of the departmental priorities; Facilitate the implementation of bilateral agreements to strengthen cooperation and achieve tangible outcomes-Coordinate and facilitate bilateral engagements, including preparatory meetings and follow-ups with designated partner countries; Maintain relationships with foreign governments, embassies, commissions, and international partners; Negotiate, draft, conclude, and renew bilateral agreements and cooperation frameworks; Implement and coordinate agreements, programmes, and action plans; Ensure alignment of bilateral agreements with national cultural diplomacy and international relations frameworks; Monitor and track bilateral engagements and programme delivery status; Enhance and strengthen bilateral cooperation in sport, arts, culture and heritage to advance South Africans interest and cultural diplomacy-Facilitate implementation of signed agreements, Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), and action plans; Monitor, evaluate, and report on progress against bilateral commitments and deliverables; Provide technical and administrative support during negotiations and review processes; Maintain a centralised database and records system for all international agreements and cooperation instruments; Ensure compliance with approved protocols, governance frameworks, and international obligations; Prepare implementation progress reports and updates for relevant stakeholders; Strengthen and maintain cordial relations between the Department and its bilateral partners-Coordinate the preparation of official documentation, including Ministerial submissions, DG submissions, briefing notes, reports, and correspondence; Facilitate internal coordination between branches and line function managers to ensure policy and operational alignment; Engage with relevant stakeholders; Coordinate participation of departmental officials and cultural practitioners in international programmes; Facilitate international travel arrangements; Assist with intergovernmental and multilateral coordination; Maintain stakeholder engagement records and communication logs; Conduct research, policy analysis, and international scanning-Conduct research on international trends, cultural diplomacy practices, and policy developments; Analyse political, economic, social, and sector-specific developments affecting bilateral relations; Prepare country profiles, policy briefs, and strategic analyses; Identify opportunities for international collaboration and partnerships; Benchmark departmental programmes against international best practice; Provide evidence-based input for negotiation and strategic decision-making; Manage international events, delegations, and protocol processes-Coordinate bilateral meetings, official visits, conferences, workshops, cultural exchanges, and international forums; Organise and facilitate incoming and outgoing international delegations; Manage logistical and programme arrangements for official visits; Support protocol and diplomatic engagement processes; Liaise with protocol units, DIRCO, embassies, and hosting institutions to ensure seamless execution of engagements; Compile post-event reports and evaluation summaries.

zu.title: Umsekeli kaMqondisi: Izindaba zezombusazwe namazwe amabili
zu.summary: Indima yesikhundla sikaboMqondisi osekela ukukhubaza izinhlelo zobudlelwano namaqembu amazwe amabili kanye nemithetho namazwe abalingana nayo besekela i-Department of Sport, Arts and Culture.
zu.requirements: Ithifikethi leSini eliphezulu / Ithifikethi leMatric / Ithifikethi leGrade 12 noma isiqu esilinganayo; I-Diploma Yesizwe yeminyaka emithathu (NQF level 6) / I-Degree (NQF level 7) njengoba kunconywa yi-SAQA kwi-International Relations/ Political Science/ / International Law/ Diplomatic studies noma noma yisiphi isiqu esifanele; 2-3 iminyaka yokuthola amava okusebenza okufanele okungenani iminyaka eyi-2 njengoMhloli kwezomphakathi namazwe, ezombusazwe, ukusebenzisana kwamazwe amabili, ubudlelwano bahulumeni, noma nanoma kuphi insiza efanayo; Ulwazi ngemitshetho yomphakathi; Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda izomphakathi namazwe kanye nobuhlakani bokusebenzisana; Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda amaphrosesi emitshina yezivumelano ezimbili kanye namazwe amanengi; Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo kahulumeni kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenzisana namazwe; Ucwaningo kanye nohlaziyo lwezinqubomgomo; Ukuphatha abalingani kanye nobuhlobo; Ukuhleleka kwezinhlelo nezinhlela; Amakhono okuxoxa ngemithetho kanye nokukhubaza; Amakhono ukuhlela futhi uhlele; Unxibelelwano nobuhlobo; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Ikakhulu ukusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo; Ukukwazi ukuxhumana nabasebenzi bezinye izwe; Ukujwayela izidingo ezishintshayo kanye nezimo; Ubuhlakani bokusebenzisana, ukuhlonipha, kanye nokuqonda amasiko.
zu.duties: Inhloso yalesi sikhundla ukukhubaza futhi kukhulise izinhlelo zokusebenzisana kwezombusazwe kanye nemitshina yezivumelano namazwe ohlobo lwabalingani ekwesekeni okuhlelekile kweziqu ezibalulekile komnyango; Ukukhubaza ukuphothulwa kwemitshina yezivumelano ezimbili ukukhulisa ukusebenzisana futhi kufeze imiphumela ethokozisayo-Hlela futhi ukhubaze amanye amahlela okusebenzisana kwezombusazwe, okuhlanganisa imihlangano yokulungiselela kanye nokulandelwa kwenqubo namazwe ohlobo lwabalingani abakhethiwe; Ugcinze ubudlelwano nahulumeni bezinye izwe, ngabamelusi, amakomisi, kanye nabalingani bakwamanye amazwe; Xoxa ngemithetho, bhala, phetha, futhi uvuselele imitshina yezivumelano nobuhlakani bokusebenzisana; Phepha futhi uhlele imitshina, izinhlelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwenza; Qinisekisa ukuvumelana kwemitshina yezivumelano nobuhlakani bokusebenzisana nasendleleni yombuso yokusebenzisana namazwe omhlaba kanye nezinhlelo zobudiplomatiki; Qaphula futhi ulandele imihlangano yokusebenzisana kwezombusazwe kanye nesimo sokuqedwa kwezinhlelo; Khulisa futhi uqinise ukusebenzisana ezimweni zemidlalo,obuciko,amasiko kanye nemvelo ekuthuthukiseni izinto ezibalulekile kwiseNingizimu Afrika nobuhlakani bokusebenzisanaamasiko-Kukhubaza ukuphothulwa kwemitshina esayinwe, imemorandamu yokuqonda (MoU), kanye nezinhlelo zokwenza; Qaphula, hlola, futhi umbike ngokuqhubeka ngokumiselwa kwemitshina yezivumelano ezimbili; Nikeza ukusekelwa ngobuchwepheshe kanye nokuphatha kolwazi ngesikhathi kuxoxwa ngemithetho kanye nenqubo yokubuka ukuqinisekiswa kwemithetho; Gcina idathabhesi evakayo kanye nesistimu yerekhodi yonke imithetho yamazwe kanye nezitho zokusebenzisana; Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemitshetho egunyaziwe, izakhiwo zokuphatha, kanye nezele imithetho yamazwe omhlaba; Lungisa imibiko yokuqhubeka nokuphothulwa kanye nezibuyekezo kubalingani abahlelekile; Qinisela futhi ugcine ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi koMnyango nalabo obusebenzisana nabo-Hlela ukulungiselelwa kolwazi olusemthethweni, okuhlanganisa izinto ezithunyelwa kuNgqongqoshe, izinto ezithunyelwa kuDG, amaphimiso amafushane, imibiko, kanye nokubhalelana; Khubaza ukuhleleka ngaphakathi phakathi kwamagatsha kanye nabaphathi bemisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambelana kwezinqubomgomo kanye nokusebenza; Hlanganyele nabalingani abahlelekile; Hlela ukubamba iqhaza kubasebenzi bomnyango kanye nabalingiswa bezamasiko ezinhlelweni zamazwe omhlaba; Khubaza izinhlela zokuhamba kwamazwe omhlaba; Siza nakuhleleka kwezombusazwe kanye nokusebenzisana namazwe amanengi; Gcina izinkomba zokubamba iqhaza zabalingani kanye namaphothisi yokuxhumana; Yenza ucwaningo, ukuhlaziya inqubomgomo, kanye nokusesha kwamazwe omhlaba-Yenza ucwaningo ngamathrendi amazwe omhlaba, izindlela zobuhlakani bokusebenzisana amasiko, kanye nenqubekela phambili yezinqubomgomo; Hlaziya ukuthuthuka kwezombusazwe, kwezomnotho, kwezomphakathi, kanye nezenza okukhethekile ezithinta ukusebenzisana kwezombusazwe; Lungisa izinhlaka zamazwe, amaphimiso ezinqubomgomo, kanye nohlaziyo oluhlelekile; Hlonza ithuba lokusebenzisana namazwe kanye namaqembu; Fanisa izinhlelo zomnyango nendlela ehle kakhulu yamazwe; Nikeza imibiko esekwe kulwazi ngesikhathi kuxoxwa ngemithetho kanye nokuqumba izinqumo; Phatha imicimbi yamazwe, amaqembu, kanye nenqubo yemitshetho-Hlela imihlangano yokusebenzisana kwezombusazwe, ukuvakashela okusemthethweni, imikhosi, amawokshopu, ukushintshana amasiko, kanye namaphorumu amazwe omhlaba; Hlela futhi ukhubaze amaqembu aveza kanye nawathumela amazwe omhlaba; Phatha izinhlela zokulungiselela kanye nokuhlela imicimbi yezivakashi eziphatha; Sekela inqubo yemitshetho kanye nobuhlakani bokuthungatha ubudlelwano; Xhumana namayunithi emitshetho, DIRCO, ngabamelusi, kanye nezikhungo ezimamela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqedwa okuhle kwezinhlelo; Bala imibiko yasemva komcimbi kanye nezinkomba zokuhlola.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Bilaterale Betrekkinge
af.summary: Assistentdirekteurpos wat bilaterale samewerkingsprogramme en ooreenkomste met vennootlande vir die Department of Sport, Arts and Culture fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie; Minimum driejarige Nasionale Diploma (NQF vlak 6) / Graad (NQF vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Internasionale Betrekkinge/ Politieke Wetenskap/ / Internasionale Reg/ Diplomatiese studies of enige relevante kwalifikasie; 2-3 jaar relevante ervaring waarvan ten minste 2 jaar as 'n Beampte in internasionale betrekkinge, diplomasie, bilaterale samewerking, interregeringsbetrekkinge, of enige relevante omgewing; Kennis van Openbare Diens Regulasies; Kennis en begrip van internasionale betrekkinge en diplomasie; Kennis en begrip van bilaterale en multilaterale samewerkingsprosesse en protokolle; Kennis van regeringsbeleid en internasionale samewerkingsraamwerke; Navorsing en beleidsontleding; Belanghebbende- en verwantskapsbestuur; Projek- en programmekoördinering; Onderhandeling en fasiliteringsvaardighede; Beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede; Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike betrekkinge; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Vermoë om met ander amptenare uit ander lande in te skakel; Pas by veranderende eise en toestande; Diplomasie, takt en kulturele sensitiwiteit.
af.duties: Die doel van hierdie pos is om bilaterale samewerkingsprogramme en -ooreenkomste met vennootlande te fasiliteer en te versterk ter ondersteuning van departementele prioriteite; Fasiliteer die implementering van bilaterale ooreenkomste om samewerking te versterk en tasbare uitkomste te bereik-Koördineer en fasiliteer bilaterale betrekkinge, insluitend voorbereidingsvergaderings en opvolgaksies met aangewese vennootlande; Onderhou verhoudings met vreemde regerings, ambassades, kommissies en internasionale vennote; Onderhandel, opstel, finaliseer en hernu bilaterale ooreenkomste en samewerkingsraamwerke; Implementeer en koördineer ooreenkomste, programme en aksieplanne; Verseker belyning van bilaterale ooreenkomste met nasionale kulturele diplomasie- en internasionale betrekkinge-raamwerke; Monitor en hou bilaterale betrekkinge en programafleweringsstatus dop; Versterk en bevorder bilaterale samewerking in sport, kuns, kultuur en erfenis om Suid-Afrikaners se belange en kulturele diplomasie te bevorder-Fasiliteer implementering van ondertekende ooreenkomste, Memoranda van Ooreenkoms (MoU) en aksieplanne; Monitor, evalueer en rapporteer oor vordering teenoor bilaterale verbintenis en aflewerbare uitkomste; Verskaf tegniese en administratiewe ondersteuning tydens onderhandelings en hersieningsprosesse; Onderhou 'n gesentraliseerde databasis en rekordsisteem vir alle internasionale ooreenkomste en samewerkingsinstrumente; Verseker nakoming van goedgekeurde protokolle, bestuursraamwerke en internasionale verpligtinge; Stel implementeringsvorderingsverslae en opdaterings vir relevante belanghebbendes op; Versterk en onderhou korrekte betrekkinge tussen die departement en sy bilaterale vennote-Koördineer die voorbereiding van amptelike dokumentasie, insluitend Ministeriële voorleggings, DG-voorleggings, kernnotas, verslae en korrespondensie; Fasiliteer interne koördinering tussen takke en lynfunksiemanagers om beleids- en bedryfsbelyning te verseker; Skakel met relevante belanghebbendes in; Koördineer deelname van departementele amptenare en kulturepraktisyns in internasionale programme; Fasiliteer internasionale reëlingreëlings; Bied bystand met interregerings- en multilaterale koördinering; Onderhou rekords van belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en kommunikasielogs; Voer navorsing, beleidsontleding en internasionale skandering uit-Doen navorsing oor internasionale tendense, kulturele diplomasiepraktyke en beleidsontwikkelings; Ontleed politieke, ekonomiese, sosiale en sektor-spesifieke ontwikkelinge wat bilaterale betrekkinge beïnvloed; Stel landprofiele, beleidsnotas en strategiese ontledings op; Identifiseer geleenthede vir internasionale samewerking en vennootskappe; Benchmark departementele programme teen internasionale beskeie praktyke; Verskaf bewysgebaseerde insette vir onderhandeling en strategiese besluitneming; Bestuur internasionale geleenthede, afvaardigings en protokolprosesse-Koördineer bilaterale vergaderings, amptelike besoeke, konferensies, werkswinkels, kulturele uitruilings en internasionale forums; Reël en fasiliteer inkomende en uitgaande internasionale afvaardigings; Bestuur logistiese en programreëlings vir amptelike besoeke; Ondersteun protokol- en diplomatieke betrokkenheidsprosesse; Skakel met protokoleenhede, DIRCO, ambassades en gasheerinrigtings om naatlose uitvoering van betrekkinge te verseker; Stel na-geleentheidsverslae en evaluasieopsommings op.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Uqhagamshelo lwangaphakathi
xh.summary: Inkosi yomncedisi yokuncedisa ekulawulweni koluntu olusebenzayo ngaphakathi kweziko lomanyano lwezwe.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi sematikhi/Kholeji yeminyaka yobomi yamabali avela kumabali esikolo/Kholeji yamabali ezingama-12 okanye isiphakamiso esingamkelwayo; Isidanga samazwe ngamazwe (NQF level 6) / Isidanga (NQF level 7) njengoko samkelwe yi-SAQA kwiZommandla kwamanye amazwe/ iiNkqubela zeZopolitiko/ / iMthetho yamazwe ngamazwe/ izifundo zeNgqalasela namazwe okanye naliphi na isiphakamiso esifanelekileyo; 2-3 iminyaka yamava ngokwaneleyo ubuncinane iya kuthi ngaphezulu kweminyaka elishumi elinesibini njengesikhululi kummandla wezommandla kwamanye amazwe, urhwebo, isiseko sendalo, amazwe ngamazwe, namazwe ngaphakathi okanye indawo engaluthi na; Ulwazi ngemigaqo yoBukhulu boLuntu; Ulwazi nokusiyingqonyamba ngabakwanomlambo namazwe ngamazwe; Ulwazi nokusiyingqonyamba kumathuba okuvumelana koluntu, urhwebo lwangaphakathi namazwe ngamazwe, nento yawo zonke iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo; Ulwazi ngabakwabo bomanyano lungangqamana nokubakho kwamathuba emisebenzi yorhwebo lwamanye amazwe; Uphononongo lweenkqubo zobulungisa noyilo lwezommandla; Ukuqhuba nokulawula iinkqubo zoluntu nezoqoqosho; Ulawulo lweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo kubomi boluntu; Ulwazi ngamandla okulunga nokuba nombono othe chaba; Ulawulo lweekhompyutha; Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamandla ahlukeneyo; Ulwazi lokubakwabo nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe; Ulwazi lokuzonkelelwa iimeko ezahlukeneyo zoluntu; Urhwebo, isilixa, nokuqonda iinkqubo zonke.
xh.duties: Injongo yalesi sithuba kukunceda nokukhuthaza ukubakho koluntu olusebenzayo ngokuvumelana kumazwe ngamazwe, nasekuqhubeni iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu, ekuqinisekiseni ukuba yonke imisebenzi ihamba ngokomthetho; Uncede ekusebenzeni koluntu oluqinisekisa iinkqubo zomanyano zentando yabantu nabakwamanye amazwe; Qhagamshela namazwe ngamazwe ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu, kubandakanya iinkqubo zoluntu ezikwisazela ngakumbi; Xhelisa urhwebo nasekuqinisekiseni ukubakho koluntu oluqinisekisa ubomi boluntu nabantu bakuwo onke amazwe; Xhelisa, qamba, qinisekisa, nokulungisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu; Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi iyaqhuba ngokomthetho weSizwe; Hlola nokuphuhlisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu ngokusebenza kwazo; Qinisekisa ukubakho koluntu olusebenzayo kumazwe ngamazwe ngokweziqinisekiso zamazwe; Sebenzisa nokuncedisa ekusebenzeni kwezi nkqubo, nakuqinisekiseni ukuba zihamba ngokomthetho weSizwe; Qinisekisa ukulungelelana koluntu nokusebenza kwemisebenzi ngokomthetho weSizwe; Hlola, qinisekisa, nokubika ngokuqhuba koluntu olusentsimbi ngokomthetho weSizwe; Qinisekisa ukulungelelana koluntu noqoqosho kumazwe ngamazwe ngokomthetho weSizwe; Gcina ulwazi lwabo bonke abantu abasebenza kuluntu oluhamba phambili; Xhelisa imisebenzi emininzi yokusebenza kumazwe ngamazwe; Yazi ukuhamba nokusebenza koluntu; Xhelisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu ngokusebenza kwemisebenzi yamanye amazwe; Xhelisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu ngokusebenza kwemisebenzi yamanye amazwe; Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi ihamba ngokomthetho weSizwe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Organisational Design & JOB Evaluation
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role at Statistics South Africa in Pretoria involving organisational design, job evaluation, and work study investigations.
jobs.requirements: A bachelor’s degree (NQF 7) in Management Services/ Business Management/ Organisational Development/ Human Resources Management. Training in Job Design and evaluation, Work study measurement and method study, Structure Design and Service Delivery Model. Certificate in Job Evaluation by NSG. 3-4 years’ experience in Human Resources Management/ Strategic Management/ Organisational Design environment. A hard worker who is strategic and forward thinking, influencing, interpersonal, communication, report writing, analytical thinking, complex problem solving, leadership, political and organisational alertness skills. Knowledge of organisational development and design, work study, job design and job evaluation, business process management and improvement and applicable regulatory frameworks. Knowledge on how to deal with resistance to change. Knowledge of how organisations function internally to be effective. A confident, curious and adaptable worker with the ability to prioritise work activities.
jobs.duties: Develop and review organisational and functional structures. Develop and review job descriptions. Conduct job evaluation. Conduct work study investigations. Coordinate organisational functionality assessment (OFA) projects. Coordinate the development and review of service delivery model. Conduct mapping and project planning.
jobs.applications: All applications must be submitted online on the following link: www.statssa.gov.za/recruitment
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted online and must be completed in full on all fields including the declaration part. Clear indication of the post and reference number that is being applied for must be selected. The application must include only completed and signed new Form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Submission of certified copies of Identity Document, Senior Certificate and the highest required qualification as well as a driver’s license where necessary are optional but will only be submitted by shortlisted candidates to HR on or before the day of the interview date. General information: Females, youth and people with disabilities are targeted for these positions and are hereby encouraged to apply. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake 2 pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise and the other will be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct Assessment). Both technical assessments will be additional criterion to the interview process. The shortlisted candidate(s) will be required to undergo a Competency Assessment and must be available for interviews at a date and time determined by Statistics South Africa. One of the minimum entry requirements for SMS positions is the pre-entry certificate submitted prior to appointment. For more details on the pre-entry course visit: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/smspre-entry-programme/.            The successful candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests and be subjected to security clearance. Applications that do not comply with the requirements will not be taken into consideration. If you have not received a response from this Department within three months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. NOTE: Statistics South Africa reserves the right to fill or not fill the below-mentioned post. OTHER POSTS

Training in Job Design and evaluation, Work study measurement and method study, Structure Design and Service Delivery Model. Certificate in Job Evaluation by NSG. 3-4 years' experience in Human Resources Management/ Strategic Management/ Organisational Design environment. zu.title: Umkleli Kahle: Ukwakheka Kwezinhlangano & Ukulinganiswa Kwemisebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somkleli kahle e-Statistics South Africa e-Pretoria esibandakanya ukwakheka kwezinhlangano, ukulinganiswa kwemisebenzi, kanye nokuphenya isifundo somsebenzi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-bachelor's (NQF 7) kumasevisi obuholo/Impatho Yezebhizinisi/Inkuthazwa Kwezinhlangano/Impatho Yamandla Abantu. Ukwazi ukuzikhulisela ekwakheni nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi, ukulinganiswa kwesifundo somsebenzi kanye nesifundo sezindlela, ukwakheka kwezinhlangano kanye namamodeli wokuletha izinsizakalo. Isitifiketi ekulinganisweni kwemisebenzi esikhiqiziwe yi-NSG. Ukuhlanganisa izinto okwenziwa emkhakheni we-3-4 iminyaka ekuphathweni kwamandla abantu/Impatho Yohlelo Lozibuse/Ukwakheka Kwezinhlangano. Umsebenzi onzima ojabulela ukubhekisisa, oqonda ngaphambili, onamandla okuthonya abanye, obusa ngokwengqondo, okhulumisana nabanye, obhala imibiko, ohlaziya ngokwengqondo, oxazulula izinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi, ohola, onesiphiwo sokuzwa ukuzipholisa ngokwezombangazwe nokuzwa ukuziphatha kwezinhlangano. Ulwazi ngempatho yezinhlangano nokuzakhela, isifundo somsebenzi, ukwakheka kwemisebenzi nokulinganiswa kwemisebenzi, ukuphathwa nokuthuthukiswa kwenqubo yebhizinisi kanye nezinhlelo zomthetho ezifanele. Ulwazi ngendlela yokuphathwa nokumelana nokuqhubeka kwezinto ezingashintshi. Ulwazi ngendlela amaphoyinti angasebenza ngaphakathi ukuze athole ukusebenza kahle. Umsebenzi onesibindi, onobudlovo kanye nendlela yokuziphatha ngokushintsha kwemikhawulo, onesipho sokunika izinto ukubaluleka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi nangokwenzakalayo.
zu.duties: Besekele futhi uqagasele izakhiwo zezinhlangano kanye nezezinhlobo ezahlukene. Besekele futhi uqagasele incazelo ngobunikazi bemisebenzi. Yenza ukulinganiswa kwemisebenzi. Yenza ukuphenya isifundo somsebenzi. Hlela izinhlelo zokuqagela isibonakalisa ukuhleleka kwezinhlangano (OFA). Hlela ukubesekelela nokuxhumanisa izinhlelo ezithela imikhiqizo yezinsizakalo abantu. Yenza ukumakela kanye neplani yemikhakha eqenjwe.

xh.title: Umqeqeshi Omncinci: Ukwakha NzakwoMsebenzi & Ukuqwalasela iMisebenzi
xh.summary: Indima kaMqeqeshi Omncinci kwiStatistics South Africa ePretoria ebandakanya ukwakha nzakwoMsebenzi, ukuqwalasela imisebenzi, nokuphanda ngemmizekelo yokusebenza.
xh.requirements: I-degree yesiqu (NQF 7) kwiiNkonzo zoLawulo/ uLawulo lweShishini/ Ukuziphuhlisa kweSebe/ uLawulo lweZemisebenzi. Uqeqesho ekwakheni uMsebenzi nokuqwalaselwa, ukulinganisa nokuphanda ngeeNzila zokusebenza, ukwakha uMxholo wesebe kunye neNqanaba lokuNikela iNkonzo. Isatifikethi kuQwalaselo lweMisebenzi ngesiNSG. Ukuba namava emyanga ka-3-4 kuloLawulo lweZemisebenzi/ uLawulo loBuchule/ kulwalamko lokwakha nzakwoMsebenzi. Umsebenzizi ongazimeli othe ngqo kwaye ecanga phambili, onethamsanqo, onobuntu obuhle, onothetha kakuhle, obhala iingxelo, ongahlalutyi ngokuchanabile, osombulula iingxaki ezingcamnanayo, onobuqhawe, onesiphiwo sokuziba ngesimo sezepolitiki nasekwenza nzakwoMsebenzi. Ulwazi ngokuziphuhlisa nokwakha nzakwoMsebenzi, ukuphanda ngeenzila zokusebenza, ukwakha umsebenzi nokuqwalasela umsebenzi, uLawulo noPhuculo lweNkqubo yeshishini namakhowudi ezilawulo ezifanelekileyo. Ulwazi ngokuphatha ukuchasana noguqulo. Ulwazi ngendlela amasebe asebenza ngayo ngaphakathi ukuze asebenze ngempumelelo. Umsebenzizi ozenzileyo, obuza imibuzo anako ukuzilungelelanisa, ongcono kakhulu ekubalulekeni imisebenzi yakhe.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa uze uqwalasele izakhiwo zendalo nezenza imisebenzi. Phuhlisa uze uqwalasele iinkcazelo zemisebenzi. Qwalasela imisebenzi. Phanda ngemmizekelo yokusebenza. Linganisa iiprojekthi zoqwalaselo lwenzakwoMsebenzi (OFA). Linganisa uphuhliso noqwalaselo lweNqanaba lokunika iNkonzo. Yenza imaphu kwaye ulungelelanise iiprojekthi.

af.title: Organisasionele Ontwikkeling- en Werkevalueringsbeampte
af.summary: Koördineer werkevaluerings- en organisasionele ontwerpsadministrasie by Statistics South Africa Hoofkantoor in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Bestuursdienste/ Besigheidsbestuur/ Operasionele Bestuur/ Openbare Bestuur/ Strategiese Bestuur/ Organisasionele Ontwikkeling/ Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. zu.title: Inkulu Yesiphakamiso Senqubo Nokulinganiswa Kwemisebenzi
zu.summary: Ukuhlela isiphakamiso nokulawulwa kwezinhlelwo zokwakhiwa kwezinhlangano ehhovisi elikhulu le-Statistics South Africa e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) kwi-Management Services/ Business Management/ Operational Management/ Public Management/ Strategic Management/ Organisational Development/ Human Resources Management. Uqeqesho ekwakheni nokulinganiswa kwemisebenzi, ukulinganisa ukufunda komsebenzi nokuphenya izindlela, ukulawulwa kwenqubo yebhizinisi kanye nendlela yokuletha izinsizakalo. Isitifikedi sokulinganiswa kwemisebenzi esinikiwe yi-NSG. Uzobo ungamakhulu angu-1-2 wamava ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano nasendaweni yokulinganiswa kwemisebenzi. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngezibalo ezifanelekile kanye nesector kahulumeni. Ikono lokunakana imininingwane. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezelayo nokufeza izikhathi eziyinakekile.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela ukulawulwa kwe-Komidi Yokulinganiswa Kwemisebenzi (JEC), ngezinkomfa zenqubo yebhizinisi nakwakheka kwezinhlangano. Ukurekhoda iinkomfa bese ulawula ukusetshenziswa kwemitamo yezinqumo kanye nezinto ezenziwayo. Ukugcina okurekhodiwe ngokunembile, izikhombimsebenzi kanye nezinhlelo zokulondolozwa kwamafayela amaxwebhu e-OD&JE. Ukuhlela ukwamukelwa, ukubhaliswa, ukulandelwa nokulondolozwa kwamafayela ezicelo zokulinganiswa kwemisebenzi nakwakheka kwezinhlangano. Ukuletha izicilo zokuphonononga inqubo yebhizinisi kanye nemisebenzi. Ukuletha izicelo zokuphenya umsebenzi kanye nokuhlola.okuqoqa futhi uhlanganise ulwazi oludingeka ohlelweni lwesinhlangano.

xh.title: Iofisa wokuPhuhlisa iNtshatsheli neSithathi sakuSebenza
xh.summary: Ukucothisa ulawulo lokulinganisa izithuba zokuSebenza nokuqamba eziko elikulu le Statistics South Africa ePretoria.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma yaseLizwe (NQF 6) kwiinkonzo zoLawulo/ uLawulo loQhagamshelwano/ uLawulo lokuQhuba/ uLawulo loLuntu/ uLawulo lokuBumba/ ukuPhuhlisa iNtshatsheli/ uLawulo lweMisebenzi yeBantu. Uqeqesho ekuguqulweni kweZithuba zokuSebenza nokuqamba, ukulinganiswa kokuQonda umSebenzi nendlela yokuQonda, uLawulo lweQela loQhagamshelwano lweQela kuqhagamshelwano neNkqubo yokuNika iNkonzo. Isatifikethi ekuQambeni iZithuba eNSG. 1-2 unyaka wamava kwimeko yokuguqula iNtshatsheli nokuqamba izithuba. Ulwazi olusisiseko lweemvume ezifanelekileyo noluntu olusebenzayo. Amandla okuQwalasela imiselwe ngokweenkcukacha. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokugqiba iindlela ezimnyama ngexesha elifutshane.

Gqiba iinkqubo zemiQunjelwe ukuqwalasela ukusebenza kwezigqibo neZinto ezenziwayo. Gcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo, iindawo zokugcina iNkcukacha kunye neendawo zokuQamba iOd&JE. Qhoboshela ukufumana,okuBhalisa, ukuLandela nokugcina iifomu zokuqamba iZithuba nokuguqula iNtshatsheli. Phatha ukufumana iimvume zokuqwalasela iNtshatsheli yeqela lokuQhagamshelwano lweQela kuqhagamshelwano nemisebenzi. Phatha ukufumana iimvume zokuQonda umSebenzi nokulinganisa. jobs.title: Director: Policy Costings
jobs.summary: Director of Policy Costings at National Treasury in Pretoria, requiring a degree in Economics or related field and five years of senior managerial experience in tax policy research.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum Bachelor’s degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Economics or Statistics or Mathematics or Accounting or Taxation. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level obtained in tax or public policy research and tax policy analysis and formulation. Knowledge and experience of the broader policy framework on tax revenue and related processes required to formulate the fiscal framework for the annual Budget and Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government available as an online course on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of an appointment.
jobs.duties: Develop microsimulation models for corporate income tax (CIT), personal income tax (PIT) and value-added tax (VAT): Develop excel-based micro simulation models to simulate policy options for Personal Income Tax, Corporate Income Tax, and Value Added Tax. Perform regular updating of the micro-simulation models. Use microsimulation models to estimate the revenue and distributional impacts of proposed policy interventions. Annual tax incentive reviews: Assist policy directorates with data and methodological requirements to perform tax incentive reviews, including sourcing relevant data and implementing methodologies to enable the quantitative and qualitative review of tax incentives. Engage the South African Revenue Service (SARS) to source and ensure the accuracy and integrity of tax administrative data enabling the review of tax incentives. Produce descriptive statistics of the tax administrative to enable policy analysis and review. Publish statistical tables and graphs for tax incentive review documents. Preparation, publication and development of tax expenditure statement and annual tax review (Tax Statistics publication): Assist with compiling the annual tax review and ensure accuracy and integrity of data. Coordinate inputs from the Tax Policy unit into the publication. Provide inputs to the South African Revenue Service (SARS) with the compiling of tables and graphs on tax revenue statistical data. Conduct research on international tax expenditure reporting and methodological best practices to enhance South Africa’s current reporting. Determine data requirements on tax expenditures in conjunction with SARS. Publish statistical tables and graphs for the tax expenditure statement in the annual Budget Review. Assist directorates with modelling of economic impact and revenue implications of different tax policy proposals: Provide analysis to estimate the revenue implications of specific tax proposals. Justify and motivate the quantification of economic impacts of various taxes. Produce analytical notes and presentations to illustrate the revenue and economic implications of different tax proposals.
jobs.enquiries: enquiries only (No applications): Recruitment.Enquries@treasury.gov.za OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment
jobs.notes: Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilizes an e-Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist.
