af.title: Direkteur: Beleidskosteberekeninge
af.summary: Direkteur van Beleidskosteberekeninge by National Treasury in Pretoria, wat 'n graad in Ekonomie of 'n verwante veld en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring in belastingbeleidnavorsing vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Baccalaureusgraad (gelykstaande aan NQF vlak 7) in Ekonomie of Statistiek of Wiskunde of Rekeningkunde of Belasting. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak verkry in belasting- of openbare beleidsnavorsing en belastingbeleidsontleding en -formulering. Kennis en ervaring van die breër beleidsraamwerk oor belastinginkomste en verwante prosesse wat vereis word om die fiskale raamwerk vir die jaarlikse Begroting en Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement te formuleer. Voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme soos deur die National School of Government goedgekeur, beskikbaar as 'n aanlyn kursus op https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, voor afhandeling van 'n aanstelling.
af.duties: Ontwikkel mikrosimulasiemodelle vir korporatiewe inkomstebelasting (CIT), persoonlike inkomstebelasting (PIT) en btw (VAT): Ontwikkel op Excel gebaseerde mikrosimulasiemodelle om beleidsopsies vir Personal Income Tax, Corporate Income Tax en Value Added Tax te simuleer. Voer gereelde bywerking van die mikrosimulasiemodelle uit. Gebruik mikrosimulasiemodelle om die inkomste- en verspreidingseffekte van voorgestelde beleidsintervensies te skat. Jaarlikse belastingaansporings hersienings: Ondersteun beleidsdirektorate met data- en metodologiese vereistes om belastingaansporings hersienings uit te voer, insluitend die bekomming van relevante data en die implementering van metodologieë om die kwantitatiewe en kwalitatiewe hersiening van belastingaansporings moontlik te maak. Skakel met die South African Revenue Service (SARS) om belastingadministratiewe data te bekom en die akkuraatheid en integriteit daarvan te verseker ten einde die hersiening van belastingaansporings moontlik te maak. Produseer beskrywende statistieke van die belastingadministratiewe data om beleidsontleding en -hersiening moontlik te maak. Publiseer statistieke tabelle en grafieke vir belastingaansporings hersieningsdokumente. Voorbereiding, publikasie en ontwikkeling van belastingbestedingsverklaring en jaarlikse belastinghersiening (Tax Statistics publikasie): Bystand met die opstel van die jaarlikse belastinghersiening en verseker die akkuraatheid en integriteit van data. Koördineer bydraes van die Tax Policy-eenheid in die publikasie. Verskaf insette aan die South African Revenue Service (SARS) met die opstel van tabelle en grafieke oor belastinginkomste-statistieke data. Voer navorsing uit oor internasionale belastingbestedingsverslaggewing en metodologiese beste praktyke om Suid-Afrika se huidige verslaggewing te verbeter. Bepaal data Vereistes oor belastingbestedings in samewerking met SARS. Publiseer statistieke tabelle en grafieke vir die belastingbestedingsverklaring in die jaarlikse Budget Review. Ondersteun direktorate met modellering van ekonomiese impak en inkomstegevolge van verskillende belastingbeleidsvoorstelle: Verskaf ontleding om die inkomstegevolge van spesifieke belastingvoorstelle te skat. Regverdig en motiveer die kwantifisering van ekonomiese impakte van verskeie belastinge. Produseer analitiese notas en aanbiedings om die inkomste- en ekonomiese gevolge van verskillende belastingvoorstellings te illustreer.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Policy Costings
zu.summary: Umqondisi we-Policy Costings e-National Treasury e-Pretoria, edinga iziqu kwe-Economics noma inkundla efanayo neminyaka emihlanu yesipiliyono esimzingeni wabaphathi abaphezulu ekucwaningeni amapholisi omthelo.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka i-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's degree okuncane (efana no-NQF level 7) ku-Economics noma i-Statistics noma i-Mathematics noma i-Accounting noma i-Taxation. Iminyaka engu-5 yokuthola isipiliyoni esimzingeni wabaphathi abaphakathi/abaphezulu kucwaningweni komthelo noma amapholisi abantu kanye nokuqonda nokubhalwa kwamapholisi omthelo. Ulwazi futhi isipiliyoni kusakhiwo somthetho ongabanzi somthelo wemali engenwayo nakuleyo minyakazo edingekayo ukubhala isakhiwo sezimali ze-National Treasury zaminyaka yonke kanye ne-Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement. Ukuphumelela ukwenza iNyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoba kunconyiwe yi-National School of Government efumaneka njengesifundo esiku-inthanethi kwi-https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokuqedwa kokubekwa esikhundleni.
zu.duties: Bhala amamodeli we-microsimulation etholakala kwezimali ezingenayo zabantu abangaphansi komthetho (CIT), ezimali ezingenayo zabantu ngabantu (PIT) nakwezinto ezibekiwe inani (VAT): Bhala amamodeli we-microsimulation asekwe kwi-Excel ukuze kulingiswe izinketho zamapholisi we-Personal Income Tax, Corporate Income Tax, nakwe-Value Added Tax. Yenza ukubuyekeza okuvamile kwamamodeli we-microsimulation. Sebenzisa amamodeli we-microsimulation ukuze kubalwe ukuthi iziphakamiso zamapholisi zingaba nomthelela kangakanani kumali ezingenwayo nakokwabiwa kwemali. Ukubuyekeza ngokuhamba kweminyaka kokubuyiswa kwemali ngesabelo: Siza iziqondiso zamapholisi ngolwazi nezidingo zeminyakazo ukuze kwenziwe ukubuyekeza kokubuyiswa kwemali ngesabelo, okuhlanganisa nokuqoqa izibalo ezifanele nokusebenzisa izindlela ukuze kwenziwe ukubuyekeza okubalulekile kwezibalo nangokomthelela kwesabelo somthelo. Xhuma no-South African Revenue Service (SARS) ukuze kuqoqwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukunemba nokupheleleka kwemininingwane yomthelo ukuze kwenzeke ukubuyekeza kokubuyiswa kwemali ngesabelo. Hlola izibalo ezingashintshiyo zemithelo ukuzuza ukuhlola amapholisi nokubuyekeza. Shicilela amatafulela nemidwebo yezibalo yamadokhumenti okubuyekeza isabelo somthelo. Ukulungiselela, ukushicilela kanye nokuthuthukisa isitatimende sezimali ezikhokhwa ngomthelo kanye nokubuyekeza imithelo ngokuhamba kweminyaka (ukushicilelwa kwezibalo zemithelo): Siza ekubhaleni ukubuyekeza imithelo ngokuhamba kweminyaka futhi uqinisekise ukunemba nokupheleleka kwemininingwane. Hlanganise izinto ezingenwayo ezivela eqenjini le-Tax Policy kuleso shicilelo. Nikeza izinto ezingenwayo ku-South African Revenue Service (SARS) ekubhaleni amatafulela nemidwebo ngezibalo zemali ezingenwayo ngomthelo. Yenza ucwaningo ngokushicilelwa kwezimali ezikhokhwayo ngomthelo emazweni aphesheya kanye nezindlela ezinhle zeminyakazo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukushicilelwa kwamanje e-South Africa. Qinisekise izidingo zeminingwane kwezimali ezikhokhwayo ngomthelo ngokubambisene no-SARS. Shicilela amatafulela nemidwebo yezibalo sesitatimende sezimali ezikhokhwayo ngomthelo ekuBuyekezeni iNgxowa yeMali ngokuhamba kweminyaka. Siza iziqondazo ekubaleni umthelela wezomnotho kanye nomthelela kumali egingenwayo wonke amapholisi wezimali ezahlukene: Nikeza ukuhlola ukuze kubalwe ukuthi amapholisi athile ezimali azobe nomthelela kangakanani kumali engenwayo. Chaza futhi uzame ukubaluleka kokulinganiselwa komthelela wezomnotho kumithelo eyahlukene. Bhaqa amanothi okuhlola kanye nezibonelo ukuze kuboniswe umthelela kwimali engenwayo nakwezomnotho weziphakamiso ezahlukene zamapholisi.

xh.title: Umkhokeli: Iinkqubo Zexabiso Lemali
xh.summary: Umntu okhokelayo weenkqubo zorhwebo kwi-National Treasury ePretoria, efuna idegree kwi-Economics okanye kwelinye icandelo elidibana nalo kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava obunkokeli obuphezulu kuphononongo lwenkqubo yorhwebo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka kube nokuba neGrade 12 idityaniswa nedegree yeBachelor (elingana ne-NQF level 7) kwi-Economics okanye i-Statistics okanye i-Mathematics okanye i-Accounting okanye i-Taxation. Iminyaka yamava emi-5 kwinqanaba elingaphakathi neliphezulu lobunkokeli efunyaniswa kuphononongo lwenkqubo yorhwebo okanye yenkqubo kahulumate nokuphonononga iinkqubo zengeniso yorhwebo kunye nokuqwalasela iinkqubo. Ulwazi namava kwinkqubo yakulawula iindingeko ezibanziyo zengeniso yorhwebo nendlela efunekayo yoqwalaselo lwenkqubo yemali yonyaka nezatatement yenkqubo ye-Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement. Ukuphumelela ukugqiba i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoko kuvunyelwe yi-National School of Government ifumaneka njengenkqubo kwi-intanethi kwi-https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqibeka kwesikhundla.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa iimodeli zemicrosimulation zorhwebo lokutsalwa kwenkampani (CIT), urhwebo lotyaliso mntu (PIT) norhwebo lwexabiso elongeziweyo (VAT): Phuhlisa iimodeli zemicrosimulation ezisekwe kwi-Excel ukuchaza iinketho zenkqubo ze-Personal Income Tax, Corporate Income Tax, kunye ne-Value Added Tax. Yenza uhlaziyo olusoloko lwenzeka kwiimodeli zemicro-simulation. Sebenzisa iimodeli zemicrosimulation ukubala neziphumo zengeniso kunye nokusaswa kweendawo ezithintelweyo zezenkqubo ezicetyiwayo. Iingqinisiso zonyaka zorhwebo obukhuthazayo: Nceda iindawo zenkqubo nggedatha nabiimfuno zendlela yokwenza ukuze kwenziwe iingqinisiso zorhwebo obukhuthazayo, kuquka nokufumana idatha efanelekileyo kunye nokusebenzisa iindlela zokwenza ukukhulula ukuqinisekisa ukulinganisa kunye nokuqinisekisa ngobungakanisiwe iingqinisiso zorhwebo obukhuthazayo. Qhagamshelana ne-South African Revenue Service (SARS) ukufumana kuqinisekisa ukuchaneka kunye nokucoceka kwegedatha yolawulo lorhwebo ukukhulula ukuqinisekisa iingqinisiso zorhwebo obukhuthazayo. Yenza iibalo ezichazayo zegedatha yolawulo lorhwebo ukukhulula ukuqonda iinkqubo kunye nokuphonononga. Shicilela iitafile zobalo kunye negrafu zemifanekiso yamaxwebhu eengqinisiso zorhwebo obukhuthazayo. Ulungiselelo, ushicilelo nokuphuhlisa isatatement yendleko zorhwebo kunye nenguqulo yonyaka worhwebo (ushicilelo lweBalo lorhwebo): Nceda ngokudibanisa inguqulo yonyaka yenguqulo yorhwebo ukuze uqinisekise ukuchaneka nokucoceka kwedatha. Qhoboshela iingcaciso ezisuka kwicandelo leTax Policy naxwebhu ashicilelwayo. Yazi iingcaciso kwi-South African Revenue Service (SARS) ekudibaniseni iitafile negrafu yedatha yebalo lengeniso yorhwebo. Yenza uphononongo ngendlela yochazo lwengeniso yorhwebo lwamazwe ngamazwe nendlela ezilungileyo zokwenza ukuphucula umbiko wase-South Africa wexesha lanje. Misela iimfuno zedatha ngendleko zorhwebo ngokusebenzisana ne-SARS. Shicilela iitafile zobalo negrafu yesatatement yendleko zorhwebo kwinguqulo yonyaka ye-Budget Review. Nceda iindawo zenkqubo ukuyila isiphumo sezozo nezithintelo zengeniso zeenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zorhwebo: Yenza uphononongo ukubala iziphumo zengeniso zeenkqubo ezithile zorhwebo. Nikela ngezizathu nangemigangatho yobungakanisiwe besiphumo sezo ziloncedo naxa zonke iindidi zorhwebo. Yaza amaxwebhu ephononongo nezihombiso ukubonisa iziphumo zengeniso nezozo zeeenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zorhwebo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Infrastructure and Climate Financing
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role at National Treasury focusing on infrastructure and climate financing strategies, including domestic and foreign borrowing for national government projects.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (NQF 6) in Economics/ Finance/ Statistics/ Investment Management/ Mathematical Sciences, A Bachelor’s Degree (NQF 7) in any of the above disciplines is added advantage. A minimum 4 years’ experience of which 2 years should be at an Assistant Director level or equivalent obtained in financial markets, development finance, and a policy environment. Knowledge and experience of research in quantitative and qualitative methodologies. Knowledge and experience in market analysis and information for utilisation in the broader business. Knowledge and experience in dealing with various market and policy stakeholders.
jobs.duties: Financing of Government’s Gross- Borrowing requirements: Assist in development and implementation of a domestic and foreign borrowing strategy for the national government to finance infrastructure and climate related projects. Assist in negotiating, shortlisting and evaluation of financial offers from domestic and international investors in a cost-effective manner. Assist in the Initiation and management of the funding of annual gross borrowing requirements. Participate in the manage the Debt portfolio by diversify funding sources, smoothening maturity profile and funding cash requirements. Stakeholder Engagement: Assist in the development and implementation tools that will improve the investor base. Coordinate engagements with foreign and local policy makers in the infrastructure and climate finance space to better understand ongoing policy and regulatory reforms that will create an enabling environment for infrastructure and climate financing. Develop relationships with stakeholders like banks, domestic and foreign investors and engage lawyers on certain conditional requirements. Contribute to the developments of the domestic debt market as it relates to infrastructure and climate financing: Participate in Advisory Committees, climate finance committees, infrastructure platforms and Associations in Domestic Debt Market. Assist in the initiation of frequent market and portfolio analysis of qualitative and quantitative domestic and foreign currency debt information. Analyse and advise on prudent debt management policies and recommend corrective debt strategies for implementation. Monitor domestic and international economic events and their impact on the South African economy and the debt portfolio. Perform Research on markets volatility: Assist in the initiation of research on capital markets pertaining to market volatility in the prudent management of debt. Perform research on local and international markets to stay abreast of developments impact on foreign debt management issues. Analyse and provide inputs to briefing notes and speeches.

xh.title: Sikhululi: Iinfrastraksha nokutyala imali-Mali ekubeni kwemozulu
xh.summary: Indima yesikhulu esingumcebisi ku-National Treasury esijonge iindlela zokutyala imali kwimisebenzi yoluntu nasekubakho kwemali-mali yoluntu, okuquka ukutsha kweemali ngaphakathi nasaphandle ukuba kuxhaswe iiprojekthi zorhulumente welizwe.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 12 iyafuneka kuphathwe ngokudityaniswa ne-National Diploma (NQF 6) kwi-Economics/ Finance/ Statistics/ Investment Management/ Mathematical Sciences, i-Bachelor's Degree (NQF 7) kweliphi na kwezi nzulu ingaphezulu kakhulu. Iminyaka engu-4 yokusebenza apho kwiminyaka engu-2 kufuneka kube ngowesiqu sobudlelwane obungumncedisi okanye esilingana nalo efunyaniswe kumajikelezo emali, ekutyalweni-mali koluntu, nasekuqoqosho. Ulwazi nangokusebenza uphando ngezindlela ezilinganiselweyo nangokulinganiswa. Ulwazi nangokusebenza ekusetyenzisweni kolwazi lwegosa nangolwazi lomntu ngamnye ekusebenziseni ngaphezu komsebenzi. Ulwazi nangokusebenza ekuphatheni iintlobo ngeentlobo zabantu abadibana nayo kumajikelezo aphathwayo nasekwenzeni iinthetho.
xh.duties: Ukuqxushwa kweemfuno ze-Gross-Borrowing kaRhulumente: Nceda ekuphuhliseni nasekusebenziseni ingcamango bokutyala-mali ngaphakathi nasaphandle ukuba kuxhaswe urhulumente welizwe kwiiprojekthi ezisolule imozulu. Nceda ekuxoxweni nangokutsha kweefowuni kwindima, ukubeka kuluhlu olufutshane nasekuqwalaselweni kwamabango emali evela kubitshalo-mali basaphakathi nabaphandle ngendlela egqithisayo ngexabiso. Nceda ekuqaliseni nasekulawulweni kweemali zonyaka zeemfuno ze-Gross-Borrowing. Thatha inxaxheba ekulawulweni kwe-Debt portfolio ngokwahlula iindidi zemali, ngokwenza ubuso bokuphela kwexesha kube butyhafu kwaye nexabiso lemali. Ukubonisana nabantu: Nceda ekuphuhliseni nasekusebenziseni izixhobo eziya kuphucula isiseko sabatshali-mali. Lawula ukubonisana nabantu abenza amagqabantshathi amapolisa aphandle nangaphakathi kwendawo yokutyala-mali kwiisolule imozulu ukuze kundiwe ngokuba kuyiphathwa njani ipolisa noluntu oluqwalasela imigqatho enguva edlula enguva ekudaleni ingcamango evumela ukutyala-mali kwisolule imozulu. Phuhlisa ubudlelwane nabanomdla njengeebhanki, abatshali-mali basaphakathi nabaphandle uze ube nomdla wee-gqwetha ngemfuno ethile. Yaphula inkqubo kwimizamo yokuphuhlisa kwimarike yetyala langaphakathi njengoko inxulumene nokutyala-mali kwiisolule imozulu: Thatha inxaxheba kwiiKomiti eziNika icebiso, kwikomiti yemali yemozulu, kwiiplatfom zeefrakstre nasekuhlanganeni kwimarike yetyala langaphakathi. Nceda ekuqaliseni ukusetyenziswa kwesiqhelo sokugqithisa kolwazi lwemarike nepotfoliyo yolwazi olulinganiselweyo kwimali ethile nengalinganiswanga ngaphakathi nasaphandle. Qwalasela unike icebiso malunga neenkqubo ezilungeleyo zolawulo lwetyala uze ulule ngamacebiso alungele ukuqhutywa phambili. Qwalasela iindaba zamanqanaba amarike aphakathi nasaphandle nempembelelo yawo kuqoqosho lwase-South Africa nepotfoliyo yet yala. Yenza uphando ngokutshintshana kwemarike: Nceda ekuqaliseni uphando ngeemarike zendalo malunga nokutshintshana kwemarike ekulawulweni okulungeleyo kwetyala. Yenza uphando malunga nemarike ngaphakathi nasaphandle ukuze uhlale ulufundile nangemitjhini yokuphuhliswa kwemarike empembelela ekulawulweni kwetyala langaphandle. Qwalasela unike izimvo ezigqithisiweyo kwimemo nasekulwazweni okuchazwa kwiiposti ezixhasa inkqubo nasekuboneni abantu.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Infrastruktuur- en Klimaatfinansiering
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-rol by National Treasury met 'n fokus op infrastruktuur- en klimaatfinansieringsstrategieë, insluitend binnelandse en buitelandse lening vir nasionale regeringsprojekte.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Ekonomie/ Finansies/ Statistiek/ Beleggingsbestuur/ Wiskundige Wetenskappe. 'n Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 7) in enige van bogenoemde dissiplines is 'n bykomende voordeel. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se ervaring waarvan 2 jaar op 'n Assistent-direkteursvlak of ekwivalent moet wees, verkry in finansiële markte, ontwikkelingsfinansiering en 'n beleidsomgewing. Kennis en ervaring van navorsing in kwantitatiewe en kwalitatiewe metodologieë. Kennis en ervaring in markontleding en inligting vir benutting in die breër besigheid. Kennis en ervaring in die hantering van verskeie mark- en beleidsbelanghebbendes.
af.duties: Finansiering van die Regering se bruto-leenbehoeftes: Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling en implementering van 'n binnelandse en buitelandse leenstrategie vir die nasionale regering om infrastruktuur- en klimaatverwante projekte te finansier. Bystand verleen met die onderhandeling, kortlys en evaluering van finansiële aanbiedinge van binnelandse en internasionale beleggers op 'n koste-effektiewe wyse. Bystand verleen met die inisiëring en bestuur van die finansiering van jaarlikse bruto-leenbehoeftes. Deelneem aan die bestuur van die skuldportefeulje deur befondsingsbronne te diversifiseer, die volwassenheidsprofiel glad te maak en kontantbehoeftes te finansier. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid: Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling en implementering van instrumente wat die beleggersbasis sal verbeter. Koördineer betrokkenheid by buitelandse en plaaslike beleidmakers in die infrastruktuur- en klimaatfinansieringsruimte om lopende beleids- en regulatoriese hervormings beter te verstaan wat 'n bemagtigende omgewing vir infrastruktuur- en klimaatfinansiering sal skep. Bou verhoudings met belanghebbendes soos banke, binnelandse en buitelandse beleggers en raadpleeg prokureurs oor sekere voorwaardelike vereistes. Bydra tot die ontwikkeling van die binnelandse skuldmark soos dit verband hou met infrastruktuur- en klimaatfinansiering: Deelneem aan Adviserende Komitees, klimaatfinansieringskomitees, infrastruktuurplatforms en Verenigings in die Binnelandse Skuldmark. Bystand verleen met die inisiëring van gereelde mark- en portefeulje-ontleding van kwalitatiewe en kwantitatiewe binnelandse en buitelandse geldeenhede-skuldinligting. Ontleed en adviseer oor versigtige skuldbestuursbeleid en beveel korrektiewe skuldstrategieë vir implementering aan. Monitor binnelandse en internasionale ekonomiese gebeure en hul impak op die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie en die skuldportefeulje. Doen navorsing oor markvolatiliteit: Bystand verleen met die inisiëring van navorsing oor kapitaalmarke met betrekking tot markvolatiliteit in die versigtige bestuur van skuld. Doen navorsing oor plaaslike en internasionale marke om op hoogte te bly van ontwikkelings wat 'n impak het op buitelandse skuldbestuursake. Ontleed en verskaf insette tot kortingsnotas en toesprake.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Persal and Vulindlela Operations (IMS)
jobs.summary: Manage PERSAL and Vulindlela system operations, maintenance and enhancement at National Treasury in Pretoria, requiring an IT diploma and three years of application support experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (NQF 6 in Information Technology or Information Systems/Business Analysis. A Bachelor’s degree (NQF 7) in any of the above disciplines is added advantage. A Qualification in Project Management is added advantage. A minimum of 3 years’ experience obtained in an application/system support or operations environment. Experience in transversal financial management systems operations and support processes (incident, problem, change and release management). Experience in Project Management (IT Systems Implementation). Knowledge and experience of the public-sector financial framework and end-user support in a multi-stakeholder environment. Experience in HR and Salary maintenance/reporting. Knowledge and experience of PERSAL and its operations.
jobs.duties: System Maintenance, Enhancement and Modernisation: Develop, maintain, configure and enhance PERSAL, Vulindlela, MIS, ad hoc reporting and related transversal financial management systems in line with approved procedures, standards, controls and business requirements. Analyse policy, business and user requirements and translate approved changes into functional specifications, configuration requirements, implementation actions and reporting requirements. Support maintenance, modernisation, patching, upgrade and enhancement initiatives across current and future financial management system platforms. Provide functional clarification and technical inputs to internal teams, consultants and service providers during design, development, configuration and implementation activities. System Configuration, Data Updates and Processing Controls: Create, amend, validate and maintain system codes, parameters, tables, calendars, workflows, salary notch codes, salary key scales, MIS classification codes and other configuration items. Coordinate approved bulk, programmatic and system- based updates across relevant systems, including payroll, salary adjustment, leave, package-structuring and reporting processes. Validate control totals, exception reports, adjustment schedules and system outputs to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance before implementation or distribution. Investigate and resolve technical exceptions arising from configuration changes, programmatic updates, financial adjustments, interfaces and processing cycles. Testing, Quality Assurance and Implementation Readiness: Plan, coordinate and conduct testing and quality assurance for new functionality, enhancements, patches, upgrades, interfaces, reports and system maintenance activities. Validate that implemented functionality meets approved business, policy, technical and operational requirements prior to deployment. Support defect resolution, business readiness, stakeholder engagement, change and release activities and post-implementation validation. Prepare implementation communications, system messages, notices, technical outputs and deployment support material for affected users and stakeholders. Operations, Service Continuity, Access and Risk Control: Provide operational and functional support for transversal financial management systems in accordance with agreed service levels, governance processes and security requirements. Monitor service issues, incidents, service requests, system availability, processing risks, turnaround times and stakeholder feedback, and coordinate approved corrective and preventive actions. Support user access management, role/profile maintenance and access review processes in accordance with security and segregation-of- duties requirements. Apply approved system controls to prevent irregular, duplicate, unauthorised or non-compliant payments and transactions, including the processing of deceased-employee salary freezes and related exceptions. Reporting, Stakeholder Support, Governance and Documentation: Develop, maintain and enhance MIS, ad hoc reports and related reporting functionality to support operational, management, compliance and stakeholder information requirements. Liaise with departments, users, internal teams, policy owners, external institutions and service providers to identify, analyse and resolve system, reporting and operational issues. Ensure that system changes, reports, financial adjustments, support processes and stakeholder communications comply with approved policies, procedures, delegations, standards and controls. Maintain technical documentation, system rules, metadata, manuals, help functions, standard operating procedures, user guides, knowledge articles and control records.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Persal en Vulindlela-operasies (IMS)
af.summary: Bestuur PERSAL- en Vulindlela-stelseloperasies, onderhoud en verbetering by National Treasury in Pretoria, wat 'n IT-diploma en drie jaar se toepassingsondersteuningervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6 in Inligtingstegnologie of Inligtingstelsels/Besigheidsanalise. 'n Bachelor se graad (NQF 7) in enige van bogenoemde dissiplines is 'n bykomende voordeel. 'n Kwalifikasie in Projekbestuur is 'n bykomende voordeel. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring verkry in 'n toepassings-/stelselondersteunings- of operasionele omgewing. Ervaring in transversale finansiële bestuurstelsel-operasies en ondersteuningsprosesse (voorval-, probleem-, verandering- en vrystellingsbestuur). Ervaring in Projekbestuur (IT-stelselimplementering). Kennis en ervaring van die openbare sektor se finansiële raamwerk en eindgebruikerondersteuning in 'n omgewing met veelvuldige belanghebbendes. Ervaring in HR- en Salarisonderhoud/rapportering. Kennis en ervaring van PERSAL en sy operasies.
af.duties: Stelselonderhoud, Verbetering en Modernisering: Ontwikkel, onderhou, konfigureer en verbeter PERSAL, Vulindlela, MIS, ad hoc-rapportering en verwante transversale finansiële bestuurstelsels in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde prosedures, standaarde, kontroles en besigheidsvereistes. Analiseer beleids-, besigheids- en gebruikersvereistes en vertaal goedgekeurde veranderinge in funksionele spesifikasies, konfigurasievereistes, implementeringsaksies en rapporteringsvereistes. Ondersteun onderhouds-, moderniserings-, regstellings-, opgraderings- en verbeteringsinisiatiewe oor huidige en toekomstige finansiële bestuurstelselplatforms. Verskaf funksionele verduideliking en tegniese insette aan interne spanne, konsultante en diensverskaffers tydens ontwerp-, ontwikkelings-, konfigurasie- en implementeringsaktiwiteite. Stelselkonfigurasie, Data-opdaterings en Verwerkingskontroles: Skep, wysig, valideer en onderhou stelselkodes, parameters, tabelle, kalenders, werksvloeie, salariskerfkodes, salarissleutelskale, MIS-klassifikasi kodes en ander konfigurasie-items. Koördineer goedgekeurde massale, programmatiese en stelselgebaseerde opdaterings oor relevante stelsels, insluitend loonlyn-, salarisaanpassings-, verlof-, pakketstrukturerings- en rapporteringsprosesse. Valideer kontrole-totalle, uitsonderingsverslae, aanpassingskedules en stelseluitvoere om akkuraatheid, volledigheid en nakoming voor implementering of verspreiding te verseker. Ondersoek en los tegniese uitsonderings wat voortspruit uit konfigurasieveranderinge, programmatiese opdaterings, finansiële aanpassings, koppelvlakke en verwerkingsikusse op. Toetsing, Kwaliteitsversekering en Implementeringgereedheid: Beplan, koördineer en voer toetsing en kwaliteitsversekering uit vir nuwe funksionaliteit, verbeterings, regstellings, opgraderings, koppelvlakke, verslae en stelselonderhoudsaktiwiteite. Valideer dat geïmplementeerde funksionaliteit voor ontplooiing aan goedgekeurde besigheids-, beleids-, tegniese en operasionele vereistes voldoen. Ondersteun foutoplossing, besigheidsgereedheid, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, verandering- en vrystellingsaktiwiteite en post-implementeringsvalidasie. Berei implementeringskommunikasie, stelselboodskappe, kennissgewings, tegniese uitvoere en ontplooiingsondersteuningsmateriaal vir geraakte gebruikers en belanghebbendes voor. Operasies, Dienskontinuïteit, Toegang en Risikobestuur: Verskaf operasionele en funksionele ondersteuning vir transversale finansiële bestuurstelsels in ooreenstemming met ooreengekome diensvlakke, bestuursprosesse en sekuriteitsvereistes. Monitor dienskwessies, voorvalle, diensversoeke, stelselbeskikbaarheid, verwerkingsrisiko's, draaitye en belanghebbende-terugvoer, en koördineer goedgekeurde korrektiewe en voorkomende aksies. Ondersteun gebruikerstoegangsbestuur, rol/profielonderhoud en toegangshersieningsprosesse in ooreenstemming met sekuriteits- en skeiding-van-pligte-vereistes. Pas goedgekeurde stelselkontroles toe om onreëlmatige, duplikaat-, ongemagtigde of nie-nakomende betalings en transaksies te voorkom, insluitend die verwerking van salarisbevriesings vir oorlede werknemers en verwante uitsonderings. Rapportering, Belanghebbende-ondersteuning, Bestuur en Dokumentasie: Ontwikkel, onderhou en verbeter MIS, ad hoc-verslae en verwante rapporteringsfunksionaliteit om operasionele, bestuurs-, nakomings- en belanghebbende-inligtingsvereistes te ondersteun. Skakel met departemente, gebruikers, interne spanne, beleideienaars, eksterne instellings en diensverskaffers om stelsel-, rapporterings- en operasionele kwessies te identifiseer, te analiseer en op te los. Verseker dat stelselveranderinge, verslae, finansiële aanpassings, ondersteuningsprosesse en belanghebbende-kommunikasie aan goedgekeurde beleide, prosedures, delegasies, standaarde en kontroles voldoen. Onderhou tegniese dokumentasie, stelselreëls, metadata, handleidings, hulpfunksies, standaard bedryfsprosedures, gebruikersgidse, kennissartikels en kontrolerekords.

zu.title: Onomdidi: Imisebenzi ye-Persal kanye ne-Vulindlela (IMS)
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yesistimu ye-PERSAL kanye ne-Vulindlela, ukugcinwa kanye nokuthuthukiswa e-National Treasury e-Pretoria, kudingeka idiploma le-IT kanye neminyaka emithathu yesipiliyoni sokusekela uhlelo lokusebenza.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka i-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF 6) ku-Information Technology noma Information Systems/Business Analysis. I-Bachelor's degree (NQF 7) kunoma yisiphi esinye sezifundo ezinhlonyeni ezingenhla kungezinto eziyisidingo esikhulu. Ifundo ku-Project Management kuyinto ezeza inzuzo. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-3 yokuthola isipiliyoni esimweni sokuqashwa kokusekela isistimu noma ukusebenza kwemisebenzi evamile. Isipiliyoni kumaprojekthi e transversal financial management systems ukusebenza, ukusekelwa emigangathweni yaphakathi nokudonxa izinto ezingafanelekile. Isipiliyoni sokuphatha i-Project Management (IT Systems Implementation). Ulwazi kanye nesipiliyoni kwisimiso sezimali sendawo yomphakathi kanye nokusekela abasebenzisi nasezindaweni ezibanzi abantu abaningi. Isipiliyoni kwe-HR kanye nokuqashwa nokubika nge-Salary. Ulwazi kanye nesipiliyoni kwi-PERSAL kanye nemisebenzi yayo.
zu.duties: Ukugcinwa, Ukuthuthukiswa Nokwenziwa kube Namuhla Kwesistimu: Butha, gcina, lungisela uhlelo bese uthuthukisa PERSAL, Vulindlela, MIS, okubikwayo ngokwesikhathi esithile kanye nezinye izistimu zezimali eziyisihlakahleka ngokuhambisana nemiyalo evunyelwe, izinga, izilawuli kanye nezidingo zebhizinisi. Hlaziya inqubomgomo, ibhizinisi nezidingo zomsebenzisi bese uhumusha inguqulo ezunyiwe zibe izinqamuleli ezisebenzayo, izidingo zokulungiselelwa uhlelo, izenzo zokuphumeleliswa kanye nezidingo zokubika. Sekela izinkambu zokugcina, ukwenza kube namuhla, ukulungisa, ukukhupha izinga bese kuthuthukiswa kulo lonke amaphulatifomu amanje nesikhizayo ezesistimu yezimali. Nikeza ucaciso olusebenzayo kanye nezinto ezingeza ulwazi obuchwepheshe amaqembu angaphakathi, abaqondisi kanye nabahlinzeki besebenza ngohlelo, ukuthuthukiswa, ukulungiselelwa uhlelo kanye nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi. Ukulungiselelwa Kwezistimu, Ukubuyekeza Imininingwane Nokulawula Inqubo: Dala, lungisa, qinisekisa bese ugcina amakhodi esistimu, amapharamitha, amatafu, amakhalenda, ukugeleza komsebenzi, amakhodiwesabhenti seholo, amasikali esihamba phambili seholo, amakhodiwoMIS sokuhlukanisa kanye nezinye izinto zokulungiselelwa uhlelo. Hlela izingqikithi ezivunyelwe, ezinhlelwe kanye nangaphakathi kwesistimu ukubuyekeza kulo lonke izistimu ezihambisanayo, okuhlanganisa ukwenza iholo, ukulungiswa kweholo, ukushiya, ukwakheka kwesiphakamiso kanye nemitapo yokubika. Qinisekisa amazinga okulawula, umbiko wokuhlukana kwemitapo, imishado yokulungisa kanye nemiphumela yesistimu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunemba, ukupheleleka nokuhambisana ngaphambi kokuphumelelisa kokusatshazwa. Phenya bese uxazulula iziphithiphithi zobuchwepheshe ezivela kuluguqulo lolungiselelo, ukubuyekeza okuhleliwe, ukulungiswa kwezimali, okuhlanganyelwe kwayo kanye nasezinkambweni zokuqhuba. Ukuhlolwa, Ukuqinisekiswa Ikhwalithi Nokulungele Ukuphumelelisa: Hlela, yenza isibambiselo bese uhola ukuhlolwa kanye nokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yemisebenzi entsha, ukuthuthukiswa, ukulungisa, ukukhupha izinga, okuhlanganyelwe kwayo, umbiko kanye nemicimbi yokugcina isistimu. Qinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi edluliwe ihambisana nezidingo zebhizinisi, inqubomgomo, ubuchwepheshe kanye nemisebenzi evunyelwe ngaphambi kokuyifaka ekusebenzeni. Sekela ukuxazululwa kwezinkinga, ukulungelelwa ibhizinisi, ukubamba iqhaza kubaningi, inguqulo kanye nemisebenzi yokukhipha bese uqinisekisa ngemva kokuphumelelisa. Lungiselela ukuxhumana ngokuphumelelisa, imilayezo yesistimu, izaziso, imiphumela yobuchwepheshe kanye ngenxa yokusekela ukusatshazwa kubasebenzisi abahlongwayo kanye nababambe iqhaza. Imisebenzi, Ukuqhubeleka Kwenkonzo, Ukufinyelela Nokulawula Ingozi: Nikeza inkonzo esebenzayo nensebenzayo kwezistimu zezimali eziyisihlakahleka ngokuhambisana namazinga enkonzo asho ukuthi avumelene kuyo, inqubo yobuso bomlomo kanye nezidingo zokuvikeleka. Qapha izinkinga zenkonzo, izehlo, izicelo zenkonzo, ukutholakala kwesistimu, ingozi ekuqhubeni, isikhathi sokuqukethwa kanye nempendulo yababambe iqhaza, bese uhlela izenzo zokulungisa kanye nokuvimbela ezivunyelwe. Sekela ukuphathwa kwezindinganiso zomsebenzisi, ukugcinwa kwendima/bhalansi kanye nemitapo yokuhlola ngokuhambisana nokuvikeleka kanye nezidingo zokuhlukaniswa kwemisebenzi. Faka izilawuli zesistimu ezivunyelwe ukuvimbela izimali kanye noshintsho olungalungile, oluphindwe kabili, olungavunyelwe noma olungahambisanyayo namithetho, okuhlanganisa nokucubungula ukubambelela kweholo labasebenzisi abashonile kanye nezinye iziphithiphithi ezihlobene. Umbiko, Ukusekela Ababambe Iqhaza, Ukubusa Nemibhalo: Butha, gcina bese uthuthukisa i-MIS, umbiko ngokwesikhathi esithile kanye nomsebenzi othile webhizinisi wokubika ukuze useke izidingo zemisebenzi, abaphathi, ukuhambisana kanye nolwazi lwababambe iqhaza. Xhumana neminyango, abasebenzisi, amaqembu angaphakathi, abanikazi benqubomgomo, izikhungo zangaphandle kanye nabahlinzeki ukuthola, hlaziya bese uxazulula izistimu, umbiko kanye neziphithiphithi zemisebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi inguqulo kwesistimu, imibiko, ukulungiswa kwezimali, imikhuba yokusekela kanye nokuqondana nababambe iqhaza kuhambisana nezinqubomgomo, imikhuba, ukwethulwa, amazinga, kanye nezilawuli ezivunyelwe. Gcina imibhalo yobuchwepheshe, imithetho yesistimu, imetadatha, imanuwali, imisebenzi yosizo, imikhuba emisiwe yokusebenza, iziqondiso zomsebenzisi, izibhalo yolwazi kanye namarekhodi okulawula.

xh.title: iSikhululi seNkokeli: iVulindlela kunye ne-Persal Operations (IMS)
xh.summary: Lawula ukusebenza, ukunyanga nokuphucula iinkqubo ze-PERSAL kunye ne-Vulindlela kwi-National Treasury e-Pretoria, nto leyo efunwa khona idiploma ye-IT kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava kwinkqubo yokuxhasa i-aplikheshini.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka kubekho i-Grade 12 kunye ne-National Diploma (NQF 6) kwTechnology yolwazi okanye kwiiSystem zulwazi/Business Analysis. I-Bachelor's degree (NQF 7) kwezinye iindlela ezongezelelweyo inguqu ezongezelelweyo. I-Qualification kwiProject Management inguqu ezongezelelweyo. Iminyaka eyi-3 yamava ebunyakeni bokuxhasa iinkqubo/zokusebenza okanye kwendawo yokujolisa iinkqubo. Amaxa kwinkqubo ye-financial management systems operations and support processes (incident, problem, change and release management). Amaxa kwiProject Management (IT Systems Implementation). Ulwazi namava kwinkqubo ye-financial framework yesikhulu sendawo yomphakathi nokuxhasa abasebenzisi ukuba bagqithise iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu. Amaxa kwinkqubo ye-HR and Salary maintenance/reporting. Ulwazi namava kwe-PERSAL nakuqhuba kwayo.
xh.duties: Ukunyanga, Ukuphucula nokuZisa Izinto Esintu kwiNkqubo: Yenza, hlala uyinyanisa, lungiselela kwaye uphucule i-PERSAL, i-Vulindlela, i-MIS, iinkcukacha ezibekiweyo ezingafunyaniswanga nakwilinye elijikelezayo leenkqubo zolawulo lweemali ngokwemigaqo egunyazisiweyo, iizinga, izilawulo nemfuno yeshishini. Hlola iinkqubo, imfuno yeshishini nabasebenzisi uze uguqulele kwiinkcukacha eziphathise nezisebenzayo, iimfuno zolungiselelo, iintshukumo zokuzezelwa nemfuno yeengxelo. Xhasa ukunyanga, ukuzisa izinto ezintsha, ukulungisa iimpazamo, ukuphucula nokwenziswa kweenkqubo zamaxesha-anjalo nangomso ezolawula iimali. Yela iingcalo ezingaphakathi, iingcalu kunye nabanelisekelo ngolwazi olucacileyo lokusebenza ngezobuchwepheshe kwixesha lokuyila, ukuphuhliswa, ukulungiselela nokuzezelwa. Ukulungiselela iNkqubo, Ukulungiswa kweMininingwane noLawulo lokuQhuba: Yenza, ulungise, uqiniseke kwaye uluhlale unyanya amakhodi enkqubo, iiparamitha, iitafile, ikhalenda, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo, amakhodi esikwere somvuzo, amakhodi amakhulu omvuzo, amakhodi wohlelo lwe-MIS nakwelinye ukulungiselela. Qhagamshela ukulungiswa kwesigunya, iinkqubo nokuhlaziya iinkqubo ezingahambelanayo, kuquka iinkqubo zokuhlawula umvuzo, ukulungiswa komvuzo, iholo, ukuhlelelwa kwemali nokuvelisa iingxelo. Qinisekisa amanani olawulo, iingxelo ezisemcelweni, iinkqubo zokulungiswa nemveliso yenkqubo ukuze kuqiniseke inyaniso, ukuphela kwayo nokuthobela imigaqo phambi kokuzisezelwa okanye kokusasazwa. Phanda kwaye ulungise izono zobuchwephesha ezivela kutshintsho lolungiselelo, ekuhlaziyweni kweenkqubo, ngokulungiswa kweemali, nakwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokudibanisa iinkqubo. Ukuvavanya, uQinisekiso lweNgcango nokuLungelelana kuQhuba: Cwangcisa, qhagamshela kwaye uvavanye ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenza okutsha, ukuphucula, ukulungisa iimpazamo, ukuphucula iinkqubo, ukudibanisa iinkqubo, iingxelo nokunyanga iinkqubo. Qinisekisa ukuba ukusebenza okuzezelwe kuhambelana nemfuno yeshishini, iinkqubo, amaxabiso nobuchwepheshe phambi kokuba kusetyenziswe. Xhasa ukulungiswa kweempazamo, ulungelelano lweshishini, kuquka nentsebenziswano namabhaladi, utshintsho nokuzezelwa kwezinto kunye nokuqinisekiswa emva kokuba kuzezelwe. Lungiselela iindaba zokuzezelwa, iyonke inkqubo, izaziso, imveliso yobuchwepheshe kunye nemisebenzi yoxhaso ethintwe kubasebenzisi namabhaladi. Isebe, uKuqhube kaPhakathi, uFikelelo noLawulo lengozi: Yinkqubo elawulayo nesebenzayo yoxhaso lwamajikelezi olawulo lwemali ngokwemigaqo, iinkqubo zolawulo kunye nemfuno yokhuseleko. Qwalasela iingxaki zesebe, iingxaki, iicelo zesebe, ukufumaneka kwenkqubo, iingxaki zokuchithwa kwexesha, iingxaki ezibangelwa kukuchithwa kwexesha nendlela abaqhuba ngayo abasebenzisi bakhuluma ngayo ukuze kusetyenziswe iinkqubo ezilungileyo zokulungisa nokuqhuba. Xhasa ukulawula ukufikelela kumsebenzisi, ukulondoloza indima/profayile nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zokufikelela ngokwemfuno yokhuseleko nokwahlulelana kweenkqubo. Sebenzisa iinkqubo ezilungileyo zeendlela zolawulo ukuze kuthintelwe ukukhokiswa okungalunganga, okuphindaphindiweyo, okungagunyaziswanga okungekhoyo kwimigaqo nakwezinye iinkqubo ezikwiingozi ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.reference_number: S107/2026 Division: Office of The Accountant-General
jobs.title: Assistant Director: Persal and Vulindlela Operations (EPP)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role maintaining and enhancing PERSAL and Vulindlela financial management systems at National Treasury in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Information Technology or Information Systems or Business Analysis. A Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) in any of the above disciplines is added advantage; and A Qualification in Project Management is added advantage. A minimum of 3 years’ experience obtained in an application or system support or operations environment. Experience in transversal financial management systems operations and support processes (incident, problem, change and release management). Experience in Project Management (IT Systems Implementation). Knowledge and experience of the public-sector financial framework and end-user support in a multi-stakeholder environment. Knowledge and experience of PERSAL and its operations.
jobs.duties: Some key Outputs include: Financial Management Systems Development, Configuration, Maintenance and Enhancement: Maintain, configure and enhance PERSAL, Vulindlela and related transversal financial management systems in line with approved policies, procedures, standards and controls. Analyse policy, business and user requirements and translate approved changes into system specifications, functional requirements and technical implementation actions. Coordinate system design, development, configuration, testing, quality assurance, implementation and post- implementation support for new or enhanced system functionality. Support modernisation, patching, upgrades and integration activities by providing functional clarification, operational input and implementation support. Maintain technical documentation, system rules, control records, standard operating procedures, user guides and knowledge articles to support consistent service delivery. System Operations, Processing, Availability and Control Management: Provide operational and technical support for payroll, EFT, EDT, SCOA, reporting, leave, salary package structuring and related financial management system processes. Monitor system availability, peak-period readiness, processing schedules, pay dates, closing dates, disk-space requirements and recovery measures to support business continuity. Apply approved system controls to prevent irregular, duplicate, unauthorised or non- compliant payments and transactions, including deceased-employee salary controls and exception management. Support user access management, role and profile maintenance, access reviews and segregation-of-duties controls in line with security requirements. Monitor and report on service performance, incident trends, request volumes, turnaround times and operational risks to support continuous improvement. Change, Release, Testing and Modernisation Support: Coordinate change and release activities for enhancements, upgrades, patches, initiatives and new implementations in line with approved governance processes. Conduct and coordinate technical, functional, user-acceptance and post-implementation testing to confirm that implemented functionality meets approved requirements. Support feasibility assessments, planning, implementation readiness, defect resolution and stakeholder communication for approved system changes. Ensure requests are recorded, assessed, approved, prioritised and implemented in a controlled manner to protect system integrity and avoid duplication. Stakeholder Engagement, Client Support and Problem Resolution: Liaise with departments, internal teams, external institutions, service providers and forums to identify, analyse, prioritise and resolve system incidents, queries and service requests. Provide third-level support, technical guidance and expert input for escalated PERSAL and financial management system matters. Prepare and issue system notices, circulars, user messages, implementation communications, audit inputs and stakeholder updates relating to system changes and operations. Coordinate user forums, stakeholder engagements, intervention strategies and knowledge-sharing activities to strengthen user readiness and service continuity. Governance, Compliance, Contractor Support and Knowledge Transfer: Support compliance with approved policies, regulations, delegations, standards, audit requirements, service levels and operational controls across system maintenance and support activities. Assist with policy research, analysis and alignment of system competencies with requirements from DPSA, Office of the Accountant-General, CPO and other relevant stakeholders. Support contractor deliverables by coordinating work allocation, SCC activities, timesheet and overtime recommendations, SLA monitoring and remedial actions where required. Facilitate documentation, knowledge transfer and collaboration between officials, consultants and service providers to strengthen internal capability and reduce dependency on external support.

Please note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. All qualifications, criminal and SA citizenship checks will be conducted on all short-listed candidates and, where applicable, additional checks will be conducted in line with the new DPSA Directive effective 01 April 2024. Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies, only for a specific period, of which the submitted documents will then be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at your own expense. Upon appointment, successful candidates will be required to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and to sign a Performance Agreement within 3 months from date of appointment and for candidates whose appointment exceeds 12 calendar months will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) calendar months excluding leave taken as prescribed by Public Service Regulation 68. The status of your application will be visible on the e- Recruitment system. However, if you have not received feedback from the National Treasury within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Note: The National Treasury reserves the right not to fill the below-mentioned posts, withdraw or to put on hold a position and/or to re-advertise a post. All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the Human           Resources         Recruitment       Support        Team        on Recruitment.Enquiries@treasury.gov.za. xh.title: Umphathi Okusetyenziswa ngamanye: iinkcukacha zePersal kunye neVulindlela Operations (EPP)
xh.summary: Indima yomphathi osetyenziswa ngamanye egcina naphucula iinkqubo zolawulo lwezimali zePERSAL naseVulindlela kwisiSebe seNazayo saseTreasury ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibe nekhradede yesi-12 edityaniswe nefomana yelizwe engaphantsi (NQF Level 6) kwInformation Technology okwaInformation Systems okwaBusiness Analysis. I degree yebachelor's (NQF Level 7) nalipha na kwezinye iindawo ezingentla ngaphezulu kokuya kuthi ibe ngumntu ongakuva kwentliziyo; kwaye igqibo kwProject Management nento engangclawuli. Okokufuna inyanga ezintsatshu ngesidanga kwindawo ekuyiyo ukuba namava kwinkqubo okwasistim okusekelo okokuzibandakanya. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwezimali ezingaphakathi ezikwisistim evela ngaphandle kwezindawo (incident, problem, change and release management). Ulwazi kwProject Management (IT Systems Implementation). Ulwazi namava ngokusetyenziswa kwentlango yezimali zabantu baseburhulentwini nasekusekelweni kwabasebenzisi ekubeni babengumnji wokugqitha. Ulwazi namava ngePERSAL nokusebenza kwayo.
xh.duties: Ezinye iziphumo eziyintsingiselo ziquka: Intshukumo nokusetyenziswa kwesistimu kwezimali, ukulungiselela, ukugcina nokuphucula: Gcina, ulungiselele uphucule i-PERSAL, i-Vulindlela nezinye iinkqubo ezingaphakathi zelawulo lezimali ngokwemigaqo, iinkqubo, ngeendidi ezamkelekileyo nolawulo. Hlengahlengisa imigaqo, iimfuno zeshishini nabezindalo uze ugqithise izinto ezamkelekileyo zibe ziinkcazelo ze-sistimu, iimfuno ezisebenzayo nokuqhutywa okusemva kwemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe. Qhoboshela ukulungiselelwa, ukuphuhliswa, ukuqwalaselwa kwezinto, ukuvavanywa, nokuqinisekiswa kwehlabathi, nokusekelwa emva kokusebenza kwezinto ezintsha okanye ezibucwiga kwisistimu. Sekela ukwenziwa kumanisi, iindawo ezilungisiweyo, ukuphuculwa kwezinto nasekuhambeni kolwazi ngokunika iziqondo ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo, ngokusebenza ngokubanzi kwaye usekele kuhamba kolwazi. Gcina amaxwebhu obuchwepheshe, imigaqo yesistimu, ukulawulwa kwamaxwebhu, iinkqubo ezisemgangathweni, izikhokelo zabasebenzisi, imibhalo yolwazi ukuze ukwazi ukusekela ukwenzeka kolwazi ngokusesikweni. Ukwenziwa kolwazi ngokubanzi kwesistimu, ukulungiselela izinto ezikwindalo, ukugcina nolawulo lwemiba: Nikela ngesekelo elisebenzayo nelobuchwepheshe kwimali yabasebenzi, kwi-EFT, EDT, SCOA, kwimibiko, kwamalungelo, nakulawulo lwesiqwenga seemali nakwezinye iinkqubo ezibambe kangangamagama. Qwalasela ukubakho kwesistimu, ukulungelelana kwexesha lokugqitha, ukulungiselelwa koshishino lwezinto, iintsuku zokuhlawulela, iintsuku ezivaliweyo, iimfuno zesithuba se-disiki nendlela zokuphindaphinda ukuze usikele ekwenzeka kolwazi ngokusikelela kolwazi. Faka kwindawo isistimu ekulawulweni ukuzigcina ezingavumelekanga ngokusesikweni ezingaphindwayo, ezingamkelekanga okanye ezingahambisana nemigaqo nokuhlawulela, kuquka nolawulo lweemali zabasebenzi abaswele iinkcukacha ezingagqibelelanga. Sekela ukulawulwa kwamafa abasebenzisi bayifikile, ukugcina amagunya namaphrofayili, ukutolikwa kolwazi ngamafa nolawulo kwaba bemi ngokulahlekileyo ngokwemfuno yokhuseleko. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kolwazi emisebenzini, ukuya phambili kwemiba, ukubakho kokusingqongileyo kwesistimu, iintsobo zokuqwalasela imiba, ukubakho kwexesha lokugqithisa iinkcukacha zolwazi ezingavunyelwanga ngokusesikweni nokuba yindawo ethile yokulunga ngokuchanekileyo ukuze usikele ekuphuculweni okuqhubekayo. Ukutshintsha, ukukhulisa, ukuvavanya nokuHambisa iNkqubo yeSistimu eNtsha: Qhoboshela ukutshintshwa nokukhuliswa kwezinto ezintsha, ukuphuculwa, iindawo ezilungiweyo ezisesikweni, izinto ezintsha ezahanela kakhulu okanye ezisingatha isistimu ngokusesikweni ngemigaqo esemgangathweni. Zenza uze uqhoboshele ekuvavanyeni kobuchwepheshe, ekusebenzayo, ekuvavanyeni kwabasebenzisi nasekuvavanyweni okusekelwe kwindalo emva kokusetyenziswa ukuqinisekisa ukuba izinto ezisetyenzisiweyo ziyahambisana neemfuno ezamkelekileyo. Sekela ukuvavanywa kokuzenzela, ukulungiselela, ukulungelelana kokwenziwa, ukulungiswa kwemiba ekhoyo nokudibana nabantu bokunika ulwazi ngezinto ezintsha kwisistimu ezamkelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iimfuno zibhalwe phantsi, ziqwalaselwe, zamkelwe, zibe ngaphezulu kwezinye kwaye zenziwe ngendlela elawulwayo ukuze zikhusele isistimu kwaye zingabi ndawo yokuphinda-phanda. Ukudibana nabathathi-nxaxheba, ukusekela abakluxhwe kwaye alungise imiba: Thetha namasebe, namaqela angaphakathi, nabemi belizwe, nabahanjiswa ngeendlela ezahanela ukubakho, ukuhlengahlengisa, ukulungelelanisa kwaye alungise iinkcukacha ezindala ngeendlela, ukubuzwa nokucelwa ulwazi. Nikela ngesekelo esiNdikimini sesithathu, ulwazi lobuchwepheshe nezinye izimvo ngokusesikweni nangobuchwepheshe kwimiba ye-PERSAL nesezimali ezilawulwa kwisistimu. Lungiselela uze uphumeze izaziso ngeendlela ezahanela imiba, iindlela ezahanela imiba, iindaba ezithunyelwa abasebenzisi, ezahanela ukusetyenziswa kwezinto ezintsha, izimvo ezahanela nabanikezwa ngolwazi ngokutshintshwa nokusetyenziswa kwezinto ezintsha. Qhoboshela amaqela abasebenzisi, abadibana nabathathi-nxaxheba, iindlela zokuzama nasekusabeleni kolwazi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulungelelana kwabasebenzisi kwaye kuqhubeke ukubakho kolwazi. Ulawulo, ukuhambelana nemigaqo, ukusekela abo bakhankanywe kwizicwangciso zabo, nokugqibelela kwamava: Sekela ukuhambelana kwemigaqo, izixhobo, izaziso, iindidi, iimfuno ezahanela ukusettyenziswa kwemiba, iindlela ezisesikweni nolawulo kuzo zonke iinkqubo zokugcina nokusetyenziswa kwesistimu. Seda ngokucwaningwa kwemigaqo, ukuhlengahlengiswa nokuhambisana kolwazi ngeemfuno eziveliswe yiDPSA, i-Office ye-Accountant-General, iCPO nabanye abathathi-nxaxheba. Sekela ngokunika izinto abo bakhankanywe ngokwencwadi yokusebenza ukuqwalasela ukwahlulwa kwemisebenzi, iinkqubo ze-SCC, izaziso ngeemfuno ezongezelelweyo ngaphezu kwexesha, ukulawulwa kwe-SLA nokuqwalaselwa kwezindawo ezilungileyo apho kuyimfuno. Yenza kubekho ulwazi, ukuhambiselana kolwazi kolwazi phakathi kwabasemagunyazini, abanikezelwa ngolwazi nabasebenzisi ngenjongo yokwazi ukuba bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo ngokwabo bangadingi ncedo kubantu abangaphandle.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Persal- en Vulindlela-bedrywighede (EPP)
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur-rol wat PERSAL- en Vulindlela-finansiële bestuurstelsels by National Treasury in Pretoria onderhou en verbeter.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Inligtingstegnologie of Inligtingstelsels of Besigheidsanalise. 'n Bachelor's Degree (NQF Level 7) in enige van bogenoemde dissiplines is 'n bykomende voordeel; en 'n Kwalifikasie in Project Management is 'n bykomende voordeel. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring opgedoen in 'n toepassings- of stelselsteun- of bedryfsomgewing. Ervaring in transversale finansiële bestuurstelselbedrywighede en -steunprosesse (insident-, probleem-, verandering- en vrystellingsbestuur). Ervaring in Project Management (IT-stelselimplementering). Kennis en ervaring van die openbare sektor se finansiële raamwerk en eindgebruikersteun in 'n multi-belanghebbende omgewing. Kennis en ervaring van PERSAL en die bedrywighede daarvan.
af.duties: Sleutellewerings sluit in: Finansiële Bestuurstelselontwikkeling, -konfigurasie, -onderhoud en -verbetering: Onderhou, konfigureer en verbeter PERSAL, Vulindlela en verwante transversale finansiële bestuurstelsels in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde beleid, prosedures, standaarde en kontroles. Analiseer beleids-, besigheids- en gebruiker vereistes en vertaal goedgekeurde veranderinge in stelselspesifikasies, funksionele vereistes en tegniese implementeringsaksies. Koördineer stelselontwerp, -ontwikkeling, -konfigurasie, -toetsing, gehaltversekering, -implementering en na-implementeringssteun vir nuwe of verbeterde stelselfunksionaliteit. Ondersteun modernisering, laptoevoegings, opgraderings en integrasie-aktiwiteite deur funksionele verduideliking, operasionele insette en implementeringssteun te verskaf. Onderhou tegniese dokumentasie, stelselreëls, kontrolelêers, standaardoperasieprosedures, gebruikersgidse en kennisartikels om konstante dienslewering te ondersteun; Stelselbedrywighede, Verwerking, Beskikbaarheid en Kontrolebestuur: Verskaf operasionele en tegniese steun vir loondief, EFT, EDT, SCOA, verslagdoening, verlof, salarispakketstrukturering en verwante finansiële bestuurstelselprosesse. Monitor stelselbeskikbaarheid, gereedheid vir spitsperiodes, verwerkingsskedules, betaaldatums, sluitingsdatums, skyfspasie-vereistes en herstelmaatreëls om besigheidskontinuïteit te ondersteun. Pas goedgekeurde stelselkontroles toe om onreëlmatige, duplikaat-, ongemagtigde of nie-nakomende betalings en transaksies te voorkom, insluitend salariskontroles vir oorlede werknemers en uitsonderingsbestuur. Ondersteun gebruikerstoegangsbestuur, rol- en profielonderhoud, toegangsverslae en skeiding-van-pligte-kontroles in ooreenstemming met sekuriteitsvereistes. Monitor en rapporteer oor diensprestasie, insidentneigings, versoeke volumes, draaitye en operasionele risiko's om deurlopende verbetering te ondersteun; Verandering, Vrystelling, Toetsing en Moderniseringssteun: Koördineer verandering- en vrystellingsaktiwiteite vir verbeterings, opgraderings, laptoevoegings, inisiatiewe en nuwe implementerings in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde prosesse. Voer en koördineer tegniese, funksionele, gebruiker-aanvaarding en na-implementeringstoetsing uit om te bevestig dat geïmplementeerde funksionaliteit aan goedgekeurde vereistes voldoen. Ondersteun haalbaarheids assessments, beplanning, implementeringsgereedheid, defekoplossing en belanghebbende kommunikasie vir goedgekeurde stelselveranderinge. Verseker dat versoeke op 'n beheerde manier aangeteken, geassesseer, goedgekeur, geprioritiseer en geïmplementeer word om stelselintegriteit te beskerm en duplikasie te vermy; Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, Kliëntsteun en Probleemoplossing: Skakel met departemente, interne spanne, eksterne instellings, diensverskaffers en forums om stelselinsidente, navrae en diensversoeke te identifiseer, analiseer, prioritiseer en op te los. Verskaf derdevlaksteun, tegniese leiding en kundige insette vir geescaleerde PERSAL- en finansiële bestuurstelselaangeleenthede. Berei en versend stelselkennisgewings, omsendbriewe, gebruikerboodskappe, implementeringskommunikasie, oudit-insette en belanghebbende opdaterings rakende stelselveranderinge en -bedrywighede voor. Koördineer gebruikerforums, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, ingrypingsstrategieë en kennisoordragaktiwiteite om gebruiker gereedheid en dienskontinuïteit te versterk; Goewerance, Nakoming, Kontrakteursteun en Kennisoordrag: Ondersteun nakoming van goedgekeurde beleid, regulasies, delegasies, standaarde, ouditvereistes, diensvlakke en operasionele kontroles oor stelselonderhoud en -steunaktiwiteite. Bystand met beleidsnavorsing, -analise en belyning van stelselbevoegdhede met vereistes van DPSA, Office of the Accountant-General, CPO en ander relevante belanghebbendes. Ondersteun kontrakteurslewerings deur werktoewysing, SCC-aktiwiteite, tydstaat- en oortydaanbevelings, SLA-monitering en remediërende aksies te koördineer waar nodig. Fasiliteer dokumentasie, kennisoordrag en samewerking tussen amptenare, konsultante en diensverskaffers om interne vermoë te versterk en afhanklikheid van eksterne steun te verminder.

zu.title: Assistant Director: Work-Persal kanye No-Vulindlela Operations (EPP)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sobakedi onguAssistant Director somsebenzi we-PERSAL kanye nowe-Vulindlela wamakhulu ezimaliNational Treasuring oPretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 iyadingeka kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ebekwe phansi kwi-Information Technology noma i-Information Systems noma i-Business Analysis. I-Bachelor's Degree (NQF Level 7) kunoma yisiphi isifundo esingenhla kuyisibonezelo; futhi isiqui-Project Management sikhona kusibonezelo esengeziwe. Amava anosuku osungu-3 abuzwe kulesimo sokuqasha isiqalekiso noma isistimu sokusekela noma izimo zokusebenza. Amava kumasistimu ozezimali ukusebenza kwawo kanye nokuqonda izehlakalo, izinkinga, ushintsho kanye nokuphathwa kokukhishwa kwemibhalo. Amava kokuqondisa iphrojekthi (kusetshenziswa amasistimu we-IT). Ukwaziswa kanye namava ngesimiso sezimali sabantu kanye nokesekela abasebenzisi esikhundleni esinabantu abaningi abahlangene. Ukwaziswa kanye namava nge-PERSAL kanye nokuqondisa imisebenzi yawo.
zu.duties: Eminye imiphumela ewugqozi ifaka phakathi: Ukuthuthukiswa, Ukulungiswa, Ukugcinwa Nokuphuculwa Kwamasistimu Ezezimali: Gcina, lungisa uphucule i-PERSAL, i-Vulindlela namanye amasistimu wezezimali ahambisanayo ngokusho nemithetho yokusebenza, izinqubo, izingimo kanye nezilawuli ezamukelekile. Hlaziya imithetho yokusebenza, izidingo zebhizinisi nomsebenzisi bese uhumusha ithuba elamukelekwe libe ngemiyalo yesistimu, izidingo ezisebenzayo kanye nezinyathelo zokuphumeza ngobuchwepheshe. Hlela ukwakheka kwesistimu, ukuthuthukiswa, ukulungiswa, ukuhlolwa, ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi, ukuphumeza kanye nokwesekwa ngemva kokuphumeza ukusebenza okusha noma okuphuculiwe kwesistimu. Sekela ukwenziwa kabusha, ukulungiswa, ukuthuthukiswa kanye namanyathelo okuhlanganisa ngokunika inhlobo echazayo, okokusebenza kanye nokesekela lokuphumeza. Gcina ukwemikelwa ngobuchwepheshe, imithetho yesistimu, irekhodi zokulawula, izinqubo zokusebenza eziyisivinini, izikhokelo zabasebenzisi kanye namabhulogi olwazi ukuze kuqedelelwe ukulethwa kwensiza okuhambisanayo. Ukuphathwa Kwezindlela Zokusebenza Zesistimu, Ukucubungula, Ukubonakala Nokulawula: Nikeza izesekelo lokusebenza nangobuchwepheshe okhokho, i-EFT, i-EDT, i-SCOA, ukubika, ukushiya, ukwakheka kweholo kanye nezinye izinqubo zamasistimu wezezimali. Londa ukubonakala kwesistimu, ukulungelelwa kwesikhathi sokuqina, izijimu zokucubungula, izinsuku zokuqashwa kweholo, izinsuku zokuvala, izidingo zesikhathi sediski kanye nezinyathelo zokubuyisela ukuze kuqedelelwe ukuqhubeka kobhizinisi. Faka izilawuli ezamukelekwe zesistimu ukuze kuthintelwe izinkokhelo kanye noshintsho olungalungile, oluphindiwe, olungavunyiwe noma olungahambisani namagunya, okuhlanganisa izilawuli zeholo lowesekeli oshonile kanye nokuqonda izingxube. Sekela ukuphathwa kokufinyelela komsebenzisi, ukugcinwa kwendima neprofayili, ukuhlolwa kokufinyelela kanye nezilawuli zokuhlukaniswa kwemisebenzi ngokusho nezidingo zokuphepha. Londa ubike ukuze kubike ngemvelo yensezo, ukwanda kwezehlakalo, izingqikithi zezicelo, isikhathi sokuqeda kanye nezingozi zokusebenza ukuze kuqedelelwe ukuphuculwa okuqhubekayo. Izesekelo Loshintsho, Lokukhishwa, Ukuhlolwa Nokwenziwa Kabusha: Hlela ithuba lokushintsha nokuqhubeleka kwamapholiso, ukuthuthukiswa, ukulungiswa, izinhloso kanye nezinto ezisha zokuphumeza ngokusho ngesinqumo sokuphatha esamukelekile. Yenza uhlele izinkambu zokuhlola ngobuchwepheshe, ngokusebenza, ngabasebenzisi ngemva kokuphumeza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuphumeziwe kuhambisana nezidingo ezamukelekile. Sekela ukuhlolwa kwezimo, ukuhlela, ukulungelelwa ukuphumeza, ukuxazulula izingxube kanye nokuxhumana nabalingani ngesinqumo esamukelekwe sesistimu. Qinisekisa ukuthi izicelo zibhalwe, zihlolwa, zamukelwa, zibekwe ngaphambili bese ziphunywa ngendlela elawulwayo ukuze kuvikelwe ukuzinza kwesistimu kanye nokugwamisa ukuphinda. Ukuxhumana Nabantu Abahlukene, Izesekelo Labakhasimende Nokuxazulula Izinkinga: Xhumana namawepahmentha, amaqembu angaphakathi, izikhungo ezingaphandle, abanikeli bensiza kanye namafomu ukuze kubonakale, kuhlwaywe, kubekwe ngaphambili bese kuxazululwa izehlakalo zesistimu, imibuzo kanye nezicelo zenkonzo. Nikeza izesekelo lesikhathi sesithathu, izikhokelo ngobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqhakambisa izinto eziyisikhungo samaphuzu emibuzo ye-PERSAL kanye namasistimu wezezimali. Lungisa uphume izaziso zesistimu, izikhwama, imiyalezo yomsebenzisi, ukuxhumana ngokuphumeza, okokuhlola kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwabantu ngokushintshwa kwesistimu. Hlela amafomu abasebenzisi, ukuxhumana kwabantu, izindlela zokungenelela kanye namanyathelo yokwabelana ngolwazi ukuze kuphuculwe ukulungelelwa komsebenzisi. Ukuphathwa, Ukuhambisana, Izesekelo Labahlinzeki Nokudluliselwa Kolwazi: Sekela ukuhambisana nemithetho, izimiso, izinkomba, izinga, izidingo zokuqinisekiswa, amanani ensiza kanye nezilawuli zokusebenza ekugcineni nakesekeleni isistimu. Siza ucwaningo lwemithetho, ukuhlaziya kanye nokuhambisa amandla esistimu nezidingo evela ku-DPSA, Nhloko-Kaupidi, i-CPO kanyeabalabakaki. Sekela okuhlinzekwa ngumhlinzeki ngokuhlela ababelwe umsebenzi, izinkambu ze-SCC, izinkomba zesikhathi noma iholo, ukuphenya i-SLA kanye nezinyathelo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Siza ukubhalwa kwemibhalo, ukudluliselwa kolwazi kanye nokusebenzisana phakathi kwabaphathi, abacebisi kanye nabahlinzeki bensiza ukuze kuphuculwe ikhono langaphakathi bese kuncishwa ukuncika ngesekelo langaphandle.

jobs.title: Engineer Production Grade a - C
jobs.salary_text: R914 517 - R1 376 199 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package), (offer will be based on years of experience)
jobs.summary: Provide water and sanitation planning support to municipalities, appraise technical reports and assist with project implementation in Kimberley.
jobs.requirements: Engineering Degree (B Eng/BSc (Eng in Civil Engineering. Three (3) years post qualification engineering experience in the field of Water and Sanitation services. Registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineer. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Knowledge of water and sanitation services engineering design and analysis, Environmental impact management, Water Services Development Planning, Supply chain management, contractual and legal requirements, business planning, Programme and project management. Change management. Service delivery innovation (SDI). Problem solving and analysis. People management and empowerment. Client orientation and customer focus. Communication. Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Provide water and sanitation planning support (i.e appraisal of water and sanitation technical report and business plans and prepare recommendations letters). Support municipalities in the planning, implementation and monitoring of water and sanitation services / projects through platforms / tools such as Excreta Flow Diagrams, Water Services Development Plans (WSDPs), participation in the Green Drop Program and undertaking site visits to verify progress. Attending technical Intergovernmental Relations meetings in the province. Ensure through evaluation that planning and design for sanitation services are done according to sound engineering principles and according to norms and standards and code of practice. Approve engineering works according to prescribed norms and standards. Investigate Water Services Delivery complaints and compile mandatory reports. Provide technical support to the sanitation sub-directorate. Building capacity and mentoring young water services engineers/ analysts.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Ingenieur Produksie Graad a - C
af.summary: Verskaf water- en sanitasiebeplanningsondersteuning aan munisipaliteite, evalueer tegniese verslae en help met projekimplementering in Kimberley.
af.requirements: Ingenieursgraad (B Eng/Bsc (Eng in Siviele Ingenieurswese. Drie (3) jaar se ingenieurservaring na kwalifikasie op die gebied van water- en sanitasiedienste. Registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieur. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van water- en sanitasiedienste se ingenieursontwerp en -analise, omgewingsimpakbestuur, Water Services Development Planning, Supply chain management, kontraktuele en regsvereistes, besigheidsbeplanning, Program- en projekbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Dienslewering-innovasie (SDI). Probleemoplossing en analise. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Kommunikasie. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Verskaf water- en sanitasiebeplanningsondersteuning (d.w.s. evaluering van water- en sanitasietegniese verslae en besigheidsplanne en die opstel van aanbevelingsbriewe). Ondersteun munisipaliteite met die beplanning, implementering en monitering van water- en sanitasiedienste/projekte deur middel van platforms/nutsmiddels soos Excreta Flow Diagrams, Water Services Development Plans (WSDPs), deelname aan die Green Drop Program en die onderneming van terreinbesoeke om vordering te verifieer. Bywoon van tegniese Intergovernmental Relations-vergaderings in die provinsie. Verseker deur evaluering dat beplanning en ontwerp vir sanitasiedienste gedoen word volgens deeglike ingenieursbeginsels en volgens norms en standards en 'n kode van praktyk. Keur ingenieurswerke goed volgens voorgeskrewe norms en standards. Ondersoek Water Services Delivery-klagtes en stel verpligte verslae op. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan die sanitasie-subdirektoraat. Bou kapasiteit en mentor jong waterdienste-ingenieurs/ontleders.

zu.title: Umchwichipheli Wokukhiqiza Izinga a - C
zu.summary: Nikeza amasipala inkxaso ekuhleleleni amanzi nokuhlanza, hlola imibiko yobuchwepheshe futhi usize ekwenzeni imigqa eKimberley.
zu.requirements: I-degree yobuchwepheshe (I-B Eng / I-BSc (Eng) ku-Civil Engineering. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuhlolwa kweminyaka yokuqala ukusebenza njengengqalasizinda kwinkundla yamandla okuhlanza. Ukuqashwa kwe-ECSA njengomchwepheshe. Ukubonisa ilayisensi yokushayela engavuselelwe. Ulwazi lokuqonda ukuhlela nokuhlola amandla okuhlanza, ukuphathwa kwezomhlaba, ukuhlela amandla amanzi, ukuphathwa kwezinkundla zokuthenga, imithetho nemibandela, ukuhlela imisebenzi, ukuphathwa kohlelo kanye nemigqa. Ukuphathwa kwezinguquko. Inkonzo yokuletha izinto ezintsha (i-SDI). Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqonda. Ukuphathwa abantu nokubakhukisa. Ukuqonda abathengi kanye nokugxila kubo. Ukuthulumelayo. Ukubhekana neziphoqi nokuziphatha kwezomfihlo.
zu.duties: Nika indawo zokuhlala inkxaso yokuhlelela amanzi nokuhlanza (okunganikezwa isibuyekezo semibiko yobuchwepheshe yamanzi nokuhlanza futhi alungiselele amapuleti okuphakamisa). Sekela amasipala ekuhleleleni, ekuqaliseni futhi ekubhekeni amandla okuhlinzeka ngamanzi nokuhlanza / imigqa ngamathuluzi afana namadiagrami okuhamba kwendle, amapuleti okuhlelela amandla amanzi (i-WSDPs), ukubamba iqhaza ohlelweni lwe-Green Drop nokwenza izivakashi kwendawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe inqubomgomo. Ukuba khona emihlanganweni yobuchwepheshe yezinhlangothi kahulumeni e ndawonye esifundeni. Qinisekisa ngokuhlola ukuthi ukuhlelela nokwakhiwa kwamandla okuhlanza kwenziwa ngaphansi kwemigomo yobuchwepheshe obulungile futhi ngokwesiko namazinga nawokusebenza. Vuma imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe ngokwezimo namazinga abekiwe. Phenya izikhalazo zokuhanjiswa kwamandla amanzi futhi ulungise imibiko ephonyelwayo. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe esifundazeni se-sanitation. Sakha amandla futhi uholele abachwepheshe / abahloli besikhashana bamandla amanzi.

xh.title: Umntu oYila iNjineli kuligada A - C
xh.summary: Nika amasipala inkxaso yokucwangcisa amanzi nendle yamanzi, qwalasela iingxelo zobuchwepheshe kwaye ube necandelo ekusebenzeni kwephrojekthi eKimberley.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokuNjulalwazi (i-B Eng/BSc (Eng) kwiNzululwazi yoLutsho. Iminyaka elithoba (3) emva kokuqwalaselwa kukhade imisebenzi yokusebenza ngokusetyenziswa kwamaza kunye neendleko zamaza. Ukubhalwa kwiNkundla yoLutsho lomZantsi-Afrika (i-ECSA) njengesithandathu esingundoqo kubuchwepheshe. Isaziswa senkundla yamaza asetyenziswa ngokutsha ngokutsha. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwamaza kunye nokuhamba phantsi kwendlu yokusika amaza kwaye isetyenziswa kwamaza, ukulawulwa kokutsha kwemeko yamaza, iNkundla yoLutsho lokuSungula iNdawo yoluntu, ukulawulwa kweNkcitho yamaza ngokomthetho nangokweemfuno, ukusetyenziswa kweNkundla yamaza ngokomthetho nangokweemfuno, ukusetyenziswa kweNkcitho yamaza ngokomthetho nangokweemfuno, ukusetyenziswa kweNkcitho yamaza ngokomthetho nangokweemfuno, ukusetyenziswa kweNkcitho yamaza ngokomthetho nangokweemfuno.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yokucwangcisa amanzi nendle yamanzi (okt judging iindaba ezinobuchwepheshe zamalungiselelo amanzi nendle yamanzi kunye neendawo zoshishino, kwaye ulungise iileta ezimisa izindululo). Xhasaamasipala ekucwangciseni, ukuze kuqutywe ngaphandle kwendlela yokusebenzisa amanzi kunye nezixhobo ezinjengeDiagrams zeExcreta, iindawo zoshishino zamaza nokuba ngaphantsi kwendlu yokusika zokutyala izityalo (iWSDPs), ukuzihlanganisa ngekhusi elifunyenwe lifunyenweyo kwiSidudla esiluhlaza kunye nokwenza iindwendwe kumthendeleko wokugqiba iimpumelelo. Ukubakho kwindibanisano yamabala obuchwepheshe phakathi kohulumeni kweliphondo ukuqinisekisa ukuba iindawo ezikumgangatho woluntu zisetyenziswa ngokwesiqu sesikhokelo ngokwemigaqo nemilinganiselo yoluntu noxwebhu lokusebenza. Ukusebenza kwemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe ngokwemigaqo nemilinganiselo efunyenweyo. Ukuqonda iindwendwe ezinxulumene nokuhlolwa kwamaza asetyenziswa waye ukulungise iindaba ezinjengokomgangatho woluntu. Ukunikela ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe kwishishini leNdle yamanzi. Ukwakha amandla okusetyenziswa kwamaza kunye nokulungisa iinkxaso ezingcalini zokuhamba amaza ezisetyenziswa kumaza asetyenziswa kumthendeleko woluntu.

jobs.title: Control Engineering Technician Grade a
jobs.summary: Control Engineering Technician needed in Kimberley to manage and monitor civil engineering processes within government water schemes, requiring ECSA registration and a National Diploma in Civil Engineering.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in Civil Engineering. Six (6) years' post-qualification technical engineering experience in civil engineering. Compulsory registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineering Technician. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver's license. Proven experience in project and programme management. Sound technical design and analytical skills. Knowledge of computer-aided engineering applications, legal compliance, and contract management. Excellent technical report writing, problem-solving, decision-making, teamwork, creativity, and customer focus skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Computer literacy. People management and budget management skills. Working knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 (Act 85 of 1993), and the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA).
jobs.duties: Manage and monitor civil engineering processes within government water schemes and water user associations. Manage administrative and related functions. Monitor the implementation of capital- and operationally funded projects through site inspections, site meetings, and the compilation and submission of progress reports. Conduct condition assessments of infrastructure and ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations, including dam safety regulations. Draft civil engineering project specifications and facilitate the implementation and contract management of civil engineering projects. Conduct research and development initiatives to support the effective management and maintenance of water infrastructure. Provide technical advice and support to ensure the sustainable operation of government water schemes and water user associations.
