af.title: Beheer Ingenieurstegnikus Graad a
af.summary: Beheer Ingenieurstegnikus word in Kimberley benodig om siviele ingenieursprosesse binne regeringswaterskemas te bestuur en te monitor, wat ECSA-registrasie en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Siviele Ingenieurswese vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in Siviele Ingenieurswese. Ses (6) jaar se tegniese ingenieurservaring na kwalifikasie in siviele ingenieurswese. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieurstegnikus. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, nie-vervalde bestuurderslisensie. Bewese ervaring in projeks- en programbestuur. Klank tegniese ontwerp en analitiese vaardighede. Kennis van rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings, regmatige nakoming, en kontrakbestuur. Uitstekende tegniese verslagskrywing, probleemoplossing, besluitneming, spanwerk, kreatiwiteit, en klongfokusvaardighede. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Mensebestuur en begrotingsbestuurvaardighede. Werkende kennis van die Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 (Act 85 of 1993), en die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA).
af.duties: Bestuur en monitor siviele ingenieursprosesse binne regeringswaterskemas en watergebruikersverenigings. Bestuur administratiewe en verwante funksies. Monitor die implementering van kapitaal- en operasioneel gefinansierde projekte deur werfinspeksies, werfsvergaderings, en die samestelling en voorlegging van vorderingsverslae. Voer toestandevaluasies van infrastruktuur uit en verseker nakoming van toepaslike standaarde en regulasies, insluitend damveiligheidsregulasies. Opstel van siviele ingenieursprojekspesifikasies en fasiliteer die implementering en kontrakbestuur van siviele ingenieursprojekte. Ondersoek navorsing- en ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe om die effektiewe bestuur en onderhoud van waterinfrastruktuur te ondersteun. zu.title: Control Engineering Technician
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma kwi-Civil Engineering. Iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yokuhlolobunjiniyela emva kokuthola iziqu kwi-civil engineering. Ukubhalisa ngamagunyazi nange-ECSA njengoba kunjaloProfessional Engineering Technician. Ukusazisa ilayisensi yokushayela ethize futhi engakapheli. Ukuqinisekiswa ngamava wokuphatha imiklamo. Amava wobuhloli bokwakha nokuhlaziya amaphuzu. Ukwazi ngohlelo lokwakha olusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ukwazi okuhle lokubhala imibiko yobuhloli, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukwazi okuhle lokukhuluma nokubhala. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Amava okuphatha imali nokuqonda imithetho yokuphepha kanye nobunikelo bokuphathwa kwemali kahulumuti (PFMA).
zu.duties: Phatha futhi ulawule izinqubo zohlolobunjiniyela ezinhlelweni zikahulumuti zamanzi nasenhlanganweni yabasebenzisi amanzi. Phatha imisebenzi yocuphulo namanye omunye umsebenzi ohlobene. Qaphisa ukuphunyiswa kwemiklamo eqhutywa ngechiza lenkulu nangechiza lokusebenza ngokuvakashela emakhempini, ngokubamba ihambe amakhempu, futhi ngokuhlela futhi ngokuhwebisa umbiko wokuqhubekayo. Yenza ukuhlola isimo sezakhiwo uze uqiniseke ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho nemiyalo ezayo, ehlanganisa imiyalo yokuphepha kwemidlilo. Bhala izinkomba zemiklamo yohlolobunjiniyela bese uxhosa ukuphunyiswa nokuphathwa kwezinkontilaka zemiklamo yohlolobunjiniyela. Yesa ucwaningo nentuthuko ukuze usekele ukuphathwa nokugcinwa okusebenza kahle kwezakhiwo zamanzi. Nikeza izeluleko nobusekeloobuhloli ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenza okuhlelekile kwezinhlelwa zikahulumuti zamanzi nasenhlanganweni yabasebenzisi amanzi.

Amava achazekileyo kulawulwa kwiprojekthi nakwinkqubo. Ikhono eliqinisekileyo lokwakhiwa lobuchwephesha noshukunyisiso. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha zobunjiniyara, ukuhambelana nemigaqo-nkqubo, nolawulo lwekontraki. Ikhono elihle lokubhala iingxelo zobuchwephesha, ukuxazula iingxaki, ukuthatha izigqibo, ukusebenza ngehlobo, ukuyila, nokujolisa kumthengi. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelwana ngelizwi nokubhalwayo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lolawulo labantu nolawulo lweemali ezimali. Ulwazi olusebenzayo ngomthetho weMfundo nokuKhuseleka koBasebenzi, 1993 (Umthetho 85 ka-1993), nangomthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA).
xh.duties: Lawula uze uqwalasele iinkqubo zobunjiniyara zolwakhiwo kwimigangatho yamanzi kahulumathi nosh anyathelo oluxhathileyo lamanzi. Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo nezinye imisebenzi ezinxulumene nayo. Qwalasela ukusebenza kweeprojekthi ezixhaswa ngeemali zexabiso nasezisebenzayo ngokwenziwa kwezinduli zovavanyo, iindibaniselwano zomhlaba, nokuhlelwa nokungenisa kweengxelo zemveliso. Yenza iintlhantlho lokuqwalasela isimo seempahla zolwakhilo uze uqinisekise ukuhambelana neemigangatho neemithetho ezifanelekileyo, kuquka nemigaqo-nkqubo yokhuseleko lweedamu. Bhala iinkcazelo zeeprojekthi zobunjiniyara bolwakhilo uze ulawule ukusebenza nokulawula iinkontraki zeeprojekthi zobunjiniyara bolwakhiwo. Yenza uphando nokuqhutywa kwemigudu entsha ukuxhasa ulawulo nokugcina olusebenzayo iimpahla zolwakhiwo lwamanzi. Nikela ngeluce lobuchwephesha naxhaso ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza okusimelayo kwemigangatho yamanzi kahulumathi nasemanyathelweni oluxhathileyo lamanzi.

zu.title: Ithnikhisheni Yobunjiniyela Bolawulo Izinga a
zu.summary: UMnyango Wamanzi Nokucofa ufuna ithnikhisheni yobunjiniyela bolawulo eKimberley ukuphatha izinsizakalo zobunjiniyela bamanzu nempahla ezokwakhiwa, okudinga iziqu ze-diploma yezwe kubunjiniyela besakhiwo noburejisti kwa-ECSA.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe Kubunjiniyela Besakhiwo. Ukutholwa kwezinhlobonhlobo ngemva kweziqu iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yempilo yobuchwepheshe Bobunjiniyela. Ukubhaliswa ngokuyikho nge-Khilongo Lobunjiniyela LaseNingizimu Afrika (ECSA) njengoThnikhisheni Yobunjiniyela othwebelayo. Ukwembula ilayisense yokuqasha esevumelekile futhi engakapheli. Ulwazi ngohlelo nobuhlakani bobuchwepheshe bemiphahla yamanzu kanye/noma impahla yamathuluzi amanzi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwemininingwane yamanzu. Ukuqonda ucwaningo nentuthuko. Ulwazi nolwazi mayelana nezinhlelo zokusebenza zekhompyutha zobunjiniyela. Ulwazi ngokulandelwa komthetho nokuqashwa kwezinhlelo. Ukubhalwa kwemibhalo yezinkundla. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle kokubili (okukhulunywayo nokubhalwayo), ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye namakhono okuxoxisana. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengomqhubi, ukudala, ukuphatha izimali, ukuphatha abantu, ukugxila kumthengi, ukuphendula, ukuhlela futhi uhlole.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe kanye nokusiza kanye noBunjiniyela, oBuchwepheshe kanye nabahlobene endaweni, e workshops, nakumisebenzi yobunjiniyela bamanzu. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kokuphepha ngokulandela imithetho nezidingo ezilawulayo. Hlola izincwadi zobuchwepheshe ezikhona, izithombe ezijwayelekile, kanye nezinqumo ukuze kufakwe ubuchwepheshe obusha. Qinisekisa izinga lobuchwepheshe emiklomweni ohlelwe ngemithetho bese uvuma/nikela izincomo zokugunyazwa ngummeli ohlobene. Phatha imisebenzi yokuphathwa, abantu kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene. Nikela izincomo kwenqubo yokwabiwa kwesabelomali, iplani yokusebenza, iplani yokuthenga kanye nezinye izinto ezihlobene. Hlela bese uthumela imibalo njengoba kudingeka. Nxamalala nemikhakha yeNgozi kanye Nokuphathwa Kwezehlakalo ezibuhlungu. Ucwaningo nentuthuko ngokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo komsebenzi njengoba kudingwa ukuze ulandele ubuchwepheshe obusha nezinqumo. Nikela ngokuqondisa futhi ulawule abantu. Ucwaningo/Imifundo yemibhalo ngobuchwepheshe bobunjiniyela ukuze ukhulise ulwazi. Xhumana namakhomidi/amabandla ahlobene ngezindlela zobunjiniyela. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchule. Amakhono amabalulekileyo ekunxibelelwani womabini (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo), ukulawula iingxabano kunye namakhono okuxoxisana. Ukuzalisa iingxaki nokuhlalutya, ukuthatha izigqibo, ukusebenza ngokwengqondo, ukuyila, ukulawula iimali, ukulawula abantu, ukugxila kumaxhwebi, ukusabela, ukucwangcisa nokuqwalasela.

Qinisekisa ukuthuthuziswa kokhuseleko ngokuhambelana neemfuno zemithetho nayemiqathango. Qwalasela imanuali zobuchule ezikhoyo, iimzobo ezingagqibekanga, nendlela ezisetyenziswayo ukuzisa inqanaba elitsha lobuchule. Qinisekisa izingqwalasela zokuyila kobuchule ngokwemigaqo nika / zenza izindululo ngenjongo yokuvunywa ngumbutho ofanelekileyo. Phatha imisebenzi yolawulo, yemithombo yabantu nakwezinye iinkalo ezinxulumene naloo nto. Nikezela ngemibhalo ecwangcisa inkqubo yohlawulo, icebo lokusebenza, icebo lothengiso nakwezinye izinto ezinxulumene nayo. Hloma ungenise iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Phanda nokuqamba ngokuchasene kokuphuhliswa kobuchule ngokungadibani nokuqhubela phambili kwabaphathi ukuze bagunyazane nobuchule obutsha nendlela entsha. Nikeza ngokuyala kunye nokuqwalasela abasebenzi. Phanda / ufunde ngokubhalwe ngobuchule be-engineering ukuze uphucule ulwazi loqobo. Thetha nabathintekayo / kumabhunga ngemiba enxulumene nobuchule. Kufuneka ulungele ukusebenza kude nendlu yomsebenzi uze uhambe kakhulu ixesha elide.

Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede beide skriftelik en mondelings. Goeie beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Wees rekenaargeletterd en oor deeglike kennis van Microsoft Office beskik, d.w.s. MS Word, MS Excel, MS Outlook, MS PowerPoint en Internet Explorer. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations en Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment Act 53 of 2003 en preferential procurement policy framework Act. Kennis van kontrakbestuur. Kennis van strategiese verkryging. Openbare sektor supply chain management-modelle en -prosesse. Program- en projekbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mens- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Kennis van Supply Chain Management Regulations, praktyknotas, sirkulaires en beleidsraamwerke. Moet in staat wees om op Government Logistical System en LOGIS-stelsel te werk. Uitstekende interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur en hou toesig oor vraag, verkryging, logistieke en kontrakbestuur. Verseker volledige nakoming van alle voorskrifte, beleid, praktyknotas en magtigings met betrekking tot verkryging, logistieke en vraagbestuur. Ontwikkel en handhaaf interne beheermaatreëls vir verkryging. Verseker die effektiewe bestuur van die Supply Chain-vraagproses. Stel op en konsolideer die vraagbestuursplan. Koördineer insette vir die Vraagbestuursplan. Verseker dat verkryging in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde vraagplan is. Verseker effektiewe benutting van die CSD. Bestuur verkryging insluitend BID-administrasie. Bystand verleen by die opstel van Termes of reference, spesifikasies en BID-dokumente. Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning aan die BID-komitees en verrig die administratiewe pligte tydens die tender/bid-voordragsessies. Bystand verleen by die hersiening van die omvang van die Terms of Reference (TOR). Bystand verleen met die monitering van die geldigheidsperiode van geslote tenders. Bystand verleen by die koördinering en uitvoering van die biedproses: Reël en bywoon bie-evalueringskomiteevergaderings. Bestuur die biedprosesse en verseker die effektiewe funksionering van alle BID-komitees. Bestuur en effektiewe benutting van Transversal Contracts. Bestuur die proses van die verkryging van kwotasies. Verseker die effektiewe koördinering en bestuur van logistieke dienste. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die administrasie van rekwisies, aflewerings, voorraadaanvullings en verseker nakoming van regulasies. Verseker behoorlike dokumentbeheer en dokumentasie. Verseker dat dokumente wat aan logistiek vir order skepping voorgelê word, volledig aan verkrygingsbestuursvoorskrifte voldoen. Implementeer en hou toesig oor risiko- en prestasiebestuursstrategieë in die supply chain management-eenheid. Bestuur kontrakte. Administreer kontrakprysaanpassings, variasies, die regsdienste-keuringsproses, kansellasies en projekafsluiting-versoentyding. Identifiseer en verminder risiko's binne die eenheid. Verseker dat alle administratiewe sake, korrespondensie en komplekse navrae onverwyld aandag geniet. Bystand verleen by die opstel van maandelikse SCM-prestasieverslae. Opstel/verifikasie van alle maandelikse SCM-verslae. Verseker implementering en nakoming van die Instruction Notes soos deur National Treasury uitgereik, asook Departementale SCM-beleid. Bestuur en hou toesig oor werknemers om 'n effektiewe supply chain management-diens te verseker en onderneem alle administratiewe funksies wat ten opsigte van finansiële en menslike hulpbronadministrasie vereis word. Verrig menslike hulpbron- en administratiewe aktiwiteite wat verband hou met SCM, insluitend die assesering van die prestasie van amptenare in die eenheid (PMDS).

zu.title: Onyukiwe njengoMphathi oSizayo: Supply Chain Management
zu.summary: Onyukiwe njengomphathi we-Supply Chain Management eDepartment of Water and Sanitation eKimberley, kudingeka iziqu ezifanele ze-NQF 7 kanye namakhono eminyaka emithathu okubaphathi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo eziphathelene nalokhu ezinga le-NQF level 7 kwe-Supply Chain Management / Finance. Ubudala obungaminyaka emithathu (3) bokusebenza njengomphathi ku-supply chain management, logistic and demand management. Ukwembula iwoyela elivumelekile elingakapheli. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle kokubili okubhaliwe nakukhulumayo. Amakhono amahle okuhlela futhi uhlele. Ukuba nobuciko kwekhompyutha futhi ube nolwazi olujulile ngaloluMicrosoft Office, okungukuthi, i-MS Word, i-MS Excel, i-MS Outlook, i-MS PowerPoint kanye ne-Internet Explorer. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Treasury Regulations kanye ne-Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment Act 53 of 2003 kanye ne-preferential procurement policy framework Act. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezinkontilaka. Ulwazi ngokucinga izinto ngobuchule. Amamodeli nezinqubo zesikhundla sikahulumeni zokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlela namaphulo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokubekeqhaza. Ukuqondiswa kukhasimende futhi ukugxila kubakhasimende. Ubunikelo nobulungisa. Ulwazi nge-Supply Chain Management Regulations, amanothi ezisebenzelo, amasabhula namapholisi. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza ku-Government Logistical System kanye nesistimu ye-LOGIS. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nomuntu ngamunye.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi qondise izindaba zesidingo, ukutholwa kwemikhiqizo, izindaba zokulogi nokuphathwa kwezinkontilaka. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana ngokugcwele nayo yonke imiyalo yokutholwa kwemikhiqizo, ukulogi kanye nokuphathwa kwezidingo, amapholisi, amanothi ezisebenzelo kanye nocalulo lwamagunya. Bumba futhi ulondoloze izindlela zokulawula ngaphakathi ezisetshenziselwa ukuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwenqubo yesidingo senkontilaka zokuhlinzeka. Hlanganisa futhi udidiwe kahle ihlelo lokuphathwa kwesidingo. Hlanganisa iminikelo enhlelweni Yokuphathwa Kwesidingo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuthenga kuhambisana nenhlelo yesidingo egunyaziwe. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwe-CSD. Phatha ukutholwa kwemikhiqizo kufaka phakathi ukuphathwa kwe-BID. Siza ekubumbeni kwamagama okumi esikhundleni, imininingwane kanye namadokhumenti we-BID. Nikeza inkonzo yesikhulumi kumakomidi we-BID futhi wenze imisebenzi yabaphathi ngesikhathi sezinkulumo-mpikiswano nge-tender/bid. Nikeza usizo ekubukeni koMkhawulo waMagama okumi Esikhundleni (TOR). Siza okubhekene nokulondoloza isikhathi esivumelekile samathenda avalswe. Siza ekuhlelweni nakwethulweni kwesinqubo yokubiza-: Hlela futhi ubambe iqhaza emihlanganweni ye-Bid Evaluation committee. Phatha izinqubo ze-bid futhi uqinisekise ukusebenza okusebenzayo kwawo wonke amakomidi we-Bid. Phatha futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kweTransversal Contracts. Phatha inqubo yokucinga izinani. Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa nokuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezinkonzo ze-Logistical. Phatha futhi ubukele ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo, izileyidi, ukugcwaliswa kwemitshago futhi uqinisekise ukuhambisana nemithetho. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwamadokhumenti okulungele kanye namadokhumenti. Qinisekisa ukuthi amadokhumenti ethunyelwa kwa-logistics ukubumba ama-oda ahambisana ngokugcwele nemiyalo yokuphathwa kokutholwa kwemikhiqizo. Fakaza futhi ubukele izindlela zokuphathwa kwezingozi nokwenza izinkonzo ezingeni elihle kwinhloko yokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo. Phatha izinkontilaka. Phatha ukulungiswa kwamaxabiso ezenkontilaka, izinguquko, inqubo yokuhlolwa kwezinkonzo zomthetho, ukukhansula kanye nokuhlelwa kwesiphetho sepilo. Hlola futhi unciphise izingozi kuleyo nhloko. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imicelo yabaphathi, ukuxhumana kanye nemibuzo eYINKIMBI ihlolwa masinya. Siza ekubumbeni imibiko yenyanga zonke yokwenza kwe-SCM. Ukubumba/uqinisekisa yonke imibiko yenyanga zonke ye-SCM. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa nokuhambisana namaNothi WoMlayo anikezwa i-National Treasury kanye nePholisi ye-SCM yoMnyango. Phatha futhi qondise abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo yokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo okusebenzayo futhi wenza yonke imisebenzi yabaphathi edingekayo okubhekene nokuphathwa kwezimali nabalimi. Yenza imisebenzi yabalimi nengabaphathi ephathelene ne-SCM kufaka phakathi ukuhlola Ukwenza KwaBaphathi kuleyo nhloko (PMDS).

xh.title: Umsekeli woMlawuli: Supply Chain Management
xh.summary: Umsekeli woLawulo we-Supply Chain Management kwi-Department of Water and Sanitation eKimberley, efuniswa isidanga esifanelekileyo se-NQF 7 kunye neminyaka elithathu yokuba ngumlawuli.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo sekoloni kwiqonga le-NQF level 7 kwi-Supply Chain Management / Finance. Iiminyaka elithathu (3) yokusebenza ngokulawula abasebenzi kwinkqubo ye-supply chain management, i-logistic kunye no-lawulo lokufuna. Ukutyhila ilayisensi yokuyela esebenzayo ezeleyo nengaphelelwa lixesha. Amakhono amabini okunxibelelanani ebhalwe ngokubhalwa nangokuthethwa. Amakhono amabini okucinga nokulungiselela. Kufuneka ube nobuchule bokusebenza ngakomputer kwaye uve ulwazi oluchanekileyo lweMicrosoft Office, oko kukuthi, MS Word, MS Excel, MS Outlook, MS PowerPoint kunye ne-Internet Explorer. ULwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), iTreasury Regulations kunye ne-Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment Act 53 of 2003 nesePreferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. ULwazi loLawulo lweKontraki. ULwazi olubanzi lokutsala iindlela ezahlukeneyo zeempahla. Iinkqubo namaxwebhu we-Supply Chain Management kwicandelo likarhulumente. ULawulo lweeprogramme neprojekthi. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuzahlulahlula. ULawulo labantu kunye noLawulo lweentlalontle. Ukuqwalasela abathengi kwaye ugqamise ukugxila kwabathengi. Ixabiso nokuziphatha ngokwayo. ULwazi lweSupply Chain Management Regulations, iipractice notes, i-circulars kunye namakhaka amanqamle ezenzo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenza kwi-Government Logistical System nakwisixubo se-LOGIS. Amakhono amabini obudlelwane nakwabanye abantu.
xh.duties: Qondisa kwaye ulawule ulwando, ukufuna, amalogistics kunye noLawulo lweKontraki. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela ngokupheleleyo kuyo yonke imiwayo, iinkqubo, iimemo ezilungiselelwo ukusebenza, kunye namalungiselelo olawulo okufuna, ukuthenga, kunye noLawulo lweLogistics. Yila kwaye ugcine iziphathi-miyalezo zangaphakathi ezithintela nokulawula ukuthengwa kweempahla. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwenkqubo yokufuna kwi-Supply Chain. Qamba kwaye udibanise icebo lokulawula ukufuna. Linganisa amagalelo kwiCebo Lokulawula ukuFuna. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuthengwa kuhambelana necebo elivunyiwe lokufuna. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo kwe-CSD. Lawula ukuthenga kuquka ulawulo lwe-BID. Nceda ekudibeniseni kwamagama eMithetho yolwazi, iSpesifications kunye namaxwebhu e-BID. Zisa inkxaso yolawu kwiikomiti ze-BID kwaye unikeze imisebenzi yolawulo ngexesha lemihla yokuxoxwa ngeetenda/bids. Nceda ekuphononongeni ubukhulu beMithetho yolwazi (TOR). Nceda kwilondolozo yexesha elisebenzayo lamaxwebhu eetenda avaliweyo. Nceda ekulawuleni nakwensenziweni yenkqubo yoku-bida-: Lungiselela kwaye uhube iintlangano zekomiti yoLinganiso lwe-BID. ULawulo lwenkqubo ye-bid kwaye uqinisekise ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo kwekonkrithi yazo zonke iiKomiti ze-BID. ULawulo nokusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo kweeKontraki zeTransversal. Lawula inkqubo yokufuna iiquotations. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo olusebenzayo kunye noLawulo lweenkonzo zeLogistics. Lawula kwaye ulawule ulawulo lweqeuirements, ukulethwa, ukuhlaziya izinto kwaye uqinisekise ukuzinikela ngokupheleleyo kwimithetho. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluchanekileyo lwamaxwebhu nolunikezelo lwamaxwebhu. Qinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu afakelwa kwi-logistics ukwenza iodolo ahambelana ngokupheleleyo nemiyalelo yolawulo wokuthenga. Zisebenzise kwaye uLawule iinkqubo zoLawulo lwoMgca kunye noMsebenzi kwicandelo lenkqubo ye-Supply Chain Management. Lawula iiKontraki. Lawula ulungelelwaniso lweNxiba yeKontraki, iindlela ezahlukeneyo, inkqubo yokuvavanywa kweenkonzo zezeMthetho, ukuRhoxiswa kwesicelo kunye nolungelelwaniso lokufaka isicelo sokuphela kuphrojekthi. Chonga kwaye unciphise iingozi kwicala. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imiceli mbuzo yolawulo, iindaba ezithunyelwana kunye nemibuzo eqhubekayo iphathwa ngokukhawuleza. Nceda ekudibeniseni iingxelo ngenyanga zobungakanisi be-SCM. Qamba /vavanya yonke iingxelo ngenyanga zobungakanisi be-SCM. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa nokuzinikela kwemiMemo yolwazi njengoko iyikhutshwa nguMzekelo weSizwe kunye noMthetho we-SCM we-Department. Lawula kwaye ulawule abasebenzi ukuze uqinisekise inkonzo esebenzayo ye-Supply Chain Management kwaye wenze yonke imisebenzi yolawulo efunekayo malunga nolawulo lwezimali nolawulo lwabantu. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo lwabantu kwaye yemisebenzi ehambelana ne-SCM kuquka ukuLinganisa ukuSebenza koMsebenzi kwicala (PMDS).

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Security Administration
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Security Administration at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria, requiring an NQF level 6 diploma in Security Management and PSIRA certification.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 6 (National Diploma) in Security Management, Five (3) years’ experience as Senior Security Administration services environment. Valid Grade B PSIRA Certificate, The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s licence a minimum of B Code, Knowledge of the access control procedures. Knowledge of prescribed security procedures and relevant acts (e.g. Minimum Physical Security Standard (MPSS), Minimum Information Security Standard (MISS), Protection of Information Act, etc) and Private Security Industry Regulation Authority (PSIRA), Public Finance Management Act (PFMA Act), Safety at Sports and Recreation Event Act (SAREA). Knowledge on the relevant emergency procedures. Knowledge of conflict management tools and methodologies. Understanding of programme and project management. Knowledge of financial management. People management and empowerment. Knowledge of information Security and its prescripts, Excellent communication (both verbal and written), computer, presentations, report writing and networking skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure the implementation of security policies, procedures and standards. Facilitate the implementation of security operations strategy. Conduct Information Security Audit, inspections, information storage and Awareness., Coordinate security directorate budget, DMP and procurement. Coordinate operation procedures during departmental events. Facilitate and conduct security treat and risk assessments. Facilitate Security Awarenesses, Management of resources. Conduct departmental events according to SASREA (Administer event management security plans). Liaise with Law enforcement e.g SSA, SAPS, etc. Conduct Security Investigations. NB: Take note the position demand excessive travel.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

zu.title: Onakekela: Ukuphathwa Kokuphepha

zu.requirements: I-diploma ebambekayo ye-NQF level 6 (National Diploma) ku-Security Management, Iminyaka yamava emi-5 (3) njengoba kunemvelo yezinsiza eziphezulu ze-Security Administration. zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwemigomo, yomchongo yokuqinisekisa namazinga. Qedela ukuphathwa kwenqubomgomo yemisebenzi yokuqinisekisa. Yenza ukuhlolwa kokuphepha kolwazi, ukuvakashela, ukugcinwa kolwazi nokwazisa., Linganisa ngenani letshalo lezokuphepha, i-DMP nentengiso. Linganisa imichango yokusebenza ngesikhathi semicimbi yomnyango. Qedela futhi wenze ukuhlolwa kwezinsongo eziphathelene nokuphepha kanye nengozi. Qedela ukwazisa ngokuphepha, Abaphathi abasabalalisiwe abakwazi ukuqondiswa. Yenza imicimbi yomnyango ngokusho kwe-SASREA (Phatha iplani zokuphatha izinsiza zemicimbi). Xhumana nomaphoyisa njenge-SSA, i-SAPS, njll. Yenza ukuphenya ngokuphepha. NB: Qaphela ukuthi lesi sikhundla sifuna ukuhamba kakhulu.

af.summary: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning, handhaaf prosedures, en bestuur verkryging binne die Department of Water and Sanitation op Vlak 8.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur. Drie (3) jaar se ondervinding in administratiewe aangeleenthede. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures. Kennis van arbeidsreg en geskilbeslegtingsproses. Basiese finansiële bestuur en kennis van PFMA, kennis van National Archive Act Rekenaargeletterdheid. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Bestuur van mense en diversiteit. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Vrywaring van 'n geldige, onvervalle bestuurderlisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan alle personeel in die komponent. Implementeer en handhaaf administratiewe prosedures. Analiseer die komponente van die besigheidsplan en verkrygingstendense. Implementeer beleid en skakel met verskaffers vir aangekoopte materiaal. Ontwikkel en voer aksieplanne vir die afdeling uit. Lewer finansiële administrasie aan die komponent. Ontwikkel implementeringsplanne en verseker voldoening aan finansiële prosedures. Stel maandelikse finansiële verslae op en bied dit aan bestuur voor. Bystand verleen met begrotingsopstel en toesig hou oor finansiële eise soos S&T-voorskotte en reiskostes. Stel en handhaaf vroeë waarskuwingstelsels vir finansiële monitering. Lewer verkrygingsadministrasie. Stel bestuur inlig oor doeltreffende administratiewe praktyke. Handhaaf en dateer die register van die komponent op. Bestuur bates en implementeer goedgekeurde besluite. Lewer Menslike Hulpbronne en toesig. Implementeer PMDS vir die komponent. Reël werkswinkels, vergaderings en geleenthede soos benodig. Pas dissipline toe.

zu.title: I-ofisa esingaphansi kunjikelwe yolawulo
zu.summary: nika inkxaso yolawulo, lgcinwe izinqubo, uphathwe ukuthengwa kwemali kwisigungu Department of Water and Sanitation e-Level 8.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esifanele se-NQF level 6 kwi-Administration /Public Management. Ubudala beyanga ezintathu (3) ngokuhambisana nezindaba ezilawulwayo. Ulwazi mayelana nezinqubo zolawulo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wabasebenzi kanye nenqubo yokuxazulula iziphixhoxho. Ukuphathwa kwezimali okuyisiseko kanye nolwazi nge-PFMA, ulwazi nge-National Archive Act Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukubheka thinta iklayenti nokuqwalasela iklayenti. Ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nokubucayi. Ubekho kanye nokuziphatha okuhle. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda. Ukubhala idrayiva lesikhathi esingakapheli.
zu.duties: Nika abantu bonke abasebenza kwelunga inkxaso yolawulo. Phumeza futhi ulondoloze izinqubo zolawulo. Hlaziya izingxenye zohlelo lokusebenza nezimo zokuthenga. Phumeza izinqubomgomo futhi uxhumane neziboneleli ngezinto ezithengiwe. Bumba futhi uphumeze izinhlelo zokuqeqesha esigabeni. Nikeza lolu lawulo lwemali kwelunga. Bumba izinhlelo zokuphumeza futhi qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezinqubo zemali. Qamba futhi uwethule imibiko yemali yanyanga zonke kubaphathi. Siza ngokubumba ibhajedi futhi ulawule izinkamelo zemali njengasikhokho se-S&T nezindleko zokuhamba. Saka futhi ulondoloze izinhlelo zokuqxaja kwangaphambili ukuze kugqitshwe ukubukeka kwezimali. Nikeza lolu lawulo lokuthenga. Luleka abaphathi ngobuyelele bokulawula. Hlakanipha futhi ulungise izikhala ezilawulweni. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezinqubo zokuqamba icala kanye nolawulo lwezindaba zabasebenzi. Gcina amarekhodi ezimpahla kanye nezinsiza ezithengiwe, unikeze izibalo ezinembile. Gcina irekhodi kwelunga.abelana imisebenzi futhi ulandele inqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubungwa ngesikhathi. Gcina futhi uvuselele irekhodi kwelunga. Lawula izimpahla ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumo ezamukelekile. Lawula abasebenzi kwaye ubophe imisebenzi, ulawule impumelelo. Khipha izibalo gemibiko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kugcinwa amafayela. Yenza imisebenzi yabasebenzi uphinde uqambe imibiko yabasebenzi yamanyeinyanga. Phumeza i-PMDS kule ntaba. Hlela amaqhinga, imihlangano nemikhosi njengoba kudingeka. Phumeza isiyahluleka.

xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo, gcina iinkqubo, kwaye ulawule inkqubo yokuthenga ngaphakathi kwisebe lezeManzi kunye noKuhlanza kwinqanaba 8.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo se-NQF level 6 kwi-Aministration /Public Management. Iminyaka mithathu (3) yamava kumacala olawulo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zolawulo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wobusebenzi nendlela yokuxazulula iingxabano. Ulawululwabiwo-mali olusiseko kunye nolwazi lwe-PFMA, ulwazi ngomthetho we-National Archive Act Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Uqwalaselo kwiklayenti kunye nolwandiso kwiklayenti. Ulawuloabantu nolwahlukano. Uxinzelelo lokuba nexesha lokuziphendula nokuziphatha ngokuziphatha kakuhle. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Ukuvezwa kolayisensi yokushukuma okusebenzayo engaphelelwe lilngu.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kuwo onke amashishini kwicala. Zisebenzise kwaye ugcine iinkqubo zolawulo. Hlalutya iicala zeplani yoshishino kunye nemiba yokuqhutywa kokuthenga. Zisebenzisa iinkqubomgomo kwaye uxhaxheke nabathengisi ngeempahla ezithengiweyo. Yakhe kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zenyani kwicala. Nikela ngolawulo lwezimali kwicala. Yakhe iinkqubo zokuzebenzisa kwaye uqiniseke ukuzilandela iinkqubo zezimali. Qamba kwaye ugcobise ngemiganeko yamanye amava yamaxesha onyaka kubaphathi. Nceda nokwakhiwa kwebhajethi kwaye ulawule izimali eziyimfuno njengasentsimbi zesidingo ngokuthutha ngemigaqo epheliliyo. Misela kwaye ugcine iinkqubo zokuqamba ekuqwalaselweni kwezimali. Nikela ngolawulo lokuqhutywa kokuzebenza kolu. Nika ingcebiso kubaphathi ngokusebenza ngamava amakhulu. Qonda kwaye ulungise amathuba abonakalayo. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa ngokufanelekileyo iinkqubo zokuqweba izinxaxhiwo nolawulo ngamazwi omsebenzi. Gcina ulwazi ngezinto ezithengwayo ngezinto neenkqubo, kuze kubekho izibalo echanekileyo. Gcina isibhalo socawa secala. Yabelana imisebenzi kwaye ulandele inkqubo yekhaya ukuze kuqiniseke ukusondelelwa komseni. Gcina kwaye ulungise isibhalo socawa secala. Lawula izinto. Sebenzisa iinkqubo ezivunyiweyo. Nikela ngezinto zomntu nokulawula. Lawula abashishini, yabelana imisebenzi, kwaye ulandele ukusebenza. Yenza iingxelo ezibalulekileyo kwaye uqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokuqinisekiswa kweefayile. Gcina imisebenzi ye-HR kwaye uqambe iingxelo zamava zonyaka ze-HR. Sebenzisa i-PMDS kwicala. Lunge iingqungqutha, iintlanganiso kwaye undimdimokuxwebhu njengoko kufuneka. Zisebenzisa isohlwayo.

Ulwazi lolwazi emimeni yokuphathwa kwezinhlela, ekwakheni nasekuhloleni ubuchwepheshe. Ukuqonda ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisekwe kakhulu kakhulu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukubumba izinkolelo ezisha, ukugxila kubathengi nokuphendula. Amakhono okuxhumana (kokukhulunywayo nakubhaliwayo).

Qapha ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zemisebenzi eyakhayo njengohlelo oluwumthamo omkhulu lwesifunda (RBIG) negranti yemisebenzi yamanzi (WSIG) ngokwenza izivakashi esizeni; imihlangano esizeni; ukuqoqa nokuhambisa imibiko yentuthuko. Nikeza okufakwayo enkambisweni yokwenza amabhajethi njengoba kudingeka. Qoqa futhi uhambise imibiko yochitho njengoba kudingeka. Qinisekisa futhi uqinisekise amafomu okukhokha obaphathi bezinkonzo zikahulumeni. Gcina amarekhodi afanele namadokhumenti yonke imisebenzi ukunikeza ithuba lokuhlolwa okuhlanzekile. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise okufakwayo ohlelweni lokuqashwa kwentuthuko yemisebenzi eyakhayo. Yakha, phatha futhi ulondoloze amadathabhesi. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Ukuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe okuqhubekayo ukuze uhlale usekwazi ngobuchwepheshe obusha nezindlela zokwenza.

af.title: Ingenieurstegnikus Produksie Graad A - C (CIVIL)
af.summary: Die Department of Water and Sanitation soek 'n Ingenieurstegnikus in Kimberley om tegniese dienste te lewer en infrastruktuurprojekte te monitor.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in Ingenieurswese of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Drie (3) jaar se tegniese ingenieurservaring na kwalifikasie. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Ingenieurstegnikus. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en ervaring in projektebestuur, tegniese ontwerp en ontleding. Begrip van navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Probleemoplossing, besluitneming, spanwerk, kreatiwiteit, klantfokus en reaksievermoë. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik).
af.duties: Lewer tegniese dienste aan die direktoraat. Ondersteun ingenieurs, technoloë en medewerkers by die evaluering van besigheidsplanne en tegniese verslae. Monitor die implementering van infrastruktuurprojekte soos Regional Bulk Infrastructure Programme (RBIG) en Water Services Infrastructure Grant (WSIG) deur terreininspeksies uit te voer; terreinvergaderings; samestelling en indiening van vorderingsverslae. Bevorder veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Evalueer tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en dien goedkeuring deur die relevante gesag in. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses soos vereis. Stel bestedingsverslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Verifieer en sertifiseer fakture vir betaling van kontraktors en openbare diensverskaffers. Onderhou behoorlike rekords en dokumentasie vir alle projekte om 'n skoon oudit moontlik te maak. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die operasionele plan vir infrastruktuurontwikkeling. Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou databasisse. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi weTekniki Umveliso Inqanaba a - C (CIVIL)
xh.summary: Isebe leZamanzi nokuCoca lifuna uMsebenzisi weTekniki kwisiXhosa ukuze anikeze iinkonzo ezobuchwepheshe alungqinde iiprojekthi ezibakhiwayo.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma kwimveliso yobuchwepheshe okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo. Iiminyaka elithoba (3) yokuba n-amava obuchwepheshe emva kokufumana isidanga. Ukuwohloka kwesithethe somgaqo kwisiBhunga soBugcisa saseMzantsi Afrika (ECSA) njengomsebenzisi weTekniki. Ukutyhila ilayisensi yokushayela ethengiweyo esebenzayo. Isivo namava ekulawula iiprojekthi, ukuyila ngokobuchwepheshe nokuqwalasela. Ukuqonda uphando nentlutho. Iinkqubo zobuchwephesha ezixhaswa khompyutha. Ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuthatha izigqibo, ukusebenza njengesebe, ubuchwephesha, ukugxila kuluntu nokusabela. Amakhono obuviso (ngamandla nangokubhalwa).
xh.duties: Zonza iinkonzo ezobuchwepheshe kwisebe. Nceda oovakalisi bobuchwepheshe, oobugcisa abasenzi nabanxibelelanisi ekulinganiseni iiplani zoshishino neengxelo zobuchwepheshe. Lungqinda izicwangciso zokusebenza kweprojekthi zeZakhiwo ezinjengendlela yoBakhu lweNdlela iNkulu (RBIG) nokuNxibelelanisa iNkonzo yeMizi (WSIG) ngokwenza iindwendwe kwiindawo zokwakhiwa; iindibano kwindawo yokwakhiwa; ulwakhiwo nokuthumela iingxelo ezingqamana nomgama wohambo. Khuthaza ukhuseleko ngokusesiqweni neemfuno zomgaqo-nkqubo. Linganisa iimanuali ezikhoyo zobuchwepheshe, izihlomelo eziyimigangatho neenkqubo ukuze zibandakanye nobuchwepheshe obutsha. Linganisa iinkcazelo zobugcisa nezikwangamacandelo aze athunyelwe kuvunywa ngamagunya afanelekileyo. Zenza imisebenzi yolawulo nezinxulume. Yonke izalathiso kwenkqubo yokubaluleka kwemali njengoko kufuneka. Hlanganisela kwaye uthumele iingxelo zexabiso njengoko kufuneka. Qinisekisa kwaye uqinisekise iimali ezibekelwe ukuhlawula abakhi kunye nabahanisi bemisebenzi kaqobo. Gcina iirekhodi ezifanelekileyo nemitabo yolwazi yazo zonke iiprojekthi ukuze kwenzeke ukuhlolwa okucocekileyo. Yonke kwaye udibanise izalathiso kwinkqubo yokuqhuba ukusetyenziswa kweZakhiwo. Yakhe, usebenzise kwaye ugcine iisiseko zeedata. Uphando nentlutho. Ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kobuchwepheshe ukugcina intshukela kwiindlela ezintsha nobuchwepheshe.

jobs.title: Engineering Technician Production Grade A-C (CIVIL)
jobs.salary_text: R407 337 – R610 131 per annum, (OSD), (Offer will be based on proven years of experience)
jobs.summary: Engineering Technician in Civil Engineering for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Kimberley, requiring ECSA registration and stream gauging experience.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in Civil Engineering. Three (3) years post qualification technical Civil Engineering experience. Compulsory registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as an Engineering Technician. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Good computer literacy and computer programming skills. Good communication skills (verbal and written) and negotiation skills. Experience in project management. Technical design and analysing knowledge of hydrological data. Knowledge and experience in Computer-aided engineering applications. Technical report writing and technical consulting skills. Problem solving, analysis, decision making and teamwork skills. Creativity, customer focus and responsiveness skills. Good planning, organising and people management. Travel extensively as and when required. Must be prepared to work away from the office for extended periods of time.
jobs.duties: Stream Gauging using ADP and conventional stream gauging methods. Survey of gauging weirs and flood (rated) sections using the levelling instrument. Preparation of drawings using CAD software. Calibration of flow gauging stations. Inspection planning of maintenance surface water gauging stations within the area of responsibility. Maintenance of electronic data logging instruments. Supervision of personnel. Hydrological Data editing and processing. Prepare technical specifications for procurement of the required resources. Collection of all forms of hydrological data within area of responsibility and compile reports. Provide technical support to requests received from stakeholders. Ensure the compliance to the Occupational Health and Safety Act in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Engage in research and developmental activities for continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Ingenieurstegnikus Produksie Graad A-C (SIVIEL)
af.summary: Ingenieurstegnikus in Siviele Ingenieurswese vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Kimberley, wat ECSA-registrasie en stroommetingservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in Siviele Ingenieurswese. Drie (3) jaar se tegniese Siviele Ingenieurswese-ervaring na kwalifikasie. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Ingenieurstegnikus. Openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Goeie rekenaarvaardigheid en rekenaarprogrammeervaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik) en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Ervaring in projekbestuur. Tegniese ontwerp en analise van hidrologiese data. Kennis en ervaring in rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Tegniese verslagskrywing en tegniese raadgewingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing, analise, besluitneming en spanwerkvaardighede. Kreatiwiteit, kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Goeie beplanning, organisasie en mensebestuur. Uitgebreide reis soos en wanneer benodig. Moet bereid wees om vir lang periodes weg van die kantoor te werk.
af.duties: Stroommeting met behulp van ADP en konvensionele stroommetingsmetodes. Opmeting van meetdamme en vloed (gegradeerde) seksies met behulp van die waterpasinstrument. Voorbereiding van tekeninge met behulp van CAD-sagteware. Kalibrering van vloeimetingsstasies. Inspeksiebeplanning van instandhouding van oppervlakwatermetingsstasies binne die area van verantwoordelikheid. Instandhouding van elektroniese dataregistreringsinstrumente. Toesig oor personeel. Redigering en verwerking van hidrologiese data. Voorbereiding van tegniese spesifikasies vir die verkryging van die benodigde hulpbronne. Versameling van alle vorme van hidrologiese data binne die area van verantwoordelikheid en samestelling van verslae. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan versoeke wat van belanghebbendes ontvang word. Verseker nakoming van die Wet op Beroepsveiligheid en Gesondheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulatoriese vereistes. Neem deel aan navorsings- en ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite vir voortdurende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures.

zu.title: Engineering Technician Production Grade A-C (CIVIL)
zu.summary: Umlinganisi wobuchwepheshe ku-Civil Engineering we-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Kimberley, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA kanye namava wokulinganisa ukugeleza kwezinhlanzi.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe kwe-National Civil Engineering. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuthola amava wobuchwepheshe be-Civil Engineering emva kokuthola izifundo. Ukubhalisa ngokuphothulayo ne-ECSA njengomlinganisi wobuchwepheshe. Ukufaka isitifiketi esivumelekile, esingakapheli sesiTuNomthwalo. Ulwazi oluhle lwekhompyutha namakhono obuhle bokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana (abomuva nalobusabalele) kanye namakhono okuxoxisana. Amava ekuphathweni kwephrojekthi. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe bokususa ukuhlakahlaza kanye nokuhlaziya idatha yezimboni zamanzi. Ulwazi namava kumayelana nabalinganisi bobuchwepheshe behlelelo. Amakhono obuchwepheshe bokususa izindlu ezingabalulekile kanye namakhono obuchwepheshe bokuqasha. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukuthatha izinqumo kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu. Amakhono obungqingili, ukugxila ekhasimende kanye nokusabela. Ukulungiselela kahle, ukuhlela kanye nokuphatha abantu. Ukuhamba kakhulu lapho kudingeka khona. Kufanele ukube ulungele ukusebenza kube kude kwe-ofisi isikhathi eside.
zu.duties: Ukulinganisa ukugeleza kwezinhlanzi kusetshenziswa i-ADP kanye nezindlela ezijwayelekile zokulinganisa ukugeleza. Ukuhlola amadamu okulinganisa kanye nezindawo zezikhathi eziphakeme zokugeleza (ezibalwe) kusetshenziswa isisetshenzisi sokulinganisa izinga. Ukulungiselela izithombe kusetshenziswa ibhuloho we-CAD. Ukulungisa iziteshi zokulinganisa ukugeleza. Ukuphatha ukuhlola ukulungiswa kweziteshi zokulinganisa amanzi aphansi emoyeni ngaphakathi kwendawo ebekiwe. Ukulungiswa kwemishini yokugcina idatha yamakhompyutha. Ukuphatha abasebenzi. Ukulungisa nokucubungula idatha yezimboni zamanzi. Ukulungiselela izinhlaka zobuchwepheshe zezenkonzo ezidingeka ukutholwa kwezinsiza. Ukuqoqa zonke izinhlobo zedatha yezimboni zamanzi ngaphakathi kwendawo ebekiwe bese uhloza imibiko. Ukuhlinzeka ngokwesekwa kobuchwepheshe ezicelweni ezitholakala kubaphathi bahlanganyele. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa umthetho wezempilo nokuphepha kwezokusebenza ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomthetho nezimiso. Ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yocwaningo nentuthuko ukuze kuqhutshekwe ukuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe bokuqasha ngokungeneki ukuze kugcineke ngetheknoloji ezintsha kanye namanyathelo amatsha.

xh.title: IEngineering Technician Production Grade A-C (CIVIL)
xh.summary: Ixesha elingekho ndawongenwa kwasekhaya kwindawo efunekayo yomsebenzi we-Civil Engineering kwiNgingqi yaManzi eKimberley, efuna ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA namava okulinga amanzi.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma kwi-Civil Engineering. Iyaholo (3) le minyaka yamava obuchwephesha kwi-Civil Engineering emva kwezifundo. Ukubhaliswa kungekho ndawongenwa kwi-ECSA njengomsingathi we-Civil Engineering. Ukutyhila ilayisenisi yokushayela engaze iqhawule. Ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha kakuhle nokwazi ukulungiselela iinkqubo zekhompyutha. Amava okuthetha nabantu (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo) nokukwazi ukuxoxisana. Amava kulawulo lweprojekthi. Ulwazi lokuyila ngobuchwepheshe nokuhlola amanzi. Ulwazi nokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ubuchwephesha bhala iingxelo ze-Civil Engineering. Ulwazi lokuba ngumcebisi we-Civil Engineering. Isakhono sokuzama, sokuyila, sokulawula nokuzama izinto. Isakhono sobuchwephesha bhala iingxelo. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphantsi kweemeko ezinzima. Isakhono sokuzama izinto ezintsha nokuba nomtsalane. Isakhono sokucinga ngokukhawuleza. Isakhono sokuhamba kakhulu njengoko kufuneka. Makabe lukhululekile ukusebenza ngaphandle kweofisi ixesha elide.
xh.duties: Ukulingwa kwamanzi kusetyenziswa i-ADP nezindlela ezisemthethweni zokulingwa kwamanzi. Uphononongo lwezinto ezibanjwa amanzi nokuhla kwawo kwiindawo ezilinganjiweyo kusetyenziswa isixhobo sokulinganisa. Ulungiselelo lwezifanekiso kusetyenziswa isoftware ye-CAD. Ulungelelwaniso lweziteshi ezingalinga ukugeleka kwamanzi. Ugcino lwendlela yokujonga iziteshi ezingalinga amanzi asemantla kwindawo efunekayo. Intlawulo yezixhobo zokubhala iingcombolo zesixhobo. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ulungiso nokuhlolwa kwamanani e-hydrological. Ulungiselelo lweenkcazelo ezithile zokuzelela iimpahla ezifunekayo. Ukuqokelelwa kweendidi zonke kwamanani e-hydrological kwindawo efunekayo nokubhala iingxelo. Unika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kumagqabo afunyenwe kubantu abahlangahlanganyo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act ngokwemigaqo nemimiselo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuphononongo lwezinto ezintsha nokuphuhlisa ulwazi olutsha lobuchwepheshe.

jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in Natural /Water Groundwater/ Geohydrology related Sciences or relevant qualification. Three (3) years’ post qualification technical scientific experience in groundwater. Compulsory registration with SACNASP as Certificated Natural Scientist. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Understanding of program and project management. Scientific methodologies and models. Research and development. Computer-aided scientific applications. Knowledge of groundwater resources management is essential. Extensive experience in water management, Environmental field, urban development, agricultural, waste management and mining. Understanding of department’s role and function with respect to Water Quality and Water Resources Protection. Knowledge of the National Water Act, 36 of 1998 and related policies, strategies and guidelines. Understanding of principles of integrated Water Resource Management. Experience in minimizing the impacts from industries, agriculture, urban development and mining. Computer literacy. Innovative thinking. Negotiation skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Data analysis. Scientific presentation. Decision making. Customer focus and responsiveness. Problem solving.
jobs.duties: Perform technical scientific and geohydrological functions and tasks that require interpretation in the presence of an established framework. Apply operational standards and consolidate methodologies, policies, systems and procedures. Identify gaps and develop appropriate interventions and extension of the groundwater monitoring network. Preparation and participation in research activities. Data collection through field surveys. Maintenance, calibration and operation of scientific equipment. Provide Geohydrological technical support and advice. Develop working relations with client base and extend client base. Promote public awareness of scientific activities. Provide technical/scientific data, information and advice. To perform technical scientific analysis and regulatory functions. Preparation of data and routine interpretation. Database and data management. Analysis of technical scientific data. Dissemination of information. Apply the appropriate scientific and technical procedures/skills to generate information and knowledge. Formulate proposals and compile reports. Research and development. Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Equipment reviews and procurement of new equipment. Research/literature studies to improve expertise. Publish and present technical reports and research findings. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on Geohydrological related matters. Supervise technical support and processes. Manage the performance management and development of staff. All duties will be performed in a Geohydrological environment.

af.title: Wetenskaplike Tegnikus: Produksie Vlak a – C
af.summary: Wetenskaplike tegnikuspos in Kimberley wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in waterverwante wetenskappe, SACNASP-registrasie en drie jaar se grondwaterervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma in Natuurlike-/Grondwater-/Geohidrologieverwante Wetenskappe of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Drie (3) jaar na kwalifikasie tegniese wetenskaplike ervaring in grondwater. Verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as Gesertifiseerde Natuurwetenskaplike. Vrugting van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Begrip van program- en projekbestuur. Wetenskaplike metodes en modelle. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde wetenskaplike toepassings. Kennis van grondwaterhulpbronbestuur is essensieel. Uitgebreide ervaring in waterbestuur, omgewingsveld, stedelike ontwikkeling, landbou, afvalbestuur en mynbou. Begrip van die departement se rol en funksie met betrekking tot Waterkwaliteit en Waterhulpbronbeskerming. Kennis van die Nasionale Waterwet, 36 van 1998 en verwante beleide, strategieë en riglyne. Begrip van die beginsels van geïntegreerde Waterhulpbronbestuur. Ervaring in die minimering van die impakte van nywerhede, landbou, stedelike ontwikkeling en mynbou. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Innoverende denke. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis van regs nakoming. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Data-analise. Wetenskaplike voorlegging. Besluitneming. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Voer tegniese wetenskaplike en geohidrologiese funksies en take uit wat interpretasie binne 'n gevestige raamwerk vereis. Pas operasionele standaarde toe en konsolideer metodes, beleide, stelsels en prosedures. Identifiseer leemtes en ontwikkel toepaslike ingrypings en uitbreiding van die grondwatermoniteringsnetwerk. Voorbereiding en deelname aan navorsingsaktiwiteite. Data-insameling deur veldopnames. Onderhoud, kalibrering en bedryf van wetenskaplike toerusting. Verskaf geohidrologiese tegniese ondersteuning en advies. Bou werksverhoudings met kliëntebasis op en brei kliëntebasis uit. Bevorder publieke bewustheid van wetenskaplike aktiwiteite. Verskaf tegniese/wetenskaplike data, inligting en advies. Voer tegniese wetenskaplike analise en regulerende funksies uit. Voorbereiding van data en roetine-interpretasie. Databasis- en databestuur. Analise van tegniese wetenskaplike data. Verspreiding van inligting. Pas die toepaslike wetenskaplike en tegniese prosedures/vaardighede toe om inligting en kennis te genereer. Formuleer voorstelle en stel verslae op. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Toerustings hersienings en verkryging van nuwe toerusting. Navorsings/literatuurstudies om kundigheid te verbeter. Publiseer en bied tegniese verslae en navorsingsbevindings aan. Skakel met toepaslike liggame/rade oor geohidrologieverwante aangeleenthede. Oorsig tegniese ondersteuning en prosesse. Bestuur prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling van personeel. Alle pligte sal in 'n geohidrologiese omgewing uitgevoer word.

zu.title: Usoshensi Wobuchwepheshe: Ukukhiqiza Izinga a – C
zu.summary: Isikhundla sososhensi wobuchwepheshe e Kimberley esifuna i-National Diploma kwezolimo ezihlotshaniswa namanzi, ukubhaliswa kwi-SACNASP kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava kwamanzi asezansi.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma kwezenzululwazi eziye zihlobene nemvelo/amanzi amanzi asezansi/ i-Geohydrology noma izifundo ezihlobene. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava obuchwepheshe bezolimo ezenzululwazi emva kweziqu kwamanzi asezansi. Ukubhaliswa ngamuphela kwi-SACNASP njengososhensi wesayensi yemvelo. Ukwenza isaziso segundane elisebenzayo futhi elingathinteki lesiqu sokushayela. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo nezinhlelo. Izindlela zezolimo nezifanekiselo. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ngekhompyutha ezesayensi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanti asezansi sibucayi. Amava amakhulu ekuphathweni kwamanzi, enkundleni yezemvelo, entuthukweni yasedolobheni, ezolimo, ekuphathweni kwenkunkuma kanye nokumbiwa kwamalahle. Ukuqonda indima nomsebenzi womnyango maqondana nobulungi bomanti nokuVikela Izinsiza Zamanti. Ulwazi lgebe-Mthetho Wamanti Kazwelonke, i-36 ka-1998 kanye nezinqubomgomo ezihlobene, izindlela kanye nezinkomba. Ukuqonda imigomo yokuphathwa kwamanzi okuhlanganiswe. Amava ekunciphisa imithelela evela emikhakheni yezimboni, ezolimo, entuthukweni yasedolobheni nasekumbiweni kwamalahle. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukucabanga ngendlela entsha. Amandla okuxoxisana. Amandla okubhala nokukhuluma kahle. Ulwazi lokuzelelwa ngomthetho. Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukuhlaziya idatha. Okubonakalayo kwezolimo. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuqashekela abathengi kanye nokuqonda izingidingo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi yobuchwepheshebezolimo kanye ne-geohydrological emibuzo edinga ukuhumusha lapho kunenhlaka esekelwe. Ukusebenzisa izinga lokusebenza futhi uhlanganise izindlela, izinqubomgomo, izinhlela kanye nezenzo. Ukuhlola izikhala futhi ukuthuthukisa izinyathelo ezifanele kanye nokunweba inethiwekhi yokulola amanzi asezansi. Ukulungiselela futhi ukuthatha inxaxheba emicwaningweni. Ukuqoqa idatha ngemicimbi yasendle. Ukugcina, ukulinganisa nokusebenzisa izinto zezolimo. Nikeza usizo lobuchwepheshe kanye neseluleko se-geohydrological. Ukuthuthukisa izinhlobonhlobo zabathengi futhi ukwandisa isisekelo sabathengi. Ukukhuthaza ukuba kwazi komphakathi ngemisebenzi yezolimo. Nikeza idatha yobuchwepheshe/ezolimo, ulwazi kanye neseluleko. Ukwenza ukuhlaziya kobuchwepheshebezolimo kanye nemisebenzi yolawulo. Ukulungiselela idatha kanye nokuhumusha njalo. Ukuphathwa kwesiqu sedatha kanye nedatha. Ukuhlaziya idatha yobuchwepheshe. Ukusakazwa kolwazi. Sebenzisa izindlela ezifanele zezolimo nobuchwepheshe ukuze kukhiqizwe ulwazi nolwazi. Hlela izinkulumo kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi ngokuqhubekayo ukuze ugqame kwezobuchwepheshe ezintsha nezindlela. Ukubuyekezwa kwemishini kanye nokuthenga emishiweni entsha. Ucwaningo/izifundo zolwazi ukuthuthukisa amandla. Shicilela futhi ubonise imibiko yobuchwepheshe kanye nemiphumela yocwaningo. Xoxa namaphuzu/amakhaphethweki ahlobene nezindaba ze-geohydrological. Qaphela ukusekelwa kobuchwepheshe kanye nezenzo. Phatha ukwenza umsebenzi kanye nentuthuko yabasebenzi. Konke imisebenzi kuzokwenziwa emvelweni ye-geohydrological.

xh.title: Iqabane lobuChwepheshe beSayensi: Ukulwa kwemveliso iNqanaba a – C
xh.summary: Isithuba sosayensiobuchwepheshe eKimberley esifuna i-National Diploma kwizayensi ezelene namanzi, ukubhalwa kwi-SACNASP kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava kwamanzimhlaba.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma kwizayensi ezelene Nezlalo/ amanzi Amanzi aphansi komhlaba/ i-Geohydrology okwesayensi okuhambelana nayo nanikwesiqikwisiso esifanelekileyo. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava obuchwephesheyesayensi emva kokufumana isidanga kwamanzimhlaba. Ukubhalwa kwi-SACNASP njengesayensi eNtsayensiyo esinelayisensi ngokumiselweyo. Ukubhengeza ilayisenisi yokutyala-moto elesebenzayo engaphelelwa lixesha. Ukuqonda ukulawula iinkqubo namaprojekthi. Iindlela zamaxhesha ezobuchwephesheyesayensi namamodela. Ucovo-lwazi nophuhliso. Izicelo zobuchwepheshe ezixhaswa yikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngolawulo loluhlaziyo lwamanzi luyimfuno enkulu. Amandla kunye namava amaninzi kulawulo lwamanzi, kwithuba lezendalo, ekuphuhliseni amadolobu, ezolimo, ekulawuleni iinkunkuma nakumigodi. Ukuqonda indima nomsebenzi wesebe ukujongana nomgangatho wamanzi nokuKhuslawulo lwamaza. UlwazingeMthetho weZwelonke wamanzi, 36 ka-1998 ngeenkqubela-mgaqo, amacebo namacebo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo-zobuchwepheshe ezahlukeneyo zolawulo lwamaza. Amandla kunye namava ekunciphisa iimpembelelo ezingenwa ziimveliso, ezolimo, ekuqhubeni amadolobu nakumigodi. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngomnatha ongayiyo nangokuchanekileyo. Okuqamba iingcinga ezitsha. Amandla okuxoxisana ngemigibe. Amandla amabali ukubhala nokuqhathanisa koluntu. Ulwazi ngomthetho nokuhambelana nawo. Ukubhala iingxelo ezobuchwepheshe. Ukuhlalutya iinkcukacha. Okubonakalisa iinkqubo-zobuchwephesheyesayensi. Ukwenza isigqibo. Ukuqonda iimfuno zabathengi nokuphendula kum. Isisombululo sezixhobo.
xh.duties: Qhuba imisebenzi yobuchwephesheyesayensi neye-geohydrological kunye nemisebenzi efunwa kukutolikwa kwangaphambili kokuba khona kwesiseko esisezinzileyo. Sebenzisa iistandard zokusebenza uze udibanise iindlela, iinkqubela-mgaqo, iinkqubo namacebo okusebenza. Phawula amathuba angapelayo uze uqulunqe iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokungena kunye nokwandisa inethiwekhi yokulolonga amanzi aphansi komhlaba. Ulungiselelo kunye noluntu lokwenza ucovo-lwazi. Ukuqokelela iinkcukacha ngemixholo yovavanyo olwenziwa evalweni. Ukugcina, ukulinganisa ngokuchanekileyo nokusebenza kwemishini yesayensi. Kubonelele ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe ye-geohydrological kunye necebiso. Yakha iindibaniselwano zokusebenza nabathengi uze uwande iindabaniselwano nabathengi. Khuthaza ukuqonda kommelwe mayela nemisebenzi yesayensi. Sika ubuchwepheshe/inkcukacha yesayensi, iinkcukacha nenceba. Ukwenza isigqibo sobuchwepheshe yesayensi kunye nemisebenzi yokulawula. Ulungiselelo lweenkcukacha kunye notoliko olusoloko lusenziwa. Ulawulo lolwahlulo nolondolozo lweenkcukacha. Ukuhlalutya iinkcukacha zobuchwepheshe yesayensi. Ukusasaza iinkcukacha. Sebenzisa iinkqubo/amakhono obuchwephesheyesayensi ezifanelekileyo ukuyila iinkcukacha ulwazi. Yila iingcombolo uze uhluze iingxelo. Ucovo-lwazi nophuhliso. Ukuphuhlisa ngokusoloko kwabasebenzi ukuze bagxile kwiinkqamlezobuchwephesha ezitsha namacebo. Ukuhlola imishini nokuzelela imishini emitsha. Ucovo-lwazi/izifundo zolwazi ukupuhlisa amakhono. Papasha uze umbonise iingxelo zobuchwepheshe neziphumo zocovo-lwazi. Thintathinta amabhashe/ngamagosa mayela neendaba ze-geohydrological. Lawula inkxaso namacebo obuchwepheshe. Lawula ukwenza ireyithing yabasebenzi ukuqonda ukusebenza kunye nophuhliso. Yonke imisebenzi iya kwenziwa kwimeko ye-geohydrological.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Practitioner
jobs.summary: A supply chain practitioner is needed in Kimberley to provide demand, acquisition, logistics and contract management support services for the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 6 qualification (National Diploma) in Supply Chain Management / Purchasing Management / Public Administration / Procurement / Financial Management or relevant qualification. One (1) year experience in Supply Chain Acquisition Management. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s licence. Knowledge of supply chain management administration procedure. Knowledge of financial legislation. Knowledge of Government Logistics Management System and LOGIS. Knowledge of PFMA, Treasury Regulation and Supply Chain Management Practice notes. Knowledge of supply chain management. Knowledge of procurement policies and legislation. Disciplinary knowledge of labour law. Knowledge of treasury regulations. Knowledge of dispute resolution policies. Understanding Social and Economic development issues. Basic Financial Management. Knowledge Management. Problem solving and analysis. People and diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Efficient communication skills, accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Render demand, acquisition, logistics and contract management support services. Render the supply chain management administrative roles. Follow relevant policies and regulations in supply chain management activities. Facilitate the procurement planning, acquisition and logistics of goods and services. Capture the acquisition requests on electronic purchasing system. Provide a Secretarial support function to Bid-Committees. Provide administrative duties during the tender/bid briefing sessions. Assist with the tender compilation of bid documents and confirm if it is in line with applicable SCM prescripts and processes. Respond to specific queries during the tender/bid briefing sessions. Open bid documents and check the responsiveness and non-responsiveness of documents. Provide assistance in the review of the scope of the Terms of Reference (TOR). Assist with the monitoring of validity period of closed tenders. Assist in the co-ordination and execution of the bidding process. Arrange and attend bid Evaluation committee meeting. Prepare register for bidders. Prepare scoring model/tender recommendation and evaluation reports. Preparation/ screening of recommendation for Adjudication. Supervise the Logistical Management Processes and compliance thereof. Ensure orders for correct goods and services are placed, checked, verified, received and paid to correct Supplier. Assist in updating the Contract registers and contract management. Supervise the Supply Chain Management financial and human resources. Manage personnel in accordance with human resource prescripts and DPSA PMDS process. Check the compliance with SCM prescripts and processes. Render administrative services to supply chain Acquisition Management. Assist in implementation of SCM policies, processes, and procedures.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Voorsieningskettingpraktisyn
af.summary: 'n Voorsieningskettingpraktisyn word benodig in Kimberley om vraag-, verkrygings-, logistiek- en kontrakbestuursondersteuningsdienste vir die Department of Water and Sanitation te verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma) in Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Aankoopbestuur / Publieke Administrasie / Verkryging / Finansiële Bestuur of tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Een (1) jaar ondervinding in Voorsieningskettingverkrygingsbestuur. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van voorsieningskettingbestuursadministratiewe prosedures. Kennis van finansiële wetgewing. Kennis van die Government Logistics Management System en LOGIS. Kennis van die PFMA, Treasury Regulation en Supply Chain Management Practice notes. Kennis van voorsieningskettingbestuur. Kennis van verkrygingsbeleide en -wetgewing. Dissiplinêre kennis van arbeidsreg. Kennis van tesourieregulasies. Kennis van geskilbeslegtingsbeleide. Begrip van sosiale en ekonomiese ontwikkelingskwessies. Basiese Finansiële Bestuur. Kennisbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise. Mens- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Doeltreffende kommunikasievaardighede, aanspreeklikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Lewer vraag, verkryging, logistiek- en kontrakbestuursondersteuningsdienste. Lewer die administratiewe rolle in voorsieningskettingbestuur. Volg tersaaklike beleide en regulasies in voorsieningskettingbestuursaktiwiteite. Fasiliteer die verkrygingsbeplanning, verkryging en logistiek van goedere en dienste. Voer die verkrygingsversoeke op die elektroniese aankoopstelsel in. Verskaf 'n sekretariële ondersteuningsfunksie aan Bied-komitees. Lewer administratiewe pligte tydens die aanbieding/bedingingsessies. Ondersteun met die samestelling van die bodokumente en bevestig of dit in ooreenstemming met toepaslike VKB-skrywes en prosesse is. Reageer op spesifieke navrae tydens die aanbieding/bedingingsessies. Maak bodokumente oop en kontroleer die mate van reaktiwiteit en nie-reaktiwiteit van dokumente. Verskaf bystand by die hersiening van die omvang van die Terms of Reference (TOR). Ondersteun met die monitering van die geldigheidsperiode van geslote tenders. Ondersteun by die koördinering en uitvoering van die biedingsproses. Reël en woon bod-evalueringskomiteevergaderings by. Berei register vir bodders voor. Berei puntemodel/tenderaanbeveling en evalueringsverslae voor. Voorbereiding/sif van aanbeveling vir Toekenning. Soupeser die Logistiese Bestuursprosesse en voldoening daaraan. Verseker dat bestellings vir korrekte goedere en dienste geplaas, nagegaan, geverifieer, ontvang en aan die korrekte Verskaffer betaal word. Ondersteun by die opdatering van die Kontrakregister en kontrakbestuur. Soupeser die finansiële en menslike hulpbronne van Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Bestuur personeel in ooreenstemming met menslike hulpbron-skrywes en die DPSA PMDS-proses. Kontroleer voldoening aan VKB-skrywes en prosesse. Lewer administratiewe dienste aan voorsieningskettingverkrygingsbestuur. Ondersteun by die implementering van VKB-beleide, prosesse en prosedures.

zu.title: Umuntu ophilayo kwi-Supply Chain Practitioner
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu ophilayo kakhulu kwizinkambu ze-Supply Chain Practitioner e-Kimberley, ukuze atikelele ngokuphenya, ukuthuthwa kwamadrayiva, kanye nesevisi yesekelo yezinkampani kwi-Department of Water and Sanitation.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 6 (National Diploma) kwi-Supply Chain Management / Purchasing Management / Public Administration / Procurement / Financial Management noma isiqu esihambisanayo. Ukuze kube khona i-One (1) year experience kwi-Supply Chain Acquisition Management. Ukusaziswa kwelayisensi yokushayela eyasebenzayo. Ukwazi imigomo yomnyango wezokuphathwa kwabakhamuzi. Ukwazi imithetho yesabelomali. Ukwazi uhlelo lwe-Government Logistics Management System kanye ne-LOGIS. Ukwazi i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulation kanye namaphuzu abhalwe ku-Supply Chain Management Practice. Ukwazi umnyango wokuhlela izimpahla. Ukwazi imigomo nemitshoyo yomnyango wokuthengisa. Ukwazi umthetho wabasebenzi. Ukwazi imigomophethi yesabelomali. Ukwazi imigomo yokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kwezohwebo nezomnotho. I-Basic Financial Management. Ukwazi ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nobunyuselwa. Ukuqonda ikhasanda nokugxila ekhasanda. Amakhono okuxhumana asetshenziswayo, ukubophezela kanye nokuziphatha okuhle.
zu.duties: Nika amandla, thola, ngcono umnyango wezempahla kanye nesevisi yesekelo sokuphathwa kwezinkontileka. Hamba emva kwemigomo ephathelene nezokuphatha imisebenzi enguquleliyo kumanyathelo okuphathwa kwezempahla. Qedela uhlelo lokuthenga izimpahla kanye namasevisi. Faka izicelo zokuthenga kwisistimu yentengo yamakhompyutha. Nikeza inkonzo yesekela lokubhalisa kwabakhi komnyango. Qedela imisebenzi yobhaliso ngesikhathi sezinkulumo-mphendvulano zithengiswa. Siza ekubhaliseni kwamadokhumenti okuthengisa ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi ahambisana nemigomo nendlela yokuqondisa imisebenzi kumnyango wezempahla. Phendula imibuzo ethize ngesikhathi sezinkulumo-mphendvulano zokuthengiswa. Vula amadokhumenti okuthengiswa uze uhlole ukuthi aphendule kanjani noma angaphenduli. Siza ekubuyeckeni isifanekiso sama-Terms of Reference (TOR). Siza ekulandeleni isikhathi esivumelekile sama-tender avaliwe. Siza ekuhleleni nasekuqedeni inqubo yokuthengiswa. Hlela bese uhamba eyonqgunyathweni lokubuyekeza ibhodo. Lungisebela abathengisi. Lungisa isibonelo sokushintsha izinombolo/izincomo nembiko lokubuyekeza. Lungisa/ukuhlolwa kwezincomo ze-Adjudication. Qondisa inqubo yokuphathwa kwezempahla kanye nokuhambisana kwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimpahla namasevisi ezilungile zibekwe, zihlolwa, ziqinisekiswa, zamukeleka kanti futhi zikhokhelwa kumsupli elungile. Siza ekubuyisweni kwesikhundla sabakhi bese kuphathwa amakhontradi. Qondisa imali nabanikazi bomnyango we Supply Chain Management. Phatha abantu ngokuhambisana nemigomo yabanikazi bomsebenzi kanye nenqubo ye-DPSA PMDS. Hlola ukuthi kuhambisana kanjani nemigomo nendlela yokuphathwa kwe Supply Chain Management. Nikeza imisebenzi esekelayo emphakathini wokuthengiswa nokuthengwa komnyango we Supply Chain Management. Siza ekuqaliseni imigomo, inqubo, kanye namandla e-SCM.

xh.title: Umsebenzi weNkqubo yokuthengwa kwemisebenzi
xh.summary: Kufuneka abantu baseKimberley abasebenzayo kwinkqubo yokuthengwa kwemisebenzi ukuba banikeze inkxaso kwimfuno, ekuthengweni, nakwindalo kwiSebe leManzi.
xh.requirements: Isetifikedi kwiNqanaba le-6 le-NQF (Isidanga seSizwe) kwinkqubo yokulawula ibhalwe eluntwini / kokulawula ukuthengwa kwemisebenzi / kokulawula iinkonzo zaluntu / kokuthenga / kwinkqubo yemali okanye isetifikedi esifanelekileyo. Unyaka omnye (1) wamava kwinkqubo yokuthenga. Isetifikedi sokusebenzisa ibhayisi. Ulwazi lwezaqubo zokulawula ibhalwe eluntwini. Ulwazi ngamagunya amathathu abantu. Ulwazi ngenkqubo kaRhulumente nokulawula ibhalwe eluntwini kunye ne-LOGIS. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, namagunya oRhulumente. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokuthenga. Ulwazi kwinkqubo yezithembiso. Ulwazi ngezaqubo. Ulwazi kwimiba yokulawula iingxabano. Ukuqonda ukuphuhliswa kwezinto. Isidanga semali. Ulwazi ngokulawula abantu. Ulwazi ngokuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Ukulawula abantu nokulawula iindidi ezahlukeneyo. Ukuzinika kumthengi nokuzikhathalela. Ikhono lokunxibelelana, nokuzibophelela.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ngenkonzo yemfuno, kokufuna izinto, yokulawula ukuthunyelwa kwemisebenzi, kwaye ulawule iinkontrata. Yenza iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo zolawulo lokulawula ibhalwe eluntwini lwemisebenzi yokufuna izinto. Landela iinqwelomlelwane kunye namagunya afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wokulawula ibhalwe eluntwini. Yenza inkqubo yocwangciso lokuthenga, ukufuna izinto, nakokuthunyelwa kwemisebenzi. Faka iimfuno zokuthenga kwinkqubo yekhompyutha. Nikezela ngenkxaso yabasebenzi abayinkontrata kwiKomiti. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo ngelixa xenkokhela iinkomityana zokuthengisa izitsha zemisebenzi. Nceda kwindalo yamagama ezitsha zemisebenzi, uqinisekise ukuba ngokwemigaqo nayiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokulawula ibhalwe eluntwini. Phendula iimbuzo ethile ngelixa xenkokhela iinkomityana zokuthengisa izitsha zemisebenzi. Vula amagama ezitsha zemisebenzi uze uqwalasele ukuba ngokwemigaqo ewe okanye hayi. Nceda kukunxibelelaniswa nokuqwalaselwa koluhlu lwamagama. Nceda ukulawula ixesha elisebenzayo lamagama ezitsha abevaliweyo. Nceda kukudibanisa kwaye wenze inkqubo yokuthengisa. Lungisa kwaye uzibuze kwindibano yeKomiti. Lungisa uludwe lwabantu abathengisayo. Lungisa iinkqubo zamaxabiso kwaye uchwetheze iingxelo. Lungisa ukusetyenziswa koluhlu lokunika iinkontrata. Lawula iinkqubo zokuthunyelwa kwemisebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba izinto ezifunekayo zithengiswa, ziqwalaselwe, zifumaneka, zithunyelwe kwaye zihlawuliswe. Nceda koludwe lwezinkontrata. Lawula imali abantu abasebenzayo kwinkqubo yemali. Lawula abantu ngokwezigaqo ezahlukeneyo. Qwalasela ukulandelwa kwemigaqo nayiinkqubo zokulawula ibhalwe eluntwini. Nika iinkonzo zolawulo kwinkqubo yokuthenga. Nceda kwindalo kwamandla emigaqo.
