jobs.duties: Render demand, acquisition, logistics and contract management support services. Render the supply chain management administrative roles. Follow relevant policies and regulations in supply chain management activities. Facilitate the procurement planning, acquisition and logistics of goods and services. Capture the acquisition requests on electronic purchasing system. Provide a Secretarial support function to Bid-Committees. Provide administrative duties during the tender/bid briefing sessions. Assist with the tender compilation of bid documents and confirm if it is in line with applicable SCM prescripts and processes. Respond to specific queries during the tender/bid briefing sessions. Open bid documents and check the responsiveness and non-responsiveness of documents. Provide assistance in the review of the scope of the Terms of Reference (TOR). Assist with the monitoring of validity period of closed tenders. Assist in the co-ordination and execution of the bidding process. Arrange and attend bid Evaluation committee meeting. Prepare register for bidders. Prepare scoring model/tender recommendation and evaluation reports. Preparation/ screening of recommendation for Adjudication. Supervise the Logistical Management Processes and compliance thereof. Ensure orders for correct goods and services are placed, checked, verified, received and paid to correct Supplier. Assist in updating the Contract registers and contract management. Supervise the Supply Chain Management financial and human resources. Manage personnel in accordance with human resource prescripts and DPSA PMDS process. Check the compliance with SCM prescripts and processes. Render administrative services to supply chain Acquisition Management. Assist in implementation of SCM policies, processes, and procedures.

af.title: Voorsieningskettingklerk toesighouer
af.summary: Hou toesig oor voorsieningskettingbestuursadministrasie, verkrygingsbeplanning, verkryging en logistiek vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Kimberley.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Grade 12-sertifikaat of tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar ondervinding in voorsieningskettingbestuur. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurslisensie. Kennis van voorsieningskettingbestuursadministrasieprosedures. Kennis van finansiële wetgewing. Kennis van Government Logistics Management System en LOGIS. Kennis van PFMA, Treasury Regulation en Supply Chain Management Practice notes. Kennis van voorsieningskettingbestuur. Kennis van verkrygingsbeleide en -wetgewing. Dissiplinêre kennis van arbeidsreg. Kennis van tesourieregulasies. Kennis van geskilbeslegtingsbeleid. Begrip van sosiale en ekonomiese ontwikkelingskwessies. Basiese finansiële bestuur. Kennisbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus. Doeltreffende kommunikasievaardighede, aanspreeklikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Lewer vraag-, verkrygings-, logistieke- en kontrakbestuursondersteuningsdienste. Lewer die voorsieningskettingbestuursadministratiewe rolle. Volg tersaaklike beleide en regulasies in voorsieningskettingbestuursaktiwiteite. Fasiliteer die verkrygingsbeplanning, verkryging en logistiek van goedere en dienste. Lui die verkrygingsversoeke op die elektroniese aankoopstelsel. Verskaf 'n sekretariële ondersteuningsfunksie aan bie-komitees. Verskaf administratiewe pligte tydens die aanbieding/bie-kortingsessies. Bystand met die aanbiedingopstel van biedokumente en bevestig of dit in ooreenstemming met toepaslike SCM-voorskifte en -prosesse is. Reageer op spesifieke navrae tydens die aanbieding/bie-kortingsessies. Maak biedokumente oop en kontroleer die responsiwiteit en nie-responsiwiteit van dokumente. Verskaf bystand by die hersiening van die omvang van die Terms of Reference (TOR). Bystand met die monitering van die geldigheidsperiode van geslote tenders. Bystand in die koördinering en uitvoering van die biedproses. Reël en woon bie-evalueringskomiteevergaderings by. Berei 'n register vir bieërs voor. Berei puntemodel/tender-aanbeveling en evalueringsverslae voor. Voorbereiding/siftering van aanbeveling vir Adjudication. Hou toesig oor die logistieke bestuursprosesse en nakoming daarvan. Verseker dat bestellings vir die korrekte goedere en dienste geplaas, gekontroleer, geverifieer, ontvang en aan die korrekte verskaffer betaal word. Bystand met die bywerking van die kontrakregisters en kontrakbestuur. Hou toesig oor die voorsieningskettingbestuur se finansiële en menslike hulpbronne. Bestuur personeel in ooreenstemming met menslike hulpbronvoorskifte en die DPSA PMDS-proses. Kontroleer die nakoming van SCM-voorskifte en -prosesse. Lewer administratiewe dienste aan voorsieningskettingverkrygingsbestuur. Bystand met die implementering van SCM-beleide, -prosesse en -prosedures.

zu.title: Mqondisi Wezinsizakalo Zokuthengisa
zu.summary: Qondisa isimo sokuphathwa kwesikweletu, iplani yokuthenga, ukuthola kanye namalogistics kuMnyango wezaManzi kanye noLwazi oKithi eKimberley.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma izifundo ezifanele. Ukutholwa kweminyaka eyi-Three (3) kuye kwayi-five (5) okusebenzeni kwakho ekuphathweni kwesikweletu. Ukwembula ilevensi yomshayeli valid futhi engakavuki. Ulwazi ngemasiko obuphathi bokuphathwa kwesikweletu. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezimali. Ulwazi nge-Government Logistics Management System kanye ne-LOGIS. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, Treasury Regulation kanye nezinqamuleli zokuphathwa kwesikweletu. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwesikweletu. Ulwazi ngezenqubomgomo zokuthenga nomthetho. Ulwazi olubhekene nomthetho wobudoda. Ulwazi ngezenqubomgomo zezimali igumbi. Ulwazi ngezenqubomgomo zokusombulula iziphixi. Ukuqonda izinto ezibhekene nentuthuko yomphakathi kanye nezomnotho. Ukuphathwa kwamali okuyisisekelo. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukusombulula izinkinga kanye nehlaziyo. Ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nokubahlukahluka. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Iziqu zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, ubuncwane kanye nokuziphatha okuhle.
zu.duties: Nikela ngezenzo zokwesekwa ezibhekene nesidingo, ukuthola, amalogistics kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkontileka. Nikela ngemisebenzi yobuphathi ehlotshaniswa nokuphathwa kwesikweletu. Landela izinqubomgomo namasiko ahlobene emisebenzini yokuphathwa kwesikweletu. Sikhundleni ucingo ekuplaniwe kokuthenga, ukuthola kanye namalogistics ezimpahla kanye nezinsizakalo. Faka izicelo zokuthola kwisistimu yobuchwepheshe yokuthenga. Nikela ngomsindo wokwesekwa komsebenzi wezocomitshi ze-Bid. Nikela ngemisebenzi yobuphathi ngesikhathi sezinkulumo-mphendulano ze-tender/bid. Siza ekubumbeni kwamadokhumenti we-tender futhi qiniseka ukuthi ahambisana namasiko namaphrocessi we-SCM. Phendula imibuzo ethize ngesikhathi sezinkulumo-mphendulano ze-tender/bid. Vula amadokhumenti we-bid futhi hlola ukuphendula nokungaphenduli kwawo. Nikela ngosizo ekubukweni kobubanzi be-Terms of Reference (TOR). Siza okubhekene nokulawula isikhathi esivumelekile sama-tender avalswe. Siza ekuhlelweni nokwenzeni iphrocessi yokubida. Hlela futhi bathathe inxaxhebe emihlanganweni yekomiti ye-Bid Evaluation. Lungisa irejista yabo ababidayo. Lungisa imodeli yokushintsha/inkomba ye-tender namabhalo ahlolwayo. Lungisa/uqobo inkomba ye-Adjudication. Lawula amaphrocessi wokuphathwa kwe-Logistics kanye nokuhambisana nawo. Qiniseka ukuthi ama-odolo ezimpahla nezinsizakalo ezifanele afakwa, ehlolelwa, eqinisekiswa, etholwa futhi akhokhwa kumSupliya ofanele. Sza ekubhaleni ngokuqhubekayo kwarejista zeinkontileka kanye nokuPhatwa kwezinkontileka. Lawula izinsizakalo zokuphathwa kwesikweletu zamali nabantu. Phatha abasebenzi ngokuhambisana namasizo wobuntu ahlobene nabantu kanye nephrocessi ye-DPSA PMDS. Hlola ukuthi kuhamanisana namasizo nobuqhebeqhebe be-SCM. Nikela ngemisebenzi yobuphathi ekutholeni kokuphathwa kwesikweletu. Siza ekusebenziseni izinqubomgomo, amaphrocessi, namasiko we-SCM.

xh.title: ISibhalo Sokulawula iNkqubo yoLondolozo lwamagumbi
xh.summary: Lawulwa kubasebenzi bolawulo lwesishishini sokwenza inkqubo ehamba phambili, nolungelelwaniso lokuThengwa kwexabiso elingathunyelwa phantsi, ekaRhini.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethat esiphezulu seBanga lama-12 noma isidanga esifanelekileyo. Iimviwo ezithathu (3) ukuya kwezihlanu (5) kwakhupha khona iNkqupo ka-Ngqondo lokuqonda kwindlela yokuphuhliswa kolwazi ngesiNgesi. Isidanga seLicencesi yendlela ePhefumlelwa ngokukhawuleza nokungenisa uLwazi kwiNdlela eNgcangcazela ukulawula uluntu.
xh.duties: Yenza iinkonzo zoxhaso lokusingathwa kwemfuno, kokuthengwa, kwezeshishini nakwinkqubo yoqoqosho yamalungiselelo. Yenza iindima ezimalunga nolawulo lwendlela yokuhamba kwezinto. Landela iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo kunye nemigaqo kumasebenzi olawulo lwendlela yokuhamba kwezinto. Qonda iplani yokuthengwa, kokuthengwa nakwezeshishini zeempahla kunye nenkonzo. Faka iimfuno zokuthenga kwinkqubo yethengiso yamakhompyutha. Yaza inkonzo yabasekili kwiKomiti yokuNqamisa uGqabiso. Yiza nemisebenzi yengqalasisonthombe phakathi kwamaseshoni enkcazelo ethile. Nceda kwinkqubo yokuqulunqa amaxwebhu okuNqamisa uGqabiso aze kuqinisekiswe ukuba ngokwemigaqo nakwiinkqubo ezikulawulo lwendlela yokuhamba kwezinto. Phendula imibuzo ethile phakathi kwamaseshoni enkcazelo ethile. Vula amaxwebhu okuNqamisa uGqabiso uze uqhagamshelle ukusabela nokungasabeli kwamaxwebhu. Yaza inkonzo kwinkqubo yokuphonononga indlela yoMgaqo weeNkcazelo ZoMgxalabhanyi. Nceda nokulawulwa kwexesha lokusebenza kwamaxwebhu aqunyiweyo. Nceda ekulungelelaniseni nasekuqhubeni inkqubo yokuNqamisa uGqabiso. Lungiselela ukuze uphile komkhosi weKomiti yoLinganiso lokuNqamisa uGqabiso. Lungiselela irejista yabanikezeli. Lungiselela inkqubo yokulinganisa/nkamiso lokuNqamisa uGqabiso neengxelo zolinganiso. Ulungelelwaniso/ukuhlola inkamiso yeGqabiso. Lawula iinkqubo zoLawulo lweZeshishini nokuthotyelwa kwazo. Qinisekisa ukuba iiodolo zemimongo yamagumbi neezenkonzo zifakelwa, zihlolwa, ziqinisekiswa, zamkelwa kwaye zihlawulwa kumNikezeli ofanelekileyo. Nceda ekubuyiseneni irejista yoLungiselelo kunye nolawulo lolungiselelo. Lawula imali nabanini-mali beNkqubo yoLawulo lweNkqubo yokuhamba kwezinto. Lawula abasebenzi ngokweemigaqo yabanini-mali nasekuqhubeni iinkqubo zeDPSA PMDS. Hlola ukuthotyelwa kwemigaqo nqqubo zoLawulo lweNkqubo yokuhamba kwezinto. Yenza iinkonzo zabasebenzi bekondrolo kokuLawulwa kokuThengwa kwemfuneko. Nceda kwinkqubo yomgaqo-nqamisa-mali, iinkqubo, namage webhu weNkqubo yolawulo lokuhanjiswa kweendlela ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Registry Clerk Supervisor
jobs.summary: Supervise registry counter services, mail handling, filing and records management for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Kimberley.

Minimum of three (3) to (5) five years relevant experience required. Knowledge of Registry duties, practice as well as the ability to capture data and operate computer. Working knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service and Records Management. Knowledge and understanding and application of National Archive and Records Services Act (Act 43 of 1996). Knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Understanding of the work in registry. Planning and organization. Computer literacy. Good verbal and written communication skills. Interpersonal relations, flexibility and teamwork.

Filing, tracing and retrieval documents and files. Complete index cards for all files. Supervise the operation and operate machine related to registry functions, Open and maintain franking machine register. Frank post. Undertake spot checks on post to ensure no private post is included. Open and Close remittance register. Keep daily record of number of letters franked. Supervise the processing and process documents for archiving and disposal. Sort and package files for archives and distribution. Keep records for archived documents. Support satellite office with the application and utilization of Departmental File Plan. Supervise human resources/Staff. Allocate and ensure quality of work, personnel development, assess staff performance and apply discipline.

zu.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wokubhaliswa Kwamarekhodi
zu.summary: Qapha izinkonzo zesikhungo sesirejistri, ukuphathwa kwemeli, ukugcwalisa kanye nokuphathwa kwarekhodi ze-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Kimberley.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma izifundo ezihambisana nalokho. Isitifiketi noma iDiploma ekuphathweni kwamarekhodi; Izinkonzo Zolwazi zizoba yinzuzo eyedlulele. Kudingeka ubude beminyaka emithathu (3) kuya kwayo (5) emihlanu ubuhle bebhoqophi. Ukwazi imisebenzi yesirejistri, amasu kanye nenhlelokusebenza yekhompyutha kanye nokuthi ukwazi ukubhalisa idatha. Ukuqonda ulwazi lwesisekelo sezomthetho silawula Imisebenzi kahulumeni kanye neQapha kwezirekhodi. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa uMthetho weZinkonzo Zezindeya Namarekhodi (Act 43 of 1996). Ulwazi lomgqamo kanye nezindlela zokubuyisa ngokomtholampilo wobuciko. Ukuqonda imisebenzi yesirejistri. Ukuhlela nokuqamba. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa ngomlomo nokubhala. Ukuxhumana kwabantu, ukuguquguquka kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi unikeze izinkonzo zesikhungo sesirejistri; Ukwesaba abathengi. Qapha ukuphathwa kwebhange elingenayo nelayophumayo. Qapha, hlela, bhalise futhi uthumele imeli. Qapha futhi unikeze insiza egqwense ukugcwalisa kanye nokuphathwa kwarekhodi ngokwesu lamafayela loMnyango. Ukuvula nokuvala amafayela ngokwesistimu yokuhlelwa kwamarekhodi. Ukugcwalisa, ukulandela kanye nokubuyisa amadokhumenti namafayela. Qedela amakhadi inkomba yawo wonke amafayela. Qapha ukusebenza kwaye usebenze imishini ehambisana nemisebenzi yesirejistri; Vula futhi ugcine ibhuku lesititshi sokushicilela. Shicilela iziphości ezigcwaliswe ngamatshini. Yenza okuhlwayo iziphości ukuze qinisekiswe ukuthi akukho ziphości zangasese ezifakiwe. Vula futhi Uvale ibhuku lemalimidi. Gcina irekhodi yansuku zonke y enombolo yamagama ashicilelwe. Qapha ukucutshungulwa kwaye ucutshungule amadokhumenti okuhlonya nokuqedwa. Hlela futhi upakethe amafayela okuhlonya nokuqoqa. Gcina amarekhodi amadokhumenti ahlonziwe. Sekela ihhovisi eliseduze ngokusebenzisa futhi ukusetshenziswa kwesu lamafayela loMnyango. Qapha abantu/abasebenzi. Aba futhi uqinisekise ikhwalithi yomsebenzi, ukukhula kwabantu, hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi futhi usebenzise isiso.

xh.title: Mlawuli weCawa le Bhodi yeZicwangciso
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo zedesika yebala le-rejista, ukuphathwa kwemeyile, ukubeka kwiifayili nokulawula irekhod kwesebe leWater and Sanitation eKimberley.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior/Grade12 okanye isigqibo esifanelekileyo. Isatifikethi okanye iDiploma ekulawuleni irekhod; iinkonzo zelwazi ziya kuba lusizoongedlelo. Kufuneka kubekho amava afanelekileyo abangaphantsi kweminyaka elishumi elithathu (3) ukuya kwelishumi elihlanu (5). Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yebala le-rejista, nendlela yokwenza nokuba nakho ukubhala i-data nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa nokuluqonda kwesakhiwo sezomthetho silawula inkonzo kaRhulumente nokuLawula irekhod. Ulwazi nokuqonda nokusetyenziswa koMthetho weZiko lweZizwe nokuLawulwa kweenkonzo zeRekhod (uMthetho ka-43 ka-1996). Ulwazi ngeendlela zokugcina nokuvelisa ngokommandla wokusebenza. Ukuqonda umsebenzi owenziwa kwibala le-rejista. Ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Amakhono amabalulweyo ethetha noku culula. Ukuziphatha komntu nomntu, ukuguquguquka nokusebenza njengesiqhanga.
xh.duties: Lawula kananjalo unike iinkonzo zesikhululo sebhodi yebala le-rejista, ukubakamela abathengi. Lawula ukuphathwa kweephepha-magazini ezingenayo nezihamba. Lawula, uhlele, ubhalise kwaye uthumele imeyile. Lawula kananjalo unike inkonzo ebangelwa kukubeka kwiifayili nokulawula irekhod ngokweplani yamafayili yesebe. Ukuvula nokuvalela amafayili ngokwendlela yokucatshulwa kwamafayili. Ukubeka kwiifayili, ukukhangela nokubuyisela amaphephadokhumente nangeefayili. Ukugqiba iikhadhi zomsonto wamafayili onke. Lawula ukusebenza kokushicilelwa kwaye ukusebenzise iimoto ezilawula iinkonzo zebala le-rejista, ukuze kuvuleke nokugcinwa koluhlu lwekhadi le-post franking. Ukufaka umhondiso wakho epostini. Ukwenzaukuvavanya ekuzinzileni nangobukhali be-post ukugqinisekisa ukuba akukho post yabucala ifakwe kuyo. Ukuvula nokuvalela uluhlu lwerejista yemali ethunyelwe. Ukuze kugcinwe iirekhodi zemihla ngemihla kule ntsumba yamagama afakelwe umhondiso. Lawula ukugqitywa kwaye uqhelanise ukutshatyalaliswa kwamaphepha-dokhumente abanjwelwa ugonyelo nokususwa kuluhlu. Ukuthunga nokupakisha amafayili ukuze athunyelwe kwisikwele yokugcina nokusasazwa. Ukugcina uluhlu lwamaphepha-dokhumente olugciniweyo. Ukuxhasa ofisi ngee satellite ngokusetyenziswa nokuqonda iplani yesebe yokubeka iifayili. Lawula abantu basebenzayo/abasebenzi. ukwaba nokugqinisekisa umgangatho womsebenzi, ukuphucula abantu basebenzayo, ukuvavanya ukuphumelela kwabasebenzi nokusebenzisa isohlwayo.

af.title: Registrateursklerk Bestuurder
af.summary: Bestuur registrateurkliëntediens, poshantering, liassering en rekordbestuur vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Kimberley.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Grade 12-sertifikaat of tersaaklike kwalifikasie; 'n Sertifikaat of Diploma in Rekordbestuur; Inligtingsdienste sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien; Minimum van drie (3) tot (5) vyf jaar tersaaklike ondervinding word vereis; Kennis van registrateurspligte, -praktyk asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedryf; Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens en Rekordbestuur regeer; Kennis en begrip en toepassing van die Nasionale Argief- en Rekorddienswet (Wet 43 van 1996); Kennis van bergings- en onttrekkingsprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing; Begrip van die werk in die registratuur; Beplanning en organisering; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Goeie verbale en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Interpersoonlike verhoudinge, buigsaamheid en spanwerk.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf registrateurkliëntediens. Beacht kliënte. Bestuur die hantering van inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Bestuur en sorteer, registreer en versend pos. Bestuur en lewer 'n doeltreffende liasseer- en rekordbestuursdiens volgens die departementele lêerplan. Oopmaak en sluit van lêers volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Liasseer, traceer en haal dokumente en lêers op. Voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers. Bestuur die werking en bedien masjiene wat verband hou met registrateurfunksies; Oopmaak en hou frankingsmasjienregister aan. Frank pos. Onderneem steekproewe op pos om te verseker dat geen private pos ingesluit is nie. Oopmaak en sluit betaalregister. Hou daaglikse rekord van aantal gefrankeerde briewe. Bestuur die verwerking en verwerk dokumente vir argivering en uitwissing. Sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Hou rekords van gearchiveerde dokumente. Ondersteun satellietkantoor met die toepassing en benutting van die departementele lêerplan. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne/personeel. Allokeer en verseker gehalte van werk, personeelsontwikkeling, evalueer personeelprestasie en pas dissipline toe.

jobs.title: Registry Clerk Supervisor
jobs.summary: Supervise registry counter services and records management compliance at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Gqeberha.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate or relevant qualification. Three (3) to five (5) years’ experience in Registry functions. Knowledge of the Public Service Act, Public Services National Archives Regulations and National Archive and Records Services Act of South Africa (NARSASA)e Regulations, and relevant Records Management prescripts. Computer literacy. Ability to capture data and collate administrative statistics. Disclosure of a valid unexpired driver`s license. Problem solving and analysis.
jobs.duties: Supervise and provide registry counter services. Facilitate implementation of records management policies and procedures. Facilitate compliance inspections of Registries. Attend to clients. Handle telephone and other enquiries received. Receive and register hand delivered mail/files. Archive and disposal of documents Supervise the handling of incoming and outgoing correspondence. Supervise the reception and receive all mail. Supervise and sort, register and dispatch mail. Distribute notices on registry issues. Supervise and render an effective filing and record management service. Opening and closing files according to the record classification system. Filing/storage, tracing(electronically/manually) and retrieval of documents and files. Ensure and complete index cards for all files. Supervise the operation and operate office machines in relation to the registry function. Supervise the processing and process documents for archiving and disposal. Electronic scanning of files. Sort and package files for archives and distribution. Compile list of documents to be archived and submit to supervisor. Keep records for archived documents. Administer and maintain file plan. Support all satellite offices on Records Management matters. Supervise registry staff. Allocate and ensure quality work. Personnel development. Assess staff performance. Apply discipline.

zu.title: Ungqongqoshe Wokuphatha Isikhundla Sikabhalisi We-Registry
zu.summary: Qapha izinsizakulo zesika le-registry kanye nokuthobela imithetho yokuphathwa kwemibhalo eDepartment of Water and Sanitation eGqeberha.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma izifundo ezihambisanayo. Ubude ubuni eminyaka emithathu (3) kuya kwemihlanu (5) emisebenzini ye-Registry. Ulwazi loMthetho Wezinsizakulo Zikahulumeni, oMthetho Wezinsizakulo Zikahulumeni Wolondolozo Lwesizwe (Public Services National Archives Regulations) kanye noMthetho Wolondolozo Lwemibhalo Wezinsizakulo Zikahulumene (NARSASA) eMzansi Afrika, namaphrescripti ahambisanayo okuphathwa kwemibhalo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ikhono lokufaka imininingo kanye nokuhlela izibalo zomsebenzi. Ukuzivula ngelayisense yokushayela evumelekile engakapheli. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi unikeze izinsizakulo zesika le-registry. Sika umzila ekusebenziseni izinqubomgomo nemiyalo yokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Sika umzila ukuhlola ukuthobela imithetho kuMabhalo (Registries). Philisela abakhasimende. Phathela imibuzo ethunywe ngefoni nanaszinye. Yamukela futhi ubhalise imeyili/ amafayela alethwe ngesandhla. Gcina kanye nokulahla imibhalo. Qapha ukuphathwa kophiko lwamelayili olungena naphuma. Qapha ukwamukelwa kanye nokuyamukela yonke imeyili. Qapha futhi uhlele, ubhalise futhi uthume imeyili. Sazisa izindaba ngezindaba le-registry. Qapha futhi nikeze insizakulo yokulondolozwa kwenhlayiyo kanye nokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Ukuvula kanye nokuvula amafayela ngokwesistimu yokuhlukanisa imibhalo. Ukulondoloza/ ukugcina, ukulandela (ngekhomphyutha/ ngesandhla) kanye nokukhipha imibhalo kanye namafayela. Qinisekisa futhi ugqibe amakhadi ashintsho (index cards) yawo wonke amafayela. Qapha ukusebenza kanye nokusebenzisa amashini ohhovu mayelana nomsebenzi we-registry. Qapha ukucubungula futhi ucubungule imibhalo ukulondoloza kanye nokulahla. Ukuskena amafayela ngekhomphyutha. Hlela futhi upheqe amafayela izilondolozi kanye nokusatshalaliswa. Hlela uhlu lwemibhalo ezolondoloza futhi uyinikeze ongqongqoshe. Gcina imibhalo yemibhalo egciniwe. Phatha futhi ulondoloze ihlelo lamafayela. Sekela wonke amahhovu esathelayithi ngezindaba zokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Qapha izisebenzi zikwa-registry. Aba kanye nokuqinisekisa umsebenzi wemigqa. Ukukhula kwabantu. Hlola ukusebenza kwesibasebenzi. Faka isiyalo.

xh.title: Umphathi weNkonzo yokuBhalisa kwesiXhosa
xh.summary: Qondisa iinkonzo zesixhobo sokubhalisa nokuzinza nokuthothelwa kokulawulwa kwamarekhodi kwiSebe lezaManzi nokuhlanza eGqeberha.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso seSini/umGqobhozo 12 okanye iziqinisekiso ezifanelekileyo. Iminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kumihlanu (5) yamava kwimisebenzi yokubhalisa. Ulwazi ngomthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente, iNgqinisekiso zeZizathu zeZiko lezeMvela leRhulumente kunye noMthetho weeNkonvo zeZiko neeNkonvo zokuQhasha zaseMzantsi Afrika (NARSASA) ezinamagunya, nemiqathango efanelekileyo yolawulo lokuQhasha. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokungenisa idatha nokuqokelela izibalo zolawulo. Ukuvezwa kwelayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni engazange iphelelwe yisikhathi. Ukuxazula iingxaki nokuhlalutya.
xh.duties: Qondisa kube naye ukunikela iinkonzo kwisixhobo sokubhalisa. Khuthaza ukusetyenziswa kweenqavo nzezonqavo zolawulo lokuQhasha. Khuthaza ukutyholwa kokuthothelwa kweendawo zokubhalisa. Phendula abaxhasi. Yazi iifowuni nezinye imibuzo efikelweyo. Yamkela ubhalise imeyile/oovimba abalethiweyo ngesandla. UkuGcina nakushenxisa amaxwebhu Qondisa ukuphathwa kweendaba ezingenayo naphephayo. Qondisa nokwamkela yonke imeyile. Qondisa kwakhona ukuhlela, ukubhalisa nokuthumela imeyile. Saza izaziso ngeenkqubo zokubhalisa. Qondisa kube nokunikela inkonzo efanelekileyo yokulondoloza nokuQhasha amaxwebhu. Ukuvula nokuvakalisa oovimba ngokwesixhobo sokwahlula iirekhodi. Ukulondoloza/ukugcina, ukuphanda (ngekhompyutha/ngesandla) nokufumana kwakhona amaxwebhu noovimba. Qinisekisa ugqibo lweekhadi zoluhlulwazi kuzo zonke iifayile. Qondisa ukusebenza nokusebenzisa iimashini zofise kweloxa elithundathu lokubhalisa. Qondisa ukulungiselela nokuqamba amaxwebhu okugcina nakushenxisa. UkuSkena ngamandla eelekthroniki iifayile. Hlela upake iifayile zokugcina nokuSazisa. Qamba uluhlu lwamaxwebhu okugcina kwaye uze uwunikeze oMphathi. Gcina amarekhodi emaxwebhu agciniweyo. Lawula ulondoloze iplani yeefayile. Nika inkxaso yonke iiofisi ezingaphandle kwemiba yolawulo lokuQhasha. Qondisa abasebenzi bokuBhalisa. Yahlula uQinisekise umgangatho womsebenzi. Ukuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi. Hlengahlengisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Sebenzisa isohlwayo.

af.title: Registratuurklerk Toesighouer
af.summary: Superviseer registratuur-toonbankdienste en nakoming van rekordbestuur by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Gqeberha.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Grade 12-sertifikaat of relevante kwalifikasie. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ondervinding in registratuurfunksies. Kennis van die Public Service Act, Public Services National Archives Regulations en National Archive and Records Services Act of South Africa (NARSASA) Regulasies, en relevante rekordbestuursvoorskifte. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om data vas te lê en administratiewe statistieke te kolligeer. Vrywaring van 'n geldige onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Probleemoplossing en ontleding.
af.duties: Superviseer en verskaf registratuur-toonbankdienste. Fasiliteer die implementering van rekordbestuurbeleid en prosedures. Fasiliteer nakomingsinspeksies van registrature. Akkommodeer kliënte. Hanteer telefoon- en ander navrae wat ontvang word. Ontvang en registreer met die hand afgeleide pos/lêers. Argiveer en beskik van dokumente. Superviseer die hantering van inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Superviseer die onvangs en ontvang alle pos. Superviseer en sorteer, registreer en stuur pos uit. Versprei kennisgewens oor registratuuraangeleenthede. Superviseer en lewer 'n doeltreffende lêer- en rekordbestuursdiens. Oopmaak en toemaak van lêers volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Lêer/berging, opspoor (elektronies/ HANDMATIG) en terugwin van dokumente en lêers. Verseker en voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers. Superviseer die werking en bedryf kantoormasjiene in verband met die registratuurfunksie. Superviseer die verwerking en prosesseer dokumente vir argivering en beskikking. Elektroniese skandering van lêers. Sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Stel lys op van dokumente om geargiveer te word en dien by toesighouer in. Hou rekords vir geargiveerde dokumente. Administreer en onderhou lêerplan. Ondersteun alle satellietkantore oor rekordbestuursaangeleenthede. Superviseer registratuurpersoneel. Allokateer en verseker gehaltewerk. Personeelsontwikkeling. Evalueer personeelprestasie. Pas dissipline toe.

jobs.centre: Waterfalls (Buffelskloof) Ref No: 051026/15 Blyde Riviespoort Ref No: 051026/16 Witklip Dam Ref No: 051026/17
jobs.summary: Control water distribution and sluice operations at dams under the Department of Water and Sanitation, requiring an NQF level 4 qualification and five years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 4 qualification (Senior/Grade 12 certificate) in Mathematical literacy or a strong mathematical background is essential. Internal Department of Water and Sanitation with water control courses will serve as an added advantage. Five (5) years of practical experience in water control or related functions. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Good communication skills (both verbal and written) Interpersonal skills. Knowledge in controlling and managing the water distribution for all Government Water Schemes, State Dams, Irrigation Boards, Water Use Associations, Canals, and Rivers within the provincial management operations and clusters. Knowledge in water related policy implementation. Knowledge in financial management act and human resources. Knowledge and implementations in OHS Act. Monitoring and evaluation principles. Knowledge in supporting water utilisation and water resource strategy. Knowledge of drought and flood management. Understanding of government legislation. Knowledge in grievance and disciplinary procedures. Knowledge in monitoring and reporting water pollution and alien vegetation. Knowledge in basic civil, mechanical and electrical maintenance. Extensive travelling and performing duties away from the office for periods of time.
jobs.duties: Assist with the controlling of the opening and closing of sluices according to schedule. Keep records of all information as well as meter readings for purpose of correct billing. Plan and prioritize duties for subordinates. Control water distribution according to regulations daily. Perform minor maintenance on structures, dams, fences and sluices. Compile disposal report for the scheme. Produce flood warning list of all water users/clients and do flood control. Present progress report in respect of tasks. Collections and safe keeping of equipment and supply daily. Control time register and leave forms. Routine dam inspections of hydrological data including water meter readings. Assist with Health and Safety regulations on the scheme.

af.title: Waterbeheerbeampte
af.summary: Beheer waterverspreiding en sluisbedrywighede by damme onder die Department of Water and Sanitation, wat 'n NQF vlak 4-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se relevante ondervinding vereis.
af.requirements: n Relevante NQF vlak 4-kwalifikasie (Senior/Grade 12-sertifikaat) in Wiskundige geletterdheid of 'n sterk wiskundige agtergrond is noodsaaklik. Interne Department of Water and Sanitation met waterbeheerkursusse sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Vyf (5) jaar se praktiese ondervinding in waterbeheer of verwante funksies. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik) Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kennis oor die beheer en bestuur van waterverspreiding vir alle Regeringswaterskemas, Staatsdamme, Besproeiingsrade, Watergebruikverenigings, Kanale en Riviere binne die provinsiale bestuursbedrywighede en trosse. Kennis oor die implementering van waterverwante beleid. Kennis van die finansiële bestuurswet en menslike hulpbronne. Kennis en implementering van die OHS-wet. Monitering en evalueringsbeginsels. Kennis oor die ondersteuning van waterbenutting en waterhulpbronstrategie. Kennis van droogte- en vloedbestuur. Begrip van regeringswetgewing. Kennis van klagte- en dissiplinêre prosedures. Kennis oor die monitering en rapportering van waterbesoedeling en uitheemse plantegroei. Kennis van basiese siviele, meganiese en elektriese onderhoud. Uitgebreide reis en die uitvoer van pligte weg van die kantoor vir tydperke gelyk.
af.duties: Behulpzaam wees met die beheer van die oopmaak en toemaak van sluisies volgens rooster. Rekords van alle inligting sowel as meterlesings vir doeleindes van korrekte fakturering hou. Pligte vir ondergeskiktes beplan en prioritiseer. Waterverspreiding daagliks volgens regulasies beheer. Klein onderhoud aan strukture, damme, heinings en sluisies uitvoer. 'n Vrywingsverslag vir die skema opstel. 'n Vloedwaarskuwingslys van alle watergebruikers/kliente opstel en vloedbeheer doen. Vorderingsverslag ten opsigte van take voorlê. Versameling en veilige bewaring van toerusting en daaglikse voorraad. Tydregister en verlofvorms beheer. Roetine-daminspesies van hidrologiese data insluitend watermeterlesings. Behulpzaam wees met Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsregulasies op die skema.

xh.title: NoMtjhi weNtlawulo yaManzi
xh.summary: Lawula ulwabiwo lwamanzi kunye nemisebenzi ye-sluice kwii-dams ngaphantsi kwe Department of Water and Sanitation, kufuneka nifune Isidanga se-NQF level 4 kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava afanelekileyo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seziqu esifanelekileyo seNQF level 4 (Isatifiketi seSenior/Grade 12) kwiMathematical literacy okanye isiseko esomelezileyo sezibalo sibalulekile. Iindaba zangaphakathi kwiDepartment of Water and Sanitation ngeendaba zamaza ziza kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamavaqonobho ekulawuleni amaza okanye kumsebenzi ohlobene nalo. Ukutyhila ilayisenisi yomqhubi egqithisiweyo engazange iphela. Amakhono amabaliso entetho nakubhalwe (nokuthethwa nokubhalwa) kwaye nasekubhalweni. Amakhono obudlelwane nabantu. Ulwazi lokulawula nokulawula ulwabiwo lwamanzi kuwo onke amacebo kaRhulumente waManzi, iDams zeRhulumente, Iirhodi zoTyelo, amaQembu aSebenzisa uManzi, iiCanals, kunye neeRivers ngaphakathi koshishino lwe provinciale kunene nakwiindawo ezahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Nceda ekulawulweni kwokuvula nokuvala kweeslayisi ngokweshedyuli. Gcina amarekhod enkonzo yonke iinkcukacha kunye nemfundo yemitha ngenjongo yokubilisa ngokuchanekileyo. Cwangcisa kwaye ubekе iziqu kumsebenzi wabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Lawula ulwabiwo lwamanzi ngokwemigaqo yonke imihla. Yenza ulungiso oluncinci kwiindlwana, iindhama, iindonga kunye neeslayisi. Lungiselela iveza ngexesha imibiko eyahlulahlukeneyo yecandelo. Yenza uludwe lwesilumkiso seempompo zabasebenzisi bamaza / abaxhasi kwaye ulawule imo yokugquma amaza. Bonisa imbiko yenkqubela ngokomsebenzi. Qokeleza kwaye ugcine ngokhuseleko iimpahla kwaye uzinike imihla yonke. Lawula irejista yexesha namafomu ekholo. Ukukhangela iindhama njengesiqhelo kwedatha yehydrology kuquka imfundo yamaza. Nceda ngemigaqo yeMpilo noKhuseleko kwilesi candelo.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Wokulawula Amanzi
zu.summary: Lawula ukusatshalaliswa kwamanzi kanye nemisebenzi yamasluice emadamu ngaphansi kwe-Department of Water and Sanitation, kudinga izifundo ezingeni le-NQF level 4 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohluwo oluhlobene.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF level 4 (isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12) kwi-Mathematical literacy noma isizinda esinamandla semathematika sibaluleke kakhulu. Izifundo zangaphakathi ku-Department of Water and Sanitation mayelana nokulawula amanzi zizoba yinzuzo. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yohluwo olusebenzayo ekulawuleni amanzi noma emisebenzini ehlobene nalokho. Ukwazisa ukuthi unelayisense yokushayela ongayiphephile ongakavimi. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle (komlomo nakubhalwayo) kanye namakhono okusebenza nabantu. Ulwazi ekulawuleni nasekuphatheni ukusatshalaliswa kwamanzi kuzo zonke izimu zikahulumuntu zamanzi, amadamu kahulumuntu, amabhoji e-Irrigation, inhlangano zokusebenzisa amanzi, amakhaneli, kanye nemifula ngaphakathi kwezindlela zokuphathwa esifundeni kanye namakluster. Ulwazi ekusebenziseni inqubomgomo ephathelene namanzi. Ulwazi mayelana nomthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nabantu. Ulwazi kanye nokusebenzisa i-OHS Act. Imininingwane yokubuka kanye nokuhlola. Ulwazi ekuksizeni ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kanye nendlela yamathuluzi amanzi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezikhathi ezomile kanye nezikharava. Ukuqonda umthetho kahulumuntu. Ulwazi mayelana nenz yesikweletu kanye nendlela yokuholoza abantu. Ulwazi ekuholweni kanye nokubika ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kanye nezithombo ezikude namathambo. Ulwazi ngokolungiswa okuyisisekelo kwesakhiwo, kwamashini kanye nakagesi. Ukuhamba kakhulu kanye nokuqhuba imisebenzi kude nehhotela ngesikhashana.
zu.duties: Siza ekupheni nasekuvaleni amasluice ngokwesheduli. Gcina irekhodi yazo lonke ulwazi kanye nezahluko zemitha ngenjongo yokubiza ngendlela efanele. Hlela futhi ubalule imisebenzi yabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Lawula ukusatshalaliswa kwamanzi ngokomthetho nsuku zonke. Yenza ukulungiswa okuncane kwezakhiwo, amadamu, izingodo kanye namasluice. Hlela umbiko wokulahla ohlelweni. Khipha uhlu lwesexwayiso sezikhathi ezinkulu zabo bonke abasebenzisi/amakhasimende futhi wenze ukulawula izikhathi ezinkulu. Yethula umbiko wenqubo mayelana nemisebenzi. Ukuqoqa kanye nokugcina ngokuphepha izinto zokusebenza kanye nezinsiza nsuku zonke. Lawula irekhodi yesikhathi kanye namafomu edlela. Ukubhekwa kwamadamu njalo ukutholwa kwemininingwane yehydrological kuhlanganise izahluko zemitha zamanzi. Siza ngemithetho yezenempilo nokuphepha ohlelweni.

jobs.title: Artisan Production Grade a – C: (FITTER and Turner)
jobs.summary: Maintain and repair water control equipment and infrastructure at dams and distribution networks as an artisan fitter and turner in Worcester.
jobs.requirements: An Appropriate Fitter and Turner Trade Test Certificate. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s code EB driver’s license. Willingness to perform standby duties, production work, and overtime as and when required. Knowledge and experience in bulk water storage, conveyance, and pressure systems will be an advantage. Ability to work independently with limited supervision. Strong technical communication skills in English, coupled with good technical report-writing and computer literacy. The ability to read and interpret manufacturing drawings will be an advantage. af.summary: Onderhou en herstel waterbeheertoerusting en infrastruktuur by damme en verspreidingsnetwerke as 'n ambagtelike passer en draaier in Worcester.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Passer en Draaier Handelskoolsertifikaat. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurder se kode EB-bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om wagdienste, produksiewerk en oortyd uit te voer soos en wanneer benodig. Kennis en ervaring in grootmaat waterberging, vervoer en druksisteme sal 'n voordeel wees. Vermoë om onafhanklik met beperkte toesig te werk. Sterk tegniese Kommunikasievaardighede in Engels, tesame met goeie tegniese verslagskrywing en rekenaargeletterdheid. Die vermoë om vervaardigingsdrawings te lees en te interpreter sal 'n voordeel wees. Noodsaaklike Kennis en ervaring ten opsigte van voldoening aan die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid (OHS) in beide werkswinkel en werf-omgewings.
af.duties: Onderhou, herstel, installeer en versien waterbeheertoerusting en verwante infrastruktuur wat tipies op damme en waterverspreidingsnetwerke gevind word (bv. pompe, pype, kleppe, sluise, hulpaandrywings, hyskrane, watervate, en industriële konstruksie-aanleg/masjinerie). Voer roetine-inspeksies uit om sigbare, operasionele en veiligheidsgebreke te identifiseer; beplan nodige herstelwerk en rapporteer gebreke onmiddellik aan die Bestuurder. Verseker dat alle dienste betyds uitgevoer word en koördineer instandhouding en herstelwerk deur bestaande kontrakte. Vervaardig items op grond van eie beplanning en uit ontwerp/vervaardigingsdrawings. Funksioneer in streng ooreenstemming met alle toepaslike wetgewende, veiligheids- en regulatoriese vereistes. Rekord daaglikse ritte, brandstofverbruik en logboeke vir beide voertuie en masjinerie, asook dienslogboeke vir geïnstalleerde toerusting. Verseker dat toerusting en onmiddellike werkareas skoon en goed onderhou gehou word en goeie huishouding wanneer op werf. Bied bystand aan verskeie instandhoudingsteams met daaglikse instandhouding, herstelwerk en konstruksiewerk soos benodig. Bestuur, mentor en evalueer personeel se prestasie op 'n deurlopende basis. Wees bereid om na afgeleë gebiede te reis en gereeld tuis weg te oornag. Wees beskikbaar vir wag- en af en toe oortydwerk, insluitend naweke en openbare vakansiedae.

Ukubekezela ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuma baye baze baye baye kube yileyo yokukhiqiza, kanye nokusebenza ngokweqolo uma kudingeka. Ulwazi lwakho nemfundo yakho ekugcineni amanzi angenhla, ekuthumeleni, kanye namasistimu we-volume extension aqukethe okuhle kokuthi abe ukwazi ukuzihlanganisa kwabakhiqizi basekhatsini.

Ukuze kuhlolwe ukusetshenziswa kwekhasino elikhokhiswa, kulandelwe imiyalo yezinto ezingezwa emoyeni wamaphoyisa awo wonke amaphoyisa, ukuba banemvula yokuthi bathole imiyalo efanayo.

Hlukanisa, lungisa, faka, buyekeze futhi gzime ukusetshenziswa kolwandle kanye nalabo bumpophezeli basendleleni, nendlela yokuholela amanzi angenhla emadolophini uma bekutholakala i-theku ekugcineni amanzi.

Umbhalo mayelana nokubaluleka kokuba khona ngemvula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi eqinisekisa, alingani ngokuzihlanganisa, kodwa ngokuhlela kokuhlolwa kwemikhiqizo ehlezi, hhayi ngaphandle kokuthi zibe zisabekwa ekubeni ngokuthi emibonweni yesikhathi kungazange kubonakale, hhayi ngokwemisebenzi yansuku zonke, kodwa isilingekile ukuba singenwa imishini engatholakali ezindaweni zokugcina amanzi.

Zonke izinkomba zitholwe, ngokulandela imiyalo yezinsiza ezisebenzayo, futhi mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo etholakala kulesi sikhundla, hhayi ngaphandle kwesidingo sokubekwa emabhalweni wezindlu eziguquguqukayo eminye yemitikha engasetshenziswa njengesibonelo ekugcineni amanzi.

zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seSenior/Grade 12 noma izifundo ezihambisanayo. Ukwazi ngemisebenzi, izindlela kanye nethonya ekuqotheni ukwaziswa, ukusebenzisa amakhompyutha kanye nohlu lwabalulekile bokuphathwa kwezomlando. Ukwazi okuyisisekelo kanye neziqondiso mayelana neNqubo zokusebenza kweZinsizakalo muntu. Ukwazi ngamashishini okusebenza izimali (PERSAL). Ukulondoloza amaqiniso, izindlela kanye nethonya ekuqotheni ukwaziswa, futhi usebenzise ikhompyutha. Ukwazi kanye neziqondiso ngokuhleleka komthetho okuphatha izinsizakabo muntu. Ukulondoloza izindlela zokubeka futhi ubuyisele ngokwemisebenzi. Ukuqonda umsebenzi osendlaleleni. Ukulondoloza izindlela zokusebenza ngokwesimo sezimo esiguquguqukayo.
zu.duties: Inikeza izinsiza zedeski: Phatha abathakatheli. Phathisa imibuzo yefoni neminye emikhulu evakiwe. Yamukela ubhalise imeyili/ amafayela alethwe ngesandla. Phatha inkulumo ephuma noma engena: Yamukela yonke imeyili. Hlela, bhalisa, thumela imeyili. Sazisa ngemiba yerekhoda Nikeza insiza eguquguqukayo yokulondolozwa kanye nokuphathwa kwerekhoda: Ukuvula nokuvala amafayela ngokwesistimu yokuhlelwa kwerekhoda. Ukugcwalisa/ ukulondoloza, ukulandela (ngemithombo/y ngesandla) kanye nokubuyiswa kwamadokhumenti namafayela. Qedela amakhadi okubonisa wonke amafayela. Ukusetshenziswa kokwaziswa okuncane okudingekayo kuyo yonke imibhalo yezinsizakalo muntu. Qinisekisa ukuthi kulandelwa izinqumo zokuphathwa kolwazi nokuphepha kanye nokusiza ekufinyeleleni olwazini. Qinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zokuphathwa kweNational Minimum Information Requirements zilandelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zokuhlelwa kwerekhoda zilandelwa.Nikeza usizo ekubumbanisweni kwamafayela omuntu. Ukugcina ngokuphepha amafayela abantu. Ukulondoloza iplani yamafayela abasebenzi. Yenza izivivinyo zemiyalezomposi ukuze qinisekisa ukuthi akukho myalezomposi oyikhendi ohlanganisiwe. Khiya imiyalezomposi esikhwameni sabathunywa ukuba uyithume ePosini. Thumela imali ethunyiwe kabi emumathumeli ngeposi ebhalisiwe futhi ubhale inombolo yokubhalisa kurekhoda. Gcina irekhoda lansuku zonke lenani lamagundane afakiwe. Ukugcina iifayile zabantu ngokhuseleko. Ukulondoloza icebo lefayile esimiyo. Yenza iintlobo zohlolo kumposi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba akukho posimntu ingangeniyo. Knowledge of the Skills Development Act and related prescripts. Knowledge of Public Service Regulations and relevant HR prescripts. Knowledge of Record management and administrative skills. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Knowledge of PERSAL system. Knowledge of registry duties and practices. Planning and organising skills. People and Diversity Management skills. Be client oriented and customer focused. Good verbal and written communication skills. Accountability and Ethical Conduct. Flexibility and teamwork. Basic knowledge of problem solving and analysis.
jobs.duties: Training: Provides administrative and clerical support to ensure the effective implementation of training, skills development, bursaries, internships, and employee development programmes within the department. Assist with the coordination and administration of training and development programmes. Capture and maintain employee training records and databases. Process training nominations and registration forms. Compile training reports. Assist in the compilation and implementation of the Workplace Skills Plan (WSP) and Annual Training Report (ATR). Collect training needs analysis information from managers and employees. Maintain records of skills development interventions and outcomes. Support compliance with Skills Development legislation and departmental policies. Administer bursary and study assistance applications. Maintain records of approved bursaries and other training interventions. Follow up on academic results and contractual obligations of bursary recipients. Assist with the administration of internship, learnership and graduate placement programmes. Coordinate induction and orientation programmes for interns and learners. Maintain accurate HRD files and employee development records. Ensure safekeeping of confidential employee information. File correspondence, training certificates and related documentation. Retrieve records and information when required for audits and reporting purposes. PMDS Administration: Administer the PMDS process for all applicable employees. Distribute PMDS templates, guidelines, and relevant circulars to employees. Receive, register, and verify performance agreements and performance assessments. Follow up on outstanding PMDS documents with supervisors and employees, inclusive of correct completion of the PMDS documents within the prescribed timeframes. zu.title: Human Resource Clerk Production (HRD)
zu.summary: Nikeza inkxaso yengqungquthelo noma amaphepha ashicilelwe kanye nenkxaso yolawulo mayelana nokuzijwayeza, intuthuko yamakhono, izibursari, kanye namaphrogremu entuthuko yabasebenzi ku-Department of Water and Sanitation.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma okulinganayo. Ulwazi nge-HRD kanye namapholisi nemithelela ye-Performance Management Development System (PMDS). Ulwazi nge-Skills Development Act kanye nemiyalo ehlobene. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulations nangemiyalo ye-HR ehlobene. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwamarekhodi namakhono olawulo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Ulwazi ngesistimu ye-PERSAL. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yesi-registry ngezinqubo zayo. Amakhono okucubungula futhi uhlele. Amakhono okuphatha abantu nokubambisana ngobuhloboness. Ukuba nomzwelo wabathengi futhi uqaphele izidingo zabathengi. Amakhono anhle okuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala. Ukuhleleka nokuziphatha ngenhlalo yokwethembeka. Ukuguquguquka nokusebenza njengaqembu. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana nokuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya ulwazi.
zu.duties: Ukuzijwayeza: Nikeza inkxaso yengqungquthelo noma amaphepha ashicilelwe kanye nenkxaso yolawulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kokuzijwayeza, intuthuko yamakhono, izibursari, iziqu zomtholampilo, kanye namaphrogremu entuthuko yabasebenzi ngaphakathi komnyango. Siza ekubumbiseni nasekulawuleni amaphrogremu okuzijwayeza nentuthuko. Faka ugqozi futhi ulondoloze irekhodi yokuzijwayeza yabasebenzi namadethabhesi. Lele izinketho zokuzijwayeza namafomu obunikelo. Hlanganisa imibiko yokuzijwayeza. Siza ekuhlanganiseni nasekuqambeni iNgesikhathi Sezihlela Zamakholo Esebenzayo (WSP) kanye neMibiko Yokuqeqesha Ngonyaka (ATR). Qoqa ulwazi lokuhlola izidingo zokuzijwayeza kubaphathi nasekubasebenzini. Londoloza amarekhodi okungenelela kwentuthuko yamakhono kanye nemiphumela yawo. Sekela ukulandelwa kwezinqumo zomthetho wentuthuko yamakhono kanye namapholisi omnyango. Phatha izicelo ze-bursary kanye nenkxaso yokufunda. Londoloza amarekhodo ezibursari ezamukelekile kanye kwezinye izidingo zokuzijwayeza. Landelela imiphumela yezifundo kanye nezigameko ezibophezela abamukele be-bursary. Siza ekuphathweni kwamaphrogremu wobunikelo, i-learnership kanye nokubekwa kwabaphumelele. Bambisa amaphrogremu okungenisa nokuqondisa kubantu abasha kanye nabafundi. Londoloza amafayela e-HRD afanele kanye namarekhodi entuthuko yabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okuphephile kolwazi lwabasebenzi olumfihlo. Faka ushicilelo, izitifikedi zokuzijwayeza namadokhumenti ahlobene. Khupha amarekhodi nolwazi lapho kudingeka khona ngenjongo yokuhlola nokubika. Ukulawula kwe-PMDS: Phatha inqubo ye-PMDS yabo bonke abasebenzi abafanelekayo. Sula amathempleyithi we-PMDS, imihlahlahlela, kanye nezikhape ezihlobene kubasebenzi. Yamukela, bhalisa futhi uqinisekise izivumelwano zokusebenza kanye nekuhlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Landelela amadokhumenti we-PMDS asashiyiwe nabaphathi nasekubasebenzini, okuhlanganisa nokuqedwa okuhle kwamadokhumenti we-PMDS ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esinconyiwe. Londoloza futhi uvuse amarekhodi we-PMDS namadethabhesi. Misela futhi ulondoloze amafayela we-PMDS umuntu ngamunye abasebenzini. Khupha amafayela namadokhumenti lapho kudingeka khona ngenjongo yokuqinisekisa, ukuhlola, noma ukubika. Faka izivumelwano zokusebenza, i-Mid-Term kanye ne-Assessments zonyaka kwi-Persal System.

Routine inspections of visible, operational and safety defects and reporting of defects to Supervisor, Transport Officer and Mechanic. Repair minor mechanical faults on vehicles and machinery and report major defects for repairs. Ensure servicing is carried out timeously. Function in accordance with applicable legislative and safety requirements. Record daily trips, fuel consumption and logbooks for both vehicles and machinery. Ensure that equipment and parking space are clean. Ensure safe storage of vehicle on route. Ensure safety of cargo while on route. On completion of journey ensure safe storage of vehicle at base. Assists maintenance team with removal and installation of equipment with truck mounted and overhead crane and forklift. Assists maintenance teams with their tasks when not operating the truck. xh.summary: Lungisa kwaye ucoce indawo, iindonga kunye neenkcuba ezahlukeneyo ze-Berg River kunye ne-Tunnel System ngeentsumba zesandla kunye nemisebenzi yegadi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethde se-ABET. Isipho sokuba nolunxaxheba lokusebenza seZero (0) ukuya kumnye (1) umnyaka. Ulunxaxheba kumsebenzi wokuqhuba umsebenzi wesandla kuya kuba luncedo. Isaziso sexesha elisebenzayo elingenamva ngomvuzo othengwayo ochaza uhlobo B Drivers licence. Kufuneka kube khona ulwazi ngalondolozo lulandelayo: Ulwazi ngokusebenza ngomsebenzi jikelele kunye nokuphatha iixela ezahlukeneyo kunye namadivaysi. Ulwazi malunga nokusika izityalo nokubumba iindonga ezifana nexesha elalungelelaniselwe ukulungiselela ulwazi malunga noqeqesho lokulungiselela inkqubo yokusika izityalo (inkqubo yokusika izityalo). Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa iixela ezahlukeneyo (ukucima/ukudibanisa) kunye nolwazi malunga namaxwebhu e-chemicals. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zolondolozo zemihla ngemihla ukukhusela iimeko ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza. Ulwazi ngolwazi ngokusika izityalo ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo ezifana nendlela yokuqhuba imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla. Ulwazi malunga nendlela yokuphatha ulwazi. Ulwazi malunga neenkqubo zokubeka ubomi kwengxaki. Ulwazi malunga noqeqesho lokusika izityalo nokutya izityalo ezahlukeneyo. Ukuqonda okusesikweni malunga nomthetho weNyuso. Ulwazi malunga neendlela ezahlukeneyo zokukhusela ulwazi kunye nolwazi malunga noqeqesho lokusika izityalo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi malunga neendlela ezahlukeneyo zokusebenzisa amanzi kunye neendlela ezahlukeneyo zokusebenzisa amanzi. Ulwazi malunga nolwazi lwemisebenzi yomso. Ulwazi malunga nolwazi malunga nesixhobo sokusika izityalo ezahlukeneyo kunye nolwazi malunga nokusetyenziswa kwezityalo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi malunga namaxwebhu aqinisekisiweyo ngendlela yokulawula ulwazi. Ulwazi malunga noqeqesho lokuphatha ulwazi nolwazi malunga noqeqesho lokuphatha iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokusebenzisa iixela ezahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Cococa kunye nokuqingcwa kwezinto kunye nokulungisa iithulusi neesakhiwo njengezindlu, iindonga ngeentsumba zesandla. Sika izityalo kwaye usebenzise i-herbicide. Ukucoxa kwamaxongo ombane kunye nama-Grids nenkqubo yomjelo. Sika iinduni nengca kwinqanaba lengcindebe kwiindonga zasendlelwini. Qhaqha amakhwenkwezi nesanti kwiibhrizi, kumanzi aluhlobo lwamajelo kunye neesluisi. Qhaqha izityalo nesanti ezibambe kumanzi avela kumanzi aluhlobo lwesixhobo esithintela ukubamba kwamanzi. Susa inkunkuma kwindawo yokungena nasekuphumeni. Qinisekisa kulungiswe iindonga. Qhaqha amajelo omjelo oqhamzayo. Gcwalisa uze uncinge amakhobba endlela yokungena. Gcwalisa uze uncinge amakhobba kwindlela yokungena nasekubekeni izinto. Susa inkunkuma engaphakathi komjelo. Coca izixhobo. Xela ngamashishini aqhekekileyo nezixhobo. Kulindeleke ukuba usebenze kwi-Jonkershoek nase-Palmiet kodwa ulungele ukusebenza kwindawo ezahlukileyo ngaphakathi kwesithili se-Western Cape.

zu.title: Umuhluzi
zu.summary: I-Department of Water and Sanitation ifuna umhluzi e-Gqeberha ukunikeza imisebenzi eyisisekelo yokuhlanza futhi alondoloze iziqobangulo zokuhlanza, okudinga isitifiketi se-ABET.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-ABET. Isipiliyoni emisebenzini yokuhlanza sizothinga njengento ezelulekayo. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemigomophakade yokuhlanza. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngokusetshenziswa kwamakhemikhali (ukuncibilika/ukuhlanganisa). Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngokuqobangula okuhlanzwa okuzosetshenziswa. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemfuneko yezokuphepha nempilo. Ulwazi nokuqamba izinkambiso zoguqulelwano. Ukuqonda ukusetshenziswa kolimi kwezimiso zokuqiniseka. Ukuqonda ukusetshenziswa noma ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali ngendlela efanele. Ukuxhumana kahle futhi kube nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu.
zu.duties: Ukunikela ngemisebenzi eyisisekelo yokuhlanza. Ukugcina futhi ukulondoloza iziqobangulo zokuhlanza nokuphatha isitoko sezinto zokuhlanza. Ukuhlanza amahhovisi, amagumbi ohamba kuso, amalifti namagumbi okuhlangana ngokusula izinkundla, ukuhwabuza, ukuhlikihla, ukusula ngomshini wokuhamba kuso konke nokushampunisa izinkundla. Ukuhlanza amadonga, amafasitela naminyondo. Ukuphuza futhi ukuhlanza izinkwazi zokuphoswa. Ukuthatha futhi ukususa inkunkuma yamahhovisi. Ukuvuselela amahhovisi, amagumbi okuhlangana, izindawo zokusebenza, igumbi lokupheka namagumbi esitoreji. Ukuhlanza amagumbi okuhlambela, ukugcwalisa usawoti wokuwasha izandla, ukushintsha amaphedi ephepha, amaphepha wesihambi namakhasi endlu yokuhamba bese kuhlanza futhi kupalwa izinkwazi zokuphoswa ezingcolile. Ukwethula iziqobangulo ephukile nezinto zokusebenza. Ukuhlanza izinto zokusebenza (amamayikroweyivhu, iziholedi zangomoya ezihamba ngaphakathi nezinto zokusebenza emva kokusetshenziswa. Ukucela izinto zokuhlanza. Ukusiza emisebenzini ehlukeneyo njalo nathini kudingeka.

xh.title: Umcoci
xh.summary: Isebe le-Water and Sanitation lifuna umcocI kwi-Gqeberha ukunikezela iinkonzo ezisisiseko zokucoca nokulondoloza iimpahla zokucoca, kwaye kufuneka isatifikethi se-ABET.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-ABET. Amava kukunikezela iinkonzo zokucoca kuya kuba ngomonuso. Ukwazi okusesiseko ngemigaqo yokucoca. Ukwazi okusesiseko ngokusetyenziswa kwamachiza (ukuchitha/ukudibanisa). Ukwazi okusesiseko ngeempahla ezisetyenziswa ukucoca. Ukwazi okusesiseko ngeemfuno zempilo yokhuseleko. Ukwazi ngegcinelo elisisiseko lemibhalo. Ukuqonda okusesiseko ngokusetyenziswa kwemiqathango yokhuseleko. Ukuqonda okusesiseko ngokusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwamachiza. Unxibelelwano olulungileyo nothetho nofudumalo phakathi kwabantu.
xh.duties: Ukunikezela iinkonzo ezisisiseko zokucoca. Ukuze ugcinwe kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo zokucoca ukuze kwenziwe ulawulo lwemveliso zokucoca. Ukucoca amagumbi emisebenzi, iindonga ezinxulumene nalo, iilifti negumbi lebhalo ngokususa uthuli nokuwaxhawula amaphasi, ukuswipha, ukurhabula noku vacuum iiphasi nakusuke kwenziwa ukushampo iiphasi. Ukucoca iindonga, iifestile namnyango. Ukuqhuba kwaye kucocwe iibhokisi zemfucuza. Ukuthatha kwaye kususwe imfucuza egumbini lokusebenza. Ukubuyisa ivumba elihle kwamagumbi emisebenzi, amagumbi okubhala, iindawo zokusebenza, igumbi lokupheka namagumbi egcinelo. Ukucoca iindawo zokuhlambela, ukuzalisa ngesepu esisityiwa ngesandla, ukutshintsha amaphepha okusula izandla, iphepha lokutyusa kwaye kuqhutywe kwaye kucocwe iibhokisi zemfucuza ezisesicholweni. Ukubika iinkqubo ezisaphukileyo nempahla. Ukucoca iinkqubo (iimicrowave, iinkqubo zokucoca ngokuyinqamla) kwaye empahla emva kokuba kusetyenziswa. Ukucela iinkqubo zokucoca. Ukuncedisa neminye imisebenzi xa kufuneka.

xh.title: Isekelwa-Mongameli: Iqela lemimoya yokudala
xh.summary: Indima yesekeza-mongameli kwingingqi yeGauteng elawula iinkqubo zophuhliso lwemizobo, ulwalamano lwabanomdla nokwabelana ngemithombo engaphakathi kweqela lemimoya yokudala.
xh.requirements: Makabe nephepha lesitshixo leGrade 12 kunye neDiploma yesiZwe / I-degree (Inqanaba le-NQF 6/7) kwimbali yemizobo / Imfundo / Uyilo lwezobizo / Unxibelelwano / Uphuhliso loluntu okanye izidanga ezifanelekileyo. Kufuneka abe nomva weminyaka engama- 3 ukuya kwi-5 yamava kwinqanaba lolawulo laphakathi (ASD) ngaphakathi kwendawo yeqela lemimoya yokudala. Ifayini yelayiseni yomqhubi. Amandla: Ukucazulula & ukuhlola ulwazi. Unxibelelwano ngeenkcukacha nangokubhalwayo. Ukumisela / ukugcina ulwazi. Ukunxibelelana ulwazi. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukusombulula iingxaki nolawulo lwezingxaki. Ulwazi: Iindlela nemigaqo yesebe. Iindaba ezibaluleleyo zesebe. Isicwangciso seGauteng DSCAR. Iindlela zokubika. Inkqubo yolwazi. Inkqubo yemali. I-PFMA, Imigaqo yeTreasury, I-PSA, I-PSR, njl. Umthetho woLinganyiso lwaBasebenzi, 1998. Ukuqonda iinkqubo namaphrojekthi karhulumente. Ukulawula ngokwezicwangciso.
xh.duties: Qamba uyilo iinkqubo zophuhliso lwemizobo ezihambelana nenjongo yamasiko esiPhondo. Linganisa ulwalamano lwabanomdla ukuze bachaze kunye noyilo lwemodeli zeenkqubo ezithintela kwaye zibandakanya bonke. Lawula ukusebenza kweenkqubo ezivunyiweyo, ukuqinisekisa ukuba zifikelela ngexesha nokwabelana kwemithombo. Pela imigaqo yeenkqubo, iinkqubo zokusebenza, kwaye ulawule iindawo zokulawula. Lawula ubudlelwane nezenzo zokuqeqesha, abalulezi kunye neentlangano zelizwe. Hlola iziphumo seenkqubo uze usebenzise iintonlezolo ngokusekelwe kwimfundo efunyenweyo. Phawula iindawo ezingenalo amandla ngaphakathi kwelizwe lemizobo ngokusebenzisa iintlobo zokuqonda iimfuno nolwalamano lwabanomdla. Pela iinkqubo zonyaka zokwakhiswa kwamandla eziphatha ukuqeqeshwa, ukwakhiswa kwabalulezi, nokuphuhliso lweshishini. Linganisa ukusebenza kwezikhundla zokuyalelwa, iinkqubo zokudibana, iklasi zezigqithisi, kunye neenkonzo zophuhliso lweshishini. Qinisekisa ukuhambelana kweenkqubo zokwakhiswa kwamandla nezicwangciso zophuhliso lwelizwe. Qwalasela amabala eezenzo, okuthengwayo, nokuthobela iimfuno zolawulo. Yenza iingxelo emva kwezenzo ezikhombisa ukuthatha inxaxheba, ukufikelela kwingaço loqoqosho, nimfundo efunyenweyo.

A minimum of 3 - 5 years of experience in high- performance environment. Valid driver’s license. No criminal records. Skills & Knowledge: Financial and administrative skills. Problem solving and analysis. Listening and negotiation. Tact and diplomacy. Teamwork. Discipline. Programme and Project Management. Ability to chair/manage meetings. Counselling. Communicating information. Departmental policies and procedures. Department Priorities. Gauteng. DSACR Strategy. Reporting procedures. Information system. PFMA, Treasury. Facilitate and establish a clear competition pathway for athletes and coaches by fostering partnerships with key stakeholders. Developing, reviewing, and ensuring compliance with sports policies, legislative requirements, and the grant frameworks, along with providing monthly and quarterly performance reports. Facilitate, identifying and managing resources, such as funding, training expertise, and scientific support, to be distributed to provincial and regional academies. Monitor and create opportunities to identify and develop talented athletes from the communities to the elite national level through structured academies. Facilitate the availability of necessary facilities for academy activities. Facilitate and monitor the design and implementation of high-performance programmes that support the development of both provincial and national athletes within the province. Monitor in sourcing training and development programmes, such as bursaries, internships, and incubator programmes for athletes and coaches. Creating and implementing talent identification programs, managing the scouting process, and managing the athlete database to support elite development. Identify skill and performance gaps. Establish clear goals, and create a formal program with resources like training, mentorship, and coaching. Regularly measure progress, provide ongoing feedback, and foster a culture that supports career development through initiatives like cross-functional projects and empowering employees, athletes and coaches to create their own development plans. Coordinating team preparation for competitions, managing elite academy fixtures, and managing sporting partnerships with federations, municipal bodies, and other stakeholders. Implement and monitor sports science testing protocols and data analysis throughout the District Academies. Monitor and manage the utilisation of financial and physical resources. Developing and implementing the operational plans and the APP of the sub- directorate. Compile the reports that must be submitted. Render administration activities within the unit.

jobs.title: Security Officer
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts, Culture and Recreation
jobs.summary: Perform access control and security functions at the Head Office in Gauteng, requiring PSIRA Grade C certification.
jobs.requirements: The successful candidate should have a Security Grade C or above and PSIRA certificate. No previous experience is required. Knowledge of control and access to public premises Act 53 of 1985. Knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act of 85 of 1993. Knowledge of MISS, & PSIRA Act 56 of 2001). Knowledge of emergency procedures in the workplace.
jobs.duties: Perform access control functions which will include the following: determine whether visitors have appointments/ or the service that the visitor requires. Contact the relevant employee to confirm the appointment or refer the visitor to the relevant service delivery point. Complete or ensure that the admission control documents/cards as required. Escort visitors to relevant employee/venues where required. Operate X-ray machines where applicable. Lock and unlock entrances. Identify suspicious conduct. Identify suspicious conduct. Ensure that unauthorized people and dangerous objects do not enter the building/premises. Follow-up incidents. Ensure safety in the building and the premises. This will include following; undertake building/premises patrols identify and check; that doors are locked or unlocked as required; water leaks and that taps are closed; fire hazards, exposed electrical contact and other fire hazards emanating from for instance chemicals; lights, switch on and off as required; and suspicious objects and packages. Apply emergency procedures (in situations like bomb scares, riots etc.) and alert emergency services and department security management. Ensure that all assets do not leave or enter the building or premises unauthorized. This will include the following tasks: ensure that all assets which leave the premises are accompanied bypass-out; inspect vehicles entering and leaving the premises; gather information and report on missing and stolen equipment and stores; handle documents at points of entry according to classification and the prescripts. Ensure all incidents are recorded in the occurrence books/registers.

Broad knowledge and understanding of the functional areas covered by the executive authority’s portfolio. Proven management competencies. Working knowledge of the political and parliamentary processes in South Africa. Computer literacy.

Work with project and program managers on compliance, templates and best practices and implements and maintains the necessary controls and procedures to cost effectively protect information systems assets from intentional or inadvertent modification, disclosure, or destruction. Provide protocols services to the Executive Authority (EA). Supervise employees.

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum All-inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules, Plus Commuted Overtime which is subject to the needs of the department. Incumbents will have to sign the commuted overtime contract form annually.
jobs.summary: Medical Officer (Grade 1-3) at Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, KwaZulu-Natal, providing internal medicine services as part of a tertiary healthcare team.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Experience: Not Applicable. Foreign qualified candidates require 1year relevant experience after registration as a Medical Practitioner with a recognized Foreign Health Professional Council, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: Experience: 5 years appropriate experience as a Medical Officer after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Foreign candidates require 6 years relevant experience after registration with a recognized Foreign Health Professional Council, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: Experience: 10 years experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Foreign qualified candidates require 11 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign health professional council in respect of foreign qualified employees of whom it is not required performing community service as required in South Africa. Senior Certificate Grade 12 or equivalent Plus MBCHB Degree or Equivalent qualification, Plus Current Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Medical Practitioner in independent practice The Employment Equity Target for this post is: African Male, African Female Additional Qualification/ Information Required Prior clinical care experience in Internal Medicine will be considered as an advantage at short-listing. Internal Medicine specific certification / examinations through the CMSA including the Diploma in Internal medicine and FCP Part 1 will be an added advantage at short-listing. Knowledge, Skills and Experience: Sound clinical and patient management skills; human resource management; information management; quality assurance programs Current health and public service legislation, regulations and policy, and medical ethics.
jobs.duties: Clinical skills appropriate to the delivery of Internal Medicine services in the context of Grey’s Hospital, as a tertiary health care facility and referral centre. Perform duties as part of an extended health care team providing 24 hour per day health care services. Note: Performance of Group 3 Overtime (13 – 20 hours per week) is mandatory but may be subject to change depending on operational demands Performance of duties in Area 2, as determined by the Chief Specialist in Internal Medicine and may include rotations between hospitals in the Pietermaritzburg metropole and outreach service to hospitals in Area 2 Performance of tasks supporting clinical care, as allocated by the management team; Participation in quality improvement programmes is required. Contribute to the development of the service by willingness to learn and teach, including undergraduate and intern teaching and participation in academic activities of the department, including research. Participate in quality assessment initiatives and audits Provide supervision and support to staff involved in health care services and facilitate the provision of health services.

jobs.salary_text: R720 821 - R821 454 per annum, plus Rural Allowance (provided the post meets the requirements), plus 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (optional). Housing / Home Owners allowance (Employee must meet prescribed conditions)
jobs.summary: Manage and supervise comprehensive primary healthcare service delivery and nursing operations at St Margaret's CHC in KwaZulu-Natal.
jobs.requirements: The Above Post: Grade 1: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) standard 10/or (Vocational National Certificate, Registration with SANC as general Nurse (Current South African Nursing Council receipt-license to practice 2026) Basic R425 qualification (i.e., Degree/ Diploma in Nursing qualification that allows registration with South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. Registration with SANC General Nurse (Current South African Nursing Council receipt –licence to practice 2026. A Post basic qualification in Primary Health Care, Clinical Nursing science, Health assessment, Treatment and Cure with duration of at least one year, accredited with the South African Nursing Council PHC.A minimum of 9 years appropriate experience in Nursing after registration as a professional Nurse and Midwifery with the SANC in General Nursing, of which 5 years must be recognisable experience after obtaining 1 year post basic qualification in primary Health care. Experience in TB/HIV/AIDS management, HIV/AIDS Certificate, Diploma. Driver’s License, Computer Certificate and NIMART Training. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Thorough knowledge and insight of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statuses and other relevant legal framework such as: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Operational management skills. Ability to interact with diverse stakeholders, health care users and givers. Good communication skills, Report writing skills, Facilitation skills, Co-ordination skills, Liaison skills, Networking, Problem solving, Information management and Planning and Organizing skills, Computer skills. Leadership, decision making, supervisory and problem-solving skills. Coaching, conflict handling and counselling skills. Financial and Budgetary knowledge and skills pertaining to the relevant resources under management. Disciplinary code procedure, Grievance procedure and financial policies and practices.
jobs.duties: Responsible for overall supervision of an integrated quality and comprehensive primary health care services delivery to the community. Improve outcomes of by focusing on health prevention, Health promotion, curative and rehabilitative approach through implementation of policies, guidelines and SOPs. Ensure PITC and adherence counselling is being provided to clients in the facility. Promote advocacy, disclosure and adherence to treatment and care thus, ensuring that facilities comply with the Batho Pele Principles. Ensure provision of Primary prevention and strategies and integrated screening of TB, HIV, COVID 19, NCDs STIs and Mental Health. Ensure availability of medication, essential equipment and supplies a well as proper utilization thereof. Participate in the realization and maintenance of ideal clinic program, (ICRM) to comply with norms and standards of the health establishment according to OHSC. Ensure data Management is implemented and monitored. Ensure communication and collaboration with other stakeholders is improved through the support of OSS interventions. Maintain interpectoral collaborations with other government structures. Participate in monitoring of hr performance through EPMDS.

jobs.summary: Deputy Director role managing operational risk and security awareness programmes at the Limpopo Department of Public Works Head Office in Polokwane.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/Matric and a qualification at NQF level 6 in Security Management /Security Risk Management/Policing as recognised by SAQA. Security Grade A/B (PSIRA). 05 years’ experience in Security Management environment of which three (03) years MUST be at Junior Management / Assistant Director level. State Security Agency (SSA) will be an added advantage. Valid firearm competencies. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of relevant Public Service Acts, regulations and frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of policy analysis, development and interpretation. Physical security risk control measures. Security principles and practices. MPSS. MISS. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer skills. People management. Conflict management.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of operational risk and security awareness programmes: Develop operational risk and security awareness programmes. Implement security awareness plans. Monitor the provision of workshops on security awareness. Evaluate the security status within the department. Liaise with other departments on security issues. Propose control measures to minimise or eliminate the security risks. Monitor and evaluate the implementation of Security Policies and Procedures as well as the Security Measures e.g. MISS, MPSS, etc: Develop security procedures. Develop policy for security measures. Develop a contingency plan. Develop, manage and monitor the implementation of security plans and programmes. Advice and attend to security breaches. Propose control measures to minimise or eliminate the security risks. Manage the provision security administrative services. Provide tender bulletin for security advertisement. Maintain the contract(s) for outsourced security. Monitor performance of private security services as per service level agreement. Monitor in – house security guards. Provide specifications for purchasing of security equipment’s (Guard Monitoring systems, EACS etc.). Investigate security related cases. Manage physical security appraisals and information security audits by: Verify company documents at PSIRA, Vetting of service providers at SSA. Manage key control. Provide resource (Human, Financial and Equipment): Manage the component’s budget against its strategic objectives. Coordinate budget monitoring, projecting & reporting expenditure. Ensure that spending is maximized in line with strategic objective. Monitor and report on the utilisation of equipment’s. Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of employees. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Manage discipline. Provide job description to subordinates. Manage division leave matters.

zu.title: Onozane Omncane: Ukulawula Ukuphepha
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaOnozane Omncane ekuphatheni ingozi yemisebenzi nemisebenzi yokwazisa ngokuphepha eLimpopo Department of Public Works Head Office ePolokwane.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/Matric nengqikithi ezingeni le-NQF level 6 kwi-Security Management/Security Risk Management/Policing njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. I-Security Grade A/B (PSIRA). Uzuvo lweminyaka engu-05 kwimvelo yokuphathwa kokuphepha lapho kuyiminyaka emithathu (03) kumele kube ngazingeni lokuqondisa abancane/kaMsizi kaOnozane. I-State Security Agency (SSA) izoba yinzuzo eyedwa. Amakhono aphelele okusebenzisa isikhali somilo. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela, ngaphandle kokuba abafakeli baphila nokuqhwaya. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho yomphakathi ehlobene, imithetho nemigomo. Ulwazi nokuqonda kohlaziyo, ukuthuthukiswa nokutolikwa kwemigogo. Izindlela zokulawula ingozi yokuphepha komzimba. Imigogo nemicimbi yokuphepha. I-MPSS. I-MISS. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuholwa iqembu. Ukudalwa kwezinto. Ukugcinwa kwezimali. Ukugxila kubathengi nokuphendula. Ukuxhumana. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Ukuphathwa kwezimpixano.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kengozi yemisebenzi nemisebenzi yokwazisa ngokuphepha: Tuthukisa imisebenzi yengozi yemisebenzi nokwazisa ngokuphepha. Faka phansi izinhlela zokwazisa ngokuphepha. Qaphela ukunikezwa kwezinhlela zokufundisa ngokwazisa ngokuphepha. Hlola isimo sokuphepha ngaphakathi kumnyango. Xhumana namanye iminyango ngemibuzo yokuphepha. Phakamisa izindlela zokulawula ukunciphisa noma ukususa izingozi zokuphepha. Qaphela futhi uhlolo ukusetshenziswa kwemigogo nemicimbi yokuphepha kanye nezindlela zokuphepha njengakwi-MISS, MPSS, njll: Tuthukisa imicimbi yokuphepha. Tuthukisa umgomo wozindlela zokuphepha. Tuthukisa ihlela lokulawula lapha kunesimo esibucayi. Tuthukisa, phatha futhi qaphela ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlela nokuhlela ukuphepha. Nikeza izeluleko futhi uphendule ekuphukeleni ukuphepha. Phakamisa izindlela zokulawula ukunciphisa noma ukususa izingozi zokuphepha. Phatha ukunikezwa kwayo imisebenzi yobalulelo bokuphepha. Nikeza izindaba zemithengiso yezinkundla zokuphepha. Gcina izivumelwano zokuphepha okuqashiwe ngaphandle. Qaphela ukusebenza kwezinkonzo zokuphepha eziyimfihlo njengokuvumelaniswa nesevisi. Qaphela abavaleli bokuqasha abangaphakathi. Nikeza izinkomba zokuthenga izinto zokuphepha (Izimisozo zokuqaphela abavali, i-EACS, njll.). Phenya izindaba ezihlobene nokuphepha. Phatha izahlulelo zokuphepha komzimba kanye nokuhlola ukuphepha kolwazi ngokuthi: Qinisekisa amadokhumenti enkampani kwi-PSIRA, ukucwabaabanikeli besevisi kwi-SSA. Phatha ukulawula okhiye. Nikeza izinsiza (Abantu, Izimali, Namathuluzi): Phatha ibhajethi yesigaba ngemigomo yaso enkulu. Hlanganisa ukulawula ibhajethi, ukubuka kanye nokubika ukusebenzisa. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukusebenziswa kugcizelelwe ngokuvumelana nalisu elikhulu. Qaphela futhi ubike ngokusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi. Hlola futhi qaphela ukusebenza nokuhlulelwa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa amandla nentuthuko yabasebenzi. Khulisa futhi gcina ukukhuthazwa kwabasebenzi futhi utshale isiko lokuphathwa kokusebenza. Phatha inzima. Nikeza incazelo yomsebenzi kumabalandeli. Phatha izindaba zokuqhiywa kwesikhathi sabahlule.

jobs.summary: Diesel mechanic artisan needed at Sibasa Mechanical Workshop in Limpopo to service and repair roads-related plant and equipment.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate Trade Test Certificate as Diesel Mechanic. Experience will be an added advantage. Valid driver’s license, with the exception of applicants with disabilities. Knowledge: Relevant Acts and regulations. Road maintenance Manual. Health and safety measures. Technical Competencies: Technical analysis. Computer aided technical applications, Legal compliance, Technical report writing, Technical consulting, Production, process knowledge and skills. Generic Competencies: Problem solving and analysis, Decision making, Team work, Creativity, Self-Management, Customer focus and responsiveness, Communication, Computer skills, Planning and organising.
