Drain oil into container. Re-install the drain plug. Remove filters (oil, fuel & air filter). Examine filter debris. Install new filters. Refill oil and check for leaks and level. Test drive. Service: Check the condition of working area for safety. Determine problem existing. State problem in writing. Visual inspection on machine/ vehicle (for further damage such as leaks boos bolts and cracks). Fix the problem and re-test. Analyse the failure. List all possible causes. Run test and record information. Eliminate and insolate. Provide mechanical expertise: Carry out services as per service category and complete standards. Doing visual and pre-checks inspection on plant before and after service/repairs is carried out as well as the compiling of inspection sheet. Making full report of the findings and completing of job cords after competing any repair or service. Perform per-inspection for additional defects before repairs: Dismantling. Lay-out. Check condition of warn out parts. Repair or replace where necessary and assemble. Clean the object/part and test it. Perform administrative and related functions: Provide inputs on the compilation of technical reports. Keep and maintain job records and other registers. Maintain and adhere to agreed development plan.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: ICT Support Services
jobs.closing_date_text: 05 October 2026 at 16H00 (walk-in and online), late application will not be considered
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for ICT Support Services in the Office of the Premier, North West, managing the provincial ICT service desk and help desk strategy.
jobs.requirements: Three- year appropriate tertiary qualification in Information Technology at NQF level 6 and/or related qualifications (NQF level and credits). 6 years’ experience in ICT services /management at medium to large IT environment of which 3 years should be at Assistant Director Level. ITIL Certificate. Valid Driver’s license. COBIT certification/qualification will be an added advantage. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Knowledge and understanding of ICT frameworks, government policies and prescripts. Knowledge of analysing statistical data. Strong written and verbal communication skills, Problem solving, good customer relations, customer focused, interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence. People management skills, understanding of working with systems, desktop and network support field. Good judgement and decision making.
jobs.duties: Management and monitoring of provincial ICT service desk services. Ensure incidents and problem routing, first line support and escalation are done within services targets. Develop and implement a Help Desk Service Strategy and standard operating procedures. Follow ITIL framework and best practices. Manage and monitor user account activities. Effective and efficient management, supervision and mentor of the helpdesk team, including interns. Track provincial performance statistics and produce daily, monthly and quarterly reports, coupled with an annual improvement plan. Assess need for any system configurations, based on request trends and make recommendations. Communicate ICT service announcements to the clients. Participate in SLA engagements. Implement audit recommendations. Collaborate with other Departments on helpdesk matters.

jobs.summary: Assistant Director role facilitating provincial research and evaluation programmes in the Office of the Premier, requiring a relevant NQF level 7 qualification and 3 to 5 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Three- year appropriate tertiary qualifications in Economics, Social Sciences, Population, Monitoring & Evaluation, Development Studies, Statistics, Innovation or related field at NQF level 7 and equivalent qualification (NQF and credits) 3.-5 years’ experience applicable to the relevant discipline of which 2 years should be at Supervisory level. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Research and Evaluation design techniques and methods, Qualitative and quantitative, Design thinking. data collection and data encoding, Questionnaire design and administration, Understanding of national, provincial and local government structures and relationship, policy analysis, Monitoring and evaluation. Computer literacy skills in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, reporting skills, Critical thinking and analytical skills, Data analysis; using statistical package for both Economic and Social Sciences, Geographical Information systems, Effective communication and writing skills, Negotiation, facilitation and presentation skills, Coordination facilitation skills, Conflict management and Evaluation techniques.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the development and implementation of the Provincial Research and Evaluation Agenda. Facilitate and coordinate capacity building programmes for research and evaluation at Provincial and local spheres. Facilitate research and evaluation projects in support of the Provincial Priorities. Facilitating the establishment of the Provincial Research and Evaluation Technical Working Group. Administering Research and Evaluation Data Warehouse. Foster and sustain partnership with knowledge institutions. Assist in handling research contracts MOU and MOA processes. Assist with Lease, network and build relationships with internal and external research stakeholders. Assist in coordination of innovation in the province.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Navorsing en Evaluering
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur-rol wat provinsiale navorsings- en evalueringsprogramme in die Office of the Premier fasiliteer, wat 'n tersaaklike NQF level 7 kwalifikasie en 3 tot 5 jaar se ondervinding vereis.
af.requirements: Drie jaar toepaslike tersiêre kwalifikasies in Ekonomie, Sosiale Wetenskappe, Bevolking, Monitering & Evaluering, Ontwikkelingstudies, Statistiek, Innovasie of verwante veld op NQF level 7 en ekwivalente kwalifikasie (NQF en krediete) 3.-5 jaar se ondervinding toepaslik op die tersaaklike dissipline waarvan 2 jaar op Toesighoudende vlak moet wees. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Navorsings- en Evalueringsontwerptegnieke en -metodes, Kwalitatief en kwantitatief, Ontwerpsdenke. data-insameling en data-kodering, Vraelysontwerp en -administrasie, Begrip van nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regeringsstrukture en verhouding, beleidsanalise, Monitering en evaluering. Rekenaarvaardighede in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, verslagdoeningsvaardighede, Kritiese denke en analitiese vaardighede, Data-analise; gebruik van statistiese pakket vir beide Ekonomiese en Sosiale Wetenskappe, Geografiese Inligtingstelsels, Effektiewe kommunikasie en skryfvaardighede, Onderhandelings-, fasiliterings- en aanbiedingsvaardighede, Koördinerings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede, Konflikbestuur en Evalueringsmetodes.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Provinsiale Navorsings- en Evaluering Agenda. Fasiliteer en koördineer kapasiteitsbouprogramme vir navorsing en evaluering op Provinsiale en plaaslike vlak. Fasiliteer navorsings- en evalueringsprojekte ter ondersteuning van die Provinsiale Prioriteite. Fasiliteer die vestiging van die Provinsiale Navorsings- en Evaluering Tegniese Werkgroep. Administreer die Navorsings- en Evaluering Data Warehouse. Bou en handhaaf vennootskappe met kennisinstansies. Bystand verleen met die hantering van navorsingskontrakte MOU en MOA prosesse. Bystand verleen met die sluit, netwerk en bou van verhoudings met interne en eksterne navorsingsbelanghebbendes. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van innovasie in die provinsie.

xh.title: Umphathi oncedayo: Uphononongo nokuqwalasela
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi oncedayo sokwenza lula amaqela ophononongo nokuqwalasela esifundazweni kwiOfisi yekaMongameli, esifuna izifundo ezifanelekileyo kumanqanaba abanemfundo ephakamileyo alingana neNQF level 7 naphantse iminyaka engu-3 ukuya kwi-5 yamava.
xh.requirements: Izifundo eziphakamileyo ezifanelekileyo zeminyaka emithathu kwilwimi lezoqoqosho, ezenzululwazi ngabantu, ebungeninani lwabantu, ekuphenyeni nokuqwalaselweni, kwezifundo zentlalo, kwisifundo sezibalo, kwezinto ezitsha okanye kuleyo ndawo enamanqanaba abanemfundo ephakamileyo alingana ne-NQF level 7 nokulingana nayo na mfuno (NQF and credits) 3.-5 years’ experience applicable to the relevant discipline of which 2 years should be at Supervisory level. Iimfuno, amakhono namandla okusebenza: Iindlela nezindlela zekuphanga nokulawula i phononongo nokuqwalasela, ngokwemigaqo nangokobukhali becala, ukucinga ngeyona ndlela yekuphanga i nto. Ukuthwala ulwazi nokuqamba amakhodi olwazi, ukuphanga noku lawula i nawe yomceli mango, ukuqonda isakhiwo nobudlelwane bamazwe ngamazwe, esifundazweni nakumasipala, ukwahlulela iinkqubo zengingqi nokuqwalasela. Amakhono okusebenzisa i khompyutha kwi Excel, Word, PowerPoint, amakhono okubika, ukucinga okubalulekileyo namakhono okuhlola amaxabiso, ukuqwalasela ulwazi; ukusebenzisa i package ezisetyenziswa kwimizobo yezibalo kwi zifundo zezoqoqosho nezentlalo, iinkqubo zemizobo yaselwandle, isithintathu nxaxheba esisebenzayo nobunobloada bokubhala, ukuphepha, ukwenza lula ukusetyenziswa kolwazi namakhono okubonisa, amakhono okulungelelanisa namakhono okulawula iingozi.
xh.duties: Ukwenza lula ukwakhiwa nokusebenza kwe nkqubo ze- Provincial Research and Evaluation Agenda. Ukwenza lula nokulungelelanisa amaqela okwakha amandla ophononongo nokuqwalasela kwimalungu abungazwe nguwo isifundazwe nakomasipala. Ukwenza lula iiprojekthi zophononongo nokuqwalasela ukuxhasa iinkqubela zesifundazwe. Ukwenza lula ukusekwa kweqela elalungiselela uphononongo nokuqwalasela kwicala lelinye iindlela zokuqwalasela ezingenaso isigqibo kwi- Provincial. Ukulawula ulwazi olugcinwa kwithangi lenkcwada zophononongo nokuqwalasela. Ukuxhasa nokugcina ingqwalasela nabalawuli izifundo ngokobungcali. Ukunceda ekulawuleni iinkqubo zangenisleo ze- MOU ne- MOA zamagqabantshintshi ophononongo. Ukunceda ngokuqesha, ukuseka inethiwekhi nokwakha ubudlelwane nabo bonke abantu abanomdla kangangokunako ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukunceda ekulungelelaniseni iindlela ezintsha kulo lonke ulawulo lwesifundazwe kwilwimi le- Provincial.

zu.title: Umlobi osemthethweni osesikhundleni: Abadala kanye Nabantu Abakhubazekile
zu.summary: Hlanganisa futhi uxhase izinhlelo zesifunda zabantu abadala kanye nabaveterani bomzimba ngaphakathi kwe-Office of the Premier eMahikeng.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zethemu zeminyaka emithathu ku-Social Work, Social Sciences, Public Administration noma indlela ehlobene nganinga 6 (NQF kanye namakhaladi) 3.-5 yeminyaka yokuhlolwa kwemvelo ekuphuhliseni komphakathi noma kwemvelo yeyunithi ye-Special Programmes lapho iminyaka emi-2 kufanele ibe budinga lokulawula / ukuhlanganisa. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile Ulwazi, Amakhono namaKhono: I-Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, Older Persons Act, 2006, Social Assistance Act, 2004, Military Veterans Act, 2011, izakhiwo zenqubomgomo yezwe ezihlobene nokuguga, abantu abadala kanye nabaveterani bomzimba, ukululeka, ukubhekezwa nokubika kwahulumeni. amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okuba ngumholi, amakhono ukuhlanganisa, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ukubhala okubikayo, okuthunywayo, ukuphathwa kwabathintekayo, ukuphathwa kwezixabisa, ukululeka kanye namakhono wokuhlela.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa futhi uxhase izinhlelo zesifunda zabantu abadala kanye nabaveterani bomzimba. Qoqa, hlanganisa futhi thumela okubikiwe mayelana nokungenisa endleleni eyisisekelo kanye nembiko yempumelelo yohlelo. Hlanganisa amaforaomu wesifunda ahlobene, izakhiwo kanye nokuxhumana nabathintekayo. Sikela ulwazi kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha ikhono ngamalungelo nezidingo zabantu abadala kanye nabaveterani bomzimba. Bheka ukusetshenziswa kwezomthetho ezifanelekile, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo. Saka futhi zigcine ubudlelwano namaphoyintu ahulumeni, amasipho, izinhlangano zomphakathi kanye nabanye abathintekayo. Hlanganisa imikhosi yokukhumbula, izinhlelo zokuthumela kubantu kanye ne-Annual General Meeting yabadala. Nikeza inkxaso yabasebenzi kanye nabakhono emsebenzini ngaphakathi kweyunithi. Gcina ukushaja okuchanekile kwezinhlelo kanye nezibonakaliso ezethembekile. Wenze omunye umsebenzi onikeziwe ngabaphathi.

jobs.summary: Manage mainframe operations and storage backup, administer contracts and prepare invoice payment reports for the Office of the Premier in Mmabatho.
jobs.requirements: Three-year appropriate tertiary qualification in ICT at NQF level 6 and/ or equivalent qualifications (NQF level and credits). 2 years’ experience in storage backup environment, 2 years exposure in mainframe contract administration and 1 year should be at supervisory level. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Knowledge of information and communication technology, Infrastructure technologies environment, ICT infrastructure invoice and contract administration, report writing, Configurations Software requirements, Network operating systems, Memory management and integration, Knowledge of methods, tools, equipment and material used in server equipment testing, repair and maintenance. Familiar with IT contract management and SITA procurements. Good Communication skills, good telephone etiquette, Report writing skills, Computer skills. Problem solving skills, Project management, Leadership and presentation.
jobs.duties: To render mainframe operations and storage environment. To assist mainframe managers with contract administration. Assist with preparing invoice payments submission. Administration of contract register, Produce monthly and quarterly invoice payment report. Assist mainframe managers with SITA procurements. Assist with the drafting and implementation of Mainframe policies and standard operating procedures to improve mainframe internal controls. Provide salary reports and salary reports distribution. Rendering reports on mainframe system availability. The provision of backup and restores.

jobs.closing_date_text: 05 October 2026 at 16H00 (walk-in and online), late application will not be considered

af.summary: Assistent-verpleegbestuurder vir nagdiens by Helderberg Hospital, met toesig oor strategiese verpleegdoelwitte, koördinering van gehalte-sorg en menslike en finansiële hulpbronbestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n 4-jarige Baccalaureus-graad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Huidige registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 8 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 3 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, openbare vakansiedae, na ure, bystand en naweekdekking vir verpleegkunde en te reis om amptelike vergaderings en/of opleiding by te woon. Waarneem vir die Adjunkbestuurder Verpleegkunde: Hoof van Verpleegkunde en bereidwilligheid om vir 'n ander lid van die Verpleegbestuurspan waar te neem. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goed op die hoogte van relevante wetgewing rakende arbeidsverhoudinge, verpleegwetgewing, verwante wettige en etiese verpleegpraktyke, en relevante openbare-sektorbelede en -protokolle. Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wettige en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Toon 'n duidelike begrip van Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer, Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, en Risikobestuur – insluitend die Ideal Hospital Framework en die Office of Health Standard Compliance. Bestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede en -waardes: integriteit, innoverende visioenêr, katalisator vir verandering, selfbewustheid en selfvertroue, delegasie, aanspreeklikheid, probleemoplossing en besluitneming, konflikhantering, interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Baie kundig en toon 'n goeie begrip van Personeelsbestuur (Menslike Hulpbronbestuur). Toon 'n goeie begrip van finansiële beleide en praktyke. Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook.
af.duties: Algehele koördinering, implementering en monitering van die strategiese verpleegpraktykdoelwitte tydens nagdiens in die hospitaal. Doeltreffende bestuur en koördinering van gehalte-verpleegsorg binne vasgestelde standaarde binne wettige en professionele raamwerke. Bestuur en fasiliteer beide menslike hulpbronne en finansiële aspekte rakende die hospitaal. Bestuur van inligting deur die versameling en ontleding van data, skryf van verslae en ontwikkeling en implementering van toepaslike ingrypings. Beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering. Verseker dat kliniese verpleegpraktyk deur die verpleegspan gelewer word en bevorder die gehalte van verpleegsore soos gerig deur die omvang van praktyk en standaarde.

xh.title: Assistant Manager Nursing: General (NIGHT Duty)
xh.summary: UmLawuli ongomNcedisi wakwa-Nursing owenza umsebenzi wobusuku eHelderberg Hospital, oqhuba iinjongo ezibalulekileyo zoonongoma, ulungelelaniso lokunakekelwa kakuhle, nokuLawula amathuba abantu nezimali.
xh.requirements: Isimfuno esingowapha baseline samaphuphu: Isimfuno seR425 (okt. diploma/idigri kwizongoma) okanye isimfuno esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiNongoma seGarda eliphezulu. I-Bachelor Degree yeminyaka eyi-4 kwizongoma (R174) okanye isimfuno esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiNongoma seGarda eliphezulu. Ukubhaliswa kwiNkundla yabachwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kwi-SANC njengesiNongoma seGarda eliphezulu. Isipili: Iminyaka elinganayo i-8 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo kwizongoma emva kokubhaliswa njengesiNongoma seGarda eliphezulu kwi-SANC kwizongoma zeGarda jikelele. Ubuncinane i-3 yeminyaka yexesha elityunywe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo kwinqanaba lobulawulo. Iimfuno ezingokwemvelo zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yomqhubi (Code B/EB) eseleyo. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa kweshifithi, iholide zasoluntu, emva kweyure yomsebenzi, ukumila nokulungelelanisa iintsuku zophel0 kwizongoma nakumahlule njengoko kufunekayo nokuhamba ukuze kubekho iindibano ezisemthethweni kunye/nokomelezo wokufundela. Ukumela i Deputy Manager Nursing: Head of Nursing nokulungele ukubakho njengomntu owayo kulunye ilungu leqela loBulawulo baseNursing. Isakhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukuba nolwazi ngomthetho ohambelana noxhumaniso lwabasebenzi, umthetho wezongoma, amasiko obuchwepheshe abuhlobene nomthetho wakwa-Islam nolungelelaniso lwezongoma, iinqobo ezahambelana nooqobo bantorhu kunye neendlela ezisetyenziswa kwindawo yokusebenza. Bonisa ukuqonda ngokubanzi umthetho wezongoma kunye namakiko obuchwepheshe ahlobene nomthetho nolungelelaniso lwezongoma. Ukuqonda ngokucaceileyo ukusika iingozi kunxulumene noLawulo lokuQwalasela iingozi ezingelona iindaba ezimnandi nobuGcisa bezona – kuquka i-Ideal Hospital Framework neNyuvesi yokuQinisekisa iSimo sezoNkonzo. Izakhono zobulawulo nokuqhuba amandla amakhulu: ukuzinikela, ukuba ngumntu onengqondo entsha, ukwenza utshintsho, ukuqonda ngokwakho nokuqina, ukwabelana ngemisebenzi, ibango, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqamba iigqibo, ukusombulula iingxabano, izakhono zoxhumaniso nokuba kuchwepheshe bokuziqonda ngamanye. Ulwazi oluninzi kwaye ubonise ukuqonda okuhle ngokuLawula abaBantu (Human Resource Management). Ubonise ukuqonda okuhle ngeendlela zomthetho ezijolise kwimali zokusebenza. Ukuqonda ngokusebenzisa iikhompyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook.
xh.duties: Ukulungelelanisa ngokubanzi, ukuqalisa nokuhlola iinjongo zokusebenza koonongoma ngobusuku kwisibhedlele. Ukulawula ngokusebenzayo nokuco-orda ukunakekelwa kakuhle koonongoma ngaphakathi kwemigangatho e miselweyo ngaphakathi kweziqendu ezingundoqo nezobuchwepheshe. Ukulawula kwaye wenze lula izinto ezibhekisa kumathuba abantu nezimali ezidityaniswe nesibhedlele. Ukulawula ulwazi ngokuthatha ngokubakonze kwaye kuqwalaselwe iingcombolo, ukubhala iingxelo, nokuqamba nokusebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokungena phakathi. Ukwenza iindlela zokusebenza kwaye zisebenze. Qinisekisa ukuba ukunakekelwa kokongoma kwenziwa ngqo lilungu leqela loonongoma kwaye kuthuthuzwe ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kokongoma njengoko kuyalwa lingakaniso lokusebenza nemigangatho.
